paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) have taken the world by storm. Their ability to communicate with us in our own language, and to reason about our world, has made them a favorite tool for writing, answering questions, and much more.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已经席卷全球。 它们能够用我们自己的语言与我们交流，并对我们的世界进行推理，这使其成为写作、回答问题以及更多用途的热门工具。

sents.en: Large language models (LLMs) have taken the world by storm.
sents.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已经席卷全球。

sents.en: Their ability to communicate with us in our own language, and to reason about our world, has made them a favorite tool for writing, answering questions, and much more.
sents.zh: 它们能够用我们自己的语言与我们交流，并对我们的世界进行推理，这使其成为写作、回答问题以及更多用途的热门工具。

paragraphs.en: Their answers already influence our decisions and our actions. What would happen if LLMs themselves could act in the world directly? What would happen if LLMs could interact with each other? Agentic LLMs combine the power of large language models with the ability to act in the real world. In this book we will discuss how agentic LLMs work, how they act, how they interact, and what this means for us, as users.
paragraphs.zh: 他们的回答已经影响了我们的决策和行动。 如果大型语言模型本身能够直接在世界中行动，会发生什么？ 如果大型语言模型能够相互互动，会发生什么？ 智能体型大型语言模型将大型语言模型的能力与在现实世界中行动的能力相结合。 在本书中，我们将探讨智能体型大型语言模型如何运作、如何行动、如何互动，以及这对我们作为用户意味着什么。

sents.en: Their answers already influence our decisions and our actions.
sents.zh: 他们的回答已经影响了我们的决策和行动。

sents.en: What would happen if LLMs themselves could act in the world directly?
sents.zh: 如果大型语言模型本身能够直接在世界中行动，会发生什么？

sents.en: What would happen if LLMs could interact with each other?
sents.zh: 如果大型语言模型能够相互互动，会发生什么？

sents.en: Agentic LLMs combine the power of large language models with the ability to act in the real world.
sents.zh: 智能体型大型语言模型将大型语言模型的能力与在现实世界中行动的能力相结合。

sents.en: In this book we will discuss how agentic LLMs work, how they act, how they interact, and what this means for us, as users.
sents.zh: 在本书中，我们将探讨智能体型大型语言模型如何运作、如何行动、如何互动，以及这对我们作为用户意味着什么。

paragraphs.en: Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing the world. Large language models that act change the world in a new way. In order to understand the extent of these changes it is important for students and researchers of AI to understand both the technology itself and the applications that are now emerging. This understanding can help us influence the direction of these developments, perhaps build in safeguards, and, specifically, it will help us to develop the field further.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能（AI）正在改变世界。 能够执行操作的大型语言模型正以全新的方式改变世界。 为了理解这些变化的程度，人工智能领域的学生和研究人员有必要既了解技术本身，也了解当前正在出现的应用。 这种理解有助于我们影响这些发展的方向，或许还能在其中建立 safeguards；尤其重要的是，它将帮助我们进一步拓展这一领域。

paragraphs.en: This book has been written for the graduate course on agentic LLMs that we teach at our university. In agentic LLMs two fields of AI research come together: the study of agents, and the study of large language models. Agents are changing the field of LLMs, and, conversely, LLMs are changing the field of agents. Although there are excellent books about LLMs and how they work (such as Jurafsky and Martin (2025) ), the ability to act puts agentic LLMs in a class of their own. We think that there is a need for a course and for a book that explain how agentic LLMs work, and how they enable things that were not possible before.
paragraphs.zh: 本书是为我们在大学开设的关于智能体式大型语言模型（agentic LLMs）的研究生课程而编写的。 在智能体式大型语言模型中，人工智能研究的两个领域得以融合：智能体的研究以及大型语言模型的研究。 智能体正在改变大型语言模型这一领域，而反过来，大型语言模型也在改变智能体这一领域。 尽管已有许多关于大型语言模型及其运作方式的优秀书籍（例如 Jurafsky 和 Martin（2025）），但行动能力使智能体式大型语言模型独树一帜。 我们认为，有必要开设一门课程并编写一本书籍，来解释智能体式大型语言模型的运作方式，以及它们如何实现了以往无法实现的事情。

paragraphs.en: The strength of the language abilities of LLMs is impressive, they talk just like we do. Now that LLMs have become agentic, their horizon extends far beyond talking: LLMs have capabilities for reasoning , for using tools such as writing and running code, for browsing the web to retrieve information, and for interacting with other agents or with the outside world.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型的语言能力令人印象深刻，它们说话的方式和我们完全一样。 如今，大语言模型已经具备智能体特性，其能力范围远远超出了单纯的对话：它们能够进行推理，使用写作和运行代码等工具，浏览网页以获取信息，以及与其他智能体或外部世界进行交互。

paragraphs.en: This brings us to two definitions that we use in this book.
paragraphs.zh: 这引出了我们在本书中使用的两个定义。

paragraphs.en: Agents perform actions, observe the effect of these actions and use the feedback they receive from the world to adapt their action policy. Agentic LLMs are agents that integrate the power of LLMs, such as to communicate using natural language, write code, or process information.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体执行动作，观察这些动作的效果，并利用从世界中获得的反馈来调整其行动策略。 智能型大语言模型是融合了大语言模型能力的智能体，例如能够使用自然语言进行通信、编写代码或处理信息。

sents.en: The ability to act has increased the relevance and applicability of LLMs in many domains of society.
sents.zh: 行动能力的提升增强了大型语言模型在社会诸多领域的相关性和适用性。

sents.en: How are agentic LLMs used?
sents.zh: 智能型大型语言模型是如何被使用的？

sents.en: In this book, we distinguish two major classes of use cases for Agentic LLMs:
sents.zh: 在本书中，我们将智能型大型语言模型的使用场景分为两大类：

paragraphs.en: (1) Agentic LLMs are used to assist their human users in application domains such as medicine, logistics, and finance (Part IV).
paragraphs.zh: （1）智能体式大型语言模型被用于在医疗、物流和金融等应用领域协助其人类用户（第四部分）。

paragraphs.en: (2) Agentic LLMs are used to interact with each other to perform tasks or function in simulations of human behavior (Part V).
paragraphs.zh: （2）智能体式大型语言模型被用于相互交互，以执行任务或在人类行为模拟中发挥作用（第五部分）。

paragraphs.en: Many research papers have been published in recent years in both domains. We will provide overviews of key studies and trends throughout the book.
paragraphs.zh: 近年来，这两个领域都发表了大量研究论文。 我们将在整本书中介绍关键研究和趋势的概述。

sents.zh: 我们将在整本书中介绍关键研究和趋势的概述。

paragraphs.en: From an engineering perspective, how do we construct agentic LLMs? Agentic LLMs consist of two elements: (1) the LLM, and (2) a piece of code that is called the harness .
paragraphs.zh: 从工程角度来看，我们该如何构建智能体式大语言模型？ 智能体式大语言模型由两个要素组成：（1）大语言模型，以及（2）一段被称为“控制程序”的代码。

sents.en: From an engineering perspective, how do we construct agentic LLMs?
sents.zh: 从工程角度来看，我们该如何构建智能体式大语言模型？

sents.en: Agentic LLMs consist of two elements: (1) the LLM, and (2) a piece of code that is called the harness .
sents.zh: 智能体式大语言模型由两个要素组成：（1）大语言模型，以及（2）一段被称为“控制程序”的代码。

paragraphs.en: The harness is a piece of computer code that wraps around the model and controls how it is called (a horse’s harness helps us guide the power of the noble animal in a productive direction). The harness performs tasks such as prompt construction, answer processing, calling external tools, state management, system prompt management, and skill management. The harness loops through the reasoning, acting, and observing that are necessary for task completion, without the need for human intervention to guide the process manually. The agentic harness can thus be seen as a versatile automatic prompt engineer (Part II, Chapter 6 ). Importantly, the harness may adapt the behavior policy of the agent based on feedback on its actions, using reinforcement learning (Part III, Chapter 9 ).
paragraphs.zh: 智能体框架是一段计算机代码，它包裹住模型并控制其调用方式（就像马具能帮助我们引导这匹高贵动物的力量朝有益的方向发挥）。 智能体框架执行诸如提示构建、答案处理、调用外部工具、状态管理、系统提示管理和技能管理等任务。 智能体框架会循环执行完成任务所需的推理、行动和观察过程，无需人类介入手动引导流程。 因此，智能体框架可被视为一种功能多样的自动提示工程师（第二部分，第六章）。 重要的是，智能体框架可以通过强化学习，根据对其行动的反馈来调整智能体的行为策略（第三部分，第九章）。

paragraphs.en: Understanding natural language is crucial for agents that interact with users and the world around them. However, for many tasks agents must also process other modalities, such as visual information, or other text formats, such as spreadsheets or computer code. As such, the domain of agentic LLMs extends beyond natural language, and includes multi-modal, code, and world models. Therefore, please note that in this book we use the term LLM pragmatically—depending on the context it can refer to language-only systems, or it can have a broader scope: large transformer-based model that processes natural language, computer code, images, tool-commands, or other relevant modalities (Part II, Chapter 7 ). In cases where the distinction is important, we flag which variant of the definition applies.
paragraphs.zh: 理解自然语言对于与用户及周围世界互动的智能体而言至关重要。 然而，在许多任务中，智能体还必须处理其他模态，例如视觉信息，或其他文本格式，如电子表格或计算机代码。 因此，智能体式大型语言模型（LLM）的领域已超越自然语言，还包括多模态、代码和世界模型。 因此，请注意，在本书中我们对“LLM”一词的使用是灵活的——根据上下文，它既可以指仅处理语言的系统，也可以指更广泛的范畴：一种基于Transformer的大型模型，能够处理自然语言、计算机代码、图像、工具命令或其他相关模态（第二部分，第七章）。 在需要明确区分的情况下，我们会标注所采用的定义版本。

paragraphs.en: Agentic LLMs mark another paradigm shift in LLM engineering, that is related to machine learning. For a long time, the learning-emphasis in the field of LLMs has been on learning during model training, but now there is an increasing role for learning at inference time, when the model is queried.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式大语言模型标志着大语言模型工程领域的又一次范式转变，这与机器学习相关。 长期以来，大语言模型领域的学习重点一直放在模型训练过程中的学习上，但现在，在推理阶段（即模型被查询时）的学习也发挥着越来越重要的作用。

sents.en: Agentic LLMs mark another paradigm shift in LLM engineering, that is related to machine learning.
sents.zh: 智能体式大语言模型标志着大语言模型工程领域的又一次范式转变，这与机器学习相关。

sents.en: For a long time, the learning-emphasis in the field of LLMs has been on learning during model training, but now there is an increasing role for learning at inference time, when the model is queried.
sents.zh: 长期以来，大语言模型领域的学习重点一直放在模型训练过程中的学习上，但现在，在推理阶段（即模型被查询时）的学习也发挥着越来越重要的作用。

paragraphs.en: This has two advantages. First, it creates flexibility and space for dynamic agentic behavior, as we will see in Chapters 8 and 9 . Second, in an era where almost the entire internet has been used as data for pretraining models ( Sutskever, 2024 ) , it has become useful to generate additional, relevant, and high-quality data. By interacting with the world, agents can generate such new data themselves. Figure 1.1 illustrates this process. This interaction-data can be used for additional training.
paragraphs.zh: 这有两个优势。 首先，它创造了灵活性和空间，使得动态的智能体行为成为可能，我们将在第 8 章和第 9 章中看到这一点。 其次，在一个几乎整个互联网都被用作模型预训练数据（Sutskever, 2024）的时代，生成额外的、相关且高质量的数据变得很有价值。 通过与世界互动，智能体可以自行生成这类新数据。 图 1.1 展示了这一过程。 这种互动所产生的数据可用于进一步的训练。

paragraphs.en: An example of how LLMs are trained on their own agentic actions are vision-language-action models that learn from robotic action sequences (Chapter 7 ). Another example can be found in Chapter 17 , where societies of agents allow models to become more intelligent through interaction, just like humans learn new behaviors and ideas when they interact with one another.
paragraphs.zh: 一个关于大型语言模型如何基于其自身智能体行为的训练示例是视觉-语言-动作模型，这些模型通过从机器人动作序列中学习来改进（第 7 章）。 另一个例子可以在第 17 章中找到，其中智能体社会允许模型通过互动变得更智能，就像人类在相互互动时学习新的行为和想法一样。

paragraphs.en: Thus, in addition to enabling useful applications, another driver of agentic LLMs is the opportunity to generate more training data, creating a recursive self-improvement loop. In Figure 1.1 this virtuous cycle of interactive data generation is shown. Shown in red are the main categories: reasoning (Part II), acting (Parts III/IV), and interacting (Part V). In green are concepts that influence a category, either directly, or in a feedback loop.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，除了能够启用实用应用之外，智能体式大型语言模型的另一大驱动力是生成更多训练数据的机会，从而形成一个递归的自我改进循环。 图 1.1 展示了这种交互式数据生成的良性循环。 红色部分显示的是主要类别：推理（第二部分）、行动（第三/四部分）和互动（第五部分）。 绿色部分则是影响某一类别的概念，这些影响可能是直接的，也可能是通过反馈循环实现的。

paragraphs.en: This book is primarily written for graduate students and researchers in artificial intelligence and computer science. It may also be of interest to students and scholars from other fields, such as the cognitive and social sciences or humanities, as long as they have an intrinsic drive to engage with machine learning and technological challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 本书主要面向人工智能和计算机科学领域的研究生及研究人员。 只要他们具有学习机器学习和应对技术挑战的内在动力，其他领域（如认知科学、社会科学或人文学科）的学生和学者也可能对此感兴趣。

paragraphs.en: The book’s aim is to introduce and review the advancements of techniques and applications in the field of agentic LLMs. We discuss the major concepts of agentic LLM engineering in some depth. We provide references to the scientific literature as well as links to source code and datasets so that you can experiment with building your own agents. Note that the field is new, and still very much in motion. A thorough understanding of the basics is important in order to be able to follow the latest developments. Our aim is to provide you with both.
paragraphs.zh: 本书旨在介绍并回顾智能体大语言模型（agentic LLMs）领域在技术和应用方面的进展。 我们将深入探讨智能体大语言模型工程的主要概念。 我们提供了科学文献的参考，以及源代码和数据集的链接，以便您能够尝试构建自己的智能体。 请注意，该领域尚属新兴，仍处于快速发展阶段。 要能够跟上最新的发展动态，全面理解基础知识至关重要。 我们的目标是为您提供这两方面的内容。

paragraphs.en: This book assumes that you have an undergraduate-level understanding of computer programming, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and natural language processing.
paragraphs.zh: 本书假设您具备计算机编程、人工智能、机器学习和自然语言处理方面的本科水平知识。

paragraphs.en: We assume that you know how to use Python and PyTorch. We also assume that you understand principles of machine learning, such as the difference between classification and regression, the difference between a training set and a test set, and the causes of overfitting and underfitting. You should know classical machine learning approaches such as decision trees, ensembles, and random forests. You should also be familiar with concepts of deep learning such as the architectures of artificial neural networks (fully connected multilayer perceptrons, convolutional neural networks, and recurrent neural networks), learning by backpropagation, with loss functions (such as cross-entropy) and activation functions (such as ReLU). We also expect that you are familiar with reinforcement learning: you should know what a sequential decision problem is, understand the difference between agent and environment, and know how to use some policy learning algorithms (such as Q-learning, DQN, PPO, and SAC). Finally, you should have an understanding of natural language processing: what is tokenization, what are word embeddings, what is attention, and what is Huggingface.
paragraphs.zh: 我们假设您知道如何使用 Python 和 PyTorch。 我们还假设您理解机器学习的基本原理，例如分类与回归的区别、训练集与测试集的区别，以及过拟合和欠拟合的原因。 您应该了解经典的机器学习方法，例如决策树、集成学习和随机森林。 您还应该熟悉深度学习的相关概念，例如人工神经网络的架构（全连接多层感知器、卷积神经网络和循环神经网络）、反向传播学习、损失函数（如交叉熵）和激活函数（如 ReLU）。 我们还希望您熟悉强化学习：您应该了解什么是序列决策问题，理解智能体与环境之间的区别，并知道如何使用一些策略学习算法（如 Q-learning、DQN、PPO 和 SAC）。 最后，您应该对自然语言处理有一定了解：什么是分词、什么是词嵌入、什么是注意力机制，以及什么是 Huggingface。

paragraphs.en: We use this book for the graduate course Agentic LLMs at our university. The book has been written to be both concise and comprehensive: we cover the full breadth of the field at a level suitable for a graduate course. To allow you to go deeper, we provide many pointers to the scientific literature, and some advanced topics are covered in the chapters and sections that are marked with a *.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用这本书作为我们学校“智能体大语言模型”研究生课程的教材。 本书的编写力求既简洁又全面：我们以适合研究生课程的水平，涵盖了该领域的全部核心内容。 为了帮助读者更深入地学习，我们提供了大量指向科学文献的参考信息，部分高级主题则包含在标有 * 的章节和节中。

paragraphs.en: Different university programs may cover different material (see Table 1.1 ). The course that we teach is comprehensive, and consists of 14 lectures: an introductory lecture, then 3 lectures on part I (language modeling), 3 lectures on parts II (reasoning) and III (agents), 3 lectures on part IV (tools and assistants), and 3 lectures on part V (social simulation). The course ends with a final evaluation lecture. Our course includes as assignments the four case studies, which we grade in an in-person meeting with the student. We do not have a separate theory exam at the end, the course grade is the average of the assignment grades.
paragraphs.zh: 不同大学的课程可能涵盖不同的内容（参见表 1.1）。 我们教授的课程内容全面，共包含 14 次讲座：一次入门讲座，接着是第 I 部分（语言建模）的 3 次讲座、第 II 部分（推理）和第 III 部分（智能体）的 3 次讲座、第 IV 部分（工具与助手）的 3 次讲座，以及第 V 部分（社会模拟）的 3 次讲座。 课程最后会有一次最终评估讲座。 我们的课程将四份案例研究作为作业，我们会在与学生面对面的会议中对其进行评分。 我们在课程结束时没有单独的理论知识考试，课程成绩是各项作业分数的平均值。

paragraphs.en: Although you are of course free to use the book in any way that makes sense in your situation, we cover two main use cases for agentic LLMs: (1) assistants and (2) social simulation.
paragraphs.zh: 当然，您完全可以根据自身情况以任何合理的方式使用本书，但我们将重点介绍智能体式大型语言模型的两个主要应用场景：（1）助手和（2）社会模拟。

paragraphs.en: When your program includes a separate in-depth course on LLMs, then a core program to focus on (1) agentic assistants can include just parts II, III and IV. For the assignments, we suggest case study 2 and 3.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你的课程包含一门关于大型语言模型的独立深度课程，那么核心课程可以仅包括第二部分、第三部分和第四部分，重点聚焦于（1）智能体助手。 对于作业，我们建议选用案例研究 2 和 3。

paragraphs.en: Both the assistants and the social simulation approach can be augmented with part I (language modeling), as necessary, depending on how the education program at your University is structured.

paragraphs.en: Part VI contains advanced topics. Chapter 19 , on synthetic data generation, is suitable for the assistants use case, Part IV. Chapter 20 , on advanced architectures, is also suitable for Part II. Chapter 22 , on cognitive architectures, is suitable for the social simulation use case, Part V.

paragraphs.en: Part I provides a basic introduction to large language models. Chapter 2 discusses important natural language processing concepts such as tokenization, embeddings, recurrent neural networks, the attention mechanism, the transformer architecture, and autoregressive training (the machine learning method that is central to how LLMs are trained). We also discuss further machine learning methods: supervised learning and reinforcement learning. Next, in Chapter 3 we discuss in some detail the training pipeline that is used to train LLMs. We discuss dataset acquisition, pretraining, finetuning, instruction tuning, value alignment, and inference. We also discuss benchmarks that are commonly used to test the performance of LLMs. In Chapter 4 we discuss scaling laws and small language models, and we discuss energy consumption. To be able to use agentic LLMs, you must understand the basics of pretraining and finetuning a transformer model. In the final chapter of Part I, we help you acquire this experience with a practical case study where we will guide you to train a transformer model from scratch.
paragraphs.zh: 第一部分对大型语言模型进行了基础介绍。 第二章探讨了自然语言处理的重要概念，例如分词、嵌入、循环神经网络、注意力机制、Transformer 架构以及自回归训练（这是训练大型语言模型的核心机器学习方法）。 我们还进一步讨论了其他机器学习方法：监督学习和强化学习。 接下来，在第三章中，我们将较为详细地讨论用于训练大型语言模型的训练流程。 我们将探讨数据集获取、预训练、微调、指令调优、价值观对齐以及推理。 我们还将讨论常用于测试大型语言模型性能的基准测试。 在第四章中，我们将探讨扩展定律、小型语言模型以及能源消耗问题。 为了能够使用智能体型大型语言模型，你必须理解 Transformer 模型预训练和微调的基础知识。 在第一部分的最后一章中，我们将通过一个实践案例研究帮助你掌握这些经验，并指导你从头开始训练一个 Transformer 模型。

paragraphs.en: Part II provides an introduction into the concepts of reasoning, reflection, and world models, three concepts that are essential elements of (advanced) agentic LLMs. In Chapter 6 we start with in-context learning, and discuss how the chain of thought method has enabled LLMs to perform multi-step reasoning in simple math word problems. We will discuss how LLMs are used to self-reflect on their own in-context learning, to enhance their reasoning power, using a harness. So far, we have focused on models that use language. To act in the real world, our agents will also have to understand image data, and other modalities. In Chapter 7 we go beyond language and discuss models that understand vision and language, and also models that learn from decision sequences and know how to perform robotic actions. To act in the world without walking into walls, agents need some understanding of physics. In Chapter 7 we discuss world models, including their relation to model-based reinforcement learning. At that point, we will have discussed a multitude of different ways in which the agents learn and interact with their environment. In Chapter 8 we discuss in more depth how they learn, and how this learning is a form of metalearning.
paragraphs.zh: 第二部分介绍了推理、反思和世界模型这些概念，它们是（高级）智能体式大型语言模型的关键要素。 在第六章中，我们从上下文学习开始，讨论思维链方法如何使大型语言模型能够解决简单的数学文字题中的多步推理问题。 我们将探讨如何利用约束机制，让大型语言模型对自身的上下文学习进行自我反思，从而增强其推理能力。 到目前为止，我们一直关注使用语言模型的模型。 为了在现实世界中行动，我们的智能体还需要理解图像数据和其他模态信息。 在第七章中，我们将超越语言领域，讨论能够理解视觉和语言信息的模型，以及能够从决策序列中学习并执行机器人动作的模型。 为了避免撞墙，智能体需要对物理世界有一定的理解。 在第七章中，我们将讨论世界模型，包括它们与基于模型的强化学习之间的关系。 到那时，我们将已经探讨了智能体学习和与环境交互的多种不同方式。 在第八章中，我们将更深入地讨论它们的学习机制，以及这种学习如何构成一种元学习形式。

paragraphs.en: Next, in Part III, Chapter 9 provides a historic review of agents in the perspective of artificial intelligence, and we discuss different agentic interaction styles of agentic LLMs. Furthermore, in order to act in the world, agents need a form of memory. We discuss different agentic memory architectures in this chapter. We conclude Part III with a practical case study, where you can build a self-reflecting agent for challenging puzzles and games from the BALROG benchmarking suite.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，在第三部分中，第 9 章从人工智能的角度对智能体进行了历史回顾，并讨论了智能体式大语言模型的不同智能体交互模式。 此外，为了在现实世界中采取行动，智能体需要某种形式的记忆。 本章将讨论不同的智能体记忆架构。 第三部分将以一个实践案例研究作结，其中你可以构建一个具备自我反思能力的智能体，用于解决 BALROG 基准测试套件中的复杂谜题和游戏。

paragraphs.en: In Part IV we switch gears, from theoretical concepts to practical implementations. We provide a discussion of the frameworks that have been developed in the community to implement agentic LLMs, and for them to use tools to act in the world. Some are proprietary, but many are open, and can be downloaded from Github. In this part, we discuss agents that act and perform practical tasks for their users. In Chapter 11 we discuss toolchains, frameworks and APIs that have been developed to implement agentic LLMs. In Chapter 12 we discuss retrieval augmentation methods and other methods to search for up to date information that was not available when the LLM was trained. Chapter 13 provides an overview of practical applications of agentic LLMs. We discuss applications of LLMs such as shopping assistants, medical assistants, trading assistants, and assistants that help perform scientific research. In the final chapter of Part IV we conclude with a practical case study of how to build a medical diagnosis agent (also to help you understand its shortcomings, so that you will never blindly follow an agent’s medical advice).
paragraphs.zh: 在第四部分，我们将转变方向，从理论概念转向实际实现。 我们将讨论社区中为实施智能体式大型语言模型（LLM）而开发的框架，以及这些模型如何利用工具在现实世界中采取行动。 其中一些是专有框架，但许多是开源的，可以从 Github 下载。 在本部分，我们将讨论能够行动并为用户执行实际任务的智能体。 在第 11 章中，我们将讨论为实施智能体式大型语言模型（LLM）而开发的工具链、框架和 API。 在第 12 章中，我们将讨论检索增强方法以及其他用于搜索大型语言模型训练时无法获取的最新信息的方法。 第 13 章概述了智能体式大型语言模型（LLM）的实际应用。 我们将讨论大型语言模型（LLM）的应用，例如购物助手、医疗助手、交易助手以及协助进行科学研究的各种助手。 在第四部分的最后一章中，我们将通过一个构建医疗诊断智能体的实际案例研究来总结（这也有助于你了解其局限性，从而避免盲目听从智能体的医疗建议）。

paragraphs.en: Part V takes a different point of view: we look at agentic LLMs through a behavioral and cognitive lens, rather than a technical one. After defining and introducing machine-behavioral research in general, Chapter 15 discusses single LLMs and agentic LLMs in controlled, experimental settings to test their social behavior. Chapter 16 shifts to multi-agent systems, first discussing role-based interactions, where agentic LLMs are built or prompted to perform a certain role and interact in goal-directed ways. Next, in Chapter 17 we move to systems comprising multiple agents that interact in open-ended ways and study emergent behaviors , such as cooperation and norm-enforcement. The case study allows you to experience social agentic behavior in-depth.
paragraphs.zh: 第五部分提出了不同的观点：我们从行为和认知的角度，而非技术角度来审视具有智能体能力的 LLM。 在总体定义并介绍机器行为研究之后，第 15 章将在受控的实验环境中探讨单个 LLM 和具有智能体能力的 LLM，以测试它们的社会行为。 第 16 章转向多智能体系统，首先讨论基于角色的互动，其中具有智能体能力的 LLM 会被构建或提示来执行特定角色，并以目标导向的方式互动。 接下来，在第 17 章中，我们将转向由多个智能体组成的系统，这些智能体以开放的方式互动，并研究涌现行为，例如合作和规范执行。 这个案例研究能让你深入体验社会性智能体行为。

paragraphs.en: The next part, Part VI, contains more advanced material. Chapter 19 discusses synthetic data generation. Like all forms of deep learning, LLMs remain to a large extent a black box, and we discuss techniques that can lift a corner of the veil. Chapter 20 discusses advanced architectures. We discuss transformers that are trained on decision traces, and looped and recursive LLMs. We also discuss advanced agentic architectures: in-context reinforcement learning, self-modifying agents and meta agents. Chapter 21 focuses on tools from mechanistic interpretability to map patterns of neuronal activity in transformer architectures, allowing to better understand the reasoning processes of LLMs. In Chapter 22 we review recent literature on behavior and cognition in Agentic LLMs, including advanced questions on Theory of Mind and consciousness.
paragraphs.zh: 下一部分，即第六部分，包含更高级的内容。 第 19 章讨论合成数据生成。 与所有形式的深度学习一样，大型语言模型在很大程度上仍然是一个黑箱，我们将讨论能够揭开这一神秘面纱一部分的技术。 第 20 章讨论高级架构。 我们将讨论在决策轨迹上训练的 Transformer，以及循环和递归的大型语言模型。 我们还将讨论高级智能体架构：上下文强化学习、自我修改的智能体和元智能体。 第 21 章重点介绍来自机制可解释性的工具，用于绘制 Transformer 架构中神经元活动的模式，从而更好地理解大型语言模型的推理过程。 在第 22 章中，我们将回顾关于智能体大型语言模型行为与认知的近期文献，包括心智理论和意识方面的高级问题。

sents.en: In Chapter 22 we review recent literature on behavior and cognition in Agentic LLMs, including advanced questions on Theory of Mind and consciousness.

paragraphs.en: In this first part we discuss the basics of language modeling and machine learning. We start with basic principles of how language can be modeled, using tokens and embeddings. Next, the attention concept is discussed, a concept that is at the foundation of the transformer architecture, and the success of large language models. We will also review two important machine learning techniques: supervised learning and reinforcement learning. In the next chapter, we become more concrete, and discuss the steps of a typical training pipeline, from pretraining and finetuning to inference. We also discuss common benchmarks in that chapter. The final content chapter of this first part is about the large part of large language models: we discuss how performance of LLMs scales with parameter count, training data and compute, and we delve into efficient models that benefit from scale while minimizing cost. At the end of the part, we turn to a hands-on case study, where you will learn how everything comes together when you create your own tiny large language model from scratch.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一部分中，我们将讨论语言模型和机器学习的基础知识。 我们将从语言建模的基本原理入手，介绍如何使用词元和嵌入来表示语言。 接下来，我们将探讨注意力机制这一概念——它不仅是 Transformer 架构的基础，也是大型语言模型取得成功的关键。 我们还将回顾两种重要的机器学习技术：监督学习和强化学习。 在下一章中，内容将变得更加具体，我们将讨论典型训练流程的各个步骤，从预训练和微调到推理阶段。 在这一章中，我们还会介绍一些常用的基准测试。 第一部分最后一章的内容聚焦于大型语言模型的核心问题：我们将探讨 LLM 的性能如何随参数数量、训练数据和计算资源的变化而扩展，并深入研究那些在控制成本的同时能受益于规模效应的轻量化模型。 在本部分结束时，我们将进入一个实践案例研究，学习如何从头开始构建自己的小型大型语言模型，从而理解所有技术环节是如何协同工作的。

paragraphs.en: Language is the primary medium through which humans communicate. Language comes in forms spanning from printed books, digital media to spoken discourse. Language research has long been a focal point of multidisciplinary research. Within the context of artificial intelligence and computer science, language is of particular significance: we use it to articulate complex ideas, we formulate algorithms in programming languages, and we use it to facilitate interaction between software and its users.
paragraphs.zh: 语言是人类交流的主要媒介。 语言的形式多种多样，从印刷书籍、数字媒体到口头表达不一而足。 语言研究长期以来一直是多学科研究的焦点之一。 在人工智能和计算机科学的领域内，语言具有特别重要的意义：我们用它来表达复杂的思想，用编程语言编写算法，并借助它促进软件与用户之间的互动。

paragraphs.en: For decades, a key aim of AI has been to unlock the ability for machines to understand human-produced language, as is argued by Jurafsky and Martin [2025] in their major textbook of the field. Research in this area is combined in the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and its counterpart, Computational Linguistics. 1 1 1 Originally further apart, the two fields have been growing closer in recent years, one starting from the linguistic side, the other from the computational side. In this chapter, we provide an overview of the complexities of capturing natural (human) language by computational means, and outline the evolution of various fundamental techniques over the years for achieving such understanding.
paragraphs.zh: 几十年来，人工智能的一个关键目标一直是让机器具备理解人类语言的能力，正如 Jurafsky 和 Martin [2025] 在他们关于该领域的重要教科书中所阐述的那样。 这一领域的研究整合于自然语言处理（NLP）及其对应领域——计算语言学之中。1 1 1 最初这两个领域相距较远，但近年来逐渐趋于融合：一个从语言学角度入手，另一个则从计算角度切入。 在本章中，我们将概述通过计算手段捕捉自然（人类）语言的复杂性，并梳理多年来为实现这种理解而发展的各种基础技术的演变过程。

paragraphs.en: One of the early goals of the fields has been to achieve the dream of practical machine translation. Since its inception in the 1950’s [ Hutchins, 1999 ] , human language processing technology has evolved greatly. Extensive research progress has allowed it to have a profound impact across industries. This widespread industrial adoption has, in turn, emerged as a vital driving force for application-oriented development. In NLP, fundamental theoretical research and practical, real-world utility, go hand in hand. As a consequence, the application areas have expanded beyond machine translation.
paragraphs.zh: 该领域早期的目标之一，就是实现实用机器翻译的梦想。 自 20 世纪 50 年代诞生以来 [ Hutchins, 1999 ]，人类语言处理技术已取得了巨大发展。 广泛的研究进展使其能够对各行业产生深远影响。 这种广泛的工业应用反过来又成为面向应用开发的重要驱动力。 在自然语言处理领域，基础理论研究与实际实用价值始终相辅相成。 因此，其应用领域已扩展到机器翻译之外。

paragraphs.en: Recently, the impact of language technology on society has truly exploded. We interact on a daily basis with chatbots such as ChatGPT and Claude. We can do so in multiple languages, and enhanced search engines have been incorporated in many popular products. However, these developments stand on the shoulders of many earlier results. A famous early example is ELIZA, the psychotherapist chatbot developed in 1966 by Joseph Weizenbaum [ Weizenbaum, 1966 ] . ELIZA was a rudimentary chatbot based on simple rule-based word substitutions (see Figure 2.1 ). ELIZA was already ascribed human-like qualities. Since these early days of rule-based systems for text processing, where we identify words based on specific delimiters (such as white space), we have come a long way.
paragraphs.zh: 最近，语言技术对社会的影响确实呈爆炸式增长。 我们日常与 ChatGPT 和 Claude 等聊天机器人互动。 我们可以用多种语言进行互动，而且许多热门产品都已集成了增强型搜索引擎。 然而，这些发展都建立在前人众多成果的基础之上。 一个著名的早期例子是 ELIZA，这是 Joseph Weizenbaum 于 1966 年开发的心理治疗聊天机器人 [Weizenbaum, 1966]。 ELIZA 是一种基于简单规则化词语替换的初级聊天机器人（参见图 2.1）。 ELIZA 当时就已经被赋予了类人的特质。 自文本处理领域早期那些基于规则的系统——其中我们依据特定的分隔符（如空白字符）来识别词语——以来，我们已经取得了长足的进步。

sents.zh: 自文本处理领域早期那些基于规则的系统——其中我们依据特定的分隔符（如空白字符）来识别词语——以来，我们已经取得了长足的进步。

paragraphs.en: Before considering how computers process language, we will consider how humans understand language.
paragraphs.zh: 在探讨计算机如何处理语言之前，我们将先探讨人类如何理解语言。

paragraphs.en: A key observation is that communication is a sequential process, and that languages are shaped accordingly. Words are uttered one at a time, and are also consumed one at a time. This parallel holds both for human and mechanical processing of language: language is a sequence of characters (when reading), syllables (when speaking), or entire words (for early computational models of language).
paragraphs.zh: 一个关键观察是，沟通是一个顺序过程，而语言也因此被塑造。 词语是一次一次说出来的，也是一次一次被使用的。 这种对应关系既适用于人类对语言的处理，也适用于机器处理：语言是一系列字符（在阅读时）、音节（在说话时）或完整的词语（对于早期的语言计算模型）。

sents.en: A key observation is that communication is a sequential process, and that languages are shaped accordingly.
sents.zh: 一个关键观察是，沟通是一个顺序过程，而语言也因此被塑造。

sents.en: Words are uttered one at a time, and are also consumed one at a time.
sents.zh: 词语是一次一次说出来的，也是一次一次被使用的。

sents.en: This parallel holds both for human and mechanical processing of language: language is a sequence of characters (when reading), syllables (when speaking), or entire words (for early computational models of language).
sents.zh: 这种对应关系既适用于人类对语言的处理，也适用于机器处理：语言是一系列字符（在阅读时）、音节（在说话时）或完整的词语（对于早期的语言计算模型）。

paragraphs.en: We will now look deeper into the technology developed for working with natural language sequences. This technology is categorized as either natural language understanding or natural language generation . We will briefly describe both categories.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们将更深入地探讨为处理自然语言序列而开发的技术。 这项技术被归类为自然语言理解或自然语言生成。 我们将简要介绍这两类技术。

sents.en: We will now look deeper into the technology developed for working with natural language sequences.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们将更深入地探讨为处理自然语言序列而开发的技术。

sents.en: This technology is categorized as either natural language understanding or natural language generation .
sents.zh: 这项技术被归类为自然语言理解或自然语言生成。

sents.en: We will briefly describe both categories.
sents.zh: 我们将简要介绍这两类技术。

paragraphs.en: Natural language understanding (NLU) focuses on developing methods for capturing meaning and intent. Approaches and techniques for NLU map unstructured human language elements onto a structured format such that a computer can interpret and act upon them. Such techniques can involve several layers of processing, inspired by linguistic analysis (as visualized in Figure 2.2 ), as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 自然语言理解（NLU）专注于开发能够捕捉意义和意图的方法。 NLU 的方法和技巧将非结构化的人类语言元素映射到结构化格式，使计算机能够解释并据此采取行动。 这类技术可能涉及多个处理层，其灵感来自语言学分析（如图 2.2 所示），具体如下：

sents.en: Natural language understanding (NLU) focuses on developing methods for capturing meaning and intent.
sents.zh: 自然语言理解（NLU）专注于开发能够捕捉意义和意图的方法。

sents.en: Approaches and techniques for NLU map unstructured human language elements onto a structured format such that a computer can interpret and act upon them.
sents.zh: NLU 的方法和技巧将非结构化的人类语言元素映射到结构化格式，使计算机能够解释并据此采取行动。

sents.en: Such techniques can involve several layers of processing, inspired by linguistic analysis (as visualized in Figure 2.2 ), as follows:
sents.zh: 这类技术可能涉及多个处理层，其灵感来自语言学分析（如图 2.2 所示），具体如下：

paragraphs.en: Tokenization: determine boundaries between meaningful linguistic elements (such as words) to be used for further processing.
paragraphs.zh: 分词：确定有意义的语言单元（例如词语）之间的边界，以便用于后续处理。

paragraphs.en: Syntactic Parsing: determine the grammatical structure (such as subjects, verbs, and objects).
paragraphs.zh: 句法解析：确定语法结构（例如主语、动词和宾语）。

paragraphs.en: Named Entity Recognition (NER): identify and categorize key entities such as names, dates, and locations.
paragraphs.zh: 命名实体识别（NER）：识别并分类关键实体，例如名称、日期和地点。

paragraphs.en: Sentiment Analysis: detect the emotional tone of a text.
paragraphs.zh: 情感分析：检测文本的情感倾向。

paragraphs.en: Co-reference Resolution: determine what person or items are referred to in referential expressions (such as: the computer talked to me).
paragraphs.zh: 共指消解：确定指称表达中提及的是哪个人或哪些物品（例如：“那台电脑和我说话了”）。

paragraphs.en: Discourse Analysis: understand how the meaning of a sentence is influenced by preceding sentences.
paragraphs.zh: 话语分析：理解句子的含义如何受到前文句子的影响。

paragraphs.en: One of the primary challenges in NLU is dealing with ambiguity [ Roth, 1998 , Liu et al., 2023 ] . Human language is rife with ambiguity. Examples are polysemy (words with multiple meanings, such as bank ) and context-dependent nuances that require world knowledge to decode correctly. Many more challenges exist; naturally occurring human language is as rich and complex as humans are.
paragraphs.zh: 自然语言理解（NLU）面临的主要挑战之一，是如何处理歧义问题 [ Roth, 1998 , Liu et al., 2023 ] 。 人类语言充满了歧义。 例如多义现象（如“bank”一词具有多种含义），以及需要结合世界知识才能正确解读的语境相关细微差别。 此外还存在更多挑战；自然状态下的人类语言，其丰富性和复杂性正与人类本身相当。

sents.en: One of the primary challenges in NLU is dealing with ambiguity [ Roth, 1998 , Liu et al., 2023 ] .
sents.zh: 自然语言理解（NLU）面临的主要挑战之一，是如何处理歧义问题 [ Roth, 1998 , Liu et al., 2023 ] 。

sents.en: Human language is rife with ambiguity.
sents.zh: 人类语言充满了歧义。

paragraphs.en: Natural language generation (NLG) focuses on developing methods for producing readable, natural-sounding human language. Tasks range from free-form language generation, to the transformation of structured data or model representations into realistic utterances.
paragraphs.zh: 自然语言生成（NLG）专注于开发能够生成可读性强、听起来像人类语言的文本的方法。 相关任务涵盖从自由形式的语言生成，到将结构化数据或模型表示转化为逼真的语言表达。

sents.en: Natural language generation (NLG) focuses on developing methods for producing readable, natural-sounding human language.
sents.zh: 自然语言生成（NLG）专注于开发能够生成可读性强、听起来像人类语言的文本的方法。

sents.en: Tasks range from free-form language generation, to the transformation of structured data or model representations into realistic utterances.
sents.zh: 相关任务涵盖从自由形式的语言生成，到将结构化数据或模型表示转化为逼真的语言表达。

paragraphs.en: An important NLG task is language modeling (LM). In language modeling, the task is to predict the next element in a sequence, given the previous context. Mathematically, this involves assigning a probability distribution over sequences of words. Traditionally, finding this distribution was achieved using simple count-based models, often relying on further simplifying assumptions to predict a word based on a fixed window of preceding words.
paragraphs.zh: 一项重要的自然语言生成（NLG）任务是语言建模（LM）。 在语言建模中，任务是根据前文上下文预测序列中的下一个元素。 从数学上讲，这涉及为词语序列分配一个概率分布。 传统上，通过简单的基于计数的模型来寻找这种分布，这些模型通常依赖进一步的简化假设，根据固定数量的前文词语来预测一个词。

sents.en: An important NLG task is language modeling (LM).
sents.zh: 一项重要的自然语言生成（NLG）任务是语言建模（LM）。

sents.en: In language modeling, the task is to predict the next element in a sequence, given the previous context.
sents.zh: 在语言建模中，任务是根据前文上下文预测序列中的下一个元素。

paragraphs.en: Modern approaches use elaborate neural methods that can generate fluent sentences based on a long context, that often appear meaningful to a human observer. 2 2 2 Which is by itself not always difficult to achieve, as we saw in the ELIZA example. Note that effective language generation requires more than just grammatical correctness; it requires coherence (logical flow) and cohesion (linguistic links). Current NLG systems use sampling methods, ensembles, and many other mechanisms to balance the creativity and predictability of the text that they produce, to ensure that the output feels natural rather than robotic [ Li and Jurafsky, 2017 , Dong et al., 2022 , Gatt and Krahmer, 2018 ] . Techniques for NLG are commonly categorized into two approaches:
paragraphs.zh: 现代方法采用复杂的神经网络技术，能够基于长上下文生成流畅的句子，这些句子通常对人类观察者而言显得有意义。2 2 2 这本身并不总是难以实现，正如我们在 ELIZA 的例子中所看到的。 请注意，有效的语言生成不仅需要语法正确性，还需要连贯性（逻辑上的流畅性）和衔接性（语言上的联系）。 当前的自然语言生成系统采用采样方法、集成模型以及许多其他机制，以平衡所生成文本的创造性和可预测性，从而确保输出感觉自然而非机械 [ Li and Jurafsky, 2017 , Dong et al., 2022 , Gatt and Krahmer, 2018 ] 。 自然语言生成的技术通常被分为两种方法：

sents.en: Modern approaches use elaborate neural methods that can generate fluent sentences based on a long context, that often appear meaningful to a human observer. 2 2 2 Which is by itself not always difficult to achieve, as we saw in the ELIZA example.
sents.zh: 现代方法采用复杂的神经网络技术，能够基于长上下文生成流畅的句子，这些句子通常对人类观察者而言显得有意义。2 2 2 这本身并不总是难以实现，正如我们在 ELIZA 的例子中所看到的。

sents.en: Techniques for NLG are commonly categorized into two approaches:
sents.zh: 自然语言生成的技术通常被分为两种方法：

paragraphs.en: Extractive Generation: Selecting and rearranging existing segments of text (often used in early summarization tools).
paragraphs.zh: 提取式生成：选择并重新排列现有的文本片段（常用于早期的摘要工具）。

paragraphs.en: Abstractive Generation: Generating entirely new sentences from scratch (as modern models such as ChatGPT do).
paragraphs.zh: 抽象生成：从头开始生成全新的句子（如同 ChatGPT 等现代模型所做的那样）。

paragraphs.en: We will now discuss early, fundamental, approaches to language modeling. We will start by discussing the complexity of language, and then discuss the principle of distributional representation, tokenization methods, and early language modeling representations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在将讨论语言建模早期的一些基本方法。 我们将首先讨论语言的复杂性，然后探讨分布表示原则、分词方法以及早期的语言建模表示方法。

sents.en: We will now discuss early, fundamental, approaches to language modeling.
sents.zh: 我们现在将讨论语言建模早期的一些基本方法。

sents.en: We will start by discussing the complexity of language, and then discuss the principle of distributional representation, tokenization methods, and early language modeling representations.
sents.zh: 我们将首先讨论语言的复杂性，然后探讨分布表示原则、分词方法以及早期的语言建模表示方法。

paragraphs.en: There are many reasons why natural language can be difficult for a machine to interpret. Language exhibits subtle nuances that carry meaning or distort it. Capturing the full nuance of language requires more than understanding its structure. Furthermore, the context in which something is said plays a role in communication. Understanding goes beyond the words themselves to grasp the intentions, implications, and subtleties embedded in communication [ Wittgenstein, 1953 , Grice, 1975 , Krause and Vossen, 2024 ] . Below, we introduce topics that are studied in the field of linguistics, each of which brings about a different view on what language is capable of expressing.
paragraphs.zh: 自然语言之所以对机器难以理解，原因有很多。 语言中存在微妙的细微差别，这些差别可能承载意义，也可能扭曲意义。 要捕捉语言的完整细微差别，仅理解其结构是远远不够的。 此外，事物被表达时所处的语境在交流中也扮演着重要角色。 真正的理解超越了词语本身，需要把握交流中蕴含的意图、隐含意义和微妙之处 [ Wittgenstein, 1953 , Grice, 1975 , Krause and Vossen, 2024 ] 。 下面，我们将介绍语言学领域研究的几个主题，每个主题都为我们理解语言能够表达的内容提供了不同的视角。

sents.zh: 自然语言之所以对机器难以理解，原因有很多。

sents.zh: 语言中存在微妙的细微差别，这些差别可能承载意义，也可能扭曲意义。

sents.zh: 要捕捉语言的完整细微差别，仅理解其结构是远远不够的。

sents.en: Furthermore, the context in which something is said plays a role in communication.
sents.zh: 此外，事物被表达时所处的语境在交流中也扮演着重要角色。

sents.zh: 真正的理解超越了词语本身，需要把握交流中蕴含的意图、隐含意义和微妙之处 [ Wittgenstein, 1953 , Grice, 1975 , Krause and Vossen, 2024 ] 。

sents.en: Below, we introduce topics that are studied in the field of linguistics, each of which brings about a different view on what language is capable of expressing.
sents.zh: 下面，我们将介绍语言学领域研究的几个主题，每个主题都为我们理解语言能够表达的内容提供了不同的视角。

paragraphs.en: Syntax rules govern the structure of sentences. In the study of linguistics, syntax refers to the set of rules, principles, and processes that regulate the structure of sentences in a given language. Linguistic syntax examines the underlying logic that allows a speaker to combine words into well-formed and meaningful sequences. In English, for example, the most common order is subject-verb-object: in cat bites dog the verb bites follows the subject cat , indicating that the meaning of the sentence is that it was the cat that was doing the biting (and not the dog).
paragraphs.zh: 句法规则决定了句子的结构。 在语言学研究中，句法指的是规范特定语言句子结构的一系列规则、原则和过程。 语言句法研究的是使说话者能够将词语组合成结构正确且富有意义的序列的底层逻辑。 例如，在英语中，最常见的语序是主谓宾：在“cat bites dog”这个句子中，动词“bites”位于主语“cat”之后，表明句子的意思是猫在执行咬的动作（而不是狗）。

sents.en: Syntax rules govern the structure of sentences.
sents.zh: 句法规则决定了句子的结构。

sents.en: In the study of linguistics, syntax refers to the set of rules, principles, and processes that regulate the structure of sentences in a given language.
sents.zh: 在语言学研究中，句法指的是规范特定语言句子结构的一系列规则、原则和过程。

sents.en: Linguistic syntax examines the underlying logic that allows a speaker to combine words into well-formed and meaningful sequences.
sents.zh: 语言句法研究的是使说话者能够将词语组合成结构正确且富有意义的序列的底层逻辑。

sents.en: In English, for example, the most common order is subject-verb-object: in cat bites dog the verb bites follows the subject cat , indicating that the meaning of the sentence is that it was the cat that was doing the biting (and not the dog).
sents.zh: 例如，在英语中，最常见的语序是主谓宾：在“cat bites dog”这个句子中，动词“bites”位于主语“cat”之后，表明句子的意思是猫在执行咬的动作（而不是狗）。

paragraphs.en: Morphology is the study of how words change shape depending on their grammatical function. How words change shape is related to syntax, and the morphological rules (and their exceptions) depend on the language (family). In the preceding example sentence, the shape of the verb to bite changed to bites , where the -s indicates simple present tense (it is happening now, by a singular actor, not by a posse of felines in ancient times).
paragraphs.zh: 形态学是研究词语如何根据其语法功能改变形式的学科。 词语形式的变化与句法有关，而形态规则（及其例外）则取决于具体的语言（语系）。 在上面的例句中，动词 bite 的形式变为 bites，其中的 -s 表示一般现在时（即动作正在发生，由单个执行者完成，而非古代一群猫科动物所为）。

sents.en: Morphology is the study of how words change shape depending on their grammatical function.
sents.zh: 形态学是研究词语如何根据其语法功能改变形式的学科。

sents.en: How words change shape is related to syntax, and the morphological rules (and their exceptions) depend on the language (family).
sents.zh: 词语形式的变化与句法有关，而形态规则（及其例外）则取决于具体的语言（语系）。

sents.en: In the preceding example sentence, the shape of the verb to bite changed to bites , where the -s indicates simple present tense (it is happening now, by a singular actor, not by a posse of felines in ancient times).
sents.zh: 在上面的例句中，动词 bite 的形式变为 bites，其中的 -s 表示一般现在时（即动作正在发生，由单个执行者完成，而非古代一群猫科动物所为）。

paragraphs.en: In linguistics, lexical semantics is the study of the meaning of words. In natural languages words derive their meaning from their relationship to other words. For instance, words with nearly identical meanings form synonyms , such as car and automobile or vanish and disappear; words with opposite meanings form antonyms , such as hot and cold or buy and sell. Many more relationships exist.
paragraphs.zh: 在语言学中，词汇语义学是研究词语意义的学科。 在自然语言中，词语的意义源于它们与其他词语之间的关系。 例如，意义几乎相同的词语构成同义词，如 car 和 automobile，或 vanish 和 disappear；意义相反的词语构成反义词，如 hot 和 cold，或 buy 和 sell。 除此之外，还存在许多其他关系。

sents.en: In linguistics, lexical semantics is the study of the meaning of words.
sents.zh: 在语言学中，词汇语义学是研究词语意义的学科。

sents.en: In natural languages words derive their meaning from their relationship to other words.
sents.zh: 在自然语言中，词语的意义源于它们与其他词语之间的关系。

sents.en: For instance, words with nearly identical meanings form synonyms , such as car and automobile or vanish and disappear; words with opposite meanings form antonyms , such as hot and cold or buy and sell.
sents.zh: 例如，意义几乎相同的词语构成同义词，如 car 和 automobile，或 vanish 和 disappear；意义相反的词语构成反义词，如 hot 和 cold，或 buy 和 sell。

sents.en: Many more relationships exist.
sents.zh: 除此之外，还存在许多其他关系。

paragraphs.en: In NLP, computational semantics is the study of how we can represent that meaning efficiently in a computer. A basic approach for storing a sentence in a computer memory would be to simply use a sequence of indices into a vector of the words of a language. However, this encoding only records the occurrence of the words, but not the relationships between the words; the semantics of the words are no longer present in this naive representation.
paragraphs.zh: 在自然语言处理中，计算语义学研究的是如何高效地在计算机中表示这种意义。 将句子存储在计算机内存中的一种基本方法，就是简单地使用一个指向语言词汇向量的索引序列。 然而，这种编码仅记录了词语的出现，却没有记录词语之间的关系；在这种简单的表示中，词语的语义已不复存在。

sents.en: In NLP, computational semantics is the study of how we can represent that meaning efficiently in a computer.
sents.zh: 在自然语言处理中，计算语义学研究的是如何高效地在计算机中表示这种意义。

sents.en: A basic approach for storing a sentence in a computer memory would be to simply use a sequence of indices into a vector of the words of a language.
sents.zh: 将句子存储在计算机内存中的一种基本方法，就是简单地使用一个指向语言词汇向量的索引序列。

sents.en: However, this encoding only records the occurrence of the words, but not the relationships between the words; the semantics of the words are no longer present in this naive representation.
sents.zh: 然而，这种编码仅记录了词语的出现，却没有记录词语之间的关系；在这种简单的表示中，词语的语义已不复存在。

paragraphs.en: Words derive their meaning from their relationship to other words, and we need a way to efficiently encode these relationships. As we will see later in this chapter, different solutions have been developed over the years, including the transformer architecture and the attention mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 词语的含义源于它们与其他词语之间的关系，而我们需要一种有效编码这些关系的方法。 正如我们将在本章后面看到的，多年来已经发展出不同的解决方案，包括 Transformer 架构和注意力机制。

sents.en: Words derive their meaning from their relationship to other words, and we need a way to efficiently encode these relationships.
sents.zh: 词语的含义源于它们与其他词语之间的关系，而我们需要一种有效编码这些关系的方法。

sents.en: As we will see later in this chapter, different solutions have been developed over the years, including the transformer architecture and the attention mechanism.
sents.zh: 正如我们将在本章后面看到的，多年来已经发展出不同的解决方案，包括 Transformer 架构和注意力机制。

paragraphs.en: In addition to the literal meaning of words, humans care about the intent of the speaker and the context of the utterance. The way language is employed in specific social contexts determines its effect ( meaning is use [ Baker and Hacker, 2008 ] ). The study of the implicit, everyday rules humans naturally follow to ensure that our communication is effective is called pragmatics .
paragraphs.zh: 除了词语的字面意思之外，人类还会关注说话者的意图以及话语的语境。 语言在特定社会语境中的使用方式决定了其效果（意义即使用 [Baker and Hacker, 2008]）。 研究人类为确保沟通有效而自然遵循的那些隐性的日常规则，被称为语用学。

sents.en: In addition to the literal meaning of words, humans care about the intent of the speaker and the context of the utterance.
sents.zh: 除了词语的字面意思之外，人类还会关注说话者的意图以及话语的语境。

sents.en: The way language is employed in specific social contexts determines its effect ( meaning is use [ Baker and Hacker, 2008 ] ).
sents.zh: 语言在特定社会语境中的使用方式决定了其效果（意义即使用 [Baker and Hacker, 2008]）。

sents.en: The study of the implicit, everyday rules humans naturally follow to ensure that our communication is effective is called pragmatics .
sents.zh: 研究人类为确保沟通有效而自然遵循的那些隐性的日常规则，被称为语用学。

paragraphs.en: A set of foundational principles are the Gricean Maxims [ Grice, 1975 ] : the unspoken cooperative principles that humans use to infer meaning. For instance, the maxim of quantity states that humans provide exactly as much information as is required for the conversation. These maxims shape our communication, and help make our language understandable and cooperative. For a machine, interpreting sarcasm, subtext, or placeholders (e.g., “thingy”) requires knowledge of these rules, beyond adherance to a static dictionary.
paragraphs.zh: 一套基础原则是格莱斯准则 [Grice, 1975]：人类用来推断意义的未明说的合作原则。 例如，数量准则指出，人类提供的信息量恰好满足对话所需。 这些准则塑造了我们的交流方式，并帮助使我们的语言易于理解且富有合作性。 对于机器而言，要解读讽刺、潜台词或占位符（例如，“那个东西”），除了遵循静态词典之外，还需要了解这些规则。

paragraphs.en: Language rarely occurs in isolated sentences; language is structured into larger units such as paragraphs, conversations, or full documents. The study of discourse focuses on how sentences connect to form a cohesive and coherent whole. For a machine to truly interpret a text, it must be able to track entities across multiple sentences, a task known as co-reference resolution (e.g., determining whether the pronoun it refers to the cat, the dog, or the bite from a previous sentence). Understanding discourse is vital for complex NLP tasks such as document summarization, machine translation, and sustaining long-form dialogue.
paragraphs.zh: 语言很少以孤立的句子形式出现；语言是由段落、对话或完整文档等更大的单元构成的。 话语研究关注的是句子如何相互连接，从而形成一个连贯统一的整体。 机器要真正理解文本，就必须能够追踪跨多个句子的实体，这项任务被称为共指消解（例如，判断代词 it 是指前一句中的猫、狗，还是被咬这件事）。 理解话语对于复杂的自然语言处理任务至关重要，例如文档摘要、机器翻译以及维持长对话。

paragraphs.en: In addition to these topics, other fields of study exist, such as phonetics (the sounds of a language that carry additional meaning in human communication), sociolinguistics (how language varies according to social factors like class or region), lexicography (the science of compiling dictionaries), and many more.
paragraphs.zh: 除了这些主题之外，还有其他研究领域，例如语音学（人类交流中承载额外意义的语言声音）、社会语言学（语言如何因阶级或地区等社会因素而发生变化）、词典编纂学（编纂词典的科学），以及许多其他领域。

paragraphs.en: As this overview may have highlighted, the generation and understanding of natural languages are large and challenging fields. It is important to realize that language is not static. Language varies over time, across geographical locations, between different cultures, and depending on the medium through which it is communicated :-). This variation makes the creation of language technology a difficult and never-ending quest.
paragraphs.zh: 正如本概述可能已经强调的，自然语言的生成和理解是庞大而富有挑战性的领域。 认识到语言并非一成不变这一点非常重要。 语言会随着时间的推移、地理位置的差异、不同文化之间的区别以及传播媒介的不同而发生变化 :-）。 这种多样性使得语言技术的开发成为一个困难且永无止境的过程。

sents.zh: 正如本概述可能已经强调的，自然语言的生成和理解是庞大而富有挑战性的领域。

sents.en: It is important to realize that language is not static.

paragraphs.en: Before we introduce the recent technologies that provide at least a partial answer to these challenges, we discuss the fundamental assumptions that inspired the modern turn in NLP.
paragraphs.zh: 在介绍那些至少能部分解答这些挑战的最新技术之前，我们将探讨启发自然语言处理领域现代转向的基本假设。

paragraphs.en: Representing natural language in a computer is difficult because natural language is rich and complex. In the remainder of this section, we discuss the principle of distributional representation, which states that the semantic meaning of a word is driven by the context that surrounds that word. Next, we will look at tokenization methods: methods for splitting sentences into words. Finally we will discuss how we can work with vectors of tokens to arrive at a representation that encodes meaning.
paragraphs.zh: 将自然语言在计算机中表示出来是很困难的，因为自然语言丰富而复杂。 在本节的剩余部分中，我们将讨论分布表示原则，该原则指出，一个词的语义意义是由其周围的上下文所决定的。 接下来，我们将研究分词方法：即将句子拆分为词语的方法。 最后，我们将讨论如何对词元向量进行操作，从而得到能够编码意义的表示形式。

sents.en: Representing natural language in a computer is difficult because natural language is rich and complex.
sents.zh: 将自然语言在计算机中表示出来是很困难的，因为自然语言丰富而复杂。

sents.en: In the remainder of this section, we discuss the principle of distributional representation, which states that the semantic meaning of a word is driven by the context that surrounds that word.

sents.en: Next, we will look at tokenization methods: methods for splitting sentences into words.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们将研究分词方法：即将句子拆分为词语的方法。

sents.en: Finally we will discuss how we can work with vectors of tokens to arrive at a representation that encodes meaning.

paragraphs.en: How can we teach a machine to understand complex semantic relationships and grammatical structures without manually encoding them all? The answer lies in the distributional hypothesis, a foundational concept in modern NLP. The core idea was articulated in the late 1950s:
paragraphs.zh: 我们如何才能在无需手动编码所有复杂语义关系和语法结构的情况下，教会机器理解它们？ 答案在于分布假设，这是现代自然语言处理中的一个基础概念。 其核心思想于 20 世纪 50 年代末被明确提出：

sents.en: How can we teach a machine to understand complex semantic relationships and grammatical structures without manually encoding them all?
sents.zh: 我们如何才能在无需手动编码所有复杂语义关系和语法结构的情况下，教会机器理解它们？

sents.en: The answer lies in the distributional hypothesis, a foundational concept in modern NLP.
sents.zh: 答案在于分布假设，这是现代自然语言处理中的一个基础概念。

sents.en: The core idea was articulated in the late 1950s:
sents.zh: 其核心思想于 20 世纪 50 年代末被明确提出：

paragraphs.en: You shall know a word by the company it keeps. (Firth, 1957)
paragraphs.zh: 物以类聚，人以群分。（菲思，1957）

paragraphs.en: This suggests that the meaning of a word can be inferred from the words around it (contexts) in which it typically appears. Words that appear in similar contexts are likely to have similar meanings. For example, if the words coffee and tea both frequently appear near verbs like drink , sip , or brew , then a machine may infer that there is a semantic relationship between them, without explicit definitions or other human-provided information.
paragraphs.zh: 这表明，一个词的含义可以从它通常出现的周围词语（上下文）中推断出来。 出现在相似上下文中的词语，其含义很可能也相似。 例如，如果“咖啡”和“茶”这两个词都经常出现在像“喝”、“啜饮”或“冲泡”这样的动词附近，那么机器就可以推断出它们之间存在语义关系，而无需明确的定义或其他由人类提供的信息。

sents.en: This suggests that the meaning of a word can be inferred from the words around it (contexts) in which it typically appears.
sents.zh: 这表明，一个词的含义可以从它通常出现的周围词语（上下文）中推断出来。

sents.en: Words that appear in similar contexts are likely to have similar meanings.
sents.zh: 出现在相似上下文中的词语，其含义很可能也相似。

sents.en: For example, if the words coffee and tea both frequently appear near verbs like drink , sip , or brew , then a machine may infer that there is a semantic relationship between them, without explicit definitions or other human-provided information.
sents.zh: 例如，如果“咖啡”和“茶”这两个词都经常出现在像“喝”、“啜饮”或“冲泡”这样的动词附近，那么机器就可以推断出它们之间存在语义关系，而无需明确的定义或其他由人类提供的信息。

paragraphs.en: To operationalize the distributional hypothesis for computational purposes, we will rely on linear algebra and turn to a framework known as vector semantics . We represent words as points in a high-dimensional continuous space. Words with similar meanings are mapped to points close to each other in this space, and we can measure semantic similarity using geometric distance measures such as cosine similarity (see Figure 2.3 and Section 2.3.1 ). Furthermore, we can make modifications to word meaning by doing vector arithmetic. Early implementations relied on sparse co-occurrence matrices to construct semantic vectors, where individual words were counted inside their context, much like other methods described in Section 2.1.5 . Modern approaches favor dense, low-dimensional vectors, often referred to as word embeddings . These representations are typically learned by training a neural model to predict a word from its neighbors or vice versa, a breakthrough popularized by the word2vec architecture [ Mikolov et al., 2013 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为了在计算上实现分布假设，我们将依赖线性代数，并采用一种被称为向量语义的框架。 我们将词语表示为高维连续空间中的点。 含义相似的词语在该空间中会被映射到彼此接近的点，我们可以使用余弦相似度等几何距离度量来衡量语义相似性（参见图 2.3 和 2.3.1 节）。 此外，通过向量运算，我们还可以对词语的含义进行修改。 早期的实现依赖于稀疏共现矩阵来构建语义向量，其中每个词语都在其上下文环境中被计数，这与第 2.1.5 节中描述的其他方法类似。 现代方法更倾向于使用密集的低维向量，通常被称为词嵌入。 这些表示通常通过训练一个神经网络模型来学习，该模型根据词语的相邻词预测目标词，或反之亦然；这一突破性的方法因 word2vec 架构 [ Mikolov et al., 2013 ] 而广为人知。

sents.zh: 为了在计算上实现分布假设，我们将依赖线性代数，并采用一种被称为向量语义的框架。

sents.zh: 现代方法更倾向于使用密集的低维向量，通常被称为词嵌入。

sents.en: These representations are typically learned by training a neural model to predict a word from its neighbors or vice versa, a breakthrough popularized by the word2vec architecture [ Mikolov et al., 2013 ] .
sents.zh: 这些表示通常通过训练一个神经网络模型来学习，该模型根据词语的相邻词预测目标词，或反之亦然；这一突破性的方法因 word2vec 架构 [ Mikolov et al., 2013 ] 而广为人知。

paragraphs.en: While learning vector-based representations for words is an effective way to capture meaning, maintaining a distinct vector for every unique word in a language results in an impractically large vocabulary.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然学习基于向量的词表示是捕捉语义的有效方法，但为语言中每个独特的词都维护一个独立的向量，会导致词汇表变得大得难以实用。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, strict word-level approaches struggle to process rare or entirely unseen words, as the model has no pre-existing vector for them. Hence, before a model can assign vectors to linguistic units, we must first determine what those fundamental units actually are. To address these inefficiencies and handle out-of-vocabulary inputs, modern methods use a systematic approach to break down raw text into more manageable pieces. This process is called tokenization, which we will now discuss.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，严格的词级方法在处理罕见或完全未出现过的词语时存在困难，因为模型没有为这些词语预存的向量。 因此，在模型能够向语言单位分配向量之前，我们必须首先确定这些基本单位究竟是什么。 为了应对这些低效问题并处理词汇表之外的输入，现代方法采用了一种系统性的方式，将原始文本分解为更易处理的片段。 这个过程被称为分词，接下来我们将对此进行探讨。

sents.en: Furthermore, strict word-level approaches struggle to process rare or entirely unseen words, as the model has no pre-existing vector for them.
sents.zh: 此外，严格的词级方法在处理罕见或完全未出现过的词语时存在困难，因为模型没有为这些词语预存的向量。

sents.en: Hence, before a model can assign vectors to linguistic units, we must first determine what those fundamental units actually are.
sents.zh: 因此，在模型能够向语言单位分配向量之前，我们必须首先确定这些基本单位究竟是什么。

sents.en: To address these inefficiencies and handle out-of-vocabulary inputs, modern methods use a systematic approach to break down raw text into more manageable pieces.
sents.zh: 为了应对这些低效问题并处理词汇表之外的输入，现代方法采用了一种系统性的方式，将原始文本分解为更易处理的片段。

sents.en: This process is called tokenization, which we will now discuss.
sents.zh: 这个过程被称为分词，接下来我们将对此进行探讨。

paragraphs.en: Before computers can ascribe meaning to language, they must first have a way to digest it. Assuming that we already have raw text at our disposal, whether scraped from the web or transcribed from speech, the immediate challenge is determining how to split these continuous character strings into meaningful units, or how to split sentences into words. This process is called tokenization . However, a robust tokenization strategy must do much more than simply divide sentences by spaces to obtain words; it needs to be able to handle the nuances of different languages and dialects, parse complex punctuation, and even account for modern additions like emojis, and fit these into a vocabulary of fixed size.
paragraphs.zh: 在计算机能够赋予语言意义之前，它们首先必须有一种方法可以解析语言。 假设我们已经获得了原始文本，无论是从网络抓取还是从语音转录而来，当务之急是确定如何将这些连续字符字符串拆分为有意义的单元，或者说如何将句子拆分为词语。 这个过程被称为分词。 然而，一个稳健的分词策略必须做得比简单地按空格分割句子以获取词语更多；它需要能够处理不同语言和方言的细微差别，解析复杂的标点符号，甚至考虑像表情符号这样的现代新增元素，并将这些内容纳入一个固定大小的词汇表中。

sents.en: Before computers can ascribe meaning to language, they must first have a way to digest it.
sents.zh: 在计算机能够赋予语言意义之前，它们首先必须有一种方法可以解析语言。

sents.zh: 这个过程被称为分词。

paragraphs.en: This process of segmentation is a key step to many NLP pipelines. While dividing text might appear straightforward, ambiguities in punctuation complicate the process, such as in abbreviations (N.L.P. or NLP?). Simple rule-based segmenters frequently fail against the structural irregularities of natural language. paragraphs.en: Large vocabularies are problematic due to the mechanics of one-hot encoding . If every word w w in a vocabulary V V is represented as a vector 𝐱 ∈ { 0 , 1 } | V | \mathbf{x}\in\{0,1\}^{|V|} , where only the index corresponding to w w is 1, the dimensionality | V | |V| scales linearly with the size of the vocabulary. As these one-hot vectors will later form the input to our neural networks, for texts that do not contain all words in a certain vocabulary, we end up creating sparse, computationally inefficient representations that fail to capture semantic relationships between words.
paragraphs.zh: 由于独热编码的机制，大规模词汇表会带来问题。 如果词汇表 V 中的每个词 w 都被表示为一个向量 𝐱 ∈ { 0 , 1 } | V | \mathbf{x}\in\{0,1\}^{|V|}，其中只有对应于 w 的位置为 1，那么维度 | V | 会随着词汇表规模的增大而线性增长。 由于这些独热向量后续将作为我们神经网络的输入，对于不包含某个词汇表中所有词语的文本来说，最终会产生稀疏且计算效率低下的表示，无法捕捉词语之间的语义关系。

paragraphs.en: Pure character-level modeling seems like a clear solution to the problem of increasing vocabularies, and has been explored over the years [ Mielke et al., 2021 ] . Such a method divides text into individual characters, which restricts the vocabulary to the size of the alphabet, virtually eliminating OOV issues. However, it significantly increases sequence length and the resulting computational burden is substantial. Furthermore, because isolated characters lack inherent semantic meaning, the model must learn word morphology before it can grasp broader linguistic patterns, increasing training time.
paragraphs.zh: 纯粹的字符级建模似乎是为解决词汇表不断膨胀问题而提出的一个明确方案，并且多年来一直受到研究 [ Mielke et al., 2021 ]。 这种方法将文本拆分为单个字符，从而将词汇表的大小限制在字母表范围内，几乎完全消除了 OOV 问题。 然而，这种方法会显著增加序列长度，由此带来的计算负担也相当巨大。 此外，由于孤立的字符缺乏内在的语义意义，模型必须先学习词的形态结构，才能理解更广泛的语言模式，这会延长训练时间。

paragraphs.en: Byte Pair Encoding (BPE): An iterative algorithm that begins with individual characters and merges the most frequent adjacent pairs into single tokens until a target vocabulary size is reached [ Sennrich et al., 2016 ] (e.g., highest → \rightarrow [ high , est ]). BPE was originally proposed as a data compression algorithm [ Gage, 1994 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 字节对编码（BPE）：一种迭代算法，从单个字符开始，将频率最高的相邻字符对合并为单个词元，直到达到目标词汇表大小 [ Sennrich et al., 2016 ]（例如，highest → \rightarrow [ high , est ]）。 BPE 最初是作为数据压缩算法提出的 [ Gage, 1994 ]。

paragraphs.en: After tokenization, the next question is how to combine our linguistic units (tokens) into coherent sentences, that carry meaning? We start with the observation that the ordering of these units in human language is dictated by strict syntactic and semantic rules. Now, if our computational approaches would be able to accurately produce sensible text sequences, then we might say that they possess the same syntactic and semantic understanding (or at least that they are able to reproduce such understanding).
paragraphs.zh: 分词之后，下一个问题是：如何将我们的语言单位（词元）组合成连贯且富有意义的句子？ 我们从这样一个观察出发：人类语言中这些单位的排列顺序是由严格的句法和语义规则决定的。 现在，如果我们的计算方法能够准确生成合乎逻辑的文本序列，那么或许可以说，它们具备相同的句法和语义理解能力（或者至少能够再现这种理解能力）。

paragraphs.en: How can we build mathematical representations that achieve this goal? A core task in this endeavor is language modeling . Mathematically speaking, a language model is a function that computes the joint probability of a sequence of words occurring together in a specific context. By calculating this probability, models can distinguish between a logical, fluent sentence and a random sequence of tokens. For example, in English, the sequence the cat sat is significantly more probable than sat cat the because it adheres to established syntactic rules.
paragraphs.zh: 我们如何构建能够实现这一目标的数学表示？ 这项工作的核心任务之一是语言建模。 从数学上讲，语言模型是一种能够计算特定语境中词语序列共同出现联合概率的函数。 通过计算这种概率，模型可以区分出合乎逻辑、流畅的句子与随机的词元序列。 例如，在英语中，“the cat sat”这一序列比“sat cat the”明显更可能成立，因为它遵循了既定的句法规则。

paragraphs.en: To make the computation of these conditional probabilities manageable, researchers rely on n n -gram models . An n n -gram is a contiguous sequence of n n items from a given sample of text. Instead of calculating the probability of a word given its entire preceding history, which quickly becomes computationally intractable, n n -gram models apply the Markov assumption . This assumption states that the probability of the next word depends only on the preceding n − 1 n-1 words, effectively truncating the context. For example, a bi-gram model ( n = 2 n=2 ) approximates the history by looking solely at the immediately preceding word. The conditional probability is then calculated by taking the frequency of the two words occurring together and dividing it by the frequency of the first word alone,

paragraphs.en: Selecting the appropriate n n involves a critical trade-off. A larger n n captures richer contextual information and deeper syntactic dependencies, resulting in a model that generates a more natural language. Yet, increasing n n exponentially exacerbates the sparsity problem: highly specific word sequences appear far less frequently in the training data, and the model will increasingly encounter zero probabilities. Conversely, a smaller n n yields robust, frequent counts but severely limits the model’s understanding of broader semantic meaning and long-distance dependencies within the sentence.
paragraphs.zh: 选择合适的 n 涉及一个关键的权衡。 较大的 n 能够捕捉更丰富的上下文信息和更深层的句法依赖，从而生成更自然的语言模型。 然而，增大 n 会指数级地加剧稀疏性问题：高度特定的词序列在训练数据中出现的频率会大幅降低，模型也会越来越频繁地遇到零概率问题。 相反，较小的 n 虽然能产生稳健且高频的计数，但会严重限制模型对更广泛语义意义和句子内部长距离依赖的理解能力。

sents.en: Selecting the appropriate n n involves a critical trade-off.
sents.zh: 选择合适的 n 涉及一个关键的权衡。

sents.zh: 较大的 n 能够捕捉更丰富的上下文信息和更深层的句法依赖，从而生成更自然的语言模型。

sents.en: Conversely, a smaller n n yields robust, frequent counts but severely limits the model’s understanding of broader semantic meaning and long-distance dependencies within the sentence.
sents.zh: 相反，较小的 n 虽然能产生稳健且高频的计数，但会严重限制模型对更广泛语义意义和句子内部长距离依赖的理解能力。

paragraphs.en: In a standard language model computation, observing an unseen n n -gram results in a probability of zero, as it nullifies the joint probability of the entire sentence via multiplication. To mitigate this counterintuitive behavior, total counts are often smoothed. A common technique is Laplace (or add-one) smoothing , which adds a fictitious count of 1 1 to every possible vocabulary item. To maintain a valid probability distribution, the denominator is adjusted by adding the vocabulary size, | V | |V| :

paragraphs.en: These probabilistic and count-based methods ultimately yield a numerical representation of language. A strong representation encodes the properties we intuitively grasp about a word: its meaning, its grammatical function, and its relationship with other words. In early NLP, these relative frequencies and co-occurrence counts were structured into vectors, representing words based on their distribution in the text.
paragraphs.zh: 这些基于概率和计数的方法最终会产生一种语言的数值表示。 一种强大的表示方法能够编码我们对一个词所直观理解的特性：其含义、语法功能以及与其他词的关系。 在早期自然语言处理中，这些相对频率和共现次数被组织成向量，根据词语在文本中的分布来表示词语。

sents.en: These probabilistic and count-based methods ultimately yield a numerical representation of language.
sents.zh: 这些基于概率和计数的方法最终会产生一种语言的数值表示。

sents.en: A strong representation encodes the properties we intuitively grasp about a word: its meaning, its grammatical function, and its relationship with other words.
sents.zh: 一种强大的表示方法能够编码我们对一个词所直观理解的特性：其含义、语法功能以及与其他词的关系。

sents.en: In early NLP, these relative frequencies and co-occurrence counts were structured into vectors, representing words based on their distribution in the text.
sents.zh: 在早期自然语言处理中，这些相对频率和共现次数被组织成向量，根据词语在文本中的分布来表示词语。

paragraphs.en: While count-based representations are tractable, they result in vectors that are high-dimensional and sparse, leading to computational inefficiencies and poor generalization on unseen data. Consequently, modern NLP has transitioned toward learning dense, low-dimensional vector representations, known as embeddings , using neural networks. Instead of relying on explicit counting, these models learn continuous representations as a byproduct of predicting a word from its surrounding context, capturing deeper semantic relationships in a more efficient format. These modern approaches will be discussed in Section 2.3 . First we will have a brief intermezzo where we review three important machine learning approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管基于计数的表示方法易于处理，但它们生成的向量是高维且稀疏的，这会导致计算效率低下，并且难以对未见过的数据进行良好泛化。 因此，现代自然语言处理已转向利用神经网络学习密集、低维的向量表示，即所谓的嵌入（embeddings）。 这些模型不再依赖显式计数，而是通过根据上下文预测词语来学习连续表示，从而以更高效的格式捕捉更深层的语义关系。 这些现代方法将在第 2.3 节中讨论。 首先，我们将简要回顾三种重要的机器学习方法。

sents.zh: 首先，我们将简要回顾三种重要的机器学习方法。

paragraphs.en: Having established a primer on language representation, we will now turn to the learning algorithms that allow us to create the large models powering modern AI systems. LLMs are trained using methods from the broader field of machine learning. While machine learning is an extensive field of research, understanding LLMs requires familiarity with three core paradigms, and how they are used in language modeling: supervised learning , autoregressive learning , and reinforcement learning . We briefly touch upon these essential methods and refer to standard works for deeper exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 在建立了语言表示的基础知识之后，我们现在将转向学习算法，这些算法使我们能够创建驱动现代人工智能系统的大型模型。 大型语言模型（LLM）是使用更广泛的机器学习领域的训练方法训练的。 虽然机器学习是一个广泛的研究领域，但要理解大型语言模型，需要熟悉三种核心范式以及它们在语言建模中的使用方式：监督学习、自回归学习和强化学习。 我们将简要介绍这些基本方法，并建议参考标准著作以进行更深入的学习。

sents.en: Having established a primer on language representation, we will now turn to the learning algorithms that allow us to create the large models powering modern AI systems.
sents.zh: 在建立了语言表示的基础知识之后，我们现在将转向学习算法，这些算法使我们能够创建驱动现代人工智能系统的大型模型。

sents.en: LLMs are trained using methods from the broader field of machine learning.
sents.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）是使用更广泛的机器学习领域的训练方法训练的。

sents.en: While machine learning is an extensive field of research, understanding LLMs requires familiarity with three core paradigms, and how they are used in language modeling: supervised learning , autoregressive learning , and reinforcement learning .
sents.zh: 虽然机器学习是一个广泛的研究领域，但要理解大型语言模型，需要熟悉三种核心范式以及它们在语言建模中的使用方式：监督学习、自回归学习和强化学习。

sents.en: We briefly touch upon these essential methods and refer to standard works for deeper exploration.
sents.zh: 我们将简要介绍这些基本方法，并建议参考标准著作以进行更深入的学习。

paragraphs.en: Supervised learning is the foundation of machine learning. It is named so because it relies on a set of labels, that must be given beforehand, that supervise the training process. This approach utilizes a dataset consisting of paired examples and labels, D = { ( x i , y i ) } D=\{(x_{i},y_{i})\} , to train the parameters θ \theta of a predictive model f θ f_{\theta} . The model can be used to compute an estimate y ^ \hat{y} for each input x x , denoted mathematically as f θ ​ ( x ) → y ^ f_{\theta}(x)\rightarrow\hat{y} . Using the model to compute this estimate is also known as inference , or the forward pass .
paragraphs.zh: 监督学习是机器学习的基础。 之所以如此命名，是因为它依赖一组必须预先提供的标签来指导训练过程。 这种方法利用由成对示例和标签组成的数据集 D = { ( x i , y i ) } D=\{(x_{i},y_{i})\} 来训练预测模型 f θ f_{\theta} 的参数 θ \theta 。 该模型可用于为每个输入 x x 计算估计值 y ^ \hat{y}，数学上表示为 f θ ​ ( x ) → y ^ f_{\theta}(x)\rightarrow\hat{y} 。 使用该模型计算此估计值的过程也称为推理，或前向传播。

sents.en: Supervised learning is the foundation of machine learning.
sents.zh: 监督学习是机器学习的基础。

sents.en: It is named so because it relies on a set of labels, that must be given beforehand, that supervise the training process.
sents.zh: 之所以如此命名，是因为它依赖一组必须预先提供的标签来指导训练过程。

sents.en: This approach utilizes a dataset consisting of paired examples and labels, D = { ( x i , y i ) } D=\{(x_{i},y_{i})\} , to train the parameters θ \theta of a predictive model f θ f_{\theta} .
sents.zh: 这种方法利用由成对示例和标签组成的数据集 D = { ( x i , y i ) } D=\{(x_{i},y_{i})\} 来训练预测模型 f θ f_{\theta} 的参数 θ \theta 。

sents.en: The model can be used to compute an estimate y ^ \hat{y} for each input x x , denoted mathematically as f θ ​ ( x ) → y ^ f_{\theta}(x)\rightarrow\hat{y} .
sents.zh: 该模型可用于为每个输入 x x 计算估计值 y ^ \hat{y}，数学上表示为 f θ ​ ( x ) → y ^ f_{\theta}(x)\rightarrow\hat{y} 。

sents.en: Using the model to compute this estimate is also known as inference , or the forward pass .
sents.zh: 使用该模型计算此估计值的过程也称为推理，或前向传播。

paragraphs.en: After the forward pass, we can use a loss function ℒ \mathcal{L} to compute some kind of difference between the estimate y ^ \hat{y} and the true label y y . Common examples of loss functions are the sum of squared-difference loss from statistical regression ℒ = ∑ i ( y i ^ − y i ) 2 \mathcal{L}=\sum_{i}(\hat{y_{i}}-y_{i})^{2} , or the cross-entropy loss for classification ℒ = − ∑ c y c log ( y c ^ ) \mathcal{L}=-\sum_{c}y_{c}\log(\hat{y_{c}}) .
paragraphs.zh: 前向传播之后，我们可以使用损失函数 ℒ \mathcal{L} 来计算估计值 y ^ \hat{y} 与真实标签 y y 之间的某种差异。 常见的损失函数示例包括统计回归中的平方差损失 ℒ = ∑ i ( y i ^ − y i ) 2 \mathcal{L}=\sum_{i}(\hat{y_{i}}-y_{i})^{2}，或分类中的交叉熵损失 ℒ = − ∑ c y c log ( y c ^ ) \mathcal{L}=-\sum_{c}y_{c}\log(\hat{y_{c}}) 。

sents.en: After the forward pass, we can use a loss function ℒ \mathcal{L} to compute some kind of difference between the estimate y ^ \hat{y} and the true label y y .
sents.zh: 前向传播之后，我们可以使用损失函数 ℒ \mathcal{L} 来计算估计值 y ^ \hat{y} 与真实标签 y y 之间的某种差异。

sents.en: Common examples of loss functions are the sum of squared-difference loss from statistical regression ℒ = ∑ i ( y i ^ − y i ) 2 \mathcal{L}=\sum_{i}(\hat{y_{i}}-y_{i})^{2} , or the cross-entropy loss for classification ℒ = − ∑ c y c log ( y c ^ ) \mathcal{L}=-\sum_{c}y_{c}\log(\hat{y_{c}}) .
sents.zh: 常见的损失函数示例包括统计回归中的平方差损失 ℒ = ∑ i ( y i ^ − y i ) 2 \mathcal{L}=\sum_{i}(\hat{y_{i}}-y_{i})^{2}，或分类中的交叉熵损失 ℒ = − ∑ c y c log ( y c ^ ) \mathcal{L}=-\sum_{c}y_{c}\log(\hat{y_{c}}) 。

paragraphs.en: The goal of a supervised training algorithm is to minimize the sum of the losses over the dataset of example pairs by adjusting the parameters. This is done in the backward pass . Here, the loss function is used to compute an error signal to adjust the parameters θ \theta of the model f f so that the next forward pass achieves a lower loss (backpropagation of the error). Minimizing the loss function on the examples from a data set is a process called training . A single training run of forward and backward passes over all of the training data is called an epoch (for efficiency reasons, epochs can be split into training batches ).
paragraphs.zh: 监督训练算法的目标是通过调整参数，最小化示例对数据集上所有损失的总和。 这是通过反向传播完成的。 在此过程中，损失函数用于计算一个误差信号，以调整模型 f 的参数 θ，使得下一次前向传播能够获得更低的损失（即误差的反向传播）。 在数据集的示例上最小化损失函数的过程称为训练。 对整个训练数据执行一次前向和反向传播的训练过程称为一个周期（出于效率考虑，周期可以拆分为多个训练批次）。

sents.en: The goal of a supervised training algorithm is to minimize the sum of the losses over the dataset of example pairs by adjusting the parameters.
sents.zh: 监督训练算法的目标是通过调整参数，最小化示例对数据集上所有损失的总和。

sents.en: This is done in the backward pass .
sents.zh: 这是通过反向传播完成的。

sents.en: Here, the loss function is used to compute an error signal to adjust the parameters θ \theta of the model f f so that the next forward pass achieves a lower loss (backpropagation of the error).
sents.zh: 在此过程中，损失函数用于计算一个误差信号，以调整模型 f 的参数 θ，使得下一次前向传播能够获得更低的损失（即误差的反向传播）。

sents.en: Minimizing the loss function on the examples from a data set is a process called training .
sents.zh: 在数据集的示例上最小化损失函数的过程称为训练。

sents.en: A single training run of forward and backward passes over all of the training data is called an epoch (for efficiency reasons, epochs can be split into training batches ).
sents.zh: 对整个训练数据执行一次前向和反向传播的训练过程称为一个周期（出于效率考虑，周期可以拆分为多个训练批次）。

paragraphs.en: After training, to see if our model f θ f_{\theta} works well—if it generalizes to unseen examples—it is tested on new examples, that were not part of the training set.
paragraphs.zh: 训练结束后，为了检验我们的模型 f θ f_{\theta} 是否表现良好——即它能否泛化到未见过的样本上——我们会用未包含在训练集中的新样本对其进行测试。

paragraphs.en: If the accuracy on the training set is high, we say that the model trains well (training converges). If the accuracy on the test set is also high, then we say that the model generalizes well and we have achieved our training goal. Informally speaking, if the accuracy of the model on the training set is high, but on the test set it is low, we say the model overfits on the training set. This usually means that the model has trained for too long or has too many parameters, so that it models not only the signal in the training set but also the noise. If the model has low accuracy on both training and test set, we say that it underfits. This is most likely due to too short training, or a model that is too simple (too few trainable parameters) to model the complexities of the data.
paragraphs.zh: 如果训练集上的准确率很高，我们就说模型训练良好（训练收敛了）。 如果测试集上的准确率也很高，那么我们就说模型泛化良好，并且实现了我们的训练目标。 通俗来说，如果模型在训练集上的准确率很高，但在测试集上却很低，我们就说模型对训练集发生了过拟合。 这通常意味着模型训练时间过长或参数过多，导致它不仅拟合了训练集中的信号，还拟合了噪声。 如果模型在训练集和测试集上的准确率都很低，我们就说它发生了欠拟合。 这很可能是由于训练时间过短，或者模型过于简单（可训练参数过少），无法捕捉数据的复杂性所致。

sents.en: If the accuracy on the training set is high, we say that the model trains well (training converges).
sents.zh: 如果训练集上的准确率很高，我们就说模型训练良好（训练收敛了）。

sents.en: If the accuracy on the test set is also high, then we say that the model generalizes well and we have achieved our training goal.
sents.zh: 如果测试集上的准确率也很高，那么我们就说模型泛化良好，并且实现了我们的训练目标。

sents.en: Informally speaking, if the accuracy of the model on the training set is high, but on the test set it is low, we say the model overfits on the training set.
sents.zh: 通俗来说，如果模型在训练集上的准确率很高，但在测试集上却很低，我们就说模型对训练集发生了过拟合。

sents.en: This usually means that the model has trained for too long or has too many parameters, so that it models not only the signal in the training set but also the noise.
sents.zh: 这通常意味着模型训练时间过长或参数过多，导致它不仅拟合了训练集中的信号，还拟合了噪声。

sents.en: If the model has low accuracy on both training and test set, we say that it underfits.
sents.zh: 如果模型在训练集和测试集上的准确率都很低，我们就说它发生了欠拟合。

sents.en: This is most likely due to too short training, or a model that is too simple (too few trainable parameters) to model the complexities of the data.
sents.zh: 这很可能是由于训练时间过短，或者模型过于简单（可训练参数过少），无法捕捉数据的复杂性所致。

paragraphs.en: Generally speaking, problems with few variables (low-dimensional problems, such as simple regression) require smaller models (fewer parameters) and less training data to perform well. Problems with many variables (high-dimensional problems, such as image classification) require larger models with many millions of parameters (often deep neural networks) and large training datasets to perform well. Indeed, breakthrough performance in image classification [ Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ] was only achieved after the construction of a large dataset with millions of hand-labeled images, Imagenet [ Deng et al., 2009 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 通常来说，变量较少的任务（低维问题，例如简单的回归问题）只需要较小的模型（参数更少）和更少的训练数据就能表现出色。 变量较多的任务（高维问题，例如图像分类）则需要包含数百万参数的更大模型（通常是深度神经网络）以及大规模的训练数据集才能表现出色。 事实上，图像分类领域的突破性表现 [ Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ] 直到构建了一个包含数百万张人工标注图像的庞大数据集 Imagenet [ Deng et al., 2009 ] 之后才得以实现。

sents.en: Generally speaking, problems with few variables (low-dimensional problems, such as simple regression) require smaller models (fewer parameters) and less training data to perform well.
sents.zh: 通常来说，变量较少的任务（低维问题，例如简单的回归问题）只需要较小的模型（参数更少）和更少的训练数据就能表现出色。

sents.en: Problems with many variables (high-dimensional problems, such as image classification) require larger models with many millions of parameters (often deep neural networks) and large training datasets to perform well.
sents.zh: 变量较多的任务（高维问题，例如图像分类）则需要包含数百万参数的更大模型（通常是深度神经网络）以及大规模的训练数据集才能表现出色。

sents.en: Indeed, breakthrough performance in image classification [ Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ] was only achieved after the construction of a large dataset with millions of hand-labeled images, Imagenet [ Deng et al., 2009 ] .
sents.zh: 事实上，图像分类领域的突破性表现 [ Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ] 直到构建了一个包含数百万张人工标注图像的庞大数据集 Imagenet [ Deng et al., 2009 ] 之后才得以实现。

paragraphs.en: Supervised learning is the basis of machine learning. Many good text books have been written about the topic [ Bishop and Bishop, 2023 , Goodfellow et al., 2016 ] . It is one of the core techniques in LLM training, for example in supervised finetuning, as we will see in the next chapter.

paragraphs.en: Large language models are trained autoregressively. In this training approach, there is no dataset of pairs of labeled examples, but there is a lot of (textual) data available. Autoregressive learning is a form of self-supervised learning, without explicit labels, using the inherent sequential nature of the data, to predict the next token.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型是以自回归方式训练的。 在这种训练方法中，并没有带标签的成对示例数据集，但存在大量可用的（文本）数据。 自回归学习是一种自监督学习形式，它无需显式标签，而是利用数据固有的序列特性来预测下一个词元。
