paragraphs.en: In autoregressive pretraining of language models, our algorithm performs predictions over the dataset where each token y = x t y=x_{t} is taken as a label for preceding example tokens 𝐱 = x t − 1 \mathbf{x}=x_{t-1} . Autoregressive learning is a core task of modern NLP, and is used in contemporary model training pipelines [ Radford et al., 2018 ] and included in textbooks on NLP [ Jurafsky and Martin, 2025 ] . We will provide more details of the methods in Section 2.3 and Chapter 3 .

paragraphs.en: Both supervised and autogregressive learning need a dataset of training data to train on—they train offline on pre-existing data. However, sometimes no dataset is available, but we may have access to a function that can tell us when we are in a good state or in a bad state. In that case, an online learning method called reinforcement learning (RL) can be used, where an agent performs an action a a to bring an environment from state s s to the next state s ′ s^{\prime} , after which the environment reports back the reward r ⁡ ( s ′ ) r(s^{\prime}) of that new state. (The method is called online because it generates its training data on the fly, while training.) The agent can then use this reward information to adjust a θ \theta -parameterized behavior policy function π θ ​ ( s ) → a \pi_{\theta}(s)\rightarrow a to know which action to perform in which state. When the problem at hand is as a sequential decision problem, actions a a take the system from state s s to another state s ′ s^{\prime} , and rewards depend on actions taken in the past (the credit assignment problem: to which actions should rewards be assigned?). Repeating the state/action/reward process can cause the agent to explore the entire state space, and learn an optimal policy π ∗ ​ ( s ) \pi^{*}(s) of which action to take, for all states.
paragraphs.zh: 监督学习和自回归学习都需要一个训练数据集来进行训练——它们都是基于已有数据离线训练的。 然而，有时可能没有可用的数据集，但我们或许能访问一个函数，该函数可以判断我们当前处于良好状态还是不良状态。 在这种情况下，可以使用一种名为强化学习（RL）的在线学习方法：智能体执行一个动作 a，使环境从状态 s 转移到下一个状态 s′，随后环境会反馈该新状态的奖励 r(s′)。 （这种方法被称为“在线”方法，因为它在训练过程中实时生成训练数据。）智能体随后可以利用这些奖励信息来调整以 θ 为参数的行为策略函数 πθ(s)→a，从而知道在特定状态下应执行哪个动作。 当所处理的问题是一个序列决策问题时，动作 a 会将系统从状态 s 转移到另一个状态 s′，而奖励则取决于过去采取的动作（信用分配问题：奖励应分配给哪些动作？）。 重复这一状态/动作/奖励的过程，可以使智能体探索整个状态空间，并学会在所有状态下应采取哪个动作的最优策略 π∗(s)。

paragraphs.en: Note that reinforcement learning, being online, is inherently circular. At the start, the policy π \pi has seen few rewards, and has useful information on which action to take for just a few states. If it would greedily use this information on which good action to take, it would traverse only a limited part of the environment, and the optimal policy that it would find would be only locally optimum. To find better optima, it should explore, and try random actions, ideally to cover the entire state space.
paragraphs.zh: 请注意，强化学习是在线进行的，因此本质上具有循环性。 在初始阶段，策略 π \pi 几乎未获得任何奖励，并且仅对少数状态下的行动选择拥有有效信息。 如果它贪婪地利用这些信息来决定采取何种最佳行动，那么它将只探索环境中有限的一部分，而找到的最优策略也只会是局部最优的。 为了找到更优的解，它应当进行探索并尝试随机行动，理想情况下应覆盖整个状态空间。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement is a form of active agentic learning from feedback from an environment. A key observation is that it is typically easier to see if an output is good (reward function), than to create a full new one (labeled dataset). Many reinforcement learning algorithms have been developed that focus on good exploration methods. Reinforcement learning problems are formally modeled as a Markov decision process (MDP), consisting of a state representation S S , an action function A ⁡ ( s ) A(s) , a transition function T ⁡ ( s , a ) → s ′ T(s,a)\rightarrow s^{\prime} , and a reward function R ⁡ ( s ) R(s) . Rewards are numeric indications of the quality of a state, provided by the environment. They can be positive or negative. The goal of an agent is to find the policy π ⁡ ( s ) \pi(s) of optimal actions a ∗ a* in each state s s . Figure 2.4 illustrates how a reinforcement learning agent learns a policy with an action for each state, online, through interaction with the environment, which can compute functions T T and R R (the environment will answer the agent’s question as to what the next state is that resulted from its action, and how good that state is).
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习是一种通过从环境中获取反馈进行主动智能体学习的形式。 一个关键观察是，通常判断一个输出是否良好（奖励函数）比创建一个全新的完整输出（带标签的数据集）更容易。 许多强化学习算法已经开发出来，这些算法专注于有效的探索方法。 强化学习问题被正式建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），包括状态表示 S、动作函数 A(s)、转移函数 T(s,a)→s′ 以及奖励函数 R(s)。 奖励是由环境提供的数值指标，用于表示某个状态的质量。 奖励可以是正的，也可以是负的。 智能体的目标是找到在每个状态 s 中产生最优动作 a* 的策略 π(s)。 图 2.4 展示了强化学习智能体如何通过与环境交互在线学习策略：对于每个状态，智能体会采取一个动作，而环境能够计算函数 T 和 R（即回答智能体的问题：其动作导致了什么下一个状态，以及该状态有多好）。

paragraphs.en: When the state space is small enough to fit in a computer memory, we can use exact tabular reinforcement learning methods, such as Q-learning [ Watkins and Dayan, 1992 ] . For larger problems, function approximation methods are used (deep neural networks) such as deep Q-learning (DQN) [ Mnih et al., 2015 ] or proximal policy optimization (PPO) [ Schulman et al., 2017 ] . In deep reinforcement learning, the policy is a parameterized neural network that is trained by backpropagation, as in supervised deep learning.
paragraphs.zh: 当状态空间足够小，能够容纳在计算机内存中时，我们可以使用精确的表格强化学习方法，例如 Q-learning [ Watkins and Dayan, 1992 ]。 对于规模更大的问题，则使用函数近似方法（深度神经网络），例如深度 Q-learning (DQN) [ Mnih et al., 2015 ] 或近端策略优化 (PPO) [ Schulman et al., 2017 ]。 在深度强化学习中，策略是一个参数化的神经网络，通过反向传播进行训练，这与监督式深度学习中的做法相同。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning is the basis of modern reasoning language models. Many text books have been written about reinforcement learning, such as the seminal work by Sutton and Barto [2018] , as well as more educational texts [ Graesser and Keng, 2019 , Plaat, 2020 , Plaat, 2022 ] . In LLM training, reinforcement learning is used in reinforcement finetuning, and in multi-step reasoning, as we will see in Chapter 6 . Furthermore, reinforcement learning formulates machine learning problems in terms of an agent that tries to learn how to interact in an environment, which fits the agentic LLM setting nicely. In agentic LLMs, it is used in in-context reinforcement learning for prompt optimization, in world models, and to model other agent behavior in relation to the environment, as we will see later in this book.
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习是现代推理语言模型的基础。 关于强化学习的教材已有很多，例如萨顿和巴托的开创性著作 [2018]，以及一些更具教育意义的文本 [Graesser 和 Keng, 2019, Plaat, 2020, Plaat, 2022]。 在 LLM 训练中，强化学习被用于强化微调和多步推理中，我们将在第 6 章看到这一点。 此外，强化学习将机器学习问题表述为一个智能体试图学习如何与环境交互的过程，这与智能体式 LLM 的设定非常契合。 在智能体式 LLM 中，它被用于提示优化的上下文内强化学习、世界模型中，以及用于模拟其他智能体与环境相关的行为，我们将在本书后续内容中看到这些应用。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning is a popular machine learning approach since we can learn new environments where we do not have data available. The method finds its own data. When we consider using reinforcement learning, two questions should be answered: (1) is the problem at hand a sequential decision problem, and, if so, (2) what is the size of the state space, can we use exact tabular methods, or must we resort to approximation?
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习是一种流行的机器学习方法，因为我们可以学习那些没有可用数据的新环境。 这种方法能够自行获取数据。 当我们考虑使用强化学习时，需要回答两个问题：（1）当前的问题是否属于序列决策问题？如果是，那么（2）状态空间的大小如何？我们能否使用精确的表格方法，还是必须采用近似方法？

paragraphs.en: Now that we have discussed the necessary language and machine learning principles, we turn back to language, to the next step: modeling language.
paragraphs.zh: 既然我们已经讨论了必要的语言和机器学习原理，现在让我们回到语言本身，进入下一步：语言建模。

paragraphs.en: After the basics of language representation and machine learning, we turn to the overarching paradigms used to build computational language modeling capabilities. The development of natural language processing is broadly characterized by three paradigms. Each paradigm represents a fundamental shift in the type of model constructed to capture language and how the inherent complexity of human language is managed. We will see that as we move through the paradigms, we incorporate more techniques from machine learning, leveraging increases in compute power to process more data to train larger and larger neural networks for language processing. The paradigms are the symbolic , statistical , and neural approaches [ Kautz, 2020 , Deng and Liu, 2018 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在掌握了语言表示和机器学习的基础知识之后，我们将转向构建计算语言建模能力所使用的主要范式。 自然语言处理的发展大致可以概括为三种范式。 每种范式都代表了构建模型类型以及管理人类语言固有复杂性的方式上的根本性转变。 随着我们逐步了解这些范式，我们会看到如何融入更多机器学习技术，并利用计算能力的提升来处理更多数据，从而训练出规模日益庞大的语言处理神经网络。 这些范式包括符号主义、统计主义和神经主义方法 [ Kautz, 2020 , Deng and Liu, 2018 ] 。

sents.en: After the basics of language representation and machine learning, we turn to the overarching paradigms used to build computational language modeling capabilities.
sents.zh: 在掌握了语言表示和机器学习的基础知识之后，我们将转向构建计算语言建模能力所使用的主要范式。

sents.en: The development of natural language processing is broadly characterized by three paradigms.
sents.zh: 自然语言处理的发展大致可以概括为三种范式。

sents.en: Each paradigm represents a fundamental shift in the type of model constructed to capture language and how the inherent complexity of human language is managed.
sents.zh: 每种范式都代表了构建模型类型以及管理人类语言固有复杂性的方式上的根本性转变。

sents.en: We will see that as we move through the paradigms, we incorporate more techniques from machine learning, leveraging increases in compute power to process more data to train larger and larger neural networks for language processing.
sents.zh: 随着我们逐步了解这些范式，我们会看到如何融入更多机器学习技术，并利用计算能力的提升来处理更多数据，从而训练出规模日益庞大的语言处理神经网络。

sents.en: The paradigms are the symbolic , statistical , and neural approaches [ Kautz, 2020 , Deng and Liu, 2018 ] .
sents.zh: 这些范式包括符号主义、统计主义和神经主义方法 [ Kautz, 2020 , Deng and Liu, 2018 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Often referred to as Classical AI or rule-based systems, these early ELIZA-like symbolic approaches rely on explicit, human-defined instructions. By treating language as a formal system, symbolic models attempt to parse meaning deductively. While these systems are highly transparent and interpretable by design, they are brittle, as they struggle using rigid rules ( if-then-else ) to handle the natural variation, idiomatic expressions, and ambiguities of real-world language. Scaling symbolic approaches to larger language tasks requires a labor-intensive, manual enumeration of many edge cases, which turned out to be unfeasible for all but the smallest problem domains.
paragraphs.zh: 这些早期的类 ELIZA 符号主义方法通常被称为经典人工智能或基于规则的系统，它们依赖于明确且由人类定义的指令。 通过将语言视为一个形式系统，符号主义模型试图以演绎方式解析其含义。 尽管这类系统在设计上具有高度透明性和可解释性，但它们却十分脆弱，因为难以使用僵化的规则（if-then-else）来处理现实语言中的自然变体、习语表达和歧义。 要将符号主义方法扩展到更复杂的语言任务，需要耗费大量人力对众多边缘情况进行手动枚举，而事实证明，除了极小的问题领域外，这种方法并不可行。

paragraphs.en: To overcome the limitations of rigid rule sets, between 1980-1990 the field experienced an empirical shift toward probabilistic modeling with the statistical methods. Instead of relying on explicit syntactic rules, statistical methods such as hidden Markov models and n n -gram language models leverage large text corpora to compute the likelihood of word co-occurrences. This data-driven approach scales efficiently and handles linguistic ambiguity and noise far better than its symbolic predecessors. However, because these models typically rely on the Markov assumption, their representation of meaning is inherently limited to local word patterns, making them ill-equipped to capture long-distance dependencies and broader context.
paragraphs.zh: 为了克服僵化规则集的局限性，1980年至1990年间，该领域经历了一次经验性转变，转向采用统计方法进行的概率建模。 与依赖显式句法规则不同，诸如隐马尔可夫模型和 n-gram 语言模型等统计方法利用大型文本语料库来计算词语共现的可能性。 这种数据驱动的方法能够高效扩展，并且比其基于符号的早期方法更能有效处理语言中的歧义和噪声。 然而，由于这些模型通常依赖马尔可夫假设，其对意义的表达本质上局限于局部词语模式，因此难以捕捉长距离依赖关系和更广泛的上文语境。

paragraphs.en: After approximately 2010, the contemporary state-of-the-art shifted to neural networks and deep learning. Rather than using logic or discrete counts, neural methods represent linguistic units as dense, low-dimensional vectors in a continuous semantic space. Modern architectures, particularly transformers, employ attention mechanisms to model global context simultaneously across an entire sequence. This approach yields impressive generalization, high fluency in text generation, and cross-lingual capabilities. Nevertheless, these advantages come with significant trade-offs: neural models operate largely as black boxes, sacrificing the interpretability seen in symbolic methods, and they require large data sets and large computational resources.
paragraphs.zh: 大约从 2010 年起，当代最先进的技术转向了神经网络和深度学习。 与使用逻辑或离散计数不同，神经方法将语言单位表示为连续语义空间中密集的低维向量。 现代架构，尤其是 Transformer，采用注意力机制来同时建模整个序列中的全局上下文。 这种方法实现了出色的泛化能力、文本生成的高流畅度以及跨语言能力。 然而，这些优势也伴随着显著的权衡：神经模型在很大程度上以黑箱方式运行，牺牲了符号方法所具备的可解释性，并且需要大规模数据集和巨大的计算资源。

paragraphs.en: The contemporary pipelines for NLP training draw inspiration from all of these three paradigms. Before describing an example pipeline in the next chapter, we require a deeper understanding of the core components of these parts, as they are the building blocks for the systems on which agentic LLMs are based. In the next sections we will discuss many topics: word embeddings, contextualized embeddings, sequence modeling, attention, transformers, encoders (such as BERT), and decoders (such as GPT).
paragraphs.zh: 当前自然语言处理训练的流程从这三种范式的全部理念中汲取灵感。 在下一章描述一个示例流程之前，我们需要更深入地理解这些部分的核心组件，因为它们是智能体式大语言模型所依赖系统的构建基础。 在接下来的几节中，我们将讨论许多主题：词嵌入、上下文相关嵌入、序列建模、注意力机制、Transformer、编码器（如 BERT）和解码器（如 GPT）。

sents.en: The contemporary pipelines for NLP training draw inspiration from all of these three paradigms.
sents.zh: 当前自然语言处理训练的流程从这三种范式的全部理念中汲取灵感。

sents.en: Before describing an example pipeline in the next chapter, we require a deeper understanding of the core components of these parts, as they are the building blocks for the systems on which agentic LLMs are based.

sents.en: In the next sections we will discuss many topics: word embeddings, contextualized embeddings, sequence modeling, attention, transformers, encoders (such as BERT), and decoders (such as GPT).
sents.zh: 在接下来的几节中，我们将讨论许多主题：词嵌入、上下文相关嵌入、序列建模、注意力机制、Transformer、编码器（如 BERT）和解码器（如 GPT）。

paragraphs.en: Early models of neural embeddings operationalize semantic understanding of lexical items by defining a context window, a span of n n words to the left and right of a target word, and predicting the missing focus word. For the sentence There are two cookies left on the table , if we set a window of n = 2 n=2 , the context words for cookies are are , two , left , and on . By systematically sliding this window over a large corpus of text, we can count how many times each word appears in the context of every other word. These counts form the basis of a co-occurrence matrix, where each row represents a target word and each column represents a context word. The value in each cell is the number of times the column word appeared in the context of the row word. For example, the vector for cherry might have a high value in the column for pie (e.g., 442) and a low value for computer (e.g., 2). The vector for strawberry would show a similar pattern, and hence reflect the semantical similarity between the two words.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的神经嵌入模型通过定义一个上下文窗口——即目标词左右各 n 个词的区间，并预测缺失的焦点词，来实现对词汇项的语义理解。 对于句子“桌子上还剩下两块饼干”，如果我们设置窗口大小 n = 2，那么“饼干”的上下文词包括“是”、“两”、“块”和“在”。 通过系统地在这个大文本语料库上滑动该窗口，我们可以统计每个词在其他所有词的上下文中出现的次数。 这些计数构成了共现矩阵的基础，其中每一行代表一个目标词，每一列代表一个上下文词。 每个单元格中的值表示该列词在该行词的上下文中出现的次数。 例如，“樱桃”的向量在“派”这一列中可能有一个较高的值（如 442），而在“计算机”这一列中则有一个较低的值（如 2）。 “草莓”的向量会呈现出类似的模式，从而反映这两个词之间的语义相似性。

sents.zh: “草莓”的向量会呈现出类似的模式，从而反映这两个词之间的语义相似性。

paragraphs.en: By representing words as vectors, we place them in a high-dimensional vector space where each dimension corresponds to a context word. In this space, words with similar meanings, which share similar contexts, will point in similar directions. This geometric relationship allows us to measure semantic similarity numerically. The most common method for this is cosine similarity , which measures the cosine of the angle θ \theta between two vectors 𝐚 \mathbf{a} and 𝐛 \mathbf{b} , as in Equation 2.6 .
paragraphs.zh: 通过将词语表示为向量，我们将其置于一个高维向量空间中，其中每个维度都对应一个上下文词语。 在这个空间中，具有相似含义且共享相似上下文的词语将指向相似的方向。 这种几何关系使我们能够以数值方式衡量语义相似度。 最常用的方法是余弦相似度，它测量两个向量 𝐚 \mathbf{a} 和 𝐛 \mathbf{b} 之间夹角 θ \theta 的余弦值，如方程 2.6 所示。

sents.en: By representing words as vectors, we place them in a high-dimensional vector space where each dimension corresponds to a context word.
sents.zh: 通过将词语表示为向量，我们将其置于一个高维向量空间中，其中每个维度都对应一个上下文词语。

sents.en: In this space, words with similar meanings, which share similar contexts, will point in similar directions.
sents.zh: 在这个空间中，具有相似含义且共享相似上下文的词语将指向相似的方向。

sents.en: This geometric relationship allows us to measure semantic similarity numerically.
sents.zh: 这种几何关系使我们能够以数值方式衡量语义相似度。

sents.en: The most common method for this is cosine similarity , which measures the cosine of the angle θ \theta between two vectors 𝐚 \mathbf{a} and 𝐛 \mathbf{b} , as in Equation 2.6 .
sents.zh: 最常用的方法是余弦相似度，它测量两个向量 𝐚 \mathbf{a} 和 𝐛 \mathbf{b} 之间夹角 θ \theta 的余弦值，如方程 2.6 所示。

paragraphs.en: Earlier, we argued that count-based vectors result in high-dimensional spaces that scale linearly with vocabulary size. Since the number of dimensions dictates the computational complexity of downstream models, we wish to keep the dimensionality in check and instead create dense embeddings. For this, we use the classical word2vec algorithm [ Mikolov et al., 2013 ] . In this approach, a random embedding matrix W W is initialized and iteratively updated to match the intuition that similar words occur in similar contexts. This general framework uses two distinct techniques to achieve this: skip-gram and continuous bag-of-words, as shown in Figure 2.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 此前，我们指出基于计数的向量会生成高维空间，其维度随词汇表规模线性增长。 由于维度数量决定了下游模型的计算复杂度，我们希望控制维度规模，转而构建密集嵌入。 为此，我们使用经典的 word2vec 算法 [ Mikolov et al., 2013 ]。 在这种方法中，会初始化一个随机嵌入矩阵 W，并通过迭代更新使其符合“相似词语常出现在相似语境中”的直觉。 这一通用框架采用两种不同的技术来实现该目标：skip-gram 和连续词袋模型，如图 2.5 所示。

sents.en: Earlier, we argued that count-based vectors result in high-dimensional spaces that scale linearly with vocabulary size.
sents.zh: 此前，我们指出基于计数的向量会生成高维空间，其维度随词汇表规模线性增长。

sents.en: Since the number of dimensions dictates the computational complexity of downstream models, we wish to keep the dimensionality in check and instead create dense embeddings.
sents.zh: 由于维度数量决定了下游模型的计算复杂度，我们希望控制维度规模，转而构建密集嵌入。

sents.en: For this, we use the classical word2vec algorithm [ Mikolov et al., 2013 ] .
sents.zh: 为此，我们使用经典的 word2vec 算法 [ Mikolov et al., 2013 ]。

sents.en: In this approach, a random embedding matrix W W is initialized and iteratively updated to match the intuition that similar words occur in similar contexts.
sents.zh: 在这种方法中，会初始化一个随机嵌入矩阵 W，并通过迭代更新使其符合“相似词语常出现在相似语境中”的直觉。

sents.en: This general framework uses two distinct techniques to achieve this: skip-gram and continuous bag-of-words, as shown in Figure 2.5 .
sents.zh: 这一通用框架采用两种不同的技术来实现该目标：skip-gram 和连续词袋模型，如图 2.5 所示。

paragraphs.en: The first, skip-gram , predicts which context words are likely to surround a given target word. It updates the matrix to ensure that the cosine similarity between positive samples, which are actual target and context pairs, is high, while driving down the similarity for negative samples, which are random word pairings. Because skip-gram treats every target-context pairing as a distinct training observation, it heavily penalizes incorrect predictions even for infrequent terms. Hence, skip-gram excels at capturing fine-grained semantic details and produces accurate representations even for rare words.
paragraphs.zh: 第一种方法，skip-gram，用于预测哪些上下文词汇可能围绕一个给定的目标词。 它会更新矩阵，以确保正样本（即实际的目标词与上下文词对）之间的余弦相似度较高，同时降低负样本（即随机组合的词对）的相似度。 由于 skip-gram 将每个目标词与上下文词的配对都视为一个独立的训练观测，因此即使对于低频词汇，它也会严厉惩罚错误的预测。 因此，skip-gram 能够出色地捕捉细微的语义细节，甚至能为罕见词汇生成准确的表示。

sents.en: The first, skip-gram , predicts which context words are likely to surround a given target word.
sents.zh: 第一种方法，skip-gram，用于预测哪些上下文词汇可能围绕一个给定的目标词。

sents.en: It updates the matrix to ensure that the cosine similarity between positive samples, which are actual target and context pairs, is high, while driving down the similarity for negative samples, which are random word pairings.
sents.zh: 它会更新矩阵，以确保正样本（即实际的目标词与上下文词对）之间的余弦相似度较高，同时降低负样本（即随机组合的词对）的相似度。

sents.en: Because skip-gram treats every target-context pairing as a distinct training observation, it heavily penalizes incorrect predictions even for infrequent terms.
sents.zh: 由于 skip-gram 将每个目标词与上下文词的配对都视为一个独立的训练观测，因此即使对于低频词汇，它也会严厉惩罚错误的预测。

sents.en: Hence, skip-gram excels at capturing fine-grained semantic details and produces accurate representations even for rare words.
sents.zh: 因此，skip-gram 能够出色地捕捉细微的语义细节，甚至能为罕见词汇生成准确的表示。

paragraphs.en: The second, continuous bag-of-words (CBOW), performs the reverse operation. It predicts a single target word based on a combined set of surrounding context words. By averaging the context vectors before predicting the target, CBOW inherently smooths over the specific details of individual context words. This distributional smoothing is the reason for its distinct performance profile: CBOW trains significantly faster than skip-gram and is highly effective at capturing general syntactic relationships among frequent words, though it sacrifices some sensitivity to a rare vocabulary.
paragraphs.zh: 第二种连续词袋模型（CBOW）则执行相反的操作。 它基于周围上下文词语的集合，预测单个目标词语。 CBOW 在预测目标词语之前对上下文向量进行平均，因此天然地平滑了各个上下文词语的具体细节。 这种分布平滑性正是其独特性能特征的原因：CBOW 的训练速度明显快于 skip-gram，并且能有效捕捉高频词语之间的通用句法关系，尽管它在处理稀有词汇时牺牲了一定的敏感度。

sents.en: The second, continuous bag-of-words (CBOW), performs the reverse operation.
sents.zh: 第二种连续词袋模型（CBOW）则执行相反的操作。

sents.en: It predicts a single target word based on a combined set of surrounding context words.
sents.zh: 它基于周围上下文词语的集合，预测单个目标词语。

sents.en: By averaging the context vectors before predicting the target, CBOW inherently smooths over the specific details of individual context words.
sents.zh: CBOW 在预测目标词语之前对上下文向量进行平均，因此天然地平滑了各个上下文词语的具体细节。

sents.en: This distributional smoothing is the reason for its distinct performance profile: CBOW trains significantly faster than skip-gram and is highly effective at capturing general syntactic relationships among frequent words, though it sacrifices some sensitivity to a rare vocabulary.
sents.zh: 这种分布平滑性正是其独特性能特征的原因：CBOW 的训练速度明显快于 skip-gram，并且能有效捕捉高频词语之间的通用句法关系，尽管它在处理稀有词汇时牺牲了一定的敏感度。

paragraphs.en: Word2vec represented a major leap forward in the creation of high-quality word embeddings. However, a major downside is that word2vec results in static embeddings . This means that a word is mapped to a single vector regardless of its usage (its context). This creates a fundamental problem with polysemy. Consider the word bank in two different sentences:
paragraphs.zh: Word2vec 在生成高质量词嵌入方面实现了重大突破。 然而，其一个主要缺点是 word2vec 会产生静态的嵌入向量。 这意味着无论词语如何使用（即不考虑其上下文），它都会被映射为一个唯一的向量。 这给多义性带来了根本性的问题。 考虑单词 bank 在以下两个不同句子中的用法：

sents.en: Word2vec represented a major leap forward in the creation of high-quality word embeddings.
sents.zh: Word2vec 在生成高质量词嵌入方面实现了重大突破。

sents.en: However, a major downside is that word2vec results in static embeddings .
sents.zh: 然而，其一个主要缺点是 word2vec 会产生静态的嵌入向量。

sents.en: This means that a word is mapped to a single vector regardless of its usage (its context).
sents.zh: 这意味着无论词语如何使用（即不考虑其上下文），它都会被映射为一个唯一的向量。

sents.en: This creates a fundamental problem with polysemy.
sents.zh: 这给多义性带来了根本性的问题。

sents.en: Consider the word bank in two different sentences:
sents.zh: 考虑单词 bank 在以下两个不同句子中的用法：

paragraphs.en: I need to go to the bank to withdraw some money.
paragraphs.zh: 我需要去银行取一些钱。

paragraphs.en: In a static model, bank has one fixed representation that must average or pick between these disparate meanings, resulting in a vector that is neither purely financial nor purely geographical or a weird blend of the two. Modern architectures (such as BERT and GPT, which are discussed later in this chapter) solve this by producing contextualized embeddings . Instead of a static look-up table, the model processes the entire sequence. The resulting vector for bank is calculated dynamically based on the surrounding tokens ( money , withdraw vs. river , swimmer ), allowing the machine to represent the specific nuance intended by the speaker.
paragraphs.zh: 在静态模型中，「bank」只有一个固定的表示形式，必须在这些截然不同的含义之间取平均值或做出选择，最终得到的向量既不是纯粹的金融概念，也不是纯粹的地域概念，而是一种奇怪的混合体。 现代架构（例如本章稍后将讨论的 BERT 和 GPT）通过生成语境化的嵌入来解决这个问题。 模型不再使用静态的查找表，而是处理整个序列。 「bank」的最终向量会根据周围的词元（如 money、withdraw 与 river、swimmer）动态计算，使机器能够表达说话者所意图的具体细微差别。

sents.en: In a static model, bank has one fixed representation that must average or pick between these disparate meanings, resulting in a vector that is neither purely financial nor purely geographical or a weird blend of the two.
sents.zh: 在静态模型中，「bank」只有一个固定的表示形式，必须在这些截然不同的含义之间取平均值或做出选择，最终得到的向量既不是纯粹的金融概念，也不是纯粹的地域概念，而是一种奇怪的混合体。

sents.en: Modern architectures (such as BERT and GPT, which are discussed later in this chapter) solve this by producing contextualized embeddings .
sents.zh: 现代架构（例如本章稍后将讨论的 BERT 和 GPT）通过生成语境化的嵌入来解决这个问题。

sents.en: Instead of a static look-up table, the model processes the entire sequence.
sents.zh: 模型不再使用静态的查找表，而是处理整个序列。

sents.en: The resulting vector for bank is calculated dynamically based on the surrounding tokens ( money , withdraw vs. river , swimmer ), allowing the machine to represent the specific nuance intended by the speaker.
sents.zh: 「bank」的最终向量会根据周围的词元（如 money、withdraw 与 river、swimmer）动态计算，使机器能够表达说话者所意图的具体细微差别。

paragraphs.en: While embeddings are capable of expressing the complex semantics of individual words, we still need an efficient way to ingest language as a sequence. Training models for classification tasks, for instance, requires independence assumptions to simplify computational dependencies. We could take a sliding window approach to concatenate all relevant word embeddings into a single vector to represent a sentence. However, this rapidly increases the size of the input to any classifier, and does not scale to long sequences of text.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管嵌入能够表达单个词语的复杂语义，但我们仍然需要一种高效的方法来处理语言序列。 例如，训练分类任务模型需要依赖独立性假设来简化计算上的依赖关系。 我们可以采用滑动窗口方法，将所有相关的词嵌入拼接成一个向量，以表示一个句子。 然而，这会迅速增加任何分类器的输入规模，并且无法适应较长的文本序列。

sents.en: While embeddings are capable of expressing the complex semantics of individual words, we still need an efficient way to ingest language as a sequence.
sents.zh: 尽管嵌入能够表达单个词语的复杂语义，但我们仍然需要一种高效的方法来处理语言序列。

sents.zh: 例如，训练分类任务模型需要依赖独立性假设来简化计算上的依赖关系。

sents.en: We could take a sliding window approach to concatenate all relevant word embeddings into a single vector to represent a sentence.
sents.zh: 我们可以采用滑动窗口方法，将所有相关的词嵌入拼接成一个向量，以表示一个句子。

sents.en: However, this rapidly increases the size of the input to any classifier, and does not scale to long sequences of text.
sents.zh: 然而，这会迅速增加任何分类器的输入规模，并且无法适应较长的文本序列。

paragraphs.en: In humans, the expectation of what we observe next is conditioned on the things that we have seen (or heard) in the past. Previously, models approximated this intuition through the independence assumption, as seen in Equation 2.2 . Formally, we introduce additional notation for our input x x occurring in sequence x 1 , x 2 , … , x t x_{1},x_{2},\dots,x_{t} from timestep 1 through t t . In this formulation, predicting the next word can be modeled as P ⁡ ( x t + 1 ∣ x 1 , … , x t ) P(x_{t+1}\mid x_{1},\dots,x_{t}) . Alternatively, we call x t + 1 x_{t+1} the prediction y t y_{t} for timestep t t .
paragraphs.zh: 对人类而言，我们对接下来会观察到什么的预期，取决于我们过去所见（或所闻）的事物。 此前，模型通过独立性假设来近似这种直觉，如方程 2.2 所示。 正式地，我们为输入 x 在时间步 1 到 t 的序列 x₁, x₂, …, xₜ 中出现的形式引入额外的符号表示。 在这种表述中，预测下一个词可以建模为 P(xₜ₊₁∣x₁, …, xₜ)。 或者，我们将 xₜ₊₁ 称为时间步 t 的预测值 yₜ。

sents.zh: 对人类而言，我们对接下来会观察到什么的预期，取决于我们过去所见（或所闻）的事物。

sents.en: Previously, models approximated this intuition through the independence assumption, as seen in Equation 2.2 .
sents.zh: 此前，模型通过独立性假设来近似这种直觉，如方程 2.2 所示。

sents.en: Formally, we introduce additional notation for our input x x occurring in sequence x 1 , x 2 , … , x t x_{1},x_{2},\dots,x_{t} from timestep 1 through t t .
sents.zh: 正式地，我们为输入 x 在时间步 1 到 t 的序列 x₁, x₂, …, xₜ 中出现的形式引入额外的符号表示。

sents.zh: 在这种表述中，预测下一个词可以建模为 P(xₜ₊₁∣x₁, …, xₜ)。

sents.en: Alternatively, we call x t + 1 x_{t+1} the prediction y t y_{t} for timestep t t .
sents.zh: 或者，我们将 xₜ₊₁ 称为时间步 t 的预测值 yₜ。

paragraphs.en: To effectively observe input in sequences and produce corresponding predictions, we must incorporate historical context into our models. This means that, in addition to the current input, we include the previous hidden state from our model. Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are networks with such a cycle, where current values depend on the input as well as the network’s state at a previous timestep. Instead of only producing a prediction (e.g., a word or token) y t y_{t} , we now also keep track of a hidden state h t h_{t} . Formally, this is expressed in Equations 2.7 and 2.8 . Figure 2.6 illustrate the architecure of an RNN, and how we can picture its unrolling in time steps.
paragraphs.zh: 为了有效观察序列中的输入并生成相应的预测，我们必须将历史上下文纳入模型中。 这意味着除了当前输入之外，我们还需要包含模型之前的隐藏状态。 循环神经网络（RNN）是具有这种循环结构的网络，其中当前值不仅取决于输入，还取决于网络在前一时间步的状态。 现在我们不再仅生成预测结果（例如一个词或词元）y t y_{t} ，还会同时跟踪隐藏状态 h t h_{t} 。 在形式上，这一点通过方程 2.7 和 2.8 表达出来。 图 2.6 展示了 RNN 的架构，以及我们如何将其在不同时间步上的展开过程可视化。

sents.en: To effectively observe input in sequences and produce corresponding predictions, we must incorporate historical context into our models.
sents.zh: 为了有效观察序列中的输入并生成相应的预测，我们必须将历史上下文纳入模型中。

sents.en: This means that, in addition to the current input, we include the previous hidden state from our model.
sents.zh: 这意味着除了当前输入之外，我们还需要包含模型之前的隐藏状态。

sents.en: Recurrent neural networks (RNNs) are networks with such a cycle, where current values depend on the input as well as the network’s state at a previous timestep.
sents.zh: 循环神经网络（RNN）是具有这种循环结构的网络，其中当前值不仅取决于输入，还取决于网络在前一时间步的状态。

sents.en: Instead of only producing a prediction (e.g., a word or token) y t y_{t} , we now also keep track of a hidden state h t h_{t} .
sents.zh: 现在我们不再仅生成预测结果（例如一个词或词元）y t y_{t} ，还会同时跟踪隐藏状态 h t h_{t} 。

sents.en: Formally, this is expressed in Equations 2.7 and 2.8 .
sents.zh: 在形式上，这一点通过方程 2.7 和 2.8 表达出来。

sents.en: Figure 2.6 illustrate the architecure of an RNN, and how we can picture its unrolling in time steps.
sents.zh: 图 2.6 展示了 RNN 的架构，以及我们如何将其在不同时间步上的展开过程可视化。

paragraphs.en: This introduces new trainable parameter matrices 𝐔 , 𝐕 , 𝐖 \mathbf{U},\mathbf{V},\mathbf{W} (and subsequent bias terms 𝐛 \mathbf{b} ) to make sure our architecture can shape the hidden state and output logits accordingly. RNNs can theoretically process infinite-length sequences, and we no longer need the Markov assumption to account for a sparsity problem.
paragraphs.zh: 这引入了新的可训练参数矩阵 𝐔、𝐕、𝐖（以及随后的偏置项 𝐛），以确保我们的架构能够相应地塑造隐藏状态和输出 logits。 RNN 理论上可以处理无限长度的序列，并且我们不再需要马尔可夫假设来解决稀疏性问题。

sents.en: This introduces new trainable parameter matrices 𝐔 , 𝐕 , 𝐖 \mathbf{U},\mathbf{V},\mathbf{W} (and subsequent bias terms 𝐛 \mathbf{b} ) to make sure our architecture can shape the hidden state and output logits accordingly.
sents.zh: 这引入了新的可训练参数矩阵 𝐔、𝐕、𝐖（以及随后的偏置项 𝐛），以确保我们的架构能够相应地塑造隐藏状态和输出 logits。

sents.en: RNNs can theoretically process infinite-length sequences, and we no longer need the Markov assumption to account for a sparsity problem.
sents.zh: RNN 理论上可以处理无限长度的序列，并且我们不再需要马尔可夫假设来解决稀疏性问题。

paragraphs.en: Training RNNs is done using backpropagation through time (BPTT), where we unroll the temporal dependencies to backpropagate the gradient from time step t t to earlier ones: t − 1 , t − 2 , … t_{-1},t_{-2},\dots . However, because the gradients for updating the model at a timestep depend recursively on the previous timesteps, this step is sensitive. Because of the repeated matrix multiplications required by the chain rule, this leads to the problem of vanishing or exploding gradients [ Bengio et al., 1994 , Pascanu et al., 2013 ] . Controlling the flow of information in RNNs is difficult. Information from early timesteps has relatively little impact on our gradients, compared to more recent information. In practice, learning salient signals with RNNs is often difficult.
paragraphs.zh: 训练循环神经网络（RNN）采用时间反向传播（BPTT）方法，其中我们将时间依赖关系展开，以便从时间步 t 将梯度反向传播到更早的时间步：t−1、t−2、… t_{-1},t_{-2},\dots。 然而，由于在某个时间步更新模型所需的梯度会递归地依赖于之前的时间步，因此该步骤具有敏感性。 由于链式法则需要反复进行矩阵乘法，这会导致梯度消失或爆炸问题 [ Bengio et al., 1994 , Pascanu et al., 2013 ]。 控制循环神经网络（RNN）中信息的流动十分困难。 与较晚时间步的信息相比，早期时间步的信息对我们的梯度影响相对较小。 在实践中，使用循环神经网络（RNN）学习显著信号通常较为困难。

sents.zh: 训练循环神经网络（RNN）采用时间反向传播（BPTT）方法，其中我们将时间依赖关系展开，以便从时间步 t 将梯度反向传播到更早的时间步：t−1、t−2、… t_{-1},t_{-2},\dots。

In an LSTM network, additional gates are added to construct a context vector, which the network will learn to add and update information to (see Figure 2.7 ). Below is the mathematical definition for a single time step t t for the LSTM architecture. The LSTM maintains two states: a context state ( c t c_{t} ) and a hidden state ( h t h_{t} ), and uses gates to control the flow of information:

paragraphs.en: In the notation above, ⊙ \odot denotes the element-wise multiplication of two vectors, also called the Hadamard product. Besides LSTMs, there are subsequent variants such as the gated recurrent unit (GRU) that balance the computational complexity and the number of trainable parameters [ Cho et al., 2014 ] .

paragraphs.en: So far, we have formulated our task as the language modeling task: how to predict the next word, given a context of preceding words. However, there is an alternative task formulation that is useful to introduce.
paragraphs.zh: 到目前为止，我们将任务定义为语言建模任务：在给定前文语境的情况下，如何预测下一个词。 然而，还有一种替代的任务定义方式值得引入。

sents.en: So far, we have formulated our task as the language modeling task: how to predict the next word, given a context of preceding words.
sents.zh: 到目前为止，我们将任务定义为语言建模任务：在给定前文语境的情况下，如何预测下一个词。

sents.en: However, there is an alternative task formulation that is useful to introduce.
sents.zh: 然而，还有一种替代的任务定义方式值得引入。

paragraphs.en: Consider the problem of machine translation. paragraphs.en: The encoder-decoder architecture is a powerful framework designed to handle sequence-to-sequence tasks where the input and output lengths may differ. The encoder and decoder are two distinct RNNs that work together to map a variable-length input to a variable-length output. The job of the encoder is to process the input sequence one step at a time and compress the information into a fixed-length vector, often called the context vector. 3 3 3 Not to be confused with the LSTM’s context vector. NLP research has repurposed terminology in relatively little time. Language in research papers is also a moving target. This forces the information into a bottleneck : compressing information of an input sequence x 1 , … , x t x_{1},\dots,x_{t} into a single hidden vector. However, this process is difficult to model and there is a loss of information. See Figure 2.8 for an illustration of the architecture.
paragraphs.zh: 编码器-解码器架构是一种强大的框架，专为处理输入和输出长度可能不同的序列到序列任务而设计。 编码器和解码器是两个独立的 RNN，它们协同工作，将可变长度的输入映射为可变长度的输出。 编码器的任务是逐步处理输入序列，并将信息压缩成一个固定长度的向量，通常称为上下文向量。3 3 3 不要与 LSTM 的上下文向量混淆。 NLP 研究在相对较短的时间内重新利用了相关术语。 研究论文中的语言本身也是一个不断变化的目标。 这迫使信息进入一个瓶颈：将输入序列 x₁, …, xₜ 的信息压缩成一个单一的隐藏向量。 然而，这个过程难以建模，并且会导致信息丢失。 有关该架构的示意图，请参见图 2.8。

sents.en: The encoder-decoder architecture is a powerful framework designed to handle sequence-to-sequence tasks where the input and output lengths may differ.
sents.zh: 编码器-解码器架构是一种强大的框架，专为处理输入和输出长度可能不同的序列到序列任务而设计。

sents.en: The encoder and decoder are two distinct RNNs that work together to map a variable-length input to a variable-length output.
sents.zh: 编码器和解码器是两个独立的 RNN，它们协同工作，将可变长度的输入映射为可变长度的输出。

sents.en: The job of the encoder is to process the input sequence one step at a time and compress the information into a fixed-length vector, often called the context vector. 3 3 3 Not to be confused with the LSTM’s context vector.
sents.zh: 编码器的任务是逐步处理输入序列，并将信息压缩成一个固定长度的向量，通常称为上下文向量。3 3 3 不要与 LSTM 的上下文向量混淆。

sents.en: NLP research has repurposed terminology in relatively little time.
sents.zh: NLP 研究在相对较短的时间内重新利用了相关术语。

sents.en: Language in research papers is also a moving target.
sents.zh: 研究论文中的语言本身也是一个不断变化的目标。

sents.en: This forces the information into a bottleneck : compressing information of an input sequence x 1 , … , x t x_{1},\dots,x_{t} into a single hidden vector.
sents.zh: 这迫使信息进入一个瓶颈：将输入序列 x₁, …, xₜ 的信息压缩成一个单一的隐藏向量。

sents.en: However, this process is difficult to model and there is a loss of information.
sents.zh: 然而，这个过程难以建模，并且会导致信息丢失。

sents.en: See Figure 2.8 for an illustration of the architecture.
sents.zh: 有关该架构的示意图，请参见图 2.8。

paragraphs.en: The context vector acts as the bridge between the encoder and the decoder. It is the final hidden state of the encoder that is passed to the decoder as its initial hidden state. This vector encodes the semantic meaning of the entire source sentence, so the decoder can begin generating the target sequence accurately. The decoder is a second RNN that produces output tokens, conditioned on the context vector. Its goal is to generate the output sequence one token at a time. This continues until a special end-of-sequence token is generated. This approach works well, in principle. However, forcing a long input sentence into a single, fixed-length context vector causes information loss (the bottleneck problem). Moreover, RNNs struggle to remember the beginning of long sequences by the time they reach the end. These two problems combined prompted the development of a more dynamic approach for passing information between the encoder and decoder, which we will discuss next.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文向量充当编码器和解码器之间的桥梁。 编码器最终的隐藏状态会被传递给解码器，作为其初始隐藏状态。 该向量编码了整个源句的语义含义，因此解码器可以开始准确生成目标序列。 解码器是第二个 RNN，它基于上下文向量生成输出词元。 它的目标是逐个词元地生成输出序列。 这个过程会持续进行，直到生成一个特殊的序列结束词元。 从原理上讲，这种方法效果很好。 然而，将长输入句子强行压缩到一个固定长度的上下文向量中会导致信息丢失（即瓶颈问题）。 此外，当 RNN 处理到长序列的末尾时，它已经难以记住序列的开头部分。 这两个问题的结合促使人们开发了一种更动态的方法，用于在编码器和解码器之间传递信息，我们将在下一部分讨论这种方法。

sents.en: The context vector acts as the bridge between the encoder and the decoder.
sents.zh: 上下文向量充当编码器和解码器之间的桥梁。

sents.en: It is the final hidden state of the encoder that is passed to the decoder as its initial hidden state.
sents.zh: 编码器最终的隐藏状态会被传递给解码器，作为其初始隐藏状态。

sents.en: The decoder is a second RNN that produces output tokens, conditioned on the context vector.
sents.zh: 解码器是第二个 RNN，它基于上下文向量生成输出词元。

sents.en: Its goal is to generate the output sequence one token at a time.
sents.zh: 它的目标是逐个词元地生成输出序列。

sents.en: This continues until a special end-of-sequence token is generated.
sents.zh: 这个过程会持续进行，直到生成一个特殊的序列结束词元。

sents.en: This approach works well, in principle.
sents.zh: 从原理上讲，这种方法效果很好。

sents.en: However, forcing a long input sentence into a single, fixed-length context vector causes information loss (the bottleneck problem).
sents.zh: 然而，将长输入句子强行压缩到一个固定长度的上下文向量中会导致信息丢失（即瓶颈问题）。

sents.en: Moreover, RNNs struggle to remember the beginning of long sequences by the time they reach the end.
sents.zh: 此外，当 RNN 处理到长序列的末尾时，它已经难以记住序列的开头部分。

sents.en: These two problems combined prompted the development of a more dynamic approach for passing information between the encoder and decoder, which we will discuss next.
sents.zh: 这两个问题的结合促使人们开发了一种更动态的方法，用于在编码器和解码器之间传递信息，我们将在下一部分讨论这种方法。

paragraphs.en: In search for a solution to the bottleneck problem, researchers looked for ways to efficiently pass information from across the entire sequence into the decoder. During the generation process, the decoder could then decide which of the parts in the input sequence were relevant for decoding the next word.
paragraphs.zh: 为了寻找解决瓶颈问题的方法，研究人员探索了如何高效地将整个序列中的信息传递到解码器中。 在生成过程中，解码器可以据此决定输入序列中的哪些部分与解码下一个词相关。

sents.en: In search for a solution to the bottleneck problem, researchers looked for ways to efficiently pass information from across the entire sequence into the decoder.
sents.zh: 为了寻找解决瓶颈问题的方法，研究人员探索了如何高效地将整个序列中的信息传递到解码器中。

sents.en: During the generation process, the decoder could then decide which of the parts in the input sequence were relevant for decoding the next word.
sents.zh: 在生成过程中，解码器可以据此决定输入序列中的哪些部分与解码下一个词相关。

paragraphs.en: This search has lead to advanced mechanisms for attention [ Bahdanau et al., 2015 , Kim et al., 2017 ] . The effect of the attention mechanism is illustrated in Figure 2.9 , where translation performance (in terms of BLEU score [ Papineni et al., 2002 ] , higher is better) is plotted. The architecture using the attention mechanism (called RNNsearch , see Figure 2.9 ) shows a consistent ability to achieve high translation quality especially for long sentences. The standard RNN encoder-decoder model ( RNNenc ) suffers a sharp drop in performance as sentence length increases.
paragraphs.zh: 这项研究催生了先进的注意力机制 [Bahdanau et al., 2015, Kim et al., 2017]。 注意力机制的效果如图 2.9 所示，图中绘制了翻译性能（以 BLEU 分数 [Papineni et al., 2002] 衡量，分数越高越好）的变化情况。 采用注意力机制的架构（称为 RNNsearch，参见图 2.9）展现出持续的高翻译质量，尤其适用于长句。 标准的 RNN 编码器-解码器模型（RNNenc）在句子长度增加时性能会急剧下降。

sents.en: This search has lead to advanced mechanisms for attention [ Bahdanau et al., 2015 , Kim et al., 2017 ] .
sents.zh: 这项研究催生了先进的注意力机制 [Bahdanau et al., 2015, Kim et al., 2017]。

sents.en: The effect of the attention mechanism is illustrated in Figure 2.9 , where translation performance (in terms of BLEU score [ Papineni et al., 2002 ] , higher is better) is plotted.
sents.zh: 注意力机制的效果如图 2.9 所示，图中绘制了翻译性能（以 BLEU 分数 [Papineni et al., 2002] 衡量，分数越高越好）的变化情况。

sents.zh: 采用注意力机制的架构（称为 RNNsearch，参见图 2.9）展现出持续的高翻译质量，尤其适用于长句。

sents.en: The standard RNN encoder-decoder model ( RNNenc ) suffers a sharp drop in performance as sentence length increases.
sents.zh: 标准的 RNN 编码器-解码器模型（RNNenc）在句子长度增加时性能会急剧下降。

paragraphs.en: The intuition behind attention is to include a linear combination of all encoder hidden states in the context vector, instead of relying on a single final hidden state. This allows the model to look back at specific parts of the input sequence that are relevant to the current word being generated. We can control how much focus each input token x i x_{i} receives by adjusting its weight a i a_{i} in the linear combination, as shown in Equation 2.9 . Here, 𝐜 j \mathbf{c}_{j} is the context vector for the j j -th output, and h i h_{i} represents the hidden state of the i i -th input token.
paragraphs.zh: 注意力机制的直观思想是，在上下文向量中纳入所有编码器隐藏状态的线性组合，而不是仅仅依赖单个最终隐藏状态。 这使得模型能够回溯输入序列中与当前正在生成的词相关的特定部分。 通过调整线性组合中每个输入标记 x_i 的权重 a_i，我们可以控制每个输入标记所获得关注程度的大小，如方程 2.9 所示。 此处，𝐜_j 是第 j 个输出的上下文向量，而 h_i 表示第 i 个输入标记的隐藏状态。

sents.en: The intuition behind attention is to include a linear combination of all encoder hidden states in the context vector, instead of relying on a single final hidden state.

sents.zh: 这使得模型能够回溯输入序列中与当前正在生成的词相关的特定部分。

sents.en: We can control how much focus each input token x i x_{i} receives by adjusting its weight a i a_{i} in the linear combination, as shown in Equation 2.9 .
sents.zh: 通过调整线性组合中每个输入标记 x_i 的权重 a_i，我们可以控制每个输入标记所获得关注程度的大小，如方程 2.9 所示。

sents.en: Here, 𝐜 j \mathbf{c}_{j} is the context vector for the j j -th output, and h i h_{i} represents the hidden state of the i i -th input token.
sents.zh: 此处，𝐜_j 是第 j 个输出的上下文向量，而 h_i 表示第 i 个输入标记的隐藏状态。

paragraphs.en: The weights a a (often called attention weights) are not fixed; they are computed dynamically. A key observation is that we can make use of the hidden states h i h_{i} , which are a representation of the semantics of a token or word. We can find out how relevant one hidden state is to another, by comparing them, for example by computing their cosine similarity. The softmax-normalized dot product is a common approach:
paragraphs.zh: 权重 a a（通常称为注意力权重）并非固定不变；它们是通过动态计算得出的。 一个关键观察是，我们可以利用隐藏状态 h i h_{i}，这些状态是对某个词元或词语语义的表示。 通过比较不同的隐藏状态，例如计算它们的余弦相似度，我们可以了解一个隐藏状态与另一个隐藏状态的相关性。 经过 softmax 归一化的点积是一种常见方法：

sents.zh: 一个关键观察是，我们可以利用隐藏状态 h i h_{i}，这些状态是对某个词元或词语语义的表示。

sents.en: We can find out how relevant one hidden state is to another, by comparing them, for example by computing their cosine similarity.
sents.zh: 通过比较不同的隐藏状态，例如计算它们的余弦相似度，我们可以了解一个隐藏状态与另一个隐藏状态的相关性。

sents.en: The softmax-normalized dot product is a common approach:

paragraphs.en: Compare the current decoder state with each encoder hidden state by applying a similarity function (such as a dot product) to see how well they match.
paragraphs.zh: 通过应用相似性函数（例如点积）将当前的解码器状态与每个编码器的隐藏状态进行比较，以观察它们的匹配程度。

paragraphs.en: Pass these scores through a softmax function so they sum to 1, effectively creating a probability distribution over the input tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 将这些分数通过一个 softmax 函数处理，使它们的总和为 1，从而在输入词元上有效地创建一个概率分布。

paragraphs.en: While attention improved accuracy, the challenge of efficient computation of RNNs still remained to be solved. Because RNNs process tokens one by one (sequentially), they cannot take full advantage of modern parallel computing hardware in GPUs. To be able to scale to large datasets the recurrence should be removed entirely. This can be achieved by going from a sequential structure to a parallel one with a fixed context width that processes all tokens in parallel. This is achieved through self-attention . Mathematically, this turns the computation of the contextualized embeddings into Equation 2.10 .
paragraphs.zh: 虽然注意力机制提高了准确性，但高效计算循环神经网络（RNN）的挑战仍然存在。 由于循环神经网络是逐个（按顺序）处理词元的，因此无法充分利用 GPU 等现代并行计算硬件的优势。 为了能够扩展到大型数据集，必须完全消除这种递归性。 这可以通过将顺序结构转变为具有固定上下文宽度的并行结构来实现，该结构可以并行处理所有词元。 这是通过自注意力机制实现的。 从数学上讲，这将上下文嵌入的计算转化为方程 2.10。

paragraphs.en: Where Q Q represents the matrix representing the current focus, K K represents the keys providing the information in the sequence to compare against, V V represents the matrix containing the actual content to be extracted, and d k d_{k} represents the dimension of the keys (used for scaling to prevent gradient vanishing). As the dimension d k d_{k} increases, the dot products Q ​ K T QK^{T} can grow large, pushing the softmax function into regions where it has small gradients. Dividing by d k \sqrt{d_{k}} counteracts this effect, ensuring more stable training.

paragraphs.en: Together, the set of attention matrices Q , K , V Q,K,V are called an attention layer or head . In practice, one attention layer captures a specific type of interaction between tokens. However, having just one type of interaction means that the model can only focus on one relationship at a time (an attention head ). Since a word can have many different types of linguistic relationships, such as syntactical ( which verb does this noun belong to? ), semantic ( is this word part of a metaphor? ), or referential ( who does he refer to? ). By using multiple heads in tandem, we give the model the ability to represent multiple types of relationships. One head might learn to look for grammatical structure, while another learns to look for pronouns, and another for entities. The heads all work in parallel, and their results are concatenated into a single, rich representation. Together, these heads form a layer. This is shown in Equation 2.12 .
paragraphs.zh: 注意力矩阵集合 Q、K、V（Q、K、V）共同被称为一个注意力层或注意力头。 在实践中，一个注意力层可以捕捉到词元之间的特定类型的相互作用。 然而，仅有一种类型的相互作用意味着模型一次只能关注一种关系（即一个注意力头）。 由于一个词可能具有多种不同的语言关系，例如句法关系（这个名词属于哪个动词？）、语义关系（这个词是否是隐喻的一部分？）或指代关系（他指的是谁？）。 通过同时使用多个注意力头，我们使模型能够表示多种类型的关系。 一个注意力头可能学会寻找语法结构，另一个则学会寻找代词，还有另一个寻找实体。 所有注意力头并行工作，其结果被拼接成一个单一且丰富的表示。 这些注意力头共同构成一个层。 这一点在方程 2.12 中有所展示。

sents.en: Together, the set of attention matrices Q , K , V Q,K,V are called an attention layer or head .
sents.zh: 注意力矩阵集合 Q、K、V（Q、K、V）共同被称为一个注意力层或注意力头。

sents.en: In practice, one attention layer captures a specific type of interaction between tokens.
sents.zh: 在实践中，一个注意力层可以捕捉到词元之间的特定类型的相互作用。

sents.en: However, having just one type of interaction means that the model can only focus on one relationship at a time (an attention head ).
sents.zh: 然而，仅有一种类型的相互作用意味着模型一次只能关注一种关系（即一个注意力头）。

sents.en: Since a word can have many different types of linguistic relationships, such as syntactical ( which verb does this noun belong to? ), semantic ( is this word part of a metaphor? ), or referential ( who does he refer to? ).
sents.zh: 由于一个词可能具有多种不同的语言关系，例如句法关系（这个名词属于哪个动词？）、语义关系（这个词是否是隐喻的一部分？）或指代关系（他指的是谁？）。

sents.en: By using multiple heads in tandem, we give the model the ability to represent multiple types of relationships.
sents.zh: 通过同时使用多个注意力头，我们使模型能够表示多种类型的关系。

sents.en: One head might learn to look for grammatical structure, while another learns to look for pronouns, and another for entities.
sents.zh: 一个注意力头可能学会寻找语法结构，另一个则学会寻找代词，还有另一个寻找实体。

sents.en: The heads all work in parallel, and their results are concatenated into a single, rich representation.
sents.zh: 所有注意力头并行工作，其结果被拼接成一个单一且丰富的表示。

sents.en: Together, these heads form a layer.
sents.zh: 这些注意力头共同构成一个层。

sents.en: This is shown in Equation 2.12 .
sents.zh: 这一点在方程 2.12 中有所展示。

paragraphs.en: How can we use the attention mechanism to build an architecture for language modeling? We will now discuss one such architecture, the transformer architecture, introduced in the seminal work by Vaswani et al. [2017] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们如何利用注意力机制来构建语言建模的架构？ 接下来我们将讨论这样一种架构——Transformer 架构，它由 Vaswani 等人 [2017] 在其开创性工作中提出。

sents.en: How can we use the attention mechanism to build an architecture for language modeling?
sents.zh: 我们如何利用注意力机制来构建语言建模的架构？

sents.en: We will now discuss one such architecture, the transformer architecture, introduced in the seminal work by Vaswani et al. [2017] .
sents.zh: 接下来我们将讨论这样一种架构——Transformer 架构，它由 Vaswani 等人 [2017] 在其开创性工作中提出。

paragraphs.en: The attention mechanism is the core of the transformer architecture. The original transformer architecture, shown in Figure 2.10 , consists of both an encoder and a decoder. The left side of the Figure shows the encoder stack, the right side shows the decoder stack. Most LLMs are decoder-only transformers.
paragraphs.zh: 注意力机制是 Transformer 架构的核心。 图 2.10 所示的原始 Transformer 架构包含编码器和解码器两部分。 该图的左侧展示了编码器堆栈，右侧展示了解码器堆栈。 大多数大型语言模型都是仅含解码器的 Transformer 模型。

sents.en: The attention mechanism is the core of the transformer architecture.
sents.zh: 注意力机制是 Transformer 架构的核心。

sents.en: The original transformer architecture, shown in Figure 2.10 , consists of both an encoder and a decoder.
sents.zh: 图 2.10 所示的原始 Transformer 架构包含编码器和解码器两部分。

sents.en: The left side of the Figure shows the encoder stack, the right side shows the decoder stack.
sents.zh: 该图的左侧展示了编码器堆栈，右侧展示了解码器堆栈。

sents.en: Most LLMs are decoder-only transformers.
sents.zh: 大多数大型语言模型都是仅含解码器的 Transformer 模型。

paragraphs.en: The Figure shows transformer blocks that each consist of a self-attention module, a feed-forward network, a normalization layer, and residual connections from input to output. In most LLMs many transformer blocks are stacked on each other, in layers. For example, GPT-2 consists of 12 layers or more, depending on the version of the model.
paragraphs.zh: 该图展示了 Transformer 模块，每个模块都包含一个自注意力模块、一个前馈网络、一个归一化层以及从输入到输出的残差连接。 在大多数大型语言模型中，许多 Transformer 模块以层的形式相互堆叠。 例如，GPT-2 包含 12 个或更多的层，具体取决于模型的版本。

sents.en: The Figure shows transformer blocks that each consist of a self-attention module, a feed-forward network, a normalization layer, and residual connections from input to output.
sents.zh: 该图展示了 Transformer 模块，每个模块都包含一个自注意力模块、一个前馈网络、一个归一化层以及从输入到输出的残差连接。

sents.en: In most LLMs many transformer blocks are stacked on each other, in layers.
sents.zh: 在大多数大型语言模型中，许多 Transformer 模块以层的形式相互堆叠。

paragraphs.en: Let us now have a closer look at the transformer architecture (please refer to the Figure). The full architecture consists of three main types of elements: embedding, transformer blocks, and output probabilities:
paragraphs.zh: 现在让我们更仔细地研究一下 Transformer 架构（请参阅图）。 完整的架构由三种主要元素组成：嵌入层、Transformer 块和输出概率：

sents.en: Let us now have a closer look at the transformer architecture (please refer to the Figure).
sents.zh: 现在让我们更仔细地研究一下 Transformer 架构（请参阅图）。

sents.en: The full architecture consists of three main types of elements: embedding, transformer blocks, and output probabilities:
sents.zh: 完整的架构由三种主要元素组成：嵌入层、Transformer 块和输出概率：

paragraphs.en: Embedding: First, the input text is tokenized, and projected into low dimensional embedding vectors. Positional encoding is added to the embedding to preserve word order.
paragraphs.zh: 嵌入：首先，输入文本会被分词，然后投影到低维的嵌入向量中。 向嵌入中添加位置编码，以保留词语顺序。

sents.en: Embedding: First, the input text is tokenized, and projected into low dimensional embedding vectors.
sents.zh: 嵌入：首先，输入文本会被分词，然后投影到低维的嵌入向量中。

sents.en: Positional encoding is added to the embedding to preserve word order.
sents.zh: 向嵌入中添加位置编码，以保留词语顺序。

paragraphs.en: Transformer Blocks: The transformer blocks are the main feature of the architecture. Most models consist of multiple layers of transformer blocks. Within each layer, each block consists of three elements:
paragraphs.zh: Transformer 模块：Transformer 模块是该架构的主要特征。 大多数模型由多层 Transformer 模块组成。 在每一层中，每个模块包含三个元素：

sents.en: Transformer Blocks: The transformer blocks are the main feature of the architecture.
sents.zh: Transformer 模块：Transformer 模块是该架构的主要特征。

sents.en: Most models consist of multiple layers of transformer blocks.
sents.zh: 大多数模型由多层 Transformer 模块组成。

sents.en: Within each layer, each block consists of three elements:
sents.zh: 在每一层中，每个模块包含三个元素：

paragraphs.en: Self-attention Mechanism: The attention mechanism allows long range connections between tokens, capturing contextual information and relationships between tokens. Multiple attention heads allow the model to consider these relationships from different perspectives, for example, for short-range syntactic links, and for broader semantic context.
paragraphs.zh: 自注意力机制：注意力机制允许词元之间建立长距离连接，从而捕捉上下文信息以及词元之间的关系。 多个注意力头使模型能够从不同视角考虑这些关系，例如，既关注短距离的句法关联，也关注更广泛的语义背景。

sents.en: Self-attention Mechanism: The attention mechanism allows long range connections between tokens, capturing contextual information and relationships between tokens.
sents.zh: 自注意力机制：注意力机制允许词元之间建立长距离连接，从而捕捉上下文信息以及词元之间的关系。

sents.en: Multiple attention heads allow the model to consider these relationships from different perspectives, for example, for short-range syntactic links, and for broader semantic context.
sents.zh: 多个注意力头使模型能够从不同视角考虑这些关系，例如，既关注短距离的句法关联，也关注更广泛的语义背景。

paragraphs.en: For an encoder stack, transformers use self-attention. For a decoder stack, they use masked self-attention, to prevent looking at the future.
paragraphs.zh: 对于编码器堆栈，Transformer 使用自注意力机制。 对于解码器堆栈，它们使用掩码自注意力机制，以防止查看未来信息。

sents.en: For an encoder stack, transformers use self-attention.
sents.zh: 对于编码器堆栈，Transformer 使用自注意力机制。

sents.en: For a decoder stack, they use masked self-attention, to prevent looking at the future.
sents.zh: 对于解码器堆栈，它们使用掩码自注意力机制，以防止查看未来信息。

paragraphs.en: Multi-layer Perceptron: A fully-connected feed-forward network operates on each token independently. The attention layer makes connections between tokens, whereas the MLP can refine each token’s representation.
paragraphs.zh: 多层感知器：一种全连接的前馈网络，对每个词元独立处理。 注意力层在词元之间建立连接，而多层感知器可以优化每个词元的表示。

sents.en: Multi-layer Perceptron: A fully-connected feed-forward network operates on each token independently.
sents.zh: 多层感知器：一种全连接的前馈网络，对每个词元独立处理。

sents.en: The attention layer makes connections between tokens, whereas the MLP can refine each token’s representation.
sents.zh: 注意力层在词元之间建立连接，而多层感知器可以优化每个词元的表示。

paragraphs.en: Normalization: In most transformer blocks typical deep learning methods such as normalization, regularization (dropouts), and residual connections are added, to prevent vanishing or exploding gradients, and to improve stable training.
paragraphs.zh: 归一化：在大多数 Transformer 模块中，通常会加入深度学习中的典型方法，例如归一化、正则化（Dropout）和残差连接，以防止梯度消失或爆炸，并提升训练的稳定性。

paragraphs.en: Output Probabilities: linear and softmax layers transform the processed embeddings into probabilities, to make the next-token predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 输出概率：线性层和 softmax 层将处理后的嵌入表示转换为概率，以便进行下一个词元的预测。

paragraphs.en: The transformer architecture has two main advantages over earlier methods, such as RNN and LSTM networks. Attention-based transformers allow (1) large scale parallel processing, and (2) fine-grained long-range semantic connections—speed and semantic accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 与早期的方法（如 RNN 和 LSTM 网络）相比，Transformer 架构主要有两个优势。 基于注意力的 Transformer 实现了（1）大规模并行处理，以及（2）精细的长距离语义连接——兼具速度与语义准确性。

sents.en: The transformer architecture has two main advantages over earlier methods, such as RNN and LSTM networks.
sents.zh: 与早期的方法（如 RNN 和 LSTM 网络）相比，Transformer 架构主要有两个优势。

sents.en: Attention-based transformers allow (1) large scale parallel processing, and (2) fine-grained long-range semantic connections—speed and semantic accuracy.
sents.zh: 基于注意力的 Transformer 实现了（1）大规模并行处理，以及（2）精细的长距离语义连接——兼具速度与语义准确性。

paragraphs.en: Transformers have dominated language modeling since their introduction. After large scale high quality training corpuses were created, transformer-based LLMs achieved impressive performance in question-answering, data-to-text generation, and application-driven tasks. Researchers have been pursuing increasingly larger models with promises of even higher capabilities [ Brown et al., 2020 ] . In Chapter 4 we will discuss how to scale performance further.
paragraphs.zh: 自引入以来，Transformer 一直在语言建模领域占据主导地位。 在创建大规模高质量训练语料库之后，基于 Transformer 的大型语言模型在问答、数据转文本生成以及应用驱动型任务中取得了令人印象深刻的性能。 研究人员一直在追求规模越来越大的模型，并期望其能力能进一步提升 [Brown et al., 2020]。 在第 4 章中，我们将讨论如何进一步提升性能。

paragraphs.en: While the original transformer model consists of a combined encoder-decoder structure, modern models are usually either an encoder or a decoder, as they are found to have specific empirical strengths.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然原始的 Transformer 模型由编码器-解码器组合结构构成，但现代模型通常要么是编码器，要么是解码器，因为研究发现它们在经验表现上各有特定优势。

paragraphs.en: Let us have a closer look at encoders. Encoders are trained to compress input data into meaningful representations (embeddings) using techniques such as masked language modeling (MLM). They are good at NLU tasks such as text classification and sentiment analysis, while decoders are good at NLG tasks such as text generation, paraphrasing and summarization.
paragraphs.zh: 让我们更仔细地看看编码器。 编码器经过训练，能够使用掩码语言建模（MLM）等技术将输入数据压缩为有意义的表示（嵌入）。 它们在自然语言理解（NLU）任务（如文本分类和情感分析）方面表现优异，而解码器则在自然语言生成（NLG）任务（如文本生成、改写和摘要）方面表现出色。

sents.en: Let us have a closer look at encoders.
sents.zh: 让我们更仔细地看看编码器。

sents.en: Encoders are trained to compress input data into meaningful representations (embeddings) using techniques such as masked language modeling (MLM).
sents.zh: 编码器经过训练，能够使用掩码语言建模（MLM）等技术将输入数据压缩为有意义的表示（嵌入）。

sents.en: They are good at NLU tasks such as text classification and sentiment analysis, while decoders are good at NLG tasks such as text generation, paraphrasing and summarization.
sents.zh: 它们在自然语言理解（NLU）任务（如文本分类和情感分析）方面表现优异，而解码器则在自然语言生成（NLG）任务（如文本生成、改写和摘要）方面表现出色。

paragraphs.en: Encoder-only models are designed to produce high-quality vector representations (embeddings) of input text. Unlike decoders, which are causal (they can only look at past words), encoders are inherently bidirectional. In an encoder, every token in a sequence can attend to every other token simultaneously. This global context allows the model to build a complex semantic representation of the input. To train these models, we use masked language modeling. In this process, roughly 15% of the input tokens are replaced with a special [MASK] token. It is up to the model to then learn which of the tokens from its vocabulary should go in its place. Often the regular cross-entropy loss is used to update the model. The goal of MLM encoder training is for the model to use the surrounding context (both left and right) to predict what the masked word is. Eventually, this forces the model to learn grammar, semantics, and even some world logic.
paragraphs.zh: 仅编码器模型旨在生成输入文本的高质量向量表示（嵌入）。 与解码器不同，后者具有因果性（只能关注之前的词语），而编码器本质上是双向的。 在编码器中，序列中的每个词元可以同时关注其他所有词元。 这种全局上下文使模型能够构建输入文本的复杂语义表示。 为了训练这些模型，我们使用掩码语言建模方法。 在此过程中，大约 15% 的输入词元会被替换为特殊的 [MASK] 词元。 接下来，模型需要自行学习从词汇表中选择哪个词元来填补该位置。 通常使用标准的交叉熵损失来更新模型。 MLM 编码器训练的目标是，让模型利用周围的上下文（包括左侧和右侧）来预测被掩码的词语。 最终，这会迫使模型学习语法、语义，甚至一些世界逻辑。

sents.en: Encoder-only models are designed to produce high-quality vector representations (embeddings) of input text.
sents.zh: 仅编码器模型旨在生成输入文本的高质量向量表示（嵌入）。

sents.en: Unlike decoders, which are causal (they can only look at past words), encoders are inherently bidirectional.
sents.zh: 与解码器不同，后者具有因果性（只能关注之前的词语），而编码器本质上是双向的。

sents.en: In an encoder, every token in a sequence can attend to every other token simultaneously.
sents.zh: 在编码器中，序列中的每个词元可以同时关注其他所有词元。

sents.en: This global context allows the model to build a complex semantic representation of the input.
sents.zh: 这种全局上下文使模型能够构建输入文本的复杂语义表示。

sents.en: To train these models, we use masked language modeling.
sents.zh: 为了训练这些模型，我们使用掩码语言建模方法。

sents.en: In this process, roughly 15% of the input tokens are replaced with a special [MASK] token.
sents.zh: 在此过程中，大约 15% 的输入词元会被替换为特殊的 [MASK] 词元。

sents.en: It is up to the model to then learn which of the tokens from its vocabulary should go in its place.
sents.zh: 接下来，模型需要自行学习从词汇表中选择哪个词元来填补该位置。

sents.en: Often the regular cross-entropy loss is used to update the model.
sents.zh: 通常使用标准的交叉熵损失来更新模型。

sents.en: The goal of MLM encoder training is for the model to use the surrounding context (both left and right) to predict what the masked word is.
sents.zh: MLM 编码器训练的目标是，让模型利用周围的上下文（包括左侧和右侧）来预测被掩码的词语。

sents.en: Eventually, this forces the model to learn grammar, semantics, and even some world logic.
sents.zh: 最终，这会迫使模型学习语法、语义，甚至一些世界逻辑。

paragraphs.en: To improve learning, in addition to the [MASK] token, encoder training typically includes several special tokens:
paragraphs.zh: 为了提升学习效果，除了 [MASK] 标记外，编码器的训练通常还包含几个特殊标记：

paragraphs.en: [CLS] (Classification): Inserted at the very start. After passing through all layers, the final state of this token is used as the aggregate representation for the whole sequence.
paragraphs.zh: [CLS]（分类）：插入在最开始的位置。 经过所有层之后，该标记的最终状态将用作整个序列的聚合表示。

sents.en: [CLS] (Classification): Inserted at the very start.
sents.zh: [CLS]（分类）：插入在最开始的位置。

sents.en: After passing through all layers, the final state of this token is used as the aggregate representation for the whole sequence.
sents.zh: 经过所有层之后，该标记的最终状态将用作整个序列的聚合表示。

paragraphs.en: [SEP] (Separator): Used to tell the model where one sentence ends and another begins, which is vital for tasks such as question answering.
paragraphs.zh: [SEP]（分隔符）：用于告知模型一句话结束和另一句话开始的位置，这对问答等任务至关重要。

paragraphs.en: [PAD] (Padding): Ensures all sequences in a training batch are the same length.
paragraphs.zh: [PAD]（填充）：确保训练批次中的所有序列长度相同。

paragraphs.en: The best-known encoder-only model may well be the bidirectional encoder representations from transformers , better known as BERT [ Devlin et al., 2018 ] . Encoder-only models such as BERT, and its successors RoBERTa [ Liu et al., 2019 ] and ALBERT [ Lan et al., 2019 ] , have become popular.
paragraphs.zh: 最著名的仅编码器模型很可能是“来自变换器的双向编码器表示”，更为人所熟知的名称是 BERT [ Devlin 等，2018 ]。 像 BERT 这样的仅编码器模型，以及其后续模型 RoBERTa [ Liu 等，2019 ] 和 ALBERT [ Lan 等，2019 ]，已经变得流行起来。

sents.zh: 像 BERT 这样的仅编码器模型，以及其后续模型 RoBERTa [ Liu 等，2019 ] 和 ALBERT [ Lan 等，2019 ]，已经变得流行起来。

paragraphs.en: Encoder-only models are quite suitable for transfer learning, where they embed inputs and are subsequently finetuned on downstream tasks, such as classification for certain application domains. The pipeline for constructing encoder-only models involves two phases:
paragraphs.zh: 仅编码器模型非常适合迁移学习，其中它们会嵌入输入，然后在下游任务（例如某些应用领域中的分类）上进行微调。 构建仅编码器模型的流程包括两个阶段：

sents.en: Encoder-only models are quite suitable for transfer learning, where they embed inputs and are subsequently finetuned on downstream tasks, such as classification for certain application domains.
sents.zh: 仅编码器模型非常适合迁移学习，其中它们会嵌入输入，然后在下游任务（例如某些应用领域中的分类）上进行微调。

sents.en: The pipeline for constructing encoder-only models involves two phases:
sents.zh: 构建仅编码器模型的流程包括两个阶段：

paragraphs.en: Pretraining: First train the model on a large corpus of billions of words. It may learn, for example, that King is related to Man and Queen is related to Woman . The model does not yet know how to do a specific job yet, it just learns English. Pretraining is an expensive step, and may take a long time (weeks or months).
paragraphs.zh: 预训练：首先在一个包含数十亿单词的大型语料库上训练模型。 例如，它可能会学到“国王”与“人”相关，“女王”与“女人”相关。 此时模型尚不知道如何执行特定任务，它只是在学习英语。 预训练是一个成本高昂的步骤，可能需要很长时间（几周或几个月）。

sents.en: Pretraining: First train the model on a large corpus of billions of words.
sents.zh: 预训练：首先在一个包含数十亿单词的大型语料库上训练模型。

sents.en: It may learn, for example, that King is related to Man and Queen is related to Woman .
sents.zh: 例如，它可能会学到“国王”与“人”相关，“女王”与“女人”相关。

sents.en: The model does not yet know how to do a specific job yet, it just learns English.
sents.zh: 此时模型尚不知道如何执行特定任务，它只是在学习英语。

sents.en: Pretraining is an expensive step, and may take a long time (weeks or months).
sents.zh: 预训练是一个成本高昂的步骤，可能需要很长时间（几周或几个月）。

paragraphs.en: Finetuning: Second, take the pretrained model and add a small additional classification layer on top (often called a classification head ). Then, the whole model is trained again on task-specific data (such as spam detection, or sentiment analysis). Because the model already understands language, it typically only needs a few thousand examples to become an expert at the new task. Finetuning is a cheap step, and may take just hours or minutes, whereas starting from scratch on the specific task would require a large dataset and much training time.
paragraphs.zh: 微调：其次，取预训练模型，并在其顶部添加一个小的额外分类层（通常称为分类头）。 然后，整个模型会在特定任务的数据上再次进行训练（例如垃圾邮件检测或情感分析）。 由于该模型已经理解语言，因此通常只需数千个样本即可成为新任务的专家。 微调是一个成本较低的过程，可能只需数小时或几分钟，而如果从头开始针对特定任务进行训练，则需要大型数据集和更长的训练时间。

sents.en: Finetuning: Second, take the pretrained model and add a small additional classification layer on top (often called a classification head ).
sents.zh: 微调：其次，取预训练模型，并在其顶部添加一个小的额外分类层（通常称为分类头）。

sents.en: Then, the whole model is trained again on task-specific data (such as spam detection, or sentiment analysis).
sents.zh: 然后，整个模型会在特定任务的数据上再次进行训练（例如垃圾邮件检测或情感分析）。

sents.en: Because the model already understands language, it typically only needs a few thousand examples to become an expert at the new task.
sents.zh: 由于该模型已经理解语言，因此通常只需数千个样本即可成为新任务的专家。

sents.en: Finetuning is a cheap step, and may take just hours or minutes, whereas starting from scratch on the specific task would require a large dataset and much training time.
sents.zh: 微调是一个成本较低的过程，可能只需数小时或几分钟，而如果从头开始针对特定任务进行训练，则需要大型数据集和更长的训练时间。

paragraphs.en: After we have discussed encoder-only models, we will now switch to decoder-only models.
paragraphs.zh: 在讨论了仅包含编码器的模型之后，我们现在将转向仅包含解码器的模型。

paragraphs.en: In language generation tasks, decoder-only models are used. Decoders are trained to reconstruct data or generate sequences using autoregressive training—they often generate output one token at a time. This autoregressive dependency, where the next tokens depend on what has been generated so far, is a form of causal attention. We cannot use future tokens to derive the best prediction. In an encoder, a word can look at the words to its right. In a decoder, this is strictly forbidden. We use a look-ahead mask (often a triangular matrix) that sets the attention scores of future tokens to − ∞ -\infty . If the model is predicting the word apple in the phrase The boy ate the… , it should not be allowed to observe the word apple in the training data. The decoder must rely solely on the preceding context. Subsequently, while encoders use masked language modeling, decoders use (regular) causal language modeling , as shown in Equation 3.1 in the next chapter.
paragraphs.zh: 在语言生成任务中，使用的是仅包含解码器的模型。 解码器通过自回归训练来重建数据或生成序列——它们通常一次生成一个词元。 这种自回归依赖关系，即下一个词元依赖于此前已生成的内容，是一种因果注意力机制。 我们不能利用未来的词元来推导出最佳预测结果。 在编码器中，一个词可以查看其右侧的词。 而在解码器中，这种行为是严格禁止的。 我们使用一个前瞻掩码（通常是一个三角矩阵），将未来词元的注意力分数设为 − ∞ -\infty 。 如果模型正在预测短语“The boy ate the…”中的单词“apple”，那么它就不应被允许观察到训练数据中的单词“apple”。 解码器必须完全依赖前面的上下文信息。 因此，编码器使用掩码语言建模，而解码器则使用（常规的）因果语言建模，如下一章的公式 3.1 所示。

sents.zh: 在语言生成任务中，使用的是仅包含解码器的模型。

sents.en: Subsequently, while encoders use masked language modeling, decoders use (regular) causal language modeling , as shown in Equation 3.1 in the next chapter.

paragraphs.en: As a consequence, when moving from encoders to decoders, the relationship between pretraining and finetuning changes slightly: decoders learn to predict the next word in pretaining, and are then fine-tuned with the same loss function, but with another type of data. This allows us to move to in-context learning (ICL) or prompt-learning: because decoders are trained to continue a sequence, you can simply give them a prompt (the context), and they will generate the answer without needing any weight updates. The learn, as it were, from the examples in the prompt [ Brown et al., 2020 ] . The ease of use with which large decoders can be used through in-context learning, without having to do expensive task-specific training or finetuning, has created much interest in ICL.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，从编码器转向解码器时，预训练与微调之间的关系会发生轻微变化：解码器在预训练阶段学习预测下一个词，随后使用相同的损失函数但另一类数据进行微调。 这使得我们可以转向上下文内学习（ICL）或提示学习：由于解码器经过训练能够延续序列，因此只需向其提供提示（即上下文），它就能生成答案，而无需更新任何权重。 它们可以说，是从提示中的示例中学习的 [Brown et al., 2020]。 通过上下文内学习，大型解码器可以轻松地被使用，而无需进行昂贵的任务特定训练或微调，这一点已使 ICL 引起了广泛关注。

paragraphs.en: Decoder-only models, such as the generalized pretrained transformer (GPT) family [ Radford et al., 2018 , Radford et al., 2019 , Brown et al., 2020 , Ouyang et al., 2022 , Achiam et al., 2023 ] , have become quite successful and are now widely used in our society. Many other models have been developed, both open and closed. Together, the training mechanisms that we discussed form the basis of the modern LLM pipeline, which we will explain in more detail in Chapter 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 仅解码器模型，例如广义预训练变换器（GPT）系列 [Radford et al., 2018, Radford et al., 2019, Brown et al., 2020, Ouyang et al., 2022, Achiam et al., 2023]，已经取得了巨大成功，并且如今被广泛应用于我们的社会。 许多其他模型也已被开发出来，包括开源和闭源模型。 综合来看，我们所讨论的训练机制构成了现代大型语言模型流程的基础，我们将在第 3 章中对此进行更详细的解释。

sents.en: Together, the training mechanisms that we discussed form the basis of the modern LLM pipeline, which we will explain in more detail in Chapter 3 .
sents.zh: 综合来看，我们所讨论的训练机制构成了现代大型语言模型流程的基础，我们将在第 3 章中对此进行更详细的解释。

paragraphs.en: In this chapter, we have traced the remarkable evolution of natural language processing from its foundational linguistic roots to the neural architectures that power today’s large language models. We have argued that human language is inherently complex, defined by intricate rules of syntax, morphology, and deep semantic and pragmatic nuances. The breakthrough in modern NLP progressed through a series of paradigm shifts—symbolic, statistical, neural—delivering building blocks for contemporary language models that are built on dense embeddings, the attention mechanism, and increases in scale, for data, model size, and compute power. Encoder models are suitable for NLU, decoder models are suitable for NLG. Both are trained by pretraining, finetuning, and decoders allow prompt-based in-context learning.
paragraphs.zh: 在本章中，我们追溯了自然语言处理从其基础的语言学根源到驱动当今大型语言模型的神经架构的非凡演变。 我们认为，人类语言本质上具有复杂性，由复杂的句法、形态规则以及深层的语义和语用细微差别所定义。 现代自然语言处理的突破经历了一系列范式的转变——符号主义、统计主义和神经主义——为当代语言模型提供了构建基础，这些模型建立在密集嵌入、注意力机制以及数据规模、模型规模和计算能力的提升之上。 编码器模型适用于自然语言理解，解码器模型则适用于自然语言生成。 两者都通过预训练和微调进行训练，而解码器支持基于提示的上下文学习。

sents.zh: 在本章中，我们追溯了自然语言处理从其基础的语言学根源到驱动当今大型语言模型的神经架构的非凡演变。

paragraphs.en: Although the performance of modern LLMs is impressive, and many useful use cases exists, important challenges remain. Understanding these challenges is critical for identifying research gaps and for engineering more robust systems, that are also relevant for agentic LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管现代大型语言模型（LLM）的性能令人印象深刻，并且已经存在许多实用的应用场景，但一些重要的挑战依然存在。 理解这些挑战对于识别研究空白以及构建更稳健的系统至关重要，而这些系统同样适用于智能体型大型语言模型（agentic LLMs）。

sents.en: Although the performance of modern LLMs is impressive, and many useful use cases exists, important challenges remain.
sents.zh: 尽管现代大型语言模型（LLM）的性能令人印象深刻，并且已经存在许多实用的应用场景，但一些重要的挑战依然存在。

sents.en: Understanding these challenges is critical for identifying research gaps and for engineering more robust systems, that are also relevant for agentic LLMs.
sents.zh: 理解这些挑战对于识别研究空白以及构建更稳健的系统至关重要，而这些系统同样适用于智能体型大型语言模型（agentic LLMs）。

paragraphs.en: Current language modeling assumes scaling laws : better generalization is achieved through the triumvirate of more parameters, more data, and more compute. However, further scaling creates significant challenges. Achieving state-of-the-art performance may require models with billions of parameters, whose training costs millions of dollars in compute, bringing about a high environmental impact. How to achieve better generalization (the ability to perform tasks that the model was not trained on) using efficient architectures is an open question. Current research is exploring model pruning and quantization (both discussed in Chapter 4 ). Furthermore, synthetic data generation (see Chapter 19 ) aims to achieve higher generalization without more training data, but the sweet spot between model size and generalization capability remains elusive.
paragraphs.zh: 当前的语言模型假设遵循扩展定律：通过增加参数、数据和计算资源这三者，可以实现更好的泛化能力。 然而，进一步的扩展带来了重大挑战。 要达到当前最先进的性能水平，可能需要拥有数十亿参数的模型，其训练所需的计算成本高达数百万美元，并因此对环境造成巨大影响。 如何利用高效的架构实现更强的泛化能力（即完成模型未经训练的任务），仍是一个悬而未决的问题。 当前的研究正在探索模型剪枝和量化技术（这两者都在第 4 章中进行了讨论）。 此外，合成数据生成（参见第 19 章）旨在无需更多训练数据的情况下实现更强的泛化能力，但如何在模型规模与泛化能力之间找到最佳平衡点仍然是一个难题。

paragraphs.en: The majority of NLP training datasets are built for the English language, and so are major benchmarks, such as GLUE (general language understanding [ Wang et al., 2018 ] ) or SQuAD (question answering [ Rajpurkar et al., 2016 ] ). The data is often accumulated from large web-scrapes. Other high-resource languages, such as Chinese or Hindi, can also benefit from this approach, while low-resource languages (such as Dutch or Flemish) lack the digital footprint and the cultural presence that is necessary to train modern transformers from scratch. Because models inherit the cultural nuances of their training data, non-English speakers often experience degraded performance or algorithmic bias that favors Western perspectives and linguistic norms.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数自然语言处理（NLP）训练数据集都是为英语构建的，主要基准数据集也是如此，例如 GLUE（通用语言理解 [ Wang et al., 2018 ]）或 SQuAD（问答任务 [ Rajpurkar et al., 2016 ]）。 这些数据通常来自大规模的网络爬虫采集。 其他高资源语言，如中文或印地语，也可以从这种方法中受益，而低资源语言（如荷兰语或佛兰德语）则缺乏训练现代 Transformer 模型从头开始所需的数字足迹和文化影响力。 由于模型会继承其训练数据中的文化细微差别，非英语使用者常常会遇到性能下降或算法偏见的问题，这些偏见倾向于西方视角和语言规范。

sents.en: The majority of NLP training datasets are built for the English language, and so are major benchmarks, such as GLUE (general language understanding [ Wang et al., 2018 ] ) or SQuAD (question answering [ Rajpurkar et al., 2016 ] ).
sents.zh: 大多数自然语言处理（NLP）训练数据集都是为英语构建的，主要基准数据集也是如此，例如 GLUE（通用语言理解 [ Wang et al., 2018 ]）或 SQuAD（问答任务 [ Rajpurkar et al., 2016 ]）。

sents.en: The data is often accumulated from large web-scrapes.
sents.zh: 这些数据通常来自大规模的网络爬虫采集。

sents.en: Other high-resource languages, such as Chinese or Hindi, can also benefit from this approach, while low-resource languages (such as Dutch or Flemish) lack the digital footprint and the cultural presence that is necessary to train modern transformers from scratch.
sents.zh: 其他高资源语言，如中文或印地语，也可以从这种方法中受益，而低资源语言（如荷兰语或佛兰德语）则缺乏训练现代 Transformer 模型从头开始所需的数字足迹和文化影响力。

sents.en: Because models inherit the cultural nuances of their training data, non-English speakers often experience degraded performance or algorithmic bias that favors Western perspectives and linguistic norms.
sents.zh: 由于模型会继承其训练数据中的文化细微差别，非英语使用者常常会遇到性能下降或算法偏见的问题，这些偏见倾向于西方视角和语言规范。

paragraphs.en: Because of the differences in available resources, NLP rarely provides a generic solution for each language. For instance, translating a model’s success from English to other languages introduces several linguistic complexities. Other languages like Turkish, Finnish, or Arabic may be morphologically richer, as they convey significant information through prefixes and suffixes to verbs or nouns. A single word in Turkish might correspond to an entire sentence in English. Models that are not trained on such languages fail to reflect such linguistic richness.
paragraphs.zh: 由于可用资源存在差异，自然语言处理很少能为每种语言提供通用的解决方案。 例如，将模型在英语中的成功经验迁移到其他语言时，会引入多种语言层面的复杂性。 土耳其语、芬兰语或阿拉伯语等其他语言可能在形态学上更为丰富，因为它们通过动词或名词的前缀和后缀传递大量信息。 土耳其语中的一个词可能对应英语中的整个句子。 未在这些语言上进行训练的模型无法反映这种语言上的丰富性。

sents.en: Because of the differences in available resources, NLP rarely provides a generic solution for each language.
sents.zh: 由于可用资源存在差异，自然语言处理很少能为每种语言提供通用的解决方案。

sents.en: For instance, translating a model’s success from English to other languages introduces several linguistic complexities.
sents.zh: 例如，将模型在英语中的成功经验迁移到其他语言时，会引入多种语言层面的复杂性。

sents.en: Other languages like Turkish, Finnish, or Arabic may be morphologically richer, as they convey significant information through prefixes and suffixes to verbs or nouns.
sents.zh: 土耳其语、芬兰语或阿拉伯语等其他语言可能在形态学上更为丰富，因为它们通过动词或名词的前缀和后缀传递大量信息。

sents.en: A single word in Turkish might correspond to an entire sentence in English.
sents.zh: 土耳其语中的一个词可能对应英语中的整个句子。

sents.en: Models that are not trained on such languages fail to reflect such linguistic richness.
sents.zh: 未在这些语言上进行训练的模型无法反映这种语言上的丰富性。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, different languages may employ different character sets and scripts. This leads to problems in handling non-Latin scripts (for example, logographic scripts for Chinese, or Abjads for Hebrew and Arabic). These languages require new tokenization and embedding strategies that lead to sensible subwords.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，不同语言可能使用不同的字符集和书写系统。 这给处理非拉丁字母的书写系统带来了问题（例如，中文的表意文字，或希伯来语和阿拉伯语的阿比贾德文字）。 这些语言需要新的分词和嵌入策略，以生成合理的子词。

sents.en: Furthermore, different languages may employ different character sets and scripts.
sents.zh: 此外，不同语言可能使用不同的字符集和书写系统。

sents.en: This leads to problems in handling non-Latin scripts (for example, logographic scripts for Chinese, or Abjads for Hebrew and Arabic).
sents.zh: 这给处理非拉丁字母的书写系统带来了问题（例如，中文的表意文字，或希伯来语和阿拉伯语的阿比贾德文字）。

sents.en: These languages require new tokenization and embedding strategies that lead to sensible subwords.
sents.zh: 这些语言需要新的分词和嵌入策略，以生成合理的子词。

paragraphs.en: Languages are living entities that evolve faster than models can be retrained. Amongst others, this leads to the out-of-vocabulary (OOV) problem. Even with sub-word tokenization (such as byte-pair encoding (BPE) [ Gage, 1994 ] or WordPiece [ Song et al., 2021 ] ), models struggle with neologisms, slang, technical jargon, or names that did not exist at the time of the training cutoff. Furthermore, a model trained in 2022 may not understand the context of global events or cultural shifts in 2026 (what is the Gen Z stare?). Creating continual learning systems that update knowledge without forgetting previous information (catastrophic forgetting) is an open challenge [ Wu et al., 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 语言是活的实体，其演化速度比模型能够重新训练的速度更快。 这导致了一系列问题，其中之一就是词汇表外（OOV）问题。 即使采用子词分词方法（例如字节对编码（BPE）[ Gage, 1994 ] 或 WordPiece [ Song et al., 2021 ]），模型在处理新造词、俚语、专业术语或训练截止时并不存在的名字时仍会遇到困难。 此外，一个在 2022 年训练的模型可能无法理解 2026 年全球事件或文化变迁的背景（比如“Z世代的凝视”是什么？）。 构建能够持续更新知识而不会遗忘先前信息（灾难性遗忘）的持续学习系统，仍然是一个未解决的挑战 [ Wu et al., 2024 ]。

sents.zh: 语言是活的实体，其演化速度比模型能够重新训练的速度更快。

sents.en: Amongst others, this leads to the out-of-vocabulary (OOV) problem.
sents.zh: 这导致了一系列问题，其中之一就是词汇表外（OOV）问题。

sents.en: Creating continual learning systems that update knowledge without forgetting previous information (catastrophic forgetting) is an open challenge [ Wu et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 构建能够持续更新知识而不会遗忘先前信息（灾难性遗忘）的持续学习系统，仍然是一个未解决的挑战 [ Wu et al., 2024 ]。

paragraphs.en: The boundary between text and other modalities is blurring as a consequence of the effort to make sense of information outside its traditional context. A challenge in providing this context is multi-modal representation: representing images, audio, and video in the same latent space as text. While text is discrete (words/characters), audio and video are continuous signals that must be sampled and quantized. Mapping a frame of video or a segment of a waveform to a token that a language model can process alongside text requires complex architectures like Vision Transformers (ViT) [ Han et al., 2022 ] or Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) [ Radford et al., 2021 ] . Chapter 7 will discuss multi-modal models.
paragraphs.zh: 由于人们试图理解脱离传统语境的信息，文本与其他模态之间的界限正变得模糊。 提供这种语境的一个挑战是多模态表示：将图像、音频和视频表示在与文本相同的潜在空间中。 虽然文本是离散的（词语/字符），但音频和视频是连续信号，必须经过采样和量化。 将一帧视频或一段波形映射到语言模型能够与文本一同处理的标记上，需要复杂的架构，例如视觉变换器（ViT）[ Han et al., 2022 ] 或对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）[ Radford et al., 2021 ]。 第 7 章将讨论多模态模型。
