paragraphs.en: Prompt 1 — Access and Democratization nanochat’s headline claim is that “the best ChatGPT that $100 can buy” brings LLM training within reach of individuals. Critically evaluate this claim. Who still cannot access this pipeline, and why?

paragraphs.en: Prompt 3 — Environmental Cost nanochat’s “affordable” training run consumes approximately four hours of 8 × \times H100 GPUs. Estimate the carbon cost of your own training run using an established methodology (e.g. the ML CO 2 Impact calculator). 5 5 5 https://mlco2.impact.compute.org Situate this in the broader context of LLM environmental impact. Is cheap the same as low-impact ?

paragraphs.en: Hugging Face [2022] — The Hugging Face LLM Course; covers the transformers , tokenizers , and datasets libraries and the Hugging Face Hub; useful context for Tasks 1, 3, and 4.

paragraphs.en: In this chapter we have used nanochat as a window into the complete LLM training pipeline. You have trained a BPE tokenizer, observed a transformer learn from web text, adapted that model to follow instructions, evaluated it on standard benchmarks, and deployed it as a chat assistant.
paragraphs.zh: 在本章中，我们将 nanochat 用作观察完整 LLM 训练流程的窗口。 你已经训练了一个 BPE 分词器，观察了 transformer 如何从网络文本中学习，对该模型进行了指令遵循能力的调整，在标准基准上对其进行了评估，并将其部署为聊天助手。

paragraphs.en: The gap between your depth-4 model and the frontier will be obvious, because we don’t expect you to have access to datacenter-grade compute capabilities. However, the experiments are, in theory, scalable: rerunning at higher depths and with additional data resources should lead to more capable models, as predicted by the scaling laws. After completion of Assignment 1, you have essentially trained a full LLM by yourself, and you will be better equipped for future experiments where an increased scale is necessary.
paragraphs.zh: 你的深度为4的模型与前沿技术之间的差距将显而易见，因为我们并不期望你拥有数据中心级别的计算能力。 然而，这些实验在理论上具有可扩展性：按照扩展定律的预测，以更高的深度和额外的数据资源重新运行，应该能生成能力更强的模型。 完成作业1后，你实际上已经自行训练出了一个完整的LLM，这将为你后续需要更大规模的实验做好准备。

paragraphs.en: This part is about the brains of our agents, and how they use them to learn. The previous part showed us how a basic next-token LLM is trained. In agentic models typically more advanced reasoning and multi-modal models are used (which we continue to call LLM ). In this part we will discuss these more advanced models, why they are needed, and how they are trained and used.
paragraphs.zh: 这一部分将介绍我们智能体的“大脑”，以及它们如何利用这些“大脑”进行学习。 上一部分向我们展示了基础的下个词 LLM 是如何训练的。 在智能体模型中，通常使用的是更高级的推理和多模态模型（我们将继续称之为 LLM）。 在这一部分，我们将讨论这些更高级的模型、它们为何必要，以及它们如何被训练和使用。

sents.en: This part is about the brains of our agents, and how they use them to learn.
sents.zh: 这一部分将介绍我们智能体的“大脑”，以及它们如何利用这些“大脑”进行学习。

sents.en: The previous part showed us how a basic next-token LLM is trained.
sents.zh: 上一部分向我们展示了基础的下个词 LLM 是如何训练的。

sents.en: In agentic models typically more advanced reasoning and multi-modal models are used (which we continue to call LLM ).
sents.zh: 在智能体模型中，通常使用的是更高级的推理和多模态模型（我们将继续称之为 LLM）。

sents.en: In this part we will discuss these more advanced models, why they are needed, and how they are trained and used.
sents.zh: 在这一部分，我们将讨论这些更高级的模型、它们为何必要，以及它们如何被训练和使用。

paragraphs.en: The first chapter of this part introduces reasoning models. Originally LLMs could not solve simple reasoning problems, and the chain of thought concept caused a major leap forward in this field. We will discuss math word problems, chain of thought prompting, and in-context learning. We will see models that use self-reflection to try to improve their own behavior. Self-reflection loops led to the development of agentic harnesses for LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 本部分的第一章介绍了推理模型。 最初，大型语言模型无法解决简单的推理问题，而“思维链”概念则使该领域实现了重大突破。 我们将讨论数学应用题、思维链提示以及在语境中学习的方法。 我们将看到一些利用自我反思来尝试改进自身行为的模型。 自我反思循环推动了为大型语言模型开发智能体控制框架的进程。

sents.zh: 本部分的第一章介绍了推理模型。

sents.zh: 我们将讨论数学应用题、思维链提示以及在语境中学习的方法。

sents.en: We will see models that use self-reflection to try to improve their own behavior.
sents.zh: 我们将看到一些利用自我反思来尝试改进自身行为的模型。

sents.en: Self-reflection loops led to the development of agentic harnesses for LLMs.
sents.zh: 自我反思循环推动了为大型语言模型开发智能体控制框架的进程。

paragraphs.en: In the following chapter we go beyond language: we will see that the transformer architecture also works for vision and action domains. We will discuss various kinds of World Models, models that allow agents to act more intelligently in their interaction with the world.
paragraphs.zh: 在下一章中，我们将超越语言领域：我们会看到，Transformer 架构同样适用于视觉和行动领域。 我们将讨论各种类型的世界模型，这些模型能让智能体在与世界的互动中表现得更加智能。

sents.en: In the following chapter we go beyond language: we will see that the transformer architecture also works for vision and action domains.
sents.zh: 在下一章中，我们将超越语言领域：我们会看到，Transformer 架构同样适用于视觉和行动领域。

sents.en: We will discuss various kinds of World Models, models that allow agents to act more intelligently in their interaction with the world.
sents.zh: 我们将讨论各种类型的世界模型，这些模型能让智能体在与世界的互动中表现得更加智能。

paragraphs.en: In the last chapter of this part, we introduce the concept of metalearning, a paradigm that is present in many of the types of learning that we see in agentic LLMs. We will discuss what metalearning is, and why it is a challenging form of machine learning.
paragraphs.zh: 在本部分的最后一章中，我们将介绍元学习这一概念，它是一种在许多智能体大语言模型所展现的学习类型中都存在的范式。 我们将探讨什么是元学习，以及为什么它是一种具有挑战性的机器学习形式。

sents.en: In the last chapter of this part, we introduce the concept of metalearning, a paradigm that is present in many of the types of learning that we see in agentic LLMs.
sents.zh: 在本部分的最后一章中，我们将介绍元学习这一概念，它是一种在许多智能体大语言模型所展现的学习类型中都存在的范式。

sents.en: We will discuss what metalearning is, and why it is a challenging form of machine learning.
sents.zh: 我们将探讨什么是元学习，以及为什么它是一种具有挑战性的机器学习形式。

paragraphs.en: As we noted Chapter 3 , in large models, beyond hundreds of billions of parameters, a new kind of learning has emerged in LLMs. It is called in-context learning (ICL) or prompt-learning [ Brown et al., 2020 ] . It is an important learning method, which we will discuss in more detail in this section. Then, we will discuss common benchmarks, and the chain of thought method for multi-step reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 正如我们在第 3 章中提到的，在大型模型中，当参数规模超过数千亿时，LLM 中出现了一种新型的学习方式。 它被称为上下文学习（ICL）或提示学习 [Brown et al., 2020]。 这是一种重要的学习方法，我们将在本节中更详细地讨论它。 接下来，我们将讨论常见的基准测试，以及多步推理中的思维链方法。

sents.en: As we noted Chapter 3 , in large models, beyond hundreds of billions of parameters, a new kind of learning has emerged in LLMs.
sents.zh: 正如我们在第 3 章中提到的，在大型模型中，当参数规模超过数千亿时，LLM 中出现了一种新型的学习方式。

sents.en: It is called in-context learning (ICL) or prompt-learning [ Brown et al., 2020 ] .
sents.zh: 它被称为上下文学习（ICL）或提示学习 [Brown et al., 2020]。

sents.en: It is an important learning method, which we will discuss in more detail in this section.
sents.zh: 这是一种重要的学习方法，我们将在本节中更详细地讨论它。

sents.en: Then, we will discuss common benchmarks, and the chain of thought method for multi-step reasoning.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们将讨论常见的基准测试，以及多步推理中的思维链方法。

paragraphs.en: In-context learning [ Dong et al., 2022 ] occurs not at training time, but at inference time, from examples that are provided in the LLM prompt, when the model is used to answer questions. These examples cause the decoder model to access relevant knowledge stored in the LLM. Because of this rich knowledge, in-context learning finds accurate results with few examples, which is why it is a so-called few-shot learning method. The few-shot learning is made possible by the large size of the model, containing rich and varied knowledge on many topics.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文学习 [ Dong et al., 2022 ] 并非发生在训练阶段，而是在推理阶段，通过 LLM 提示中提供的示例，在模型被用于回答问题时实现。 这些示例会促使解码器模型访问存储在 LLM 中的相关知识。 由于这种丰富的知识储备，上下文学习仅需少量示例即可得出准确结果，因此它被称为一种所谓的小样本学习方法。 小样本学习的可行性得益于模型的大规模结构，其中包含了关于众多主题丰富且多样的知识。

sents.en: In-context learning [ Dong et al., 2022 ] occurs not at training time, but at inference time, from examples that are provided in the LLM prompt, when the model is used to answer questions.
sents.zh: 上下文学习 [ Dong et al., 2022 ] 并非发生在训练阶段，而是在推理阶段，通过 LLM 提示中提供的示例，在模型被用于回答问题时实现。

sents.en: These examples cause the decoder model to access relevant knowledge stored in the LLM.
sents.zh: 这些示例会促使解码器模型访问存储在 LLM 中的相关知识。

sents.en: Because of this rich knowledge, in-context learning finds accurate results with few examples, which is why it is a so-called few-shot learning method.
sents.zh: 由于这种丰富的知识储备，上下文学习仅需少量示例即可得出准确结果，因此它被称为一种所谓的小样本学习方法。

sents.en: The few-shot learning is made possible by the large size of the model, containing rich and varied knowledge on many topics.
sents.zh: 小样本学习的可行性得益于模型的大规模结构，其中包含了关于众多主题丰富且多样的知识。

paragraphs.en: A main difference between in-context learning and finetuning or pretraining is that in-context learning does not change the parameters of the transformer. Since no model-parameters are changed at inference time, it is not a parameter training method; however, since it does learn an answer from provided examples, it is a learning method. A consequence is that ICL has the disadvantage of forgetfulness: since model parameters remain unchanged, all learned information is lost between LLM calls. To share information between LLM calls, previous results must be added to the prompt of the next call, in the context window, as extra learning examples.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文学习与微调或预训练之间的一个主要区别在于，上下文学习不会改变变压器的参数。 由于在推理阶段没有模型参数被更改，因此它不是一种参数训练方法；然而，由于它确实能从提供的示例中学习答案，所以它是一种学习方法。 由此带来的一个后果是，上下文学习存在遗忘的缺点：由于模型参数保持不变，所有学到的信息在大型语言模型调用之间都会丢失。 为了在大型语言模型调用之间共享信息，必须将之前的结果作为额外的学习示例，添加到下一次调用的提示词中，即置于上下文窗口内。

sents.en: A main difference between in-context learning and finetuning or pretraining is that in-context learning does not change the parameters of the transformer.
sents.zh: 上下文学习与微调或预训练之间的一个主要区别在于，上下文学习不会改变变压器的参数。

sents.en: Since no model-parameters are changed at inference time, it is not a parameter training method; however, since it does learn an answer from provided examples, it is a learning method.
sents.zh: 由于在推理阶段没有模型参数被更改，因此它不是一种参数训练方法；然而，由于它确实能从提供的示例中学习答案，所以它是一种学习方法。

sents.en: A consequence is that ICL has the disadvantage of forgetfulness: since model parameters remain unchanged, all learned information is lost between LLM calls.
sents.zh: 由此带来的一个后果是，上下文学习存在遗忘的缺点：由于模型参数保持不变，所有学到的信息在大型语言模型调用之间都会丢失。

sents.en: To share information between LLM calls, previous results must be added to the prompt of the next call, in the context window, as extra learning examples.
sents.zh: 为了在大型语言模型调用之间共享信息，必须将之前的结果作为额外的学习示例，添加到下一次调用的提示词中，即置于上下文窗口内。

paragraphs.en: How does in-context learning work? The part of an LLM in which the prompt is written is called its context window . The decoder model learns inside this context window, from the examples that are provided in the prompt. A point to note is that all examples that the answer is learned from must be provided together in the context window—they should fit in the prompt. Typically, the size of the context window is limited to a few thousand tokens, and only few examples can be provided: all ICL is able to perform is few-shot learning. This becomes problematic when the amount of information that we wish to learn from grows, since the context window is typically limited in size. We might say that in-context learning suffers from long-term memory loss.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文内学习是如何工作的？ LLM 中用于写入提示的部分被称为其上下文窗口。 解码模型会在该上下文窗口内，根据提示中提供的示例进行学习。 需要注意的一点是，模型用来生成答案的所有示例都必须一同提供在上下文窗口中——它们必须能够容纳在提示中。 通常，上下文窗口的大小仅限于数千个词元，因此只能提供少量示例：上下文内学习所能执行的全部操作就是少样本学习。 当我们希望学习的信息量增加时，这个问题就会变得突出，因为上下文窗口的大小通常是有限的。 我们可以说，上下文内学习存在长期记忆丢失的问题。

sents.en: How does in-context learning work?
sents.zh: 上下文内学习是如何工作的？

sents.zh: 我们可以说，上下文内学习存在长期记忆丢失的问题。

paragraphs.en: In in-context learning, a prompt, consisting of a few pieces of demonstration context, is concatenated with a query question, which is given to the context window of the language model [ Liu et al., 2023 ] . The model will then generate the answer by performing a forward pass through the model. For example, when the task is emotion recognition in a social media post, I missed the bus today , can be followed by I felt so [___] , and the model could answer with bad . Alternatively, for translation, we could follow I missed the bus today , by French: [___] to request a translation. The prompt contains background information that is recognized by the model, selecting the desired model context.
paragraphs.zh: 在上下文学习中，提示由几段示例上下文组成，并将其与查询问题拼接后输入语言模型的上下文窗口 [ Liu et al., 2023 ]。 随后，模型将通过前向传播生成答案。 例如，当任务为社交媒体帖子的情感识别时，“我今天错过了公交车”后面可以接“我感觉非常 [___]”，模型可能会回答“糟糕”。 或者，对于翻译任务，可以在“我今天错过了公交车”后加上法语：[___]，以请求翻译。 提示包含模型能够识别的背景信息，从而选择所需的模型上下文。

sents.en: In in-context learning, a prompt, consisting of a few pieces of demonstration context, is concatenated with a query question, which is given to the context window of the language model [ Liu et al., 2023 ] .
sents.zh: 在上下文学习中，提示由几段示例上下文组成，并将其与查询问题拼接后输入语言模型的上下文窗口 [ Liu et al., 2023 ]。

sents.zh: 随后，模型将通过前向传播生成答案。

sents.en: For example, when the task is emotion recognition in a social media post, I missed the bus today , can be followed by I felt so [___] , and the model could answer with bad .
sents.zh: 例如，当任务为社交媒体帖子的情感识别时，“我今天错过了公交车”后面可以接“我感觉非常 [___]”，模型可能会回答“糟糕”。

sents.en: Alternatively, for translation, we could follow I missed the bus today , by French: [___] to request a translation.
sents.zh: 或者，对于翻译任务，可以在“我今天错过了公交车”后加上法语：[___]，以请求翻译。

sents.en: The prompt contains background information that is recognized by the model, selecting the desired model context.
sents.zh: 提示包含模型能够识别的背景信息，从而选择所需的模型上下文。

paragraphs.en: In-context learning works when language models contain enough knowledge, allowing them to generalize on the (few) examples provided in the prompt. The user provides a few relevant examples in the prompt, in order to prime the LLM to select the right background knowledge for answering the prompted instruction. Contexts that contain a few examples are said to perform few-shot learning. Contexts that contain only instructions, with zero examples, are said to perform zero-shot learning.
paragraphs.zh: 当语言模型包含足够的知识时，上下文学习就能发挥作用，使其能够根据提示中提供的（少量）示例进行泛化。 用户在提示中提供几个相关示例，以此引导大型语言模型选择正确的背景知识来回答所提出的指令。 包含少量示例的上下文被称为执行少样本学习。 仅包含指令且没有示例的上下文被称为执行零样本学习。

sents.en: In-context learning works when language models contain enough knowledge, allowing them to generalize on the (few) examples provided in the prompt.
sents.zh: 当语言模型包含足够的知识时，上下文学习就能发挥作用，使其能够根据提示中提供的（少量）示例进行泛化。

sents.en: The user provides a few relevant examples in the prompt, in order to prime the LLM to select the right background knowledge for answering the prompted instruction.
sents.zh: 用户在提示中提供几个相关示例，以此引导大型语言模型选择正确的背景知识来回答所提出的指令。

sents.en: Contexts that contain a few examples are said to perform few-shot learning.
sents.zh: 包含少量示例的上下文被称为执行少样本学习。

sents.en: Contexts that contain only instructions, with zero examples, are said to perform zero-shot learning.
sents.zh: 仅包含指令且没有示例的上下文被称为执行零样本学习。

paragraphs.en: ICL is a form of few-shot learning that caused much excitement among researchers. In traditional machine learning, a model f f is trained on dataset. To achieve high accuracy on complex problems, the datasets must contain many examples. Traditional machine learning is a form of many-shot learning , requiring many (expensive) training epochs to train the parameters of the model. In-context learning, on the other hand, is cheap, requiring just a few examples followed by a single forward pass through the decoder model (since the expensive training has been done in the pretraining phase). Few-shot learning is something of the holy grail of machine learning: a model that generalizes, cheaply.
paragraphs.zh: ICL 是一种小样本学习形式，在研究人员中引起了极大的关注。 在传统机器学习中，模型 f f 是在数据集上训练的。 要在复杂问题上实现高准确性，数据集必须包含大量示例。 传统机器学习是一种多样本学习形式，需要许多（代价高昂的）训练轮次来训练模型的参数。 另一方面，上下文学习则成本较低，只需几个示例，然后对解码器模型进行一次前向传播即可（因为昂贵的训练工作已在预训练阶段完成）。 小样本学习堪称机器学习的圣杯：一种能够低成本实现泛化的模型。

sents.zh: ICL 是一种小样本学习形式，在研究人员中引起了极大的关注。

sents.en: In traditional machine learning, a model f f is trained on dataset.
sents.zh: 在传统机器学习中，模型 f f 是在数据集上训练的。

sents.en: To achieve high accuracy on complex problems, the datasets must contain many examples.

paragraphs.en: In-context learning further has the practical advantage of convenience: we can perform ICL on an LLM that runs commercially in the cloud, from our smartphone, without going through the difficulty of finding a computer to train a large model on.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文学习还有一个实际上的便利优势：我们可以使用智能手机，对云端商业运行的语言模型执行上下文学习，而无需费力寻找一台可用于训练大型模型的计算机。

paragraphs.en: Although prompts provide a user-friendly interface to LLMs, the success of in-context learning tends to be quite sensitive to the way a prompt is formulated or when different examples are provided. Prompt-learning is brittle, and a new field called prompt engineering has emerged to help human users to learn how to make LLMs do what we want them to do [ Radford et al., 2019 , Wei et al., 2022a , Giray, 2023 , Sahoo et al., 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管提示词为大型语言模型提供了用户友好的接口，但上下文学习的成功往往对提示词的构建方式或所提供示例的顺序相当敏感。 提示词学习具有脆弱性，因此出现了一个名为“提示词工程”的新领域，旨在帮助人类用户学会如何让大型语言模型执行我们期望的任务 [ Radford et al., 2019 , Wei et al., 2022a , Giray, 2023 , Sahoo et al., 2024 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In most LLMs the context window is provided with hidden prompts, the system prompts, to specify a particular role for the model, to prevent the use of swear words, and, in chatbots, to have a short history of previous search results, to allow for more naturally flowing conversations.
paragraphs.zh: 在大多数大型语言模型中，上下文窗口会包含隐藏提示（即系统提示），用于为模型指定特定角色、防止使用脏话，以及在聊天机器人中保留先前搜索结果的历史记录，以实现更自然的对话流程。

paragraphs.en: In-context learning has spawned much further research. One of the areas is multi-step reasoning, which is the topic of this chapter. Reasoning used to be an area where LLMs performed poorly. For example, LLMs failed at simple math exercises. To better understand this application domain we will introduce a few reasoning benchmarks. Then we will discuss an in-context learning method that greatly improved the performance of reasoning by LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文学习催生了许多后续研究。 其中一个领域是多步推理，这也是本章的主题。 推理过去曾是大型语言模型表现不佳的一个领域。 例如，大型语言模型在简单的数学练习中表现不佳。 为了更好地理解这一应用领域，我们将介绍几个推理基准测试。 然后，我们将讨论一种上下文学习方法，该方法显著提升了大型语言模型在推理方面的性能。

paragraphs.en: Progress in artificial intelligence is measured by benchmarks. The research on multi-step reasoning with LLMs started with easy (grade school) math word problems. Specifically for the study of such easy reasoning the GSM8K benchmark was composed [ Cobbe et al., 2021 ] . GSM8K was created with the aim of providing high quality problems, of high diversity and moderate difficulty, in natural language. It consists of 8500 human-written math problems and solutions. Language models struggled to achieve good performance on this dataset before chain of thought was introduced (see the next section). Here is an example of a typical math word problem:

paragraphs.en: Problem: Romeo bakes 4 trays with two dozen batches of cookies in a week. If these cookies are shared amongst 16 people equally, how many cookies does each person consume? Answer: 4 × 2 × 12 / 16 = 6 4\times 2\times 12/16=6 .
paragraphs.zh: 问题：罗密欧在一周内烤了 4 盘饼干，每盘包含两打（即 24 块）饼干。 如果这些饼干由 16 个人平均分享，那么每个人会吃到多少块饼干？ 答案：4 × 2 × 12 / 16 = 6 4\times 2\times 12/16=6 。

paragraphs.en: The GSM8K benchmark, although it may look easy to us, turned out to be difficult for LLMs. When it was introduced, the state of the art LLM GPT-3-175B achieved a rather low accuracy of around 15% [ Wei et al., 2022b ] . Other benchmarks of similar math word problems are the SVAMP varying structures benchmark [ Patel et al., 2021 ] , the ASDiv dataset of diverse math problems [ Miao et al., 2021 ] , the AQuA dataset of algebraic word problems [ Ling et al., 2017 ] , and the MAWPS benchmark [ Koncel-Kedziorski et al., 2016 ] .
paragraphs.zh: GSM8K基准测试虽然在我们看来可能很简单，但事实证明它对大型语言模型来说却颇具难度。 该基准测试刚推出时，当时最先进的语言模型GPT-3-175B的准确率相当低，仅为15%左右 [ Wei et al., 2022b ] 。 其他类似的数学文字题基准测试包括结构多变的SVAMP基准测试 [ Patel et al., 2021 ] 、包含多样化数学问题的ASDiv数据集 [ Miao et al., 2021 ] 、代数文字题的AQuA数据集 [ Ling et al., 2017 ] ，以及MAWPS基准测试 [ Koncel-Kedziorski et al., 2016 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Later, benchmarks for other tasks were introduced, to assess LLM reasoning abilities in other fields of reasoning. For example, benchmarks have been developed on advanced mathematical questions (AIME [ Codeforces, 2024 ] ), computer code comprehension (Spider [ Yu et al., 2018 ] , transcoding (translating a program in one computer language to another) [ Roziere et al., 2020 ] ), robotic movement (Alfworld [ Shridhar et al., 2020 ] , kitchen tasks [ Ahn et al., 2022 ] ), puzzle solving (Game24 [ Yao et al., 2024 ] ), creative writing [ Yao et al., 2024 ] ), board games (Checkmate problems [ Yang et al., 2024 ] , MineCraft [ Fan et al., 2022 ] ), and webpage navigation (WebShop [ Yao et al., 2022a ] ). Further relevant benchmark studies also focus on games and planning problems [ Ruoss et al., 2024 , Paglieri et al., 2025 , Wen et al., 2025a ] .
paragraphs.zh: 后来，针对其他任务的基准测试被引入，用于评估大型语言模型在其他推理领域的推理能力。 例如，研究人员已经开发了针对高级数学问题（AIME [ Codeforces, 2024 ]）、计算机代码理解（Spider [ Yu et al., 2018 ]）、转码（将一种计算机语言的程序翻译成另一种语言）[ Roziere et al., 2020 ]、机器人运动（Alfworld [ Shridhar et al., 2020 ]、厨房任务 [ Ahn et al., 2022 ]）、谜题解决（Game24 [ Yao et al., 2024 ]）、创意写作 [ Yao et al., 2024 ]、棋盘游戏（国际象棋残局问题 [ Yang et al., 2024 ]、MineCraft [ Fan et al., 2022 ]）以及网页导航（WebShop [ Yao et al., 2022a ]）的基准测试。 其他相关的基准研究还聚焦于游戏和规划问题 [ Ruoss et al., 2024 , Paglieri et al., 2025 , Wen et al., 2025a ] 。

However, it can be difficult to directly compare different benchmarking results, since there may be differences in the way the experiments were conducted. See Kamoi et al. [2024] , Shojaee et al. [2025] for a critical discussion of challenges in benchmarking LLM reasoning.

paragraphs.en: Around 2022, regular LLMs of the time performed poorly on simple math word problems. Interestingly, the standard Chapter 4 approach to improve performance of LLMs by scaling up the size of the LLM, did not solve the problem [ Rae et al., 2021 ] . The problem appeared to be somehow fundamental in nature, and researchers went looking for a different approach.
paragraphs.zh: 大约在 2022 年，当时普通的 LLM 在简单的数学文字题上表现不佳。 有趣的是，通过扩大 LLM 规模来提升其性能的标准第 4 章方法并未解决这个问题 [ Rae et al., 2021 ]。 这个问题似乎具有某种根本性，因此研究人员开始寻找一种不同的方法。

sents.en: Around 2022, regular LLMs of the time performed poorly on simple math word problems.
sents.zh: 大约在 2022 年，当时普通的 LLM 在简单的数学文字题上表现不佳。

sents.zh: 这个问题似乎具有某种根本性，因此研究人员开始寻找一种不同的方法。

paragraphs.en: The LLM architecture is a transformer-based decoder. Given a certain input, it is designed to produce a single token. LLMs are next-token predictors. When we prompt such a decoder to produce an answer, it does as it is instructed to: it provides an answer quickly—any answer. But that is not how humans work towards an answer in a mathematical reasoning problem, we divide the question into a sequence of steps to solve ( 4 × 2 × 12 / 16 = 6 4\times 2\times 12/16=6 ). Thus, for the LLM, what we should do instead is to prompt it to follow a well-chosen sequence of intermediate steps, answer those, and thus work towards the final answer, just as a student is taught to break down a complex problem into smaller steps, and to also provide the reasoning steps when answering a problem in school— Don’t just tell me the answer, but tell me how you arrived at the answer . Children are taught in school to break down a big problem into a sequence of small steps, when solving a mathematical problem. Similarly, we should guide the language model to explicitly produce such intermediate steps, and then to combine the results. The LLM should then provide an answer that includes the intermediate steps, arriving at a correct result.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 的架构是一种基于 Transformer 的解码器。 给定某个输入，它被设计为生成单个词元。 LLM 是下一个词元的预测模型。 当我们提示这样的解码器生成答案时，它会按照指令执行：迅速给出一个答案——任何答案都可以。 但人类在解决数学推理问题时并非如此，我们会将问题分解为一系列步骤来解决（4 × 2 × 12 / 16 = 6 4\times 2\times 12/16=6）。 因此，对于 LLM，我们应当改为提示它遵循一个精心选择的中间步骤序列，逐一回答这些步骤，从而逐步逼近最终答案，就像学生被教导将复杂问题分解为更小的步骤，并在学校回答问题时提供推理过程一样——不要只告诉我答案，还要告诉我你是如何得出这个答案的。 在学校里，孩子们被教导在解决数学问题时，将一个大的问题分解为一系列小步骤。 同样地，我们应该引导语言模型明确生成这样的中间步骤，然后再合并这些结果。 此时，LLM 应该提供一个包含中间步骤的答案，并最终得出正确的结果。

sents.zh: LLM 的架构是一种基于 Transformer 的解码器。

sents.zh: 因此，对于 LLM，我们应当改为提示它遵循一个精心选择的中间步骤序列，逐一回答这些步骤，从而逐步逼近最终答案，就像学生被教导将复杂问题分解为更小的步骤，并在学校回答问题时提供推理过程一样——不要只告诉我答案，还要告诉我你是如何得出这个答案的。

sents.en: Children are taught in school to break down a big problem into a sequence of small steps, when solving a mathematical problem.
sents.zh: 在学校里，孩子们被教导在解决数学问题时，将一个大的问题分解为一系列小步骤。

sents.en: Similarly, we should guide the language model to explicitly produce such intermediate steps, and then to combine the results.
sents.zh: 同样地，我们应该引导语言模型明确生成这样的中间步骤，然后再合并这些结果。

sents.en: The LLM should then provide an answer that includes the intermediate steps, arriving at a correct result.
sents.zh: 此时，LLM 应该提供一个包含中间步骤的答案，并最终得出正确的结果。

paragraphs.en: Thus, our few-shot prompt should contain examples of intermediate reasoning steps, instead of only examples of the final answer. This question was studied by Wei et al. [2022b] , amongst others, who introduced the chain of thought approach. Figure 6.1 illustrates how the approach works, in addition to related approaches, that it inspired.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们的少样本提示应包含中间推理步骤的示例，而不仅仅是最终答案的示例。 Wei 等人研究了这个问题。 [2022b] 等人（以及其他研究者）提出了思维链方法。 图 6.1 说明了该方法的工作原理，以及它所启发的相关方法。

sents.en: Thus, our few-shot prompt should contain examples of intermediate reasoning steps, instead of only examples of the final answer.
sents.zh: 因此，我们的少样本提示应包含中间推理步骤的示例，而不仅仅是最终答案的示例。

sents.en: This question was studied by Wei et al.
sents.zh: Wei 等人研究了这个问题。

sents.en: [2022b] , amongst others, who introduced the chain of thought approach.
sents.zh: [2022b] 等人（以及其他研究者）提出了思维链方法。

sents.en: Figure 6.1 illustrates how the approach works, in addition to related approaches, that it inspired.
sents.zh: 图 6.1 说明了该方法的工作原理，以及它所启发的相关方法。

paragraphs.en: The way to instruct an LLM to generate intermediate steps is to manually write a prompt consisting of specific reasoning steps to answer the task (for example, calculate how many balls are in the container, or in how many pieces the pie was cut). Indeed, when Wei et al. [2022b] tried this approach, and the LLM was prompted to rephrase information from the question as intermediate reasoning steps in its answer, the LLM performed much better than when it was prompted to produce a single answer. The example from the chain of thought paper is shown in Figure 6.1 . When shown the longer example prompt, the LLM follows the longer example when answering the question (Few-Shot CoT). On GSM8K, the chain of thought approach showed a large increase in accuracy, from 16% to 47%.
paragraphs.zh: 指导大型语言模型生成中间步骤的方法，是手动编写一个提示词，其中包含完成该任务所需的特定推理步骤（例如，计算容器中有多少个球，或者派被切成了多少块）。事实上，当 Wei 等人 [2022b] 尝试这种方法时，他们要求大型语言模型在回答中将问题中的信息重新表述为中间推理步骤，此时其表现比仅被要求给出单一答案时要好得多。 《链式思维》论文中的示例如图 6.1 所示。 当看到更长的示例提示词时，大型语言模型在回答问题时会遵循这个更长的示例（少样本链式思维）。 在 GSM8K 数据集上，链式思维方法使准确率大幅提升，从 16% 提高到了 47%。

paragraphs.en: The idea that, when prompted, an LLM can be made to follow step-by-step instructions, has caused much excitement and has opened up further research on multi-step reasoning with LLMs. Chain of thought (CoT) has become a standard prompting approach in LLMs since.
paragraphs.zh: 这一观点——即通过提示，大型语言模型（LLM）可以被引导来遵循分步指令——引发了广泛的热情，并开启了关于 LLM 多步骤推理的进一步研究。 自此，“思维链”（CoT）已成为 LLM 中一种标准的提示方法。

sents.en: The idea that, when prompted, an LLM can be made to follow step-by-step instructions, has caused much excitement and has opened up further research on multi-step reasoning with LLMs.
sents.zh: 这一观点——即通过提示，大型语言模型（LLM）可以被引导来遵循分步指令——引发了广泛的热情，并开启了关于 LLM 多步骤推理的进一步研究。

sents.en: Chain of thought (CoT) has become a standard prompting approach in LLMs since.
sents.zh: 自此，“思维链”（CoT）已成为 LLM 中一种标准的提示方法。

paragraphs.en: In the original paper the prompts were hand-written by the researchers for the individual types of problems. Kojima et al. [2022] go a step further. They show that the addition of a single task-independent sentence ( Let’s think step by step ) also significantly improves performance for many problems. Since this text does not contain problem-related elements, it is as a form of zero-shot learning. Figure 6.1 compares the approaches (second and third column). Experiments further show that with this addition significant performance gains are also achieved on other reasoning benchmarks, including arithmetic, symbolic, and logical reasoning (achieving 70% accuracy on GSM8K when self consistency (see next section) is also included, using the newer PaLM LLM [ Wang et al., 2022 ] ).
paragraphs.zh: 在原始论文中，研究人员为不同类型的任务手动编写了提示词。Kojima 等人 [2022] 在此基础上更进一步。 他们表明，仅添加一句与任务无关的句子（“让我们逐步思考”）也能显著提升许多问题的性能。 由于这段文本不包含与问题相关的元素，因此它属于一种零样本学习形式。 图 6.1 比较了这些方法（第二列和第三列）。 实验还表明，通过添加这句话，在其他推理基准测试中也能取得显著的性能提升，包括算术、符号和逻辑推理（当同时采用自一致性方法（见下一节）并使用更新的 PaLM LLM [Wang 等人，2022] 时，在 GSM8K 上的准确率达到 70%）。

sents.zh: 他们表明，仅添加一句与任务无关的句子（“让我们逐步思考”）也能显著提升许多问题的性能。

paragraphs.en: The chain of thought idea itself is inspired by Scratchpad [ Nye et al., 2021 ] , by other earlier work where natural language steps are generated for arithmetic reasoning [ Ling et al., 2017 , Cobbe et al., 2021 ] , and by the use of formal languages for reasoning [ Roy and Roth, 2016 , Chiang and Chen, 2018 , Amini et al., 2019 , Chen et al., 2019 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这种链式思维的概念本身受到 Scratchpad [ Nye 等人，2021 ] 的启发，也受到其他早期工作的启发，这些工作为算术推理生成了自然语言步骤 [ Ling 等人，2017；Cobbe 等人，2021 ]，以及形式化语言在推理中的应用 [ Roy 和 Roth，2016；Chiang 和 Chen，2018；Amini 等人，2019；Chen 等人，2019 ]。

paragraphs.en: LLMs are not perfect, and errors in results occur. When multiple reasoning steps are generated, errors accumulate. To prevent the errors from getting out of hand we should pay extra attention to the evaluation of results. We will now review approaches to reduce error accumulation, either by examining the model, or by evaluating intermediate reasoning steps.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 并不完美，其结果中会出现错误。 当生成多个推理步骤时，错误会不断累积。 为防止错误失控，我们应该格外关注结果的评估。 接下来，我们将回顾减少错误累积的方法，包括检查模型或评估中间推理步骤。

sents.en: LLMs are not perfect, and errors in results occur.
sents.zh: LLM 并不完美，其结果中会出现错误。

sents.en: When multiple reasoning steps are generated, errors accumulate.
sents.zh: 当生成多个推理步骤时，错误会不断累积。

sents.en: To prevent the errors from getting out of hand we should pay extra attention to the evaluation of results.
sents.zh: 为防止错误失控，我们应该格外关注结果的评估。

sents.en: We will now review approaches to reduce error accumulation, either by examining the model, or by evaluating intermediate reasoning steps.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们将回顾减少错误累积的方法，包括检查模型或评估中间推理步骤。

paragraphs.en: When LLMs are prompted to perform CoT reasoning, they perform a sequence of steps. Performing multiple steps makes them sensitive to mistakes and vulnerable to error accumulation [ Weng et al., 2022 , Xiao et al., 2023 ] . Several methods have been developed to prevent error accumulation. One approach is to create a new model to separately evaluate the results. Weng et al. [2022] propose an automated approach using evaluation by the same LLM, called self verification. The LLM is prompted to use the conclusion of the chain of thought reasoning chain as a condition for solving the original problem and then compare the answer, going back to the original question. The LLM is given variations of its own conclusion and is instructed to choose the one with the highest similarity to the original question.
paragraphs.zh: 当提示大型语言模型（LLM）执行链式思维（CoT）推理时，它们会执行一系列步骤。 执行多个步骤会使它们对错误变得敏感，并容易引发错误累积问题 [ Weng et al., 2022 , Xiao et al., 2023 ] 。 目前已开发出多种方法以防止错误累积。 一种方法是创建一个新的模型来单独评估结果。Weng et al. [2022] 提出了一种自动化方法，通过同一大型语言模型进行验证，称为自我验证。 提示大型语言模型将思维链推理的结论作为解决原始问题的条件，然后比较答案，并回溯到原始问题。 向大型语言模型提供其自身结论的多个变体，并指示它选择与原始问题相似度最高的一个。

sents.en: When LLMs are prompted to perform CoT reasoning, they perform a sequence of steps.
sents.zh: 当提示大型语言模型（LLM）执行链式思维（CoT）推理时，它们会执行一系列步骤。

sents.zh: [2022] 提出了一种自动化方法，通过同一大型语言模型进行验证，称为自我验证。

sents.zh: 提示大型语言模型将思维链推理的结论作为解决原始问题的条件，然后比较答案，并回溯到原始问题。

sents.en: The LLM is given variations of its own conclusion and is instructed to choose the one with the highest similarity to the original question.
sents.zh: 向大型语言模型提供其自身结论的多个变体，并指示它选择与原始问题相似度最高的一个。

paragraphs.en: A popular related approach is self consistency [ Wang et al., 2022 ] . Self consistency is an ensemble approach (a well-known machine learning technique to make a strong learner by running multiple weaker learners [ Sagi and Rokach, 2018 , Breiman, 2001 ] ). Conventionally, the answer of an LLM query is extracted from the decoder network by greedily following the path with the highest logit values. In self consistency, greedy single-path decoding is replaced by majority voting over a wider sample of paths. By sampling diverse reasoning paths, evaluating them, and selecting the most consistent answer among them, self consistency effectively asks the LLM to perform the same query multiple times, and takes the majority-vote of the internal decoding paths of the transformer model. Self consistency works because complex reasoning problems typically have different reasoning paths that lead to the correct answer. Figure 6.2 provides an example of the approach.
paragraphs.zh: 一种流行的相关方法是自洽性 [ Wang et al., 2022 ]。 自洽性是一种集成方法（一种众所周知的机器学习技术，通过运行多个较弱的学习器来构建一个强大的学习器 [ Sagi and Rokach, 2018 , Breiman, 2001 ]）。 传统上，LLM查询的答案是通过贪婪地跟随对数概率值最高的路径，从解码器网络中提取的。 在自洽性方法中，贪婪的单路径解码被更广泛样本路径上的多数投票所取代。 通过采样多样化的推理路径、评估这些路径，并在其中选择最一致的答案，自洽性有效地让LLM多次执行相同的查询，并采用Transformer模型内部解码路径的多数投票结果。 自洽性之所以有效，是因为复杂的推理问题通常存在不同的推理路径，而这些路径最终都会导向正确答案。 图6.2展示了该方法的一个示例。

paragraphs.en: Self consistency has been evaluated on arithmetic reasoning, on commonsense reasoning and on symbolic reasoning, with a variety of LLMs, including GPT-3. Self consistency typically improves the performance of chain of thought by a further 10-20 percentage points. Self consistency is often used in combination with chain of thought in modern LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 自我一致性已在算术推理、常识推理和符号推理方面，通过多种大型语言模型（包括 GPT-3）进行了评估。 自我一致性通常能将链式思维的性能进一步提升 10-20 个百分点。 在现代大型语言模型中，自我一致性与链式思维常被结合使用。

sents.zh: 自我一致性已在算术推理、常识推理和符号推理方面，通过多种大型语言模型（包括 GPT-3）进行了评估。

sents.zh: 自我一致性通常能将链式思维的性能进一步提升 10-20 个百分点。

sents.zh: 在现代大型语言模型中，自我一致性与链式思维常被结合使用。

paragraphs.en: Another approach to improve the accuracy of a sequence of reasoning steps is to switch from a natural to a formal language. The advantage of a formal language is that it is less ambiguous than a natural language. Examples are computer languages, such as Python, or mathematical logic.
paragraphs.zh: 另一种提高推理步骤序列准确性的方法，是从自然语言切换到形式化语言。 形式化语言的优势在于其歧义性比自然语言更低。 例如计算机语言（如 Python）或数学逻辑。

sents.en: Another approach to improve the accuracy of a sequence of reasoning steps is to switch from a natural to a formal language.
sents.zh: 另一种提高推理步骤序列准确性的方法，是从自然语言切换到形式化语言。

sents.en: The advantage of a formal language is that it is less ambiguous than a natural language.
sents.zh: 形式化语言的优势在于其歧义性比自然语言更低。

sents.en: Examples are computer languages, such as Python, or mathematical logic.
sents.zh: 例如计算机语言（如 Python）或数学逻辑。

paragraphs.en: LLMs have been quite successful in generating computer code from natural language prompts. Chen et al. [2021] introduced Codex, a GPT model that was trained on publicly available code in the repository GitHub. Codex is able to generate correct programs from descriptions in natural language, such as commentary strings. Subsequently, the use of a formal language for reasoning has become a popular approach. Many approaches generate the reasoning steps in Python, so that the code can be evaluated by a compiler, debugger, or interpreter. Human programmers, when writing code, typically follow a cycle of writing some code, compiling and executing it to look for errors, and then using the feedback to improve the code. This approach is followed, for example, in self debugging [ Chen et al., 2023 ] . It follows the same steps of code generation, code execution, and code explanation. Self debugging is able to identify mistakes in its own code by investigating the execution results, and can also provide an explanation of the generated code, in natural language.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 在根据自然语言提示生成计算机代码方面取得了相当成功。Chen 等人 [2021] 提出了 Codex，这是一个基于 GitHub 仓库中公开可用代码训练的 GPT 模型。 Codex 能够根据自然语言描述（例如注释字符串）生成正确的程序。 随后，使用形式化语言进行推理已成为一种流行的方法。 许多方法用 Python 生成推理步骤，以便代码能够通过编译器、调试器或解释器进行评估。 人类程序员在编写代码时，通常会遵循一个循环：先编写部分代码，然后编译并执行以查找错误，再利用反馈改进代码。 例如，自我调试 [ Chen 等人，2023 ] 就采用了这种方法。 它遵循相同的步骤：代码生成、代码执行和代码解释。 自我调试能够通过分析执行结果发现自身代码中的错误，并且还能以自然语言的形式对生成的代码进行解释。

sents.en: Many approaches generate the reasoning steps in Python, so that the code can be evaluated by a compiler, debugger, or interpreter.
sents.zh: 许多方法用 Python 生成推理步骤，以便代码能够通过编译器、调试器或解释器进行评估。

sents.en: Human programmers, when writing code, typically follow a cycle of writing some code, compiling and executing it to look for errors, and then using the feedback to improve the code.
sents.zh: 人类程序员在编写代码时，通常会遵循一个循环：先编写部分代码，然后编译并执行以查找错误，再利用反馈改进代码。

sents.en: This approach is followed, for example, in self debugging [ Chen et al., 2023 ] .
sents.zh: 例如，自我调试 [ Chen 等人，2023 ] 就采用了这种方法。

sents.en: It follows the same steps of code generation, code execution, and code explanation.
sents.zh: 它遵循相同的步骤：代码生成、代码执行和代码解释。

sents.en: Self debugging is able to identify mistakes in its own code by investigating the execution results, and can also provide an explanation of the generated code, in natural language.
sents.zh: 自我调试能够通过分析执行结果发现自身代码中的错误，并且还能以自然语言的形式对生成的代码进行解释。

paragraphs.en: Another approach, program aided language [ Gao et al., 2023 ] , uses the LLM to generate Python and then use an interpreter to evaluate the result. In this approach the problem is translated into small pieces of Python code, that can then be executed by an interpreter to solve the problem. Figure 6.1 (fourth column) illustrates the program aided language approach. When the evaluation of the reasoning steps is offloaded to the Python interpreter, decomposing the natural language problem into executable code-steps remains the only task for the LLM. Gao et al. [2023] provide extensive experimental evidence showing the synergy between the neural LLM and the symbolic interpreter. Experiments were performed on 13 mathematical, symbolic, and algorithmic reasoning tasks, achieving more accurate results than much larger models of the time (for example, program aided language reported 72% on GSM8K and 93% on Penguins).
paragraphs.zh: 另一种方法是程序辅助语言 [Gao 等，2023]，该方法利用大语言模型生成 Python 代码，然后使用解释器来评估结果。 在这种方法中，问题被分解为小型的 Python 代码片段，这些片段随后可以由解释器执行以解决问题。 图 6.1（第四列）展示了程序辅助语言方法。 当推理步骤的评估被转移给 Python 解释器时，将自然语言问题分解为可执行的代码步骤仍然是大语言模型唯一需要完成的任务。Gao 等 [2023] 提供了大量实验证据，表明神经大语言模型与符号解释器之间存在协同效应。 实验在 13 个数学、符号和算法推理任务上进行，其结果比当时规模大得多的模型更为准确（例如，程序辅助语言在 GSM8K 上的准确率为 72%，在 Penguins 上为 93%）。

paragraphs.en: The work on verification with formal languages has lead to several works that generate working code tuned for solving specific problems automatically, without human feedback. Romera-Paredes et al. [2024] introduced FunSearch, an approach that integrates formal methods and LLMs to enhance mathematical reasoning and code generation. FunSearch uses a genetic approach with multiple populations of candidate solutions (programs), which are evaluated using a function depending on the problem specification. After evaluating the generated programs from the starting prompt, a new prompt is created, in an iterative fashion, combining a selection of sampled programs sorted according to their evaluation score, and the LLM is requested to generate a new program. Another work leverages evolutionary computation methods to generate and optimize evolutionary algorithms [ van Stein and Bäck, 2024 ] . This approach, LLaMEA (Large Language Model Evolutionary Algorithm), utilizes LLMs to design and optimize evolutionary algorithms. The approach uses LLMs to generate initial algorithmic structures, which are then refined through mutation and selection. Accuracy improvements on the Black-Box Optimization Benchmark (BBOB) [ Hansen and Ros, 2010 ] are reported of 11 percentage points.
paragraphs.zh: 使用形式语言进行验证的研究催生了若干能够自动生成针对特定问题的解决方案代码的工作，这些代码无需人类反馈即可运行。Romera-Paredes 等人 [2024] 提出了 FunSearch，这是一种将形式化方法与大型语言模型（LLM）相结合的方法，旨在增强数学推理和代码生成能力。 FunSearch 采用了一种遗传方法，包含多个候选解决方案（程序）种群，这些种群通过一个取决于问题规格的函数进行评估。 在评估初始提示生成的程序后，系统会以迭代方式创建新的提示：将按评估分数排序的采样程序组合起来，并请求 LLM 生成新程序。 另一项研究则利用进化计算方法来生成和优化进化算法 [ van Stein and Bäck, 2024 ]。 这种方法名为 LLaMEA（大型语言模型进化算法），它利用 LLM 来设计和优化进化算法。 该方法使用 LLM 生成初始的算法结构，随后通过变异和选择对其进行优化。 研究指出，在“黑盒优化基准测试”（BBOB）[ Hansen and Ros, 2010 ] 上，准确率提升了 11 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: In-context learning has emerged as a powerful new few-shot learning method. When our few-shot examples specify reasoning steps, we can improve the capabilities of LLMs even more.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文学习已成为一种强大的新型少样本学习方法。 当我们的少样本示例明确指定推理步骤时，我们可以进一步提升大型语言模型的能力。

sents.zh: 上下文学习已成为一种强大的新型少样本学习方法。

sents.en: When our few-shot examples specify reasoning steps, we can improve the capabilities of LLMs even more.
sents.zh: 当我们的少样本示例明确指定推理步骤时，我们可以进一步提升大型语言模型的能力。

paragraphs.en: In this section we will look at some of the limits of in-context learning, and we will look at ways to extend the limits. We will first discuss the question of state and memory. We will look at how state can be passed between separate invocations of LLMs, at long context windows, and at the question if LLMs are good at solving problems for which they have to manipulate state.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将探讨上下文学习的一些局限性，并研究扩展这些局限性的方法。 我们首先将讨论状态与记忆的问题。 我们将探讨如何在 LLM 的不同调用之间传递状态、长上下文窗口，以及 LLM 是否擅长解决需要操作状态的问题。

paragraphs.en: In-context few-shot learning exploits the capabilities of LLMs to retrieve knowledge, conditioned by the prompt. The instructions and examples are provided, and the transformer architecture finds the answer (next token) in its vast model of ( K , V ) (K,V) -parameters. With chain of thought prompts, the LLM is conditioned on few-shot reasoning steps that are specified in the prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 上下文少样本学习利用大语言模型根据提示词检索知识的能力。 在提供指令和示例后，Transformer 架构会在其庞大的 (K, V)（K,V）参数模型中找出答案（下一个词元）。 通过思维链提示，大语言模型会根据提示词中指定的少样本推理步骤进行条件调整。

paragraphs.en: In principle, LLMs do not retain information between LLM calls (model parameters remain unchanged, and there are no global variables with history). If we wish to refine our request, and we wish to carry state information from the previous call to the next, then all such state must be specified by the user in the new prompt p ′ p^{\prime} . The model itself has forgotten all about the previous answer.
paragraphs.zh: 原则上，大型语言模型（LLM）在每次调用之间不会保留信息（模型参数保持不变，且不存在包含历史记录的全局变量）。 如果我们希望优化请求，并希望将上一次调用的状态信息带到下一次调用中，那么所有此类状态都必须由用户在新的提示 p ′ p^{\prime} 中明确指定。 模型本身已经完全忘记了之前的回答。

sents.en: In principle, LLMs do not retain information between LLM calls (model parameters remain unchanged, and there are no global variables with history).
sents.zh: 原则上，大型语言模型（LLM）在每次调用之间不会保留信息（模型参数保持不变，且不存在包含历史记录的全局变量）。

sents.en: If we wish to refine our request, and we wish to carry state information from the previous call to the next, then all such state must be specified by the user in the new prompt p ′ p^{\prime} .
sents.zh: 如果我们希望优化请求，并希望将上一次调用的状态信息带到下一次调用中，那么所有此类状态都必须由用户在新的提示 p ′ p^{\prime} 中明确指定。

sents.en: The model itself has forgotten all about the previous answer.
sents.zh: 模型本身已经完全忘记了之前的回答。

paragraphs.en: For a chatbot, repeating the entire conversational history in each new question would be a cumbersome and unnatural way of conversing. In human conversation our conversation partners do remember what was last said, without us having to explicitly repeat their last sentence (although, when interviewing politicians, journalists sometimes use this method to try to keep them on message). Commercial chatbots overcome this problem in part using system prompts, by invisibly providing the output of the previous LLM call to the prompt for a new LLM query. However, the principle remains that LLMs are good at finding associative next-token answers for a prompt, but not at all at remembering answers and manipulating the state of variables as we know them from general computer programming languages. As no parameters are changed, LLMs do not remember in-context state between calls.
paragraphs.zh: 对于聊天机器人而言，在每次新问题中都重复整个对话历史，会是一种笨拙且不自然的交流方式。 在人类对话中，我们的对话伙伴能够记住之前所说的内容，而无需我们明确重复他们的上一句话（尽管在采访政治家时，记者有时会使用这种方法来试图让他们保持主题一致）。 商业聊天机器人部分通过系统提示解决了这个问题：它们会将前一次 LLM 调用的输出结果，以不可见的方式提供给新的 LLM 查询提示。 然而，其基本原理仍然是：LLM 擅长为提示找到具有关联性的下一个词的答案，但完全无法记住答案或操控变量状态——正如我们在通用计算机编程语言中所了解的那样。 由于没有任何参数被更改，LLM 在不同调用之间不会记住上下文中的状态。

paragraphs.en: The LLM-memory problem goes deeper. All information for the query must be specified in a context window. The size of this context window is limited, which fundamentally limits the amount of information that can be communicated to the LLM for a query. This limitation is a problem when a large text (such as a book) is to be summarized. Furthermore, in Section 20.2.1 we will discuss in-context reinforcement learning methods, that work by storing full episode histories in the context window. In short, methods are needed to pass more information to the LLM.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 记忆问题更为复杂。 查询所需的所有信息都必须明确指定在上下文窗口中。 这个上下文窗口的尺寸有限，这从根本上限制了每次查询时能够提供给 LLM 的信息量。 当需要对大文本（例如一本书）进行摘要时，这种限制会成为一个问题。 此外，在第 20.2.1 节中，我们将讨论“上下文内强化学习”方法，该方法通过将完整的事件历史存储在上下文窗口中来实现其功能。 简而言之，我们需要能够向 LLM 传递更多信息的方法。

paragraphs.en: One of the earliest methods to extend the amount of information at inference time is retrieval augmentation for generative AI (RAG). RAG lets the LLM place a call to external data, such as a corporate database, or to Wikipedia [ Lewis et al., 2020 ] . RAG’s use is also in reducing factual hallucinations and providing access to time-sensitive information, such as financial or logistics data. RAG will be discussed in Chapter 12 .
paragraphs.zh: 在推理阶段扩展信息量的最早方法之一，是为生成式人工智能采用的检索增强（RAG）。 RAG 允许大型语言模型调用外部数据，例如企业数据库或维基百科 [Lewis et al., 2020]。 RAG 的用途还包括减少事实性幻觉，并提供对时效性信息（如金融或物流数据）的访问。 RAG 将在第 12 章中讨论。

paragraphs.en: For passing longer texts to the model, LLMs have been developed with longer context windows. With the standard transformer architecture, the compute requirements scale quadratically with the size of the context window, and linear architectures are being developed [ Ren et al., 2024 ] . Another solution is to compress the information in the context window, for example using semantic compression [ Fei et al., 2024 ] , by chunking the information [ Wang et al., 2023 , Zhou et al., 2025 ] , or by recursive methods [ Zhang et al., 2025 ] . Devising novel memory architectures for LLMs is an active area of research [ Yan et al., 2025 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为了向模型传递更长的文本，研究人员已经开发出具有更长上下文窗口的 LLM。 在标准的 Transformer 架构中，计算需求会随着上下文窗口的大小呈二次方增长，因此研究人员正在开发线性架构 [Ren et al., 2024]。 另一种解决方案是压缩上下文窗口中的信息，例如使用语义压缩 [Fei et al., 2024]、通过分块处理信息 [Wang et al., 2023, Zhou et al., 2025]，或者采用递归方法 [Zhang et al., 2025]。 为 LLM 设计新颖的记忆架构是当前活跃的研究领域 [Yan et al., 2025]。

sents.en: For passing longer texts to the model, LLMs have been developed with longer context windows.
sents.zh: 为了向模型传递更长的文本，研究人员已经开发出具有更长上下文窗口的 LLM。

sents.en: With the standard transformer architecture, the compute requirements scale quadratically with the size of the context window, and linear architectures are being developed [ Ren et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 在标准的 Transformer 架构中，计算需求会随着上下文窗口的大小呈二次方增长，因此研究人员正在开发线性架构 [Ren et al., 2024]。

sents.en: Another solution is to compress the information in the context window, for example using semantic compression [ Fei et al., 2024 ] , by chunking the information [ Wang et al., 2023 , Zhou et al., 2025 ] , or by recursive methods [ Zhang et al., 2025 ] .
sents.zh: 另一种解决方案是压缩上下文窗口中的信息，例如使用语义压缩 [Fei et al., 2024]、通过分块处理信息 [Wang et al., 2023, Zhou et al., 2025]，或者采用递归方法 [Zhang et al., 2025]。

sents.en: Devising novel memory architectures for LLMs is an active area of research [ Yan et al., 2025 ] .
sents.zh: 为 LLM 设计新颖的记忆架构是当前活跃的研究领域 [Yan et al., 2025]。

paragraphs.en: LLMs perform poorly at solving problems in which state must be managed [ Wong et al., 2025 ] . This occurs for example in planning problems in which the current state has to be remembered accurately, even in simple board games such as the one shown in Figure 6.3 . LLMs tend to mix up the states, and to provide plausible sounding answers that may be correct for games that it has seen in its training corpus, but that are wrong for the actual board state at hand [ Paglieri et al., 2025 , Ruoss et al., 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: LLM 在需要管理状态的解决问题中表现不佳 [ Wong et al., 2025 ]。 例如，在规划问题中就会出现这种情况，此时必须准确记住当前状态，即便是在像图 6.3 所示的简单棋盘游戏中也是如此。 LLM 往往会混淆不同的状态，并给出听起来合理的回答；这些答案可能对于它在训练语料中见过的游戏是正确的，但对于当前实际的棋盘状态而言却是错误的 [ Paglieri et al., 2025 , Ruoss et al., 2024 ]。

sents.en: LLMs perform poorly at solving problems in which state must be managed [ Wong et al., 2025 ] .
sents.zh: LLM 在需要管理状态的解决问题中表现不佳 [ Wong et al., 2025 ]。

sents.en: This occurs for example in planning problems in which the current state has to be remembered accurately, even in simple board games such as the one shown in Figure 6.3 .
sents.zh: 例如，在规划问题中就会出现这种情况，此时必须准确记住当前状态，即便是在像图 6.3 所示的简单棋盘游戏中也是如此。

sents.en: LLMs tend to mix up the states, and to provide plausible sounding answers that may be correct for games that it has seen in its training corpus, but that are wrong for the actual board state at hand [ Paglieri et al., 2025 , Ruoss et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: LLM 往往会混淆不同的状态，并给出听起来合理的回答；这些答案可能对于它在训练语料中见过的游戏是正确的，但对于当前实际的棋盘状态而言却是错误的 [ Paglieri et al., 2025 , Ruoss et al., 2024 ]。

paragraphs.en: Many approaches have been tried to improve reasoning with state, often inspired by reinforcement learning and planning algorithms [ Wong et al., 2026 ] . To see how LLMs can be used to solve these stateful problems, we discuss how the memory-less nature of LLMs makes them suffer from a problem known as the knowing-doing gap . Other, advanced, methods have been developed to allow LLMs to deal better with stateful problems. Chapter 20 will discuss these advanced approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 为了改进状态推理能力，人们尝试了许多方法，这些方法通常受到强化学习和规划算法的启发 [ Wong et al., 2026 ]。 要了解如何利用 LLM 解决这类涉及状态的问题，我们将讨论 LLM 的无记忆特性如何导致其面临所谓的“知-行鸿沟”问题。 此外，还发展出其他更先进的方法，使 LLM 能够更好地处理涉及状态的问题。 第 20 章将讨论这些先进方法。

sents.en: Many approaches have been tried to improve reasoning with state, often inspired by reinforcement learning and planning algorithms [ Wong et al., 2026 ] .
sents.zh: 为了改进状态推理能力，人们尝试了许多方法，这些方法通常受到强化学习和规划算法的启发 [ Wong et al., 2026 ]。

sents.en: To see how LLMs can be used to solve these stateful problems, we discuss how the memory-less nature of LLMs makes them suffer from a problem known as the knowing-doing gap .
sents.zh: 要了解如何利用 LLM 解决这类涉及状态的问题，我们将讨论 LLM 的无记忆特性如何导致其面临所谓的“知-行鸿沟”问题。

sents.en: Other, advanced, methods have been developed to allow LLMs to deal better with stateful problems.
sents.zh: 此外，还发展出其他更先进的方法，使 LLM 能够更好地处理涉及状态的问题。

sents.en: Chapter 20 will discuss these advanced approaches.
sents.zh: 第 20 章将讨论这些先进方法。

paragraphs.en: In addition to the lack of state between LLM calls, there is another memory-related problem, in the internal execution by the LLM of certain tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 除了 LLM 调用之间缺乏状态之外，在 LLM 执行某些任务的内部过程中，还存在另一个与记忆相关的问题。

paragraphs.en: This problem has been named the knowing-doing gap . This gap describes the curious phenomenon where an LLM is able to generate a correct textual description to solve a problem, even the correct algorithm, but is not able to execute this algorithm correctly [ Paglieri et al., 2025 ] . When you ask an LLM how to solve a certain problem, it can promptly provide the right algorithm in executable Python code. When one subsequently asks it to actually solve this problem, the LLM does not correctly follow the algorithm that it just generated. More often than not, errors start appearing between state changes of the variables in the algorithm that it generated [ Paglieri et al., 2025 , Ruoss et al., 2024 ] . Note that faithfully executing algorithmic code step by step, tracking values in registers, is not what the attention-based transformers in LLMs were designed for at all—they were designed to simulate natural language processing through a form of associative memory [ La Malfa et al., 2024 ] . 1 1 1 Note further that the human mind sometimes has the same problem: we can easily describe an algorithm for long division, but when asked to compute 12345 / 42 12345/42 , we may make mistakes—computers are good at this, but not humans, and also not LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 这个问题被称为“知做鸿沟”。 这一鸿沟描述了一个奇特的现象：大型语言模型（LLM）能够生成正确的文本描述来解决某个问题，甚至能给出正确的算法，但却无法正确执行该算法 [ Paglieri et al., 2025 ]。 当你询问 LLM 如何解决某个特定问题时，它能迅速提供以可执行 Python 代码形式呈现的正确算法。 但随后当要求它实际解决这个问题时，LLM 却未能正确遵循自己刚刚生成的算法。 大多数情况下，错误会出现在所生成算法中变量状态变化之间的环节 [ Paglieri et al., 2025 , Ruoss et al., 2024 ]。 需要注意的是，忠实地按步骤执行算法代码、追踪寄存器中的数值，并非 LLM 中基于注意力的 Transformer 模型最初的设计目标——它们的设计初衷是通过一种联想记忆机制来模拟自然语言处理 [ La Malfa et al., 2024 ]。1 1 1 此外还需注意，人类心智有时也存在同样的问题：我们可以轻松描述出长除法的算法，但当被要求计算 12345 / 42 12345/42 时，我们仍可能出错——计算机擅长这项任务，但人类和 LLM 却不然。

sents.en: This problem has been named the knowing-doing gap .
sents.zh: 这个问题被称为“知做鸿沟”。

sents.en: This gap describes the curious phenomenon where an LLM is able to generate a correct textual description to solve a problem, even the correct algorithm, but is not able to execute this algorithm correctly [ Paglieri et al., 2025 ] .
sents.zh: 这一鸿沟描述了一个奇特的现象：大型语言模型（LLM）能够生成正确的文本描述来解决某个问题，甚至能给出正确的算法，但却无法正确执行该算法 [ Paglieri et al., 2025 ]。

sents.en: When you ask an LLM how to solve a certain problem, it can promptly provide the right algorithm in executable Python code.
sents.zh: 当你询问 LLM 如何解决某个特定问题时，它能迅速提供以可执行 Python 代码形式呈现的正确算法。

sents.en: When one subsequently asks it to actually solve this problem, the LLM does not correctly follow the algorithm that it just generated.
sents.zh: 但随后当要求它实际解决这个问题时，LLM 却未能正确遵循自己刚刚生成的算法。

sents.en: More often than not, errors start appearing between state changes of the variables in the algorithm that it generated [ Paglieri et al., 2025 , Ruoss et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 大多数情况下，错误会出现在所生成算法中变量状态变化之间的环节 [ Paglieri et al., 2025 , Ruoss et al., 2024 ]。

sents.en: Note that faithfully executing algorithmic code step by step, tracking values in registers, is not what the attention-based transformers in LLMs were designed for at all—they were designed to simulate natural language processing through a form of associative memory [ La Malfa et al., 2024 ] . 1 1 1 Note further that the human mind sometimes has the same problem: we can easily describe an algorithm for long division, but when asked to compute 12345 / 42 12345/42 , we may make mistakes—computers are good at this, but not humans, and also not LLMs.
sents.zh: 需要注意的是，忠实地按步骤执行算法代码、追踪寄存器中的数值，并非 LLM 中基于注意力的 Transformer 模型最初的设计目标——它们的设计初衷是通过一种联想记忆机制来模拟自然语言处理 [ La Malfa et al., 2024 ]。1 1 1 此外还需注意，人类心智有时也存在同样的问题：我们可以轻松描述出长除法的算法，但当被要求计算 12345 / 42 12345/42 时，我们仍可能出错——计算机擅长这项任务，但人类和 LLM 却不然。

paragraphs.en: In addition to the knowing-doing gap, there is another state-management problem. Prompting an LLM to play the first few moves of a board game against itself may show a game in which pieces on the board magically (dis)appear between moves. The model does not recognize that the moves that it plays that may have been good in certain situations, do not fit the current board position, and even decorates these wrong moves with a plausibly sounding reason in a chatty conversational style. LLMs have difficulty reliably managing the state transition of a variable that goes from one value to another value. Individual values tend to be forgotten or mixed up. Additional text can be inserted into the prompt to instruct the model to carefully track values of variables before making a next step [ La Malfa et al., 2024 ] , but this is a cumbersome and error-prone solution.
paragraphs.zh: 除了“认知-行动”鸿沟之外，还存在另一个状态管理问题。 如果提示大型语言模型（LLM）与自身对弈棋盘游戏的前几手，可能会看到棋子在回合之间神奇地出现或消失的情况。 该模型并未意识到，某些情况下看似合理的走法，在当前棋盘局势下却并不适用；它甚至还会以闲聊般的口吻，为这些错误的走法编造一个听起来合情合理的理由。 大型语言模型（LLM）难以可靠地管理一个变量从一种值过渡到另一种值的状态变化。 各个具体值往往会被遗忘或混淆。 可以在提示词中插入额外文本，指导模型在采取下一步之前仔细追踪变量的值 [ La Malfa et al., 2024 ]，但这种方法既繁琐又容易出错。

sents.en: In addition to the knowing-doing gap, there is another state-management problem.
sents.zh: 除了“认知-行动”鸿沟之外，还存在另一个状态管理问题。

sents.en: Prompting an LLM to play the first few moves of a board game against itself may show a game in which pieces on the board magically (dis)appear between moves.
sents.zh: 如果提示大型语言模型（LLM）与自身对弈棋盘游戏的前几手，可能会看到棋子在回合之间神奇地出现或消失的情况。

sents.en: The model does not recognize that the moves that it plays that may have been good in certain situations, do not fit the current board position, and even decorates these wrong moves with a plausibly sounding reason in a chatty conversational style.
sents.zh: 该模型并未意识到，某些情况下看似合理的走法，在当前棋盘局势下却并不适用；它甚至还会以闲聊般的口吻，为这些错误的走法编造一个听起来合情合理的理由。

sents.en: LLMs have difficulty reliably managing the state transition of a variable that goes from one value to another value.
sents.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）难以可靠地管理一个变量从一种值过渡到另一种值的状态变化。

sents.en: Individual values tend to be forgotten or mixed up.
sents.zh: 各个具体值往往会被遗忘或混淆。

sents.en: Additional text can be inserted into the prompt to instruct the model to carefully track values of variables before making a next step [ La Malfa et al., 2024 ] , but this is a cumbersome and error-prone solution.
sents.zh: 可以在提示词中插入额外文本，指导模型在采取下一步之前仔细追踪变量的值 [ La Malfa et al., 2024 ]，但这种方法既繁琐又容易出错。

paragraphs.en: Both the knowing-doing gap and the disappearing-pieces problem can be circumvented by calling an external interpreter to execute an LLM-generated algorithm. This strategy is sometimes taken by commercial chatbots. It is a smart, practical, solution, since, in addition to being able to correctly execute Python code, the Python interpreter will do so more efficiently than an LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 通过调用外部解释器来执行由大型语言模型生成的算法，既可以克服“知做鸿沟”问题，也可以解决“消失的棋子”问题。 一些商业聊天机器人有时会采用这种策略。 这是一种巧妙而实用的解决方案，因为除了能够正确执行 Python 代码外，Python 解释器执行效率还会比大型语言模型更高。

sents.en: Both the knowing-doing gap and the disappearing-pieces problem can be circumvented by calling an external interpreter to execute an LLM-generated algorithm.
sents.zh: 通过调用外部解释器来执行由大型语言模型生成的算法，既可以克服“知做鸿沟”问题，也可以解决“消失的棋子”问题。

sents.en: This strategy is sometimes taken by commercial chatbots.
sents.zh: 一些商业聊天机器人有时会采用这种策略。

sents.en: It is a smart, practical, solution, since, in addition to being able to correctly execute Python code, the Python interpreter will do so more efficiently than an LLM.
sents.zh: 这是一种巧妙而实用的解决方案，因为除了能够正确执行 Python 代码外，Python 解释器执行效率还会比大型语言模型更高。

paragraphs.en: Chapter 20 will discuss other approaches that address state and memory in the transformer architecture.
paragraphs.zh: 第 20 章将讨论其他处理 Transformer 架构中状态和记忆的方法。

paragraphs.en: In addition to resorting to externally executing generated code, other methods have been developed to deal with memory and state. In this section, we will go agentic, and introduce small external algorithms to explicitly manage state and prompts. Such an algorithm is called a harness . The harness may also call the same LLM in different roles, with different prompts for each role, for example, for generation or for evaluation of states. We start with prompt management based on search algorithms.
paragraphs.zh: 除了借助外部执行生成的代码之外，人们还开发出了其他方法来处理内存和状态问题。 在本节中，我们将采用智能体方法，引入小型的外部算法来显式管理状态和提示。 这类算法被称为“harness”。 “Harness”还可以以不同角色调用同一个大型语言模型（LLM），并为每个角色使用不同的提示，例如用于生成或状态评估。 我们首先介绍基于搜索算法的提示管理方法。

sents.en: In addition to resorting to externally executing generated code, other methods have been developed to deal with memory and state.
sents.zh: 除了借助外部执行生成的代码之外，人们还开发出了其他方法来处理内存和状态问题。

sents.en: In this section, we will go agentic, and introduce small external algorithms to explicitly manage state and prompts.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们将采用智能体方法，引入小型的外部算法来显式管理状态和提示。

sents.en: Such an algorithm is called a harness .
sents.zh: 这类算法被称为“harness”。

sents.en: The harness may also call the same LLM in different roles, with different prompts for each role, for example, for generation or for evaluation of states.
sents.zh: “Harness”还可以以不同角色调用同一个大型语言模型（LLM），并为每个角色使用不同的提示，例如用于生成或状态评估。

sents.en: We start with prompt management based on search algorithms.
sents.zh: 我们首先介绍基于搜索算法的提示管理方法。

paragraphs.en: When the LLM is called in different roles, for example to critique (evaluate) its own performance (that it just generated), the LLM can be said to perform self-reflection . This somewhat anthropomorphic term is often used in the literature for these approaches. Exactly what (not who) is doing the self-reflecting, the LLM, or the agentic harness, is a matter for debate.
paragraphs.zh: 当大型语言模型以不同角色被调用时，例如用来批判（评估）其刚刚生成的内容表现，就可以说该模型进行了自我反思。 这种略带拟人色彩的术语在相关文献中常被用于描述此类方法。 究竟是什么（而非谁）在执行自我反思——是大型语言模型本身，还是智能体框架——这一点仍有争议。

sents.en: When the LLM is called in different roles, for example to critique (evaluate) its own performance (that it just generated), the LLM can be said to perform self-reflection .
sents.zh: 当大型语言模型以不同角色被调用时，例如用来批判（评估）其刚刚生成的内容表现，就可以说该模型进行了自我反思。

sents.en: This somewhat anthropomorphic term is often used in the literature for these approaches.
sents.zh: 这种略带拟人色彩的术语在相关文献中常被用于描述此类方法。

sents.en: Exactly what (not who) is doing the self-reflecting, the LLM, or the agentic harness, is a matter for debate.
sents.zh: 究竟是什么（而非谁）在执行自我反思——是大型语言模型本身，还是智能体框架——这一点仍有争议。

paragraphs.en: We will now discuss search-based inference-time decision methods. These are in-context learning methods that go beyond chain of thought. Chain of thought explores a single line of reasoning steps, where each step has a single successor step. Search-based methods explore multiple options at each step, creating a tree of possibilities.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在将讨论基于搜索的推理时决策方法。 这些是在语境中学习的方法，它们超越了思维链方法。 思维链方法探索单一线索的推理步骤，其中每个步骤只有一个后续步骤。 基于搜索的方法在每个步骤中探索多种选项，从而形成一棵可能性树。

sents.en: We will now discuss search-based inference-time decision methods.
sents.zh: 我们现在将讨论基于搜索的推理时决策方法。

sents.en: These are in-context learning methods that go beyond chain of thought.
sents.zh: 这些是在语境中学习的方法，它们超越了思维链方法。

sents.en: Chain of thought explores a single line of reasoning steps, where each step has a single successor step.
sents.zh: 思维链方法探索单一线索的推理步骤，其中每个步骤只有一个后续步骤。

sents.en: Search-based methods explore multiple options at each step, creating a tree of possibilities.
sents.zh: 基于搜索的方法在每个步骤中探索多种选项，从而形成一棵可能性树。

paragraphs.en: When we wish to examine a tree of possible reasoning steps, then we need a method to keep track of the state of which step we have seen, what the best answer so far was, and which steps should still be further examined. As we have seen, LLMs are not terribly good at keeping track of state, whereas conventional computer algorithms, such as small pieces of Python code, are. Such an algorithm will decompose the problem into a search tree, where multiple alternative steps are generated that can be searched multiple steps into the future (see Figure 6.6 on page 6.6 ). The algorithms call the LLM as a subroutine prompting it to perform requested tasks, such as action selection and reward evaluation. Then, backtracking can be performed by the algorithm, allowing alternative steps to be tried. This control algorithm is external to the LLM. It wraps around the LLM, keeping track of state, managing the prompts, shielding it from the outside world (and shielding the outside world from LLMs that mess up state). The control algorithm is called a harness .
paragraphs.zh: 当我们想要检查一个可能推理步骤的树状结构时，就需要一种方法来追踪我们已经看到哪个步骤的状态、目前为止的最佳答案是什么，以及哪些步骤还需要进一步检查。 正如我们所见，大型语言模型（LLM）在追踪状态方面并不出色，而传统的计算机算法，例如简短的 Python 代码片段，则能很好地做到这一点。 这类算法会将问题分解为一棵搜索树，其中会生成多个替代步骤，并可以深入未来多个步骤进行搜索（参见第 6.6 页的图 6.6）。 这些算法将 LLM 作为一个子程序来调用，提示其执行所需的任务，例如动作选择和奖励评估。 然后，算法可以进行回溯操作，从而尝试其他替代步骤。 这种控制算法是独立于 LLM 的。 它包裹着 LLM，负责追踪状态、管理提示，并使其免受外部世界的干扰（同时也能保护外部世界免受 LLM 破坏状态的影响）。 这种控制算法被称为“约束框架”。

sents.en: When we wish to examine a tree of possible reasoning steps, then we need a method to keep track of the state of which step we have seen, what the best answer so far was, and which steps should still be further examined.
sents.zh: 当我们想要检查一个可能推理步骤的树状结构时，就需要一种方法来追踪我们已经看到哪个步骤的状态、目前为止的最佳答案是什么，以及哪些步骤还需要进一步检查。

sents.en: As we have seen, LLMs are not terribly good at keeping track of state, whereas conventional computer algorithms, such as small pieces of Python code, are.
sents.zh: 正如我们所见，大型语言模型（LLM）在追踪状态方面并不出色，而传统的计算机算法，例如简短的 Python 代码片段，则能很好地做到这一点。

sents.en: Such an algorithm will decompose the problem into a search tree, where multiple alternative steps are generated that can be searched multiple steps into the future (see Figure 6.6 on page 6.6 ).
sents.zh: 这类算法会将问题分解为一棵搜索树，其中会生成多个替代步骤，并可以深入未来多个步骤进行搜索（参见第 6.6 页的图 6.6）。

sents.en: The algorithms call the LLM as a subroutine prompting it to perform requested tasks, such as action selection and reward evaluation.
sents.zh: 这些算法将 LLM 作为一个子程序来调用，提示其执行所需的任务，例如动作选择和奖励评估。

sents.en: Then, backtracking can be performed by the algorithm, allowing alternative steps to be tried.
sents.zh: 然后，算法可以进行回溯操作，从而尝试其他替代步骤。

sents.en: This control algorithm is external to the LLM.
sents.zh: 这种控制算法是独立于 LLM 的。

sents.en: It wraps around the LLM, keeping track of state, managing the prompts, shielding it from the outside world (and shielding the outside world from LLMs that mess up state).
sents.zh: 它包裹着 LLM，负责追踪状态、管理提示，并使其免受外部世界的干扰（同时也能保护外部世界免受 LLM 破坏状态的影响）。

sents.en: The control algorithm is called a harness .
sents.zh: 这种控制算法被称为“约束框架”。

paragraphs.en: We start our discussion of control strategies with depth-first and breadth-first search [ Cormen et al., 2022 ] . Tree of thoughts [ Yao et al., 2024 ] uses breadth-first or depth-first search to dynamically follow different reasoning steps. 2 2 2 Tree of thoughts is a popular approach. The Huggingface link is here: https://huggingface.co/blog/sadhaklal/tree-of-thoughts Both the generation (red) and the evaluation (green) part in tree of thoughts are performed by prompting the LLM, see Figure 6.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们从深度优先和广度优先搜索开始讨论控制策略 [ Cormen et al., 2022 ]。 思维树方法 [ Yao et al., 2024 ] 使用广度优先或深度优先搜索来动态追踪不同的推理步骤。思维树是一种流行的方法。 Huggingface 的链接如下：https://huggingface.co/blog/sadhaklal/tree-of-thoughts 在思维树方法中，生成（红色）和评估（绿色）部分都通过提示 LLM 来完成，参见图 6.4。

sents.en: We start our discussion of control strategies with depth-first and breadth-first search [ Cormen et al., 2022 ] .
sents.zh: 我们从深度优先和广度优先搜索开始讨论控制策略 [ Cormen et al., 2022 ]。

sents.en: Tree of thoughts [ Yao et al., 2024 ] uses breadth-first or depth-first search to dynamically follow different reasoning steps. 2 2 2 Tree of thoughts is a popular approach.
sents.zh: 思维树方法 [ Yao et al., 2024 ] 使用广度优先或深度优先搜索来动态追踪不同的推理步骤。思维树是一种流行的方法。

sents.en: The Huggingface link is here: https://huggingface.co/blog/sadhaklal/tree-of-thoughts Both the generation (red) and the evaluation (green) part in tree of thoughts are performed by prompting the LLM, see Figure 6.4 .
sents.zh: Huggingface 的链接如下：https://huggingface.co/blog/sadhaklal/tree-of-thoughts 在思维树方法中，生成（红色）和评估（绿色）部分都通过提示 LLM 来完成，参见图 6.4。

paragraphs.en: Together, the two LLM prompts with the external control, allow systematic exploration of the space of reasoning steps, performing look-ahead and backtracking.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个带有外部控制的 LLM 提示共同实现了对推理步骤空间的系统性探索，能够执行前瞻和回溯操作。

paragraphs.en: Tree of thoughts (ToT) has been used on planning-based puzzles, such as the Game of 24. In this game, 4 numbers are give, and the task is to reach the number 24 by using the arithmetic operators ( + − ∗ / ) (+-*/) in between the numbers. For example, for the numbers 4 4 9 9 10 10 13 13 , a solution would be ( 10 − 4 ) ∗ ( 13 − 9 ) = 24 (10-4)*(13-9)=24 . Tree of thoughts first generates a position with the propose prompt: Input 4 9 10 13; Possible next steps: to which the model answers by generating possible next step thoughts. These are then evaluated by the model with an evaluation prompt including chain of thought examples. Figure 6.5 shows a possible prompting sequence from the original paper.
paragraphs.zh: 思维树（ToT）已被用于基于规划的谜题，例如“24点游戏”。 在该游戏中，给定4个数字，任务是通过在数字之间使用算术运算符（+ − ∗ /）得到数字24。 例如，对于数字 4 4 9 9 10 10 13 13，一个解法是 (10 − 4) ∗ (13 − 9) = 24。 思维树首先通过提示生成一个状态：输入 4 9 10 13；可能的下一步骤为：模型会对此回答，生成可能的下一步骤思考。 随后，模型会使用包含链式思考示例的评估提示来对这些思考进行评估。 图6.5展示了原始论文中一种可能的提示序列。

sents.en: Tree of thoughts (ToT) has been used on planning-based puzzles, such as the Game of 24.
sents.zh: 思维树（ToT）已被用于基于规划的谜题，例如“24点游戏”。

sents.en: In this game, 4 numbers are give, and the task is to reach the number 24 by using the arithmetic operators ( + − ∗ / ) (+-*/) in between the numbers.
sents.zh: 在该游戏中，给定4个数字，任务是通过在数字之间使用算术运算符（+ − ∗ /）得到数字24。

sents.en: For example, for the numbers 4 4 9 9 10 10 13 13 , a solution would be ( 10 − 4 ) ∗ ( 13 − 9 ) = 24 (10-4)*(13-9)=24 .
Tree of thoughts first generates a position with the propose prompt: Input 4 9 10 13; Possible next steps: to which the model answers by generating possible next step thoughts.
sents.zh: 思维树首先通过提示生成一个状态：输入 4 9 10 13；可能的下一步骤为：模型会对此回答，生成可能的下一步骤思考。

sents.en: These are then evaluated by the model with an evaluation prompt including chain of thought examples.
sents.zh: 随后，模型会使用包含链式思考示例的评估提示来对这些思考进行评估。

sents.en: Figure 6.5 shows a possible prompting sequence from the original paper.
sents.zh: 图6.5展示了原始论文中一种可能的提示序列。

paragraphs.en: The authors compare their approach to traditional linear chain of thought with self consistency on the Game of 24, Creative writing, and Mini crossword, achieving an accuracy of 74% on a Game of 24 task. The other tasks are evaluated qualitatively. Figure 6.6 illustrates the different reasoning structures. 3 3 3 A similarly named approach is graph of thoughts [ Besta et al., 2024 ] . Graph of thoughts allows more general reasoning graphs, providing a formal framework, where the different elements can then be specified manually.
paragraphs.zh: 作者将他们的方法与传统的线性思维链方法以及自洽性方法在“24点游戏”“创意写作”和“迷你填字游戏”任务上进行了比较，并在“24点游戏”任务中实现了74%的准确率。 其他任务则通过定性方式进行评估。 图6.6展示了不同的推理结构。3 3 3 一种名称类似的方法是思维图 [Besta et al., 2024]。 思维图支持更通用的推理图，提供了一个正式框架，其中各个元素可以手动指定。

sents.en: The authors compare their approach to traditional linear chain of thought with self consistency on the Game of 24, Creative writing, and Mini crossword, achieving an accuracy of 74% on a Game of 24 task.
sents.zh: 作者将他们的方法与传统的线性思维链方法以及自洽性方法在“24点游戏”“创意写作”和“迷你填字游戏”任务上进行了比较，并在“24点游戏”任务中实现了74%的准确率。

sents.en: The other tasks are evaluated qualitatively.
sents.zh: 其他任务则通过定性方式进行评估。

sents.en: Figure 6.6 illustrates the different reasoning structures. 3 3 3 A similarly named approach is graph of thoughts [ Besta et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 图6.6展示了不同的推理结构。3 3 3 一种名称类似的方法是思维图 [Besta et al., 2024]。

sents.en: Graph of thoughts allows more general reasoning graphs, providing a formal framework, where the different elements can then be specified manually.
sents.zh: 思维图支持更通用的推理图，提供了一个正式框架，其中各个元素可以手动指定。

paragraphs.en: Tree of thoughts is an elegant approach, adding two of the simplest possible search structures on top of an LLM. The sequence of prompts is easy to follow, and finding and correcting mistakes is also easy.
paragraphs.zh: “思维树”是一种优雅的方法，它在大型语言模型之上叠加了两种最简单的搜索结构。 提示词序列易于遵循，而且发现和纠正错误也很简单。

sents.en: Tree of thoughts is an elegant approach, adding two of the simplest possible search structures on top of an LLM.
sents.zh: “思维树”是一种优雅的方法，它在大型语言模型之上叠加了两种最简单的搜索结构。

sents.en: The sequence of prompts is easy to follow, and finding and correcting mistakes is also easy.
sents.zh: 提示词序列易于遵循，而且发现和纠正错误也很简单。

paragraphs.en: The two search methods of tree of thoughts follow a fixed expansion policy. Next, we will discuss more advanced learning-based approaches, that may perform better, at the cost of higher algorithmic complexity.
paragraphs.zh: 思维树这两种搜索方法遵循固定的扩展策略。 接下来，我们将讨论更高级的基于学习的方法，这些方法可能会表现更好，但代价是算法复杂度更高。

sents.en: The two search methods of tree of thoughts follow a fixed expansion policy.
sents.zh: 思维树这两种搜索方法遵循固定的扩展策略。

sents.en: Next, we will discuss more advanced learning-based approaches, that may perform better, at the cost of higher algorithmic complexity.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们将讨论更高级的基于学习的方法，这些方法可能会表现更好，但代价是算法复杂度更高。

paragraphs.en: Many approaches have been devised that use the LLM in more than one role. Such approaches are generally called self-reflective approaches. The LLM is used not just to evaluate a prompt, but also to generate new reasoning steps, and often to refine them.
paragraphs.zh: 人们已经设计出了许多方法，这些方法让大型语言模型（LLM）承担不止一个角色。 这类方法通常被称为自我反思方法。 大型语言模型不仅用于评估提示，还用于生成新的推理步骤，并且经常用于优化这些步骤。

sents.en: Many approaches have been devised that use the LLM in more than one role.
sents.zh: 人们已经设计出了许多方法，这些方法让大型语言模型（LLM）承担不止一个角色。

sents.en: Such approaches are generally called self-reflective approaches.
sents.zh: 这类方法通常被称为自我反思方法。

sents.en: The LLM is used not just to evaluate a prompt, but also to generate new reasoning steps, and often to refine them.
sents.zh: 大型语言模型不仅用于评估提示，还用于生成新的推理步骤，并且经常用于优化这些步骤。

paragraphs.en: The field of self-reflection is young and new approaches are being developed regularly. We will present four such approaches: self refine, ReAct, reflexion, and buffer of thoughts. These approaches use the LLMs in different ways, using schemes inspired by reinforcement learning to let the LLMs improve themselves.
paragraphs.zh: 自我反思这一领域尚处于起步阶段，新的方法正在不断被开发出来。 我们将介绍四种这样的方法：self refine、ReAct、reflexion 和 buffer of thoughts。 这些方法以不同方式利用大型语言模型（LLM），并采用受强化学习启发的方案，使 LLM 能够自我改进。

sents.en: The field of self-reflection is young and new approaches are being developed regularly.
sents.zh: 自我反思这一领域尚处于起步阶段，新的方法正在不断被开发出来。

sents.en: We will present four such approaches: self refine, ReAct, reflexion, and buffer of thoughts.
sents.zh: 我们将介绍四种这样的方法：self refine、ReAct、reflexion 和 buffer of thoughts。

sents.en: These approaches use the LLMs in different ways, using schemes inspired by reinforcement learning to let the LLMs improve themselves.
sents.zh: 这些方法以不同方式利用大型语言模型（LLM），并采用受强化学习启发的方案，使 LLM 能够自我改进。

paragraphs.en: The first approach is self refine [ Madaan et al., 2023 ] . This approach aims to improve answers from feedback. The LLM generates an initial output and provides feedback for its answer, using the LLM to refine itself, iteratively. The LLM is thus used to improve its own answers, see Figure 6.7 .
paragraphs.zh: 第一种方法是自我优化 [ Madaan et al., 2023 ]。 这种方法旨在通过反馈来改进答案。 LLM 会生成初始输出，并为自己的答案提供反馈，再利用 LLM 进行迭代优化。 因此，LLM 被用来改进自身的答案，参见图 6.7。

sents.en: The first approach is self refine [ Madaan et al., 2023 ] .
sents.zh: 第一种方法是自我优化 [ Madaan et al., 2023 ]。

sents.en: This approach aims to improve answers from feedback.
sents.zh: 这种方法旨在通过反馈来改进答案。

sents.en: The LLM generates an initial output and provides feedback for its answer, using the LLM to refine itself, iteratively.
sents.zh: LLM 会生成初始输出，并为自己的答案提供反馈，再利用 LLM 进行迭代优化。

sents.en: The LLM is thus used to improve its own answers, see Figure 6.7 .
sents.zh: 因此，LLM 被用来改进自身的答案，参见图 6.7。

paragraphs.en: Self refine prompts the LLM in three ways: (1) for initial generation, (2) for feedback, and (3) for refinement, following a greedy reasoning chain. Self refine reportedly improves significantly over regular chain of thought, on benchmarks such as dialogue response generation, code optimization, and constrained generation. This approach does follow a linear, greedy, reasoning chain, where a single successor is tried in a state (it does not explore a tree, as in ToT).
paragraphs.zh: Self refine 通过三种方式引导 LLM：（1）初始生成，（2）反馈，以及（3）优化，整个过程遵循贪心推理链。 据报道，Self refine 在对话响应生成、代码优化和约束生成等基准测试中，相比常规的思维链方法有显著提升。 这种方法确实遵循线性的贪心推理链，即在每个状态下只尝试一个后续步骤（它不会像 ToT 那样探索树状结构）。

sents.en: Self refine prompts the LLM in three ways: (1) for initial generation, (2) for feedback, and (3) for refinement, following a greedy reasoning chain.
sents.zh: Self refine 通过三种方式引导 LLM：（1）初始生成，（2）反馈，以及（3）优化，整个过程遵循贪心推理链。

sents.en: Self refine reportedly improves significantly over regular chain of thought, on benchmarks such as dialogue response generation, code optimization, and constrained generation.
sents.zh: 据报道，Self refine 在对话响应生成、代码优化和约束生成等基准测试中，相比常规的思维链方法有显著提升。

sents.en: This approach does follow a linear, greedy, reasoning chain, where a single successor is tried in a state (it does not explore a tree, as in ToT).
sents.zh: 这种方法确实遵循线性的贪心推理链，即在每个状态下只尝试一个后续步骤（它不会像 ToT 那样探索树状结构）。

paragraphs.en: Generalizing the greedy approach, we can use LLMs to examine multiple options per state. A notable approach that combines reinforcement learning and LLMs is ReAct [ Yao et al., 2022b ] . 4 4 4 https://github.com/ysymyth/ReAct ReAct uses chain of thought prompt-learning as part of a reinforcement learning framework that also uses external knowledge sources (Wikipedia) and finetuning; for error reduction, grounding, and for reducing hallucination. The framework allows hand-written prompts. On two interactive decision making benchmarks (Alfworld and WebShop), ReAct outperforms imitation and reinforcement learning methods by an absolute success rate of 34% and 10% respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 通过推广贪心策略，我们可以利用大型语言模型（LLM）在每种状态下评估多种选项。 一种结合强化学习和大型语言模型（LLM）的显著方法是 ReAct [ Yao et al., 2022b ]。4 4 4 https://github.com/ysymyth/ReAct ReAct 将思维链提示学习作为强化学习框架的一部分，该框架还利用外部知识源（维基百科）和微调；用于减少错误、实现接地以及降低幻觉。 该框架支持手写提示。 在两个交互式决策基准测试（Alfworld 和 WebShop）中，ReAct 的绝对成功率分别比模仿学习和强化学习方法高出 34% 和 10%。

sents.en: Generalizing the greedy approach, we can use LLMs to examine multiple options per state.
sents.zh: 通过推广贪心策略，我们可以利用大型语言模型（LLM）在每种状态下评估多种选项。

sents.en: A notable approach that combines reinforcement learning and LLMs is ReAct [ Yao et al., 2022b ] . 4 4 4 https://github.com/ysymyth/ReAct ReAct uses chain of thought prompt-learning as part of a reinforcement learning framework that also uses external knowledge sources (Wikipedia) and finetuning; for error reduction, grounding, and for reducing hallucination.
sents.zh: 一种结合强化学习和大型语言模型（LLM）的显著方法是 ReAct [ Yao et al., 2022b ]。4 4 4 https://github.com/ysymyth/ReAct ReAct 将思维链提示学习作为强化学习框架的一部分，该框架还利用外部知识源（维基百科）和微调；用于减少错误、实现接地以及降低幻觉。

sents.en: The framework allows hand-written prompts.
sents.zh: 该框架支持手写提示。

sents.en: On two interactive decision making benchmarks (Alfworld and WebShop), ReAct outperforms imitation and reinforcement learning methods by an absolute success rate of 34% and 10% respectively.
sents.zh: 在两个交互式决策基准测试（Alfworld 和 WebShop）中，ReAct 的绝对成功率分别比模仿学习和强化学习方法高出 34% 和 10%。

paragraphs.en: The ReAct work has been developed further. Reflexion [ Shinn et al., 2024 ] creates AI agents that learn by reflecting on failures and enhance their results, inspired by the way that humans do this. 5 5 5 https://github.com/noahshinn/reflexion Reflexion uses three prompts for the LLM: actor, evaluator, and reflector. The reflexion harness incorporates explicit memory between LLM calls. For trajectory generation it has a short-term memory, and for storing experience information it has a long term memory. This approach addresses the state management problem of regular LLMs using memory in the external algorithm. Reflexion works as follows: (1) an actor model generates text and actions, (2) an evaluator model scores the outputs produced by the actor, and (3) a self-reflection model generates verbal reinforcement cues to assist the actor to self-improve (see Figure 6.8 ). For the actor, chain of thought and ReAct can be used. Reflexion has been evaluated on decision-making, reasoning, and coding tasks. Improvements of 10-20 percentage points are reported [ Shinn et al., 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: ReAct 方法得到了进一步的发展。 Reflexion [ Shinn et al., 2024 ] 创建了能够通过反思失败来学习并提升结果的 AI 智能体，这一设计灵感来自人类的学习方式。5 5 5 https://github.com/noahshinn/reflexion Reflexion 为 LLM 使用了三个提示：执行者、评估者和反思者。 Reflexion 框架在 LLM 调用之间整合了显式记忆。 在轨迹生成方面，它具备短期记忆；在存储经验信息方面，它具备长期记忆。 这种方法通过在外部算法中使用记忆，解决了常规 LLM 的状态管理问题。 Reflexion 的工作流程如下：（1）执行者模型生成文本和行动；（2）评估者模型对执行者产生的输出进行评分；（3）自我反思模型生成语言形式的强化提示，以帮助执行者实现自我改进（参见图 6.8）。 对于执行者，可以使用思维链和 ReAct 方法。 Reflexion 已在决策、推理和编程任务上进行了评估。 据报道，该方法实现了 10-20 个百分点的性能提升 [ Shinn et al., 2024 ]。

sents.en: The ReAct work has been developed further.
sents.zh: ReAct 方法得到了进一步的发展。

sents.en: Reflexion [ Shinn et al., 2024 ] creates AI agents that learn by reflecting on failures and enhance their results, inspired by the way that humans do this. 5 5 5 https://github.com/noahshinn/reflexion Reflexion uses three prompts for the LLM: actor, evaluator, and reflector.
