sents.zh: 在轨迹生成方面，它具备短期记忆；在存储经验信息方面，它具备长期记忆。

sents.en: This approach addresses the state management problem of regular LLMs using memory in the external algorithm.
sents.zh: 这种方法通过在外部算法中使用记忆，解决了常规 LLM 的状态管理问题。

sents.en: Reflexion works as follows: (1) an actor model generates text and actions, (2) an evaluator model scores the outputs produced by the actor, and (3) a self-reflection model generates verbal reinforcement cues to assist the actor to self-improve (see Figure 6.8 ).
sents.zh: Reflexion 的工作流程如下：（1）执行者模型生成文本和行动；（2）评估者模型对执行者产生的输出进行评分；（3）自我反思模型生成语言形式的强化提示，以帮助执行者实现自我改进（参见图 6.8）。

sents.en: For the actor, chain of thought and ReAct can be used.
sents.zh: 对于执行者，可以使用思维链和 ReAct 方法。

sents.en: Reflexion has been evaluated on decision-making, reasoning, and coding tasks.
sents.zh: Reflexion 已在决策、推理和编程任务上进行了评估。

sents.en: Improvements of 10-20 percentage points are reported [ Shinn et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 据报道，该方法实现了 10-20 个百分点的性能提升 [ Shinn et al., 2024 ]。

paragraphs.en: Another approach is buffer of thoughts [ Yang et al., 2024 ] , which goes a step towards metareasoning [ Gao et al., 2024 ] . It introduces a meta-buffer that stores high-level thought-templates . Thought-templates are derived from a variety of tasks. Buffer of thoughts uses a problem distiller that stores high-level thoughts distilled from different problems in a meta-buffer, which is actively managed for capacity. Figure 6.9 compares the buffer of thoughts approach to other approaches such as chain of thought and tree of thoughts. Buffer of thoughts outperforms other methods in puzzles such as Game of 24 (by 11%) and checkmating (by 51%). Thought templates are related to metacognition (thinking about thinking) [ Didolkar et al., 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 另一种方法是“思维缓冲区”[Yang et al., 2024]，该方法向元推理[Gao et al., 2024]迈出了一步。 它引入了一种元缓冲区，用于存储高级的思维模板。 思维模板源自多种不同的任务。 “思维缓冲区”使用一种问题提炼器，将不同问题中提炼出的高级思维存储在元缓冲区中，并对该缓冲区进行主动容量管理。 图6.9将“思维缓冲区”方法与其他方法（如“思维链”和“思维树”）进行了比较。 在“24点游戏”（提升11%）和“国际象棋将军”（提升51%）等谜题中，“思维缓冲区”的表现优于其他方法。 思维模板与元认知（关于思考的思考）[Didolkar et al., 2024]相关。

paragraphs.en: The concept of self-reflection is not without pitfalls and criticism. To start, the basic idea of asking a model to refine its results begs the question why the model did not give the better answer in the first place. Next, studies by Huang et al. [2023] , Shojaee et al. [2025] find methodological issues with some of the studies, such as the use of data labels that reveal the answer, second refinement prompts that unintentionally reveal more information than the initial prompts, and the use of the same LLM for agent and environment. In one reproducibility study performance did not exceed that of chain of thought with self consistency [ Huang et al., 2023 ] . LLMs are sensitive to how a question is formulated in the prompt. Self-reflection is still a young and active field of research, with an appealing premise, but many open questions.
paragraphs.zh: 自我反思这一概念并非没有陷阱和批评。 首先，要求模型改进其结果这一基本想法引发了一个问题：为什么模型一开始就没有给出更好的答案？ 其次，Huang 等人 [2023]、Shojaee 等人 [2025] 的研究发现部分研究存在方法论问题，例如使用暴露答案的数据标签、二次改进提示无意中比初始提示透露了更多信息，以及将同一 LLM 同时用于智能体和环境。 在一项可重复性研究中，其表现并未超过“思维链与自我一致性”方法 [Huang 等人, 2023]。 LLM 对问题在提示中的表述方式十分敏感。 自我反思仍是一个年轻且活跃的研究领域，其前提颇具吸引力，但仍有许多悬而未决的问题。

Finding the optimum approach for your problem may require quite some experimentation. In Chapter 10 we will discuss a practical case study where we will get hands-on experience with self-reflection methods. Please keep the preceding critique in mind.

paragraphs.en: The focus of this chapter is on in-context learning. In-context learning occurs at inference time, and no parameters are trained or changed. Finetuning occurs at training time, and does change the parameters of the model. In this section we will, however, briefly talk about a mix of finetuning and in-context learning, we will be mixing training and inference.
paragraphs.zh: 本章的重点是上下文学习。 上下文学习发生在推理阶段，且没有任何参数被训练或改变。 微调发生在训练阶段，并且确实会改变模型参数。 然而，在本节中，我们将简要讨论微调与上下文学习的结合，即同时涉及训练和推理。

sents.en: The focus of this chapter is on in-context learning.
sents.zh: 本章的重点是上下文学习。

sents.en: In-context learning occurs at inference time, and no parameters are trained or changed.
sents.zh: 上下文学习发生在推理阶段，且没有任何参数被训练或改变。

sents.en: Finetuning occurs at training time, and does change the parameters of the model.
sents.zh: 微调发生在训练阶段，并且确实会改变模型参数。

sents.en: In this section we will, however, briefly talk about a mix of finetuning and in-context learning, we will be mixing training and inference.
sents.zh: 然而，在本节中，我们将简要讨论微调与上下文学习的结合，即同时涉及训练和推理。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards refers to an algorithmic approach for training language models on tasks with verifiable outcomes such as mathematical problem-solving and instruction following. Especially for reasoning problems, such as math word problems and coding, inference-time chain of thought results have been found to significantly improve models when they are used for finetuning.
paragraphs.zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习，是指一种算法方法，用于在具有可验证结果的任务（如数学问题求解和指令遵循）上训练语言模型。 尤其是在推理类问题中，例如数学应用题和编程问题，研究发现，在微调时利用推理阶段的思维链结果能显著提升模型性能。

sents.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards refers to an algorithmic approach for training language models on tasks with verifiable outcomes such as mathematical problem-solving and instruction following.
sents.zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习，是指一种算法方法，用于在具有可验证结果的任务（如数学问题求解和指令遵循）上训练语言模型。

sents.en: Especially for reasoning problems, such as math word problems and coding, inference-time chain of thought results have been found to significantly improve models when they are used for finetuning.
sents.zh: 尤其是在推理类问题中，例如数学应用题和编程问题，研究发现，在微调时利用推理阶段的思维链结果能显著提升模型性能。

paragraphs.en: RLVR is an improvement over reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), dispensing with the need for human feedback. In many domains, such as mathematics, a simple function exists to check if an answer is correct, without the need for human feedback. RLVR leverages the existing RLHF objective but replaces the reward model with a verification function. RLVR samples completions from a policy model given a set of prompts, and verifies their correctness using a deterministic function. If correct, the reward is positive, otherwise it is 0. This reward is then used to train against using PPO [ Schulman et al., 2017 ] (a standard reinforcement learning algorithm), as in RLHF.
paragraphs.zh: RLVR 是对人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）的改进，无需依赖人类反馈。 在许多领域（如数学），存在一个简单的函数可以判断答案是否正确，而无需人类反馈。 RLVR 利用了现有的 RLHF 目标函数，但将奖励模型替换为验证函数。 RLVR 根据一组提示从策略模型中采样生成回答，并使用确定性函数验证其正确性。 如果正确，奖励值为正；否则为 0。 随后，该奖励值被用于通过 PPO [ Schulman et al., 2017 ]（一种标准的强化学习算法）进行训练，与 RLHF 的做法相同。

sents.zh: RLVR 是对人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）的改进，无需依赖人类反馈。

sents.zh: RLVR 根据一组提示从策略模型中采样生成回答，并使用确定性函数验证其正确性。

sents.zh: 如果正确，奖励值为正；否则为 0。

paragraphs.en: An influential approach of this type was proposed in the development of DeepSeek-R1 Guo et al. [2025] . This method distinguishes itself from external reasoning approaches by emphasizing the model’s self-generated reasoning steps. It learns the steps through reinforcement learning, integrating data generation and training in a single loop. Lowering the supervised data requirements to train LLMs, DeepSeek’s methodology leverages reinforcement learning to enable models to evolve reasoning skills autonomously. By starting with a base model and applying reinforcement learning, the system identifies and reinforces effective reasoning patterns. DeepSeek uses group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), which calculates advantages with group-based scoring [ Shao et al., 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: Guo 等人 [2025] 在开发 DeepSeek-R1 时提出了一种此类具有影响力的方法。 该方法通过强调模型自我生成的推理步骤，与外部推理方法区分开来。 它通过强化学习来学习这些步骤，将数据生成和训练整合到单个循环中。 DeepSeek 的方法降低了训练大型语言模型所需的监督数据量，它利用强化学习使模型能够自主发展推理能力。 系统从一个基础模型出发并应用强化学习，从而识别并强化有效的推理模式。 DeepSeek 使用了群体相对策略优化（GRPO），该方法基于群体评分来计算优势 [Shao 等人，2024]。

sents.en: An influential approach of this type was proposed in the development of DeepSeek-R1 Guo et al. [2025] .
sents.zh: Guo 等人 [2025] 在开发 DeepSeek-R1 时提出了一种此类具有影响力的方法。

sents.zh: 该方法通过强调模型自我生成的推理步骤，与外部推理方法区分开来。

sents.zh: 它通过强化学习来学习这些步骤，将数据生成和训练整合到单个循环中。

sents.en: Lowering the supervised data requirements to train LLMs, DeepSeek’s methodology leverages reinforcement learning to enable models to evolve reasoning skills autonomously.
sents.zh: DeepSeek 的方法降低了训练大型语言模型所需的监督数据量，它利用强化学习使模型能够自主发展推理能力。

sents.en: By starting with a base model and applying reinforcement learning, the system identifies and reinforces effective reasoning patterns.
sents.zh: 系统从一个基础模型出发并应用强化学习，从而识别并强化有效的推理模式。

sents.en: DeepSeek uses group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), which calculates advantages with group-based scoring [ Shao et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: DeepSeek 使用了群体相对策略优化（GRPO），该方法基于群体评分来计算优势 [Shao 等人，2024]。

paragraphs.en: One of the key features of DeepSeek’s approach is the emergence of sophisticated reasoning behaviors during finetuning, such as reflection and exploration of alternative problem-solving methods [ Mercer et al., 2025 ] . These behaviors arise spontaneously as a result of the model’s interaction with the reinforcement learning environment, rather than being pre-programmed, and without external self-reflection loops. For example, DeepSeek-R1-Zero learns to allocate more thinking time to problems by reevaluating its initial approach. This autonomous approach of learning to reason may lead to more stable and adaptive reasoning LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: DeepSeek 方法的关键特征之一，是在微调过程中出现了复杂的推理行为，例如反思以及对替代问题解决方法进行探索 [ Mercer et al., 2025 ]。 这些行为是模型与强化学习环境相互作用的结果而自发产生的，而非预先编程设定，且无需外部自我反思循环。 例如，DeepSeek-R1-Zero 通过重新评估其初始方法，学会了为问题分配更多的思考时间。 这种自主学习推理的方法，或许能带来更稳定、更具适应性的推理大语言模型。

sents.en: One of the key features of DeepSeek’s approach is the emergence of sophisticated reasoning behaviors during finetuning, such as reflection and exploration of alternative problem-solving methods [ Mercer et al., 2025 ] .
sents.zh: DeepSeek 方法的关键特征之一，是在微调过程中出现了复杂的推理行为，例如反思以及对替代问题解决方法进行探索 [ Mercer et al., 2025 ]。

sents.zh: 例如，DeepSeek-R1-Zero 通过重新评估其初始方法，学会了为问题分配更多的思考时间。

sents.en: This autonomous approach of learning to reason may lead to more stable and adaptive reasoning LLMs.
sents.zh: 这种自主学习推理的方法，或许能带来更稳定、更具适应性的推理大语言模型。

paragraphs.en: One of the successes behind GRPO is its focus on applications for which verifiable rewards exist, allowing reinforcement learning methods to be used. The focus on verifiable rewards has been quite successful, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) methods are often used in finetuning LLMs [ Lambert et al., 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: GRPO 取得成功的原因之一，在于它专注于存在可验证奖励的应用场景，从而使得强化学习方法得以应用。 对可验证奖励的聚焦取得了相当不错的成果，使用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）方法常被用于微调大型语言模型 [ Lambert et al., 2024 ] 。

sents.en: One of the successes behind GRPO is its focus on applications for which verifiable rewards exist, allowing reinforcement learning methods to be used.
sents.zh: GRPO 取得成功的原因之一，在于它专注于存在可验证奖励的应用场景，从而使得强化学习方法得以应用。

sents.en: The focus on verifiable rewards has been quite successful, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) methods are often used in finetuning LLMs [ Lambert et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 对可验证奖励的聚焦取得了相当不错的成果，使用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）方法常被用于微调大型语言模型 [ Lambert et al., 2024 ] 。

paragraphs.en: RLVR methods such as GRPO are typically used dynamically, where an inference time chain of thought query is used to answer a query from the training set to finetune the model. Thus, test time inference is used for finetuning. The impressive results of DeepSeek [ Guo et al., 2025 ] have made GRPO [ Shao et al., 2024 ] and RLVR [ Lambert et al., 2024 , Guo et al., 2025 , Wen et al., 2025b , Yue et al., 2025 ] highly popular finetuning methods.
paragraphs.zh: 像 GRPO 这样的 RLVR 方法通常被动态使用，其中在推理时会通过链式思考查询来回答训练集中的问题，从而对模型进行微调。 因此，测试时的推理被用于微调。 DeepSeek [ Guo et al., 2025 ] 令人印象深刻的成果使 GRPO [ Shao et al., 2024 ] 和 RLVR [ Lambert et al., 2024 , Guo et al., 2025 , Wen et al., 2025b , Yue et al., 2025 ] 成为广受欢迎的微调方法。

sents.en: RLVR methods such as GRPO are typically used dynamically, where an inference time chain of thought query is used to answer a query from the training set to finetune the model.
sents.zh: 像 GRPO 这样的 RLVR 方法通常被动态使用，其中在推理时会通过链式思考查询来回答训练集中的问题，从而对模型进行微调。

sents.en: Thus, test time inference is used for finetuning.
sents.zh: 因此，测试时的推理被用于微调。

sents.en: The impressive results of DeepSeek [ Guo et al., 2025 ] have made GRPO [ Shao et al., 2024 ] and RLVR [ Lambert et al., 2024 , Guo et al., 2025 , Wen et al., 2025b , Yue et al., 2025 ] highly popular finetuning methods.
sents.zh: DeepSeek [ Guo et al., 2025 ] 令人印象深刻的成果使 GRPO [ Shao et al., 2024 ] 和 RLVR [ Lambert et al., 2024 , Guo et al., 2025 , Wen et al., 2025b , Yue et al., 2025 ] 成为广受欢迎的微调方法。

paragraphs.en: In the preceding pages we have seen how the reasoning capabilities of language models can be improved. The best-known approach is chain of thought, which is a prompt-engineering method that shows an LLM to provide a multi-step reasoning when it is answering a question, just like we are taught in school when we are shown how to solve math exercises. More elaborate prompt improvement algorithms have been introduced, from depth-first search, via self-reflection, to inference-time reinforcement learning methods. Advanced training methods such as RLVR combine inference-results with finetuning, achieving strong training results.
paragraphs.zh: 在之前的页面中，我们已经了解了如何提升语言模型的推理能力。 最知名的方法是“思维链”，这是一种提示工程方法，它引导大型语言模型在回答问题时提供多步骤的推理过程，就像我们在学校学习解决数学题时接受的教学一样。 人们已经引入了更复杂的提示改进算法，从深度优先搜索、自我反思，到推理时的强化学习方法。 像 RLVR 这样的高级训练方法将推理结果与微调相结合，从而实现了出色的训练效果。

sents.en: In the preceding pages we have seen how the reasoning capabilities of language models can be improved.
sents.zh: 在之前的页面中，我们已经了解了如何提升语言模型的推理能力。

sents.en: The best-known approach is chain of thought, which is a prompt-engineering method that shows an LLM to provide a multi-step reasoning when it is answering a question, just like we are taught in school when we are shown how to solve math exercises.
sents.zh: 最知名的方法是“思维链”，这是一种提示工程方法，它引导大型语言模型在回答问题时提供多步骤的推理过程，就像我们在学校学习解决数学题时接受的教学一样。

sents.en: More elaborate prompt improvement algorithms have been introduced, from depth-first search, via self-reflection, to inference-time reinforcement learning methods.
sents.zh: 人们已经引入了更复杂的提示改进算法，从深度优先搜索、自我反思，到推理时的强化学习方法。

sents.en: Advanced training methods such as RLVR combine inference-results with finetuning, achieving strong training results.
sents.zh: 像 RLVR 这样的高级训练方法将推理结果与微调相结合，从而实现了出色的训练效果。

paragraphs.en: We have discussed many different algorithmic approaches to create an agentic harness. There are multiple reasons why there are so many. First, the field of agentic LLM is still young, many challenges exist, leading to many new solutions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们已经探讨了多种不同的算法方法，以构建一个智能体框架。 之所以有如此多的方法，原因有很多。 首先，智能体大语言模型这一领域仍处于早期阶段，存在许多挑战，从而催生了众多新的解决方案。

sents.en: We have discussed many different algorithmic approaches to create an agentic harness.
sents.zh: 我们已经探讨了多种不同的算法方法，以构建一个智能体框架。

sents.en: There are multiple reasons why there are so many.
sents.zh: 之所以有如此多的方法，原因有很多。

sents.en: First, the field of agentic LLM is still young, many challenges exist, leading to many new solutions.
sents.zh: 首先，智能体大语言模型这一领域仍处于早期阶段，存在许多挑战，从而催生了众多新的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: Second, the methods are quite brittle. Small changes in prompts, a comma here or there, sometimes make the difference whether an approach works or not. Small changes in hyperparameters, such as the temperature of your model, or even using a different seed of a random number generator, may have large effects. Changes to the memory management method of the agentic harness, or using a different LLM, may all have a large effect on performance.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，这些方法相当脆弱。 提示词中的微小变化，比如这里或那里多一个逗号，有时就会决定某种方法是否有效。 超参数中的微小变化，例如模型的温度设置，甚至使用随机数生成器的不同种子，都可能会产生巨大影响。 智能体框架的记忆管理方法的改变，或者使用不同的 LLM，都可能对性能产生重大影响。

sents.en: Second, the methods are quite brittle.
sents.zh: 其次，这些方法相当脆弱。

sents.en: Small changes in prompts, a comma here or there, sometimes make the difference whether an approach works or not.
sents.zh: 提示词中的微小变化，比如这里或那里多一个逗号，有时就会决定某种方法是否有效。

sents.zh: 超参数中的微小变化，例如模型的温度设置，甚至使用随机数生成器的不同种子，都可能会产生巨大影响。

sents.en: Changes to the memory management method of the agentic harness, or using a different LLM, may all have a large effect on performance.
sents.zh: 智能体框架的记忆管理方法的改变，或者使用不同的 LLM，都可能对性能产生重大影响。

paragraphs.en: This may feel like a unsatisfactory state of affairs. Indeed, the field is young, and it will take some years before methods have stabilized. In your experiments, you should keep in mind to always do multiple runs, with different seeds, different models, and different hyperparameter settings. This will help you better understand how your solution works in different circumstances.
paragraphs.zh: 这或许会让人觉得是一种不尽如人意的状态。 事实上，这个领域尚处于起步阶段，需要若干年时间，相关方法才会趋于稳定。 在你的实验中，应当始终牢记进行多次运行，并使用不同的种子、不同的模型以及不同的超参数设置。 这将有助于你更好地理解你的解决方案在不同情况下是如何运作的。

sents.en: This may feel like a unsatisfactory state of affairs.
sents.zh: 这或许会让人觉得是一种不尽如人意的状态。

sents.en: Indeed, the field is young, and it will take some years before methods have stabilized.
sents.zh: 事实上，这个领域尚处于起步阶段，需要若干年时间，相关方法才会趋于稳定。

paragraphs.en: To conclude this chapter we will discuss reasoning in LLMs in a broader perspective. In the history of AI, two approaches, or schools of thought, can be seen: symbolic AI and connectionist AI. Symbolic AI roughly corresponds to the idea that intelligence is best modeled as the manipulation of symbols via the rules of logic. Connectionist AI studies whether intelligence emerges spontaneously out of interactions between connected elements (be they neurons, cells, ants, humans, or robots). Symbolic AI draws on mathematics, connectionist AI on biology. As we already saw in Section 2.3 , both schools have developed useful methods, and both schools have seen important successes (such as search algorithms and reasoning, or deep learning and LLMs).
paragraphs.zh: 为总结本章，我们将从更广泛的视角探讨大型语言模型中的推理问题。 在人工智能的历史中，可以看到两种方法或思想流派：符号主义人工智能和连接主义人工智能。 符号主义人工智能大致对应于这样一种观点：智能最好被建模为通过逻辑规则对符号进行操作的过程。 连接主义人工智能研究的是，智能是否能够从相互连接的元素（无论是神经元、细胞、蚂蚁、人类还是机器人）之间的相互作用中自发涌现。 符号主义人工智能借鉴了数学，而连接主义人工智能则借鉴了生物学。 正如我们在第 2.3 节中已经看到的，这两种流派都发展出了有用的方法，也都取得了重要的成功（例如搜索算法与推理，或深度学习与大型语言模型）。

sents.en: To conclude this chapter we will discuss reasoning in LLMs in a broader perspective.
sents.zh: 为总结本章，我们将从更广泛的视角探讨大型语言模型中的推理问题。

paragraphs.en: In 2011 Daniel Kahneman published the book Thinking, Fast and Slow in which the terms System 1 and System 2 were used to distinguish human thought into intuitive, fast, thinking, and deliberative, slow, thinking [ Kahneman, 2011 ] . These terms have become popular in artificial intelligence, where fast thinking is linked to associative lookup and slow thinking to multi-step reasoning. At inference time, zero-shot LLMs think fast (System 1 thinking). Inference-time step-by-step methods (either through longer prompts or with an agentic harness) perform deliberative slow thinking (System 2 thinking).
paragraphs.zh: 2011年，丹尼尔·卡尼曼出版了《思考，快与慢》一书，书中使用“系统1”和“系统2”这两个术语来区分人类的直觉性快速思维与审慎性缓慢思维 [ Kahneman, 2011 ]。 这些术语在人工智能领域已广为人知，其中快速思维与联想式查找相关，而缓慢思维则与多步骤推理相关。 在推理阶段，零样本大语言模型会进行快速思维（系统1思维）。 推理阶段的逐步方法（无论是通过更长的提示，还是借助智能体框架）都会执行审慎的缓慢思维（系统2思维）。

sents.en: In 2011 Daniel Kahneman published the book Thinking, Fast and Slow in which the terms System 1 and System 2 were used to distinguish human thought into intuitive, fast, thinking, and deliberative, slow, thinking [ Kahneman, 2011 ] .

sents.zh: 在推理阶段，零样本大语言模型会进行快速思维（系统1思维）。

sents.zh: 推理阶段的逐步方法（无论是通过更长的提示，还是借助智能体框架）都会执行审慎的缓慢思维（系统2思维）。

paragraphs.en: LLMs are based on the connectionist AI tradition (System 1). The use of tools at inference time enhances the LLM part with knowledge retrieval or processing tools from the symbolic AI tradition (System 2).
paragraphs.zh: LLM 基于联结主义人工智能传统（系统 1）。 在推理阶段使用工具，可以通过知识检索或处理来自符号主义人工智能传统（系统 2）的工具来增强 LLM 部分。

sents.en: LLMs are based on the connectionist AI tradition (System 1).
sents.zh: LLM 基于联结主义人工智能传统（系统 1）。

sents.en: The use of tools at inference time enhances the LLM part with knowledge retrieval or processing tools from the symbolic AI tradition (System 2).
sents.zh: 在推理阶段使用工具，可以通过知识检索或处理来自符号主义人工智能传统（系统 2）的工具来增强 LLM 部分。

paragraphs.en: We should note that whereas researchers sometimes humanize LLMs and their capabilities, LLMs only perform next-token prediction. LLMs are not even close to being human. By generating more tokens to form an answer (reasoning step-by-step), the token-path from the prompt to the final answer becomes longer. The reason that this leads more often to correct answers, might be because it takes smaller steps into the direction of the answer, making the correct answer more plausible with every step in between—not that it is similar to the way humans are taught to solve the problem. Reasoning is narrowing down probabilities such that the correct answer becomes more probable to generate, independent of interpretations related to human cognition [ Guo et al., 2025 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们应当注意到，尽管研究人员有时会将大型语言模型（LLM）及其能力拟人化，但LLM实际上仅执行下一个词元的预测。 大型语言模型（LLM）甚至远未达到人类的水平。 通过生成更多词元来形成答案（逐步推理），从提示到最终答案的词元路径会变得更长。 这种做法之所以更常得出正确答案，可能是因为它以较小的步骤朝着答案的方向推进，使得每一步都让正确答案显得更合理——但这并不等同于人类被教导解决问题的方式。 推理过程通过逐步缩小概率范围，使正确答案生成的可能性更高，这与与人类认知相关的解释无关 [ Guo et al., 2025 ]。

sents.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）甚至远未达到人类的水平。

sents.zh: 推理过程通过逐步缩小概率范围，使正确答案生成的可能性更高，这与与人类认知相关的解释无关 [ Guo et al., 2025 ]。

paragraphs.en: In this chapter we have discussed how LLMs can solve language tasks by next-token prediction, and solve tasks that require multi-step reasoning. We have discussed ways to manage complex reasoning structures.
paragraphs.zh: 在本章中，我们探讨了大型语言模型如何通过预测下一个词元来解决语言任务，以及如何解决需要多步推理的任务。 我们讨论了管理复杂推理结构的方法。

sents.en: In this chapter we have discussed how LLMs can solve language tasks by next-token prediction, and solve tasks that require multi-step reasoning.
sents.zh: 在本章中，我们探讨了大型语言模型如何通过预测下一个词元来解决语言任务，以及如何解决需要多步推理的任务。

sents.en: We have discussed ways to manage complex reasoning structures.
sents.zh: 我们讨论了管理复杂推理结构的方法。

paragraphs.en: Most methods are in-context methods, efficient and easy to use since the prompts that guide the reasoning are readable by the user. We have introduced the rule of an agentic harness for prompt improvement and memory management. We have also touched upon methods that use pretraining and finetuning, not just for the language part, but also for integrating multi-step reasoning. These methods thus train models for decision making, beyond pure next-token prediction in language models.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数方法都是上下文内方法，由于引导推理的提示对用户来说可读性强，因此这些方法既高效又易于使用。 我们引入了一种智能体框架规则，用于提示改进和记忆管理。 我们还简要介绍了使用预训练和微调的方法，这些方法不仅适用于语言部分，也适用于整合多步推理。 因此，这些方法训练模型进行决策，超越了语言模型中纯粹的下一个词预测。

sents.en: Most methods are in-context methods, efficient and easy to use since the prompts that guide the reasoning are readable by the user.
sents.zh: 大多数方法都是上下文内方法，由于引导推理的提示对用户来说可读性强，因此这些方法既高效又易于使用。

sents.en: We have introduced the rule of an agentic harness for prompt improvement and memory management.
sents.zh: 我们引入了一种智能体框架规则，用于提示改进和记忆管理。

sents.en: We have also touched upon methods that use pretraining and finetuning, not just for the language part, but also for integrating multi-step reasoning.
sents.zh: 我们还简要介绍了使用预训练和微调的方法，这些方法不仅适用于语言部分，也适用于整合多步推理。

sents.en: These methods thus train models for decision making, beyond pure next-token prediction in language models.
sents.zh: 因此，这些方法训练模型进行决策，超越了语言模型中纯粹的下一个词预测。

paragraphs.en: There has been much activity in the creation of such richer models, adding visual reasoning, decision making, and actions to become an integral part of the LLMs. In the next chapter we will look deeper into these pretrained and finetuned multi-modal models.
paragraphs.zh: 在构建这类更丰富的模型方面，已有大量研究活动，通过增加视觉推理、决策和行动能力，使其成为大型语言模型（LLM）的有机组成部分。 在下一章中，我们将更深入地探讨这些经过预训练和微调的多模态模型。

sents.en: There has been much activity in the creation of such richer models, adding visual reasoning, decision making, and actions to become an integral part of the LLMs.
sents.zh: 在构建这类更丰富的模型方面，已有大量研究活动，通过增加视觉推理、决策和行动能力，使其成为大型语言模型（LLM）的有机组成部分。

sents.en: In the next chapter we will look deeper into these pretrained and finetuned multi-modal models.
sents.zh: 在下一章中，我们将更深入地探讨这些经过预训练和微调的多模态模型。

paragraphs.en: Many decisions involve vision. As we will see in this section, the transformer architecture is also able to learn tokenized visual patterns. Models that are pretrained on both language and visual data are called vision-language models, or VLMs. VLMs typically consist of (1) a language part, (2) a vision part, and (3) a part that combines both embeddings.
paragraphs.zh: 许多决策都涉及视觉信息。 正如我们将在本节中看到的，Transformer 架构也能够学习经过分词的视觉模式。 在语言和视觉数据上都经过预训练的模型被称为视觉-语言模型，或 VLMs。 VLMs 通常包括（1）一个语言部分、（2）一个视觉部分，以及（3）一个结合两者嵌入的部分。

sents.en: Many decisions involve vision.
sents.zh: 许多决策都涉及视觉信息。

sents.en: As we will see in this section, the transformer architecture is also able to learn tokenized visual patterns.
sents.zh: 正如我们将在本节中看到的，Transformer 架构也能够学习经过分词的视觉模式。

sents.en: Models that are pretrained on both language and visual data are called vision-language models, or VLMs.
sents.zh: 在语言和视觉数据上都经过预训练的模型被称为视觉-语言模型，或 VLMs。

sents.en: VLMs typically consist of (1) a language part, (2) a vision part, and (3) a part that combines both embeddings.
sents.zh: VLMs 通常包括（1）一个语言部分、（2）一个视觉部分，以及（3）一个结合两者嵌入的部分。

paragraphs.en: We will discuss various architectures of these vision-language models. For each type of model we will describe the task, the architecture of the model, and the algorithm with which it is trained. We will see impressive results.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将讨论这些视觉语言模型的各种架构。 对于每种类型的模型，我们将描述其任务、模型架构以及训练该模型所用的算法。 我们将看到令人印象深刻的结果。

sents.en: We will discuss various architectures of these vision-language models.
sents.zh: 我们将讨论这些视觉语言模型的各种架构。

sents.en: For each type of model we will describe the task, the architecture of the model, and the algorithm with which it is trained.
sents.zh: 对于每种类型的模型，我们将描述其任务、模型架构以及训练该模型所用的算法。

sents.en: We will see impressive results.
sents.zh: 我们将看到令人印象深刻的结果。

paragraphs.en: Computer vision has a long and successful history in AI. Deep learning has been successful in image recognition tasks, long before the breakthroughs in natural language processing [ Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ] . Can these two successful fields be combined? This is not a trivial question, since the two fields are based on deep learning architectures that re quite different: image processing is based on convolutional neural networks that work well on two-dimensional rectangular grids of pixels, and language processing on transformers that work well on one-dimensional sequences of tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 计算机视觉在人工智能领域拥有悠久而成功的历史。 深度学习在图像识别任务中取得了成功，这比自然语言处理领域的突破要早得多 [ Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ]。 这两个成功的领域能否被结合起来呢？ 这并不是一个简单的问题，因为这两个领域所基于的深度学习架构截然不同：图像处理基于卷积神经网络，它在二维矩形像素网格上表现良好；而语言处理则基于 Transformer，它在由词元组成的一维序列上表现良好。

sents.en: Computer vision has a long and successful history in AI.
sents.zh: 计算机视觉在人工智能领域拥有悠久而成功的历史。

sents.en: Deep learning has been successful in image recognition tasks, long before the breakthroughs in natural language processing [ Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ] .
sents.zh: 深度学习在图像识别任务中取得了成功，这比自然语言处理领域的突破要早得多 [ Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ]。

sents.en: Can these two successful fields be combined?
sents.zh: 这两个成功的领域能否被结合起来呢？

sents.en: This is not a trivial question, since the two fields are based on deep learning architectures that re quite different: image processing is based on convolutional neural networks that work well on two-dimensional rectangular grids of pixels, and language processing on transformers that work well on one-dimensional sequences of tokens.
sents.zh: 这并不是一个简单的问题，因为这两个领域所基于的深度学习架构截然不同：图像处理基于卷积神经网络，它在二维矩形像素网格上表现良好；而语言处理则基于 Transformer，它在由词元组成的一维序列上表现良好。

paragraphs.en: As we will see, architectures have indeed been developed for combining the two fields, to the extent that most frontier models are now VLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 正如我们将要看到的，人们确实已经开发出结合这两个领域的架构，以至于如今大多数前沿模型都是VLM。

paragraphs.en: Let us first discuss the types of tasks that vision-language models must solve, and list some of the popular benchmark suites. For understanding, the models can be tested on visual question answering tasks (VQA), to see if the models have acquired some textual understanding of visual images. A related, but generative, task is that of captioning problems, where models have to generate a textual descriptions of images. Additionally, models may be tasked to do image generation.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我们来讨论视觉语言模型必须解决的任务类型，并列出一些常用的基准测试套件。 为了评估理解能力，可以在视觉问答任务（VQA）上测试这些模型，以判断它们是否已经对视觉图像获得了一定的文本理解能力。 一个相关但属于生成类的任务是图像描述问题，即模型需要生成对图像的文本描述。 此外，模型还可能被赋予图像生成的任务。

sents.en: Let us first discuss the types of tasks that vision-language models must solve, and list some of the popular benchmark suites.
sents.zh: 首先，我们来讨论视觉语言模型必须解决的任务类型，并列出一些常用的基准测试套件。

sents.en: For understanding, the models can be tested on visual question answering tasks (VQA), to see if the models have acquired some textual understanding of visual images.
sents.zh: 为了评估理解能力，可以在视觉问答任务（VQA）上测试这些模型，以判断它们是否已经对视觉图像获得了一定的文本理解能力。

sents.en: A related, but generative, task is that of captioning problems, where models have to generate a textual descriptions of images.
sents.zh: 一个相关但属于生成类的任务是图像描述问题，即模型需要生成对图像的文本描述。

sents.en: Additionally, models may be tasked to do image generation.
sents.zh: 此外，模型还可能被赋予图像生成的任务。

paragraphs.en: Let us have a look at some example tasks. For Figure 7.1 , a VQA question could be: What is the mustache made of? and the system should answer: Bananas . Other typical VQA questions are to count the number of certain shapes of a certain color in a certain part of an image (to answer questions such as: Is there a red block in the upper corner of the table in this scene? ). The tasks can be quite diverse, and there is a range of popular benchmarks such as MOSAIC [ Burda-Lassen et al., 2025 ] , GLOBAL-RG [ Bhatia et al., 2024 ] , CultureVQA [ Nayak et al., 2024 ] , FoodieQA [ Li et al., 2024 ] , and MaRVL [ Liu et al., 2021 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 让我们来看一些示例任务。 对于图 7.1，一个 VQA 问题可能是：这个八字胡是由什么制成的？系统应回答：香蕉。 其他典型的 VQA 问题包括统计图像中特定区域某种颜色形状的数量（例如回答这样的问题：在这个场景中，桌子右上角是否有红色方块？）。 这些任务可能相当多样化，并且存在一系列流行的基准测试，例如 MOSAIC [ Burda-Lassen et al., 2025 ]、GLOBAL-RG [ Bhatia et al., 2024 ]、CultureVQA [ Nayak et al., 2024 ]、FoodieQA [ Li et al., 2024 ] 和 MaRVL [ Liu et al., 2021 ]。

sents.en: Let us have a look at some example tasks.
sents.zh: 让我们来看一些示例任务。

sents.en: For Figure 7.1 , a VQA question could be: What is the mustache made of? and the system should answer: Bananas .
sents.zh: 对于图 7.1，一个 VQA 问题可能是：这个八字胡是由什么制成的？系统应回答：香蕉。

sents.en: Other typical VQA questions are to count the number of certain shapes of a certain color in a certain part of an image (to answer questions such as: Is there a red block in the upper corner of the table in this scene? ).
sents.zh: 其他典型的 VQA 问题包括统计图像中特定区域某种颜色形状的数量（例如回答这样的问题：在这个场景中，桌子右上角是否有红色方块？）。

sents.en: The tasks can be quite diverse, and there is a range of popular benchmarks such as MOSAIC [ Burda-Lassen et al., 2025 ] , GLOBAL-RG [ Bhatia et al., 2024 ] , CultureVQA [ Nayak et al., 2024 ] , FoodieQA [ Li et al., 2024 ] , and MaRVL [ Liu et al., 2021 ] .
sents.zh: 这些任务可能相当多样化，并且存在一系列流行的基准测试，例如 MOSAIC [ Burda-Lassen et al., 2025 ]、GLOBAL-RG [ Bhatia et al., 2024 ]、CultureVQA [ Nayak et al., 2024 ]、FoodieQA [ Li et al., 2024 ] 和 MaRVL [ Liu et al., 2021 ]。

paragraphs.en: In captioning problems, a model could be prompted to provide a caption for the scene in Figure 7.2 , which shows a happy dog standing in the ocean . Note that variations may be equally valid, such as a wet dog , a cold dog , or a dog with a red collar standing in the ocean . Popular benchmarks are MS-COCO [ Lin et al., 2014 ] , nocaps, 1 1 1 https://nocaps.org and, for video, MSR-VTT [ Xu et al., 2016 ] , and VATEX for traditional, short-caption evaluation [ Wang et al., 2019 ] . Newer benchmarks have been developed that focus on detailed, multi-faceted descriptions: DetailCaps [ Dong et al., 2024 ] , VDC [ Chai et al., 2024 ] , and CapArena [ Cheng et al., 2025 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在图像描述任务中，模型可以被提示为图 7.2 中的场景提供描述，该图展示了一只站在海洋中的快乐小狗。 请注意，其他变体同样可能有效，例如一只湿漉漉的小狗、一只冷得发抖的小狗，或者一只戴着红色项圈站在海洋中的小狗。 常用的基准数据集包括 MS-COCO [ Lin et al., 2014 ]、nocaps, 1 1 1 https://nocaps.org，以及用于视频任务的 MSR-VTT [ Xu et al., 2016 ]，还有用于传统短描述评估的 VATEX [ Wang et al., 2019 ]。 近期也开发了一些新的基准数据集，专注于更详细和多维度的描述：DetailCaps [ Dong et al., 2024 ]、VDC [ Chai et al., 2024 ] 和 CapArena [ Cheng et al., 2025 ]。

paragraphs.en: Typical applications of VLMs are summarization, image generation, search and retrieval, image segmentation, and object detection. The Massive Multi-discipline Multi-modal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark (MMMU) for Expert AGI is a comprehensive benchmark for vision-language models [ Yue et al., 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: VLM 的典型应用包括摘要生成、图像生成、搜索与检索、图像分割和物体检测。 面向专家级通用人工智能的大规模多学科多模态理解与推理基准（MMMU）是一项针对视觉语言模型的综合性基准测试 [ Yue et al., 2024 ] 。

sents.en: Typical applications of VLMs are summarization, image generation, search and retrieval, image segmentation, and object detection.
sents.zh: VLM 的典型应用包括摘要生成、图像生成、搜索与检索、图像分割和物体检测。

sents.en: The Massive Multi-discipline Multi-modal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark (MMMU) for Expert AGI is a comprehensive benchmark for vision-language models [ Yue et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 面向专家级通用人工智能的大规模多学科多模态理解与推理基准（MMMU）是一项针对视觉语言模型的综合性基准测试 [ Yue et al., 2024 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Now that we have seen the types of tasks that VLMs are tested on, how could we design a model to perform these tasks?
paragraphs.zh: 既然我们已经了解了 VLM 所测试的任务类型，那么我们又该如何设计一个能够执行这些任务的模型呢？

paragraphs.en: Language, when modeled as a sequence of tokens, is a sequential (1 dimensional) problem domain. Vision, when modeled as a grid of pixels, is a rectangular (2 dimensional) problem domain. Correspondingly, the deep learning architectures for the two applications are different. For language, the transformer architecture is used, finding sequential patterns, and for imaging, the convolutional neural network is used, finding 2-dimensional patterns. It is therefore not obvious what architecture a multi-modal vision-language model should have. Indeed, it was unclear if a VLM would work at all.
paragraphs.zh: 当语言被建模为一系列词元时，它是一个序列性（一维）的问题领域。 当视觉被建模为像素网格时，它是一个矩形（二维）的问题领域。 相应地，这两种应用所采用的深度学习架构也各不相同。 对于语言，使用的是能够发现序列模式的 Transformer 架构；而对于图像，则使用能够发现二维模式的卷积神经网络。 因此，一个多模态视觉-语言模型应采用何种架构，这一点并不明显。 事实上，当时甚至不清楚视觉-语言模型是否真的可行。

sents.en: Language, when modeled as a sequence of tokens, is a sequential (1 dimensional) problem domain.
sents.zh: 当语言被建模为一系列词元时，它是一个序列性（一维）的问题领域。

sents.en: Vision, when modeled as a grid of pixels, is a rectangular (2 dimensional) problem domain.
sents.zh: 当视觉被建模为像素网格时，它是一个矩形（二维）的问题领域。

sents.en: Correspondingly, the deep learning architectures for the two applications are different.
sents.zh: 相应地，这两种应用所采用的深度学习架构也各不相同。

sents.en: For language, the transformer architecture is used, finding sequential patterns, and for imaging, the convolutional neural network is used, finding 2-dimensional patterns.
sents.zh: 对于语言，使用的是能够发现序列模式的 Transformer 架构；而对于图像，则使用能够发现二维模式的卷积神经网络。

sents.en: It is therefore not obvious what architecture a multi-modal vision-language model should have.
sents.zh: 因此，一个多模态视觉-语言模型应采用何种架构，这一点并不明显。

sents.en: Indeed, it was unclear if a VLM would work at all.
sents.zh: 事实上，当时甚至不清楚视觉-语言模型是否真的可行。

paragraphs.en: Research first focused on the question if the transformer architecture would also be able to work on image processing (in addition to the conventional convolutional neural networks, CNN). Special vision transformers and tokenization schemes were developed that worked well in image processing [ Dosovitskiy et al., 2020 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 最初的研究聚焦于这样一个问题：除了传统的卷积神经网络（CNN）之外，Transformer 架构是否也能用于图像处理。 研究人员开发出了专门的视觉 Transformer 和分词方案，这些方案在图像处理中表现良好 [Dosovitskiy et al., 2020]。

sents.en: Research first focused on the question if the transformer architecture would also be able to work on image processing (in addition to the conventional convolutional neural networks, CNN).
sents.zh: 最初的研究聚焦于这样一个问题：除了传统的卷积神经网络（CNN）之外，Transformer 架构是否也能用于图像处理。

sents.en: Special vision transformers and tokenization schemes were developed that worked well in image processing [ Dosovitskiy et al., 2020 ] .
sents.zh: 研究人员开发出了专门的视觉 Transformer 和分词方案，这些方案在图像处理中表现良好 [Dosovitskiy et al., 2020]。

paragraphs.en: Then, an architecture was needed to combine the language and image embeddings, and to generate language. In general, the architecture of a VLM consists of an image encoder (either a CNN or a specially tokenized vision-transformer) and a text encoder that are connected to an embedding projector to align image and text representations (often a dense neural network), connecting to, finally, a text decoder (a transformer). Figure 7.3 illustrates this architecture, using LLaVa as an example [ Liu et al., 2023 ] . The connection between the visual embedding and the textual embedding is made by a network that projects the visual embedding to another embedding, to allow unified reasoning by the model. The projector network is often a dense neural network (multi-layer perceptron, MLP).
paragraphs.zh: 接着，需要一种架构来结合语言和图像嵌入，并生成语言。 通常，VLM 的架构包括一个图像编码器（可以是 CNN 或经过特殊分词的视觉变换器）和一个文本编码器，它们通过一个嵌入投影器连接起来以对齐图像和文本表示（通常是密集神经网络），并最终连接到文本解码器（一种变换器）。 图 7.3 展示了这种架构，并以 LLaVa 为例 [ Liu et al., 2023 ]。 视觉嵌入与文本嵌入之间的连接是通过一个网络实现的，该网络将视觉嵌入投影到另一个嵌入上，以便模型能够进行统一推理。 投影器网络通常是一个密集神经网络（多层感知器，MLP）。

sents.en: Then, an architecture was needed to combine the language and image embeddings, and to generate language.
sents.zh: 接着，需要一种架构来结合语言和图像嵌入，并生成语言。

sents.en: In general, the architecture of a VLM consists of an image encoder (either a CNN or a specially tokenized vision-transformer) and a text encoder that are connected to an embedding projector to align image and text representations (often a dense neural network), connecting to, finally, a text decoder (a transformer).
sents.zh: 通常，VLM 的架构包括一个图像编码器（可以是 CNN 或经过特殊分词的视觉变换器）和一个文本编码器，它们通过一个嵌入投影器连接起来以对齐图像和文本表示（通常是密集神经网络），并最终连接到文本解码器（一种变换器）。

sents.en: Figure 7.3 illustrates this architecture, using LLaVa as an example [ Liu et al., 2023 ] .
sents.zh: 图 7.3 展示了这种架构，并以 LLaVa 为例 [ Liu et al., 2023 ]。

sents.en: The connection between the visual embedding and the textual embedding is made by a network that projects the visual embedding to another embedding, to allow unified reasoning by the model.
sents.zh: 视觉嵌入与文本嵌入之间的连接是通过一个网络实现的，该网络将视觉嵌入投影到另一个嵌入上，以便模型能够进行统一推理。

sents.en: The projector network is often a dense neural network (multi-layer perceptron, MLP).
sents.zh: 投影器网络通常是一个密集神经网络（多层感知器，MLP）。

paragraphs.en: More elaborate architectures have been developed, and the architecture of state of the art VLMs can become quite complex, consisting of multiple transformer modules. As an example, Figure 7.4 shows the generative Stable Diffusion architecture [ Esser et al., 2024 , Weng, 2021 , Yang et al., 2023 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 更复杂的架构已被开发出来，而当前最先进的 VLM 的架构可能相当复杂，由多个 Transformer 模块组成。 例如，图 7.4 展示了生成式 Stable Diffusion 的架构 [Esser et al., 2024, Weng, 2021, Yang et al., 2023]。

sents.en: More elaborate architectures have been developed, and the architecture of state of the art VLMs can become quite complex, consisting of multiple transformer modules.
sents.zh: 更复杂的架构已被开发出来，而当前最先进的 VLM 的架构可能相当复杂，由多个 Transformer 模块组成。

sents.en: As an example, Figure 7.4 shows the generative Stable Diffusion architecture [ Esser et al., 2024 , Weng, 2021 , Yang et al., 2023 ] .
sents.zh: 例如，图 7.4 展示了生成式 Stable Diffusion 的架构 [Esser et al., 2024, Weng, 2021, Yang et al., 2023]。

paragraphs.en: Now that we have seen the tasks and the architecture of VLMs, it is time to look at the type of learning algorithm that is used by the models. The different encoders and projectors allow the VLM to be trained. The training algorithms should align and fuse the knowledge from both the visual and the language encoders. The VLM can then correlate the image and text information so that the model can analyze the query and provide an answer based on the two modalities. The literature reports a variety of approaches for training the VLM.
paragraphs.zh: 既然我们已经了解了任务以及 VLM 的架构，现在就该看看模型所使用的学习算法类型了。 不同的编码器和投影器使得 VLM 能够被训练。 训练算法应当对齐并融合来自视觉编码器和语言编码器的知识。 这样，VLM 就能将图像和文本信息关联起来，使模型能够分析查询，并根据这两种模态提供答案。 文献中报道了多种训练 VLM 的方法。

sents.en: Now that we have seen the tasks and the architecture of VLMs, it is time to look at the type of learning algorithm that is used by the models.
sents.zh: 既然我们已经了解了任务以及 VLM 的架构，现在就该看看模型所使用的学习算法类型了。

sents.en: The different encoders and projectors allow the VLM to be trained.
sents.zh: 不同的编码器和投影器使得 VLM 能够被训练。

sents.en: The training algorithms should align and fuse the knowledge from both the visual and the language encoders.
sents.zh: 训练算法应当对齐并融合来自视觉编码器和语言编码器的知识。

sents.en: The VLM can then correlate the image and text information so that the model can analyze the query and provide an answer based on the two modalities.
sents.zh: 这样，VLM 就能将图像和文本信息关联起来，使模型能够分析查询，并根据这两种模态提供答案。

sents.en: The literature reports a variety of approaches for training the VLM.
sents.zh: 文献中报道了多种训练 VLM 的方法。

paragraphs.en: OpenAI’s CLIP [ Radford et al., 2021 ] , which stands for contrastive language-image pretraining , uses contrastive learning. Contrastive learning is a form of self-supervised learning, creating supervisory signals when there are no such labels in the dataset. The idea is to push dissimilar data points apart and pull similar data points together in an embedding space. Contrastive learning maximizes the similarity of representations for positive pairs (such as similar forms of the same image) and minimize the similarity for negative pairs (images of different objects).
paragraphs.zh: OpenAI 的 CLIP [ Radford et al., 2021 ]（即对比语言-图像预训练）采用对比学习。 对比学习是一种自监督学习形式，在数据集中没有相应标签时也能生成监督信号。 其核心思想是在嵌入空间中，将不相似的数据点推开，同时将相似的数据点拉近。 对比学习会最大化正样本对（例如同一图像的不同变体）表示之间的相似度，并最小化负样本对（不同物体的图像）表示之间的相似度。

sents.en: OpenAI’s CLIP [ Radford et al., 2021 ] , which stands for contrastive language-image pretraining , uses contrastive learning.
sents.zh: OpenAI 的 CLIP [ Radford et al., 2021 ]（即对比语言-图像预训练）采用对比学习。

sents.en: Contrastive learning is a form of self-supervised learning, creating supervisory signals when there are no such labels in the dataset.
sents.zh: 对比学习是一种自监督学习形式，在数据集中没有相应标签时也能生成监督信号。

sents.en: The idea is to push dissimilar data points apart and pull similar data points together in an embedding space.
sents.zh: 其核心思想是在嵌入空间中，将不相似的数据点推开，同时将相似的数据点拉近。

sents.en: Contrastive learning maximizes the similarity of representations for positive pairs (such as similar forms of the same image) and minimize the similarity for negative pairs (images of different objects).
sents.zh: 对比学习会最大化正样本对（例如同一图像的不同变体）表示之间的相似度，并最小化负样本对（不同物体的图像）表示之间的相似度。

paragraphs.en: Another approach is to use masking. Here the VLM learns to predict randomly obscured parts of an input text or image, just as it is used in language model training. The model learns to reconstruct the hidden pixels in an image given an (unmasked) caption. An example is FLAVA, or foundational language and vision alignment , which uses a vision transformer as image encoder and a transformer for its language encoder and multi-modal projector [ Singh et al., 2022 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 另一种方法是使用掩码技术。 在此方法中，VLM 会学习预测输入文本或图像中被随机遮蔽的部分，这与语言模型训练中的做法相同。 该模型会根据（未遮蔽的）描述，学习重建图像中隐藏的像素。 一个例子是 FLAVA（基础语言与视觉对齐），它使用视觉变换器作为图像编码器，并使用变换器作为语言编码器和多模态投影器 [ Singh et al., 2022 ]。

sents.en: Another approach is to use masking.
sents.zh: 另一种方法是使用掩码技术。

sents.en: Here the VLM learns to predict randomly obscured parts of an input text or image, just as it is used in language model training.
sents.zh: 在此方法中，VLM 会学习预测输入文本或图像中被随机遮蔽的部分，这与语言模型训练中的做法相同。

sents.en: The model learns to reconstruct the hidden pixels in an image given an (unmasked) caption.
sents.zh: 该模型会根据（未遮蔽的）描述，学习重建图像中隐藏的像素。

sents.en: An example is FLAVA, or foundational language and vision alignment , which uses a vision transformer as image encoder and a transformer for its language encoder and multi-modal projector [ Singh et al., 2022 ] .
sents.zh: 一个例子是 FLAVA（基础语言与视觉对齐），它使用视觉变换器作为图像编码器，并使用变换器作为语言编码器和多模态投影器 [ Singh et al., 2022 ]。

paragraphs.en: VLM’s are also used in a generative style, to generate an image based on a text prompt. Popular text-to-image models often use diffusion models [ Ho et al., 2022 , Yang et al., 2023 ] . Well-known examples are Google’s Imagen [ Baldridge et al., 2024 ] , Midjourney, OpenAI’s DALL-E [ Betker et al., 2023 ] and Stability AI’s stable diffusion [ Esser et al., 2024 ] . DALL-E 2 uses a diffusion model conditioned on CLIP image embeddings. Figure 7.5 shows DALL-E’s well-known surrealistic avocado armchairs.
paragraphs.zh: VLM 也以生成式方式使用，即根据文本提示生成图像。 流行的文本到图像模型通常使用扩散模型 [ Ho et al., 2022 , Yang et al., 2023 ] 。 著名的例子包括 Google 的 Imagen [ Baldridge et al., 2024 ]、Midjourney、OpenAI 的 DALL-E [ Betker et al., 2023 ] 以及 Stability AI 的 stable diffusion [ Esser et al., 2024 ] 。 DALL-E 2 使用基于 CLIP 图像嵌入的条件扩散模型。 图 7.5 展示了 DALL-E 著名的超现实主义牛油果扶手椅。

sents.en: VLM’s are also used in a generative style, to generate an image based on a text prompt.
sents.zh: VLM 也以生成式方式使用，即根据文本提示生成图像。

sents.en: Popular text-to-image models often use diffusion models [ Ho et al., 2022 , Yang et al., 2023 ] .
sents.zh: 流行的文本到图像模型通常使用扩散模型 [ Ho et al., 2022 , Yang et al., 2023 ] 。

sents.zh: 图 7.5 展示了 DALL-E 著名的超现实主义牛油果扶手椅。

paragraphs.en: Pretraining vision language models from scratch is expensive, and since a VLM consists of a language model and a vision model, we could try to see if it is possible to build a VLM out of one or two existing models, that have already been pretrained before. Both a pretrained LLM and a pretrained vision encoder can be used, to which a mapping network can be added that projects the visual embedding to the textual input space of the language model. An example is LLaVA, which stands for large language and vision assistant . LLaVa uses the Vicuna language decoder and the CLIP ViT visual encoder, and their outputs are merged into a shared dimensional space using a linear projector [ Liu et al., 2023 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 从头开始预训练视觉语言模型成本高昂，而且由于视觉语言模型由语言模型和视觉模型组成，我们可以尝试看看是否有可能利用一个或两个已经过预训练的现有模型来构建视觉语言模型。 既可以使用预训练的大型语言模型，也可以使用预训练的视觉编码器，并为其添加一个映射网络，该网络可将视觉嵌入投影到语言模型的文本输入空间中。 一个例子是 LLaVA，即大型语言与视觉助手。 LLaVa 使用了 Vicuna 语言解码器和 CLIP ViT 视觉编码器，并通过一个线性投影器将它们的输出合并到一个共享的维度空间中 [ Liu et al., 2023 ]。

paragraphs.en: Many vision language models have been developed. VLMs tend to perform well on benchmark tasks and they are often used for decision making in agents. VLMs have become so popular that many current open and commercial LLMs are VLMs: DeepSeek-VL2, Gemini 2.0 Flash, GPT-4o, Llama 3.2, NVLM, Qwen 2.5-VL.
paragraphs.zh: 许多视觉语言模型已经开发出来。 视觉语言模型在基准任务上通常表现良好，并且常被用于智能体的决策过程中。 视觉语言模型已变得极为流行，以至于许多当前的开放和商用大语言模型都是视觉语言模型：DeepSeek-VL2、Gemini 2.0 Flash、GPT-4o、Llama 3.2、NVLM、Qwen 2.5-VL。

paragraphs.en: Let us take a look at how well VLMs perform at captioning and image generation by looking at some of the examples that are reported in the literature.
paragraphs.zh: 让我们通过考察文献中报告的一些示例，来看看 VLM 在图像描述和图像生成方面的表现如何。

paragraphs.en: Vision language models have produced imaginative and inspiring results ranging from visual question answering, object detection, image captioning to text-to-image generation. An example of the test dataset that is used in Flava is shown in Figure 7.6 . The successor of DALL-E 2, DALL-E 3, focused on training on highly descriptive generated image captions, yielding even more impressive results [ Betker et al., 2023 ] . Some of the prompt following image generation capabilities of DALL-E 3 are shown in Figure 7.7 . Figure 7.8 shows examples from stable diffusion (based on the rectified-flow diffusion models).
paragraphs.zh: 视觉语言模型已产生富有想象力和启发性的成果，涵盖视觉问答、物体检测、图像描述生成到文本到图像生成等多个领域。 Flava 所用测试数据集的一个示例如图 7.6 所示。 DALL-E 2 的继任者 DALL-E 3 专注于在高度描述性的生成图像标题上进行训练，从而获得了更加令人印象深刻的结果 [ Betker et al., 2023 ]。 DALL-E 3 的部分提示词及图像生成能力如图 7.7 所示。 图 7.8 展示了稳定扩散（基于修正流扩散模型）的示例。

paragraphs.en: To act, agents must make decisions, and to make decisions, different options must be weighed. As we will see in this section, we can train transformers on episodes of states, actions and rewards { ( s , a , r ) } \{(s,a,r)\} (see also Section 20.1.2 ). These models are trained on sequences of language, vision, and robotic actions. Vision-language-action models, VLAs, (Figure 7.9 ) are trained to output robot API commands, which are a special type of language: the language of commands to steer robotic movement.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体要采取行动，就必须做出决策；而要做出决策，就必须对不同的选项进行权衡。 我们将在本节中看到，我们可以利用状态、动作和奖励的序列 { ( s , a , r ) } \{(s,a,r)\} 来训练变换器（另见第 20.1.2 节）。 这些模型是在语言、视觉和机器人动作的序列上进行训练的。 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA，见图 7.9）经过训练，能够输出机器人 API 命令，这是一种特殊的语言：用于引导机器人运动的命令语言。

sents.en: To act, agents must make decisions, and to make decisions, different options must be weighed.
sents.zh: 智能体要采取行动，就必须做出决策；而要做出决策，就必须对不同的选项进行权衡。

sents.en: As we will see in this section, we can train transformers on episodes of states, actions and rewards { ( s , a , r ) } \{(s,a,r)\} (see also Section 20.1.2 ).
sents.zh: 我们将在本节中看到，我们可以利用状态、动作和奖励的序列 { ( s , a , r ) } \{(s,a,r)\} 来训练变换器（另见第 20.1.2 节）。

sents.en: These models are trained on sequences of language, vision, and robotic actions.
sents.zh: 这些模型是在语言、视觉和机器人动作的序列上进行训练的。

sents.en: Vision-language-action models, VLAs, (Figure 7.9 ) are trained to output robot API commands, which are a special type of language: the language of commands to steer robotic movement.
sents.zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA，见图 7.9）经过训练，能够输出机器人 API 命令，这是一种特殊的语言：用于引导机器人运动的命令语言。

paragraphs.en: The task of a VLA is to understand a visual scene, and, when given a textual command, instruct a robot arm to perform an appropriate action, depending on what the model sees through the camera. These models have shown impressive results of robots generalizing to unseen situations, successfully performing tasks.
paragraphs.zh: VLA 的任务是理解视觉场景，并在接收到文本指令时，根据模型通过摄像头所看到的内容，指导机械臂执行适当的动作。 这些模型已展现出令人印象深刻的成果：机器人能够泛化到未见过的情况，并成功完成任务。

sents.en: The task of a VLA is to understand a visual scene, and, when given a textual command, instruct a robot arm to perform an appropriate action, depending on what the model sees through the camera.
sents.zh: VLA 的任务是理解视觉场景，并在接收到文本指令时，根据模型通过摄像头所看到的内容，指导机械臂执行适当的动作。

sents.en: These models have shown impressive results of robots generalizing to unseen situations, successfully performing tasks.
sents.zh: 这些模型已展现出令人印象深刻的成果：机器人能够泛化到未见过的情况，并成功完成任务。

paragraphs.en: The main task of VLAs is to perform instructions in the real world, and to do so in a general way, in a changing environment. When a robotic manipulation model has been trained to pick up a set of red pencils, and the task changes to pick up blue pencils, then it would be nice if the model generalizes, and we do not have to assemble a new training set involving blue pencils and re-train the model again from scratch. We also want our model to recognize objects, and recognize when an object is oriented differently, has moved, or the lighting changes. The model should know how to use a robot arm to manipulate objects, and how to perform different actions. See Figure 7.10 for an example, taken from the CLIPort paper [ Shridhar et al., 2022 ] .
paragraphs.zh: VLA 的主要任务是在现实世界中执行指令，并且要以一种通用的方式在变化的环境中完成这些任务。 当一个机器人操作模型已经训练好可以拿起一组红色铅笔，而任务变为拿起蓝色铅笔时，如果该模型能够泛化，我们就不必重新构建一个包含蓝色铅笔的新训练集，也不必从头开始重新训练模型，这会非常理想。 我们还希望我们的模型能够识别物体，并能识别出物体方向不同、位置移动或光照发生变化的情况。 该模型应知道如何使用机械臂来操作物体，以及如何执行不同的动作。 参见图 7.10 中的示例，该示例摘自 CLIPort 论文 [ Shridhar et al., 2022 ]。

sents.en: The main task of VLAs is to perform instructions in the real world, and to do so in a general way, in a changing environment.
sents.zh: VLA 的主要任务是在现实世界中执行指令，并且要以一种通用的方式在变化的环境中完成这些任务。

sents.en: When a robotic manipulation model has been trained to pick up a set of red pencils, and the task changes to pick up blue pencils, then it would be nice if the model generalizes, and we do not have to assemble a new training set involving blue pencils and re-train the model again from scratch.
sents.zh: 当一个机器人操作模型已经训练好可以拿起一组红色铅笔，而任务变为拿起蓝色铅笔时，如果该模型能够泛化，我们就不必重新构建一个包含蓝色铅笔的新训练集，也不必从头开始重新训练模型，这会非常理想。

sents.en: We also want our model to recognize objects, and recognize when an object is oriented differently, has moved, or the lighting changes.
sents.zh: 我们还希望我们的模型能够识别物体，并能识别出物体方向不同、位置移动或光照发生变化的情况。

sents.en: The model should know how to use a robot arm to manipulate objects, and how to perform different actions.
sents.zh: 该模型应知道如何使用机械臂来操作物体，以及如何执行不同的动作。

sents.en: See Figure 7.10 for an example, taken from the CLIPort paper [ Shridhar et al., 2022 ] .
sents.zh: 参见图 7.10 中的示例，该示例摘自 CLIPort 论文 [ Shridhar et al., 2022 ]。

paragraphs.en: The hardest task for VLAs is to combine these scenes, objects and actions to manipulations that are complicated combinations of what the model has seen during training, and to generalize to unseen combinations. Especially long-horizon navigation through complex, changing, environments (perhaps even outdoors) is a complex challenge [ Shridhar et al., 2022 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 对于视觉语言模型而言，最困难的任务是将这些场景、物体和动作组合成复杂的操作——这些操作是模型在训练期间所见内容的复杂组合，并能够泛化到从未见过的组合。 尤其是在复杂且不断变化的环境中（甚至可能是在户外）进行长期导航，是一项极具挑战性的任务 [ Shridhar et al., 2022 ]。

sents.en: The hardest task for VLAs is to combine these scenes, objects and actions to manipulations that are complicated combinations of what the model has seen during training, and to generalize to unseen combinations.
sents.zh: 对于视觉语言模型而言，最困难的任务是将这些场景、物体和动作组合成复杂的操作——这些操作是模型在训练期间所见内容的复杂组合，并能够泛化到从未见过的组合。

sents.en: Especially long-horizon navigation through complex, changing, environments (perhaps even outdoors) is a complex challenge [ Shridhar et al., 2022 ] .
sents.zh: 尤其是在复杂且不断变化的环境中（甚至可能是在户外）进行长期导航，是一项极具挑战性的任务 [ Shridhar et al., 2022 ]。

paragraphs.en: In realistic human-robot interaction settings, collecting additional demonstrations is often infeasible. To perform high-level tasks, such as in Figure 7.11 , the VLA must be able to recognize objects, their poses, and segmentations of instances. The model must also be able to understand language, and relate the meaning of language to the meaning of visual objects and to the meaning of robotic actions.
paragraphs.zh: 在真实的人机交互场景中，收集额外的演示通常并不可行。 为了执行高级任务（如第 7.11 图所示），VLA 必须能够识别物体、其姿态以及实例的分割。 该模型还必须能够理解语言，并将语言的含义与视觉物体的含义以及机器人动作的含义联系起来。

sents.en: In realistic human-robot interaction settings, collecting additional demonstrations is often infeasible.
sents.zh: 在真实的人机交互场景中，收集额外的演示通常并不可行。

sents.en: To perform high-level tasks, such as in Figure 7.11 , the VLA must be able to recognize objects, their poses, and segmentations of instances.
sents.zh: 为了执行高级任务（如第 7.11 图所示），VLA 必须能够识别物体、其姿态以及实例的分割。

sents.en: The model must also be able to understand language, and relate the meaning of language to the meaning of visual objects and to the meaning of robotic actions.
sents.zh: 该模型还必须能够理解语言，并将语言的含义与视觉物体的含义以及机器人动作的含义联系起来。

paragraphs.en: As we will see, language provides an intuitive interface for specifying goals and for transferring semantic concepts across tasks. Furthermore, the work on VLMs has shown how to semantically connect different kinds of embeddings.
paragraphs.zh: 正如我们将要看到的，语言为指定目标以及在不同任务间传递语义概念提供了一种直观的接口。 此外，关于视觉语言模型的研究已经展示了如何将不同类型的嵌入在语义上连接起来。

sents.en: As we will see, language provides an intuitive interface for specifying goals and for transferring semantic concepts across tasks.
sents.zh: 正如我们将要看到的，语言为指定目标以及在不同任务间传递语义概念提供了一种直观的接口。

sents.en: Furthermore, the work on VLMs has shown how to semantically connect different kinds of embeddings.
sents.zh: 此外，关于视觉语言模型的研究已经展示了如何将不同类型的嵌入在语义上连接起来。

paragraphs.en: Now that we have seen the task and the challenges, let us look at possible model architectures. Again, they can become quite complex. The transformer architecture is well suited to learn patterns in sequential data, as the results on natural language show. Intuitively, this suggests that transformers may also work well to model sequential decision problems, the type of problems that are often solved in reinforcement learning for robotic action, as we discussed in Section 2.2.3 (and further in depth in Section 20.2.1 ). These problems consist of a state, from which actions cause the system to enter a new state, which has actions, etc. The transformer architecture is well suited to model these problems.
paragraphs.zh: 既然我们已经了解了任务和挑战，接下来就来看看可能的模型架构。 同样，这些架构也可能变得相当复杂。 正如自然语言处理的结果所显示的那样，Transformer 架构非常适合学习序列数据中的模式。 从直觉上讲，这表明 Transformer 可能也适用于对序列决策问题进行建模，这类问题通常出现在机器人动作的强化学习中，正如我们在第 2.2.3 节（以及第 20.2.1 节中更深入地讨论）所探讨的那样。 这些问题包含一个状态，执行动作会使系统进入一个新的状态，而该状态又包含一系列动作，依此类推。 Transformer 架构非常适合对这类问题进行建模。

sents.zh: 既然我们已经了解了任务和挑战，接下来就来看看可能的模型架构。

sents.zh: 同样，这些架构也可能变得相当复杂。

paragraphs.en: Early work on decision transformer (DT) [ Chen et al., 2021 , Janner et al., 2021 ] showed that on offline (static) reinforcement learning problems, the GPT architecture was indeed able to learn optimal policies. The decision-pretrained transformer (DPT) Lee et al. [2023] , Wang et al. [2024a] showed that the basic transformer architectures can be pretrained and finetuned on decision traces. Section 20.1.2 discusses decision traces further.
paragraphs.zh: 关于决策变换器（DT）的早期研究 [Chen et al., 2021, Janner et al., 2021] 表明，在离线（静态）强化学习问题中，GPT 架构确实能够学会最优策略。 决策预训练变换器（DPT） Lee et al. [2023], Wang et al. [2024a] 的研究表明，基础变换器架构可以在决策轨迹上进行预训练和微调。 第 20.1.2 节将进一步讨论决策轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Following pioneering work on CLIPort [ Shridhar et al., 2022 , Shridhar et al., 2020 ] , VLAs are often built on VLMs, where the robotic commands are used as regular language tokens. Let us have a closer look at some representative models.
paragraphs.zh: 在 CLIPort [ Shridhar et al., 2022 , Shridhar et al., 2020 ] 的开创性工作之后，VLA 通常构建于 VLM 之上，其中机器人指令被用作常规语言词元。 让我们更仔细地审视一些代表性模型。

sents.en: Following pioneering work on CLIPort [ Shridhar et al., 2022 , Shridhar et al., 2020 ] , VLAs are often built on VLMs, where the robotic commands are used as regular language tokens.
sents.zh: 在 CLIPort [ Shridhar et al., 2022 , Shridhar et al., 2020 ] 的开创性工作之后，VLA 通常构建于 VLM 之上，其中机器人指令被用作常规语言词元。

sents.en: Let us have a closer look at some representative models.
sents.zh: 让我们更仔细地审视一些代表性模型。

paragraphs.en: The goal of Mobility VLA [ Chiang et al., 2024 ] is navigation. This VLA is created by combining a long context VLM with topological maps, as illustrated in Figure 7.12 .
paragraphs.zh: Mobility VLA [Chiang et al., 2024] 的目标是导航。 这个 VLA 是通过将长上下文 VLM 与拓扑地图相结合而创建的，如图 7.12 所示。

sents.en: The goal of Mobility VLA [ Chiang et al., 2024 ] is navigation.
sents.zh: Mobility VLA [Chiang et al., 2024] 的目标是导航。

sents.en: This VLA is created by combining a long context VLM with topological maps, as illustrated in Figure 7.12 .
sents.zh: 这个 VLA 是通过将长上下文 VLM 与拓扑地图相结合而创建的，如图 7.12 所示。

paragraphs.en: Mobility VLA is used on a problem category of navigation tasks called multi-modal instruction navigation with demonstration tours (MINT). In this dataset, an environment prior is provided through a previously recorded demonstration video. The model consists of a two-level VLA that combines the environment understanding and common sense reasoning of long-context VLMs with a low-level navigation policy based on topological graphs. The high-level policy is created by combining user instructions from a long-context VLM that finds the goal frame in a demonstration video. Then, a low-level policy starts at this goal frame to traverse a topological graph to generate the robot action instructions at every timestep.
paragraphs.zh: Mobility VLA 被应用于一个名为“多模态指令导航与演示路线（MINT）”的导航任务问题类别中。 在该数据集中，环境先验信息通过一段预先录制的演示视频提供。 该模型由一个双层 VLA 组成，它将长上下文 VLM 的环境理解与常识推理能力，同基于拓扑图的低层导航策略相结合。 高层策略通过将长上下文 VLM 从演示视频中定位目标帧的用户指令整合而形成。 随后，低层策略从该目标帧出发，遍历一个拓扑图，以在每个时间步生成机器人的动作指令。

sents.en: Mobility VLA is used on a problem category of navigation tasks called multi-modal instruction navigation with demonstration tours (MINT).
sents.zh: Mobility VLA 被应用于一个名为“多模态指令导航与演示路线（MINT）”的导航任务问题类别中。

sents.en: In this dataset, an environment prior is provided through a previously recorded demonstration video.
sents.zh: 在该数据集中，环境先验信息通过一段预先录制的演示视频提供。

sents.en: The model consists of a two-level VLA that combines the environment understanding and common sense reasoning of long-context VLMs with a low-level navigation policy based on topological graphs.
sents.zh: 该模型由一个双层 VLA 组成，它将长上下文 VLM 的环境理解与常识推理能力，同基于拓扑图的低层导航策略相结合。

sents.en: The high-level policy is created by combining user instructions from a long-context VLM that finds the goal frame in a demonstration video.
sents.zh: 高层策略通过将长上下文 VLM 从演示视频中定位目标帧的用户指令整合而形成。

sents.en: Then, a low-level policy starts at this goal frame to traverse a topological graph to generate the robot action instructions at every timestep.
sents.zh: 随后，低层策略从该目标帧出发，遍历一个拓扑图，以在每个时间步生成机器人的动作指令。

paragraphs.en: LM-Nav [ Shah et al., 2023 ] uses a different architecture, based on existing models. It takes as input a set of raw observations from the target environment and from free-form textual instructions. From this, it derives an action plan using three pretrained models: a language model (LLM) for extracting landmarks, a vision-language model (VLM) for grounding, and a visual-navigation model (VNM) for execution (not unlike the topological map previously discussed). Together, these models enable LM-Nav to follow textual instructions from visual observations without any finetuning. Figure 7.13 shows an illustration of the approach.
paragraphs.zh: LM-Nav [Shah et al., 2023] 采用了一种基于现有模型的不同架构。 它的输入包括来自目标环境的一组原始观察数据以及自由形式的文本指令。 通过这些数据，它利用三个预训练模型来制定行动计划：一个用于提取路标的语言模型（LLM）、一个用于定位的视觉-语言模型（VLM），以及一个用于执行的视觉导航模型（VNM）（这与之前讨论的拓扑地图并无太大不同）。 这些模型共同使 LM-Nav 能够在无需任何微调的情况下，根据视觉观察结果执行文本指令。 图 7.13 展示了该方法的一个示意图。

sents.en: LM-Nav [ Shah et al., 2023 ] uses a different architecture, based on existing models.
sents.zh: LM-Nav [Shah et al., 2023] 采用了一种基于现有模型的不同架构。

sents.en: It takes as input a set of raw observations from the target environment and from free-form textual instructions.
sents.zh: 它的输入包括来自目标环境的一组原始观察数据以及自由形式的文本指令。

sents.en: From this, it derives an action plan using three pretrained models: a language model (LLM) for extracting landmarks, a vision-language model (VLM) for grounding, and a visual-navigation model (VNM) for execution (not unlike the topological map previously discussed).
sents.zh: 通过这些数据，它利用三个预训练模型来制定行动计划：一个用于提取路标的语言模型（LLM）、一个用于定位的视觉-语言模型（VLM），以及一个用于执行的视觉导航模型（VNM）（这与之前讨论的拓扑地图并无太大不同）。

sents.en: Together, these models enable LM-Nav to follow textual instructions from visual observations without any finetuning.
sents.zh: 这些模型共同使 LM-Nav 能够在无需任何微调的情况下，根据视觉观察结果执行文本指令。

sents.en: Figure 7.13 shows an illustration of the approach.
sents.zh: 图 7.13 展示了该方法的一个示意图。

paragraphs.en: Google’s RT-2 [ Brohan et al., 2023 ] uses a different approach. The idea of RT-2 is to leverage knowledge from the web to inform robotic control: the robot should learn how to act from watching videos. A standard vision language model is finetuned both on textual robotic trajectory data and on Internet-scale vision-language tasks, such as visual question answering. Robotic actions are expressed as regular text tokens and are incorporated directly into the training set in the same way as natural language tokens, as shown in Figure 7.14 .
paragraphs.zh: Google 的 RT-2 [ Brohan et al., 2023 ] 采用了一种不同的方法。 RT-2 的核心思想是利用网络知识来指导机器人控制：机器人应当通过观看视频来学习如何行动。 一种标准的视觉语言模型会在文本形式的机器人轨迹数据和互联网规模的视觉语言任务（例如视觉问答）上同时进行微调。 机器人的动作以常规文本词元的形式表示，并以与自然语言词元相同的方式直接整合到训练集中，如第 7.14 图所示。

sents.en: Google’s RT-2 [ Brohan et al., 2023 ] uses a different approach.
sents.zh: Google 的 RT-2 [ Brohan et al., 2023 ] 采用了一种不同的方法。

sents.en: The idea of RT-2 is to leverage knowledge from the web to inform robotic control: the robot should learn how to act from watching videos.
sents.zh: RT-2 的核心思想是利用网络知识来指导机器人控制：机器人应当通过观看视频来学习如何行动。

sents.en: A standard vision language model is finetuned both on textual robotic trajectory data and on Internet-scale vision-language tasks, such as visual question answering.
sents.zh: 一种标准的视觉语言模型会在文本形式的机器人轨迹数据和互联网规模的视觉语言任务（例如视觉问答）上同时进行微调。

sents.en: Robotic actions are expressed as regular text tokens and are incorporated directly into the training set in the same way as natural language tokens, as shown in Figure 7.14 .
sents.zh: 机器人的动作以常规文本词元的形式表示，并以与自然语言词元相同的方式直接整合到训练集中，如第 7.14 图所示。

paragraphs.en: A similar approach is taken by Magma [ Yang et al., 2025 ] . Magma is pretrained on heterogeneous datasets spanning from images and videos to robotics data. However, in Magma the actionable visual objects in images are labeled by special tokens (Set-of-Mark) for action grounding. Similarly, object movements (such as the trace of human hands or robotic arms) are labeled by Trace-of-Mark to ease action planning. Figure 7.15 provides an illustration.
paragraphs.zh: Magma [ Yang et al., 2025 ] 也采用了类似的方法。 Magma 在涵盖图像、视频到机器人数据的异构数据集上进行预训练。 然而，在 Magma 中，图像中的可操作视觉对象通过特殊标记（Set-of-Mark）进行标注，以实现动作接地。 同样地，物体运动（例如人类双手或机械臂的轨迹）通过 Trace-of-Mark 进行标注，以简化动作规划。 图 7.15 提供了相关说明。

sents.en: A similar approach is taken by Magma [ Yang et al., 2025 ] .
sents.zh: Magma [ Yang et al., 2025 ] 也采用了类似的方法。

sents.en: Magma is pretrained on heterogeneous datasets spanning from images and videos to robotics data.
sents.zh: Magma 在涵盖图像、视频到机器人数据的异构数据集上进行预训练。

sents.en: However, in Magma the actionable visual objects in images are labeled by special tokens (Set-of-Mark) for action grounding.
sents.zh: 然而，在 Magma 中，图像中的可操作视觉对象通过特殊标记（Set-of-Mark）进行标注，以实现动作接地。

sents.en: Similarly, object movements (such as the trace of human hands or robotic arms) are labeled by Trace-of-Mark to ease action planning.
sents.zh: 同样地，物体运动（例如人类双手或机械臂的轨迹）通过 Trace-of-Mark 进行标注，以简化动作规划。

sents.en: Figure 7.15 provides an illustration.
sents.zh: 图 7.15 提供了相关说明。

paragraphs.en: Finally, a VLA called π 0 \pi_{0} [ Black et al., 2024 ] stresses the reinforcement learning approach by using a pretrained late-fusion vision-language model, as well as a diverse cross-embodiment dataset with a variety of manipulation tasks. The model is inspired by the Transfusion approach [ Zhou et al., 2024 ] . This model is adapted to robot control by adding a separate action expert that produces actions via flow matching, for fluent manipulation skills. The resulting model can either be used directly to perform tasks based on a prompt, or be further finetuned on higher-quality data to enable complex multi-stage tasks, such as folding multiple articles of laundry or assembling a box (see Figure 7.16 ).
paragraphs.zh: 最后，一个名为 π₀ [Black et al., 2024] 的 VLA 强调了一种强化学习方法，该方法使用预训练的晚期融合视觉语言模型，以及包含多种操控任务的多样化跨具身数据集。 该模型受到 Transfusion 方法 [Zhou et al., 2024] 的启发。 通过添加一个独立的动作专家模块，该模型被适配用于机器人控制；该模块通过流匹配生成动作，以实现流畅的操控技能。 最终得到的模型既可以直接根据提示执行任务，也可以进一步在更高质量的数据上进行微调，以完成复杂的多阶段任务，例如折叠多件衣物或组装盒子（参见图 7.16）。

sents.en: Finally, a VLA called π 0 \pi_{0} [ Black et al., 2024 ] stresses the reinforcement learning approach by using a pretrained late-fusion vision-language model, as well as a diverse cross-embodiment dataset with a variety of manipulation tasks.

sents.zh: 该模型受到 Transfusion 方法 [Zhou et al., 2024] 的启发。

sents.en: This model is adapted to robot control by adding a separate action expert that produces actions via flow matching, for fluent manipulation skills.
sents.zh: 通过添加一个独立的动作专家模块，该模型被适配用于机器人控制；该模块通过流匹配生成动作，以实现流畅的操控技能。

sents.en: The resulting model can either be used directly to perform tasks based on a prompt, or be further finetuned on higher-quality data to enable complex multi-stage tasks, such as folding multiple articles of laundry or assembling a box (see Figure 7.16 ).
sents.zh: 最终得到的模型既可以直接根据提示执行任务，也可以进一步在更高质量的数据上进行微调，以完成复杂的多阶段任务，例如折叠多件衣物或组装盒子（参见图 7.16）。

paragraphs.en: The model architecture of most VLAs is based on VLMs, in some cases augmented with navigation map data. The robotic action commands are typically encoded as regular text commands. Likewise, for pretraining and finetuning typical LLM self-supervised learning algorithms are used, similar to VLMs and decision transformers. Sometimes existing pretrained models are used, to reduce the training expense.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数视觉语言智能体（VLA）的模型架构都基于视觉语言模型（VLM），在某些情况下还会加入导航地图数据作为增强。 机器人动作指令通常被编码为常规文本指令。 同样地，在预训练和微调阶段，通常会使用与视觉语言模型（VLM）和决策变换器类似的典型大语言模型（LLM）自监督学习算法。 有时也会使用现有的预训练模型，以降低训练成本。

sents.en: The model architecture of most VLAs is based on VLMs, in some cases augmented with navigation map data.
sents.zh: 大多数视觉语言智能体（VLA）的模型架构都基于视觉语言模型（VLM），在某些情况下还会加入导航地图数据作为增强。

sents.zh: 有时也会使用现有的预训练模型，以降低训练成本。

paragraphs.en: Various VLA models have been created that achieve impressive zero-shot results, generalizing behavior to unseen situations. Chiang et al. [2024] , Brohan et al. [2023] , Yang et al. [2025] are examples of VLA models for robotic action, achieving complex tasks such as navigation, table top manipulation, or even folding laundry [ Black et al., 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 人们已经开发出多种 VLA 模型，这些模型在零样本任务中取得了令人印象深刻的成果，能够将行为推广到未见过的场景。Chiang 等人 [2024]、Brohan 等人 [2023] 和 Yang 等人 [2025] 是用于机器人操作的 VLA 模型的例子，这些模型能够完成导航、桌面操作甚至折叠衣物等复杂任务 [Black 等人, 2024]。

paragraphs.en: To a VLM, an image consists of pixels without a deeper intrinsic meaning. However, agents that interact with the world need knowledge about physical aspects of that world. The models need an understanding of what is physically possible, so that agents do not walk through walls, as they still sometimes do in video games.
paragraphs.zh: 对于视觉语言模型（VLM）而言，图像仅由像素组成，并无更深层次的内在本义。 然而，与世界互动的智能体需要掌握该世界的物理特性相关知识。 这些模型必须理解哪些事物在物理上是可能的，这样智能体才不会像某些电子游戏中那样穿过墙壁。

sents.en: To a VLM, an image consists of pixels without a deeper intrinsic meaning.
sents.zh: 对于视觉语言模型（VLM）而言，图像仅由像素组成，并无更深层次的内在本义。

sents.en: However, agents that interact with the world need knowledge about physical aspects of that world.
sents.zh: 然而，与世界互动的智能体需要掌握该世界的物理特性相关知识。

sents.en: The models need an understanding of what is physically possible, so that agents do not walk through walls, as they still sometimes do in video games.
sents.zh: 这些模型必须理解哪些事物在物理上是可能的，这样智能体才不会像某些电子游戏中那样穿过墙壁。

paragraphs.en: World models help agents understand the world, allowing them to act effectively in the physical world, taking actions that make sense. Originally, LLMs are language models. We can converse with them in natural language, and they necessarily contain some knowledge of the world, but they were not specifically trained to have a wide and deep understanding of worldly affairs. Some researchers argue that in order for agentic LLMs to be truly successful, and for LLMs to reach a high level of general intelligence, research into world models should be strengthened [ Sutton et al., 2022 , Matsuo et al., 2022 , LeCun and others, 2022 , Klindt et al., 2026 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型帮助智能体理解世界，使它们能够在物理世界中有效行动，并采取合乎逻辑的行为。 最初，大型语言模型是语言模型。 我们可以用自然语言与它们对话，它们必然包含一些关于世界的知识，但它们并未经过专门训练以获得对世间事务广泛而深入的理解。 一些研究人员认为，为了使具备智能体能力的大型语言模型真正成功，并使其达到高度通用智能水平，应加强世界模型的研究 [ Sutton et al., 2022 , Matsuo et al., 2022 , LeCun and others, 2022 , Klindt et al., 2026 ] 。

sents.en: World models help agents understand the world, allowing them to act effectively in the physical world, taking actions that make sense.
sents.zh: 世界模型帮助智能体理解世界，使它们能够在物理世界中有效行动，并采取合乎逻辑的行为。

sents.en: Originally, LLMs are language models.
sents.zh: 最初，大型语言模型是语言模型。

sents.en: We can converse with them in natural language, and they necessarily contain some knowledge of the world, but they were not specifically trained to have a wide and deep understanding of worldly affairs.
sents.zh: 我们可以用自然语言与它们对话，它们必然包含一些关于世界的知识，但它们并未经过专门训练以获得对世间事务广泛而深入的理解。

sents.en: Some researchers argue that in order for agentic LLMs to be truly successful, and for LLMs to reach a high level of general intelligence, research into world models should be strengthened [ Sutton et al., 2022 , Matsuo et al., 2022 , LeCun and others, 2022 , Klindt et al., 2026 ] .
sents.zh: 一些研究人员认为，为了使具备智能体能力的大型语言模型真正成功，并使其达到高度通用智能水平，应加强世界模型的研究 [ Sutton et al., 2022 , Matsuo et al., 2022 , LeCun and others, 2022 , Klindt et al., 2026 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Agents and robots that act in the world need a rudimentary understanding of the physics of the world. One of the challenges for training an LLM is to ground its understanding of the physical world and of the possible robotic actions into reality. One way to do this is to learn an agentic model of the world (environment) from feedback on actions.
paragraphs.zh: 在现实世界中行动的智能体和机器人需要对世界的基本物理规律有初步理解。 训练大型语言模型（LLM）的挑战之一，是将它对物理世界和可能机器人动作的理解与真实世界相联系。 实现这一目标的一种方法，是通过动作反馈来学习一个智能体导向的世界（环境）模型。

sents.en: Agents and robots that act in the world need a rudimentary understanding of the physics of the world.
sents.zh: 在现实世界中行动的智能体和机器人需要对世界的基本物理规律有初步理解。

sents.en: One of the challenges for training an LLM is to ground its understanding of the physical world and of the possible robotic actions into reality.
sents.zh: 训练大型语言模型（LLM）的挑战之一，是将它对物理世界和可能机器人动作的理解与真实世界相联系。

sents.en: One way to do this is to learn an agentic model of the world (environment) from feedback on actions.
sents.zh: 实现这一目标的一种方法，是通过动作反馈来学习一个智能体导向的世界（环境）模型。

paragraphs.en: The term world model has been used in AI in other contexts. Most notably, it refers to the model in model-based reinforcement learning [ Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 , Moerland et al., 2023 , Sutton, 1991 ] (see next section). This model contains a local copy of some knowledge of the environment, based on the interactions it has had with the environment, to be used to improve the action policy. The world model contains an efficient, compressed, learned representation of the world [ Hafner et al., 2019 , Plaat et al., 2020 ] . The representation of a world model is often called an abstract or latent representation, to contrast it with the regular representation of the real world in the environment. World models are often trained to contain knowledge about physics and certain spatial properties, that puts restrictions on the agent’s actions. The precise contents of the world model depends on the domain in which the agent operates.
paragraphs.zh: “世界模型”这一术语在人工智能的其他领域也已被使用。 最值得注意的是，它指的是基于模型的强化学习中的模型 [ Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 , Moerland et al., 2023 , Sutton, 1991 ]（见下一节）。 该模型包含对环境部分知识的本地副本，这些知识基于智能体与环境之间的交互，用于改进动作策略。 世界模型包含一个高效、压缩且经过学习的对世界的表示 [ Hafner et al., 2019 , Plaat et al., 2020 ]。 世界模型的表示通常被称为抽象或潜在表示，以区别于环境中对现实世界的常规表示。 世界模型通常被训练为包含关于物理和某些空间属性的知识，这些知识会对智能体的动作施加限制。 世界模型的具体内容取决于智能体所运行的领域。

paragraphs.en: Note that in a just few chapters we have progressed from understanding language to understanding the world. The goal of a large language model is to understand some semantics of natural language from statistical patterns in text, to be used for question answering and translation. The goal of a world model is to understand causal relations in the laws of physics, to be used to simulate future world states for our agent. Quite some new technology is necessary to go from LLM to agentic LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 请注意，在短短几章中，我们已经从理解语言进步到了理解世界。 大型语言模型的目标是从文本中的统计模式中理解自然语言的某些语义，以便用于问答和翻译。 世界模型的目标是理解物理定律中的因果关系，以便为我们的智能体模拟未来的世界状态。 要从大型语言模型（LLM）发展到智能体型大型语言模型（agentic LLM），需要相当多的新技术。

sents.en: Note that in a just few chapters we have progressed from understanding language to understanding the world.
sents.zh: 请注意，在短短几章中，我们已经从理解语言进步到了理解世界。

sents.en: The goal of a large language model is to understand some semantics of natural language from statistical patterns in text, to be used for question answering and translation.
sents.zh: 大型语言模型的目标是从文本中的统计模式中理解自然语言的某些语义，以便用于问答和翻译。

sents.en: The goal of a world model is to understand causal relations in the laws of physics, to be used to simulate future world states for our agent.
sents.zh: 世界模型的目标是理解物理定律中的因果关系，以便为我们的智能体模拟未来的世界状态。

sents.en: Quite some new technology is necessary to go from LLM to agentic LLM.
sents.zh: 要从大型语言模型（LLM）发展到智能体型大型语言模型（agentic LLM），需要相当多的新技术。

paragraphs.en: We start with a look at how world models are currently used in agentic LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先来看看世界模型目前在智能体式大型语言模型中的使用方式。

paragraphs.en: World models should encapsulate knowledge of the world, so that an agent can perform meaningful actions. The actions should be grounded in the physical world. For example, the model should understand the limitations of the joints of a robot arm that it is commanding; a navigational agent should understand some physics, such as the concept of gravity, of distance, and that walls are solid objects; a financial agent should understand the consequences of a negative bank balance. Often this is the type of information that humans take for granted, and we are surprised when an agent fails to understand such basic things about the world in which it operates. VLMs that are only trained on pixels may miss the semantic meaning of a specific texture, whether it is a garment, smoke, or a wall.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型应当封装对世界的知识，以便智能体能够执行有意义的操作。 这些操作应当以物理世界为基础。 例如，模型应当理解其所控制的机器人手臂关节的局限性；导航智能体应当了解一些物理概念，如重力和距离，以及墙壁是固体物体；金融智能体应当理解银行账户余额为负所带来的后果。 这些信息通常是人类习以为常的，因此当智能体无法理解其运行环境中的这些基本事物时，我们会感到惊讶。 仅以像素为训练数据的视觉语言模型可能会忽略特定纹理的语义含义，无论该纹理是衣物、烟雾还是墙壁。

sents.en: World models should encapsulate knowledge of the world, so that an agent can perform meaningful actions.
sents.zh: 世界模型应当封装对世界的知识，以便智能体能够执行有意义的操作。

sents.en: The actions should be grounded in the physical world.
sents.zh: 这些操作应当以物理世界为基础。

sents.en: For example, the model should understand the limitations of the joints of a robot arm that it is commanding; a navigational agent should understand some physics, such as the concept of gravity, of distance, and that walls are solid objects; a financial agent should understand the consequences of a negative bank balance.
sents.zh: 例如，模型应当理解其所控制的机器人手臂关节的局限性；导航智能体应当了解一些物理概念，如重力和距离，以及墙壁是固体物体；金融智能体应当理解银行账户余额为负所带来的后果。
