sents.zh: 这些信息通常是人类习以为常的，因此当智能体无法理解其运行环境中的这些基本事物时，我们会感到惊讶。

sents.en: VLMs that are only trained on pixels may miss the semantic meaning of a specific texture, whether it is a garment, smoke, or a wall.
sents.zh: 仅以像素为训练数据的视觉语言模型可能会忽略特定纹理的语义含义，无论该纹理是衣物、烟雾还是墙壁。

paragraphs.en: Standard pretrained LLMs already contain some useful world knowledge. They learn acceptable textual behavior using reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and acceptable mathematical and coding behavior using reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Some early approaches use LLMs as pretrained world model without any finetuning. A natural way to learn about the physics of the world is through interaction: agents can learn acceptable physical behavior through a reinforcement learning-style reward function.
paragraphs.zh: 标准的预训练大型语言模型已经包含了一些有用的世界知识。 它们通过结合人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）来学习可接受的文本行为，并通过结合可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）来学习可接受的数学和编码行为。 一些早期的方法将大型语言模型作为预训练的世界模型使用，而无需任何微调。 了解世界物理规律的一种自然方式是通过互动：智能体可以通过类强化学习的奖励函数来学习可接受的物理行为。

sents.en: Standard pretrained LLMs already contain some useful world knowledge.
sents.zh: 标准的预训练大型语言模型已经包含了一些有用的世界知识。

sents.en: They learn acceptable textual behavior using reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF), and acceptable mathematical and coding behavior using reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR).
sents.zh: 它们通过结合人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）来学习可接受的文本行为，并通过结合可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）来学习可接受的数学和编码行为。

sents.en: Some early approaches use LLMs as pretrained world model without any finetuning.
sents.zh: 一些早期的方法将大型语言模型作为预训练的世界模型使用，而无需任何微调。

sents.en: A natural way to learn about the physics of the world is through interaction: agents can learn acceptable physical behavior through a reinforcement learning-style reward function.
sents.zh: 了解世界物理规律的一种自然方式是通过互动：智能体可以通过类强化学习的奖励函数来学习可接受的物理行为。

paragraphs.en: The goal of world models in model-based reinforcement learning is to improve the sample efficiency of learning from interaction, by planning with the world model instead of sampling from the real world. This is especially useful when interacting with the world is more expensive than performing a simulation, as will often be the case in agentic LLM. In the approaches that we will discuss, LLM world models use methods from model-based reinforcement learning (see Section 7.3.5 ). Currently, world model approaches in LLM are quite diverse. To show which tasks world models are used for in LLMs, we will discuss three examples: WorldGPT, WebDreamer, and WorldCoder.
paragraphs.zh: 基于模型强化学习中的世界模型旨在通过利用世界模型进行规划，而非从真实世界中采样，从而提高通过与环境交互进行学习时的样本效率。 当与世界交互的成本高于执行模拟时，这种方法尤其有用，而这种情况在智能体式大语言模型中通常会出现。 在我们将要讨论的方法中，大语言模型的世界模型采用了基于模型强化学习中的方法（参见第 7.3.5 节）。 目前，大语言模型中的世界模型方法相当多样化。 为了展示世界模型在大语言模型中用于哪些任务，我们将讨论三个例子：WorldGPT、WebDreamer 和 WorldCoder。

sents.en: The goal of world models in model-based reinforcement learning is to improve the sample efficiency of learning from interaction, by planning with the world model instead of sampling from the real world.
sents.zh: 基于模型强化学习中的世界模型旨在通过利用世界模型进行规划，而非从真实世界中采样，从而提高通过与环境交互进行学习时的样本效率。

sents.en: In the approaches that we will discuss, LLM world models use methods from model-based reinforcement learning (see Section 7.3.5 ).
sents.zh: 在我们将要讨论的方法中，大语言模型的世界模型采用了基于模型强化学习中的方法（参见第 7.3.5 节）。

sents.en: Currently, world model approaches in LLM are quite diverse.
sents.zh: 目前，大语言模型中的世界模型方法相当多样化。

sents.en: To show which tasks world models are used for in LLMs, we will discuss three examples: WorldGPT, WebDreamer, and WorldCoder.
sents.zh: 为了展示世界模型在大语言模型中用于哪些任务，我们将讨论三个例子：WorldGPT、WebDreamer 和 WorldCoder。

paragraphs.en: The goal of WorldGPT [ Ge et al., 2024 ] is to solve visual question answering and embodied planning tasks, including audio-video question answering. WorldGPT learns a world-VLM from videos. It uses a latent space VLM with external knowledge bases and long-term memory.
paragraphs.zh: WorldGPT [ Ge et al., 2024 ] 的目标是解决视觉问答和具身规划任务，包括音视频问答。 WorldGPT 从视频中学习一个世界-VLM。 它使用一个包含外部知识库和长期记忆的潜在空间 VLM。

sents.en: The goal of WorldGPT [ Ge et al., 2024 ] is to solve visual question answering and embodied planning tasks, including audio-video question answering.
sents.zh: WorldGPT [ Ge et al., 2024 ] 的目标是解决视觉问答和具身规划任务，包括音视频问答。

sents.en: WorldGPT learns a world-VLM from videos.
sents.zh: WorldGPT 从视频中学习一个世界-VLM。

sents.en: It uses a latent space VLM with external knowledge bases and long-term memory.
sents.zh: 它使用一个包含外部知识库和长期记忆的潜在空间 VLM。

paragraphs.en: The goal of WebDreamer [ Gu et al., 2024 ] is to improve efficient learning of Web-interaction tasks, such as e-commerce. WebDreamer enables web-agents to simulate actions before execution, and thus be faster and more sample efficient (by not having to act in the real web to gather experience). WebDreamer is a model-based reinforcement learning approach in a web-world. (The name is derived from Dreamer , a series of influential model-based reinforcement learning latent dynamics models [ Hafner et al., 2019 , Hafner et al., 2020a , Hafner et al., 2023 ] .) Typical tasks are to find products on e-commerce sites. It does so by training a small model from a large model, allowing efficient simulation.
paragraphs.zh: WebDreamer [ Gu et al., 2024 ] 的目标是提升网络交互任务（例如电子商务）的高效学习。 WebDreamer 使网络智能体能够在执行前模拟操作，从而更快且更节省样本（因为无需在真实网络中行动以积累经验）。 WebDreamer 是一种基于模型的网络世界强化学习方法。 （该名称源自 Dreamer——一系列具有影响力的基于模型强化学习的潜在动态模型 [ Hafner et al., 2019 , Hafner et al., 2020a , Hafner et al., 2023 ] 。）典型任务是找到电子商务网站上的商品。 它通过从一个大模型中训练一个小模型来实现这一点，从而支持高效的模拟。

sents.en: The goal of WebDreamer [ Gu et al., 2024 ] is to improve efficient learning of Web-interaction tasks, such as e-commerce.
sents.zh: WebDreamer [ Gu et al., 2024 ] 的目标是提升网络交互任务（例如电子商务）的高效学习。

sents.en: WebDreamer enables web-agents to simulate actions before execution, and thus be faster and more sample efficient (by not having to act in the real web to gather experience).
sents.zh: WebDreamer 使网络智能体能够在执行前模拟操作，从而更快且更节省样本（因为无需在真实网络中行动以积累经验）。

sents.en: WebDreamer is a model-based reinforcement learning approach in a web-world.
sents.zh: WebDreamer 是一种基于模型的网络世界强化学习方法。

sents.en: (The name is derived from Dreamer , a series of influential model-based reinforcement learning latent dynamics models [ Hafner et al., 2019 , Hafner et al., 2020a , Hafner et al., 2023 ] .) Typical tasks are to find products on e-commerce sites.
sents.zh: （该名称源自 Dreamer——一系列具有影响力的基于模型强化学习的潜在动态模型 [ Hafner et al., 2019 , Hafner et al., 2020a , Hafner et al., 2023 ] 。）典型任务是找到电子商务网站上的商品。

sents.en: It does so by training a small model from a large model, allowing efficient simulation.
sents.zh: 它通过从一个大模型中训练一个小模型来实现这一点，从而支持高效的模拟。

paragraphs.en: The goal of WorldCoder [ Tang et al., 2024 ] is also to improve sample efficiency, but the approach is different. WorldCoder improves efficiency by generating the dynamics model (transition function and reward function) in interpretable Python code, which is then used in a standard model-based reinforcement learning design. The generated Python code executes more efficiently than LLM inference does. WorldCoder is used in grid-tasks (Sokoban, see Figure 7.17 ) and domestic task planning (AlfWorld, see Figure 7.18 ).
paragraphs.zh: WorldCoder [ Tang et al., 2024 ] 的目标同样是提高样本效率，但其方法有所不同。 WorldCoder 通过以可解释的 Python 代码生成动态模型（转移函数和奖励函数）来提高效率，然后将其用于标准的基于模型强化学习框架中。 生成的 Python 代码执行效率高于 LLM 推理。 WorldCoder 被应用于网格任务（Sokoban，参见图 7.17）和家庭任务规划（AlfWorld，参见图 7.18）。

sents.en: The goal of WorldCoder [ Tang et al., 2024 ] is also to improve sample efficiency, but the approach is different.
sents.zh: WorldCoder [ Tang et al., 2024 ] 的目标同样是提高样本效率，但其方法有所不同。

sents.en: WorldCoder improves efficiency by generating the dynamics model (transition function and reward function) in interpretable Python code, which is then used in a standard model-based reinforcement learning design.
sents.zh: WorldCoder 通过以可解释的 Python 代码生成动态模型（转移函数和奖励函数）来提高效率，然后将其用于标准的基于模型强化学习框架中。

sents.en: The generated Python code executes more efficiently than LLM inference does.
sents.zh: 生成的 Python 代码执行效率高于 LLM 推理。

sents.en: WorldCoder is used in grid-tasks (Sokoban, see Figure 7.17 ) and domestic task planning (AlfWorld, see Figure 7.18 ).
sents.zh: WorldCoder 被应用于网格任务（Sokoban，参见图 7.17）和家庭任务规划（AlfWorld，参见图 7.18）。

paragraphs.en: The purpose of a world model is to add semantic meaning to observations—actions having consequences—something that LLMs and VLMs may struggle with. When does a pixel belong to a floor to walk on (restrict y y movement) and when is it part of a wall to stop you (restrict x x movement)? A reward function provides feedback information on which actions are good, and which are not. Thus, world model architectures often use a reinforcement learning setting, in which an action policy is trained from feedback rewards. We can think of a world model as a VLM with a policy learner inside.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型的作用是为观察结果添加语义意义——即行为会产生后果——而这可能是大型语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）难以处理的。 一个像素在什么情况下属于可供行走的地面（限制 y 方向的移动），又在什么情况下是阻碍前进的墙壁（限制 x 方向的移动）？ 奖励函数提供反馈信息，说明哪些行为是好的，哪些则不然。 因此，世界模型架构通常采用强化学习框架，其中行为策略通过奖励反馈进行训练。 我们可以将世界模型视为一个内部包含策略学习器的视觉语言模型（VLM）。

sents.en: The purpose of a world model is to add semantic meaning to observations—actions having consequences—something that LLMs and VLMs may struggle with.
sents.zh: 世界模型的作用是为观察结果添加语义意义——即行为会产生后果——而这可能是大型语言模型（LLM）和视觉语言模型（VLM）难以处理的。

sents.en: When does a pixel belong to a floor to walk on (restrict y y movement) and when is it part of a wall to stop you (restrict x x movement)?

sents.zh: 奖励函数提供反馈信息，说明哪些行为是好的，哪些则不然。

sents.en: Thus, world model architectures often use a reinforcement learning setting, in which an action policy is trained from feedback rewards.
sents.zh: 因此，世界模型架构通常采用强化学习框架，其中行为策略通过奖励反馈进行训练。

sents.en: We can think of a world model as a VLM with a policy learner inside.
sents.zh: 我们可以将世界模型视为一个内部包含策略学习器的视觉语言模型（VLM）。

paragraphs.en: WorldGPT, WebDreamer, and WorldCoder use different architectures for their world model, which we will now discuss in more detail.
paragraphs.zh: WorldGPT、WebDreamer 和 WorldCoder 为其世界模型采用了不同的架构，接下来我们将对此进行更详细的讨论。

paragraphs.en: WorldGPT is based on a standard LLM, Vicuna-7B-v0. 4 4 4 https://huggingface.co/lmsys/vicuna-7b-v1.3 , https://lmsys.org It performs reasoning in latent space, following the model-based reinforcement learning approach. The goal of WorldGPT is to be a simulator of realistic dynamics of the world—the transition and the reward function in reinforcement learning. To do so, the architecture helps synthesize multi-modal instruction instances, using a special architecture. At the core WorldGPT follows the common VLM architecture with a central LLM, and a multi-modal encoder and a decoder. To help the model synthesize multi-modal instructions, a cognitive architecture is added to help with specialized or long-term tasks. The architecture adds memory, knowledge retrieval, and context reflection. The context reflection is built on Q-former [ Li et al., 2023 ] . See Figure 7.19 for a diagram of the architecture.
paragraphs.zh: WorldGPT 基于标准的 LLM——Vicuna-7B-v0.444，参考链接：https://huggingface.co/lmsys/vicuna-7b-v1.3、https://lmsys.org。它通过潜在空间进行推理，遵循基于模型的强化学习方法。 WorldGPT 的目标是模拟世界的真实动态——即强化学习中的状态转移和奖励函数。 为此，其架构借助一种特殊结构来合成多模态指令实例。 在核心层面，WorldGPT 遵循通用的 VLM 架构，包含一个中央 LLM、一个多模态编码器和一个解码器。 为帮助模型合成多模态指令，系统增加了一种认知架构，以支持专业或长期任务。 该架构增加了记忆、知识检索和上下文反思功能。 上下文反思功能基于 Q-former [Li et al., 2023] 构建。 有关该架构的示意图，请参见图 7.19。

sents.zh: WorldGPT 基于标准的 LLM——Vicuna-7B-v0.444，参考链接：https://huggingface.co/lmsys/vicuna-7b-v1.3、https://lmsys.org。它通过潜在空间进行推理，遵循基于模型的强化学习方法。

paragraphs.en: WebDreamer is aimed at web-interaction. It distills a large model, Qwen-70B [ Bai et al., 2025 ] , into a small 7B model. The small model is then used for simulating actions with the world model, before acting in the “real” web-world. It uses model predictive control (MPC) as planning approach [ Garcia et al., 1989 , Schwenzer et al., 2021 ] for decision making about website actions, re-planning at each interaction step. WebDreamer leverages LLMs as world model and as value function. The LLM implements both the simulation function (sim) and the scoring function (score), see Figure 7.20 . Furthermore, following [ Koh et al., 2024 ] , the LLM is used for candidate action generation (in addition to sim and score). The authors employ a two-stage approach: first sampling top- k k actions, and then using the LLM to self-refine unnecessary actions for simulation.
paragraphs.zh: WebDreamer 旨在实现网络交互。 它将大型模型 Qwen-70B [ Bai et al., 2025 ] 蒸馏为一个小型的 7B 模型。 随后，该小型模型被用于通过世界模型模拟动作，之后在“真实”的网络世界中执行操作。 它采用模型预测控制（MPC）作为规划方法 [ Garcia et al., 1989 , Schwenzer et al., 2021 ]，用于对网站操作进行决策，并在每次交互步骤中重新规划。 WebDreamer 利用大型语言模型（LLM）作为世界模型和价值函数。 LLM 同时实现了模拟函数（sim）和评分函数（score），参见图 7.20。 此外，遵循 [ Koh et al., 2024 ] 的方法，LLM 还被用于生成候选动作（除了 sim 和 score 之外）。 作者采用了一种两阶段方法：首先采样前 k 个动作，然后使用 LLM 自我优化以去除不必要的模拟动作。

sents.en: WebDreamer is aimed at web-interaction.
sents.zh: WebDreamer 旨在实现网络交互。

sents.zh: LLM 同时实现了模拟函数（sim）和评分函数（score），参见图 7.20。

sents.en: Furthermore, following [ Koh et al., 2024 ] , the LLM is used for candidate action generation (in addition to sim and score).
sents.zh: 此外，遵循 [ Koh et al., 2024 ] 的方法，LLM 还被用于生成候选动作（除了 sim 和 score 之外）。

paragraphs.en: WorldCoder is a model-based agent that builds a Python program to represent its knowledge of the world. WorldCoder creates a transition function of the world in executable Python code, see Figure 7.21 . WorldCoder uses program synthesis. In reinforcement learning, problems are formalized as MDPs, consisting of a state representation S S , action function A A , transition function T T , and reward function R R (see Section 7.3.5 ). WorldCoder uses an LLM to generate Python code for action, transition and reward functions for a task, as well as for the state representation, which is then used in a model-based reinforcement learning approach. This code is checked and improved, in an iterative self debug refinement process [ Chen et al., 2023 ] , see Section 6.1.3.2 . This process repeats until the program produces the correct output.
paragraphs.zh: WorldCoder 是一种基于模型的智能体，它会构建一个 Python 程序来表示其对世界的知识。 WorldCoder 以可执行的 Python 代码形式创建世界的转移函数，参见图 7.21。 WorldCoder 使用程序合成技术。 在强化学习中，问题被形式化为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），包括状态表示 S、动作函数 A、转移函数 T 和奖励函数 R（参见第 7.3.5 节）。 WorldCoder 利用大语言模型（LLM）为特定任务生成用于动作、转移和奖励函数的 Python 代码，以及状态表示的代码，这些代码随后被用于基于模型的强化学习方法中。 这段代码会通过迭代式的自我调试与优化过程进行检验和改进 [Chen et al., 2023]，参见第 6.1.3.2 节。 该过程会持续重复，直到程序能够生成正确的输出。

sents.en: WorldCoder is a model-based agent that builds a Python program to represent its knowledge of the world.
sents.zh: WorldCoder 是一种基于模型的智能体，它会构建一个 Python 程序来表示其对世界的知识。

sents.en: WorldCoder creates a transition function of the world in executable Python code, see Figure 7.21 .
sents.zh: WorldCoder 以可执行的 Python 代码形式创建世界的转移函数，参见图 7.21。

sents.zh: WorldCoder 使用程序合成技术。

sents.en: In reinforcement learning, problems are formalized as MDPs, consisting of a state representation S S , action function A A , transition function T T , and reward function R R (see Section 7.3.5 ).
sents.zh: 在强化学习中，问题被形式化为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），包括状态表示 S、动作函数 A、转移函数 T 和奖励函数 R（参见第 7.3.5 节）。

sents.en: WorldCoder uses an LLM to generate Python code for action, transition and reward functions for a task, as well as for the state representation, which is then used in a model-based reinforcement learning approach.
sents.zh: WorldCoder 利用大语言模型（LLM）为特定任务生成用于动作、转移和奖励函数的 Python 代码，以及状态表示的代码，这些代码随后被用于基于模型的强化学习方法中。

sents.en: This code is checked and improved, in an iterative self debug refinement process [ Chen et al., 2023 ] , see Section 6.1.3.2 .
sents.zh: 这段代码会通过迭代式的自我调试与优化过程进行检验和改进 [Chen et al., 2023]，参见第 6.1.3.2 节。

sents.en: This process repeats until the program produces the correct output.
sents.zh: 该过程会持续重复，直到程序能够生成正确的输出。

paragraphs.en: Note that in WorldCoder the learned model is symbolic (the transition function is represented as computer code), where in regular deep reinforcement learning the model is a neural network. At inference time, WorldCoder is efficient, since no LLM calls occur that require forward passes through a large network, only interpretation of the transition and reward function Python code.
paragraphs.zh: 请注意，在 WorldCoder 中，学习到的模型是符号化的（转移函数以计算机代码的形式表示），而在普通的深度强化学习中，模型是一个神经网络。 在推理阶段，WorldCoder 的效率很高，因为它不需要进行任何需要前向传播通过大型网络的 LLM 调用，只需解释转移函数和奖励函数的 Python 代码即可。

sents.en: Note that in WorldCoder the learned model is symbolic (the transition function is represented as computer code), where in regular deep reinforcement learning the model is a neural network.
sents.zh: 请注意，在 WorldCoder 中，学习到的模型是符号化的（转移函数以计算机代码的形式表示），而在普通的深度强化学习中，模型是一个神经网络。

sents.en: At inference time, WorldCoder is efficient, since no LLM calls occur that require forward passes through a large network, only interpretation of the transition and reward function Python code.
sents.zh: 在推理阶段，WorldCoder 的效率很高，因为它不需要进行任何需要前向传播通过大型网络的 LLM 调用，只需解释转移函数和奖励函数的 Python 代码即可。

paragraphs.en: In regular model-based LLM approaches, the LLM simulates the world, in WorldCoder the LLM builds a simulation of the world, for later execution. At inference time, the Python interpreter executes the transition function, where in ReAct, an LLM reasons about the world state. For planning problems, the symbolic approach is better suited, since LLMs struggle with planning during inference (see Section 6.2.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在常规的基于模型的大型语言模型方法中，大型语言模型会模拟世界；而在 WorldCoder 中，大型语言模型会构建一个世界的模拟，以便后续执行。 在推理阶段，Python 解释器会执行转换函数；而在 ReAct 方法中，大型语言模型会对世界状态进行推理。 对于规划问题，符号化方法更为适用，因为大型语言模型在推理阶段难以进行规划（参见第 6.2.3 节）。

sents.en: In regular model-based LLM approaches, the LLM simulates the world, in WorldCoder the LLM builds a simulation of the world, for later execution.
sents.zh: 在常规的基于模型的大型语言模型方法中，大型语言模型会模拟世界；而在 WorldCoder 中，大型语言模型会构建一个世界的模拟，以便后续执行。

sents.en: At inference time, the Python interpreter executes the transition function, where in ReAct, an LLM reasons about the world state.
sents.zh: 在推理阶段，Python 解释器会执行转换函数；而在 ReAct 方法中，大型语言模型会对世界状态进行推理。

sents.en: For planning problems, the symbolic approach is better suited, since LLMs struggle with planning during inference (see Section 6.2.3 ).
sents.zh: 对于规划问题，符号化方法更为适用，因为大型语言模型在推理阶段难以进行规划（参见第 6.2.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: We will now discuss the pretraining and finetuning algorithms that the different approaches use.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们将讨论不同方法所采用的预训练和微调算法。

paragraphs.en: WorldGPT acquires an understanding of world dynamics by pretraining and finetuning on millions of videos across various domains. Vicuna-7B-v0 is used as the base LLM. Pretraining then uses a language-centric encoder to obtain a unified representation of the multi-modal state. For multi-modal decoding, special tokens are inserted into the LLM’s vocabulary. Training starts uni-modal, and progresses to cross-modal. For finetuning, a special cognitive reinforcement architecture is used with a dataset with fine-grain sequential state-transition sample annotations from more than 10 million videos. As mentioned before, the cognitive architecture consists of memory, knowledge retrieval, and context reflection. Through finetuning, agents acquire specialized knowledge by finetuning on synthetic multi-modal instruction data.
paragraphs.zh: WorldGPT 通过在多个领域的数百万视频上进行预训练和微调，获得了世界动态的理解。 Vicuna-7B-v0 被用作基础大语言模型。 预训练随后使用一种以语言为中心的编码器，以获得多模态状态的统一表示。 对于多模态解码，会在大语言模型的词汇表中插入特殊标记。 训练首先从单模态开始，然后逐步过渡到跨模态。 在微调阶段，采用了一种特殊的认知强化架构，并使用一个包含来自超过 1000 万条视频的详细序列状态转换样本标注的数据集进行训练。 如前所述，该认知架构包括记忆、知识检索和上下文反思三个部分。 通过微调，智能体能够在合成多模态指令数据上进行微调，从而获得专门的知识。

sents.en: WorldGPT acquires an understanding of world dynamics by pretraining and finetuning on millions of videos across various domains.
sents.zh: WorldGPT 通过在多个领域的数百万视频上进行预训练和微调，获得了世界动态的理解。

sents.en: Vicuna-7B-v0 is used as the base LLM.
sents.zh: Vicuna-7B-v0 被用作基础大语言模型。

sents.en: Pretraining then uses a language-centric encoder to obtain a unified representation of the multi-modal state.
sents.zh: 预训练随后使用一种以语言为中心的编码器，以获得多模态状态的统一表示。

sents.en: For multi-modal decoding, special tokens are inserted into the LLM’s vocabulary.
sents.zh: 对于多模态解码，会在大语言模型的词汇表中插入特殊标记。

sents.en: Training starts uni-modal, and progresses to cross-modal.
sents.zh: 训练首先从单模态开始，然后逐步过渡到跨模态。

sents.en: For finetuning, a special cognitive reinforcement architecture is used with a dataset with fine-grain sequential state-transition sample annotations from more than 10 million videos.
sents.zh: 在微调阶段，采用了一种特殊的认知强化架构，并使用一个包含来自超过 1000 万条视频的详细序列状态转换样本标注的数据集进行训练。

sents.en: As mentioned before, the cognitive architecture consists of memory, knowledge retrieval, and context reflection.
sents.zh: 如前所述，该认知架构包括记忆、知识检索和上下文反思三个部分。

sents.en: Through finetuning, agents acquire specialized knowledge by finetuning on synthetic multi-modal instruction data.
sents.zh: 通过微调，智能体能够在合成多模态指令数据上进行微调，从而获得专门的知识。

paragraphs.en: The WebDreamer approach aims to learn dynamics suitable for model-based reinforcement learning. First the pretrained Qwen-2-VL vision language model [ Wang et al., 2024b ] is used to initialize the Dreamer-7B model, which is then further finetuned on 3.1 million interaction examples. The data synthesis pipeline consists of (1) random walks over the web, where the model autonomously interacts with web pages through actions such as typing for search and clicking, and (2) synthesis, where Qwen2-VL-72B generates textual descriptions of state changes based on visual snapshots before and after the actions. WebDreamer simulates possible future states for each action over a finite horizon (replanning and retraining according to the model predictive control (MPC) approach, a reinforcement learning approach for adaptive retraining that is used in engineering and control problems).
paragraphs.zh: WebDreamer 方法旨在学习适用于基于模型强化学习的动态过程。 首先，使用预训练的 Qwen-2-VL 视觉语言模型 [ Wang et al., 2024b ] 来初始化 Dreamer-7B 模型，然后在该模型上进一步基于 310 万个交互示例进行微调。 数据合成流程包括：（1）在网络上进行随机游走，其中模型通过输入搜索关键词和点击等动作与网页自主互动；以及（2）合成阶段，Qwen2-VL-72B 根据动作执行前后的视觉快照生成状态变化的文本描述。 WebDreamer 会在有限的时间范围内模拟每个动作可能产生的未来状态（并根据模型预测控制（MPC）方法重新规划与重新训练；MPC 是一种用于自适应再训练的强化学习方法，广泛应用于工程和控制问题中）。

sents.en: The WebDreamer approach aims to learn dynamics suitable for model-based reinforcement learning.
sents.zh: WebDreamer 方法旨在学习适用于基于模型强化学习的动态过程。

sents.en: First the pretrained Qwen-2-VL vision language model [ Wang et al., 2024b ] is used to initialize the Dreamer-7B model, which is then further finetuned on 3.1 million interaction examples.
sents.zh: 首先，使用预训练的 Qwen-2-VL 视觉语言模型 [ Wang et al., 2024b ] 来初始化 Dreamer-7B 模型，然后在该模型上进一步基于 310 万个交互示例进行微调。

sents.en: The data synthesis pipeline consists of (1) random walks over the web, where the model autonomously interacts with web pages through actions such as typing for search and clicking, and (2) synthesis, where Qwen2-VL-72B generates textual descriptions of state changes based on visual snapshots before and after the actions.
sents.zh: 数据合成流程包括：（1）在网络上进行随机游走，其中模型通过输入搜索关键词和点击等动作与网页自主互动；以及（2）合成阶段，Qwen2-VL-72B 根据动作执行前后的视觉快照生成状态变化的文本描述。

sents.en: WebDreamer simulates possible future states for each action over a finite horizon (replanning and retraining according to the model predictive control (MPC) approach, a reinforcement learning approach for adaptive retraining that is used in engineering and control problems).
sents.zh: WebDreamer 会在有限的时间范围内模拟每个动作可能产生的未来状态（并根据模型预测控制（MPC）方法重新规划与重新训练；MPC 是一种用于自适应再训练的强化学习方法，广泛应用于工程和控制问题中）。

paragraphs.en: WorldCoder uses program synthesis to learn to make a transition function, the function that computes the next state of the world. WorldCoder then performs planning-actions using that coded world model. It initially performs random exploration to initialize a dataset of environmental interactions; it updates its world model using a program synthesis algorithm, generates the code, and then performs planning. Different planners are possible, from depth-limited value iteration (in simple domains) to MCTS (for more complex domains) [ Browne et al., 2012 ] .
paragraphs.zh: WorldCoder 利用程序合成来学习构建一个转换函数，即计算世界下一状态的函数。 随后，WorldCoder 使用该编码的世界模型执行规划动作。 它最初通过随机探索来初始化一个环境交互数据集；接着使用程序合成算法更新其世界模型，生成代码，然后进行规划。 可以采用不同的规划方法，从深度受限的值迭代（在简单领域）到 MCTS（用于更复杂的领域）[ Browne et al., 2012 ]。

sents.en: WorldCoder uses program synthesis to learn to make a transition function, the function that computes the next state of the world.
sents.zh: WorldCoder 利用程序合成来学习构建一个转换函数，即计算世界下一状态的函数。

sents.en: WorldCoder then performs planning-actions using that coded world model.
sents.zh: 随后，WorldCoder 使用该编码的世界模型执行规划动作。

sents.en: It initially performs random exploration to initialize a dataset of environmental interactions; it updates its world model using a program synthesis algorithm, generates the code, and then performs planning.
sents.zh: 它最初通过随机探索来初始化一个环境交互数据集；接着使用程序合成算法更新其世界模型，生成代码，然后进行规划。

paragraphs.en: The WorldGPT model is evaluated with a multi-modal state transition prediction benchmark. WorldGPT is effective, and understands and predicts the dynamics of complex real-world kitchen and cooking scenarios accurately.

paragraphs.en: WebDreamer also performs well. It is reported to surpass GPT-4o performance on web interaction tasks. Substantial performance improvements are reported over reactive baselines, on which it is 4-5 times more efficient than tree search. WebDreamer performs well on the sandbox environment VisualWebArena, and also on real-world websites (Online-Mind2Web and Mind2Web-Live), where tree search methods are difficult to implement and deploy. Moreover, on online benchmarks, using Dreamer-7B, the approach achieves performance comparable to GPT-4o. On real-world websites, WebDreamer outperforms the reactive baseline with a relative gain of 42% and 24%, respectively.

paragraphs.en: Generating world knowledge as computer code by LLMs brings advantages. It allows prior world knowledge embedded in the LLM to improve code generation, as existing solutions to published problems may well have been seen during pretraining. The code can also be transferred across tasks by reusing pieces of old programs. Furthermore, the results are human readable, allowing the world knowledge to be inspected by humans by reading the generated code.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）以计算机代码形式生成世界知识具有诸多优势。 这使得嵌入在 LLM 中的先验世界知识能够改进代码生成，因为已发表问题的现有解决方案很可能在预训练阶段已被识别。 通过复用旧程序的部分内容，这些代码还可以在不同任务之间迁移使用。 此外，生成的结果对人类可读，因此人类可以通过阅读生成的代码来检验其中包含的世界知识。

paragraphs.en: Though promising for planning problems, a limitation of the WorldCoder approach is inherent to the computational difficulty of planning problems. Problem instances that are difficult to solve with dedicated solvers are also difficult to solve for WorldCoder solvers. The transition function that is generated by the LLM is unlikely to be better than those designed by expert human researchers.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 WorldCoder 方法在规划问题上展现出前景，但其局限性源于规划问题本身固有的计算难度。 那些使用专用求解器也难以解决的问题实例，对于 WorldCoder 求解器来说同样难以解决。 由 LLM 生成的转换函数不太可能优于由人类专家研究人员设计的转换函数。

paragraphs.en: World models are being used successfully in agentic LLM. An extensive literature exists on world models in model-based reinforcement learning. paragraphs.en: In reinforcement learning, agents learn how to act in an environment by sampling rewards from actions that are executed in the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 在强化学习中，智能体通过在环境中执行动作并采样奖励，学习如何在环境中采取行动。

paragraphs.en: In regular reinforcement learning an optimal agent policy is learned model-free: the best actions for all states are learned directly from interaction with the environment (see Figure 7.22 ), without the help of an extra model of the environment. Regular reinforcement learning is formally described as a Markov decision process, with four functions { S , T , A , R } \{S,T,A,R\} : a function S ⁡ ( o ) → s S(o)\rightarrow s to represent the state of the system for observation o o , a function T ⁡ ( s , a ) → s ′ T(s,a)\rightarrow s^{\prime} that transitions from one state to the next state using an action, a function A ⁡ ( s ) → a A(s)\rightarrow a that returns an action for a state, and a function R ⁡ ( s ) → r R(s)\rightarrow r that assign a reward value (positive or negative) to a state. The goal of reinforcement learning is to use the MDP to learn an optimal policy π ∗ ​ ( s ) → a ∗ \pi^{*}(s)\rightarrow a^{*} , the function that returns the best action for each state that the MDP can be in. Thus, a reinforcement learning problem consists of four functions S S , T T , A A , and R R , and the goal of the agent is to find the optimal policy π ∗ ​ ( s ) \pi^{*}(s) with the highest expected cumulative reward. The agent does not have access to T T and R R , functions that reside in the environment. Regular, model-free, reinforcement learning is also called direct reinforcement learning. The direct method naturally has high sample complexity: policy improvement requires sampling, and large MDPs require many samples for the policy improvement process to converge (Figure 7.22 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在常规强化学习中，智能体的最优策略是通过无模型方法学习的：通过与环境直接交互（参见图 7.22），无需借助额外的环境模型，即可直接学会所有状态下的最佳动作。 常规强化学习可正式描述为一个马尔可夫决策过程，包含四个函数 { S , T , A , R } \{S,T,A,R\}：一个函数 S ⁡ ( o ) → s S(o)\rightarrow s，用于表示在观测 o o 下系统的状态；一个函数 T ⁡ ( s , a ) → s ′ T(s,a)\rightarrow s^{\prime}，用于通过执行动作从一个状态转移到下一个状态；一个函数 A ⁡ ( s ) → a A(s)\rightarrow a，用于返回某个状态对应的动作；以及一个函数 R ⁡ ( s ) → r R(s)\rightarrow r，用于为某个状态分配奖励值（正或负）。 强化学习的目标是利用该马尔可夫决策过程学习最优策略 π ∗ ​ ( s ) → a ∗ \pi^{*}(s)\rightarrow a^{*}，即返回马尔可夫决策过程可能处于的每个状态下的最佳动作的函数。 因此，一个强化学习问题由四个函数 S S、T T、A A 和 R R 组成，智能体的目标是找到期望累积奖励最高的最优策略 π ∗ ​ ( s ) \pi^{*}(s)。 智能体无法访问 T T 和 R R——这两个函数位于环境中。 常规的无模型强化学习也称为直接强化学习。 直接方法天然具有高的样本复杂度：策略改进需要采样，而大型马尔可夫决策过程则需要大量样本才能使策略改进过程收敛（图 7.22）。

sents.en: The direct method naturally has high sample complexity: policy improvement requires sampling, and large MDPs require many samples for the policy improvement process to converge (Figure 7.22 ).
sents.zh: 直接方法天然具有高的样本复杂度：策略改进需要采样，而大型马尔可夫决策过程则需要大量样本才能使策略改进过程收敛（图 7.22）。

paragraphs.en: In direct reinforcement learning, sampled information is not retained by the agent, but forgotten, and each policy improvement requires a new sample. Interaction by the agent with the outside environment is often expensive, for example for a robot acting in the real world, whose joints wear out. In this case it would be beneficial to find ways to reduce the sample complexity. We should try to improve the policy without having to sample as much from the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 在直接强化学习中，智能体不会保留采样得到的信息，而是将其遗忘，并且每次策略改进都需要新的样本。 智能体与外部环境之间的交互通常成本高昂，例如机器人在真实世界中行动时，其关节会磨损。 在这种情况下，找到降低样本复杂度的方法将大有裨益。 我们应该尝试在无需从环境中进行大量采样的情况下改进策略。

sents.en: In direct reinforcement learning, sampled information is not retained by the agent, but forgotten, and each policy improvement requires a new sample.
sents.zh: 在直接强化学习中，智能体不会保留采样得到的信息，而是将其遗忘，并且每次策略改进都需要新的样本。

sents.en: Interaction by the agent with the outside environment is often expensive, for example for a robot acting in the real world, whose joints wear out.
sents.zh: 智能体与外部环境之间的交互通常成本高昂，例如机器人在真实世界中行动时，其关节会磨损。

sents.en: In this case it would be beneficial to find ways to reduce the sample complexity.
sents.zh: 在这种情况下，找到降低样本复杂度的方法将大有裨益。

sents.en: We should try to improve the policy without having to sample as much from the environment.
sents.zh: 我们应该尝试在无需从环境中进行大量采样的情况下改进策略。

paragraphs.en: A straightforward idea is not to throw away the samples, but to store them in a buffer, and also sample from that buffer of older interaction results, or, slightly more advanced, to train a local surrogate model M = ( T ^ , R ^ ) M=(\hat{T},\hat{R}) of the environment dynamics. When we have trained this local dynamics model, we can also sample from the model, cheaply, in addition to sampling the environment, expensively (see Figure 7.23 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一个直接的想法不是丢弃样本，而是将它们存储在缓冲区中，并且也从这个包含旧交互结果的缓冲区中进行采样；或者，稍微高级一点的做法是，训练一个局部代理模型 M = ( T ^ , R ^ ) M=(\hat{T},\hat{R}) 来模拟环境动态。 当我们训练好这个局部动态模型后，除了昂贵地对环境进行采样之外，还可以低成本地从该模型中进行采样（参见图 7.23）。

sents.en: A straightforward idea is not to throw away the samples, but to store them in a buffer, and also sample from that buffer of older interaction results, or, slightly more advanced, to train a local surrogate model M = ( T ^ , R ^ ) M=(\hat{T},\hat{R}) of the environment dynamics.
sents.zh: 一个直接的想法不是丢弃样本，而是将它们存储在缓冲区中，并且也从这个包含旧交互结果的缓冲区中进行采样；或者，稍微高级一点的做法是，训练一个局部代理模型 M = ( T ^ , R ^ ) M=(\hat{T},\hat{R}) 来模拟环境动态。

sents.en: When we have trained this local dynamics model, we can also sample from the model, cheaply, in addition to sampling the environment, expensively (see Figure 7.23 ).
sents.zh: 当我们训练好这个局部动态模型后，除了昂贵地对环境进行采样之外，还可以低成本地从该模型中进行采样（参见图 7.23）。

paragraphs.en: These methods are indirect methods, since, in the last methods, where a local dynamics model is built up by the agent, the policy is learned indirectly (through a local model) from the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 这些方法属于间接方法，因为在最后提到的那些方法中，智能体会构建一个局部动态模型，而策略则是通过该局部模型从环境中间接学习的。

paragraphs.en: Using a local dynamics model is called model-based reinforcement learning. The dynamics model consist of local estimations T ^ \hat{T} and R ^ \hat{R} by the agent, estimates of the real T T and R R that are known only to the environment. Model-based reinforcement learning has been successful in some applications, such as Go [ Silver et al., 2016 ] , Diplomacy [ Bakhtin et al., 2022 ] , StarCraft [ Vinyals et al., 2019 ] , and showing learning across domains [ Hafner et al., 2020b ] .
paragraphs.zh: 使用局部动态模型被称为基于模型的强化学习。 动态模型由智能体对局部动态 T ^ \hat{T} 和奖励 R ^ \hat{R} 的估计组成，这些估计是对仅环境所知的真实 T T 和 R R 的近似。 基于模型的强化学习在某些应用中取得了成功，例如围棋 [ Silver et al., 2016 ]、外交 [ Bakhtin et al., 2022 ]、星际争霸 [ Vinyals et al., 2019 ]，并展示了跨领域的学习能力 [ Hafner et al., 2020b ]。

sents.en: Using a local dynamics model is called model-based reinforcement learning.
sents.zh: 使用局部动态模型被称为基于模型的强化学习。

sents.en: The dynamics model consist of local estimations T ^ \hat{T} and R ^ \hat{R} by the agent, estimates of the real T T and R R that are known only to the environment.
sents.zh: 动态模型由智能体对局部动态 T ^ \hat{T} 和奖励 R ^ \hat{R} 的估计组成，这些估计是对仅环境所知的真实 T T 和 R R 的近似。

sents.zh: 基于模型的强化学习在某些应用中取得了成功，例如围棋 [ Silver et al., 2016 ]、外交 [ Bakhtin et al., 2022 ]、星际争霸 [ Vinyals et al., 2019 ]，并展示了跨领域的学习能力 [ Hafner et al., 2020b ]。

paragraphs.en: Model-based reinforcement learning also connects to planning , a classic field in symbolic artificial intelligence, that looks ahead into the future, simulating different possible worlds using the efficient latent representation, without having to act in the real world.
paragraphs.zh: 基于模型的正强化学习也与规划领域相关，这是符号人工智能中的一个经典领域。规划通过高效的潜在表示对未来进行预测，模拟各种可能的世界，而无需在真实世界中采取行动。

paragraphs.en: In deep model-based reinforcement learning, the local dynamics models are also called world models [ Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ] . In this context world models reduce high dimensional observation spaces to lower dimensional state and reward spaces, that can then be used in model-based reinforcement learning methods to efficiently improve policy functions. The idea behind world models is that in most high-dimensional environments there are elements that are less important, such as, in a video game, trees in the background that never move, that have little or no relation to the value of the agent’s actions. The goal is to abstract away these unimportant elements of the input space, reducing the effective dimensionality of the state space.
paragraphs.zh: 在基于深度模型的政策强化学习中，局部动态模型也被称为世界模型 [ Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ]。 在此背景下，世界模型将高维观测空间降维为低维状态和奖励空间，这些空间随后可用于基于模型的政策强化学习方法中，以高效地改进策略函数。 世界模型的核心思想是：在大多数高维环境中，存在一些相对不重要的元素；例如，在电子游戏中，背景中静止不动的树木与智能体行动的价值几乎没有或完全没有关联。 其目标是抽象掉输入空间中这些不重要的元素，从而降低状态空间的有效维度。

sents.en: In deep model-based reinforcement learning, the local dynamics models are also called world models [ Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ] .
sents.zh: 在基于深度模型的政策强化学习中，局部动态模型也被称为世界模型 [ Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ]。

paragraphs.en: The joint embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) is proposed by LeCun and others [2022] and further refined in Assran et al. [2023] . The goal of JEPA is to predict future states in an abstract, compressed representation (latent space) rather than trying to recreate raw sensory details or pixels. This goal is similar to the dimension-reduction goal of a world model in model-based reinforcement learning. Where model-based reinforcement learning uses learns a local transition model supervised by rewards, JEPA is a self-supervised representation learning framework. JEPA is trained via self-supervised observation (watching videos or images) to map context embeddings to target embeddings without rewards or explicit actions. Model-based reinforcement learning explicitly incorporates actions, rewards, and control optimization to maximize the return [ Lim et al., 2026 ] . JEPA and reinforcement learning are close, JEPA can be used as a perception engine (world model) for reinforcement learning or planning algorithms, for example to guide robotic control [ Destrade et al., 2025 ] .
paragraphs.zh: LeCun 等人 [2022] 提出了联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），并在 Assran 等 [2023] 的研究中得到了进一步改进。 JEPA 的目标是在抽象的压缩表示（潜在空间）中预测未来状态，而不是试图重现原始感官细节或像素。 这一目标与基于模型强化学习中的世界模型的降维目标相似。 基于模型强化学习通过奖励进行监督以学习局部转移模型，而 JEPA 是一种自监督的表示学习框架。 JEPA 通过自监督观察（观看视频或图像）进行训练，将上下文嵌入映射到目标嵌入，无需奖励或显式动作。 基于模型强化学习明确地整合了动作、奖励和控制优化，以最大化回报 [Lim 等, 2026]。 JEPA 与强化学习关系密切，JEPA 可用作强化学习或规划算法的感知引擎（世界模型），例如用于指导机器人控制 [Destrade 等, 2025]。

paragraphs.en: In the context of model-based reinforcement learning, LLMs can be used in two different ways. We can use a pre-trained (static) LLM as world model ( T ^ , R ^ ) (\hat{T},\hat{R}) in model-based reinforcement learning (LLM4MBRL). Often this approach uses a tree search or MCTS planning. In this approach, the LLM is used to help reinforcement learning.
paragraphs.zh: 在基于模型的政策梯度学习背景下，大语言模型（LLM）可以以两种不同方式使用。 我们可以将预训练好的（静态）大语言模型用作世界模型（ T ^ , R ^ ）（\hat{T},\hat{R}），应用于基于模型的政策梯度学习（LLM4MBRL）。 这种方法通常会使用树搜索或蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）进行规划。 在这种方法中，大语言模型被用来辅助政策梯度学习。

sents.en: In the context of model-based reinforcement learning, LLMs can be used in two different ways.
sents.zh: 在基于模型的政策梯度学习背景下，大语言模型（LLM）可以以两种不同方式使用。

sents.en: We can use a pre-trained (static) LLM as world model ( T ^ , R ^ ) (\hat{T},\hat{R}) in model-based reinforcement learning (LLM4MBRL).
sents.zh: 我们可以将预训练好的（静态）大语言模型用作世界模型（ T ^ , R ^ ）（\hat{T},\hat{R}），应用于基于模型的政策梯度学习（LLM4MBRL）。

sents.zh: 这种方法通常会使用树搜索或蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）进行规划。

sents.en: In this approach, the LLM is used to help reinforcement learning.
sents.zh: 在这种方法中，大语言模型被用来辅助政策梯度学习。

paragraphs.en: Alternatively (model-based) reinforcement learning settings can be used to train LLM world models (MBRL4LLM) with feedback from world-interaction. Now, the LLM has become adaptive, either through an adaptive harness, or by posttraining the model itself, as in a VLA. This approach is also known as agentic world models, and holds much promise for agents to better understand their environment, to act in more realistic ways. In this approach, reinforcement learning is used to help agentic language modeling. This is an active area of research, see, for example, Zuo et al. [2026] , including their references. 5 5 5 There is a third connection between reinforcement learning and language modeling. Model-free reinforcement learning is also used inside the LLM training pipeline, for finetuning, as in RLHF and RLVR.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，也可以使用（基于模型的）强化学习设置，通过与世界交互的反馈来训练大型语言模型的世界模型（MBRL4LLM）。 如今，大型语言模型已经具备适应性，这可以通过自适应框架实现，也可以通过像 VLA 那样的模型后训练来实现。 这种方法也被称为智能体世界模型，它为智能体更好地理解环境、以更真实的方式行动带来了巨大希望。 在这种方法中，强化学习被用来辅助智能体语言建模。 这是一个活跃的研究领域，例如可参见 Zuo 等人。 [2026]，包括他们引用的文献。5 5 5 强化学习与语言建模之间还存在第三种联系。 无模型强化学习也被用于大型语言模型的训练流程中，用于微调，例如在 RLHF 和 RLVR 中。

paragraphs.en: Transformers can be trained on tokenized language data, but also on other tokenized data. In this chapter we have seen different model architectures for different modalities. Architecturally, the models were quite different. However, most models are transformer based, and tokenization approaches have been devised for a surprising difference in modalities. Let us review the different types of models to see what they have in common:
paragraphs.zh: 变换模型可以在经过分词的语言数据上进行训练，也可以在其他经过分词的数据上进行训练。 在本章中，我们已经了解了适用于不同模态的不同模型架构。 从架构上看，这些模型差异很大。 然而，大多数模型都基于变换模型，并且针对模态之间令人惊讶的差异，人们已经设计出了相应的分词方法。 让我们回顾一下不同类型的模型，看看它们的共同点：

sents.en: Transformers can be trained on tokenized language data, but also on other tokenized data.
sents.zh: 变换模型可以在经过分词的语言数据上进行训练，也可以在其他经过分词的数据上进行训练。

sents.en: In this chapter we have seen different model architectures for different modalities.
sents.zh: 在本章中，我们已经了解了适用于不同模态的不同模型架构。

sents.en: Architecturally, the models were quite different.
sents.zh: 从架构上看，这些模型差异很大。

sents.en: However, most models are transformer based, and tokenization approaches have been devised for a surprising difference in modalities.
sents.zh: 然而，大多数模型都基于变换模型，并且针对模态之间令人惊讶的差异，人们已经设计出了相应的分词方法。

sents.en: Let us review the different types of models to see what they have in common:
sents.zh: 让我们回顾一下不同类型的模型，看看它们的共同点：

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLM) are transformers that are pretrained on tokenized natural language .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）是预先在分词后的自然语言上进行预训练的 Transformer。

paragraphs.en: Vision language models (VLM) are models that consist of a transformer that is trained on tokenized vision data (or a diffusion model, or a convolutional network) and a transformer trained on tokenized natural language , whose embeddings come together in a joint decoder.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）是由一个在分词后的视觉数据上训练的变换器（或扩散模型，或卷积网络）和一个在分词后的自然语言上训练的变换器组成的模型，它们的嵌入向量共同进入一个联合解码器。

paragraphs.en: Decision transformers (DT) are transformers that are trained on tokenized ( s , a , r ) (s,a,r) -episodes of decision paths (see Section 20.1.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 决策变换器（DT）是一种在决策路径的标记化（s, a, r）（s,a,r）-片段上进行训练的变换器（参见第 20.1.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Vision language action models (VLA) are models that consist of a vision-language architecture that are also trained on tokenized ( s , a , r ) (s,a,r) episodes of robotic actions.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉语言动作模型（VLA）是一种由视觉语言架构组成的模型，该模型还基于经过分词处理的机器人动作序列（s, a, r）进行训练。

paragraphs.en: World models are models that consist of a vision-language architecture that are also trained on tokenized ( s , a , r ) (s,a,r) episodes of real world actions or decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型是由视觉-语言架构组成的模型，这些模型还基于真实世界中经过分词处理的 (s, a, r) 行为或决策片段进行训练。

paragraphs.en: There are other types of models that we have not discussed in this chapter. For example, a large music model (LMM) is a transformer that is pretrained on tokenized musical sequences (which can be either symbolic music (score sheets) or a soundtrack) [ Yuan et al., 2025 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 本章中尚未讨论过其他类型的模型。 例如，大型音乐模型（LMM）是一种在经过分词的音乐序列（可以是符号化音乐（乐谱）或音轨）上进行预训练的 Transformer [ Yuan et al., 2025 ]。

sents.en: There are other types of models that we have not discussed in this chapter.
sents.zh: 本章中尚未讨论过其他类型的模型。

sents.en: For example, a large music model (LMM) is a transformer that is pretrained on tokenized musical sequences (which can be either symbolic music (score sheets) or a soundtrack) [ Yuan et al., 2025 ] .

paragraphs.en: This chapter was devoted to advanced models for agents. We discussed language models that were pretrained and finetuned on vision and action. These models understand more of the world, allowing agents to achieve impressive generalization results. We have seen how the LLM, originally a language model, is becoming a world model, a term that is borrowed from the field of model-based reinforcement learning.
paragraphs.zh: 本章专门探讨了智能体的先进模型。 我们讨论了在视觉和动作数据上预训练并微调的语言模型。 这些模型对世界的理解更加深入，使智能体能够取得令人印象深刻的泛化效果。 我们已经看到，最初作为语言模型的 LLM 正在逐渐演变为世界模型，这一术语借用了基于模型强化学习领域的概念。

sents.en: This chapter was devoted to advanced models for agents.
sents.zh: 本章专门探讨了智能体的先进模型。

sents.en: We discussed language models that were pretrained and finetuned on vision and action.
sents.zh: 我们讨论了在视觉和动作数据上预训练并微调的语言模型。

sents.en: These models understand more of the world, allowing agents to achieve impressive generalization results.
sents.zh: 这些模型对世界的理解更加深入，使智能体能够取得令人印象深刻的泛化效果。

sents.en: We have seen how the LLM, originally a language model, is becoming a world model, a term that is borrowed from the field of model-based reinforcement learning.
sents.zh: 我们已经看到，最初作为语言模型的 LLM 正在逐渐演变为世界模型，这一术语借用了基于模型强化学习领域的概念。

paragraphs.en: At this point it might be good to look back on what we have seen so far. The first part of the book explained how to pretrain models self-referentially for language . Then, Chapter 6 explained how in-context learning emerged, and how it can be used for inference time multi-step reasoning and self-reflection. This chapter discussed pretraining and finetuning methods to yield multi-modal world models of the environment. Together, pretrained language, inference time reasoning, and finetuned world models enable agents more and more to act intelligently and achieve tasks in the world for their users.
paragraphs.zh: 此时，回顾一下我们迄今为止所看到的内容或许会有所帮助。 本书的第一部分解释了如何对模型进行自指性语言预训练。 接着，第 6 章解释了上下文学习是如何出现的，以及它如何能够用于推理时的多步推理和自我反思。 本章讨论了预训练和微调方法，以生成对环境的多模态世界模型。 综合来看，预训练的语言模型、推理时的推理能力以及经过微调的世界模型，使智能体能够越来越智能地行动，并为用户完成现实世界中的任务。

sents.en: At this point it might be good to look back on what we have seen so far.
sents.zh: 此时，回顾一下我们迄今为止所看到的内容或许会有所帮助。

sents.en: The first part of the book explained how to pretrain models self-referentially for language .
sents.zh: 本书的第一部分解释了如何对模型进行自指性语言预训练。

sents.en: Then, Chapter 6 explained how in-context learning emerged, and how it can be used for inference time multi-step reasoning and self-reflection.

sents.en: This chapter discussed pretraining and finetuning methods to yield multi-modal world models of the environment.
sents.zh: 本章讨论了预训练和微调方法，以生成对环境的多模态世界模型。

sents.en: Together, pretrained language, inference time reasoning, and finetuned world models enable agents more and more to act intelligently and achieve tasks in the world for their users.
sents.zh: 综合来看，预训练的语言模型、推理时的推理能力以及经过微调的世界模型，使智能体能够越来越智能地行动，并为用户完成现实世界中的任务。

paragraphs.en: We have now discussed many different modalities and training methods. In the next chapter we will take a step back and reflect on how agents can learn in a stable manner, while they are also acting in the world that they learn from.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在已经讨论了许多不同的模态和训练方法。 在下一章中，我们将退一步思考智能体如何能够以稳定的方式学习，同时也在它们所学习的这个世界中进行行动。
