sents.zh: 我们现在已经讨论了许多不同的模态和训练方法。

sents.en: In the next chapter we will take a step back and reflect on how agents can learn in a stable manner, while they are also acting in the world that they learn from.
sents.zh: 在下一章中，我们将退一步思考智能体如何能够以稳定的方式学习，同时也在它们所学习的这个世界中进行行动。

paragraphs.en: As we have seen, the self-reflecting LLM approaches are powerful, but getting the training processes to converge can be a challenge. In agentic LLM, learning occurs at multiple levels, and sometimes at the same time. In machine learning, algorithms that learn at multiple levels are said to perform metalearning. Metalearning is often described as learning to learn , for example, learning which prompt works better for a certain task. Metalearning can be a powerful concept, but sometimes the different learning levels interfere, and learning stops.
paragraphs.zh: 正如我们所见，自我反思的 LLM 方法虽然强大，但要使训练过程收敛却可能是一项挑战。 在智能体式 LLM 中，学习发生在多个层面，有时甚至同时发生。 在机器学习中，能够在多个层面学习的算法被称为执行元学习。 元学习通常被描述为“学习如何学习”，例如，学习哪种提示对特定任务更有效。 元学习可以是一个强大的概念，但有时不同层级的学习会相互干扰，导致学习过程停止。

sents.en: As we have seen, the self-reflecting LLM approaches are powerful, but getting the training processes to converge can be a challenge.
sents.zh: 正如我们所见，自我反思的 LLM 方法虽然强大，但要使训练过程收敛却可能是一项挑战。

sents.en: In agentic LLM, learning occurs at multiple levels, and sometimes at the same time.
sents.zh: 在智能体式 LLM 中，学习发生在多个层面，有时甚至同时发生。

sents.en: In machine learning, algorithms that learn at multiple levels are said to perform metalearning.
sents.zh: 在机器学习中，能够在多个层面学习的算法被称为执行元学习。

sents.en: Metalearning is often described as learning to learn , for example, learning which prompt works better for a certain task.
sents.zh: 元学习通常被描述为“学习如何学习”，例如，学习哪种提示对特定任务更有效。

sents.en: Metalearning can be a powerful concept, but sometimes the different learning levels interfere, and learning stops.
sents.zh: 元学习可以是一个强大的概念，但有时不同层级的学习会相互干扰，导致学习过程停止。

paragraphs.en: To help us understand why our LLM multi-level learning algorithms sometimes do not work, we will look deeper into metalearning. In this chapter we will discuss how we can improve the stability of dynamic, feedback-rich, metalearning approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 为了帮助我们理解为何我们的 LLM 多级学习算法有时无法正常工作，我们将更深入地探讨元学习。 在本章中，我们将讨论如何提升动态且富含反馈的元学习方法稳定性。

sents.en: To help us understand why our LLM multi-level learning algorithms sometimes do not work, we will look deeper into metalearning.
sents.zh: 为了帮助我们理解为何我们的 LLM 多级学习算法有时无法正常工作，我们将更深入地探讨元学习。

sents.en: In this chapter we will discuss how we can improve the stability of dynamic, feedback-rich, metalearning approaches.
sents.zh: 在本章中，我们将讨论如何提升动态且富含反馈的元学习方法稳定性。

paragraphs.en: The term metalearning is used for multi-level learning algorithms. Metalearning algorithms learn to learn, to quickly solve examples of new, unseen, tasks, that the model has not trained for.
paragraphs.zh: “元学习”这一术语用于指代多层级学习算法。 元学习算法能够学习如何学习，从而快速解决模型未曾训练过的新任务实例。

sents.en: The term metalearning is used for multi-level learning algorithms.
sents.zh: “元学习”这一术语用于指代多层级学习算法。

sents.en: Metalearning algorithms learn to learn, to quickly solve examples of new, unseen, tasks, that the model has not trained for.
sents.zh: 元学习算法能够学习如何学习，从而快速解决模型未曾训练过的新任务实例。

paragraphs.en: Metalearning has a long history in machine learning (see, for example, Schmidhuber [1987] , Hospedales et al. [2021] , Huisman et al. [2021] ). It is inspired by human learning, since humans are said to be able to learn how to learn. Another reason for its development, is speed.
paragraphs.zh: 元学习在机器学习领域拥有悠久的历史（例如，参见 Schmidhuber [1987]、Hospedales 等人 [2021] 以及 Huisman 等人 [2021]）。 它的灵感来自人类的学习，因为据说人类能够学会如何学习。 推动其发展的另一个原因是速度。

sents.en: Metalearning has a long history in machine learning (see, for example, Schmidhuber [1987] , Hospedales et al. [2021] , Huisman et al. [2021] ).
sents.zh: 元学习在机器学习领域拥有悠久的历史（例如，参见 Schmidhuber [1987]、Hospedales 等人 [2021] 以及 Huisman 等人 [2021]）。

sents.en: It is inspired by human learning, since humans are said to be able to learn how to learn.
sents.zh: 它的灵感来自人类的学习，因为据说人类能够学会如何学习。

sents.en: Another reason for its development, is speed.
sents.zh: 推动其发展的另一个原因是速度。

paragraphs.en: The problem is that regular deep learning is slow. Neural networks for typical deep learning tasks are large, with millions or billions of parameters, and training them requires large datasets, often with millions of examples. Training times for training a network from scratch are long, from hours to months, and only when special parallel parallel hardware (GPU) was employed, did deep learning become successful [ Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 问题在于，普通的深度学习速度很慢。 用于典型深度学习任务的神经网络规模庞大，包含数百万甚至数十亿个参数，而训练它们则需要大型数据集，通常包含数百万个样本。 从头开始训练一个网络的训练时间很长，从数小时到数月不等；直到使用了专门的并行硬件（GPU），深度学习才取得了成功 [ Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ]。

sents.en: The problem is that regular deep learning is slow.
sents.zh: 问题在于，普通的深度学习速度很慢。

sents.en: Neural networks for typical deep learning tasks are large, with millions or billions of parameters, and training them requires large datasets, often with millions of examples.
sents.zh: 用于典型深度学习任务的神经网络规模庞大，包含数百万甚至数十亿个参数，而训练它们则需要大型数据集，通常包含数百万个样本。

sents.en: Training times for training a network from scratch are long, from hours to months, and only when special parallel parallel hardware (GPU) was employed, did deep learning become successful [ Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ] .
sents.zh: 从头开始训练一个网络的训练时间很长，从数小时到数月不等；直到使用了专门的并行硬件（GPU），深度学习才取得了成功 [ Krizhevsky et al., 2012 ]。

paragraphs.en: At this point, researchers started dreaming about few-shot learning, methods that would achieve high accuracy by training on just a few examples.
paragraphs.zh: 到了这个时候，研究人员开始对少样本学习产生憧憬——这是一种仅通过少量示例训练就能实现高准确度的方法。

paragraphs.en: In machine learning, some algorithms are better suited for certain types of problems than others. Furthermore, most training algorithms have elements that can be tuned for performance, such as the learning rate, momentum, the initialization scheme of the parameters, or, for a multi-level algorithm, even the choice of the underlying training algorithm. These elements are called hyperparameters , and they govern how the algorithm learns. Would we be able to learn them?
paragraphs.zh: 在机器学习中，某些算法比其他算法更适合处理特定类型的问题。 此外，大多数训练算法都包含一些可以调整以提升性能的元素，例如学习率、动量、参数的初始化方案，或者对于多层级算法而言，甚至包括底层训练算法的选择。 这些元素被称为超参数，它们决定了算法的学习方式。 我们是否能够学会它们呢？

sents.en: In machine learning, some algorithms are better suited for certain types of problems than others.
sents.zh: 在机器学习中，某些算法比其他算法更适合处理特定类型的问题。

sents.en: Furthermore, most training algorithms have elements that can be tuned for performance, such as the learning rate, momentum, the initialization scheme of the parameters, or, for a multi-level algorithm, even the choice of the underlying training algorithm.
sents.zh: 此外，大多数训练算法都包含一些可以调整以提升性能的元素，例如学习率、动量、参数的初始化方案，或者对于多层级算法而言，甚至包括底层训练算法的选择。

sents.en: These elements are called hyperparameters , and they govern how the algorithm learns.
sents.zh: 这些元素被称为超参数，它们决定了算法的学习方式。

sents.en: Would we be able to learn them?
sents.zh: 我们是否能够学会它们呢？

paragraphs.en: Different types of problems require different hyperparameter settings. For example, for a smooth dataset, a high learning rate may work well, or a local search algorithm, but for a peaky dataset a lower learning rate works better, or a global search algorithm. The point is that the best hyperparameter configuration in machine learning depends on the task to be solved, and that, crucially, this configuration can be learned. Learning such hyperparameters of the algorithm for different tasks is called metalearning . (In contrast, the learning of the regular parameters of the model is now called base learning .)
paragraphs.zh: 不同类型的任务需要不同的超参数设置。 例如，对于平滑的数据集，较高的学习率或局部搜索算法可能效果良好；而对于峰谷密集的数据集，较低的学习率或全局搜索算法则更合适。 关键在于，机器学习中最佳的超参数配置取决于待解决的任务，而且这种配置是可以被学习的。 针对不同任务学习算法的此类超参数的过程被称为元学习。 （相比之下，模型常规参数的学习现在被称为基础学习。）

sents.en: Different types of problems require different hyperparameter settings.
sents.zh: 不同类型的任务需要不同的超参数设置。

sents.en: For example, for a smooth dataset, a high learning rate may work well, or a local search algorithm, but for a peaky dataset a lower learning rate works better, or a global search algorithm.
sents.zh: 例如，对于平滑的数据集，较高的学习率或局部搜索算法可能效果良好；而对于峰谷密集的数据集，较低的学习率或全局搜索算法则更合适。

sents.en: The point is that the best hyperparameter configuration in machine learning depends on the task to be solved, and that, crucially, this configuration can be learned.
sents.zh: 关键在于，机器学习中最佳的超参数配置取决于待解决的任务，而且这种配置是可以被学习的。

sents.en: Learning such hyperparameters of the algorithm for different tasks is called metalearning .
sents.zh: 针对不同任务学习算法的此类超参数的过程被称为元学习。

sents.en: (In contrast, the learning of the regular parameters of the model is now called base learning .)
sents.zh: （相比之下，模型常规参数的学习现在被称为基础学习。）

paragraphs.en: The aim of metalearning is to create algorithms that learn certain tasks faster. Instead of using a generic algorithm that is not adapted to the task, starting from scratch, we should use a learning algorithm whose hyperparameters are first matched to the type of task to be solved. The metalearning approach is to first learn from a set of related tasks how to configure the learning algorithm, learning to learn a certain set of tasks faster.
paragraphs.zh: 元学习的目标是创建能够更快学习特定任务的算法。 我们不应使用一个未针对任务进行优化、从头开始的通用算法，而应使用一种其超参数首先与待解决任务类型相匹配的学习算法。 元学习方法首先是通过对一组相关任务进行学习，掌握如何配置学习算法，从而学会更快地学习某一组特定任务。

sents.en: The aim of metalearning is to create algorithms that learn certain tasks faster.
sents.zh: 元学习的目标是创建能够更快学习特定任务的算法。

sents.en: Instead of using a generic algorithm that is not adapted to the task, starting from scratch, we should use a learning algorithm whose hyperparameters are first matched to the type of task to be solved.
sents.zh: 我们不应使用一个未针对任务进行优化、从头开始的通用算法，而应使用一种其超参数首先与待解决任务类型相匹配的学习算法。

sents.en: The metalearning approach is to first learn from a set of related tasks how to configure the learning algorithm, learning to learn a certain set of tasks faster.
sents.zh: 元学习方法首先是通过对一组相关任务进行学习，掌握如何配置学习算法，从而学会更快地学习某一组特定任务。

paragraphs.en: When we have learned the hyperparameter configuration for such an adapted algorithm, we may hope to be able to achieve few-shot training: being able to train on just a few examples, while still achieving high accuracy on examples from a new test task. Metalearning achieves few-shot learning by starting the training not from scratch, but from related knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦我们掌握了这种自适应算法的超参数配置，就可以期望实现少样本训练：即仅用少量样本进行训练，同时仍能在新的测试任务样本上达到高准确率。 元学习通过不从零开始训练，而是从相关知识出发，来实现少样本学习。

sents.en: When we have learned the hyperparameter configuration for such an adapted algorithm, we may hope to be able to achieve few-shot training: being able to train on just a few examples, while still achieving high accuracy on examples from a new test task.
sents.zh: 一旦我们掌握了这种自适应算法的超参数配置，就可以期望实现少样本训练：即仅用少量样本进行训练，同时仍能在新的测试任务样本上达到高准确率。

sents.en: Metalearning achieves few-shot learning by starting the training not from scratch, but from related knowledge.
sents.zh: 元学习通过不从零开始训练，而是从相关知识出发，来实现少样本学习。

paragraphs.en: Metalearning consists of a (hyper) training loop around a (base) training loop. In classical (non-neural network) machine learning, common hyperparameters are the learning rate, or algorithm selection, where different learning algorithms are tested on training tasks [ Brazdil et al., 2022 ] . In deep learning, the initialization of the neural network weights is often used [ Finn et al., 2017 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 元学习包含一个围绕（基础）训练循环的（超）参数训练循环。 在经典的（非神经网络）机器学习中，常见的超参数包括学习率或算法选择，即在不同的学习任务上测试不同的学习算法 [ Brazdil et al., 2022 ] 。 在深度学习中，神经网络的权重初始化常被用于此目的 [ Finn et al., 2017 ] 。

sents.en: Metalearning consists of a (hyper) training loop around a (base) training loop.
sents.zh: 元学习包含一个围绕（基础）训练循环的（超）参数训练循环。

sents.en: In classical (non-neural network) machine learning, common hyperparameters are the learning rate, or algorithm selection, where different learning algorithms are tested on training tasks [ Brazdil et al., 2022 ] .
sents.zh: 在经典的（非神经网络）机器学习中，常见的超参数包括学习率或算法选择，即在不同的学习任务上测试不同的学习算法 [ Brazdil et al., 2022 ] 。

sents.en: In deep learning, the initialization of the neural network weights is often used [ Finn et al., 2017 ] .
sents.zh: 在深度学习中，神经网络的权重初始化常被用于此目的 [ Finn et al., 2017 ] 。

paragraphs.en: In agentic LLM, we have also encountered learning at different levels (and we will continue to discuss multi-level learning in the next chapter). It is useful for us to study the theory and insights of the metalearning literature.
paragraphs.zh: 在智能体式大语言模型中，我们也遇到了不同层级的学习问题（我们将在下一章继续讨论多层级学习）。 研究元学习领域的理论与见解对我们很有帮助。

sents.en: In agentic LLM, we have also encountered learning at different levels (and we will continue to discuss multi-level learning in the next chapter).
sents.zh: 在智能体式大语言模型中，我们也遇到了不同层级的学习问题（我们将在下一章继续讨论多层级学习）。

sents.en: It is useful for us to study the theory and insights of the metalearning literature.
sents.zh: 研究元学习领域的理论与见解对我们很有帮助。

paragraphs.en: As any supervised learning approach, metalearning consists of (1) a meta- train phase, training on a variety of related tasks, and (2) a meta- test phase, testing on a new, unseen, task, to see how well it generalizes to this new task . The goal is to improve generalization by learning a hyperparameter setting of the training algorithm that work well on a wide variety of training tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 与任何监督学习方法一样，元学习包括（1）一个元训练阶段，即在各种相关任务上进行训练；以及（2）一个元测试阶段，即在一个新的、未见过的任务上进行测试，以观察其对该新任务的泛化能力。 其目标是通过学习一种在多种训练任务中表现良好的训练算法超参数设置，从而提升泛化能力。

sents.en: As any supervised learning approach, metalearning consists of (1) a meta- train phase, training on a variety of related tasks, and (2) a meta- test phase, testing on a new, unseen, task, to see how well it generalizes to this new task .
sents.zh: 与任何监督学习方法一样，元学习包括（1）一个元训练阶段，即在各种相关任务上进行训练；以及（2）一个元测试阶段，即在一个新的、未见过的任务上进行测试，以观察其对该新任务的泛化能力。

sents.en: The goal is to improve generalization by learning a hyperparameter setting of the training algorithm that work well on a wide variety of training tasks.
sents.zh: 其目标是通过学习一种在多种训练任务中表现良好的训练算法超参数设置，从而提升泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: The process of training the parameters of a model is implemented as an optimization loop, in which a loss-function is used to compute a difference between training examples and current model-estimates. The training algorithm loops over the dataset, each time adjusting the parameters of the model, with the goal to minimize the sum of the loss.
paragraphs.zh: 模型参数训练的过程被实现为一个优化循环，其中使用损失函数来计算训练样本与当前模型估计值之间的差异。 训练算法会遍历数据集，每次调整模型的参数，其目标是使损失总和最小化。

sents.en: The process of training the parameters of a model is implemented as an optimization loop, in which a loss-function is used to compute a difference between training examples and current model-estimates.
sents.zh: 模型参数训练的过程被实现为一个优化循环，其中使用损失函数来计算训练样本与当前模型估计值之间的差异。

sents.en: The training algorithm loops over the dataset, each time adjusting the parameters of the model, with the goal to minimize the sum of the loss.
sents.zh: 训练算法会遍历数据集，每次调整模型的参数，其目标是使损失总和最小化。

paragraphs.en: The learning-to-learn concept consists of two loops: an inner training loop to optimize the model’s parameters, and an outer training loop to optimize the algorithm’s hyperparameters. The inner loop optimizes parameters over the examples of one task, the outer loop optimizes hyperparameters over the set of tasks of an application domain.
paragraphs.zh: 学习如何学习的概念包含两个循环：一个用于优化模型参数的内部训练循环，以及一个用于优化算法超参数的外部训练循环。 内部循环基于单个任务的示例来优化参数，而外部循环则基于应用领域的任务集合来优化超参数。

sents.en: The learning-to-learn concept consists of two loops: an inner training loop to optimize the model’s parameters, and an outer training loop to optimize the algorithm’s hyperparameters.
sents.zh: 学习如何学习的概念包含两个循环：一个用于优化模型参数的内部训练循环，以及一个用于优化算法超参数的外部训练循环。

sents.en: The inner loop optimizes parameters over the examples of one task, the outer loop optimizes hyperparameters over the set of tasks of an application domain.
sents.zh: 内部循环基于单个任务的示例来优化参数，而外部循环则基于应用领域的任务集合来优化超参数。

paragraphs.en: Each base-learning task 𝒯 i \mathcal{T}_{i} has a dataset D i D_{i} and a learning objective, the loss function ℒ i \mathcal{L}_{i} . Thus 𝒯 i = ( D i , ℒ i ) \mathcal{T}_{i}=(D_{i},\mathcal{L}_{i}) . Each dataset consists of pairs of input-examples and labels D i = { ( x j , y j ) } D_{i}=\{(x_{j},y_{j})\} , and is split into a training and a testset D i = { D i , t ​ r ​ a ​ i ​ n , D i , t ​ e ​ s ​ t } D_{i}=\{D_{i,train},D_{i,test}\} . On each training dataset a parameterized model f ^ θ i ​ ( D i , t ​ r ​ a ​ i ​ n ) \hat{f}_{\theta_{i}}(D_{i,{train}}) is estimated, with a loss function ℒ i ​ ( θ i , D i , t ​ r ​ a ​ i ​ n ) \mathcal{L}_{i}(\theta_{i},D_{i,{train}}) . The model f ^ \hat{f} is approximated with an algorithm that is governed by a set of hyperparameters ω \omega . The particular hyperparameters vary from algorithm to algorithm, but frequently encountered hyperparameters are the learning rate α \alpha , the initial parameters θ 0 \theta_{0} , and algorithm constants.
paragraphs.zh: 每个基础学习任务 𝒯 i \mathcal{T}_{i} 都包含一个数据集 D i D_{i} 和一个学习目标，即损失函数 ℒ i \mathcal{L}_{i}。 因此，𝒯 i = ( D i , ℒ i ) \mathcal{T}_{i}=(D_{i},\mathcal{L}_{i})。 每个数据集由输入示例与标签的配对组成，即 D i = { ( x j , y j ) } D_{i}=\{(x_{j},y_{j})\}，并划分为训练集和测试集：D i = { D i , t ​ r ​ a ​ i ​ n , D i , t ​ e ​ s ​ t } D_{i}=\{D_{i,train},D_{i,test}\}。 在每个训练数据集上，会估计一个参数化模型 f ^ θ i ​ ( D i , t ​ r ​ a ​ i ​ n ) \hat{f}_{\theta_{i}}(D_{i,{train}})，并使用损失函数 ℒ i ​ ( θ i , D i , t ​ r ​ a ​ i ​ n ) \mathcal{L}_{i}(\theta_{i},D_{i,{train}})。 模型 f ^ \hat{f} 通过一个由一组超参数 ω \omega 控制的算法进行近似。 具体的超参数因算法而异，但常见的超参数包括学习率 α \alpha、初始参数 θ 0 \theta_{0} 以及算法常数。

sents.en: Each base-learning task 𝒯 i \mathcal{T}_{i} has a dataset D i D_{i} and a learning objective, the loss function ℒ i \mathcal{L}_{i} .
sents.zh: 每个基础学习任务 𝒯 i \mathcal{T}_{i} 都包含一个数据集 D i D_{i} 和一个学习目标，即损失函数 ℒ i \mathcal{L}_{i}。

sents.en: Thus 𝒯 i = ( D i , ℒ i ) \mathcal{T}_{i}=(D_{i},\mathcal{L}_{i}) .
sents.zh: 因此，𝒯 i = ( D i , ℒ i ) \mathcal{T}_{i}=(D_{i},\mathcal{L}_{i})。

sents.en: Each dataset consists of pairs of input-examples and labels D i = { ( x j , y j ) } D_{i}=\{(x_{j},y_{j})\} , and is split into a training and a testset D i = { D i , t ​ r ​ a ​ i ​ n , D i , t ​ e ​ s ​ t } D_{i}=\{D_{i,train},D_{i,test}\} .
sents.zh: 每个数据集由输入示例与标签的配对组成，即 D i = { ( x j , y j ) } D_{i}=\{(x_{j},y_{j})\}，并划分为训练集和测试集：D i = { D i , t ​ r ​ a ​ i ​ n , D i , t ​ e ​ s ​ t } D_{i}=\{D_{i,train},D_{i,test}\}。

sents.en: On each training dataset a parameterized model f ^ θ i ​ ( D i , t ​ r ​ a ​ i ​ n ) \hat{f}_{\theta_{i}}(D_{i,{train}}) is estimated, with a loss function ℒ i ​ ( θ i , D i , t ​ r ​ a ​ i ​ n ) \mathcal{L}_{i}(\theta_{i},D_{i,{train}}) .
sents.zh: 在每个训练数据集上，会估计一个参数化模型 f ^ θ i ​ ( D i , t ​ r ​ a ​ i ​ n ) \hat{f}_{\theta_{i}}(D_{i,{train}})，并使用损失函数 ℒ i ​ ( θ i , D i , t ​ r ​ a ​ i ​ n ) \mathcal{L}_{i}(\theta_{i},D_{i,{train}})。

sents.en: The model f ^ \hat{f} is approximated with an algorithm that is governed by a set of hyperparameters ω \omega .
sents.zh: 模型 f ^ \hat{f} 通过一个由一组超参数 ω \omega 控制的算法进行近似。

sents.en: The particular hyperparameters vary from algorithm to algorithm, but frequently encountered hyperparameters are the learning rate α \alpha , the initial parameters θ 0 \theta_{0} , and algorithm constants.
sents.zh: 具体的超参数因算法而异，但常见的超参数包括学习率 α \alpha、初始参数 θ 0 \theta_{0} 以及算法常数。

paragraphs.en: The inner loop optimizes the base-parameters θ \theta , and the outer loop optimizes the hyperparameters ω \omega to find the best performance on the set of base tasks with the appropriate test data:
paragraphs.zh: 内循环优化基础参数 θ \theta，而外循环则优化超参数 ω \omega，以在适当的测试数据上找到基础任务集合中的最佳性能：

paragraphs.en: The inner loop optimizes θ i \theta_{i} within the datasets D i D_{i} of the tasks 𝒯 i \mathcal{T}_{i} , and the outer loop optimizes ω \omega across the tasks and datasets. The outcome of the meta optimization is a set of optimal hyperparameters ω ⋆ \omega^{\star} .
paragraphs.zh: 内循环在任务 𝒯 i \mathcal{T}_{i} 的数据集 D i D_{i} 中优化 θ i \theta_{i}，而外循环则跨所有任务和数据集优化 ω \omega。 元优化的结果是一组最优超参数 ω ⋆ \omega^{\star}。

sents.en: The inner loop optimizes θ i \theta_{i} within the datasets D i D_{i} of the tasks 𝒯 i \mathcal{T}_{i} , and the outer loop optimizes ω \omega across the tasks and datasets.
sents.zh: 内循环在任务 𝒯 i \mathcal{T}_{i} 的数据集 D i D_{i} 中优化 θ i \theta_{i}，而外循环则跨所有任务和数据集优化 ω \omega。

sents.en: The outcome of the meta optimization is a set of optimal hyperparameters ω ⋆ \omega^{\star} .
sents.zh: 元优化的结果是一组最优超参数 ω ⋆ \omega^{\star}。

paragraphs.en: After metalearning has finished, we have a hyperparameter set (tuned algorithm) that works well for a set of tasks in an application domain, and we can assume that it will generalize well, after training on just a few examples of a new task, scoring high accuracy on testing an unseen example.
paragraphs.zh: 元学习完成后，我们便得到一组超参数（经过调优的算法），该算法能很好地适用于某一应用领域中的一系列任务。我们可以认为，在仅用新任务的少数几个示例进行训练后，它仍能良好泛化，并在对未见示例的测试中取得高准确率。

paragraphs.en: There is an important connection between metalearning and transfer learning. Transfer learning pretrains the neural network on a single task, and then performs a transfer of the weights to a quick finetuning phase. Transfer learning can thus be regarded as a single iteration of a network-initialization-based metalearning approach: transfer learning is metalearning with just one base learning task.
paragraphs.zh: 元学习与迁移学习之间存在一个重要联系。 迁移学习先在一个单一任务上对神经网络进行预训练，然后将权重迁移到快速的微调阶段。 因此，迁移学习可以被视为一种基于网络初始化的元学习方法中的单次迭代：迁移学习就是仅包含一个基础学习任务的元学习。

sents.en: There is an important connection between metalearning and transfer learning.
sents.zh: 元学习与迁移学习之间存在一个重要联系。

sents.en: Transfer learning pretrains the neural network on a single task, and then performs a transfer of the weights to a quick finetuning phase.
sents.zh: 迁移学习先在一个单一任务上对神经网络进行预训练，然后将权重迁移到快速的微调阶段。

sents.en: Transfer learning can thus be regarded as a single iteration of a network-initialization-based metalearning approach: transfer learning is metalearning with just one base learning task.
sents.zh: 因此，迁移学习可以被视为一种基于网络初始化的元学习方法中的单次迭代：迁移学习就是仅包含一个基础学习任务的元学习。

paragraphs.en: In the field of LLM, we encounter metalearning in many places. A common metalearning approach is to initialize the model parameters to earlier learned knowledge, so that they may train faster on a related task. This is transfer learning, that we find in every standard LLM training pipeline, in the pretrain/finetune phases, where we take the pretrained parameters and finetune them further for a specific task. Metalearning is repeated finetuning, and large language models are a prime example of a metalearning training pipeline that achieves that major goal of machine learning: few-shot learning. In-context learning was one of the major breakthroughs of machine learning [ Brown et al., 2020 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在大型语言模型（LLM）领域，我们在许多地方都会遇到元学习。 一种常见的元学习方法是将模型参数初始化为先前学到的知识，这样它们就能在相关任务上更快地进行训练。 这就是迁移学习，我们在每个标准的大型语言模型训练流程中都能找到它，即预训练/微调阶段：我们使用预训练的参数，并针对特定任务进一步进行微调。 元学习是反复进行的微调，而大型语言模型正是元学习训练流程的一个典型范例，它实现了机器学习的主要目标：少样本学习。 上下文内学习是机器学习的重大突破之一 [Brown et al., 2020]。

sents.en: In the field of LLM, we encounter metalearning in many places.
sents.zh: 在大型语言模型（LLM）领域，我们在许多地方都会遇到元学习。

sents.en: A common metalearning approach is to initialize the model parameters to earlier learned knowledge, so that they may train faster on a related task.
sents.zh: 一种常见的元学习方法是将模型参数初始化为先前学到的知识，这样它们就能在相关任务上更快地进行训练。

sents.en: This is transfer learning, that we find in every standard LLM training pipeline, in the pretrain/finetune phases, where we take the pretrained parameters and finetune them further for a specific task.
sents.zh: 这就是迁移学习，我们在每个标准的大型语言模型训练流程中都能找到它，即预训练/微调阶段：我们使用预训练的参数，并针对特定任务进一步进行微调。

sents.en: Metalearning is repeated finetuning, and large language models are a prime example of a metalearning training pipeline that achieves that major goal of machine learning: few-shot learning.
sents.zh: 元学习是反复进行的微调，而大型语言模型正是元学习训练流程的一个典型范例，它实现了机器学习的主要目标：少样本学习。

sents.en: In-context learning was one of the major breakthroughs of machine learning [ Brown et al., 2020 ] .
sents.zh: 上下文内学习是机器学习的重大突破之一 [Brown et al., 2020]。

paragraphs.en: When we go to agentic LLM, few-shot learning occurs in many other places as well. We will discuss both static and dynamic forms of metalearning. In static metalearning, weights in inner loops are not influenced by other loops. In dynamic metalearning, they are.
paragraphs.zh: 当我们转向智能体式大语言模型时，少样本学习也出现在许多其他场景中。 我们将讨论元学习的静态和动态形式。 在静态元学习中，内循环中的权重不受其他循环的影响。 而在动态元学习中，它们则会受到影响。

sents.en: When we go to agentic LLM, few-shot learning occurs in many other places as well.
sents.zh: 当我们转向智能体式大语言模型时，少样本学习也出现在许多其他场景中。

sents.en: We will discuss both static and dynamic forms of metalearning.
sents.zh: 我们将讨论元学习的静态和动态形式。

sents.en: In static metalearning, weights in inner loops are not influenced by other loops.
sents.zh: 在静态元学习中，内循环中的权重不受其他循环的影响。

sents.en: In dynamic metalearning, they are.
sents.zh: 而在动态元学习中，它们则会受到影响。

paragraphs.en: We start by reviewing some examples of static LLM metalearning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先回顾一些静态 LLM 元学习示例。

paragraphs.en: The regular LLM training pipeline is a good example of an elaborate, multi-phase, transfer learning scheme. It achieves good zero-shot performance, in the sense that it can answer many regular queries accurately— where was Mozart born? —based on the pretrained and finetuned knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 常规的 LLM 训练流程是复杂、多阶段迁移学习方案的一个良好示例。 它能实现良好的零样本性能，也就是说，基于预训练和微调后的知识，它可以准确回答许多常规问题——例如，莫扎特出生在哪里？

sents.en: The regular LLM training pipeline is a good example of an elaborate, multi-phase, transfer learning scheme.
sents.zh: 常规的 LLM 训练流程是复杂、多阶段迁移学习方案的一个良好示例。

sents.en: It achieves good zero-shot performance, in the sense that it can answer many regular queries accurately— where was Mozart born? —based on the pretrained and finetuned knowledge.
sents.zh: 它能实现良好的零样本性能，也就是说，基于预训练和微调后的知识，它可以准确回答许多常规问题——例如，莫扎特出生在哪里？

paragraphs.en: The different phases in the pipeline are the inner optimization loops, and the choices of which weights to transfer, and the manual choices of how to finetune in the subsequent phases, can be considered as the outer loop hyperparameter choices.
paragraphs.zh: 流程中的不同阶段包括内部优化循环、选择要转移的权重，以及在后续阶段中手动决定如何进行微调；这些都可以被视为外部循环的超参数选择。

paragraphs.en: This is a static form of metalearning, since the weights, once trained in a phase, are not influenced by training results of later phases. Weights are stable between phases of the pipeline. The pipeline is a purely sequential training process.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一种静态的元学习形式，因为一旦在某个阶段训练完成，权重就不会受到后续阶段训练结果的影响。 在流程的各个阶段之间，权重保持稳定。 该流程是一个完全顺序的训练过程。

sents.en: This is a static form of metalearning, since the weights, once trained in a phase, are not influenced by training results of later phases.
sents.zh: 这是一种静态的元学习形式，因为一旦在某个阶段训练完成，权重就不会受到后续阶段训练结果的影响。

sents.en: Weights are stable between phases of the pipeline.
sents.zh: 在流程的各个阶段之间，权重保持稳定。

sents.en: The pipeline is a purely sequential training process.
sents.zh: 该流程是一个完全顺序的训练过程。

paragraphs.en: Going beyond zero-shot learning, in-context learning is a form of few-shot learning where a few training examples are provided by the user, prompting the LLM to infer a better answer. The pretrained model is the inner loop, the examples in the prompt guide the outer loop.
paragraphs.zh: 除了零样本学习之外，上下文学习是一种小样本学习的形式，其中用户会提供几个训练示例，从而引导大型语言模型推断出更准确的答案。 预训练模型是内循环，而提示中的示例则指导外循环。

sents.en: Going beyond zero-shot learning, in-context learning is a form of few-shot learning where a few training examples are provided by the user, prompting the LLM to infer a better answer.
sents.zh: 除了零样本学习之外，上下文学习是一种小样本学习的形式，其中用户会提供几个训练示例，从而引导大型语言模型推断出更准确的答案。

sents.en: The pretrained model is the inner loop, the examples in the prompt guide the outer loop.
sents.zh: 预训练模型是内循环，而提示中的示例则指导外循环。

paragraphs.en: This is a static form of metalearning, since the values of the weights of the model are not influenced by the examples in the prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一种静态的元学习形式，因为模型权重的值不会受到提示中示例的影响。

paragraphs.en: Regular in-context learning provides facts as few-shot examples; it is content-focused. Chain of thought provides process-steps as few-shot examples, it is process-focused.
paragraphs.zh: 常规上下文学习以事实作为少样本示例；它侧重于内容。 思维链以过程步骤作为少样本示例，它侧重于过程。

sents.en: Regular in-context learning provides facts as few-shot examples; it is content-focused.
sents.zh: 常规上下文学习以事实作为少样本示例；它侧重于内容。

sents.en: Chain of thought provides process-steps as few-shot examples, it is process-focused.
sents.zh: 思维链以过程步骤作为少样本示例，它侧重于过程。

paragraphs.en: Again, the pretrained model is the inner loop, the examples in the prompt guide the outer loop, and the weights of the model are static.
paragraphs.zh: 同样地，预训练模型是内循环，提示中的示例指导外循环，而模型的权重是静态的。

paragraphs.en: The regular LLM pipeline consists of transfer learning phases (inner loops), that run in sequence. Once an inner training loop has converged, that phase is not run again. The pipeline is a form of static metalearning. (The results of finetuning are not fed back into the pretrainer again, nor is the pretrainer ran with adjusted hyperparameters based on the finetuning results. The different training phases can not interfere.)
paragraphs.zh: 标准的 LLM 流程由一系列依次执行的迁移学习阶段（内部循环）组成。 一旦某个内部训练循环收敛，该阶段就不会再次运行。 这种流程属于一种静态的元学习形式。 （微调的结果不会重新输入预训练器，也不会根据微调结果调整超参数后重新运行预训练器。 不同的训练阶段之间无法相互干扰。）

sents.en: The regular LLM pipeline consists of transfer learning phases (inner loops), that run in sequence.
sents.zh: 标准的 LLM 流程由一系列依次执行的迁移学习阶段（内部循环）组成。

sents.en: Once an inner training loop has converged, that phase is not run again.
sents.zh: 一旦某个内部训练循环收敛，该阶段就不会再次运行。

sents.en: The pipeline is a form of static metalearning.
sents.zh: 这种流程属于一种静态的元学习形式。

sents.en: (The results of finetuning are not fed back into the pretrainer again, nor is the pretrainer ran with adjusted hyperparameters based on the finetuning results.
sents.zh: （微调的结果不会重新输入预训练器，也不会根据微调结果调整超参数后重新运行预训练器。

sents.en: The different training phases can not interfere.)
sents.zh: 不同的训练阶段之间无法相互干扰。）

paragraphs.en: In contrast to static metalearning, there is also dynamic metalearning, where different iterations do interfere.
paragraphs.zh: 与静态元学习不同，还存在动态元学习，其中不同的迭代之间会相互影响。

paragraphs.en: In agentic LLMs different forms of dynamic metalearning are used. In dynamic metalearning the iterations are run concurrently, and can have destabilizing effects on each other’s convergence process.
paragraphs.zh: 在智能体式大型语言模型中，会采用不同形式的动态元学习。 在动态元学习中，迭代过程是并行运行的，并且可能对彼此的收敛过程产生不稳定的影响。

sents.en: In agentic LLMs different forms of dynamic metalearning are used.
sents.zh: 在智能体式大型语言模型中，会采用不同形式的动态元学习。

sents.en: In dynamic metalearning the iterations are run concurrently, and can have destabilizing effects on each other’s convergence process.
sents.zh: 在动态元学习中，迭代过程是并行运行的，并且可能对彼此的收敛过程产生不稳定的影响。

paragraphs.en: In previous chapters, we have discussed self-reflection, and RLVR. These are approaches where an inner loop can be changed by an outer loop, and results of one inner loop may affect another inner loop. We have created a moving training target. This may cause unstable divergence of the training process. Training results may also appear brittle: they react greatly to small changes in input values or hyperparameters, such as different random seeds, different prompt reformulations, or even changes in the length of the metalearning process itself. Furthermore, hallucinating tendencies of the base LLM may be amplified when the same model is used in different roles, such as for correction and for generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在之前的章节中，我们已经讨论了自我反思和 RLVR。 这些方法允许外层循环修改内层循环，且一个内层循环的结果可能会影响另一个内层循环。 我们创建了一个动态的训练目标。 这可能导致训练过程出现不稳定的发散。 训练结果也可能显得脆弱：它们对输入值或超参数的小幅变化（例如不同的随机种子、不同的提示重构，甚至元学习过程本身的长度变化）会产生强烈反应。 此外，当同一模型被用于不同角色（如纠错和生成）时，基础 LLM 的幻觉倾向可能会被放大。

sents.en: In previous chapters, we have discussed self-reflection, and RLVR.
sents.zh: 在之前的章节中，我们已经讨论了自我反思和 RLVR。

sents.en: These are approaches where an inner loop can be changed by an outer loop, and results of one inner loop may affect another inner loop.
sents.zh: 这些方法允许外层循环修改内层循环，且一个内层循环的结果可能会影响另一个内层循环。

sents.en: We have created a moving training target.
sents.zh: 我们创建了一个动态的训练目标。

sents.en: This may cause unstable divergence of the training process.
sents.zh: 这可能导致训练过程出现不稳定的发散。

sents.en: Training results may also appear brittle: they react greatly to small changes in input values or hyperparameters, such as different random seeds, different prompt reformulations, or even changes in the length of the metalearning process itself.
sents.zh: 训练结果也可能显得脆弱：它们对输入值或超参数的小幅变化（例如不同的随机种子、不同的提示重构，甚至元学习过程本身的长度变化）会产生强烈反应。

sents.en: Furthermore, hallucinating tendencies of the base LLM may be amplified when the same model is used in different roles, such as for correction and for generation.
sents.zh: 此外，当同一模型被用于不同角色（如纠错和生成）时，基础 LLM 的幻觉倾向可能会被放大。

paragraphs.en: Let us discuss the examples of dynamic metalearning in agentic LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 我们来讨论智能体大语言模型中动态元学习的一些例子。

paragraphs.en: In self-reflection (Section 6.2.4.2 ) an agentic harness performs prompt management, calling the LLM in different roles, such as, to evaluate a state, and to refine an answer.
paragraphs.zh: 在自我反思（第 6.2.4.2 节）中，智能体框架会执行提示管理，以不同角色调用大语言模型（LLM），例如评估状态和精炼答案。

paragraphs.en: In metalearning terms, the model is the inner training loop, and the harness the outer loop. Although the model itself is static, it is called with different prompts, and the answers of the model are used by the harness to produce new prompts. Therefore, the prompt results (outer loops) start interfering, and may interact in non-linear and non-intuitive ways.
paragraphs.zh: 从元学习角度来看，模型是内部训练循环，而外壳则是外部循环。 尽管模型本身是静态的，但它会接收不同的提示，而模型的回答会被外壳用来生成新的提示。 因此，提示结果（外部循环）开始相互干扰，并可能以非线性且非直观的方式相互作用。

sents.en: In metalearning terms, the model is the inner training loop, and the harness the outer loop.
sents.zh: 从元学习角度来看，模型是内部训练循环，而外壳则是外部循环。

sents.en: Although the model itself is static, it is called with different prompts, and the answers of the model are used by the harness to produce new prompts.
sents.zh: 尽管模型本身是静态的，但它会接收不同的提示，而模型的回答会被外壳用来生成新的提示。

sents.en: Therefore, the prompt results (outer loops) start interfering, and may interact in non-linear and non-intuitive ways.
sents.zh: 因此，提示结果（外部循环）开始相互干扰，并可能以非线性且非直观的方式相互作用。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, when the same model is used for different roles, imperfections (biases, hallucinations) may be amplified.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，当同一模型被用于不同角色时，其不完美之处（偏见、幻觉）可能会被放大。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR, Section 6.2.4.3 ) is a popular training scheme for code and math applications, where inference-time reasoning results are used for finetuning at training-time.
paragraphs.zh: 具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR，第 6.2.4.3 节）是一种用于代码和数学应用的流行训练方案，其中推理时的推理结果被用于训练时的微调。

paragraphs.en: In metalearning terms, finetuning is the inner loop, and inference-time reasoning is the outer loop. RLVR uses outer loop results in the inner loop, feeding inference results into the training phase, mixing two learning processes. Care should be taken to prevent that inference time errors, which are used as truths, are amplified in the finetuning/inference loop.
paragraphs.zh: 从元学习角度来看，微调是内循环，而推理时的推理则是外循环。 RLVR 将外循环的结果用于内循环，将推理结果输入训练阶段，从而将两种学习过程融合在一起。 需要注意防止推理阶段的错误被当作正确答案，在微调/推理循环中被进一步放大。

sents.en: In metalearning terms, finetuning is the inner loop, and inference-time reasoning is the outer loop.
sents.zh: 从元学习角度来看，微调是内循环，而推理时的推理则是外循环。

sents.en: RLVR uses outer loop results in the inner loop, feeding inference results into the training phase, mixing two learning processes.
sents.zh: RLVR 将外循环的结果用于内循环，将推理结果输入训练阶段，从而将两种学习过程融合在一起。

sents.en: Care should be taken to prevent that inference time errors, which are used as truths, are amplified in the finetuning/inference loop.
sents.zh: 需要注意防止推理阶段的错误被当作正确答案，在微调/推理循环中被进一步放大。

paragraphs.en: Unstable training occurs when inner/outer interference is under-damped. When this happens, oscillation between inner loops and outer loops may grow larger, instead of dying out.
paragraphs.zh: 当内层/外层干扰处于欠阻尼状态时，会发生不稳定的训练。 当这种情况发生时，内层循环与外层循环之间的振荡可能会不断增大，而不是逐渐消失。

sents.en: Unstable training occurs when inner/outer interference is under-damped.
sents.zh: 当内层/外层干扰处于欠阻尼状态时，会发生不稳定的训练。

sents.en: When this happens, oscillation between inner loops and outer loops may grow larger, instead of dying out.
sents.zh: 当这种情况发生时，内层循环与外层循环之间的振荡可能会不断增大，而不是逐渐消失。

paragraphs.en: This problem can be mitigated by increased damping, or by decoupling the time by which different inner loops move. For example, the learning rates of one of the loops may be reduced, or the parameters of some of the inner loops may be kept stable for a longer time than the other loops. Another idea is to use a mixture of model types or sizes, such as in Mixture-of-Experts [ Jiang et al., 2024 ] . A student/teacher setup deliberately uses a stronger and a weaker model for the different roles. By using different models, we may hope to dampen hallucinations and interference between inner loops.
paragraphs.zh: 这个问题可以通过增加阻尼，或者通过解耦不同内环的移动时间来缓解。 例如，可以降低其中一个循环的学习率，或者让某些内环的参数比其他循环更长时间地保持稳定。 另一种思路是使用混合的模型类型或大小，例如在“专家混合”方法中 [ Jiang et al., 2024 ]。 学生/教师设置会刻意为不同角色使用一个更强和一个较弱的模型。 通过使用不同的模型，我们或许能够抑制内环之间的幻觉和干扰。

sents.en: This problem can be mitigated by increased damping, or by decoupling the time by which different inner loops move.
sents.zh: 这个问题可以通过增加阻尼，或者通过解耦不同内环的移动时间来缓解。

sents.en: For example, the learning rates of one of the loops may be reduced, or the parameters of some of the inner loops may be kept stable for a longer time than the other loops.
sents.zh: 例如，可以降低其中一个循环的学习率，或者让某些内环的参数比其他循环更长时间地保持稳定。

sents.en: Another idea is to use a mixture of model types or sizes, such as in Mixture-of-Experts [ Jiang et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 另一种思路是使用混合的模型类型或大小，例如在“专家混合”方法中 [ Jiang et al., 2024 ]。

sents.en: A student/teacher setup deliberately uses a stronger and a weaker model for the different roles.
sents.zh: 学生/教师设置会刻意为不同角色使用一个更强和一个较弱的模型。

sents.en: By using different models, we may hope to dampen hallucinations and interference between inner loops.
sents.zh: 通过使用不同的模型，我们或许能够抑制内环之间的幻觉和干扰。

paragraphs.en: In general, when metalearning misbehaves, we should aim to create more diversity, to stimulate exploration, and to prevent greedy behavior that leads to local optima or divergent training. These solutions often require much experimentation to build up intuition about the problem. Debugging agentic LLMs can be challenging.
paragraphs.zh: 通常来说，当元学习出现异常时，我们应该致力于创造更多多样性，以激发探索行为，并防止导致局部最优或训练发散的贪婪行为。 这些解决方案通常需要大量实验，才能对问题建立起直观理解。 调试智能体式的大语言模型可能充满挑战。

sents.en: In general, when metalearning misbehaves, we should aim to create more diversity, to stimulate exploration, and to prevent greedy behavior that leads to local optima or divergent training.
sents.zh: 通常来说，当元学习出现异常时，我们应该致力于创造更多多样性，以激发探索行为，并防止导致局部最优或训练发散的贪婪行为。

sents.en: These solutions often require much experimentation to build up intuition about the problem.
sents.zh: 这些解决方案通常需要大量实验，才能对问题建立起直观理解。

sents.en: Debugging agentic LLMs can be challenging.
sents.zh: 调试智能体式的大语言模型可能充满挑战。

paragraphs.en: As we have seen, we can understand LLM-training as a form of metalearning. Regular LLM training is a form of transfer learning, and inference-time reasoning and training, as is used in agentic LLM, use even more metalearning ideas. Although dynamic metalearning approaches (such as self-reflection) are a powerful concept, care should be taken since interference between inner and outer loops may destabilize the training process. This may happen unexpectedly, in agents that were previously behaving.
paragraphs.zh: 正如我们所见，我们可以将 LLM 训练理解为一种元学习形式。 常规的 LLM 训练是一种迁移学习形式，而推理时的推理与训练（如智能体式 LLM 中所使用的）则应用了更多元学习的理念。 尽管动态的元学习方法（例如自我反思）是一个强大的概念，但仍需谨慎，因为内部循环与外部循环之间的干扰可能会使训练过程变得不稳定。 这种情况可能出乎意料地发生在之前行为正常的智能体中。

sents.en: As we have seen, we can understand LLM-training as a form of metalearning.
sents.zh: 正如我们所见，我们可以将 LLM 训练理解为一种元学习形式。

sents.en: Regular LLM training is a form of transfer learning, and inference-time reasoning and training, as is used in agentic LLM, use even more metalearning ideas.
sents.zh: 常规的 LLM 训练是一种迁移学习形式，而推理时的推理与训练（如智能体式 LLM 中所使用的）则应用了更多元学习的理念。

sents.en: Although dynamic metalearning approaches (such as self-reflection) are a powerful concept, care should be taken since interference between inner and outer loops may destabilize the training process.
sents.zh: 尽管动态的元学习方法（例如自我反思）是一个强大的概念，但仍需谨慎，因为内部循环与外部循环之间的干扰可能会使训练过程变得不稳定。

sents.en: This may happen unexpectedly, in agents that were previously behaving.
sents.zh: 这种情况可能出乎意料地发生在之前行为正常的智能体中。

paragraphs.en: When we use a trained model in our agent that interacts with the world, and that agent is also trained using feedback from this interaction, then the model can be regarded as the base learner (inner loop) and the interaction with the world can be regarded as the metalearner (outer loop). All the preceding caveats for in-pipeline metalearning also apply for out-of-pipeline metalearning. Only now, when interacting with the real world, the consequence of errors may be more severe.
paragraphs.zh: 当我们在智能体中使用一个训练好的模型与该世界进行交互，并且该智能体也通过这种交互的反馈进行训练时，这个模型就可以被视为基础学习器（内循环），而与世界的交互则可以被视为元学习器（外循环）。 前面所有关于管道内元学习的注意事项同样适用于管道外元学习。 只是现在，在与真实世界交互时，错误所带来的后果可能会更加严重。

sents.en: When we use a trained model in our agent that interacts with the world, and that agent is also trained using feedback from this interaction, then the model can be regarded as the base learner (inner loop) and the interaction with the world can be regarded as the metalearner (outer loop).
sents.zh: 当我们在智能体中使用一个训练好的模型与该世界进行交互，并且该智能体也通过这种交互的反馈进行训练时，这个模型就可以被视为基础学习器（内循环），而与世界的交互则可以被视为元学习器（外循环）。

sents.en: All the preceding caveats for in-pipeline metalearning also apply for out-of-pipeline metalearning.
sents.zh: 前面所有关于管道内元学习的注意事项同样适用于管道外元学习。

sents.en: Only now, when interacting with the real world, the consequence of errors may be more severe.
sents.zh: 只是现在，在与真实世界交互时，错误所带来的后果可能会更加严重。

paragraphs.en: Related fields of online machine learning, such as deep reinforcement learning, also suffer from the unstable training and the moving target problem. The field of deep reinforcement learning has introduced many stabilization techniques, such as replay buffers and target networks [ Mnih et al., 2015 , Hessel et al., 2018 ] . These methods typically try to decouple the periodicity of the two learning processes, often by slowing down one of them. A similar approach is introduced in Hierarchical Reasoning Models (HRM) [ Wang et al., 2025 ] . HRM consists of a two-layer metalearning approach. Here, too, the learning is stabilized by learning at two different speeds.
paragraphs.zh: 在线机器学习的相关领域，例如深度强化学习，也面临着训练不稳定和移动目标问题。 深度强化学习领域已经引入了许多稳定化技术，例如重播缓冲区和目标网络 [ Mnih et al., 2015 , Hessel et al., 2018 ] 。 这些方法通常试图将两个学习过程的周期性解耦，常常通过减缓其中一个过程的速度来实现。 层级推理模型（HRM）[ Wang et al., 2025 ] 也引入了一种类似的方法。 HRM 由一种双层元学习方法构成。 在这里，同样通过以两种不同的速度进行学习来稳定学习过程。

sents.en: Related fields of online machine learning, such as deep reinforcement learning, also suffer from the unstable training and the moving target problem.
sents.zh: 在线机器学习的相关领域，例如深度强化学习，也面临着训练不稳定和移动目标问题。

sents.en: The field of deep reinforcement learning has introduced many stabilization techniques, such as replay buffers and target networks [ Mnih et al., 2015 , Hessel et al., 2018 ] .
sents.zh: 深度强化学习领域已经引入了许多稳定化技术，例如重播缓冲区和目标网络 [ Mnih et al., 2015 , Hessel et al., 2018 ] 。

sents.en: These methods typically try to decouple the periodicity of the two learning processes, often by slowing down one of them.
sents.zh: 这些方法通常试图将两个学习过程的周期性解耦，常常通过减缓其中一个过程的速度来实现。

sents.en: A similar approach is introduced in Hierarchical Reasoning Models (HRM) [ Wang et al., 2025 ] .
sents.zh: 层级推理模型（HRM）[ Wang et al., 2025 ] 也引入了一种类似的方法。

sents.en: HRM consists of a two-layer metalearning approach.
sents.zh: HRM 由一种双层元学习方法构成。

sents.en: Here, too, the learning is stabilized by learning at two different speeds.
sents.zh: 在这里，同样通过以两种不同的速度进行学习来稳定学习过程。

paragraphs.en: Knowledge of such stabilization methods is useful when designing agentic LLM solutions. In the next part we will provide an overview of the different interaction styles by which agentic LLM interact with the world. The styles go from static to dynamic.
paragraphs.zh: 在设计智能体式大语言模型解决方案时，了解此类稳定化方法会很有帮助。 在下一部分中，我们将概述智能体式大语言模型与世界交互的不同互动模式。 这些模式从静态到动态依次展开。

sents.en: Knowledge of such stabilization methods is useful when designing agentic LLM solutions.
sents.zh: 在设计智能体式大语言模型解决方案时，了解此类稳定化方法会很有帮助。

sents.en: In the next part we will provide an overview of the different interaction styles by which agentic LLM interact with the world.
sents.zh: 在下一部分中，我们将概述智能体式大语言模型与世界交互的不同互动模式。

sents.en: The styles go from static to dynamic.
sents.zh: 这些模式从静态到动态依次展开。

paragraphs.en: We have now discussed the foundations of LLMs and agents. We have seen how language and tokenization works, we have seen how LLMs are trained and finetuned, and we have seen how advanced reasoning models reason and self-reflect. We have looked at different learning modalities, from language, vision, and action. We have also looked at the intricacies of metalearning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在已经讨论了 LLM 和智能体的基础。 我们已经了解了语言和分词的工作原理，了解了 LLM 的训练与微调方法，还了解了高级推理模型如何进行推理和自我反思。 我们探讨了不同的学习模式，包括语言、视觉和行动。 我们还研究了元学习的复杂细节。

sents.en: We have now discussed the foundations of LLMs and agents.
sents.zh: 我们现在已经讨论了 LLM 和智能体的基础。

sents.en: We have seen how language and tokenization works, we have seen how LLMs are trained and finetuned, and we have seen how advanced reasoning models reason and self-reflect.
sents.zh: 我们已经了解了语言和分词的工作原理，了解了 LLM 的训练与微调方法，还了解了高级推理模型如何进行推理和自我反思。

sents.en: We have looked at different learning modalities, from language, vision, and action.
sents.zh: 我们探讨了不同的学习模式，包括语言、视觉和行动。

sents.en: We have also looked at the intricacies of metalearning.
sents.zh: 我们还研究了元学习的复杂细节。

paragraphs.en: We have now arrived at the heart of agentic LLM, where we will review the different interaction styles of LLM agents. This part consists of one content chapter and one practical chapter. First we will review the five agentic interaction styles that we have seen so far, and we discuss the importance of memory. Then, in the practical chapter, we will discuss a hands-on case study where many of the techniques of this part come together. You will be invited to create a self-reflective LLM agent that can play typical AI-games such as TextWorld and NetHack.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在已经来到了智能体式大型语言模型的核心部分，在这里我们将回顾大型语言模型智能体的不同交互风格。 这一部分包括一个内容章节和一个实践章节。 首先，我们将回顾迄今为止所介绍的五种智能体式交互风格，并讨论记忆的重要性。 接下来，在实践章节中，我们将探讨一个动手实践的案例研究，其中融合了本部分的许多技术。 你将受邀创建一个具备自我反思能力的大型语言模型智能体，使其能够玩 TextWorld 和 NetHack 等典型的 AI 游戏。

sents.en: We have now arrived at the heart of agentic LLM, where we will review the different interaction styles of LLM agents.
sents.zh: 我们现在已经来到了智能体式大型语言模型的核心部分，在这里我们将回顾大型语言模型智能体的不同交互风格。

sents.en: This part consists of one content chapter and one practical chapter.
sents.zh: 这一部分包括一个内容章节和一个实践章节。

sents.en: First we will review the five agentic interaction styles that we have seen so far, and we discuss the importance of memory.
sents.zh: 首先，我们将回顾迄今为止所介绍的五种智能体式交互风格，并讨论记忆的重要性。

sents.en: Then, in the practical chapter, we will discuss a hands-on case study where many of the techniques of this part come together.
sents.zh: 接下来，在实践章节中，我们将探讨一个动手实践的案例研究，其中融合了本部分的许多技术。

sents.en: You will be invited to create a self-reflective LLM agent that can play typical AI-games such as TextWorld and NetHack.
sents.zh: 你将受邀创建一个具备自我反思能力的大型语言模型智能体，使其能够玩 TextWorld 和 NetHack 等典型的 AI 游戏。

paragraphs.en: Agents play a central role in artificial intelligence, and we will first discuss some of the background of agents in AI.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体在人工智能中扮演着核心角色，我们将首先探讨智能体在人工智能领域的一些背景知识。

paragraphs.en: In artificial intelligence, entities that act in the world are called agents . They are the AI equivalent of humans acting in the world. In the agent concept, AI researchers try to capture what they perceive to be the essence of what humans do—understanding intelligence by building it.
paragraphs.zh: 在人工智能领域，那些在世界中行动的存在被称为智能体。 它们相当于人类在世界中行动的人工智能版本。 在智能体的概念中，人工智能研究人员试图捕捉他们认为的人类行为本质——通过构建智能来理解智能。

sents.en: In artificial intelligence, entities that act in the world are called agents .
sents.zh: 在人工智能领域，那些在世界中行动的存在被称为智能体。

sents.en: They are the AI equivalent of humans acting in the world.
sents.zh: 它们相当于人类在世界中行动的人工智能版本。

sents.en: In the agent concept, AI researchers try to capture what they perceive to be the essence of what humans do—understanding intelligence by building it.
sents.zh: 在智能体的概念中，人工智能研究人员试图捕捉他们认为的人类行为本质——通过构建智能来理解智能。

paragraphs.en: Agents are autonomous software systems that act in an environment. They (1) have goals, they (2) perceive their environment, they (3) make decisions, they (4) take actions to achieve their goals, and, most importantly, they (5) learn from experience. Agents should adapt to new information in order to achieve their goals better, or, in reinforcement learning terms, agents improve their action policy.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体是能够在环境中自主行动的软件系统。 它们（1）有目标，它们（2）感知环境，它们（3）做出决策，它们（4）采取行动以实现目标，而最重要的是，它们（5）能从经验中学习。 为了更有效地实现目标，智能体应能根据新信息进行调整；用强化学习的术语来说，就是智能体需要改进其行动策略。

sents.en: Agents are autonomous software systems that act in an environment.
sents.zh: 智能体是能够在环境中自主行动的软件系统。

sents.en: They (1) have goals, they (2) perceive their environment, they (3) make decisions, they (4) take actions to achieve their goals, and, most importantly, they (5) learn from experience.
sents.zh: 它们（1）有目标，它们（2）感知环境，它们（3）做出决策，它们（4）采取行动以实现目标，而最重要的是，它们（5）能从经验中学习。

sents.en: Agents should adapt to new information in order to achieve their goals better, or, in reinforcement learning terms, agents improve their action policy.
sents.zh: 为了更有效地实现目标，智能体应能根据新信息进行调整；用强化学习的术语来说，就是智能体需要改进其行动策略。

paragraphs.en: Traditional computer programs are deterministic, they predictably follow pre-set instructions (this makes computers so useful to do things from accounting to control, in which predictability is paramount). LLM agents, in contrast, are less deterministic, and less predictable. They learn, and change their behavior from time to time. They can autonomously reason, plan, and perform tasks using tools to perform simple workflows for users in areas such as coding, customer service, and data analysis. (They also hallucinate, make mistakes, and generally are unpredictable and undependable. In that respect, LLM agents are more like humans than computers.)
paragraphs.zh: 传统计算机程序是确定性的，它们会按照预设的指令进行可预测的执行（这使得计算机在从会计到控制等各种任务中极为有用，在这些任务中，可预测性至关重要）。 相比之下，LLM 智能体则确定性较低，且难以预测。 它们会学习，并时不时地改变自己的行为。 它们能够自主推理、规划，并利用工具执行任务，从而在编程、客户服务和数据分析等领域为用户完成简单的流程操作。 （它们也会出现幻觉、犯错，总体而言不可预测且不可靠。） 从这个角度看，LLM 智能体更像是人类，而非计算机。

sents.en: Traditional computer programs are deterministic, they predictably follow pre-set instructions (this makes computers so useful to do things from accounting to control, in which predictability is paramount).
sents.zh: 传统计算机程序是确定性的，它们会按照预设的指令进行可预测的执行（这使得计算机在从会计到控制等各种任务中极为有用，在这些任务中，可预测性至关重要）。

sents.en: LLM agents, in contrast, are less deterministic, and less predictable.
sents.zh: 相比之下，LLM 智能体则确定性较低，且难以预测。

sents.en: They learn, and change their behavior from time to time.
sents.zh: 它们会学习，并时不时地改变自己的行为。

sents.en: They can autonomously reason, plan, and perform tasks using tools to perform simple workflows for users in areas such as coding, customer service, and data analysis.
sents.zh: 它们能够自主推理、规划，并利用工具执行任务，从而在编程、客户服务和数据分析等领域为用户完成简单的流程操作。

sents.en: (They also hallucinate, make mistakes, and generally are unpredictable and undependable.
sents.zh: （它们也会出现幻觉、犯错，总体而言不可预测且不可靠。）

sents.en: In that respect, LLM agents are more like humans than computers.)
sents.zh: 从这个角度看，LLM 智能体更像是人类，而非计算机。

paragraphs.en: Agents have been studied for quite some time in artificial intelligence. It is useful to distinguish three types of agents: (1) robotic assistant agents, (2) belief-desire-intention agents, and (3) swarm agents.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体在人工智能领域已经得到了相当长时间的研究。 区分三种类型的智能体会很有帮助：（1）机器人助手智能体，（2）信念-欲望-意图智能体，以及（3）群体智能体。

sents.en: Agents have been studied for quite some time in artificial intelligence.
sents.zh: 智能体在人工智能领域已经得到了相当长时间的研究。

sents.en: It is useful to distinguish three types of agents: (1) robotic assistant agents, (2) belief-desire-intention agents, and (3) swarm agents.
sents.zh: 区分三种类型的智能体会很有帮助：（1）机器人助手智能体，（2）信念-欲望-意图智能体，以及（3）群体智能体。

paragraphs.en: First we discuss agents that are robotic assistants. This view on AI agents is from the field of engineering: agents perform human-like tasks for humans. An agent is a tool to more easily achieve routine tasks. An example is a welding robot in a factory, an auto-pilot in an airplane, or a self-driving car that has to find a safe route in an unpredictable environment.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我们讨论作为机器人助理的智能体。 这种对 AI 智能体的看法来自工程领域：智能体为人类执行类似人类的任务。 智能体是一种更轻松地完成常规任务的工具。 例如，工厂中的焊接机器人、飞机上的自动驾驶系统，或需要在不可预测的环境中寻找安全路线的自动驾驶汽车。

sents.en: First we discuss agents that are robotic assistants.
sents.zh: 首先，我们讨论作为机器人助理的智能体。

sents.en: An example is a welding robot in a factory, an auto-pilot in an airplane, or a self-driving car that has to find a safe route in an unpredictable environment.

paragraphs.en: Further examples of such agents are virtual assistants, such as Alexa and Siri, or coding assistants such as CoPilot that help software developers become more productive, or customer service bots that help customers navigate the maze of rules of a company to achieve goals such as filing a complaint or getting a refund. Robotic assistant agents can have significant reasoning abilities [ Dorri et al., 2018 ] , and LLMs are increasingly used for such assistants [ Plaat et al., 2025 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这类智能体的其他例子包括虚拟助手，例如 Alexa 和 Siri，或编程助手，例如 CoPilot，它们能帮助软件开发者提高生产力；还有客户服务机器人，它们能协助客户穿越公司复杂的规则体系，实现诸如提出投诉或获得退款等目标。 机器人助手智能体可以具备强大的推理能力 [ Dorri et al., 2018 ]，而大型语言模型正越来越多地被用于此类助手 [ Plaat et al., 2025 ]。

sents.en: Further examples of such agents are virtual assistants, such as Alexa and Siri, or coding assistants such as CoPilot that help software developers become more productive, or customer service bots that help customers navigate the maze of rules of a company to achieve goals such as filing a complaint or getting a refund.
sents.zh: 这类智能体的其他例子包括虚拟助手，例如 Alexa 和 Siri，或编程助手，例如 CoPilot，它们能帮助软件开发者提高生产力；还有客户服务机器人，它们能协助客户穿越公司复杂的规则体系，实现诸如提出投诉或获得退款等目标。

sents.en: Robotic assistant agents can have significant reasoning abilities [ Dorri et al., 2018 ] , and LLMs are increasingly used for such assistants [ Plaat et al., 2025 ] .
sents.zh: 机器人助手智能体可以具备强大的推理能力 [ Dorri et al., 2018 ]，而大型语言模型正越来越多地被用于此类助手 [ Plaat et al., 2025 ]。

paragraphs.en: Another view on AI agents is rooted in the field of cognitive science. Here the goal is for agents to model human cognitive processes, and agents have beliefs, desires and intentions (BDI). Cognitive science studies human thinking processes. AI agents can be used to implement cognitive models, and experiment with models of thinking: is the model able to reason logically, to cooperate with human players in a game of Bridge, to deconstruct a theater play by Shakespeare, to compose music, or to have self-awareness? Cognition may take many subtle forms, such as interpreting sensory input, guiding physical actions, and empathizing with others.
paragraphs.zh: 对 AI 智能体的另一种看法源于认知科学领域。 在这里，目标是让智能体模拟人类的认知过程，并且这些智能体拥有信念、欲望和意图（BDI）。 认知科学研究人类的思维过程。 AI 智能体可用于实现认知模型，并对思维模型进行实验：该模型是否能够进行逻辑推理，在桥牌游戏中与人类玩家合作，解析莎士比亚的戏剧作品，创作音乐，或者具备自我意识？ 认知可能以许多微妙形式存在，例如解释感官输入、指导身体行动以及对他人心生共情。

sents.en: Another view on AI agents is rooted in the field of cognitive science.
sents.zh: 对 AI 智能体的另一种看法源于认知科学领域。

sents.en: Here the goal is for agents to model human cognitive processes, and agents have beliefs, desires and intentions (BDI).

paragraphs.en: Originally, BDI agents come from the tradition of logic reasoning. They are imbued with goals, which they pursue through actions. The literature in this field sees actions as a way to achieve the goals of an agent [ Rao et al., 1995 , Georgeff et al., 1998 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 最初，BDI智能体源于逻辑推理的传统。 它们被赋予了目标，并通过行动来追求这些目标。 该领域的文献将行动视为实现智能体目标的一种方式 [ Rao et al., 1995 , Georgeff et al., 1998 ] 。

sents.en: Originally, BDI agents come from the tradition of logic reasoning.
sents.zh: 最初，BDI智能体源于逻辑推理的传统。

sents.en: They are imbued with goals, which they pursue through actions.
sents.zh: 它们被赋予了目标，并通过行动来追求这些目标。

sents.en: The literature in this field sees actions as a way to achieve the goals of an agent [ Rao et al., 1995 , Georgeff et al., 1998 ] .
sents.zh: 该领域的文献将行动视为实现智能体目标的一种方式 [ Rao et al., 1995 , Georgeff et al., 1998 ] 。

paragraphs.en: A third view on AI agents stresses interaction patterns between large numbers of small agents. Where the previous multi-agent systems consisted of few, complex, agents that act and think—agents that could assist, or agents with beliefs, desires and intentions (BDI)—this approach studies flocks and swarms of many, simple, agents. Now the emphasis is on emergent collaborative behavior, behavior that emerges at a scale beyond the reasoning of the agents themselves. Can a swarm offer protection against a predator? What are the prerequisites for collaboration to occur? When is a society peaceful, when is it at war? What is a super-organism [ Johnson and Linksvayer, 2010 , Wilson and Sober, 1989 ] ?
paragraphs.zh: 关于人工智能智能体的第三种观点强调了大量小型智能体之间的互动模式。 此前的多智能体系统由少数复杂的、能够行动和思维的智能体组成——这些智能体可以提供帮助，或者拥有信念、欲望和意图（BDI）——而这种方法则研究由大量简单的智能体组成的群体和蜂群。 现在，重点在于涌现的协作行为，即这种行为在超出智能体自身推理能力的规模上出现。 一个蜂群能否提供抵御捕食者的保护？ 协作发生的前提条件是什么？ 社会何时处于和平状态，何时处于战争状态？ 什么是超有机体 [ Johnson and Linksvayer, 2010 , Wilson and Sober, 1989 ]？

paragraphs.en: Swarm agents come from the connectionist tradition of embodied AI [ Brooks, 1990 ] . The agents communicate, and researchers are often interested in the emergence of large scale behavioral patterns such as cooperation and communication. A well-known swarm algorithm is ant colony optimization [ Dorigo et al., 2007 ] , and a well-known software environment to study such patterns is Netlogo [ Wilensky and Rand, 2015 ] . 1 1 1 https://www.netlogo.org
paragraphs.zh: 群体智能体源于具身人工智能的连接主义传统 [ Brooks, 1990 ]。 这些智能体之间会相互通信，而研究人员通常关注大规模行为模式（如合作与通信）的出现。 一种广为人知的群体算法是蚁群优化 [ Dorigo et al., 2007 ]，而用于研究此类模式的知名软件环境则是 Netlogo [ Wilensky and Rand, 2015 ]。1 1 1 https://www.netlogo.org

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent systems and agentic LLMs are suitable for the study of all three types of approaches: agents as tools, agents as cognitive entities, and agents that help us study how to achieve peaceful societies (or how to conquer another). Part IV of this book is dedicated to agents as tools, and Part V is dedicated to cognition and agent societies.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体系统和智能体式大型语言模型适用于对全部三种方法的研究：将智能体视为工具、将智能体视为认知实体，以及利用智能体帮助我们研究如何构建和平社会（或如何征服另一个社会）。 本书第四部分专门探讨将智能体视为工具的问题，第五部分则专门探讨认知与智能体社会。

sents.en: Multi-agent systems and agentic LLMs are suitable for the study of all three types of approaches: agents as tools, agents as cognitive entities, and agents that help us study how to achieve peaceful societies (or how to conquer another).

sents.en: Part IV of this book is dedicated to agents as tools, and Part V is dedicated to cognition and agent societies.
sents.zh: 本书第四部分专门探讨将智能体视为工具的问题，第五部分则专门探讨认知与智能体社会。

paragraphs.en: The study of the behavior of intelligent agents has a long tradition in AI. A central aspect of agent behavior is how agents learn in their environment. Mechanisms by which agents learn from feedback are studied in reinforcement learning [ Sutton and Barto, 2018 ] and multi-agent reinforcement learning [ Wong et al., 2021 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 对智能体行为的研究在人工智能领域有着悠久的传统。 智能体行为的一个核心方面是智能体如何在环境中学习。 智能体通过反馈进行学习的机制，在强化学习 [ Sutton and Barto, 2018 ] 和多智能体强化学习 [ Wong et al., 2021 ] 中得到了研究。

sents.en: The study of the behavior of intelligent agents has a long tradition in AI.
sents.zh: 对智能体行为的研究在人工智能领域有着悠久的传统。

sents.en: A central aspect of agent behavior is how agents learn in their environment.
sents.zh: 智能体行为的一个核心方面是智能体如何在环境中学习。

paragraphs.en: In the next section we will discuss five interaction styles that we see in agentic LLM. As preparation for this overview, we will provide a formal basis for agents that interact in the world using the language of reinforcement learning.
paragraphs.zh: 在下一节中，我们将讨论智能体式大型语言模型中出现的五种交互风格。 为了为这一概述做好准备，我们将利用强化学习的语言，为与世界进行交互的智能体提供一个形式化的基础。

sents.en: In the next section we will discuss five interaction styles that we see in agentic LLM.
sents.zh: 在下一节中，我们将讨论智能体式大型语言模型中出现的五种交互风格。

sents.en: As preparation for this overview, we will provide a formal basis for agents that interact in the world using the language of reinforcement learning.
sents.zh: 为了为这一概述做好准备，我们将利用强化学习的语言，为与世界进行交互的智能体提供一个形式化的基础。

paragraphs.en: Figure 9.1 shows a reinforcement learning system that consists of an agent and an environment. In this system, the agent interacts with the environment through actions, and the environment responds with the new state of the system and a reward value, indicating how good the new state is.
paragraphs.zh: 图 9.1 展示了一个强化学习系统，该系统由一个智能体和一个环境组成。 在这个系统中，智能体通过动作与环境进行交互，而环境则通过系统的新状态和奖励值作出响应，其中奖励值表示新状态的好坏程度。

sents.en: Figure 9.1 shows a reinforcement learning system that consists of an agent and an environment.
sents.zh: 图 9.1 展示了一个强化学习系统，该系统由一个智能体和一个环境组成。

sents.en: In this system, the agent interacts with the environment through actions, and the environment responds with the new state of the system and a reward value, indicating how good the new state is.
sents.zh: 在这个系统中，智能体通过动作与环境进行交互，而环境则通过系统的新状态和奖励值作出响应，其中奖励值表示新状态的好坏程度。

paragraphs.en: The agent can learn from these reward values, and note which actions are favorable and which are unfavorable in each state. The goal of the agent is to find the optimal behavior for the environment, and thus, the best actions in each state. The agent uses the rewards to reinforce its notion of the best actions in each state, and thus learn a function of optimal behavior. This function, mapping each state to an action, is called the behavior policy, denoted as π \pi . The optimal policy is denoted as π ∗ \pi^{*} . If the agent learns through deep learning, then the policy is parameterized by the weights θ \theta of a neural network.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体可以从这些奖励值中学习，并注意到在每个状态下哪些行为是有利的，哪些是不利的。 智能体的目标是找到针对环境的最佳行为，从而确定每个状态下的最佳行为。 智能体利用奖励来强化其对每个状态下最佳行为的理解，从而学会一个描述最佳行为的函数。 这个将每个状态映射到一个行为的函数被称为行为策略，表示为 π \pi 。 最优策略表示为 π ∗ \pi^{*} 。 如果智能体通过深度学习进行学习，那么该策略就由神经网络的重置 θ \theta 参数化。

sents.en: The agent can learn from these reward values, and note which actions are favorable and which are unfavorable in each state.
sents.zh: 智能体可以从这些奖励值中学习，并注意到在每个状态下哪些行为是有利的，哪些是不利的。

paragraphs.en: The world in which the agent operates is represented by the environment. The agent takes actions and changes the state of the environment. The environment has a probabilistic transition function that computes the new state whenever an action has been performed by the agent. The environment also computes a corresponding reward for the new state. Thus, the environment is modeled with two functions: a transition function T T and a reward function R R .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体所运行的世界由环境来表示。 智能体会采取行动，并改变环境的当前状态。 环境具有一个概率转移函数，每当智能体执行一个动作时，该函数就会计算出新的状态。 环境还会为新状态计算一个相应的奖励值。 因此，环境可以通过两个函数来建模：转移函数 T T 和奖励函数 R R 。

sents.zh: 智能体所运行的世界由环境来表示。

sents.en: The agent takes actions and changes the state of the environment.
sents.zh: 智能体会采取行动，并改变环境的当前状态。
