paragraphs.en: This model, of an agent acting in an environment, receiving feedback to learn which actions caused good state transitions, and which did not, suits the concept of agentic LLMs quite well, as we will see in the next section.
paragraphs.zh: 这个模型描述了一个智能体在环境中行动，通过接收反馈来学习哪些行为能带来良好的状态转换，而哪些则不然。正如我们将在下一节中看到的，该模型与智能体式 LLM 的概念非常契合。

paragraphs.en: From the reinforcement learning point of view, we can use the LLM as a function in the agent: L ​ L ​ M ​ ( p ​ r ​ o ​ m ​ p ​ t ) → a ​ n ​ s ​ w ​ e ​ r LLM(prompt)\rightarrow answer . The LLM can be used in different places in reinforcement learning: in the agent, or in the environment. For example, the agent can use the LLM as policy-improver. It can call an LLM with a certain prompt for the policy function π L ​ L ​ M P ​ π ​ ( s , r ) \pi_{LLM_{P\pi}}(s,r) that learns from environment feedback which actions to take in the different states that the environment can be in (see Figure 9.2 ). The LLM is given a prompt P ​ π P\pi that tells it to act as a policy improver using reward r r , and returns an action a a for state s s . As we will see in Section 20.2.1 , in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) uses the LLM as a policy improver, and tree of thoughts can use an LLM to generate the successor actions.
paragraphs.zh: 从强化学习的角度来看，我们可以将 LLM 用作智能体中的一个函数：LLM(prompt) → answer。 LLM 可以在强化学习的不同环节中使用：在智能体中，或者在环境中。 例如，智能体可以将 LLM 用作策略改进器。 它可以通过特定提示调用 LLM，用于策略函数 π_{LLM_{P\pi}}(s,r)，该函数会根据环境的反馈学习在不同状态下应采取哪些行动（参见图 9.2）。 LLM 会收到一个提示 P\pi，指示其作为策略改进器使用奖励 r，并为状态 s 返回一个动作 a。 我们将在第 20.2.1 节中看到，上下文强化学习（ICRL）将 LLM 用作策略改进器，而“思维树”方法则可以利用 LLM 生成后续动作。

sents.en: From the reinforcement learning point of view, we can use the LLM as a function in the agent: L ​ L ​ M ​ ( p ​ r ​ o ​ m ​ p ​ t ) → a ​ n ​ s ​ w ​ e ​ r LLM(prompt)\rightarrow answer .
sents.zh: 从强化学习的角度来看，我们可以将 LLM 用作智能体中的一个函数：LLM(prompt) → answer。

sents.en: The LLM can be used in different places in reinforcement learning: in the agent, or in the environment.
sents.zh: LLM 可以在强化学习的不同环节中使用：在智能体中，或者在环境中。

sents.en: For example, the agent can use the LLM as policy-improver.
sents.zh: 例如，智能体可以将 LLM 用作策略改进器。

sents.en: It can call an LLM with a certain prompt for the policy function π L ​ L ​ M P ​ π ​ ( s , r ) \pi_{LLM_{P\pi}}(s,r) that learns from environment feedback which actions to take in the different states that the environment can be in (see Figure 9.2 ).
sents.zh: 它可以通过特定提示调用 LLM，用于策略函数 π_{LLM_{P\pi}}(s,r)，该函数会根据环境的反馈学习在不同状态下应采取哪些行动（参见图 9.2）。

sents.en: The LLM is given a prompt P ​ π P\pi that tells it to act as a policy improver using reward r r , and returns an action a a for state s s .
sents.zh: LLM 会收到一个提示 P\pi，指示其作为策略改进器使用奖励 r，并为状态 s 返回一个动作 a。

sents.en: As we will see in Section 20.2.1 , in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) uses the LLM as a policy improver, and tree of thoughts can use an LLM to generate the successor actions.
sents.zh: 我们将在第 20.2.1 节中看到，上下文强化学习（ICRL）将 LLM 用作策略改进器，而“思维树”方法则可以利用 LLM 生成后续动作。

paragraphs.en: The LLM can also be used in the environment, to compute the reward of the state L ​ L ​ M R ⁡ ( s ) LLM_{R(s)} , or to compute the next state L ​ L ​ M T ⁡ ( s , a ) LLM_{T(s,a)} , see Figure 9.3 . In the figure, the same LLM is now used for three different roles, with three different prompts: to perform the policy, the transition, and the reward function. For example, tree of thoughts can use an LLM to evaluate the reward of a state. There are many options in designing our agentic LLMs, as we will see next. We use the reinforcement learning paradigm to discuss and illustrate the different agentic styles.
paragraphs.zh: 该大型语言模型（LLM）也可以在环境中使用，用于计算状态奖励 L ​ L ​ M R ⁡ ( s ) LLM_{R(s)}，或计算下一个状态 L ​ L ​ M T ⁡ ( s , a ) LLM_{T(s,a)}，参见图 9.3。 在图中，同一个 LLM 现在被用于三种不同的角色，并配有三种不同的提示：执行策略、转移函数和奖励函数。 例如，“思维树”方法可以使用 LLM 来评估某个状态的奖励值。 在设计我们的智能体式大型语言模型时，有许多不同的选择，我们将在下一部分看到。 我们采用强化学习范式来讨论和说明不同的智能体风格。

sents.en: The LLM can also be used in the environment, to compute the reward of the state L ​ L ​ M R ⁡ ( s ) LLM_{R(s)} , or to compute the next state L ​ L ​ M T ⁡ ( s , a ) LLM_{T(s,a)} , see Figure 9.3 .
sents.zh: 该大型语言模型（LLM）也可以在环境中使用，用于计算状态奖励 L ​ L ​ M R ⁡ ( s ) LLM_{R(s)}，或计算下一个状态 L ​ L ​ M T ⁡ ( s , a ) LLM_{T(s,a)}，参见图 9.3。

sents.en: In the figure, the same LLM is now used for three different roles, with three different prompts: to perform the policy, the transition, and the reward function.
sents.zh: 在图中，同一个 LLM 现在被用于三种不同的角色，并配有三种不同的提示：执行策略、转移函数和奖励函数。

sents.en: For example, tree of thoughts can use an LLM to evaluate the reward of a state.
sents.zh: 例如，“思维树”方法可以使用 LLM 来评估某个状态的奖励值。

sents.en: There are many options in designing our agentic LLMs, as we will see next.
sents.zh: 在设计我们的智能体式大型语言模型时，有许多不同的选择，我们将在下一部分看到。

sents.en: We use the reinforcement learning paradigm to discuss and illustrate the different agentic styles.
sents.zh: 我们采用强化学习范式来讨论和说明不同的智能体风格。

paragraphs.en: The field of agentic LLM is new, and the previous chapters have shown many different approaches in which LLMs have been used in an agentic setting. In this section we will review the approaches that we have seen so far in this book. We distinguish the approaches based on their prompting method and their training method.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体大语言模型这一领域尚属新兴，前几章已经介绍了许多将大语言模型应用于智能体场景的不同方法。 在本节中，我们将回顾本书目前为止所介绍的方法。 我们根据提示方法和训练方法来区分这些方法。

sents.en: The field of agentic LLM is new, and the previous chapters have shown many different approaches in which LLMs have been used in an agentic setting.
sents.zh: 智能体大语言模型这一领域尚属新兴，前几章已经介绍了许多将大语言模型应用于智能体场景的不同方法。

sents.en: In this section we will review the approaches that we have seen so far in this book.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们将回顾本书目前为止所介绍的方法。

sents.en: We distinguish the approaches based on their prompting method and their training method.
sents.zh: 我们根据提示方法和训练方法来区分这些方法。

paragraphs.en: We will describe five styles of interaction that fit agentic LLMs. Table 9.1 summarizes the five agent styles. We focus on the way that the LLM is prompted by the harness at inference time, and how it is trained. All prompting styles can yield useful agentic assistants and interaction partners, that act in realistic ways, for certain domains. The more elaborate prompting styles have been developed in the pursuit for better performance in more challenging domains.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将描述五种适合智能体式大型语言模型（LLM）的交互风格。 表 9.1 总结了这五种智能体风格。 我们关注的是推理阶段智能体式 LLM 被工具框架提示的方式，以及其训练方式。 在所有提示风格中，某些风格都能生成实用的智能体式助手和交互伙伴，使其在特定领域以符合现实的方式行动。 更复杂的提示风格是在追求更具挑战性的领域中实现更好性能的过程中发展而来的。

sents.en: We will describe five styles of interaction that fit agentic LLMs.
sents.zh: 我们将描述五种适合智能体式大型语言模型（LLM）的交互风格。

sents.en: Table 9.1 summarizes the five agent styles.
sents.zh: 表 9.1 总结了这五种智能体风格。

sents.en: We focus on the way that the LLM is prompted by the harness at inference time, and how it is trained.
sents.zh: 我们关注的是推理阶段智能体式 LLM 被工具框架提示的方式，以及其训练方式。

sents.en: All prompting styles can yield useful agentic assistants and interaction partners, that act in realistic ways, for certain domains.
sents.zh: 在所有提示风格中，某些风格都能生成实用的智能体式助手和交互伙伴，使其在特定领域以符合现实的方式行动。

sents.en: The more elaborate prompting styles have been developed in the pursuit for better performance in more challenging domains.
sents.zh: 更复杂的提示风格是在追求更具挑战性的领域中实现更好性能的过程中发展而来的。

paragraphs.en: The first column of the table gives the name of the agentic interaction style, from query to reinforcement finetuning. The second column lists the type of prompting of the styles, from a simple static instruction prompt without any examples, to a dynamic reinforcement learning prompt. The third column shows the training method of the LLM, whether it is pretrained or finetuned or both. The fourth column gives a concrete example of the interaction style (with references to the literature).
paragraphs.zh: 表格的第一列给出了智能体交互风格的名字，从查询到强化微调。 第二列列出了这些风格的提示类型，从没有示例的简单静态指令提示，到动态强化学习提示。 第三列展示了大语言模型的训练方法，即它是预训练的、微调的，还是两者兼有。 第四列给出了这种交互风格的具体示例（并引用了相关文献）。

sents.en: The first column of the table gives the name of the agentic interaction style, from query to reinforcement finetuning.
sents.zh: 表格的第一列给出了智能体交互风格的名字，从查询到强化微调。

sents.en: The second column lists the type of prompting of the styles, from a simple static instruction prompt without any examples, to a dynamic reinforcement learning prompt.
sents.zh: 第二列列出了这些风格的提示类型，从没有示例的简单静态指令提示，到动态强化学习提示。

sents.en: The third column shows the training method of the LLM, whether it is pretrained or finetuned or both.
sents.zh: 第三列展示了大语言模型的训练方法，即它是预训练的、微调的，还是两者兼有。

sents.en: The fourth column gives a concrete example of the interaction style (with references to the literature).
sents.zh: 第四列给出了这种交互风格的具体示例（并引用了相关文献）。

paragraphs.en: We will now discuss the interaction styles. In the first three agent styles the prompt of the LLM is static. The prompt is written by the user and does not change.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在将讨论交互模式。 在前三种智能体模式中，LLM 的提示是静态的。 提示由用户编写且不会改变。

sents.en: We will now discuss the interaction styles.
sents.zh: 我们现在将讨论交互模式。

sents.en: In the first three agent styles the prompt of the LLM is static.
sents.zh: 在前三种智能体模式中，LLM 的提示是静态的。

sents.en: The prompt is written by the user and does not change.
sents.zh: 提示由用户编写且不会改变。

paragraphs.en: The first interaction style is interacting with the LLM by giving it a simple instruction. Figure 9.4 shows this interaction style. It simply consists of an instruction written by the user. For example, Lily missed the train. She felt very … to which the model hopefully responds with something like angry , or sad . The prompt is purely a query, without any training examples. The learning style is zero-shot learning, instruction only.
paragraphs.zh: 第一种交互方式是向大型语言模型（LLM）发出简单指令与其进行交互。 图 9.4 展示了这种交互方式。 它仅由用户编写的一条指令组成。 例如，莉莉错过了火车。 她感到非常……，而模型有望对此作出类似“生气”或“难过”的回应。 该提示纯粹是一个查询，不包含任何训练示例。 这种学习方式是零样本学习，仅使用指令。

sents.en: The first interaction style is interacting with the LLM by giving it a simple instruction.
sents.zh: 第一种交互方式是向大型语言模型（LLM）发出简单指令与其进行交互。

sents.en: Figure 9.4 shows this interaction style.
sents.zh: 图 9.4 展示了这种交互方式。

sents.en: It simply consists of an instruction written by the user.
sents.zh: 它仅由用户编写的一条指令组成。

sents.en: For example, Lily missed the train.
sents.zh: 例如，莉莉错过了火车。

sents.en: She felt very … to which the model hopefully responds with something like angry , or sad .
sents.zh: 她感到非常……，而模型有望对此作出类似“生气”或“难过”的回应。

sents.en: The prompt is purely a query, without any training examples.
sents.zh: 该提示纯粹是一个查询，不包含任何训练示例。

sents.en: The learning style is zero-shot learning, instruction only.
sents.zh: 这种学习方式是零样本学习，仅使用指令。

paragraphs.en: The LLM is able to correctly answer many such queries because it has been pretrained on a large corpus of text, which may provide an answer to many of the queries that users may ask. The model has also been finetuned for instruction answering. Examples of this interaction style are the early LLMs, such as GPT-2 [ Vaswani et al., 2017 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型能够正确回答许多此类问题，因为它是在大量文本语料库上预训练过的，这些语料库可能为用户提出的许多问题提供答案。 该模型还针对指令回答进行了微调。 这种交互方式的例子包括早期的大型语言模型，例如 GPT-2 [ Vaswani et al., 2017 ]。

sents.en: The LLM is able to correctly answer many such queries because it has been pretrained on a large corpus of text, which may provide an answer to many of the queries that users may ask.
sents.zh: 大型语言模型能够正确回答许多此类问题，因为它是在大量文本语料库上预训练过的，这些语料库可能为用户提出的许多问题提供答案。

sents.en: The model has also been finetuned for instruction answering.
sents.zh: 该模型还针对指令回答进行了微调。

sents.en: Examples of this interaction style are the early LLMs, such as GPT-2 [ Vaswani et al., 2017 ] .
sents.zh: 这种交互方式的例子包括早期的大型语言模型，例如 GPT-2 [ Vaswani et al., 2017 ]。

paragraphs.en: Next, we turn to in-context learning. For machine learning, in-context learning is an exciting new type of learning, in addition to supervised and reinforcement learning. In a large language model in-context learning often achieves good results with just a few examples, achieving one of the main challenges of the field of machine learning.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们转向上下文学习。 对于机器学习而言，除了监督学习和强化学习之外，上下文学习是一种激动人心的新型学习方式。 在大型语言模型中，上下文学习通常只需少量示例就能取得良好效果，从而实现了该领域机器学习的主要挑战之一。

sents.en: Next, we turn to in-context learning.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们转向上下文学习。

sents.en: For machine learning, in-context learning is an exciting new type of learning, in addition to supervised and reinforcement learning.
sents.zh: 对于机器学习而言，除了监督学习和强化学习之外，上下文学习是一种激动人心的新型学习方式。

sents.en: In a large language model in-context learning often achieves good results with just a few examples, achieving one of the main challenges of the field of machine learning.
sents.zh: 在大型语言模型中，上下文学习通常只需少量示例就能取得良好效果，从而实现了该领域机器学习的主要挑战之一。

paragraphs.en: Compared to interaction style A, in-context few-shot learning is a more involved interaction style.
paragraphs.zh: 与交互风格 A 相比，上下文少样本学习是一种更为复杂的交互风格。

paragraphs.en: In-context learning occurs when the user provides a few examples along with the query. In doing so, the user conditions the decoder model to activate the correct part of the large amount of knowledge that is represented in its parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 当用户在与查询一同提供几个示例时，就会发生上下文学习。 通过这样做，用户会条件性地引导解码器模型激活其参数中所包含的庞大知识中的正确部分。

sents.en: In-context learning occurs when the user provides a few examples along with the query.
sents.zh: 当用户在与查询一同提供几个示例时，就会发生上下文学习。

sents.en: In doing so, the user conditions the decoder model to activate the correct part of the large amount of knowledge that is represented in its parameters.
sents.zh: 通过这样做，用户会条件性地引导解码器模型激活其参数中所包含的庞大知识中的正确部分。

paragraphs.en: Figure 9.5 shows an illustration of a prompt that fits this interaction style. An example from the literature of this interaction style is GPT-3. The paper that introduced in-context learning is Brown et al. [2020] . An example of a few-shot prompt is: Fill in the dots: the sea-la mer, oysters-huitre, the window-la fenetre, cheese-… to which the model hopefully responds with fromage .
paragraphs.zh: 图 9.5 展示了一个符合这种交互风格的提示示例。 文献中关于这种交互风格的一个例子是 GPT-3。 提出上下文学习的论文是 Brown 等人 [2020]。 一个少样本提示的例子是：填写省略号：海-la mer，牡蛎-huitre，窗户-la fenetre，奶酪-……模型 hopefully 会回答 fromage。

sents.en: Figure 9.5 shows an illustration of a prompt that fits this interaction style.
sents.zh: 图 9.5 展示了一个符合这种交互风格的提示示例。

sents.en: An example from the literature of this interaction style is GPT-3.
sents.zh: 文献中关于这种交互风格的一个例子是 GPT-3。

sents.en: The paper that introduced in-context learning is Brown et al. [2020] .
sents.zh: 提出上下文学习的论文是 Brown 等人 [2020]。

sents.en: An example of a few-shot prompt is: Fill in the dots: the sea-la mer, oysters-huitre, the window-la fenetre, cheese-… to which the model hopefully responds with fromage .
sents.zh: 一个少样本提示的例子是：填写省略号：海-la mer，牡蛎-huitre，窗户-la fenetre，奶酪-……模型 hopefully 会回答 fromage。

paragraphs.en: Note that in-context learning only emerges when the model is large enough. Originally, in-context learning emerged in models with around 100 billion parameters. At that size, the model was rich enough for the few prompt examples to activate the right parts of the model. As our LLM methods improve, this boundary keeps shrinking.
paragraphs.zh: 请注意，上下文学习仅在模型足够大时才会出现。 最初，上下文学习出现在参数规模约为 1000 亿的模型中。 在那个规模下，模型已经足够丰富，少数提示示例就能激活模型中的正确部分。 随着我们的 LLM 方法不断改进，这一界限也在持续缩小。

sents.en: Note that in-context learning only emerges when the model is large enough.
sents.zh: 请注意，上下文学习仅在模型足够大时才会出现。

sents.en: Originally, in-context learning emerged in models with around 100 billion parameters.
sents.zh: 最初，上下文学习出现在参数规模约为 1000 亿的模型中。

sents.en: At that size, the model was rich enough for the few prompt examples to activate the right parts of the model.
sents.zh: 在那个规模下，模型已经足够丰富，少数提示示例就能激活模型中的正确部分。

sents.en: As our LLM methods improve, this boundary keeps shrinking.
sents.zh: 随着我们的 LLM 方法不断改进，这一界限也在持续缩小。

paragraphs.en: Next, we turn to another famous method, chain of thought learning [ Wei et al., 2022 ] , Figure 9.6 , top. This method was developed, as we saw in Chapter 6 , to address the weakness of LLMs in solving simple math word reasoning problems. A disadvantage of the original chain of thought approach is that a new prompt has to be written by the user for each new reasoning task at hand. A subsequent development was the zero-shot chain of thought prompt, Figure 9.6 , bottom. Kojima et al. [2022] found that adding the generic sentence: Let’s think step by step to prompts already improves performance on many benchmarks, although often not by as much as a hand-written task-specific prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们转向另一种著名方法——思维链学习 [Wei et al., 2022]，参见图 9.6 上半部分。正如我们在第 6 章中所见，该方法旨在解决大型语言模型（LLM）在解决简单数学文字推理问题方面的弱点。原始思维链方法的一个缺点是，对于每个新的推理任务，用户都必须编写一个新的提示。后续的一项改进是零样本思维链提示，参见图 9.6 下半部分。Kojima 等人 [2022] 发现，在提示中添加通用句子“让我们逐步思考”本身就能提升许多基准测试的性能，尽管这种提升通常不如手动编写的特定任务提示显著。

paragraphs.en: As in the previous interaction style, chain of thought is an in-context few-shot learning method, although now the examples in the prompt are a few examples of the steps that the model should take before it provides its answer—whereas previously they were examples of facts. These steps help the model arrive at the right answer, following a multi-step reasoning chain. The examples are not examples of answers to activate parts of the model, but of steps on how to arrive at the answer. Example prompts for few-shot and zero-shot chain of thought have been shown in Figure 6.1 on page 6.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 与之前的交互模式一样，思维链是一种上下文中的少样本学习方法，只不过现在提示词中的示例是模型在给出答案之前应遵循的几个步骤示例——而此前的示例则是事实示例。 这些步骤帮助模型通过多步推理过程得出正确答案。 这些示例并非用于激活模型部分的回答示例，而是展示如何得出答案的步骤示例。 少样本和零样本思维链的提示词示例已展示在第 6.1 页的图 6.1 中。

sents.en: As in the previous interaction style, chain of thought is an in-context few-shot learning method, although now the examples in the prompt are a few examples of the steps that the model should take before it provides its answer—whereas previously they were examples of facts.
sents.zh: 与之前的交互模式一样，思维链是一种上下文中的少样本学习方法，只不过现在提示词中的示例是模型在给出答案之前应遵循的几个步骤示例——而此前的示例则是事实示例。

sents.en: These steps help the model arrive at the right answer, following a multi-step reasoning chain.
sents.zh: 这些步骤帮助模型通过多步推理过程得出正确答案。

sents.en: The examples are not examples of answers to activate parts of the model, but of steps on how to arrive at the answer.
sents.zh: 这些示例并非用于激活模型部分的回答示例，而是展示如何得出答案的步骤示例。

sents.en: Example prompts for few-shot and zero-shot chain of thought have been shown in Figure 6.1 on page 6.1 .
sents.zh: 少样本和零样本思维链的提示词示例已展示在第 6.1 页的图 6.1 中。

paragraphs.en: Again, as with in-context learning, chain of thought only works in models of sufficient size, and again, this size is getting smaller as our understanding of LLM methods increases and models are being finetuned for chain of thought. Furthermore, it is possible to transfer the learned reasoning methods from a large model to a model with orders of magnitude fewer parameters, by distillation [ Li et al., 2023 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 同样地，与上下文学习一样，链式思考仅在模型规模足够大时才能生效，而且随着我们对大型语言模型方法的理解加深以及模型为链式思考进行微调，所需的模型规模也在不断减小。 此外，通过蒸馏 [ Li et al., 2023 ]，可以将从大型模型中学到的推理方法迁移到参数数量少几个数量级的模型中。

sents.en: Again, as with in-context learning, chain of thought only works in models of sufficient size, and again, this size is getting smaller as our understanding of LLM methods increases and models are being finetuned for chain of thought.
sents.zh: 同样地，与上下文学习一样，链式思考仅在模型规模足够大时才能生效，而且随着我们对大型语言模型方法的理解加深以及模型为链式思考进行微调，所需的模型规模也在不断减小。

sents.en: Furthermore, it is possible to transfer the learned reasoning methods from a large model to a model with orders of magnitude fewer parameters, by distillation [ Li et al., 2023 ] .
sents.zh: 此外，通过蒸馏 [ Li et al., 2023 ]，可以将从大型模型中学到的推理方法迁移到参数数量少几个数量级的模型中。

paragraphs.en: The preceding agentic interaction styles all used a single static prompt, achieving encouraging performance on many benchmarks. To perform well on planning problems, or other problems where state must be tracked, a reasoning style is needed where prompts are optimized, searching through options in a tree of possibilities.
paragraphs.zh: 上述所有智能体交互模式都使用了单一的静态提示，并在许多基准测试中取得了令人鼓舞的性能。 为了在规划问题或其他需要跟踪状态的问题中表现出色，需要一种推理模式：通过可能性树中的选项进行搜索，从而优化提示。

sents.en: The preceding agentic interaction styles all used a single static prompt, achieving encouraging performance on many benchmarks.
sents.zh: 上述所有智能体交互模式都使用了单一的静态提示，并在许多基准测试中取得了令人鼓舞的性能。

sents.en: To perform well on planning problems, or other problems where state must be tracked, a reasoning style is needed where prompts are optimized, searching through options in a tree of possibilities.
sents.zh: 为了在规划问题或其他需要跟踪状态的问题中表现出色，需要一种推理模式：通过可能性树中的选项进行搜索，从而优化提示。

paragraphs.en: We will now discuss two interaction styles where the LLM prompt is dynamically manipulated by a small algorithm that is external to the LLM. This algorithm is called a harness . The first style is in-context (LLM parameters are not changed), while the second style (in the next subsection) also uses finetuning of the model.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们将讨论两种交互方式：在这些方式中，大型语言模型（LLM）的提示会由一个位于 LLM 之外的小型算法动态调整。 这种算法被称为“harness”。 第一种方式是上下文内交互（LLM 的参数不会改变），而第二种方式（见下一小节）还会对模型进行微调。

sents.en: We will now discuss two interaction styles where the LLM prompt is dynamically manipulated by a small algorithm that is external to the LLM.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们将讨论两种交互方式：在这些方式中，大型语言模型（LLM）的提示会由一个位于 LLM 之外的小型算法动态调整。

sents.en: This algorithm is called a harness .
sents.zh: 这种算法被称为“harness”。

sents.en: The first style is in-context (LLM parameters are not changed), while the second style (in the next subsection) also uses finetuning of the model.
sents.zh: 第一种方式是上下文内交互（LLM 的参数不会改变），而第二种方式（见下一小节）还会对模型进行微调。

paragraphs.en: These interaction styles are dynamic. As we saw in the previous chapter on metalearning, a challenge of dynamic methods is to achieve a stable learning process. When training targets are changing, learning algorithms may diverge, and extra care is needed to achieve convergence. Achieving predictable high performance with self-reflection is still an area of active research.
paragraphs.zh: 这些交互模式是动态的。 正如我们在前一章关于元学习的内容中所看到的，动态方法的一个挑战是实现稳定的学习过程。 当训练目标发生变化时，学习算法可能会发散，因此需要格外注意以实现收敛。 通过自我反思实现可预测的高性能仍然是一个活跃的研究领域。

sents.en: These interaction styles are dynamic.
sents.zh: 这些交互模式是动态的。

sents.en: As we saw in the previous chapter on metalearning, a challenge of dynamic methods is to achieve a stable learning process.
sents.zh: 正如我们在前一章关于元学习的内容中所看到的，动态方法的一个挑战是实现稳定的学习过程。

sents.en: When training targets are changing, learning algorithms may diverge, and extra care is needed to achieve convergence.
sents.zh: 当训练目标发生变化时，学习算法可能会发散，因此需要格外注意以实现收敛。

sents.en: Achieving predictable high performance with self-reflection is still an area of active research.
sents.zh: 通过自我反思实现可预测的高性能仍然是一个活跃的研究领域。

paragraphs.en: The first dynamic prompting methods that we discuss emerged out of the need to model more complex reasoning structures, that go beyond the straight line sequence of steps of chain of thought. First, simple search algorithms were introduced (tree of thoughts). Next, full fledged dynamic prompting methods were introduced to manage prompt development (ReAct, reflexion, self refine). Often, the harness of these methods introduced short-term and long-term memories to remember state between LLM invocations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们讨论的首批动态提示方法源于对更复杂推理结构建模的需求，这些结构超越了思维链中线性步骤的简单序列。 首先，引入了简单的搜索算法（思维树）。 接下来，引入了功能完整的动态提示方法，以管理提示的发展过程（ReAct、reflexion、self refine）。 通常，这些方法的运用引入了短期和长期记忆，以便在多次调用大语言模型之间记住状态。

sents.en: The first dynamic prompting methods that we discuss emerged out of the need to model more complex reasoning structures, that go beyond the straight line sequence of steps of chain of thought.
sents.zh: 我们讨论的首批动态提示方法源于对更复杂推理结构建模的需求，这些结构超越了思维链中线性步骤的简单序列。

sents.en: First, simple search algorithms were introduced (tree of thoughts).
sents.zh: 首先，引入了简单的搜索算法（思维树）。

sents.en: Next, full fledged dynamic prompting methods were introduced to manage prompt development (ReAct, reflexion, self refine).
sents.zh: 接下来，引入了功能完整的动态提示方法，以管理提示的发展过程（ReAct、reflexion、self refine）。

sents.en: Often, the harness of these methods introduced short-term and long-term memories to remember state between LLM invocations.
sents.zh: 通常，这些方法的运用引入了短期和长期记忆，以便在多次调用大语言模型之间记住状态。

paragraphs.en: An interesting aspect of these methods is that the LLM is used in different roles, for which it is called with different types of prompts. The original role of the LLM in chain of thought tasks is to evaluate the answer in each reasoning step. This evaluation prompt is now augmented with a different type of prompt, to generate a new reasoning step. Sometimes a third type of prompt is added, whose task is to improve the prompt itself. Thus, a single model is used to self-reflect on itself through different prompts, managed by an external harness.
paragraphs.zh: 这些方法的一个有趣之处在于，大语言模型（LLM）被赋予了不同的角色，因此需要调用不同类型的提示词。 在思维链任务中，大语言模型（LLM）的原始角色是评估每个推理步骤中的答案。 现在，这种评估提示词被另一种类型的提示词所增强，以生成一个新的推理步骤。 有时还会加入第三种类型的提示词，其任务是改进提示词本身。 因此，通过一个外部框架管理的不同提示词，单个模型能够对自己进行自我反思。

sents.en: An interesting aspect of these methods is that the LLM is used in different roles, for which it is called with different types of prompts.
sents.zh: 这些方法的一个有趣之处在于，大语言模型（LLM）被赋予了不同的角色，因此需要调用不同类型的提示词。

sents.en: The original role of the LLM in chain of thought tasks is to evaluate the answer in each reasoning step.
sents.zh: 在思维链任务中，大语言模型（LLM）的原始角色是评估每个推理步骤中的答案。

sents.en: This evaluation prompt is now augmented with a different type of prompt, to generate a new reasoning step.
sents.zh: 现在，这种评估提示词被另一种类型的提示词所增强，以生成一个新的推理步骤。

sents.en: Sometimes a third type of prompt is added, whose task is to improve the prompt itself.
sents.zh: 有时还会加入第三种类型的提示词，其任务是改进提示词本身。

sents.en: Thus, a single model is used to self-reflect on itself through different prompts, managed by an external harness.
sents.zh: 因此，通过一个外部框架管理的不同提示词，单个模型能够对自己进行自我反思。

paragraphs.en: Figure 9.7 shows these ideas. At the top, the self-reflection is controlled by a standard tree search algorithm, as in tree of thoughts [ Yao et al., 2024 ] . At the bottom, a reinforcement learning loop controls self-reflection, where the prompt for policy π \pi is updated with the history of (state, action, reward) triples (see also Section 20.2.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 图 9.7 展示了这些思想。 在顶部，自我反思由标准的树搜索算法控制，如“思维树”[ Yao et al., 2024 ]所示。 在底部，一个强化学习循环控制着自我反思，其中策略 π \pi 的提示会根据（状态、动作、奖励）三元组的历史记录进行更新（另见第 20.2.1 节）。

sents.en: Figure 9.7 shows these ideas.
sents.zh: 图 9.7 展示了这些思想。

sents.en: At the top, the self-reflection is controlled by a standard tree search algorithm, as in tree of thoughts [ Yao et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 在顶部，自我反思由标准的树搜索算法控制，如“思维树”[ Yao et al., 2024 ]所示。

sents.en: At the bottom, a reinforcement learning loop controls self-reflection, where the prompt for policy π \pi is updated with the history of (state, action, reward) triples (see also Section 20.2.1 ).
sents.zh: 在底部，一个强化学习循环控制着自我反思，其中策略 π \pi 的提示会根据（状态、动作、奖励）三元组的历史记录进行更新（另见第 20.2.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: Up to now, all learning was in-context, the model provided answers based on examples provided in the context. The parameters of the LLM were not changed. Although ICL is easy to use, it limits learning. If we wish the model to adapt more profoundly to a certain environment, if we wish the model to remember what it learned at inference time, then it helps if the parameters can change. We call approaches that use this method reinforcement finetuning . RLVR is a well-known example.
paragraphs.zh: 到目前为止，所有学习都是在上下文中进行的，模型根据上下文提供的示例来给出答案。 LLM 的参数并未被改变。 尽管 ICL 易于使用，但它限制了学习能力。 如果我们希望模型能更深入地适应特定环境，希望模型能在推理时记住所学到的内容，那么让参数能够变化就会很有帮助。 我们称采用这种方法的方式为强化微调。 RLVR 是一个广为人知的例子。

sents.en: Up to now, all learning was in-context, the model provided answers based on examples provided in the context.
sents.zh: 到目前为止，所有学习都是在上下文中进行的，模型根据上下文提供的示例来给出答案。

sents.en: The parameters of the LLM were not changed.
sents.zh: LLM 的参数并未被改变。

sents.en: Although ICL is easy to use, it limits learning.
sents.zh: 尽管 ICL 易于使用，但它限制了学习能力。

sents.en: If we wish the model to adapt more profoundly to a certain environment, if we wish the model to remember what it learned at inference time, then it helps if the parameters can change.
sents.zh: 如果我们希望模型能更深入地适应特定环境，希望模型能在推理时记住所学到的内容，那么让参数能够变化就会很有帮助。

sents.en: We call approaches that use this method reinforcement finetuning .
sents.zh: 我们称采用这种方法的方式为强化微调。

sents.en: RLVR is a well-known example.
sents.zh: RLVR 是一个广为人知的例子。

paragraphs.en: Figure 9.8 provides an illustration, where the trainable model parameters are indicated as ψ \psi . Note that the only difference with Figure 9.7 (bottom) is the introduction of the ψ \psi parameters. In ReFT the LLM parameters ψ \psi change, they are finetuned based on the rewards from the dataset. We should interpret the figures such that where learning at inference time was in-context, this has now changed, since we allow finetuning of the parameters ψ \psi . In the traditional LLM training pipeline, finetuning is a stage that comes before inference. However, for many important applications, such as math reasoning or coding, chain of thought multi-step inference-time roll-outs produce accurate rewards that can be used for finetuning. Therefore, in reinforcement finetuning, the model is used to produce training targets at inference-time, that are then used to finetune the parameters of the same model—finetuning at inference-time. Reinforcement finetuning blurs the line between inference and finetuning, where supervised finetuning has a clear separation between training and inference.
paragraphs.zh: 图 9.8 提供了一个示意图，其中可训练的模型参数表示为 ψ \psi。 请注意，与图 9.7（底部）相比，唯一的区别是引入了 ψ \psi 参数。 在 ReFT 中，LLM 的参数 ψ \psi 会发生变化，它们会根据数据集提供的奖励进行微调。 我们应该这样理解这些图表：原本推理时的学习是在上下文中进行的，但现在情况发生了变化，因为我们允许对参数 ψ \psi 进行微调。 在传统 LLM 训练流程中，微调是一个发生在推理之前的阶段。 然而，对于许多重要应用（如数学推理或编程），思维链多步推理过程能够生成准确的奖励，这些奖励可用于微调。 因此，在强化微调中，模型被用于在推理时生成训练目标，而这些目标随后又被用来对同一模型进行微调——即推理时的微调。 强化微调模糊了推理与微调之间的界限，而监督式微调则在训练和推理之间有着明确的区分。

sents.en: Figure 9.8 provides an illustration, where the trainable model parameters are indicated as ψ \psi .
sents.zh: 图 9.8 提供了一个示意图，其中可训练的模型参数表示为 ψ \psi。

sents.en: Note that the only difference with Figure 9.7 (bottom) is the introduction of the ψ \psi parameters.
sents.zh: 请注意，与图 9.7（底部）相比，唯一的区别是引入了 ψ \psi 参数。

sents.en: In ReFT the LLM parameters ψ \psi change, they are finetuned based on the rewards from the dataset.
sents.zh: 在 ReFT 中，LLM 的参数 ψ \psi 会发生变化，它们会根据数据集提供的奖励进行微调。

sents.en: We should interpret the figures such that where learning at inference time was in-context, this has now changed, since we allow finetuning of the parameters ψ \psi .
sents.zh: 我们应该这样理解这些图表：原本推理时的学习是在上下文中进行的，但现在情况发生了变化，因为我们允许对参数 ψ \psi 进行微调。

sents.en: In the traditional LLM training pipeline, finetuning is a stage that comes before inference.
sents.zh: 在传统 LLM 训练流程中，微调是一个发生在推理之前的阶段。

sents.en: However, for many important applications, such as math reasoning or coding, chain of thought multi-step inference-time roll-outs produce accurate rewards that can be used for finetuning.
sents.zh: 然而，对于许多重要应用（如数学推理或编程），思维链多步推理过程能够生成准确的奖励，这些奖励可用于微调。

sents.en: Therefore, in reinforcement finetuning, the model is used to produce training targets at inference-time, that are then used to finetune the parameters of the same model—finetuning at inference-time.
sents.zh: 因此，在强化微调中，模型被用于在推理时生成训练目标，而这些目标随后又被用来对同一模型进行微调——即推理时的微调。

sents.en: Reinforcement finetuning blurs the line between inference and finetuning, where supervised finetuning has a clear separation between training and inference.
sents.zh: 强化微调模糊了推理与微调之间的界限，而监督式微调则在训练和推理之间有着明确的区分。

paragraphs.en: In LLM training there are three main training/inference moments: (1) pretraining, (2) finetuning, (3) testing (inference). Self-reflection (Style D) does reinforcement learning at inference time. In style E, reinforcement finetuning, we do not do reinforcement learning at test time (3), but at finetune time (2). In agentic LLM, this interaction style allows the LLM to learn from agent interaction with the world.
paragraphs.zh: 在 LLM 训练中，主要有三个训练/推理阶段：(1) 预训练、(2) 微调、(3) 测试（推理）。 自我反思（风格 D）在推理阶段执行强化学习。 在风格 E 的强化微调中，我们不在测试阶段 (3) 执行强化学习，而是在微调阶段 (2) 执行。 在智能体式 LLM 中，这种交互方式使 LLM 能够从智能体与世界的互动中学习。

sents.en: In LLM training there are three main training/inference moments: (1) pretraining, (2) finetuning, (3) testing (inference).
sents.zh: 在 LLM 训练中，主要有三个训练/推理阶段：(1) 预训练、(2) 微调、(3) 测试（推理）。

sents.en: Self-reflection (Style D) does reinforcement learning at inference time.
sents.zh: 自我反思（风格 D）在推理阶段执行强化学习。

sents.en: In style E, reinforcement finetuning, we do not do reinforcement learning at test time (3), but at finetune time (2).
sents.zh: 在风格 E 的强化微调中，我们不在测试阶段 (3) 执行强化学习，而是在微调阶段 (2) 执行。

sents.en: In agentic LLM, this interaction style allows the LLM to learn from agent interaction with the world.
sents.zh: 在智能体式 LLM 中，这种交互方式使 LLM 能够从智能体与世界的互动中学习。

paragraphs.en: For the dynamic agentic styles D and E, care must be taken to achieve stable convergence. As of this writing, few works have been published that report on such results.
paragraphs.zh: 对于动态智能体风格 D 和 E，必须谨慎处理以实现稳定收敛。 截至本文撰写之时，仅有少数研究报道了此类结果。

sents.en: For the dynamic agentic styles D and E, care must be taken to achieve stable convergence.
sents.zh: 对于动态智能体风格 D 和 E，必须谨慎处理以实现稳定收敛。

sents.en: As of this writing, few works have been published that report on such results.
sents.zh: 截至本文撰写之时，仅有少数研究报道了此类结果。

paragraphs.en: Humans (and other forms of life) remember. Our memory enables us to have an identity. We can remember our name, our friends, and our family members. Memory allows us to learn what is good an what is bad for us, and it allows us to adapt our behavior. When we suffer memory-loss, either through injury, illness, or old age, our personality changes. Severe memory-loss leads to loss of identity, we wander aimlessly through the world.
paragraphs.zh: 人类（以及其他生命形式）具有记忆能力。 我们的记忆使我们能够拥有身份认同。 我们能够记住自己的名字、朋友以及家人。 记忆让我们学会哪些事物对我们有益，哪些有害，并使我们能够调整自己的行为。 当我们因受伤、疾病或衰老而遭受记忆丧失时，我们的个性也会随之改变。 严重的记忆丧失会导致身份认同的丧失，我们会漫无目的地在世界上游荡。

sents.en: Our memory enables us to have an identity.
sents.zh: 我们的记忆使我们能够拥有身份认同。

sents.en: We can remember our name, our friends, and our family members.
sents.zh: 我们能够记住自己的名字、朋友以及家人。

sents.zh: 当我们因受伤、疾病或衰老而遭受记忆丧失时，我们的个性也会随之改变。

sents.en: Severe memory-loss leads to loss of identity, we wander aimlessly through the world.
sents.zh: 严重的记忆丧失会导致身份认同的丧失，我们会漫无目的地在世界上游荡。

paragraphs.en: Agents also need memory. In this section we will discuss why agentic LLM needs memory, and we provide a brief overview of the different types of memory that have been developed for agentic LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体也需要记忆。 在本节中，我们将讨论为什么具备智能体能力的 LLM 需要记忆，并对为这类 LLM 开发的各类记忆机制进行简要概述。

sents.en: Agents also need memory.
sents.zh: 智能体也需要记忆。

sents.en: In this section we will discuss why agentic LLM needs memory, and we provide a brief overview of the different types of memory that have been developed for agentic LLM.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们将讨论为什么具备智能体能力的 LLM 需要记忆，并对为这类 LLM 开发的各类记忆机制进行简要概述。

paragraphs.en: A statistical model f ⁡ ( x ) → y ^ f(x)\rightarrow\hat{y} estimates an output y ^ \hat{y} based on the relation f f that it has learned for its input x x at training time. Such functional behavior is memory-free. Any new information (post-training) must be provided to the model through the input parameters x x . LLMs are no different, and even the earliest chatbots were provided with special hidden system prompts that fed the model a history of the conversation, so that it is able to hold a coherent conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 统计模型 f ⁡ ( x ) → y ^ f(x)\rightarrow\hat{y} 基于其在训练时针对输入 x x 所学到的关系 f f，对输出 y ^ \hat{y} 进行估计。 这种函数行为是无记忆的。 任何新信息（训练后）都必须通过输入参数 x x 提供给模型。 LLM 也不例外，甚至最早的聊天机器人也通过特殊的隐藏系统提示向模型提供对话历史，使其能够进行连贯的对话。

sents.en: A statistical model f ⁡ ( x ) → y ^ f(x)\rightarrow\hat{y} estimates an output y ^ \hat{y} based on the relation f f that it has learned for its input x x at training time.
sents.zh: 统计模型 f ⁡ ( x ) → y ^ f(x)\rightarrow\hat{y} 基于其在训练时针对输入 x x 所学到的关系 f f，对输出 y ^ \hat{y} 进行估计。

sents.en: Such functional behavior is memory-free.
sents.zh: 这种函数行为是无记忆的。

sents.en: Any new information (post-training) must be provided to the model through the input parameters x x .
sents.zh: 任何新信息（训练后）都必须通过输入参数 x x 提供给模型。

sents.en: LLMs are no different, and even the earliest chatbots were provided with special hidden system prompts that fed the model a history of the conversation, so that it is able to hold a coherent conversation.
sents.zh: LLM 也不例外，甚至最早的聊天机器人也通过特殊的隐藏系统提示向模型提供对话历史，使其能够进行连贯的对话。

paragraphs.en: As the use cases for agentic LLM increase, more advanced techniques are needed, beyond the system-prompt method. To better understand what memory is used for in agentic LLMs, we will now discuss different use cases for memory.
paragraphs.zh: 随着智能体式大语言模型的使用场景日益增多，我们需要采用比系统提示方法更先进的技术。 为了更好地理解记忆在智能体式大语言模型中的用途，接下来我们将讨论记忆的不同使用场景。

sents.en: As the use cases for agentic LLM increase, more advanced techniques are needed, beyond the system-prompt method.
sents.zh: 随着智能体式大语言模型的使用场景日益增多，我们需要采用比系统提示方法更先进的技术。

sents.en: To better understand what memory is used for in agentic LLMs, we will now discuss different use cases for memory.
sents.zh: 为了更好地理解记忆在智能体式大语言模型中的用途，接下来我们将讨论记忆的不同使用场景。

paragraphs.en: Many machine learning benchmarks for LLMs are of the challenge/response type, and they are well suited for the functional input/output behavior of statistical models. The main real world use case for LLMs, however, is as a chat-bot, where the LLM is expected to engage in a meaningful conversation with the user. In order to maintain a coherent conversation, in which conversational partners react and respond to each other, chat-bots must be able to know what has been said before.
paragraphs.zh: 许多针对大型语言模型（LLM）的机器学习基准测试都属于挑战/响应类型，它们非常适合统计模型的功能性输入/输出行为。 然而，LLM 在现实世界中的主要应用是作为聊天机器人，此时 LLM 需要能够与用户进行有意义的对话。 为了维持连贯的对话，使对话双方能够相互反应和回应，聊天机器人必须能够了解之前已经说过什么。

sents.en: Many machine learning benchmarks for LLMs are of the challenge/response type, and they are well suited for the functional input/output behavior of statistical models.
sents.zh: 许多针对大型语言模型（LLM）的机器学习基准测试都属于挑战/响应类型，它们非常适合统计模型的功能性输入/输出行为。

sents.en: The main real world use case for LLMs, however, is as a chat-bot, where the LLM is expected to engage in a meaningful conversation with the user.
sents.zh: 然而，LLM 在现实世界中的主要应用是作为聊天机器人，此时 LLM 需要能够与用户进行有意义的对话。

sents.en: In order to maintain a coherent conversation, in which conversational partners react and respond to each other, chat-bots must be able to know what has been said before.
sents.zh: 为了维持连贯的对话，使对话双方能够相互反应和回应，聊天机器人必须能够了解之前已经说过什么。

paragraphs.en: Thus, a first requirement for agentic LLMs is to be able know what has been said before in a conversation.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，智能体式大型语言模型的首要要求是能够了解对话中之前已经说过什么。

paragraphs.en: According to our definition in Chapter 1 , agentic LLMs are expected to learn. When a robot performs a task in a kitchen, such as chopping an onion, and the location of the knife has moved, then it should adapt its actions: it should now first pick up the knife from its new location before starting to chop. Agents interact with the environment, and if the environment changes, then agents should adapt.
paragraphs.zh: 根据我们在第 1 章中的定义，智能体式 LLM 应当具备学习能力。 当机器人在厨房中执行任务（例如切洋葱）时，如果刀具的位置发生了变化，它就应该调整自己的动作：此时它应当先从新的位置拿起刀具，然后再开始切。 智能体与环境进行交互，如果环境发生变化，那么智能体也应该做出相应调整。

sents.en: According to our definition in Chapter 1 , agentic LLMs are expected to learn.
sents.zh: 根据我们在第 1 章中的定义，智能体式 LLM 应当具备学习能力。

sents.en: When a robot performs a task in a kitchen, such as chopping an onion, and the location of the knife has moved, then it should adapt its actions: it should now first pick up the knife from its new location before starting to chop.
sents.zh: 当机器人在厨房中执行任务（例如切洋葱）时，如果刀具的位置发生了变化，它就应该调整自己的动作：此时它应当先从新的位置拿起刀具，然后再开始切。

sents.en: Agents interact with the environment, and if the environment changes, then agents should adapt.
sents.zh: 智能体与环境进行交互，如果环境发生变化，那么智能体也应该做出相应调整。

paragraphs.en: Either our agent’s pretrained policies must be highly general, and able to adapt to all new situations in a certain domain, or our agents architecture must flexible, and recognize when a pretrained policy requires adaptation, finetuning or even re-training. For this, they need memory.
paragraphs.zh: 要么我们智能体的预训练策略必须具备高度的通用性，能够适应特定领域内的所有新情况；要么我们智能体的架构必须足够灵活，能够识别出何时需要对预训练策略进行调整、微调甚至重新训练。 为此，它们需要记忆能力。

sents.en: Either our agent’s pretrained policies must be highly general, and able to adapt to all new situations in a certain domain, or our agents architecture must flexible, and recognize when a pretrained policy requires adaptation, finetuning or even re-training.
sents.zh: 要么我们智能体的预训练策略必须具备高度的通用性，能够适应特定领域内的所有新情况；要么我们智能体的架构必须足够灵活，能够识别出何时需要对预训练策略进行调整、微调甚至重新训练。

sents.en: For this, they need memory.
sents.zh: 为此，它们需要记忆能力。

paragraphs.en: As we have seen in Section 6.2.4 , the external prompt improvement harnesses that are used in self-reflective agent architectures require buffers and other memory types for explicit prompt improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 正如我们在第 6.2.4 节中所看到的，外部提示改进机制需要缓冲区和其他类型的内存来实现显式的提示改进，而这些机制正是自我反思型智能体架构所采用的。

paragraphs.en: Our experiences shape our personality and our identity. When LLM agents are to build up their own identity, the experiences must either be collected and held in a memory, to be used for self-reflection, or they must be processed and used in other ways to adapt their behavior policy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的经历塑造了我们的性格和身份。 当 LLM 智能体需要建立自己的身份时，这些经历要么必须被收集并储存在记忆中，用于自我反思；要么必须经过处理并以其他方式加以利用，以调整其行为策略。

sents.en: Our experiences shape our personality and our identity.
sents.zh: 我们的经历塑造了我们的性格和身份。

sents.en: When LLM agents are to build up their own identity, the experiences must either be collected and held in a memory, to be used for self-reflection, or they must be processed and used in other ways to adapt their behavior policy.
sents.zh: 当 LLM 智能体需要建立自己的身份时，这些经历要么必须被收集并储存在记忆中，用于自我反思；要么必须经过处理并以其他方式加以利用，以调整其行为策略。

paragraphs.en: As the memory architectures of agentic harnesses improve, agents will be able to better remember their experiences. When that happens, we may find that our agents can acquire, through their agentic experiences, a unique personality.
paragraphs.zh: 随着智能体工具的记忆架构不断改进，智能体将能够更清晰地记住自己的经历。 当这种情况发生时，我们可能会发现，我们的智能体能够通过其作为智能体的经历，形成一种独特的个性。

sents.en: As the memory architectures of agentic harnesses improve, agents will be able to better remember their experiences.
sents.zh: 随着智能体工具的记忆架构不断改进，智能体将能够更清晰地记住自己的经历。

sents.en: When that happens, we may find that our agents can acquire, through their agentic experiences, a unique personality.
sents.zh: 当这种情况发生时，我们可能会发现，我们的智能体能够通过其作为智能体的经历，形成一种独特的个性。

paragraphs.en: Traditional machine learning trains a model on a particular dataset for a particular task. Human learning is different, our learning evolves continuously throughout our lives. In machine learning, continual learning studies how models can be trained for a sequence of new tasks while preserving previously learned tasks [ Wang et al., 2024 , Li et al., 2025a ] . Like metalearning, it studies generalization across related tasks. Major challenges in continual learning are to overcome catastrophic forgetting, and how to cope with changing data distributions.
paragraphs.zh: 传统机器学习针对特定任务，在特定数据集上训练模型。 人类的学习则不同，我们的学习会在一生中持续演变。 在机器学习中，持续学习研究的是如何使模型能够针对一系列新任务进行训练，同时保留之前已学到的任务 [ Wang et al., 2024 , Li et al., 2025a ] 。 与元学习类似，它研究的是在相关任务之间的泛化能力。 持续学习的主要挑战在于克服灾难性遗忘，以及如何处理不断变化的数据分布。

sents.en: Traditional machine learning trains a model on a particular dataset for a particular task.
sents.zh: 传统机器学习针对特定任务，在特定数据集上训练模型。

sents.en: Human learning is different, our learning evolves continuously throughout our lives.
sents.zh: 人类的学习则不同，我们的学习会在一生中持续演变。

sents.en: In machine learning, continual learning studies how models can be trained for a sequence of new tasks while preserving previously learned tasks [ Wang et al., 2024 , Li et al., 2025a ] .
sents.zh: 在机器学习中，持续学习研究的是如何使模型能够针对一系列新任务进行训练，同时保留之前已学到的任务 [ Wang et al., 2024 , Li et al., 2025a ] 。

sents.en: Like metalearning, it studies generalization across related tasks.
sents.zh: 与元学习类似，它研究的是在相关任务之间的泛化能力。

sents.en: Major challenges in continual learning are to overcome catastrophic forgetting, and how to cope with changing data distributions.
sents.zh: 持续学习的主要挑战在于克服灾难性遗忘，以及如何处理不断变化的数据分布。

paragraphs.en: The field of continual learning provides a variety of architectures that support this type of training.
paragraphs.zh: 持续学习领域提供了多种支持此类训练的建筑结构。

paragraphs.en: The field of agentic LLM is young. Only recently are memory architectures for LLM agents starting to receive attention. We will discuss the different approaches that have so far appeared.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体大语言模型这一领域尚处于起步阶段。 直到最近，为大语言模型智能体设计的记忆架构才开始受到关注。 我们将讨论迄今为止出现的不同方法。

sents.en: The field of agentic LLM is young.
sents.zh: 智能体大语言模型这一领域尚处于起步阶段。

sents.en: Only recently are memory architectures for LLM agents starting to receive attention.
sents.zh: 直到最近，为大语言模型智能体设计的记忆架构才开始受到关注。

sents.en: We will discuss the different approaches that have so far appeared.
sents.zh: 我们将讨论迄今为止出现的不同方法。

paragraphs.en: A pragmatic way to deal with the need for memory is to incorporate new information into the model as it arrives. Instead of developing external memory management algorithms, we could take advantage of the fact that model parameters are a form of memory, and finetune the model as the new examples arrive.
paragraphs.zh: 应对记忆需求的一种实用方法是，在新信息到达时将其整合到模型中。 与其开发外部的记忆管理算法，不如利用模型参数本身就是一种记忆这一事实，并在新样本到达时对模型进行微调。

sents.en: A pragmatic way to deal with the need for memory is to incorporate new information into the model as it arrives.
sents.zh: 应对记忆需求的一种实用方法是，在新信息到达时将其整合到模型中。

sents.en: Instead of developing external memory management algorithms, we could take advantage of the fact that model parameters are a form of memory, and finetune the model as the new examples arrive.
sents.zh: 与其开发外部的记忆管理算法，不如利用模型参数本身就是一种记忆这一事实，并在新样本到达时对模型进行微调。

paragraphs.en: To achieve this approach in an agentic setting, the finetuning must happen quickly, before the user can perceive a lag. Parameter efficient finetuning methods such as LoRA are an option [ Yang et al., 2024 ] . Although this is an elegant approach that does not require external algorithms or memory structures, for most applications the finetuning will not happen quickly enough, and an in-context or harness solution should be developed.
paragraphs.zh: 要在智能体环境中实现这种方法，微调过程必须足够迅速，以免用户察觉到延迟。 LoRA 等参数高效的微调方法是一种可行方案 [ Yang et al., 2024 ] 。 尽管这是一种优雅的方法，无需外部算法或记忆结构，但对于大多数应用而言，微调的速度仍不够快，因此需要开发一种上下文内或工具集成的解决方案。

sents.en: To achieve this approach in an agentic setting, the finetuning must happen quickly, before the user can perceive a lag.
sents.zh: 要在智能体环境中实现这种方法，微调过程必须足够迅速，以免用户察觉到延迟。

sents.en: Parameter efficient finetuning methods such as LoRA are an option [ Yang et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: LoRA 等参数高效的微调方法是一种可行方案 [ Yang et al., 2024 ] 。

sents.en: Although this is an elegant approach that does not require external algorithms or memory structures, for most applications the finetuning will not happen quickly enough, and an in-context or harness solution should be developed.
sents.zh: 尽管这是一种优雅的方法，无需外部算法或记忆结构，但对于大多数应用而言，微调的速度仍不够快，因此需要开发一种上下文内或工具集成的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: A second approach is to perform prompt management. The standard approach of chat-bots is to provide a truncated form of the chat-history to the LLM by injecting it into the prompt in addition to the user’s text. This is an approach that works quite well in practice. A limitation is that context windows are limited in size, and processing large contexts is expensive because of the squared time complexity of the attention mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 第二种方法是进行提示管理。 聊天机器人的标准做法是，在提示中注入聊天历史的部分内容，并将其与用户的文本一并提供给大型语言模型（LLM）。 这种方法在实践中效果相当好。 其局限性在于上下文窗口的数量有限，而且由于注意力机制的时间复杂度为平方级，处理大规模上下文会耗费大量资源。

sents.en: A second approach is to perform prompt management.
sents.zh: 第二种方法是进行提示管理。

sents.en: The standard approach of chat-bots is to provide a truncated form of the chat-history to the LLM by injecting it into the prompt in addition to the user’s text.
sents.zh: 聊天机器人的标准做法是，在提示中注入聊天历史的部分内容，并将其与用户的文本一并提供给大型语言模型（LLM）。

sents.en: This is an approach that works quite well in practice.
sents.zh: 这种方法在实践中效果相当好。

sents.en: A limitation is that context windows are limited in size, and processing large contexts is expensive because of the squared time complexity of the attention mechanism.
sents.zh: 其局限性在于上下文窗口的数量有限，而且由于注意力机制的时间复杂度为平方级，处理大规模上下文会耗费大量资源。

paragraphs.en: Two types of solutions have been pursued. First, specific long-context architectures have been developed, that keep track of attention in different ways [ Smith et al., 2022 ] . This is an active field of research, a survey of recent approaches is Liu et al. [2025] . Second, compression schemes have been developed, to semantically compress the prompt into a smaller stream. A survey is Li et al. [2025b] . Prompts can be divided into chunks [ Sheng et al., 2025 ] , to allow processing of large prompts. A related approach uses the LLM to generate code for processing long prompts recursively [ Zhang et al., 2025a ] .
paragraphs.zh: 目前已有两类解决方案被提出。 首先，研究人员开发了特定的长上下文架构，这些架构以不同方式跟踪注意力机制 [Smith et al., 2022]。 这是一个活跃的研究领域，近期方法的综述可见于 Liu et al. [2025]。 其次，研究人员开发了压缩方案，用于将提示在语义层面压缩为更短的数据流。相关综述可见于 Li et al. [2025b]。 提示可以被划分为多个片段 [Sheng et al., 2025]，从而能够处理大型提示。 一种相关的方法是利用大语言模型递归地生成处理长提示的代码 [Zhang et al., 2025a]。

sents.en: Two types of solutions have been pursued.
sents.zh: 目前已有两类解决方案被提出。

sents.en: First, specific long-context architectures have been developed, that keep track of attention in different ways [ Smith et al., 2022 ] .
sents.zh: 首先，研究人员开发了特定的长上下文架构，这些架构以不同方式跟踪注意力机制 [Smith et al., 2022]。

sents.en: This is an active field of research, a survey of recent approaches is Liu et al. [2025] .
sents.zh: 这是一个活跃的研究领域，近期方法的综述可见于 Liu et al. [2025]。

sents.en: Second, compression schemes have been developed, to semantically compress the prompt into a smaller stream. A survey is Li et al. [2025b] .
sents.zh: 其次，研究人员开发了压缩方案，用于将提示在语义层面压缩为更短的数据流。相关综述可见于 Li et al. [2025b]。

sents.en: Prompts can be divided into chunks [ Sheng et al., 2025 ] , to allow processing of large prompts.
sents.zh: 提示可以被划分为多个片段 [Sheng et al., 2025]，从而能够处理大型提示。

sents.en: A related approach uses the LLM to generate code for processing long prompts recursively [ Zhang et al., 2025a ] .
sents.zh: 一种相关的方法是利用大语言模型递归地生成处理长提示的代码 [Zhang et al., 2025a]。

paragraphs.en: Prompts can also be compressed through filtering of unnecessary tokens (this sentence could become Prompts compressed filtering unnecessary tokens ). Another approach is soft prompts [ Lester et al., 2021 ] . Soft prompts eliminate discrete tokens, but learn embeddings (via backpropagation) that can be fed directly into the transformer, without mapping them to actual language tokens. This context can serve as an alternative to a plain-text context. Impressive compression rates have been reported, from ten-fold [ Mu et al., 2023 ] to hundred-fold [ Li et al., 2025c ] .
paragraphs.zh: 提示词也可以通过过滤不必要的标记进行压缩（这句话可以简化为“提示词通过过滤不必要的标记进行压缩”）。 另一种方法是软提示 [ Lester et al., 2021 ]。 软提示消除了离散标记，但会学习嵌入表示（通过反向传播），这些嵌入可以直接输入到变换器中，而无需将其映射到实际的语言标记。 这种上下文可以作为纯文本上下文的替代方案。 据报道，压缩率非常显著，从十倍 [ Mu et al., 2023 ] 到百倍 [ Li et al., 2025c ] 不等。

sents.en: Prompts can also be compressed through filtering of unnecessary tokens (this sentence could become Prompts compressed filtering unnecessary tokens ).
sents.zh: 提示词也可以通过过滤不必要的标记进行压缩（这句话可以简化为“提示词通过过滤不必要的标记进行压缩”）。

sents.en: Another approach is soft prompts [ Lester et al., 2021 ] .
sents.zh: 另一种方法是软提示 [ Lester et al., 2021 ]。

sents.zh: 这种上下文可以作为纯文本上下文的替代方案。

sents.en: Impressive compression rates have been reported, from ten-fold [ Mu et al., 2023 ] to hundred-fold [ Li et al., 2025c ] .
sents.zh: 据报道，压缩率非常显著，从十倍 [ Mu et al., 2023 ] 到百倍 [ Li et al., 2025c ] 不等。

paragraphs.en: If we need to store state between LLM calls, then a straightforward solution is for the agent harness to provide this storage, as part of its prompt management. In Section 6.2.4 we saw how the external prompt-improvement algorithms for self-reflection add different types of storage, such as in the reflexion approach and the buffer of thoughts approach (Figures 6.8 and 6.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 如果我们需要在 LLM 调用之间存储状态，那么一个直接的解决方案是，由智能体框架作为提示管理的一部分来提供这种存储功能。 在第 6.2.4 节中，我们了解了用于自我反思的外部提示改进算法如何添加不同类型的存储，例如在反思方法和思想缓冲区方法中（图 6.8 和图 6.6）。

sents.en: If we need to store state between LLM calls, then a straightforward solution is for the agent harness to provide this storage, as part of its prompt management.
sents.zh: 如果我们需要在 LLM 调用之间存储状态，那么一个直接的解决方案是，由智能体框架作为提示管理的一部分来提供这种存储功能。

sents.en: In Section 6.2.4 we saw how the external prompt-improvement algorithms for self-reflection add different types of storage, such as in the reflexion approach and the buffer of thoughts approach (Figures 6.8 and 6.6 ).
sents.zh: 在第 6.2.4 节中，我们了解了用于自我反思的外部提示改进算法如何添加不同类型的存储，例如在反思方法和思想缓冲区方法中（图 6.8 和图 6.6）。

paragraphs.en: Agents can have different requirements for their storage (see Zhang et al. [2025b] , Chhikara et al. [2025] for a survey). We will discuss some of the recent studies of this active field of research. Prompts can be stored in textual or parametric form, and relevant operations are the reading and writing to memory. Furthermore, memory management operations are important, such as for compacting and forgetting information. Also, additional services can be provided by the memory systems. For example, MemoryBank [ Zhong et al., 2024 ] adds hierarchical summaries and uses LLM prompts to provide a running personality of the interaction events of a user.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体对其存储可能有不同的要求（相关综述请参见 Zhang 等人 [2025b] 和 Chhikara 等人 [2025] 的研究）。我们将讨论这一活跃研究领域的一些近期研究。提示可以以文本或参数形式存储，相关的操作包括对内存的读取和写入。此外，内存管理操作也很重要，例如信息的压缩和遗忘。另外，内存系统还可以提供额外的服务。例如，MemoryBank [Zhong 等人, 2024] 增加了层级摘要，并利用大型语言模型（LLM）提示来为用户的交互事件提供持续的人格设定。

paragraphs.en: Operations to store and retrieve items can be added to an agent. MemGPT [ Packer et al., 2023 ] studies how LLMs can read and write to external memory using function calls (memory as a tool). A-mem [ Xu et al., 2025 ] introduces contextual descriptions of memory, based on a mailbox principle.
paragraphs.zh: 可以添加用于存储和检索项目的操作到智能体中。 MemGPT [ Packer 等人，2023 ] 研究了大型语言模型如何通过函数调用（将记忆作为一种工具）读取和写入外部记忆。 A-mem [ Xu 等人，2025 ] 基于邮箱原则引入了对记忆的上下文描述。

sents.en: Operations to store and retrieve items can be added to an agent.
sents.zh: 可以添加用于存储和检索项目的操作到智能体中。

sents.en: MemGPT [ Packer et al., 2023 ] studies how LLMs can read and write to external memory using function calls (memory as a tool).
sents.zh: MemGPT [ Packer 等人，2023 ] 研究了大型语言模型如何通过函数调用（将记忆作为一种工具）读取和写入外部记忆。

sents.en: A-mem [ Xu et al., 2025 ] introduces contextual descriptions of memory, based on a mailbox principle.
sents.zh: A-mem [ Xu 等人，2025 ] 基于邮箱原则引入了对记忆的上下文描述。

paragraphs.en: A disadvantage of the explicit memory management approach is that the LLM has to perform memory management explicitly, without having been trained how to do this effectively. An alternative solution is to manually write memory management code, when it is possible to foresee all possible requirements. The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a set of strategies designed for context management. Section 11.4 describes the protocol in more depth.
paragraphs.zh: 显式内存管理方法的一个缺点是，大型语言模型必须显式地执行内存管理，而它并未接受过如何有效执行这项任务的训练。 另一种解决方案是手动编写内存管理代码，前提是能够预见所有可能的需求。 模型上下文协议（MCP）是一系列为上下文管理而设计的策略。 第 11.4 节将更详细地介绍该协议。

sents.en: A disadvantage of the explicit memory management approach is that the LLM has to perform memory management explicitly, without having been trained how to do this effectively.
sents.zh: 显式内存管理方法的一个缺点是，大型语言模型必须显式地执行内存管理，而它并未接受过如何有效执行这项任务的训练。

sents.en: An alternative solution is to manually write memory management code, when it is possible to foresee all possible requirements.
sents.zh: 另一种解决方案是手动编写内存管理代码，前提是能够预见所有可能的需求。

sents.en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a set of strategies designed for context management.
sents.zh: 模型上下文协议（MCP）是一系列为上下文管理而设计的策略。

sents.en: Section 11.4 describes the protocol in more depth.
sents.zh: 第 11.4 节将更详细地介绍该协议。

paragraphs.en: Mem1 [ Zhou et al., 2025 ] uses a different approach: after each LLM interaction the agent updates a compact state to be shared with future LLM calls. The memory size required is constant, so that the state does not run out of the context window. The shared state is created by inserting reasoning-style tags into the prompt, and is trained using reinforcement learning to incentivize state consolidation. Mem- α \alpha is another approach that uses reinforcement learning to train agents to effectively use memory [ Wang et al., 2025 ] .
paragraphs.zh: Mem1 [ Zhou et al., 2025 ] 采用了一种不同的方法：在每次与 LLM 交互之后，智能体会更新一个紧凑的状态，以便在与未来的 LLM 调用中共享。 所需的内存大小是固定的，因此该状态不会超出上下文窗口。 共享状态通过将推理风格的标签插入提示词中创建出来，并通过强化学习进行训练，以激励状态的整合。 Mem- α \alpha 是另一种方法，它利用强化学习训练智能体有效使用内存 [ Wang et al., 2025 ] 。

sents.en: Mem1 [ Zhou et al., 2025 ] uses a different approach: after each LLM interaction the agent updates a compact state to be shared with future LLM calls.
sents.zh: Mem1 [ Zhou et al., 2025 ] 采用了一种不同的方法：在每次与 LLM 交互之后，智能体会更新一个紧凑的状态，以便在与未来的 LLM 调用中共享。

sents.en: The memory size required is constant, so that the state does not run out of the context window.
sents.zh: 所需的内存大小是固定的，因此该状态不会超出上下文窗口。

sents.en: The shared state is created by inserting reasoning-style tags into the prompt, and is trained using reinforcement learning to incentivize state consolidation.
sents.zh: 共享状态通过将推理风格的标签插入提示词中创建出来，并通过强化学习进行训练，以激励状态的整合。

sents.en: Mem- α \alpha is another approach that uses reinforcement learning to train agents to effectively use memory [ Wang et al., 2025 ] .
sents.zh: Mem- α \alpha 是另一种方法，它利用强化学习训练智能体有效使用内存 [ Wang et al., 2025 ] 。

paragraphs.en: AgeMem [ Yu et al., 2026 ] integrates memory management operations into agent’s policy for end-to-end optimization. It distinguishes long term and short term memory, and uses a three-stage reinforcement learning scheme to train the agent in the use of the two types of memory.
paragraphs.zh: AgeMem [ Yu et al., 2026 ] 将记忆管理操作整合到智能体的策略中，以实现端到端的优化。 它区分了长期记忆和短期记忆，并采用三阶段强化学习方案来训练智能体使用这两种类型的记忆。

sents.en: AgeMem [ Yu et al., 2026 ] integrates memory management operations into agent’s policy for end-to-end optimization.
sents.zh: AgeMem [ Yu et al., 2026 ] 将记忆管理操作整合到智能体的策略中，以实现端到端的优化。

sents.en: It distinguishes long term and short term memory, and uses a three-stage reinforcement learning scheme to train the agent in the use of the two types of memory.
sents.zh: 它区分了长期记忆和短期记忆，并采用三阶段强化学习方案来训练智能体使用这两种类型的记忆。

paragraphs.en: This, too, is an active field of research, new studies and frameworks can be expected. See, for an overview, Zhou et al. [2026] .
paragraphs.zh: 这也是一个活跃的研究领域，预计会有新的研究和框架出现。 如需概览，请参见 Zhou 等人 [2026] 的研究。

paragraphs.en: In addition to the storage of prompts as human-readable text, we can also store their tokenized embeddings directly. Storing prompts as text is useful for retrieving data when an exact textual match is needed. Embeddings encode semantic information—which tokens are close to each other in meaning. Storing embeddings is therefore useful when we would like to retrieve items that are semantically close.
paragraphs.zh: 除了以人类可读文本的形式存储提示词外，我们也可以直接存储它们的分词嵌入表示。 以文本形式存储提示词有助于在需要精确文本匹配时检索数据。 嵌入表示编码了语义信息——即哪些分词在意义上彼此接近。 因此，当我们需要检索语义相近的项目时，存储嵌入表示会很有用。

sents.en: In addition to the storage of prompts as human-readable text, we can also store their tokenized embeddings directly.
sents.zh: 除了以人类可读文本的形式存储提示词外，我们也可以直接存储它们的分词嵌入表示。

sents.zh: 以文本形式存储提示词有助于在需要精确文本匹配时检索数据。

sents.zh: 嵌入表示编码了语义信息——即哪些分词在意义上彼此接近。

sents.en: Storing embeddings is therefore useful when we would like to retrieve items that are semantically close.
sents.zh: 因此，当我们需要检索语义相近的项目时，存储嵌入表示会很有用。

paragraphs.en: Embeddings can be stored in vector databases. Traditional relational databases store data in rows and columns. Vector databases store high-dimensional lists of numbers, and provide low-latency access to them, making them well-suited for LLMs [ Xie et al., 2023 , Ma et al., 2023 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 嵌入向量可以存储在向量数据库中。 传统的关系型数据库以行和列的形式存储数据。 向量数据库存储高维数字列表，并能提供低延迟的访问，因此非常适合大型语言模型 [ Xie et al., 2023 , Ma et al., 2023 ] 。

sents.en: Embeddings can be stored in vector databases.
sents.zh: 嵌入向量可以存储在向量数据库中。

sents.en: Traditional relational databases store data in rows and columns.
sents.zh: 传统的关系型数据库以行和列的形式存储数据。

paragraphs.en: The concept of an intelligent agent is a central concept in artificial intelligence. LLMs have increased the communication and reasoning capabilities of agents significantly. In this chapter, we have discussed different agent types, and have connected them to different traditions in AI.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的概念是人工智能中的一个核心概念。 大语言模型显著提升了智能体的沟通和推理能力。 在本章中，我们讨论了不同类型的智能体，并将其与人工智能的不同传统联系起来。

paragraphs.en: In this case we will work with an agentic LLM that performs self-reflection. We use a popular benchmark suite for reasoning tasks, called BALROG. 1 1 1 A Balrog is a mythical demon from Middle-earth, featured in the fantasy works of J.R.R. Tolkien. A Balrog is a match even for Gandalf the Grey, the most powerful wizard of all. BALROG is an acronym for B enchmarking A gentic L LM and VLM R easoning O n G ames. The BALROG benchmark consists of a mix of easy and hard games, some of which are difficult for LLMs to play well, as the BALROG paper shows in their own benchmarking study [ Paglieri et al., 2025 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在这种情况下，我们将使用一个能够进行自我反思的智能体式大语言模型。 我们使用一个用于推理任务的流行基准测试套件，名为 BALROG。1 1 1 巴洛格是源自中土世界的神话恶魔，出现在 J.R.R. 托尔金的奇幻作品中。 即使是所有巫师中最强大的灰袍甘道夫，也无法与巴洛格抗衡。 BALROG 是“智能体式大语言模型与视觉语言模型推理游戏基准测试”的缩写。 BALROG 基准测试包含一系列简单和复杂的混合游戏，其中一些游戏对于大语言模型来说很难玩得出色，正如 BALROG 论文在其自身的基准测试研究中所示 [ Paglieri et al., 2025 ]。

paragraphs.en: BALROG is designed to challenge in-context agents on reasoning problems. It uses puzzle-style games to benchmark the reasoning capabilities of LLMs and VLMs. Figure 10.1 lists the games. The games are from easy to hard: BabyAI, Crafter, TextWorld, BabaIsAI, MiniHack, and NetHack. The games offer a mix of challenges, some are text-based, some have a visual component, all include reasoning challenges for the model. Some of the games are considered hard. For example, it is not expected that your model or your agent—or your self—will reach a high score on NetHack. (If you do achieve that, without having accessed the cheat-sheets, you may want to consider writing a paper for a prestigious AI conference.)
paragraphs.zh: BALROG 旨在通过推理问题来挑战上下文智能体。 它使用谜题类游戏来评估 LLM 和 VLM 的推理能力。 图 10.1 列出了这些游戏。 这些游戏从易到难依次为：BabyAI、Crafter、TextWorld、BabaIsAI、MiniHack 和 NetHack。 这些游戏提供了多样化的挑战，有些基于文本，有些包含视觉元素，但所有游戏都为模型设置了推理难题。 其中一些游戏被认为具有较高难度。 例如，你的模型或智能体——甚至是你自己——都不太可能在 NetHack 中获得高分。 （如果你在没有查阅作弊表的情况下真的做到了，或许可以考虑为某个顶尖的人工智能会议撰写一篇论文。）

paragraphs.en: BALROG consists of the six puzzles and games shown in Figure 10.1 . The games run from easy grid world puzzles to hard text-based dungeon and dragons strategy games, with long credit assignment episodes and flat reward landscapes.
paragraphs.zh: BALROG 由图 10.1 中展示的六个谜题和游戏组成。 这些游戏涵盖了从简单的网格世界谜题到复杂的文本型龙与地下城策略游戏，具有较长的信用分配阶段和扁平化的奖励分布。

sents.en: BALROG consists of the six puzzles and games shown in Figure 10.1 .
sents.zh: BALROG 由图 10.1 中展示的六个谜题和游戏组成。

sents.en: The games run from easy grid world puzzles to hard text-based dungeon and dragons strategy games, with long credit assignment episodes and flat reward landscapes.
sents.zh: 这些游戏涵盖了从简单的网格世界谜题到复杂的文本型龙与地下城策略游戏，具有较长的信用分配阶段和扁平化的奖励分布。

paragraphs.en: The authors of BALROG provide a code base that allows experimentation with agents, to design your own agent, to see how well they do on the benchmarks. To perform well on the benchmarks in BALROG, the agents must be good at reasoning and planning, and, most likely, be good at adapting and reflecting on their own behavior.
paragraphs.zh: BALROG 的作者提供了一个代码库，允许对智能体进行实验、设计自己的智能体，并观察它们在基准测试中的表现。 要在 BALROG 的基准测试中表现出色，这些智能体必须擅长推理和规划，并且很可能还需要善于适应自身行为并对之进行反思。

sents.en: The authors of BALROG provide a code base that allows experimentation with agents, to design your own agent, to see how well they do on the benchmarks.
sents.zh: BALROG 的作者提供了一个代码库，允许对智能体进行实验、设计自己的智能体，并观察它们在基准测试中的表现。

sents.en: To perform well on the benchmarks in BALROG, the agents must be good at reasoning and planning, and, most likely, be good at adapting and reflecting on their own behavior.
sents.zh: 要在 BALROG 的基准测试中表现出色，这些智能体必须擅长推理和规划，并且很可能还需要善于适应自身行为并对之进行反思。

paragraphs.en: BabyAI is a simple grid-world game, where the agent has to solve a navigation task. A simple reinforcement learning type algorithm would be able to easily solve this game. Tasks are given in natural language, such as: go to the blue ball, then pick up the grey key . Of course, the challenge for the agentic LLM is to perform the planning part of the task. It is expected that the LLM will be able to do well on this simple game (see the BALROG paper).
paragraphs.zh: BabyAI 是一款简单的网格世界游戏，其中智能体需要完成一项导航任务。 一种简单的强化学习算法就能轻松解决这个游戏。 任务以自然语言给出，例如：前往蓝色球，然后捡起灰色钥匙。 当然，对于智能体式的大语言模型来说，挑战在于执行任务的规划部分。 预计大语言模型能够在这款简单游戏中表现出色（参见 BALROG 论文）。

sents.en: BabyAI is a simple grid-world game, where the agent has to solve a navigation task.
sents.zh: BabyAI 是一款简单的网格世界游戏，其中智能体需要完成一项导航任务。

sents.en: A simple reinforcement learning type algorithm would be able to easily solve this game.
sents.zh: 一种简单的强化学习算法就能轻松解决这个游戏。

sents.en: Tasks are given in natural language, such as: go to the blue ball, then pick up the grey key .
sents.zh: 任务以自然语言给出，例如：前往蓝色球，然后捡起灰色钥匙。

sents.zh: 当然，对于智能体式的大语言模型来说，挑战在于执行任务的规划部分。

sents.en: It is expected that the LLM will be able to do well on this simple game (see the BALROG paper).
sents.zh: 预计大语言模型能够在这款简单游戏中表现出色（参见 BALROG 论文）。

paragraphs.en: NetHack, on the other hand, is a highly challenging game, also for human players. NetHack is a text-based dungeons and dragons-like game. It includes both long-term strategic planning, in the sense that winning a game can involve hundreds of thousands of steps, and short-term tactical fights to fend of the usual hordes of monsters. Credit assignment is a challenge in NetHack, in order to understand which of the actions that the agent took in the past contributed to ultimate success or failure, since actions in one area of the game may have unexpected consequences far away, making it difficult to play for reinforcement learning agents. NetHack is known for human players to take years to master the game without resorting to cheat guides.
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面，NetHack 是一款极具挑战性的游戏，对人类玩家来说也是如此。 NetHack 是一款基于文本的类龙与地下城游戏。 它既包含长期战略规划——赢得一局游戏可能需要数十万步操作——也包含短期战术战斗，以抵御常见的怪物潮。 在 NetHack 中，信用分配是一个挑战：为了理解智能体过去采取的行动中哪些促成了最终的成功或失败，需要明确这些行动的影响，因为游戏中的某些行动可能会在遥远之处产生意想不到的后果，这使得强化学习智能体的游戏过程变得困难。 NetHack 以这样的特点而闻名：人类玩家若不借助作弊指南，往往需要数年才能完全掌握这款游戏。

paragraphs.en: Please familiarize yourself with the BALROG system. Read the paper Paglieri et al. [2025] , which you can find on https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.13543 , or go to the BALROG website at https://balrogai.com .
paragraphs.zh: 请熟悉 BALROG 系统。请阅读 Paglieri 等人 [2025] 的论文，您可以在 https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.13543 上找到该论文，或者访问 BALROG 网站：https://balrogai.com。

paragraphs.en: If you have not done so yet, install BALROG on your system with the git clone command. Go to https://balrogai.com , or directly to the Github repository at https://github.com/balrog-ai/BALROG . Install the repository on your local computer.
paragraphs.zh: 如果您尚未执行此操作，请使用 git clone 命令在您的系统上安装 BALROG。 访问 https://balrogai.com，或直接访问 Github 仓库：https://github.com/balrog-ai/BALROG。 在您的本地计算机上安装该仓库。

sents.en: If you have not done so yet, install BALROG on your system with the git clone command.
sents.zh: 如果您尚未执行此操作，请使用 git clone 命令在您的系统上安装 BALROG。

sents.en: Go to https://balrogai.com , or directly to the Github repository at https://github.com/balrog-ai/BALROG .
sents.zh: 访问 https://balrogai.com，或直接访问 Github 仓库：https://github.com/balrog-ai/BALROG。

sents.en: Install the repository on your local computer.
sents.zh: 在您的本地计算机上安装该仓库。

paragraphs.en: Decide which LLM you want to use. Please note that typical BALROG agents make many LLM calls, at each step of the way. If you want to run the LLM locally, install it, or use it from Huggingface. If you want to use a (commercial) cloud-based LLM, acquire an API-key and install the API-key in your environment. You may want to consider applying for a free student-tier, if that is offered. The use of frontier LLMs can be expensive, but usually older and smaller LLMs, some of which are still relatively capable, are much cheaper.
paragraphs.zh: 决定你想使用哪个大型语言模型（LLM）。 请注意，典型的 BALROG 智能体在每一步都会多次调用大型语言模型。 如果你想在本地运行该大型语言模型，可以安装它，或者通过 Huggingface 使用它。 如果你想使用（商业）云端大型语言模型，则需要获取一个 API 密钥，并将其安装到你的环境中。 如果提供免费的学生版，你可能需要考虑申请一个。 使用前沿大型语言模型可能会很昂贵，但通常较旧且规模较小的模型（其中一些仍然具备相当强的能力）要便宜得多。

sents.en: Decide which LLM you want to use.
sents.zh: 决定你想使用哪个大型语言模型（LLM）。

sents.en: Please note that typical BALROG agents make many LLM calls, at each step of the way.
sents.zh: 请注意，典型的 BALROG 智能体在每一步都会多次调用大型语言模型。

sents.en: If you want to run the LLM locally, install it, or use it from Huggingface.
sents.zh: 如果你想在本地运行该大型语言模型，可以安装它，或者通过 Huggingface 使用它。

sents.en: If you want to use a (commercial) cloud-based LLM, acquire an API-key and install the API-key in your environment.
sents.zh: 如果你想使用（商业）云端大型语言模型，则需要获取一个 API 密钥，并将其安装到你的环境中。

sents.en: You may want to consider applying for a free student-tier, if that is offered.
sents.zh: 如果提供免费的学生版，你可能需要考虑申请一个。

sents.en: The use of frontier LLMs can be expensive, but usually older and smaller LLMs, some of which are still relatively capable, are much cheaper.
sents.zh: 使用前沿大型语言模型可能会很昂贵，但通常较旧且规模较小的模型（其中一些仍然具备相当强的能力）要便宜得多。

paragraphs.en: The BALROG readme on the Github repository contains information on how to install the system, and how to install an API key for your favorite LLM, see Listing 10.3 . (In one of the exercises we will use multiple LLMs, to compare their performance. For now, we are just trying to get the system to run, and anyone will do.)
paragraphs.zh: Github 仓库中的 BALROG 说明文件包含了如何安装该系统以及如何为您的首选大型语言模型安装 API 键的信息，请参见列表 10.3。 （在其中一个练习中，我们将使用多个大型语言模型来比较它们的性能。 目前，我们只是想让系统运行起来，任何模型都可以。）

paragraphs.en: Please read the Agent tutorial in BALROG at https://github.com/balrog-ai/BALROG/blob/main/docs/agents.md . In BALROG, agents are small pieces of Python code that call an LLM with a prompt to provide an answer how to determine the next step. The agent code is responsible for receiving answers from the model (observations) and for selecting the next action. The LLM is used to execute various prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 请阅读 BALROG 中的智能体教程，地址为 https://github.com/balrog-ai/BALROG/blob/main/docs/agents.md 。 在 BALROG 中，智能体是小型的 Python 代码片段，它们通过提示调用大语言模型（LLM），以获取如何确定下一步骤的答案。 智能体代码负责接收来自模型的答案（观察结果），并选择下一个动作。 大语言模型（LLM）被用于执行各种提示。

sents.en: Please read the Agent tutorial in BALROG at https://github.com/balrog-ai/BALROG/blob/main/docs/agents.md .
sents.zh: 请阅读 BALROG 中的智能体教程，地址为 https://github.com/balrog-ai/BALROG/blob/main/docs/agents.md 。

sents.en: In BALROG, agents are small pieces of Python code that call an LLM with a prompt to provide an answer how to determine the next step.
sents.zh: 在 BALROG 中，智能体是小型的 Python 代码片段，它们通过提示调用大语言模型（LLM），以获取如何确定下一步骤的答案。

sents.en: The agent code is responsible for receiving answers from the model (observations) and for selecting the next action.
sents.zh: 智能体代码负责接收来自模型的答案（观察结果），并选择下一个动作。

sents.en: The LLM is used to execute various prompts.
sents.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）被用于执行各种提示。

paragraphs.en: BALROG follows interaction style D from Figure 9.7 , where the prompt is built up from the history of interactions.
paragraphs.zh: BALROG遵循图9.7中的交互风格D，其中提示词是根据交互历史构建的。

paragraphs.en: The agent builds a prompt based on previous actions, based on observation/action pairs from previous interactions. Thus, in reinforcement learning terms, the agent performs the function of the policy, selecting the next action to perform based on the incoming observation.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体基于先前交互中的观察/动作对，根据先前的动作构建提示。 因此，在强化学习的术语中，智能体执行策略的功能，根据传入的观察结果选择要执行的下一个动作。

sents.en: The agent builds a prompt based on previous actions, based on observation/action pairs from previous interactions.
sents.zh: 智能体基于先前交互中的观察/动作对，根据先前的动作构建提示。

sents.en: Thus, in reinforcement learning terms, the agent performs the function of the policy, selecting the next action to perform based on the incoming observation.
sents.zh: 因此，在强化学习的术语中，智能体执行策略的功能，根据传入的观察结果选择要执行的下一个动作。

paragraphs.en: Go to the prompt_builder directory to change the way that prompts are constructed from the history of actions.
paragraphs.zh: 前往 prompt_builder 目录，更改根据历史操作构建提示的方式。

paragraphs.en: Agents are responsible for the memory function: managing the observation/action histories. The agents must keep a record of past observations and actions to support context-aware decision-making, and this must be implemented by us, external to the LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体负责记忆功能：管理观察/动作历史。 智能体必须记录过去的观察和动作，以支持上下文感知的决策，而这一功能必须由我们在大型语言模型之外实现。

sents.en: Agents are responsible for the memory function: managing the observation/action histories.
sents.zh: 智能体负责记忆功能：管理观察/动作历史。

sents.en: The agents must keep a record of past observations and actions to support context-aware decision-making, and this must be implemented by us, external to the LLM.
sents.zh: 智能体必须记录过去的观察和动作，以支持上下文感知的决策，而这一功能必须由我们在大型语言模型之外实现。

paragraphs.en: The agent code in BALROG queries the LLM: agents send observations to the LLM, receive responses, and use those responses to decide on actions to take in the game.
paragraphs.zh: BALROG 中的智能体代码会向 LLM 发起查询：智能体将观察结果发送给 LLM，接收响应，并利用这些响应对游戏中的行动做出决策。

paragraphs.en: BALROG comes with a number of pre-written agents, which you should study to design your own. The repository has a naive agent and a chain of thought agent. Also provided are more robust versions for handling LLM responses.
paragraphs.zh: BALROG 附带了若干预先编写好的智能体，你应该研究它们以设计自己的智能体。 该仓库包含一个朴素智能体和一个链式思维智能体。 此外，还提供了更稳健的版本来处理 LLM 的响应。

sents.en: BALROG comes with a number of pre-written agents, which you should study to design your own.
sents.zh: BALROG 附带了若干预先编写好的智能体，你应该研究它们以设计自己的智能体。

sents.en: The repository has a naive agent and a chain of thought agent.
sents.zh: 该仓库包含一个朴素智能体和一个链式思维智能体。

sents.en: Also provided are more robust versions for handling LLM responses.
sents.zh: 此外，还提供了更稳健的版本来处理 LLM 的响应。

paragraphs.en: When you build your own agent, you will most likely build on the custom agent. The BALROG agent tutorial provides an example for a simple planning agent.
paragraphs.zh: 当你构建自己的智能体时，你很可能会基于自定义智能体进行构建。 BALROG 智能体教程提供了一个简单规划智能体的示例。

sents.zh: 当你构建自己的智能体时，你很可能会基于自定义智能体进行构建。

sents.en: The BALROG agent tutorial provides an example for a simple planning agent.
sents.zh: BALROG 智能体教程提供了一个简单规划智能体的示例。

paragraphs.en: We will now provide some exercises to help you explore building your agents.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们将提供一些练习，帮助您探索如何构建自己的智能体。

paragraphs.en: We start by trying to reproduce the results in the BALROG paper. Please have a look at the BALROG code at Github https://github.com/balrog-ai/BALROG . Read the Evaluation Guide, the Agent Development tutorial, and the instructions how to run Few Shot Learning experiments (in-context learning). Install the relevant tools on your computer, and the right Python version (and put it in your PATH). Check the version by starting the Python interpreter from the command prompt: $ python .
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先尝试复现 BALROG 论文中的结果。 请查看 Github 上的 BALROG 代码：https://github.com/balrog-ai/BALROG 。 阅读《评估指南》、《智能体开发教程》以及运行少样本学习（上下文学习）实验的说明。 在您的计算机上安装相关工具，并安装正确的 Python 版本（同时将其添加到 PATH 环境变量中）。 通过从命令提示符启动 Python 解释器来检查版本：$ python .
