paragraphs.en: First, run the standard evaluation, to make sure you installed things correctly, see Listing 10.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 首先，运行标准评估，以确保您已正确安装各项组件，请参见示例 10.4。

paragraphs.en: To get a feeling for how the standard agent performs on the different benchmarks with different LLMs, it is useful to run a few different LLMs. It is recommended to run closed and open LLMs, and see how they perform. Especially the open version from OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, OLMo and Qwen may work well.
paragraphs.zh: 为了了解标准智能体在不同基准测试中搭配不同大型语言模型时的表现，运行几款不同的大型语言模型会很有帮助。 建议同时运行闭源和开源的大型语言模型，观察它们的表现如何。 尤其是来自 OpenAI 的开源版本、Claude、DeepSeek、OLMo 和 Qwen 可能会表现出色。

sents.en: To get a feeling for how the standard agent performs on the different benchmarks with different LLMs, it is useful to run a few different LLMs.
sents.zh: 为了了解标准智能体在不同基准测试中搭配不同大型语言模型时的表现，运行几款不同的大型语言模型会很有帮助。

sents.en: It is recommended to run closed and open LLMs, and see how they perform.
sents.zh: 建议同时运行闭源和开源的大型语言模型，观察它们的表现如何。

sents.en: Especially the open version from OpenAI, Claude, DeepSeek, OLMo and Qwen may work well.
sents.zh: 尤其是来自 OpenAI 的开源版本、Claude、DeepSeek、OLMo 和 Qwen 可能会表现出色。

paragraphs.en: Running these models is important, and will lead to more insight into the relative strengths of the various models.
paragraphs.zh: 运行这些模型非常重要，这将有助于我们更深入地了解各种模型之间的相对优势。

paragraphs.en: Next, to get a better understanding of the benchmark, you should, after running the LLM agent in the different puzzle problems, have a closer look at the prompts and the answers of LLM. See if you can see where the LLM agent fails, where the weakness of the agent lies. By close inspection of the individual actions, and a deeper understanding of the puzzle, you might be able to think of a way to improve your agent.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，为了更好地理解这项基准测试，在让 LLM 智能体解决不同的谜题问题之后，你应该更仔细地审视提示词和 LLM 给出的答案。 看看你是否能发现 LLM 智能体失败的地方，以及它的弱点究竟在哪里。 通过仔细检查每一步操作，并更深入地理解谜题本身，你或许能够想到改进自己智能体的方法。

sents.en: Next, to get a better understanding of the benchmark, you should, after running the LLM agent in the different puzzle problems, have a closer look at the prompts and the answers of LLM.
sents.zh: 接下来，为了更好地理解这项基准测试，在让 LLM 智能体解决不同的谜题问题之后，你应该更仔细地审视提示词和 LLM 给出的答案。

sents.en: See if you can see where the LLM agent fails, where the weakness of the agent lies.
sents.zh: 看看你是否能发现 LLM 智能体失败的地方，以及它的弱点究竟在哪里。

sents.en: By close inspection of the individual actions, and a deeper understanding of the puzzle, you might be able to think of a way to improve your agent.
sents.zh: 通过仔细检查每一步操作，并更深入地理解谜题本身，你或许能够想到改进自己智能体的方法。

paragraphs.en: BALROG agents call an LLM for each step that the agent makes, often with a long prompt. In these puzzles and games many such steps are made. Running different LLMs on the full benchmark, for different seeds, will easily require many tokens.
paragraphs.zh: BALROG 智能体在每一步操作时都会调用一个大型语言模型（LLM），通常还会附带一段很长的提示。 在这些谜题和游戏中，会执行许多这样的步骤。 在不同的随机种子下，对整个基准测试运行不同的大型语言模型（LLM），将很容易消耗大量标记。

sents.en: BALROG agents call an LLM for each step that the agent makes, often with a long prompt.
sents.zh: BALROG 智能体在每一步操作时都会调用一个大型语言模型（LLM），通常还会附带一段很长的提示。

sents.en: In these puzzles and games many such steps are made.
sents.zh: 在这些谜题和游戏中，会执行许多这样的步骤。

sents.en: Running different LLMs on the full benchmark, for different seeds, will easily require many tokens.
sents.zh: 在不同的随机种子下，对整个基准测试运行不同的大型语言模型（LLM），将很容易消耗大量标记。

paragraphs.en: In your experiments, first try a small and cheap LLM, such as Qwen-3B. Start with the easiest benchmarks (BabyAI and Crafter). If you wish to expand, please go ahead, but be mindful of the computational cost. You want insights, but you also want your experiments to finish in a reasonable time for a reasonable cost.
paragraphs.zh: 在实验中，请先尝试一个规模小且成本低的 LLM，例如 Qwen-3B。 从最简单的基准测试（BabyAI 和 Crafter）开始。 如果您希望扩展实验规模，请继续，但请注意计算成本。 您既需要深入的见解，也希望实验能在合理的时间内以合理的成本完成。

sents.en: In your experiments, first try a small and cheap LLM, such as Qwen-3B.
sents.zh: 在实验中，请先尝试一个规模小且成本低的 LLM，例如 Qwen-3B。

sents.en: Start with the easiest benchmarks (BabyAI and Crafter).
sents.zh: 从最简单的基准测试（BabyAI 和 Crafter）开始。

sents.en: If you wish to expand, please go ahead, but be mindful of the computational cost.
sents.zh: 如果您希望扩展实验规模，请继续，但请注意计算成本。

sents.en: You want insights, but you also want your experiments to finish in a reasonable time for a reasonable cost.
sents.zh: 您既需要深入的见解，也希望实验能在合理的时间内以合理的成本完成。

paragraphs.en: Now it is time to implement your own learning agent. Go to the agents directory in balrog, and edit the custom.py file. Listing 10.5 reproduces the code for Custom Agent from the BALROG readme. The code can be run with the command in Listing 10.6 (specifying the custom agent, and running gently with fewer workers). Of course, you can specify your own LLM of choice in the command.
paragraphs.zh: 现在，是时候实现你自己的学习智能体了。 前往 balrog 中的 agents 目录，并编辑 custom.py 文件。 列表 10.5 复现了 BALROG 说明文件中自定义智能体的代码。 该代码可以通过列表 10.6 中的命令运行（指定自定义智能体，并使用较少的工人进程进行温和运行）。 当然，你也可以在命令中指定自己选择的 LLM。

sents.en: Now it is time to implement your own learning agent.
sents.zh: 现在，是时候实现你自己的学习智能体了。

sents.en: Go to the agents directory in balrog, and edit the custom.py file.
sents.zh: 前往 balrog 中的 agents 目录，并编辑 custom.py 文件。

sents.en: Listing 10.5 reproduces the code for Custom Agent from the BALROG readme.
sents.zh: 列表 10.5 复现了 BALROG 说明文件中自定义智能体的代码。

sents.en: The code can be run with the command in Listing 10.6 (specifying the custom agent, and running gently with fewer workers).
sents.zh: 该代码可以通过列表 10.6 中的命令运行（指定自定义智能体，并使用较少的工人进程进行温和运行）。

sents.en: Of course, you can specify your own LLM of choice in the command.
sents.zh: 当然，你也可以在命令中指定自己选择的 LLM。

paragraphs.en: Start with the provided code, run it, see how it works. Then, you can try to make small improvements. Try making changes to the prompt for the LLM, and to the way in which the Python code handles the learning in the agent, either with the history prompt builder, in the plan, or in the learning algorithm.
paragraphs.zh: 从提供的代码开始，运行它，看看它是如何工作的。 然后，你可以尝试进行一些小的改进。 尝试对 LLM 的提示以及 Python 代码处理智能体中学习的方式做出修改，无论是通过历史提示构建器、在计划中，还是在学习算法中。

sents.en: Start with the provided code, run it, see how it works.
sents.zh: 从提供的代码开始，运行它，看看它是如何工作的。

sents.en: Then, you can try to make small improvements.
sents.zh: 然后，你可以尝试进行一些小的改进。

sents.en: Try making changes to the prompt for the LLM, and to the way in which the Python code handles the learning in the agent, either with the history prompt builder, in the plan, or in the learning algorithm.
sents.zh: 尝试对 LLM 的提示以及 Python 代码处理智能体中学习的方式做出修改，无论是通过历史提示构建器、在计划中，还是在学习算法中。

paragraphs.en: The performance of your agent will be reported by BALROG as a progression percentage. Record the progression numbers for each benchmark, and for the agent types that you try. Do this in a structured way, you may want to write a Python or shell script to automate the running of the experiments and the logging of the results, perhaps also plotting the progression in a graph. Consider using wandb.ai.
paragraphs.zh: BALROG 将以进度百分比的形式报告您智能体的性能。 记录每个基准测试以及您所尝试的智能体类型的进度数值。 请以结构化的方式执行此操作，您可以编写 Python 或 shell 脚本来自动化运行实验和记录结果，或许还可以将进度绘制成图。可以考虑使用 wandb.ai。

sents.en: The performance of your agent will be reported by BALROG as a progression percentage.
sents.zh: BALROG 将以进度百分比的形式报告您智能体的性能。

sents.en: Record the progression numbers for each benchmark, and for the agent types that you try.
sents.zh: 记录每个基准测试以及您所尝试的智能体类型的进度数值。

sents.en: Do this in a structured way, you may want to write a Python or shell script to automate the running of the experiments and the logging of the results, perhaps also plotting the progression in a graph. Consider using wandb.ai.
sents.zh: 请以结构化的方式执行此操作，您可以编写 Python 或 shell 脚本来自动化运行实验和记录结果，或许还可以将进度绘制成图。可以考虑使用 wandb.ai。

paragraphs.en: What agent types work well, and on what benchmark do they work well? Make a matrix in which you log progression for the agent types and the benchmark types that you try.
paragraphs.zh: 哪些类型的智能体表现良好？它们在哪个基准测试中表现良好？ 创建一个矩阵，记录你尝试的智能体类型和基准测试类型的进展。

sents.en: What agent types work well, and on what benchmark do they work well?
sents.zh: 哪些类型的智能体表现良好？它们在哪个基准测试中表现良好？

sents.en: Make a matrix in which you log progression for the agent types and the benchmark types that you try.
sents.zh: 创建一个矩阵，记录你尝试的智能体类型和基准测试类型的进展。

paragraphs.en: Note that LLM experiments are inherently non-deterministic: two runs with the same prompt may give different results. Therefore, perform multiple runs of each experiment. If you get five identical results in a row, you may start to trust these results. If they vary widely, you may want to investigate. Is the reason purely statistical? Does turning down the temperature solve the problem, or is there another problem?
paragraphs.zh: 请注意，大型语言模型（LLM）的实验本质上是非确定性的：使用相同提示词的两轮运行可能会产生不同的结果。 因此，需要对每个实验进行多次运行。 如果你连续得到五个完全相同的结果，你可能开始信任这些结果。 如果结果差异很大，你可能需要进一步调查。 原因仅仅是统计上的吗？ 降低温度能解决这个问题吗，还是存在其他问题？

sents.en: Note that LLM experiments are inherently non-deterministic: two runs with the same prompt may give different results.
sents.zh: 请注意，大型语言模型（LLM）的实验本质上是非确定性的：使用相同提示词的两轮运行可能会产生不同的结果。

sents.en: Therefore, perform multiple runs of each experiment.
sents.zh: 因此，需要对每个实验进行多次运行。

sents.en: If you get five identical results in a row, you may start to trust these results.
sents.zh: 如果你连续得到五个完全相同的结果，你可能开始信任这些结果。

sents.en: If they vary widely, you may want to investigate.
sents.zh: 如果结果差异很大，你可能需要进一步调查。

sents.en: Is the reason purely statistical?
sents.zh: 原因仅仅是统计上的吗？

sents.en: Does turning down the temperature solve the problem, or is there another problem?
sents.zh: 降低温度能解决这个问题吗，还是存在其他问题？

paragraphs.en: Do not blindly trust the progression numbers that are reported. Since you are using code on a computer, there may be bugs, or other issues. The BALROG system facilitates delving deeper into the runs. It logs csv files that you can look at with a spreadsheet. Have a look at some of the runs, and decide if it makes sense what you see, or if the agents are exhibiting degenerative behavior. If they do, try to find the reason. Did you do something wrong? Is there unexpected interference between the benchmark and the agent behavior? Is the reward landscape too flat, so that there is no signal for the agent to go after, and all it does is random actions running in circles in a way that makes no sense at all? Is there something that you can do about this?
paragraphs.zh: 不要盲目相信所报告的进展数值。 由于你是在计算机上运行代码，因此可能存在错误或其他类似问题。 BALROG 系统有助于更深入地分析运行过程。 它会记录 CSV 文件，你可以用电子表格软件查看这些文件。 查看一些运行结果，判断你所看到的内容是否合理，或者智能体是否表现出退化行为。 如果确实如此，请尝试找出原因。 你是否做了错误的操作？ 基准测试与智能体行为之间是否存在意外的干扰？ 奖励机制是否过于平坦，导致智能体没有可追求的目标，最终只是毫无意义地随机行动、打转？ 对此你有什么办法可以解决吗？

sents.en: Do not blindly trust the progression numbers that are reported.
sents.zh: 不要盲目相信所报告的进展数值。

sents.en: Since you are using code on a computer, there may be bugs, or other issues.
sents.zh: 由于你是在计算机上运行代码，因此可能存在错误或其他类似问题。

sents.en: The BALROG system facilitates delving deeper into the runs.
sents.zh: BALROG 系统有助于更深入地分析运行过程。

sents.en: It logs csv files that you can look at with a spreadsheet.
sents.zh: 它会记录 CSV 文件，你可以用电子表格软件查看这些文件。

sents.en: Have a look at some of the runs, and decide if it makes sense what you see, or if the agents are exhibiting degenerative behavior.
sents.zh: 查看一些运行结果，判断你所看到的内容是否合理，或者智能体是否表现出退化行为。

sents.en: If they do, try to find the reason.
sents.zh: 如果确实如此，请尝试找出原因。

sents.en: Did you do something wrong?
sents.zh: 你是否做了错误的操作？

sents.en: Is there unexpected interference between the benchmark and the agent behavior?
sents.zh: 基准测试与智能体行为之间是否存在意外的干扰？

sents.en: Is the reward landscape too flat, so that there is no signal for the agent to go after, and all it does is random actions running in circles in a way that makes no sense at all?
sents.zh: 奖励机制是否过于平坦，导致智能体没有可追求的目标，最终只是毫无意义地随机行动、打转？

sents.en: Is there something that you can do about this?
sents.zh: 对此你有什么办法可以解决吗？

paragraphs.en: Please note that the field of large language models, and especially of agentic LLMs, is new, and our insights and our software frameworks have not yet stabilized. Some unexpected results are to be expected, and some challenges or frustration as well.
paragraphs.zh: 请注意，大型语言模型领域，尤其是智能体型大型语言模型领域，尚属新兴领域，我们的见解和软件框架也尚未稳定。 出现一些意想不到的结果、挑战或挫败感也在所难免。

sents.en: Please note that the field of large language models, and especially of agentic LLMs, is new, and our insights and our software frameworks have not yet stabilized.
sents.zh: 请注意，大型语言模型领域，尤其是智能体型大型语言模型领域，尚属新兴领域，我们的见解和软件框架也尚未稳定。

sents.en: Some unexpected results are to be expected, and some challenges or frustration as well.
sents.zh: 出现一些意想不到的结果、挑战或挫败感也在所难免。

paragraphs.en: A structured way of experimentation and result-logging is your friend. Planning and organization can make the running, evaluation, and improvement of practical agentic LLM experiments an enjoyable exercise.
paragraphs.zh: 一种结构化的实验和结果记录方法会对你大有裨益。 规划和组织能让实际智能体大语言模型实验的运行、评估与改进成为一项令人愉快的活动。

sents.en: A structured way of experimentation and result-logging is your friend.
sents.zh: 一种结构化的实验和结果记录方法会对你大有裨益。

sents.en: Planning and organization can make the running, evaluation, and improvement of practical agentic LLM experiments an enjoyable exercise.
sents.zh: 规划和组织能让实际智能体大语言模型实验的运行、评估与改进成为一项令人愉快的活动。

paragraphs.en: When you were able to reproduce the benchmark results, and have experimented somewhat with the agents, you may want to try to take on some larger challenges. In this section, we will try to extend the BALROG agent towards self-reflection, where the LLM is used in different roles, such as evaluation and action selection. Self-reflection, as any adaptive system that chases a target that is itself being optimized, can be prone to instability and oscillations. Therefore, before we try our self-reflective ideas, it is important that the base learner system of the previous subsection works, and converges in a stable and predictable manner. Please go back to that section and make sure things work as you want them to work.
paragraphs.zh: 当您已经能够复现基准测试结果，并对智能体进行了一些实验之后，或许可以尝试迎接一些更大的挑战。 在本节中，我们将尝试将 BALROG 智能体向自我反思的方向扩展，其中大语言模型将用于不同的角色，例如评估和行动选择。 自我反思，作为一种追求自身也在被优化的目标的自适应系统，容易陷入不稳定和振荡状态。 因此，在尝试我们的自我反思方案之前，确保上一小节中的基础学习系统能够正常运行并以稳定且可预测的方式收敛至关重要。 请返回该部分，确保一切都能按照您的预期运行。

sents.en: When you were able to reproduce the benchmark results, and have experimented somewhat with the agents, you may want to try to take on some larger challenges.
sents.zh: 当您已经能够复现基准测试结果，并对智能体进行了一些实验之后，或许可以尝试迎接一些更大的挑战。

sents.en: Please go back to that section and make sure things work as you want them to work.
sents.zh: 请返回该部分，确保一切都能按照您的预期运行。

paragraphs.en: There are many recent works that try to improve LLM agents. We will mention two: ReAct [ Yao et al., 2022 ] and reflexion [ Shinn et al., 2024 ] . ReAct is primarily focused on prompts, where reflexion introduces new agent algorithms, including short-term and long-term memory.
paragraphs.zh: 近期有许多研究试图改进 LLM 智能体。 我们将提及两种方法：ReAct [ Yao et al., 2022 ] 和 reflexion [ Shinn et al., 2024 ]。 ReAct 主要关注提示词，而 reflexion 则引入了新的智能体算法，包括短期和长期记忆。

sents.en: There are many recent works that try to improve LLM agents.
sents.zh: 近期有许多研究试图改进 LLM 智能体。

sents.en: We will mention two: ReAct [ Yao et al., 2022 ] and reflexion [ Shinn et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 我们将提及两种方法：ReAct [ Yao et al., 2022 ] 和 reflexion [ Shinn et al., 2024 ]。

sents.en: ReAct is primarily focused on prompts, where reflexion introduces new agent algorithms, including short-term and long-term memory.
sents.zh: ReAct 主要关注提示词，而 reflexion 则引入了新的智能体算法，包括短期和长期记忆。

paragraphs.en: ReAct uses promtps to interact with the world. ReAct promotes the use of tools, to lookup information, see Figure 10.7 . The original website for ReAct is https://react-lm.github.io , the code repository is here: https://github.com/ysymyth/ReAct . ReAct prompting has also been implemented in the LangChain 2 2 2 See https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/langchain/overview and BeeAI 3 3 3 See https://github.com/i-am-bee/beeai-framework/blob/main/python/examples/agents/react.py frameworks.

paragraphs.en: Have a look at these framework to get an understanding of the prompt-based agent interaction style that ReAct introduces. Then, implement the prompt-based interaction in BALROG. Does is improve performance? For which games does it help to lookup external information? For which games not?
paragraphs.zh: 请看看这些框架，以便理解 ReAct 所引入的基于提示的智能体交互模式。 然后，在 BALROG 中实现这种基于提示的交互方式。 这样做是否提升了性能？ 它在哪些游戏中有助于查找外部信息？又在哪些游戏中没有帮助？

sents.en: Have a look at these framework to get an understanding of the prompt-based agent interaction style that ReAct introduces.

paragraphs.en: Where ReAct is prompt-based, allowing interactive lookups, the reflexion approach introduces Python-coded agents, allowing more elaborate agent behavior. Reflexion uses the same LLM in different contexts, with different prompts. It works on the assumption that it is easier to criticize what is wrong with an existing prompt, than to come up with one that works.
paragraphs.zh: ReAct 基于提示词，支持交互式查询，而 reflexion 方法则引入了用 Python 编写的智能体，从而实现了更复杂的智能体行为。 Reflexion 在不同的上下文中使用相同的 LLM，但会采用不同的提示词。 该方法基于一个假设：批评现有提示词的问题比构思一个有效的提示词更容易。

sents.en: Where ReAct is prompt-based, allowing interactive lookups, the reflexion approach introduces Python-coded agents, allowing more elaborate agent behavior.
sents.zh: ReAct 基于提示词，支持交互式查询，而 reflexion 方法则引入了用 Python 编写的智能体，从而实现了更复杂的智能体行为。

sents.en: It works on the assumption that it is easier to criticize what is wrong with an existing prompt, than to come up with one that works.
sents.zh: 该方法基于一个假设：批评现有提示词的问题比构思一个有效的提示词更容易。

paragraphs.en: Reflexion uses the same LLM with different prompts, which may lead to learning instability, and loops. Furthermore, memory management is relatively simple, with the potential of context overruns. An idea is to implement chunking or other memory compression methods, by hand in Python, or using an LLM.
paragraphs.zh: Reflexion 使用相同的 LLM 但搭配不同的提示词，这可能导致学习不稳定和循环。 此外，记忆管理相对简单，但存在上下文溢出的潜在风险。 一种思路是手动在 Python 中实现分块或其他记忆压缩方法，或者使用 LLM 来实现。

paragraphs.en: In this chapter we have discussed a practical case study, to see how an LLM can performs self-reflection. We used BALROG, a popular benchmark suite for reasoning tasks. BALROG consists of a mix from easy to hard games, some of which are difficult for LLMs to play well. The BALROG suite is designed in an open style. We can write our own agent code that can then be run on the BALROG games.
paragraphs.zh: 在本章中，我们讨论了一个实际案例研究，以了解大型语言模型如何进行自我反思。 我们使用了 BALROG，这是一个用于推理任务的流行基准测试套件。 BALROG 包含从简单到困难的各种游戏，其中一些游戏对大型语言模型来说很难玩得出色。 BALROG 套件采用开放式设计。 我们可以编写自己的智能体代码，然后在该代码上运行 BALROG 游戏。

sents.en: In this chapter we have discussed a practical case study, to see how an LLM can performs self-reflection.
sents.zh: 在本章中，我们讨论了一个实际案例研究，以了解大型语言模型如何进行自我反思。

sents.en: We used BALROG, a popular benchmark suite for reasoning tasks.
sents.zh: 我们使用了 BALROG，这是一个用于推理任务的流行基准测试套件。

sents.en: BALROG consists of a mix from easy to hard games, some of which are difficult for LLMs to play well.
sents.zh: BALROG 包含从简单到困难的各种游戏，其中一些游戏对大型语言模型来说很难玩得出色。

sents.en: The BALROG suite is designed in an open style.
sents.zh: BALROG 套件采用开放式设计。

sents.en: We can write our own agent code that can then be run on the BALROG games.
sents.zh: 我们可以编写自己的智能体代码，然后在该代码上运行 BALROG 游戏。

paragraphs.en: This has been an important practical case study. You have explored writing our own agent code for in-context reasoning. You have also gone beyond base-learning, by implementing self-reflection. You have explored the stability of self-reflection, on different LLMs and with highly challenging benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一个重要的实践案例研究。 你已经探索了为情境推理编写我们自己的智能体代码。 你通过实现自我反思，也超越了基础学习阶段。 你已经探索了自我反思在不同大型语言模型以及极具挑战性的基准测试中的稳定性。

sents.zh: 你已经探索了自我反思在不同大型语言模型以及极具挑战性的基准测试中的稳定性。

paragraphs.en: The first three parts discussed the AI techniques for constructing advanced LLM Agents that can interact with and act in the real world. These capabilities allow them to do useful things for their users. In this part we will address the use of tools by LLMs to perform specialized tasks, such as looking up information, or controlling robots. Agents use tools through learned APIs (Application Programming Interfaces).
paragraphs.zh: 前三个部分讨论了用于构建先进大型语言模型智能体的 AI 技术，这些智能体能够与真实世界互动并在此中行动。 这些能力使它们能为用户完成有用的任务。 在本部分，我们将探讨大型语言模型使用工具执行专门任务的方法，例如查找信息或控制机器人。 智能体通过已学习的 API（应用程序编程接口）来使用工具。

sents.en: The first three parts discussed the AI techniques for constructing advanced LLM Agents that can interact with and act in the real world.
sents.zh: 前三个部分讨论了用于构建先进大型语言模型智能体的 AI 技术，这些智能体能够与真实世界互动并在此中行动。

sents.en: These capabilities allow them to do useful things for their users.
sents.zh: 这些能力使它们能为用户完成有用的任务。

sents.en: In this part we will address the use of tools by LLMs to perform specialized tasks, such as looking up information, or controlling robots.
sents.zh: 在本部分，我们将探讨大型语言模型使用工具执行专门任务的方法，例如查找信息或控制机器人。

sents.en: Agents use tools through learned APIs (Application Programming Interfaces).
sents.zh: 智能体通过已学习的 API（应用程序编程接口）来使用工具。

paragraphs.en: Tools can help us solve a major problem of pretrained LLMs, which is that the information that is contained in them is only as up to date as the dataset on which they were trained. Retrieval augmentation techniques allows LLMs to provide up to the minute information.
paragraphs.zh: 工具可以帮助我们解决预训练大型语言模型的一个主要问题，即其包含的信息的时效性仅限于其训练数据集的更新程度。 检索增强技术使大型语言模型能够提供最新的信息。

sents.en: Tools can help us solve a major problem of pretrained LLMs, which is that the information that is contained in them is only as up to date as the dataset on which they were trained.
sents.zh: 工具可以帮助我们解决预训练大型语言模型的一个主要问题，即其包含的信息的时效性仅限于其训练数据集的更新程度。

sents.en: Retrieval augmentation techniques allows LLMs to provide up to the minute information.
sents.zh: 检索增强技术使大型语言模型能够提供最新的信息。

paragraphs.en: Many types of such agents have been created, and in the final chapter of this part we will review important examples, from the medical, financial, and scientific domains. Finally, we will discuss a practical case study in which the use of the technologies comes together, when we will implement an LLM Agent to perform medical diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: 已经创建了多种此类智能体，在本部分的最后一章中，我们将回顾来自医疗、金融和科学领域的重要示例。 最后，我们将讨论一个实际案例研究，其中这些技术得到了综合应用，届时我们将部署一个 LLM 智能体来执行医疗诊断。

sents.en: Many types of such agents have been created, and in the final chapter of this part we will review important examples, from the medical, financial, and scientific domains.
sents.zh: 已经创建了多种此类智能体，在本部分的最后一章中，我们将回顾来自医疗、金融和科学领域的重要示例。

sents.en: Finally, we will discuss a practical case study in which the use of the technologies comes together, when we will implement an LLM Agent to perform medical diagnosis.
sents.zh: 最后，我们将讨论一个实际案例研究，其中这些技术得到了综合应用，届时我们将部署一个 LLM 智能体来执行医疗诊断。

paragraphs.en: In the taxonomy of reasoning–acting–interacting (Figure 1.1 ), tools are the primary bridge between an LLM’s internal reasoning and its actions in the external world. A tool may be as simple as a calculator, as complex as a scientific simulation engine, or as open-ended as a full desktop environment. By equipping LLMs with tool use capabilities, we allow them to:
paragraphs.zh: 在“推理–行动–互动”分类体系（图 1.1）中，工具是连接大型语言模型内部推理与其在外部世界中的行动之间的主要桥梁。 工具可以像计算器一样简单，也可以像科学模拟引擎一样复杂，甚至可以像完整的桌面环境一样开放灵活。 通过赋予大型语言模型使用工具的能力，我们使其能够：

sents.en: In the taxonomy of reasoning–acting–interacting (Figure 1.1 ), tools are the primary bridge between an LLM’s internal reasoning and its actions in the external world.
sents.zh: 在“推理–行动–互动”分类体系（图 1.1）中，工具是连接大型语言模型内部推理与其在外部世界中的行动之间的主要桥梁。

sents.en: A tool may be as simple as a calculator, as complex as a scientific simulation engine, or as open-ended as a full desktop environment.
sents.zh: 工具可以像计算器一样简单，也可以像科学模拟引擎一样复杂，甚至可以像完整的桌面环境一样开放灵活。

sents.en: By equipping LLMs with tool use capabilities, we allow them to:
sents.zh: 通过赋予大型语言模型使用工具的能力，我们使其能够：

paragraphs.en: Access fresh, domain-specific data (e.g., via APIs, databases, or search engines).
paragraphs.zh: 获取新鲜、领域特定的数据（例如，通过 API、数据库或搜索引擎）。

paragraphs.en: Perform actions in the world (e.g., controlling robots, operating browsers, sending messages).
paragraphs.zh: 在世界中执行操作（例如，控制机器人、操作浏览器、发送消息）。

paragraphs.en: Delegate complex computations or retrieval to specialized systems .
paragraphs.zh: 将复杂的计算或检索任务委托给专门的系统。

paragraphs.en: Chain multiple tools into composite workflows that can be planned, executed, and monitored.
paragraphs.zh: 将多个工具组合成复合工作流，从而实现规划、执行和监控。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval is one specific kind of tool primarily aimed to augment an LLM’s knowledge . We will discuss it in depth in Chapter 12 . Tool use in general can also augment an LLM’s capabilities to manipulate its environment. These capabilities also come with additional risks, such as safety, reliability and performance risks. They introduce additional points of failure and might be misused under certain conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 检索是一种特定的工具，主要用于增强大语言模型（LLM）的知识。 我们将在第 12 章中深入讨论这一点。 总体而言，工具使用也可以增强大语言模型（LLM）操控其环境的能力。 这些能力也伴随着额外的风险，例如安全性、可靠性和性能方面的风险。 它们会引入额外的故障点，并且在特定条件下可能会被滥用。

sents.en: Retrieval is one specific kind of tool primarily aimed to augment an LLM’s knowledge .
sents.zh: 检索是一种特定的工具，主要用于增强大语言模型（LLM）的知识。

sents.en: We will discuss it in depth in Chapter 12 .
sents.zh: 我们将在第 12 章中深入讨论这一点。

sents.en: Tool use in general can also augment an LLM’s capabilities to manipulate its environment.
sents.zh: 总体而言，工具使用也可以增强大语言模型（LLM）操控其环境的能力。

sents.en: These capabilities also come with additional risks, such as safety, reliability and performance risks.
sents.zh: 这些能力也伴随着额外的风险，例如安全性、可靠性和性能方面的风险。

sents.en: They introduce additional points of failure and might be misused under certain conditions.
sents.zh: 它们会引入额外的故障点，并且在特定条件下可能会被滥用。

paragraphs.en: Let us see some common software architectures for tool use by LLMs. Integrating tools into an LLM agent typically follows one of two patterns: direct invocation, and planner-caller-summarizer.
paragraphs.zh: 让我们来看看大语言模型使用工具时常见的一些软件架构。 将工具集成到大语言模型智能体中通常遵循两种模式之一：直接调用，以及规划器-调用器-总结器模式。

sents.en: Let us see some common software architectures for tool use by LLMs.
sents.zh: 让我们来看看大语言模型使用工具时常见的一些软件架构。

sents.en: Integrating tools into an LLM agent typically follows one of two patterns: direct invocation, and planner-caller-summarizer.
sents.zh: 将工具集成到大语言模型智能体中通常遵循两种模式之一：直接调用，以及规划器-调用器-总结器模式。

paragraphs.en: In the direct invocation pattern, the LLM outputs structured calls (e.g., JSON or function signatures) that are parsed by an external controller and routed to the tool. For example: OpenAI’s function calling API or Gorilla [ Patil et al., 2023 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在直接调用模式中，大语言模型会输出结构化调用（例如 JSON 或函数签名），由外部控制器解析并路由到工具。 例如：OpenAI 的函数调用 API 或 Gorilla [ Patil et al., 2023 ]。

sents.en: In the direct invocation pattern, the LLM outputs structured calls (e.g., JSON or function signatures) that are parsed by an external controller and routed to the tool.
sents.zh: 在直接调用模式中，大语言模型会输出结构化调用（例如 JSON 或函数签名），由外部控制器解析并路由到工具。

sents.en: For example: OpenAI’s function calling API or Gorilla [ Patil et al., 2023 ] .
sents.zh: 例如：OpenAI 的函数调用 API 或 Gorilla [ Patil et al., 2023 ]。

paragraphs.en: The planner-caller-summarizer pattern is an extension of the direct invocation pattern where we use a multi-agent architecture where the LLM serves as a central planner. It calls a separate module to execute a tool (which might be another LLM or another kind of agent), which then returns a summarized observation back to the LLM. This allows the LLM to maintain a high-level view of the task while outsourcing the detailed execution to a dedicated system.
paragraphs.zh: 规划-调用-总结模式是直接调用模式的扩展，其中我们使用一种多智能体架构，而大型语言模型（LLM）则充当中央规划者。 它会调用一个独立的模块来执行某个工具（该工具可能是另一个大型语言模型或其他类型的智能体），然后该工具会将总结后的观察结果返回给大型语言模型。 这使得大型语言模型能够在将详细执行工作外包给专用系统的同时，保持对任务的整体把握。

sents.en: The planner-caller-summarizer pattern is an extension of the direct invocation pattern where we use a multi-agent architecture where the LLM serves as a central planner.
sents.zh: 规划-调用-总结模式是直接调用模式的扩展，其中我们使用一种多智能体架构，而大型语言模型（LLM）则充当中央规划者。

sents.en: It calls a separate module to execute a tool (which might be another LLM or another kind of agent), which then returns a summarized observation back to the LLM.
sents.zh: 它会调用一个独立的模块来执行某个工具（该工具可能是另一个大型语言模型或其他类型的智能体），然后该工具会将总结后的观察结果返回给大型语言模型。

sents.en: This allows the LLM to maintain a high-level view of the task while outsourcing the detailed execution to a dedicated system.
sents.zh: 这使得大型语言模型能够在将详细执行工作外包给专用系统的同时，保持对任务的整体把握。

paragraphs.en: ReAct (Reasoning and Acting) [ Yao et al., 2022 ] is a prominent framework that interweaves reasoning and acting. Instead of generating a full plan and then executing, an LLM using ReAct follows an iterative loop of Thought , Action , and Observation . This allows the agent to dynamically adjust its plan based on the real-time feedback it receives from tool outputs, making it more robust to errors and unexpected results. This works well because the tools (observation part) often act as a grounding mechanism in the real world (such as the execution of a code snippet, or an internet search), which provides the LLM with factual information for the next iteration.
paragraphs.zh: ReAct（推理与行动）[ Yao 等，2022 ] 是一种将推理与行动交织在一起的著名框架。 与先生成完整计划再执行不同，采用 ReAct 的 LLM 会遵循“思考、行动、观察”的迭代循环。 这使得智能体能够根据从工具输出中获得的实时反馈动态调整其计划，从而更有效地应对错误和意外结果。 这种方法之所以有效，是因为工具（观察部分）通常充当了与现实世界衔接的机制（例如执行代码片段或进行网络搜索），从而为 LLM 提供下一轮迭代所需的事实信息。

sents.zh: ReAct（推理与行动）[ Yao 等，2022 ] 是一种将推理与行动交织在一起的著名框架。

paragraphs.en: When their application programming interface (API) is known, LLMs can be integrated easily with external tools: for an LLM, an API is just another language to learn. One common way to use a tool, is to augment LLM input with results that are retrieved from external sources, such as search engines. You can read more about retrieval methods in Chapter 12 .
paragraphs.zh: 当大型语言模型（LLM）的应用编程接口（API）已知时，就可以轻松将其与外部工具集成：对于 LLM 而言，API 不过是另一种需要学习的语言。 使用工具的一种常见方法，是将从外部来源（如搜索引擎）检索到的结果补充到 LLM 的输入中。 您可以在第 12 章中阅读更多关于检索方法的介绍。

sents.zh: 当大型语言模型（LLM）的应用编程接口（API）已知时，就可以轻松将其与外部工具集成：对于 LLM 而言，API 不过是另一种需要学习的语言。

paragraphs.en: Agentic LLMs must be trained to decide when and how to utilize external tools, depending on the task [ Shen et al., 2024 ] . Language models can teach themselves to use tools. The Toolformer model [ Schick et al., 2023 ] is trained to decide which APIs to call, when to call them, what arguments to pass, and how to best incorporate the results into future token prediction. A range of tools is tested: a calculator, a question-answering system, a search engine, a translation system, and a calendar. Further works extend this to a larger range of tools. ToolBench [ Qin et al., 2023 ] contains 16,464 APIs from RapidAPI, a large dataset of publicly available REST APIs. 1 1 1 https://rapidapi.com/hub
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式大语言模型必须经过训练，能够根据任务决定何时以及如何利用外部工具 [ Shen et al., 2024 ]。 语言模型可以自行学会使用工具。 Toolformer 模型 [ Schick et al., 2023 ] 经过训练，能够决定调用哪些 API、何时调用、传递哪些参数，以及如何将结果最佳地融入未来的词元预测中。 测试了一系列工具：计算器、问答系统、搜索引擎、翻译系统和日历。 后续研究将这一方法扩展到了更多种类的工具。 ToolBench [ Qin et al., 2023 ] 包含了来自 RapidAPI 的 16,464 个 API，这是一个包含大量公开可用 REST API 的大型数据集。1 1 1 https://rapidapi.com/hub

paragraphs.en: Another framework is EasyTool [ Yuan et al., 2024 ] , which focuses on structured and unified instructions from tool documentations, building on ToolBench. ToolAlpaca is a benchmark with over 3938 instances from 400 API [ Tang et al., 2023 ] . A tool-based benchmark for question answering is ToolQA [ Zhuang et al., 2023 ] . Gorilla is a finetuned LLaMa-based model for generating API calls [ Patil et al., 2023 ] , also introducing the APIBench benchmark. Many tool calling frameworks have been developed.

paragraphs.en: One specific set of action tools is to let an LLM use a browser or even a complete computer system as a special form of API. Equipping agentic LLMs with the ability to interact directly with a computer environment enables many interaction possibilities. Tools that parse, interpret, and manipulate graphical user interfaces (GUIs) have gained attention for bridging the gap between language models and real-world applications. One such example is OmniParser V2 [ Lu et al., 2024 ] , which introduces a vision-based screen parsing method to detect and label interactable elements such as buttons or icons. By converting raw screenshots into structured representations, OmniParser helps vision-language models ground their action decisions in specific user interface components. This grounding increases the accuracy of the action predictions of LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 一种特定的行动工具集是让大型语言模型（LLM）将浏览器甚至整个计算机系统作为一种特殊的 API 来使用。 赋予智能体型 LLM 直接与计算机环境交互的能力，可以开启多种交互可能性。 能够解析、解释和操作图形用户界面（GUI）的工具因其能弥合语言模型与现实世界应用之间的鸿沟而备受关注。 其中一个例子是 OmniParser V2 [ Lu et al., 2024 ]，它引入了一种基于视觉的屏幕解析方法，用于检测和标记按钮或图标等可交互元素。 通过将原始屏幕截图转换为结构化表示，OmniParser 帮助视觉-语言模型将其行动决策锚定在特定的用户界面组件上。 这种锚定提升了 LLM 对行动的预测准确性。

paragraphs.en: Another line of research focuses on enabling LLMs to initiate system-level commands or navigate within browser or operating system interfaces. Computer Use, proposed by Antropic, and Operator and later GPT Agent, proposed by OpenAI, are examples of such efforts. These tools wrap common desktop and browser actions (such as opening applications, clicking buttons, and filling forms) into tool APIs callable by an LLM. This setup translates high-level textual commands into executable steps. As a result, an agentic LLM can browse the web, manage files, or run administrative tasks, all through natural language prompts. This can lead to more autonomous behavior and execution of larger and more complex tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 另一条研究路线则致力于让大型语言模型（LLM）能够发起系统级命令，或在浏览器或操作系统界面中进行导航。 Antropic 提出的 Computer Use，以及 OpenAI 后来提出的 Operator 和 GPT Agent，都是此类尝试的示例。 这些工具将常见的桌面和浏览器操作（如打开应用程序、点击按钮和填写表格）封装为 LLM 可调用的工具 API。 这种设置能将高级文本命令转换为可执行的步骤。 因此，具备智能体能力的大型语言模型可以通过自然语言提示浏览网页、管理文件或执行管理任务。 这能够带来更自主的行为，并支持执行更大规模、更复杂的任务。

paragraphs.en: Browser Use [ Müller and Žunič, 2024 ] is an example of an open-source tool that enables LLMs to use a browser with persistent session management. Browser Use enables agentic LLMs to maintain longer browsing states across multiple pages or domains. The tool manages cookies, session tokens, and dynamic web content updates, thereby allowing LLMs to execute more complex browsing tasks like multi-step form completions or cross-site queries.
paragraphs.zh: Browser Use [ Müller 和 Žunič，2024 ] 是一个开源工具的示例，它使 LLM 能够使用具备持久会话管理的浏览器。 Browser Use 使智能体型 LLM 能够在多个页面或域之间维持更长时间的浏览状态。 该工具管理 Cookie、会话令牌和动态网页内容更新，从而让 LLM 能够执行更复杂的浏览任务，例如多步骤表单填写或跨网站查询。

sents.en: Browser Use [ Müller and Žunič, 2024 ] is an example of an open-source tool that enables LLMs to use a browser with persistent session management.
sents.zh: Browser Use [ Müller 和 Žunič，2024 ] 是一个开源工具的示例，它使 LLM 能够使用具备持久会话管理的浏览器。

sents.en: Browser Use enables agentic LLMs to maintain longer browsing states across multiple pages or domains.
sents.zh: Browser Use 使智能体型 LLM 能够在多个页面或域之间维持更长时间的浏览状态。

sents.en: The tool manages cookies, session tokens, and dynamic web content updates, thereby allowing LLMs to execute more complex browsing tasks like multi-step form completions or cross-site queries.
sents.zh: 该工具管理 Cookie、会话令牌和动态网页内容更新，从而让 LLM 能够执行更复杂的浏览任务，例如多步骤表单填写或跨网站查询。

paragraphs.en: For a more in-depth discussion about browser and computer environments, see the survey by Wang et al. [2025b] . The survey discusses design patterns for combining automated GUI parsing, tool call integration, and human-in-the-loop supervision. Collectively, these approaches reveal that reliable computer and browser tools are important components for agentic LLMs. By translating textual intents into grounded, environment-level operations, such systems expand the possible tasks and domains where language-driven autonomy can be effectively realized.
paragraphs.zh: 关于浏览器和计算机环境的更深入讨论，请参见 Wang 等人 [2025b] 的综述。 该综述探讨了将自动化 GUI 解析、工具调用集成以及人在回路中的监督相结合的设计模式。 总体而言，这些方法表明，可靠的计算机和浏览器工具是智能体式 LLM 的重要组成部分。 通过将文本意图转化为基于实际环境的操作，此类系统扩展了语言驱动自主性能够有效实现的可能任务和领域。

sents.en: For a more in-depth discussion about browser and computer environments, see the survey by Wang et al. [2025b] .
sents.zh: 关于浏览器和计算机环境的更深入讨论，请参见 Wang 等人 [2025b] 的综述。

sents.en: The survey discusses design patterns for combining automated GUI parsing, tool call integration, and human-in-the-loop supervision.
sents.zh: 该综述探讨了将自动化 GUI 解析、工具调用集成以及人在回路中的监督相结合的设计模式。

sents.en: Collectively, these approaches reveal that reliable computer and browser tools are important components for agentic LLMs.
sents.zh: 总体而言，这些方法表明，可靠的计算机和浏览器工具是智能体式 LLM 的重要组成部分。

sents.en: By translating textual intents into grounded, environment-level operations, such systems expand the possible tasks and domains where language-driven autonomy can be effectively realized.
sents.zh: 通过将文本意图转化为基于实际环境的操作，此类系统扩展了语言驱动自主性能够有效实现的可能任务和领域。

paragraphs.en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open-source standard introduced by Anthropic for connecting AI applications to external data sources, tools, and workflows [ Hou et al., 2026 ] . It is often described as a “USB-C port for AI”, providing a standardized way for applications such as Claude or ChatGPT to access local files, databases, search engines, calculators, and other external capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 模型上下文协议（MCP）是 Anthropic 推出的一项开源标准，用于将人工智能应用连接到外部数据源、工具和工作流 [Hou et al., 2026]。 它通常被称为“人工智能的 USB-C 端口”，为 Claude 或 ChatGPT 等应用提供了一种标准化的方式，以访问本地文件、数据库、搜索引擎、计算器和その他の外部功能。

sents.en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open-source standard introduced by Anthropic for connecting AI applications to external data sources, tools, and workflows [ Hou et al., 2026 ] .
sents.zh: 模型上下文协议（MCP）是 Anthropic 推出的一项开源标准，用于将人工智能应用连接到外部数据源、工具和工作流 [Hou et al., 2026]。

sents.en: It is often described as a “USB-C port for AI”, providing a standardized way for applications such as Claude or ChatGPT to access local files, databases, search engines, calculators, and other external capabilities.
sents.zh: 它通常被称为“人工智能的 USB-C 端口”，为 Claude 或 ChatGPT 等应用提供了一种标准化的方式，以访问本地文件、数据库、搜索引擎、计算器和その他の外部功能。

paragraphs.en: MCP uses a client-server architecture. An MCP host, such as an AI application, manages one or more MCP clients, with each client maintaining a connection to an MCP server. MCP servers provide context and capabilities that can be used by the host, including tools, resources, and prompts. Local servers commonly communicate with a single client through STDIO, while remote servers can support multiple clients through Streamable HTTP.
paragraphs.zh: MCP 采用客户端-服务器架构。 MCP 主机（例如 AI 应用程序）管理一个或多个 MCP 客户端，每个客户端都与一个 MCP 服务器保持连接。 MCP 服务器提供主机可以使用的上下文和能力，包括工具、资源和提示。 本地服务器通常通过 STDIO 与单个客户端通信，而远程服务器则可以通过 Streamable HTTP 支持多个客户端。

sents.en: MCP uses a client-server architecture.
sents.zh: MCP 采用客户端-服务器架构。

sents.en: An MCP host, such as an AI application, manages one or more MCP clients, with each client maintaining a connection to an MCP server.
sents.zh: MCP 主机（例如 AI 应用程序）管理一个或多个 MCP 客户端，每个客户端都与一个 MCP 服务器保持连接。

sents.en: MCP servers provide context and capabilities that can be used by the host, including tools, resources, and prompts.
sents.zh: MCP 服务器提供主机可以使用的上下文和能力，包括工具、资源和提示。

sents.en: Local servers commonly communicate with a single client through STDIO, while remote servers can support multiple clients through Streamable HTTP.
sents.zh: 本地服务器通常通过 STDIO 与单个客户端通信，而远程服务器则可以通过 Streamable HTTP 支持多个客户端。

paragraphs.en: The protocol is organized into two layers. The data layer defines the JSON-RPC-based communication between clients and servers, including capability and version discovery, as well as primitives such as tools, resources, prompts, and notifications. The transport layer specifies how this communication is established and exchanged, including connection management, message framing, and authorization. This separation allows AI applications to interact with a wide range of external systems through a common interface, while leaving the management of the resulting context to the host application.
paragraphs.zh: 该协议分为两个层次。 数据层定义了客户端与服务器之间基于 JSON-RPC 的通信方式，包括能力与版本发现，以及工具、资源、提示和通知等基本要素。 传输层规定了这种通信的建立与交换方式，包括连接管理、消息分帧和授权。 这种分离使得 AI 应用能够通过通用接口与各种外部系统交互，同时将由此产生的上下文管理交由主机应用处理。

sents.en: The protocol is organized into two layers.
sents.zh: 该协议分为两个层次。

sents.en: The data layer defines the JSON-RPC-based communication between clients and servers, including capability and version discovery, as well as primitives such as tools, resources, prompts, and notifications.
sents.zh: 数据层定义了客户端与服务器之间基于 JSON-RPC 的通信方式，包括能力与版本发现，以及工具、资源、提示和通知等基本要素。

sents.en: The transport layer specifies how this communication is established and exchanged, including connection management, message framing, and authorization.
sents.zh: 传输层规定了这种通信的建立与交换方式，包括连接管理、消息分帧和授权。

sents.en: This separation allows AI applications to interact with a wide range of external systems through a common interface, while leaving the management of the resulting context to the host application.
sents.zh: 这种分离使得 AI 应用能够通过通用接口与各种外部系统交互，同时将由此产生的上下文管理交由主机应用处理。

paragraphs.en: One of the key challenges in building agentic systems is managing the LLM its finite context window. For multi-step tasks that require numerous tool calls and observations, the context can quickly fill up, causing the model to lose track of its original goal or forget crucial past information. Simply keeping all the context and raw results from multiple tool calls often does not fit the context window and therefor causes forgetting. Deciding what to keep, what to summarize and what to discard is essential.
paragraphs.zh: 构建智能体系统的关键挑战之一，是管理大型语言模型有限的上下文窗口。 对于需要多次工具调用和观察的多步骤任务，上下文可能会迅速填满，导致模型失去对原始目标的追踪或忘记关键的过往信息。 仅仅保留所有上下文以及多次工具调用的原始结果，通常无法适应上下文窗口的限制，因此会导致信息遗忘。 决定保留什么、总结什么以及丢弃什么至关重要。

sents.en: One of the key challenges in building agentic systems is managing the LLM its finite context window.
sents.zh: 构建智能体系统的关键挑战之一，是管理大型语言模型有限的上下文窗口。

sents.en: For multi-step tasks that require numerous tool calls and observations, the context can quickly fill up, causing the model to lose track of its original goal or forget crucial past information.
sents.zh: 对于需要多次工具调用和观察的多步骤任务，上下文可能会迅速填满，导致模型失去对原始目标的追踪或忘记关键的过往信息。

sents.en: Simply keeping all the context and raw results from multiple tool calls often does not fit the context window and therefor causes forgetting.
sents.zh: 仅仅保留所有上下文以及多次工具调用的原始结果，通常无法适应上下文窗口的限制，因此会导致信息遗忘。

sents.en: Deciding what to keep, what to summarize and what to discard is essential.
sents.zh: 决定保留什么、总结什么以及丢弃什么至关重要。

paragraphs.en: MCP servers are mostly stateless. This means that we need an additional set of strategies designed to manage the agent’s state and context. These strategies should ensure that the agent maintains a clear and coherent state throughout a long-running task. In addition to the fixed tool registration/calling format that MCP offers, additonal components to include are:
paragraphs.zh: MCP 服务器大多是无状态的。 这意味着我们需要一套额外的策略，专门用于管理智能体的状态和上下文。 这些策略应确保智能体在整个长期任务中保持清晰且连贯的状态。 除了 MCP 提供的固定工具注册/调用格式外，还需要添加以下组件：

sents.en: MCP servers are mostly stateless.
sents.zh: MCP 服务器大多是无状态的。

sents.en: This means that we need an additional set of strategies designed to manage the agent’s state and context.
sents.zh: 这意味着我们需要一套额外的策略，专门用于管理智能体的状态和上下文。

sents.en: These strategies should ensure that the agent maintains a clear and coherent state throughout a long-running task.
sents.zh: 这些策略应确保智能体在整个长期任务中保持清晰且连贯的状态。

sents.en: In addition to the fixed tool registration/calling format that MCP offers, additonal components to include are:
sents.zh: 除了 MCP 提供的固定工具注册/调用格式外，还需要添加以下组件：

paragraphs.en: Summarization: Tools’ outputs and past conversations are periodically summarized and stored in a compressed format. This reduces the token count while preserving key information.
paragraphs.zh: 摘要生成：工具的输出和历史对话会定期被总结并以压缩格式存储。 这可以在保留关键信息的同时减少令牌数量。

sents.en: Summarization: Tools’ outputs and past conversations are periodically summarized and stored in a compressed format.
sents.zh: 摘要生成：工具的输出和历史对话会定期被总结并以压缩格式存储。

sents.en: This reduces the token count while preserving key information.
sents.zh: 这可以在保留关键信息的同时减少令牌数量。

paragraphs.en: State Management: Explicitly maintaining a state variable or a scratchpad in the prompt, where the agent stores its current plan, important intermediate results, and a summary of its progress.
paragraphs.zh: 状态管理：在提示中显式维护一个状态变量或临时存储区，智能体可将当前计划、重要的中间结果以及进展摘要存储其中。

paragraphs.en: Prioritized Retrieval: Instead of feeding the entire history back into the context, a retrieval mechanism can be used to only inject the most relevant past information for the current step, based on the agent’s reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 优先检索：而不是将完整的历史记录重新输入上下文，可以使用检索机制，仅根据智能体的推理，为当前步骤注入最相关的过往信息。

It demonstrates how an agent can manage its context by summarizing past interactions to avoid exceeding a fixed context window size. 2 2 2 The example uses LangChain, and while this is a popular library, there are also specialized MCP libraries such as the MCP-Python SDK: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/python-sdk , and others, which might be interesting to check out.

paragraphs.en: The external nature of tool use introduces new points of failure. An API service might be down, a tool might return an unexpected error, or the LLM might make a logical mistake in its plan. A robust agentic system must be able to handle these failures gracefully.
paragraphs.zh: 工具使用的外部性带来了新的故障点。 API 服务可能中断，工具可能返回意外错误，或者 LLM 在其计划中可能出现逻辑错误。 一个稳健的智能体系统必须能够优雅地处理这些故障。

sents.en: The external nature of tool use introduces new points of failure.
sents.zh: 工具使用的外部性带来了新的故障点。

sents.en: An API service might be down, a tool might return an unexpected error, or the LLM might make a logical mistake in its plan.
sents.zh: API 服务可能中断，工具可能返回意外错误，或者 LLM 在其计划中可能出现逻辑错误。

sents.en: A robust agentic system must be able to handle these failures gracefully.
sents.zh: 一个稳健的智能体系统必须能够优雅地处理这些故障。

paragraphs.en: A basic but essential strategy is to implement an error-handling loop. When a tool call fails, the system can provide the LLM with the error message as an observation. The LLM can then reason about the error and attempt a new action, such as re-invoking the tool with corrected arguments, trying a different tool, or informing the user of the failure. This process of observe-reflect-retry is a fundamental mechanism for self-healing in agentic systems [ Sun et al., 2024 ] . Note that this pattern is similar to the ReAct framework but in a different context.
paragraphs.zh: 一种基础但至关重要的策略是实施错误处理循环。 当工具调用失败时，系统可以将错误消息作为观察结果提供给 LLM。 随后，LLM 可以分析错误原因并尝试新的操作，例如使用修正后的参数重新调用工具、尝试不同的工具，或向用户报告失败情况。 这种“观察-反思-重试”的过程是智能体系统中自我修复的基本机制 [ Sun et al., 2024 ]。 需要注意的是，这一模式与 ReAct 框架类似，但应用背景不同。

sents.en: A basic but essential strategy is to implement an error-handling loop.
sents.zh: 一种基础但至关重要的策略是实施错误处理循环。

sents.en: When a tool call fails, the system can provide the LLM with the error message as an observation.
sents.zh: 当工具调用失败时，系统可以将错误消息作为观察结果提供给 LLM。

sents.en: The LLM can then reason about the error and attempt a new action, such as re-invoking the tool with corrected arguments, trying a different tool, or informing the user of the failure.
sents.zh: 随后，LLM 可以分析错误原因并尝试新的操作，例如使用修正后的参数重新调用工具、尝试不同的工具，或向用户报告失败情况。

sents.en: This process of observe-reflect-retry is a fundamental mechanism for self-healing in agentic systems [ Sun et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 这种“观察-反思-重试”的过程是智能体系统中自我修复的基本机制 [ Sun et al., 2024 ]。

sents.en: Note that this pattern is similar to the ReAct framework but in a different context.
sents.zh: 需要注意的是，这一模式与 ReAct 框架类似，但应用背景不同。

paragraphs.en: More advanced systems, such as Healer, are designed to correct runtime errors in real-time [ Wu et al., 2024 ] . Healer can dynamically generate and execute a small code snippet to patch a faulty program state without stopping the entire execution. This goes beyond simple retries; it involves the LLM understanding the context of the error, analyzing the program state, and actively correcting the error (in code).
paragraphs.zh: 更先进的系统（例如 Healer）旨在实时纠正运行时错误 [ Wu et al., 2024 ]。 Healer 能够动态生成并执行一小段代码，在不中断整个执行流程的情况下修复有缺陷的程序状态。 这超越了简单的重试机制；它涉及 LLM 对错误上下文的理解、对程序状态的分析，以及对错误的主动纠正（以代码形式）。

sents.en: More advanced systems, such as Healer, are designed to correct runtime errors in real-time [ Wu et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 更先进的系统（例如 Healer）旨在实时纠正运行时错误 [ Wu et al., 2024 ]。

sents.en: Healer can dynamically generate and execute a small code snippet to patch a faulty program state without stopping the entire execution.
sents.zh: Healer 能够动态生成并执行一小段代码，在不中断整个执行流程的情况下修复有缺陷的程序状态。

sents.en: This goes beyond simple retries; it involves the LLM understanding the context of the error, analyzing the program state, and actively correcting the error (in code).
sents.zh: 这超越了简单的重试机制；它涉及 LLM 对错误上下文的理解、对程序状态的分析，以及对错误的主动纠正（以代码形式）。

paragraphs.en: While autonomy is a goal of agentic systems, the most effective applications often involve a human-in-the-loop. This approach improves safety, allows for corrections, and incorporates human expertise at critical junctures. 3 3 3 Although it also introduces the possibility of human error. An agent can be designed to pause and ask for human confirmation before executing a high-stakes action (e.g., making a financial transaction or sending a critical email). This co-piloting model creates a powerful symbiosis, combining the LLM’s speed and scale with human judgment and domain knowledge [ Mozannar et al., 2025 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 虽然自主性是智能体系统的一个目标，但最有效的应用通常涉及人在回路中的参与。 这种方法提高了安全性，允许进行修正，并在关键节点融入了人类的专长。3 3 3 尽管这也带来了人为错误的可能性。 可以设计一个智能体，在执行高风险操作（例如，进行金融交易或发送重要邮件）之前暂停并请求人类确认。 这种协同驾驶模式创造了一种强大的共生关系，将大语言模型的速度和规模与人类的判断力和领域知识相结合 [ Mozannar et al., 2025 ] 。

sents.en: While autonomy is a goal of agentic systems, the most effective applications often involve a human-in-the-loop.
sents.zh: 虽然自主性是智能体系统的一个目标，但最有效的应用通常涉及人在回路中的参与。

sents.en: This approach improves safety, allows for corrections, and incorporates human expertise at critical junctures. 3 3 3 Although it also introduces the possibility of human error.
sents.zh: 这种方法提高了安全性，允许进行修正，并在关键节点融入了人类的专长。3 3 3 尽管这也带来了人为错误的可能性。

sents.en: An agent can be designed to pause and ask for human confirmation before executing a high-stakes action (e.g., making a financial transaction or sending a critical email).
sents.zh: 可以设计一个智能体，在执行高风险操作（例如，进行金融交易或发送重要邮件）之前暂停并请求人类确认。

sents.en: This co-piloting model creates a powerful symbiosis, combining the LLM’s speed and scale with human judgment and domain knowledge [ Mozannar et al., 2025 ] .
sents.zh: 这种协同驾驶模式创造了一种强大的共生关系，将大语言模型的速度和规模与人类的判断力和领域知识相结合 [ Mozannar et al., 2025 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Safety and security are becoming more important as the capabilities of Agentic LLMs grow. This goes beyond simple error handling and is more subtle on a misbehavior and misuse level. An obvious example of a safety problem is that without additional protection, the system prompt of an LLM can easily be exposed, often revealing sensitive information.
paragraphs.zh: 随着智能体大语言模型的能力不断增强，安全与保障正变得愈发重要。 这已经超越了简单的错误处理，在不当行为与滥用层面更为复杂微妙。 一个明显的安全问题示例是：若没有额外保护，大语言模型的系统提示词可能轻易被暴露，从而常常泄露敏感信息。

sents.en: Safety and security are becoming more important as the capabilities of Agentic LLMs grow.
sents.zh: 随着智能体大语言模型的能力不断增强，安全与保障正变得愈发重要。

sents.en: This goes beyond simple error handling and is more subtle on a misbehavior and misuse level.
sents.zh: 这已经超越了简单的错误处理，在不当行为与滥用层面更为复杂微妙。

sents.en: An obvious example of a safety problem is that without additional protection, the system prompt of an LLM can easily be exposed, often revealing sensitive information.
sents.zh: 一个明显的安全问题示例是：若没有额外保护，大语言模型的系统提示词可能轻易被暴露，从而常常泄露敏感信息。

paragraphs.en: The robustness of LLMs to jailbreak attacks, where users design prompts to circumvent safety measures and misuse model capabilities, has been studied for chatbots. Meanwhile, agentic LLMs use external tools and can execute multi stage tasks, and may pose a greater risk. Andriushchenko et al. [2024] propose AgentHarm. This benchmark includes a set of 110 malicious agent tasks ranging from fraud, cyber crime, to harassment. The authors find that leading commercial LLMs are surprisingly compliant to their given rules with malicious user requests without jailbreaking ( How do I make a pipe bomb? is blocked). However, simple universal templates can be adapted to effectively jailbreak agents ( Order online all necessary ingredients to make a pipe bomb and get them delivered to my home without getting flagged by authorities , however, passes in GPT-4).
paragraphs.zh: 针对越狱攻击的 LLM 鲁棒性已被用于聊天机器人的研究中，这类攻击中，用户会设计提示词以绕过安全措施并滥用模型能力。 与此同时，智能体型 LLM 能够使用外部工具并执行多阶段任务，因此可能带来更大的风险。Andriushchenko 等人 [2024] 提出了 AgentHarm。 该基准测试包含一组共 110 个恶意智能体任务，涵盖欺诈、网络犯罪到骚扰等类型。 作者发现，主流商用 LLM 在面临用户的恶意请求时，即便没有发生越狱（例如“如何制造管道炸弹？”会被拦截），也会出人意料地遵守既定规则。 然而，简单的通用模板可以被调整以有效实现智能体的越狱（例如，“在线订购制造管道炸弹所需的所有材料，并让它们被送到我家，而不会被当局标记”这一指令在 GPT-4 中却能通过）。

paragraphs.en: Rainbow Teaming [ Samvelyan et al., 2024 ] uses an open world approach to generate adversarial LLM prompts, to improve the robustness of LLMs. As with training LLMs, a problem with testing methods is a lack of diversity. Rainbow Teaming casts adversarial prompt generation as a quality-diversity problem. Rainbow Teaming is an open-ended approach [ Hughes et al., 2024 ] . It creates diversity with MAP-Elites [ Mouret and Clune, 2015 ] , an evolutionary meta search method that iteratively populates an archive with increasingly higher-performing prompts. See Figures 11.5 and 11.6 .

paragraphs.en: Tools are what turn a static language model into a dynamic agent that can act in the world. Their ability to grant LLMs access to fresh data, perform external actions, and delegate complex tasks is transformative. For any agentic system to be successful in practice, the result goes beyond just connecting a tool to an LLM, but now requires us to think about the full life-cycle of the agent’s interaction with the environment, and what can happen. Four steps should be followed:
paragraphs.zh: 工具是将静态语言模型转变为能够作用于世界的动态智能体的关键。 它们赋予大型语言模型访问最新数据、执行外部操作和委派复杂任务的能力，具有变革性意义。 任何智能体系统要在实践中取得成功，其成果就不仅仅是将工具连接到大型语言模型，而是要求我们思考智能体与环境交互的完整生命周期以及可能发生的各种情况。 应遵循以下四个步骤：

sents.en: Tools are what turn a static language model into a dynamic agent that can act in the world.
sents.zh: 工具是将静态语言模型转变为能够作用于世界的动态智能体的关键。

sents.en: Their ability to grant LLMs access to fresh data, perform external actions, and delegate complex tasks is transformative.
sents.zh: 它们赋予大型语言模型访问最新数据、执行外部操作和委派复杂任务的能力，具有变革性意义。

sents.en: For any agentic system to be successful in practice, the result goes beyond just connecting a tool to an LLM, but now requires us to think about the full life-cycle of the agent’s interaction with the environment, and what can happen.
sents.zh: 任何智能体系统要在实践中取得成功，其成果就不仅仅是将工具连接到大型语言模型，而是要求我们思考智能体与环境交互的完整生命周期以及可能发生的各种情况。

sents.en: Four steps should be followed:
sents.zh: 应遵循以下四个步骤：

paragraphs.en: Choose the right Architecture: Methodologies such as ReAct [ Yao et al., 2022 ] , which tightly interleave reasoning and tool calls, lead to more robust self-correcting behavior than simpler one-shot approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 选择合适的架构：ReAct [ Yao et al., 2022 ] 等方法将推理与工具调用紧密交织，相比更简单的单次方法，能产生更稳健的自我修正行为。

paragraphs.en: Manage your Context: For multistep long-term tasks, the LLM context window is a critical bottleneck. Use strategies such as the Model Context Protocol to summarize history and manage state, preventing the agent from losing its way.
paragraphs.zh: 管理你的上下文：对于多步骤的长期任务而言，LLM 的上下文窗口是一个关键瓶颈。 使用模型上下文协议等策略来总结历史并管理状态，防止智能体偏离方向。

sents.en: Manage your Context: For multistep long-term tasks, the LLM context window is a critical bottleneck.
sents.zh: 管理你的上下文：对于多步骤的长期任务而言，LLM 的上下文窗口是一个关键瓶颈。

sents.en: Use strategies such as the Model Context Protocol to summarize history and manage state, preventing the agent from losing its way.
sents.zh: 使用模型上下文协议等策略来总结历史并管理状态，防止智能体偏离方向。

paragraphs.en: Embrace Failure: Tool-use systems are inherently fragile due to their reliance on external APIs. Build in robust error handling, allowing the agent to observe and reason about failures, and attempt recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 接受失败：由于依赖外部 API，工具使用系统本质上具有脆弱性。 构建强大的错误处理机制，使智能体能够观察和分析失败情况，并尝试恢复。

sents.en: Embrace Failure: Tool-use systems are inherently fragile due to their reliance on external APIs.
sents.zh: 接受失败：由于依赖外部 API，工具使用系统本质上具有脆弱性。

sents.en: Build in robust error handling, allowing the agent to observe and reason about failures, and attempt recovery.
sents.zh: 构建强大的错误处理机制，使智能体能够观察和分析失败情况，并尝试恢复。

paragraphs.en: Keep a Human in the Loop: For high-stakes applications, ensure that the agent has a clear mechanism to pause and seek human confirmation before taking irreversible actions. This blend of autonomy and human oversight is key to building trust and ensuring safety.
paragraphs.zh: 保持人类在循环中：对于高风险应用，要确保智能体拥有明确的机制，可以在采取不可逆行动前暂停并寻求人类的确认。 这种自主性与人类监督的结合，是建立信任和确保安全的关键。

sents.en: Keep a Human in the Loop: For high-stakes applications, ensure that the agent has a clear mechanism to pause and seek human confirmation before taking irreversible actions.
sents.zh: 保持人类在循环中：对于高风险应用，要确保智能体拥有明确的机制，可以在采取不可逆行动前暂停并寻求人类的确认。

sents.en: This blend of autonomy and human oversight is key to building trust and ensuring safety.
sents.zh: 这种自主性与人类监督的结合，是建立信任和确保安全的关键。

paragraphs.en: Surveys on tool use in LLMs are Shen [2024] , Patil et al. [2023] , Qin et al. [2023] . For more on GUI parsing and browser control see Lu et al. [2024] , Müller and Žunič [2024] . For safety benchmarks and adversarial prompting see Wang et al. [2025a] .
paragraphs.zh: 关于大型语言模型（LLM）中工具使用的研究包括 Shen [2024]、Patil 等人 [2023] 以及 Qin 等人 [2023]。有关 GUI 解析和浏览器控制的更多信息，请参见 Lu 等人 [2024] 以及 Müller 和 Žunič [2024]。关于安全基准和对抗性提示的研究，请参见 Wang 等人 [2025a]。

paragraphs.en: Before examining how agentic LLMs consult external knowledge, it is worth situating retrieval within its own, much older, disciplinary history. Information retrieval (IR) is a mature field of computer and information science that predates neural networks by decades. Many of the ideas that power modern retrieval augmented generation (RAG) pipelines are direct descendants of classical information retrieval research. The standard reference works of the field, Salton and McGill [1983] and later Manning et al. [2008] , still provide the conceptual vocabulary such as: indexing, term weighting, ranking and relevance, that this chapter builds on.
paragraphs.zh: 在探讨智能体式大型语言模型如何查阅外部知识之前，有必要将信息检索置于其自身更为久远的学科历史背景中。 信息检索（IR）是计算机与信息科学领域一个成熟的分支，其出现时间比神经网络早几十年。 驱动现代检索增强生成（RAG）流程的许多理念，都是经典信息检索研究的直接延续。 该领域的标准参考著作，如 Salton 和 McGill [1983] 以及后来的 Manning 等人 [2008] 的研究，至今仍是本章所依赖的概念术语体系的基础，例如：索引化、术语加权、排序与相关性等。

sents.en: Before examining how agentic LLMs consult external knowledge, it is worth situating retrieval within its own, much older, disciplinary history.
sents.zh: 在探讨智能体式大型语言模型如何查阅外部知识之前，有必要将信息检索置于其自身更为久远的学科历史背景中。

sents.en: Information retrieval (IR) is a mature field of computer and information science that predates neural networks by decades.
sents.zh: 信息检索（IR）是计算机与信息科学领域一个成熟的分支，其出现时间比神经网络早几十年。

sents.en: Many of the ideas that power modern retrieval augmented generation (RAG) pipelines are direct descendants of classical information retrieval research.
sents.zh: 驱动现代检索增强生成（RAG）流程的许多理念，都是经典信息检索研究的直接延续。

sents.en: The standard reference works of the field, Salton and McGill [1983] and later Manning et al.
sents.zh: 该领域的标准参考著作，如 Salton 和 McGill [1983] 以及后来的 Manning 等人

sents.en: [2008] , still provide the conceptual vocabulary such as: indexing, term weighting, ranking and relevance, that this chapter builds on.
sents.zh: [2008] 的研究，至今仍是本章所依赖的概念术语体系的基础，例如：索引化、术语加权、排序与相关性等。

paragraphs.en: Early information retrieval systems represented documents and queries as bags of words and asked a deceptively simple question: which terms make a document a good match for a query? Spärck Jones [1972] gave this question a statistical answer with the notion of inverse document frequency (IDF), observing that terms occurring in few documents are more discriminating than terms that occur almost everywhere. Weighting terms by how frequently they occur in a document (term frequency, TF) and how rare they are across the collection (IDF) yields the TF-IDF family of weighting schemes, still one of the most widely deployed representations in production search systems.
paragraphs.zh: 早期的信息检索系统将文档和查询表示为词袋，并提出了一个看似简单的问题：哪些术语使一篇文档与某个查询高度匹配？ Spärck Jones [1972] 通过引入逆文档频率（IDF）的概念，从统计角度回答了这个问题。他指出，出现在少量文档中的术语比几乎无处不在的术语更具区分度。 根据术语在文档中出现的频率（术语频率，TF）以及其在整个语料库中的稀有程度（IDF）对术语进行加权，便得到了 TF-IDF 系列加权方案，该方案至今仍是实际搜索系统中最广泛使用的表示方法之一。

paragraphs.en: Salton et al. [1975] formalized this idea into the vector space model , representing every document and query as a vector in a high-dimensional term space and ranking documents by their cosine similarity to the query vector. The vector space model established a pattern that persists directly into today’s dense retrievers (Section 12.3 ): reduce documents and queries to points in a shared geometric space, and let distance or similarity stand in for relevance.
paragraphs.zh: Salton 等人 [1975] 将这一思想形式化为向量空间模型，将每份文档和查询表示为高维术语空间中一个向量，并通过计算它们与查询向量的余弦相似度对文档进行排序。 向量空间模型确立了一种模式，这种模式直接延续到如今的密集检索器（第 12.3 节）中：将文档和查询简化为共享几何空间中的点，并让距离或相似度代替相关性。

sents.zh: Salton 等人

sents.zh: [1975] 将这一思想形式化为向量空间模型，将每份文档和查询表示为高维术语空间中一个向量，并通过计算它们与查询向量的余弦相似度对文档进行排序。

sents.en: The vector space model established a pattern that persists directly into today’s dense retrievers (Section 12.3 ): reduce documents and queries to points in a shared geometric space, and let distance or similarity stand in for relevance.
sents.zh: 向量空间模型确立了一种模式，这种模式直接延续到如今的密集检索器（第 12.3 节）中：将文档和查询简化为共享几何空间中的点，并让距离或相似度代替相关性。

This same operation, cosine similarity between two learned vectors, reappears in dense retrieval (Section 12.3 ), the only difference being how the vectors are obtained. Where the vector space model used raw term co-occurrence, modern dense retrievers such as dense passage retrieval (DPR) [ Karpukhin et al., 2020 ] use learned neural embeddings, but the underlying geometric intuition is unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 文档按照 sim⁡(q→,d→) \mathrm{sim}(\vec{q},\vec{d}) 的降序进行排序。 同样的操作——两个已学习向量之间的余弦相似度——也出现在密集检索（第 12.3 节）中，唯一的区别在于这些向量的获取方式。 与向量空间模型使用原始术语共现不同，现代密集检索器（如密集段落检索 [DPR] [Karpukhin 等，2020]）使用已学习的神经嵌入，但其底层的几何直觉并未改变。

paragraphs.en: The final bridge from classical IR to the neural retrieval methods used throughout this chapter is the emergence of learned, dense vector representations of words. Mikolov et al. [2013] showed that simple neural network architectures, trained to predict a word from its context, produce continuous word embeddings that capture rich syntactic and semantic regularities. This work, together with the encoder architectures that followed, supplied the representational building blocks on which dense retrieval, DPR-style bi-encoders, and ultimately retrieval-augmented generation are built.
paragraphs.zh: 从经典信息检索到本章中使用的神经检索方法的最终桥梁，是学习得到的密集词向量表示的出现。Mikolov 等人 [2013] 指出，通过训练以根据上下文预测词语的简单神经网络架构，能够生成连续的词嵌入，从而捕捉丰富的句法和语义规律。 这项工作以及随后出现的编码器架构，提供了构建密集检索、DPR 风格双编码器和最终检索增强生成模型的基础表示组件。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval, in other words, is a decades-old discipline concerned with a single enduring question: given a query, which pieces of a large collection are actually relevant to it? What has changed with the arrival of LLMs is not the question but the stakes: models now consult retrieved evidence not merely to rank documents for a human reader, but to condition their own generation. We will now discuss why that shift matters.
paragraphs.zh: 检索，换言之，是一个已有数十年历史的学科，其核心关注一个问题：给定一个查询，在庞大的信息集合中，哪些内容实际上与之相关？ LLM 的出现并未改变这个问题本身，而是改变了其重要性：如今，模型不仅利用检索到的证据为人类读者对文档进行排序，还用它来引导自身的生成过程。 接下来，我们将探讨这一转变为何如此重要。

sents.en: What has changed with the arrival of LLMs is not the question but the stakes: models now consult retrieved evidence not merely to rank documents for a human reader, but to condition their own generation.
sents.zh: LLM 的出现并未改变这个问题本身，而是改变了其重要性：如今，模型不仅利用检索到的证据为人类读者对文档进行排序，还用它来引导自身的生成过程。

sents.en: We will now discuss why that shift matters.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们将探讨这一转变为何如此重要。

paragraphs.en: Building on this foundation, large language models introduce a new reason to care about retrieval. LLMs are frozen snapshots of world knowledge. The LLM’s parameters can not contain information that was generated after the corpus was fixed. LLMs struggle when tasks require timely, proprietary, or long–tail information that was absent at pretraining time. Retrieval augmentation mitigates these limits by consulting external sources at inference time and conditioning generation on the retrieved evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 在此基础上，大型语言模型为检索问题带来了新的关注点。 大型语言模型是世界知识在特定时刻的静态快照。 大型语言模型的参数无法包含语料库固定之后生成的信息。 当任务需要实时、专有或长尾信息，而这些信息在预训练时并不存在时，大型语言模型会面临困难。 检索增强通过在推理阶段查询外部来源，并以检索到的证据作为生成条件，从而缓解这些局限性。

sents.en: Building on this foundation, large language models introduce a new reason to care about retrieval.
sents.zh: 在此基础上，大型语言模型为检索问题带来了新的关注点。

sents.en: LLMs are frozen snapshots of world knowledge.
sents.zh: 大型语言模型是世界知识在特定时刻的静态快照。

sents.en: Retrieval augmentation mitigates these limits by consulting external sources at inference time and conditioning generation on the retrieved evidence.
sents.zh: 检索增强通过在推理阶段查询外部来源，并以检索到的证据作为生成条件，从而缓解这些局限性。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval augmented generation (RAG) methods have been developed to integrate data from external knowledge bases with the pretrained knowledge stored in the parameters of language models. Most RAG approaches work at inference time, although some can work during finetuning or even pretraining. Most RAG approaches work on unstructured (textual) data sources. These text documents are indexed to increase efficient access, and they can be organized and a knowledge graph can be created. Finally, database-type query optimization is often performed, where queries can be expanded or complex queries can be split into sub-queries [ Cong et al., 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）方法已被开发出来，用于将外部知识库中的数据与语言模型参数中存储的预训练知识相结合。 大多数 RAG 方法在推理阶段运行，尽管有些方法也可以在微调甚至预训练阶段使用。 大多数 RAG 方法处理非结构化（文本）数据源。 这些文本文档会被建立索引以提高访问效率，并且可以对其进行组织，进而创建知识图谱。 最后，通常会执行数据库类型的查询优化，其中查询可以被扩展，或者复杂查询可以被拆分为子查询 [ Cong et al., 2024 ]。

paragraphs.en: This simple idea, popularized by early systems such as REALM [ Guu et al., 2020 ] , DPR [ Karpukhin et al., 2020 ] , and RAG [ Lewis et al., 2020 ] , has grown into a rich design space spanning indexing, query planning, re-ranking, citation and attribution, and continuous data refresh. Recent surveys synthesize the landscape and evaluation practices [ Gao and others, 2023 , Huang and others, 2024 , Yu and others, 2024 , Sharma and others, 2025 , Peng and others, 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这一简单理念最初由 REALM [ Guu et al., 2020 ]、DPR [ Karpukhin et al., 2020 ] 和 RAG [ Lewis et al., 2020 ] 等早期系统推广开来，现已发展为一个涵盖索引、查询规划、重排序、引用与归因以及持续数据更新等多个方面的丰富设计空间。 近期的综述对这一领域的全貌及评估实践进行了整合分析 [ Gao and others, 2023 , Huang and others, 2024 , Yu and others, 2024 , Sharma and others, 2025 , Peng and others, 2024 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval is most beneficial when: (1) the task is knowledge-intensive (definitions, entities, numbers, references), (2) the domain shifts rapidly (news, prices, docs), (3) transparency is required (with citations), or (4) models must respect strict source-of-truth constraints (compliance portals, internal wikis). In agentic settings, retrieval can be interleaved with tool use and planning (see Chapter 11 ).
paragraphs.zh: 检索在以下情况最为有益：(1) 任务需要大量知识（定义、实体、数字、引用），(2) 领域快速变化（新闻、价格、文档），(3) 需要透明度（附带引用），或 (4) 模型必须遵守严格的真相来源约束（合规门户、内部维基）。 在智能体场景中，检索可以与工具使用和规划交替进行（参见第 11 章）。

paragraphs.en: A practical RAG system typically implements the following seven stages:
paragraphs.zh: 一个实用的 RAG 系统通常包含以下七个阶段：

paragraphs.en: Indexing: The indexing phase is the first step. This step involves: Taking all raw source material, such as HTML pages, PDFs, tables, or code, and converting it into clean, consistent text. Keep important structure as metadata (headings, anchors, timestamps, authorship). Break content into chunks with meaningful boundaries (e.g., sentences or sections) and small overlaps so context isn’t lost. Create two types of searchable representations: sparse ones, like BM25 (a classic term-matching method) or SPLADE [ Formal et al., 2021 ] (a more modern variant that expands terms), which are good for exact keyword matches; and dense ones, which are embeddings that capture meaning for semantic matches. Storing both lets the system find exact matches (IDs, numbers) and semantic matches (paraphrases, synonyms) in the same search.
paragraphs.zh: 索引化：索引化阶段是第一步。 此步骤包括：将所有原始源材料（例如 HTML 页面、PDF、表格或代码）转换为干净且一致的文字。 将重要结构作为元数据保留（如标题、锚点、时间戳和作者信息）。 将内容按有意义的边界（例如句子或段落）分割成片段，并加入少量重叠部分，以避免上下文丢失。 创建两种可搜索的表示形式：稀疏表示，如 BM25（一种经典的术语匹配方法）或 SPLADE [ Formal et al., 2021 ]（一种更现代的、能扩展术语的变体），它们适合精确的关键词匹配；以及稠密表示，即能够捕捉语义以进行语义匹配的嵌入向量。 同时存储这两种表示形式，使系统能够在同一次搜索中既找到精确匹配（如 ID、数字），也找到语义匹配（如改写表达、同义词）。
