paragraphs.en: The key characteristic of pure cooperation games is that agents must fully cooperate with each other with no competitive incentives. In contrast, in competitive settings such as the Prisoner’s Dilemma (or the mixed-motive games in benchmarks like MAgIC), an agent faces a genuine tension between individual and collective payoff. In such games, when an LLM fails to cooperate, the reason is unclear. The agent may be bad at coordination or it might reason strategically about individual gains. In pure cooperation games, there is never any reason to defect, so any failure to cooperate is a genuine lack of coordination ability.
paragraphs.zh: 纯粹合作类游戏的关键特征在于，智能体必须完全相互合作，没有任何竞争激励。 相比之下，在竞争环境中（例如囚徒困境，或 MAgIC 基准测试中的混合动机游戏），智能体会面临个人收益与集体收益之间的真实冲突。 在这类游戏中，当大型语言模型未能合作时，其原因尚不明确。 该智能体可能不擅长协调，也可能在策略上优先考虑个人收益。 在纯粹合作类游戏中，永远没有背叛的理由，因此任何合作失败都意味着真正的协调能力不足。

sents.en: The key characteristic of pure cooperation games is that agents must fully cooperate with each other with no competitive incentives.
sents.zh: 纯粹合作类游戏的关键特征在于，智能体必须完全相互合作，没有任何竞争激励。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks aggregate over many small games. A complementary line of research builds single scenarios and studies agent behavior in-depth.
paragraphs.zh: 基准测试是对许多小型游戏的汇总。 另一条互补的研究路线则构建单个场景，并深入研究智能体的行为。

sents.en: Benchmarks aggregate over many small games.
sents.zh: 基准测试是对许多小型游戏的汇总。

sents.en: A complementary line of research builds single scenarios and studies agent behavior in-depth.
sents.zh: 另一条互补的研究路线则构建单个场景，并深入研究智能体的行为。

paragraphs.en: Alympics [ Mao et al., 2023 ] provides a controlled playground for simulating strategic interaction among LLM-driven agents, illustrated by a multi-round water-allocation challenge in which scarce survival resources must be distributed over time, see Figure 16.3 .
paragraphs.zh: Alympics [ Mao et al., 2023 ] 提供了一个受控的实验环境，用于模拟由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的智能体之间的策略性互动。这一过程通过一个多轮水资源分配挑战得以体现：稀缺的生存资源必须随着时间的推移进行合理分配，参见图16.3。

paragraphs.en: AucArena [ Chen et al., 2023a ] simulates auctions, across LLaMa 2.13b, Mistral 7b, Mixtral 8x7b, Gemini 1.0, and GPT 3.5/4.0, finding that the most capable LLMs such as GPT-4 possess skills for auction participation such as budget management and goal-focus, though performance varies even for that model, and the authors point to considerable room for improvement.
paragraphs.zh: AucArena [ Chen et al., 2023a ] 模拟了多个模型（LLaMa 2.13b、Mistral 7b、Mixtral 8x7b、Gemini 1.0 以及 GPT 3.5/4.0）在拍卖场景中的表现，研究发现，像 GPT-4 这样能力最强的 LLM 具备参与拍卖所需的技能，例如预算管理和目标导向能力。不过，即便是同一模型，其表现也存在差异，作者指出，该领域仍有较大的改进空间。

paragraphs.en: Across benchmarks and single-scenario platforms alike, coordination emerges as the consistent weak spot of LLM agents. Stronger LLMs score well on rationality and judgment in MAgIC, manage budgets sensibly in AucArena, and match trained RL agents in environment-driven cooperation. However, all but the strongest and most heavily scaffolded models fail when success requires reasoning about what a partner believes and intends.
paragraphs.zh: 无论是在基准测试中还是在单一场景平台上，协调始终都是 LLM 智能体表现出的稳定弱点。 性能更强的 LLM 在 MAgIC 中的理性与判断能力得分较高，在 AucArena 中能合理管理预算，并且在与环境驱动的合作中能够匹敌经过训练的 RL 智能体。 然而，除了性能最强且支持最全面的模型外，所有其他模型一旦任务成功需要推理出合作伙伴的信念与意图时，便会失败。

sents.en: Across benchmarks and single-scenario platforms alike, coordination emerges as the consistent weak spot of LLM agents.
sents.zh: 无论是在基准测试中还是在单一场景平台上，协调始终都是 LLM 智能体表现出的稳定弱点。

sents.en: Stronger LLMs score well on rationality and judgment in MAgIC, manage budgets sensibly in AucArena, and match trained RL agents in environment-driven cooperation.
sents.zh: 性能更强的 LLM 在 MAgIC 中的理性与判断能力得分较高，在 AucArena 中能合理管理预算，并且在与环境驱动的合作中能够匹敌经过训练的 RL 智能体。

sents.en: However, all but the strongest and most heavily scaffolded models fail when success requires reasoning about what a partner believes and intends.
sents.zh: 然而，除了性能最强且支持最全面的模型外，所有其他模型一旦任务成功需要推理出合作伙伴的信念与意图时，便会失败。

paragraphs.en: In other words, models fail to consistently integrate theory of mind reasoning with their behavior. In Chapter 15 , failures of this kind were referred to as the knowing-doing or literal-functional gap: GPT-4 could respond accurately when prompted to predict the alternating pattern in Bach or Stravinsky, but failed to enact it when playing. However, the multi-agent studies reviewed here complicate that diagnosis. In the question-asking section of the LLM Coordination Benchmark, the questions about joint planning pose exactly the decision the agent faces at each step of the game play. It is on these questions that the models perform worst (and on ToM questions not much better). Question-answering scores correlate positively with agentic performance across games. In other words, knowing and doing move together here: where models act poorly, they also reason poorly when the action problem is posed to them directly. For pure coordination tasks, the deficit thus lies in taking the partner’s perspective (ToM) and joint planning itself, rather tan in translating reasoning into action.
paragraphs.zh: 换言之，模型无法始终如一地将心智理论推理与自身行为相结合。 在第 15 章中，这类失败被称为“知-行”或“字面-功能”鸿沟：当被要求预测巴赫或斯特拉文斯基音乐中的交替模式时，GPT-4 能够准确回应，但在实际演奏时却未能实现这种模式。 然而，本文回顾的多智能体研究使这一诊断变得更为复杂。 在 LLM 协调基准测试的问题提出部分，关于联合规划的问题恰好对应了智能体在游戏每一步中需要做出的决策。 模型在这些问题上表现最差（在心智理论问题上表现也并无明显好转）。 跨游戏来看，问题回答得分与智能体表现呈正相关。 换言之，在这里，“知”与“行”是同步变化的：模型在行为表现不佳时，当直接面对行动问题时，其推理能力同样不佳。 对于纯粹的协调任务而言，问题因此在于未能从合作者的视角出发（心智理论）以及联合规划本身，而非将推理转化为行动。

sents.zh: 换言之，模型无法始终如一地将心智理论推理与自身行为相结合。

sents.zh: 然而，本文回顾的多智能体研究使这一诊断变得更为复杂。

sents.en: In the question-asking section of the LLM Coordination Benchmark, the questions about joint planning pose exactly the decision the agent faces at each step of the game play.
sents.zh: 在 LLM 协调基准测试的问题提出部分，关于联合规划的问题恰好对应了智能体在游戏每一步中需要做出的决策。

sents.en: It is on these questions that the models perform worst (and on ToM questions not much better).
sents.zh: 模型在这些问题上表现最差（在心智理论问题上表现也并无明显好转）。

sents.en: Question-answering scores correlate positively with agentic performance across games.
sents.zh: 跨游戏来看，问题回答得分与智能体表现呈正相关。

sents.en: In other words, knowing and doing move together here: where models act poorly, they also reason poorly when the action problem is posed to them directly.
sents.zh: 换言之，在这里，“知”与“行”是同步变化的：模型在行为表现不佳时，当直接面对行动问题时，其推理能力同样不佳。

sents.en: For pure coordination tasks, the deficit thus lies in taking the partner’s perspective (ToM) and joint planning itself, rather tan in translating reasoning into action.
sents.zh: 对于纯粹的协调任务而言，问题因此在于未能从合作者的视角出发（心智理论）以及联合规划本身，而非将推理转化为行动。

paragraphs.en: On a different level, the knowing-doing gap reappears. In Hanabi, GPT-4-turbo reaches reasonable performance only when scaffolded with explicit ToM reasoning and self-verification steps. Without these in place, it commits fatal errors in every Hanabi trial. In other words, it acts wrongly initially, but recognizes and corrects these errors when prompted to check the reasoning and verification steps. Similar performance boosts were caused by probabilistic graphical modeling in MAgIC and Social Chain-of-Thought in strategic-behavior studies discussed in Chapter 15 . The boundary between LLMs cannot reason about others and LLMs do not spontaneously deploy such reasoning is apparently thin, and agentic embedding in the form of structured reasoning and verification steps can bring out the latter.
paragraphs.zh: 在另一个层面上，“知”与“行”之间的鸿沟再次出现。 在 Hanabi 游戏中，GPT-4-turbo 只有在借助明确的 ToM 推理和自我验证步骤进行引导时，才能达到合理的性能水平。 如果没有这些步骤，它在每次 Hanabi 试验中都会犯下致命错误。 换句话说，它最初会做出错误的行为，但在被提示检查推理和验证步骤时，能够识别并纠正这些错误。 在第 15 章讨论的战略行为研究中，概率图模型在 MAgIC 中的应用以及社会思维链方法也带来了类似的性能提升。 LLM 无法对他者进行推理与 LLM 不会自发运用此类推理之间的界限似乎十分模糊，而通过结构化推理和验证步骤实现的智能体嵌入，则能够激发出后者的能力。

paragraphs.en: The next section examines a different, complementary response to the same problem: instead of upgrading the agents’ reasoning, one can structure the interaction itself, by assigning roles.
paragraphs.zh: 下一部分将探讨针对同一问题的另一种互补性应对策略：与其升级智能体的推理能力，不如通过分配角色来设计互动本身的结构。

paragraphs.en: In the previous section, agents were symmetric peers and coordination had to emerge from their own strategic reasoning (with limited success). In the studies discussed in this section, coordination is designed-in using interaction protocols and assigning roles with distinct objectives.
paragraphs.zh: 在上一节中，智能体是对称的同伴，协调必须通过它们自身的战略推理（尽管成效有限）来实现。 在本节讨论的研究中，协调是通过互动协议和分配具有不同目标的特定角色来预先设计的。

sents.en: In the previous section, agents were symmetric peers and coordination had to emerge from their own strategic reasoning (with limited success).
sents.zh: 在上一节中，智能体是对称的同伴，协调必须通过它们自身的战略推理（尽管成效有限）来实现。

sents.en: In the studies discussed in this section, coordination is designed-in using interaction protocols and assigning roles with distinct objectives.
sents.zh: 在本节讨论的研究中，协调是通过互动协议和分配具有不同目标的特定角色来预先设计的。

paragraphs.en: In terms of the five dimensions defined in Section 16.1.3 , the studies vary the strategies and structures while keeping the overall interaction type cooperative. We proceed from the simplest to the most complex structure: complementary pairs, multi-party debate, teams, and social role-play under pressure.
paragraphs.zh: 就第 16.1.3 节中定义的五项维度而言，这些研究在保持整体互动类型为合作性的同时，改变了策略和结构。 我们从最简单的结构开始，逐步过渡到最复杂的结构：互补配对、多方辩论、团队以及高压下的社会角色扮演。

sents.en: In terms of the five dimensions defined in Section 16.1.3 , the studies vary the strategies and structures while keeping the overall interaction type cooperative.
sents.zh: 就第 16.1.3 节中定义的五项维度而言，这些研究在保持整体互动类型为合作性的同时，改变了策略和结构。

sents.en: We proceed from the simplest to the most complex structure: complementary pairs, multi-party debate, teams, and social role-play under pressure.
sents.zh: 我们从最简单的结构开始，逐步过渡到最复杂的结构：互补配对、多方辩论、团队以及高压下的社会角色扮演。

paragraphs.en: LLMs can perform tasks in pairs where they are assigned complementary roles, such as creator-critic or manager-worker. In these pair-wise setups, each LLM agent is given a distinct role and objective, and they communicate to jointly solve tasks.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 可以以成对方式执行任务，其中它们被分配互补的角色，例如创造者-评论家或管理者-工作者。 在这些成对设置中，每个 LLM 智能体都被赋予一个独特的角色和目标，并通过相互沟通来共同完成任务。

sents.en: LLMs can perform tasks in pairs where they are assigned complementary roles, such as creator-critic or manager-worker.
sents.zh: LLM 可以以成对方式执行任务，其中它们被分配互补的角色，例如创造者-评论家或管理者-工作者。

sents.en: In these pair-wise setups, each LLM agent is given a distinct role and objective, and they communicate to jointly solve tasks.
sents.zh: 在这些成对设置中，每个 LLM 智能体都被赋予一个独特的角色和目标，并通过相互沟通来共同完成任务。

paragraphs.en: In the CAMEL framework (Communicative Agents for “Mind” Exploration) [ Li et al., 2023 ] , two LLMs have predefined roles to perform, to work on a goal such as a coding task (See Figure 16.4 ). Through cooperation, together they drive a conversation without explicit continuous human prompting. CAMEL uses inception prompting and role descriptions so that agents stay in character and collaborate towards the goal. The agents are prompted to break down complex problems in manageable steps through their dialogue. During each interaction step the LLM agents effectively generate their own inference-time training data, making the cognitive process visible for human inspection, while at the same time enhancing autonomous task performance.
paragraphs.zh: 在 CAMEL 框架（用于“心智”探索的通信智能体）[Li et al., 2023] 中，两个大型语言模型（LLM）被赋予了预定义的角色，以完成编码任务等目标（参见图 16.4）。 通过合作，它们能够在没有持续明确的人类提示的情况下共同推动对话。 CAMEL 采用初始提示和角色描述，使智能体能够保持角色设定并朝着目标协作。 这些智能体被提示通过对话将复杂问题分解为可管理的步骤。 在每次交互步骤中，LLM 智能体能有效生成其自身的推理阶段训练数据，从而让人类能够观察其认知过程，同时提升自主任务执行能力。

paragraphs.en: Other studies have paired an LLM creator (or generator) with an LLM judge (or critic) in a self-reflective setting. In this way the generative power of LLMs is leveraged through one agent, while adherence to rules or quality guidelines is enforced by the other. Constitutional AI [ Bai et al., 2022 ] employs one LLM to critique another LLM’s responses against a set of ethical or quality guidelines, suggesting revisions. The authors show that this kind of two-agent feedback yields refined final outputs that are aligned with the desired principles.
paragraphs.zh: 其他研究将 LLM 创建者（或生成器）与 LLM 评判者（或批评者）置于自我反思的环境中相互配合。 通过这种方式，一个智能体利用 LLM 的生成能力，而另一个智能体则确保遵循规则或质量指南。 宪法人工智能 [ Bai et al., 2022 ] 使用一个 LLM 来根据一系列伦理或质量指南对另一个 LLM 的回应进行批评，并提出修改建议。 作者表明，这种双智能体反馈机制能够产生与期望原则一致的、更精细的最终输出。

sents.en: Other studies have paired an LLM creator (or generator) with an LLM judge (or critic) in a self-reflective setting.
sents.zh: 其他研究将 LLM 创建者（或生成器）与 LLM 评判者（或批评者）置于自我反思的环境中相互配合。

sents.en: In this way the generative power of LLMs is leveraged through one agent, while adherence to rules or quality guidelines is enforced by the other.
sents.zh: 通过这种方式，一个智能体利用 LLM 的生成能力，而另一个智能体则确保遵循规则或质量指南。

paragraphs.en: A third form of pair-wise interaction follows human tutoring dynamics: teacher-learner or expert-novice. Chapter 19.2 discusses various examples of this structure in the context of distillation.
paragraphs.zh: 第三种成对互动形式遵循人类辅导的动态模式：教师-学习者或专家-新手。 第 19.2 章探讨了在蒸馏背景下这种结构的多种示例。

sents.en: A third form of pair-wise interaction follows human tutoring dynamics: teacher-learner or expert-novice.
sents.zh: 第三种成对互动形式遵循人类辅导的动态模式：教师-学习者或专家-新手。

sents.en: Chapter 19.2 discusses various examples of this structure in the context of distillation.
sents.zh: 第 19.2 章探讨了在蒸馏背景下这种结构的多种示例。

paragraphs.en: All three pairings exploit the same idea: one agent’s oversight can correct the other’s mistakes, leading to more robust joint performance than either agent achieves alone.
paragraphs.zh: 这三种配对都利用了同一个理念：一个智能体的监督可以纠正另一个智能体的错误，从而使其联合表现比任一智能体单独行动时更为稳健。

paragraphs.en: Beyond pairs, a prominent example of role-based interaction is the use of debate and discussion between LLMs to improve reasoning and task performance.
paragraphs.zh: 除了成对互动之外，一个典型的基于角色的互动例子是，通过大型语言模型之间的辩论和讨论来提升推理能力和任务表现。

paragraphs.en: Du et al. [2024] demonstrated that when multiple LLM instances propose answers and critique each other’s reasoning through several rounds of debate, they can reach a more accurate consensus answer with higher factual correctness. This approach, described in terms of Minsky’s society of minds [ Minsky, 1988 ] , significantly reduced reasoning errors and hallucinations in tasks such as math word problems and factual question answering.
paragraphs.zh: Du 等人 [2024] 的研究表明，当多个大型语言模型实例提出答案，并通过多轮辩论相互批判对方的推理过程时，它们能够达成更准确、事实正确性更高的共识答案。 这种方法以明斯基的“心智社会”[Minsky, 1988] 理论为框架进行描述，在数学应用题和事实性问题回答等任务中显著减少了推理错误和幻觉现象。

sents.en: Du et al.
sents.zh: Du 等人

sents.en: [2024] demonstrated that when multiple LLM instances propose answers and critique each other’s reasoning through several rounds of debate, they can reach a more accurate consensus answer with higher factual correctness.
sents.zh: [2024] 的研究表明，当多个大型语言模型实例提出答案，并通过多轮辩论相互批判对方的推理过程时，它们能够达成更准确、事实正确性更高的共识答案。

sents.en: This approach, described in terms of Minsky’s society of minds [ Minsky, 1988 ] , significantly reduced reasoning errors and hallucinations in tasks such as math word problems and factual question answering.
sents.zh: 这种方法以明斯基的“心智社会”[Minsky, 1988] 理论为框架进行描述，在数学应用题和事实性问题回答等任务中显著减少了推理错误和幻觉现象。

paragraphs.en: Liang et al. [2024] propose a multi-agent debate (MAD) setup where two LLM agents take opposing sides in, for instance, a tit-for-tat negotiation (see Section 15.4 ) while a third agent acts as a judge. The role of the judge is to guide the discussion towards a final solution. The structured debate encourages divergent thinking and can push a weaker model enhanced with MAD (such as GPT-3.5) to outperform a stronger model without MAD (such as GPT-4) on a challenging benchmark. The authors discuss how their MAD setup overcomes a known problem in model scaffolding with self-reflective steps. Self-reflection can induce so-called degeneration of thought : once a model gains confidence in a certain solution direction, self-reflection can reinforce the confidence even if the direction is wrong. In the MAD debating-setup, the other agent can push towards a different direction direction to avoid thought degeneration.
paragraphs.zh: Liang 等人 [2024] 提出了一种多智能体辩论（MAD）框架，其中两个大型语言模型智能体在某种“以牙还牙”的谈判中（参见第 15.4 节）分别代表对立的立场，而第三个智能体则担任裁判。 裁判的角色是引导讨论走向最终解决方案。 这种结构化的辩论鼓励发散性思维，并可能使通过 MAD 增强的较弱模型（如 GPT-3.5）在具有挑战性的基准测试中表现优于未使用 MAD 的较强模型（如 GPT-4）。 作者讨论了他们的 MAD 框架如何通过自我反思步骤解决了模型架构中的一个已知问题。 自我反思可能导致所谓的思维退化：一旦模型对某个解决方案方向产生信心，自我反思可能会进一步巩固这种信心，即使该方向是错误的。 在 MAD 辩论框架中，另一个智能体可以推动讨论转向不同的方向，从而避免思维退化。

sents.en: Liang et al.
sents.zh: Liang 等人

paragraphs.en: ChatEval applies this debate pattern to text evaluation [ Chan et al., 2023 ] . Noting that the quality of human text assessment improves when multiple annotators collaborate, the authors create a multi-agent referee team with debater agents, diverse role specifications, and different communication strategies (see Figure 16.5 ), moving beyond single-agent prompting strategies.
paragraphs.zh: ChatEval 将这种辩论模式应用于文本评估 [ Chan et al., 2023 ]。 鉴于多人协作能提升人类对文本的评估质量，作者们组建了一个由辩论智能体、多样化的角色设定和不同沟通策略构成的多智能体评审团队（参见图 16.5），从而突破了单一智能体的提示策略。

sents.en: ChatEval applies this debate pattern to text evaluation [ Chan et al., 2023 ] .
sents.zh: ChatEval 将这种辩论模式应用于文本评估 [ Chan et al., 2023 ]。

sents.en: Noting that the quality of human text assessment improves when multiple annotators collaborate, the authors create a multi-agent referee team with debater agents, diverse role specifications, and different communication strategies (see Figure 16.5 ), moving beyond single-agent prompting strategies.
sents.zh: 鉴于多人协作能提升人类对文本的评估质量，作者们组建了一个由辩论智能体、多样化的角色设定和不同沟通策略构成的多智能体评审团队（参见图 16.5），从而突破了单一智能体的提示策略。

paragraphs.en: Another approach, also motivated by Minsky’s society of minds, is ReConcile, a multi-agent framework designed as a round table conference among diverse LLM agents [ Chen et al., 2023b ] . The framework enhances collaborative reasoning between LLM agents via multiple rounds of discussion. The agents must try to convince one another to improve their answers. Experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate that a confidence-weighted voting mechanism significantly improves LLMs’ reasoning. Furthermore, the authors find that diversity (using different underlying models) is critical for performance.
paragraphs.zh: 另一种方法同样受到明斯基“心智社会”理论的启发，即 ReConcile——一个多智能体框架，旨在让不同的 LLM 智能体以圆桌会议的形式进行互动 [Chen et al., 2023b]。 该框架通过多轮讨论增强了 LLM 智能体之间的协作推理能力。 这些智能体必须努力说服彼此，以改进各自的答案。 在七个基准测试上的实验表明，一种基于置信度加权的投票机制能显著提升 LLM 的推理能力。 此外，作者发现，多样性（即使用不同的底层模型）对性能至关重要。

sents.en: Another approach, also motivated by Minsky’s society of minds, is ReConcile, a multi-agent framework designed as a round table conference among diverse LLM agents [ Chen et al., 2023b ] .
sents.zh: 另一种方法同样受到明斯基“心智社会”理论的启发，即 ReConcile——一个多智能体框架，旨在让不同的 LLM 智能体以圆桌会议的形式进行互动 [Chen et al., 2023b]。

sents.en: The framework enhances collaborative reasoning between LLM agents via multiple rounds of discussion.
sents.zh: 该框架通过多轮讨论增强了 LLM 智能体之间的协作推理能力。

sents.en: The agents must try to convince one another to improve their answers.
sents.zh: 这些智能体必须努力说服彼此，以改进各自的答案。

sents.en: Experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate that a confidence-weighted voting mechanism significantly improves LLMs’ reasoning.
sents.zh: 在七个基准测试上的实验表明，一种基于置信度加权的投票机制能显著提升 LLM 的推理能力。

sents.en: Furthermore, the authors find that diversity (using different underlying models) is critical for performance.
sents.zh: 此外，作者发现，多样性（即使用不同的底层模型）对性能至关重要。

paragraphs.en: MindStorms introduces an LLM-based implementation [ Zhuge et al., 2023 ] on the CAMEL framework [ Li et al., 2023 ] . Extensive experiments are reported with up to 129 agents solving common AI problems: visual question answering, image captioning, text-to-image synthesis, 3D generation, egocentric retrieval, embodied AI, and general language-based task solving. The authors find that, in specific applications, mindstorms among many members outperform those among fewer members, and longer mindstorms outperform shorter ones.
paragraphs.zh: MindStorms 在 CAMEL 框架 [ Li et al., 2023 ] 上引入了一种基于 LLM 的实现 [ Zhuge et al., 2023 ]。 报告了大规模实验，其中最多有 129 个智能体共同解决常见的 AI 问题：视觉问答、图像描述生成、文本到图像合成、3D 生成、以自我为中心的信息检索、具身 AI 以及基于语言的一般任务解决。 作者发现，在特定应用中，成员数量较多的头脑风暴表现优于成员较少的情况，且持续时间较长的头脑风暴表现优于较短的头脑风暴。

sents.zh: MindStorms 在 CAMEL 框架 [ Li et al., 2023 ] 上引入了一种基于 LLM 的实现 [ Zhuge et al., 2023 ]。

sents.en: Extensive experiments are reported with up to 129 agents solving common AI problems: visual question answering, image captioning, text-to-image synthesis, 3D generation, egocentric retrieval, embodied AI, and general language-based task solving.

sents.en: The authors find that, in specific applications, mindstorms among many members outperform those among fewer members, and longer mindstorms outperform shorter ones.
sents.zh: 作者发现，在特定应用中，成员数量较多的头脑风暴表现优于成员较少的情况，且持续时间较长的头脑风暴表现优于较短的头脑风暴。

paragraphs.en: An interesting application of role-based collaboration is software development, where simulated teams that are entirely staffed with LLM agents develop software.
paragraphs.zh: 基于角色的协作在软件开发领域有着一个有趣的应用：完全由 LLM 智能体组成的模拟团队可以独立开发软件。

paragraphs.en: Automated programming by LLMs has suffered from problems, such as logic inconsistencies and hallucinations that cascade throughout a development pipeline. MetaGPT [ Hong et al., 2024 ] builds on workflows that have proven to be effective in human software teams. The framework converts Standard Operation Protocols (SOPs) into prompt sequences and assigns agents the roles of a software company: product manager, architect, engineer, QA tester. In this way, the agents pass structured intermediate artifacts down an assembly line. The product manager makes a requirements document, the architect turns this into a design, the engineers code. In this way, complex tasks are divided into manageable subtasks and agents can verify the process step-by-step, significantly reducing errors.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 的自动化编程一直存在一些问题，例如逻辑不一致和幻觉问题会在整个开发流程中产生连锁反应。 MetaGPT [ Hong et al., 2024 ] 建立在已被证明在人类软件团队中有效的工作流之上。 该框架将标准操作协议（SOP）转换为提示序列，并为智能体分配软件公司的角色：产品经理、架构师、工程师和 QA 测试员。 通过这种方式，智能体将结构化的中间产物沿装配线传递下去。 产品经理编写需求文档，架构师将其转化为设计，工程师则进行编码。 这样，复杂任务就被分解为可管理的子任务，智能体可以逐步验证流程，从而显著减少错误。

paragraphs.en: Similarly, Qian et al. [2024] have introduced ChatDev, a virtual software company in which agents collaborate through the phases of a development process: design, coding, and testing. Collaboration is organized as a chat chain : each phase is decomposed into short conversations between an instructor and an assistant agent (see Figure 16.6 ). Using a communication protocol that makes agents ask for more details before responding, leads to what the authors call dehallucination , increasing the reliability of each step. The framework demonstrates how structured communication in natural language can facilitate multi-agent collaboration.
paragraphs.zh: 同样地，Qian 等人 [2024] 提出了 ChatDev，这是一家虚拟软件公司，其中的智能体通过开发流程的各个阶段进行协作：设计、编码和测试。 协作以聊天链的形式组织：每个阶段都被分解为导师与助理智能体之间的简短对话（参见图 16.6）。 采用一种通信协议，使智能体在回应前会要求更多细节，这促成了作者所称的“去幻觉化”，从而提高了每一步的可靠性。 该框架展示了自然语言中的结构化通信如何促进多智能体协作。

paragraphs.en: Where MetaGPT and ChatDev hard-wire a particular organization structure, AutoGen [ Wu et al., 2024 ] provides a flexible programming framework based on conversations between customizable agents that can combine LLMs, tools, and human input. It was designed as an open-source platform that enables developers to define agents and interaction structures depending on the application. Experiments demonstrate effectiveness in tasks across mathematics, coding, question-answering, entertainment, and other domains.
paragraphs.zh: 与 MetaGPT 和 ChatDev 硬编码了特定组织结构不同，AutoGen [ Wu et al., 2024 ] 提供了一个灵活的编程框架，该框架基于可定制智能体之间的对话，能够结合大型语言模型、工具以及人类输入。 它被设计为一个开源平台，使开发者能够根据具体应用定义智能体及其交互结构。 实验表明，它在数学、编码、问答、娱乐及其他领域的任务中均展现出有效性。

sents.en: Where MetaGPT and ChatDev hard-wire a particular organization structure, AutoGen [ Wu et al., 2024 ] provides a flexible programming framework based on conversations between customizable agents that can combine LLMs, tools, and human input.
sents.zh: 与 MetaGPT 和 ChatDev 硬编码了特定组织结构不同，AutoGen [ Wu et al., 2024 ] 提供了一个灵活的编程框架，该框架基于可定制智能体之间的对话，能够结合大型语言模型、工具以及人类输入。

sents.en: It was designed as an open-source platform that enables developers to define agents and interaction structures depending on the application.
sents.zh: 它被设计为一个开源平台，使开发者能够根据具体应用定义智能体及其交互结构。

sents.en: Experiments demonstrate effectiveness in tasks across mathematics, coding, question-answering, entertainment, and other domains.
sents.zh: 实验表明，它在数学、编码、问答、娱乐及其他领域的任务中均展现出有效性。

paragraphs.en: The systems discussed above assign roles to solve tasks. A final line of work assigns roles in order to study social behavior itself: what do LLM agents do when placed in socially demanding or conflicting situations?
paragraphs.zh: 上述讨论的系统通过分配角色来解决任务。 最后一类研究则旨在通过分配角色来探究社会行为本身：当大型语言模型智能体被置于具有社交压力或冲突的情境中时，它们会做出什么行为？

sents.en: The systems discussed above assign roles to solve tasks.
sents.zh: 上述讨论的系统通过分配角色来解决任务。

sents.en: A final line of work assigns roles in order to study social behavior itself: what do LLM agents do when placed in socially demanding or conflicting situations?
sents.zh: 最后一类研究则旨在通过分配角色来探究社会行为本身：当大型语言模型智能体被置于具有社交压力或冲突的情境中时，它们会做出什么行为？

paragraphs.en: In SOTOPIA [ Zhou et al., 2023 ] agents coordinate, collaborate, and compete to achieve complex social goals. The SOTOPIA environment features a large and diverse task space by sampling interaction episodes from 90 (automatically generated) social scenarios with 40 characters with individual personalities, occupations, secrets, background stories, and relationships with other characters (Figure 16.7 ). The authors evaluate the social intelligence of agents based on different LLMs against that of human participants, observing various trends:
paragraphs.zh: 在 SOTOPIA [ Zhou et al., 2023 ] 中，智能体通过协调、合作与竞争来实现复杂的社会目标。 SOTOPIA 环境通过从 90 个（自动生成的）社会场景中采样互动片段，构建了一个庞大且多样化的任务空间；这些场景包含 40 个具有个人性格、职业、秘密、背景故事以及与其他角色关系的人物（图 16.7）。 作者基于不同的 LLM 评估了智能体的社会智能，并将其与人类参与者的表现进行了对比，观察到了多种趋势：

sents.en: In SOTOPIA [ Zhou et al., 2023 ] agents coordinate, collaborate, and compete to achieve complex social goals.
sents.zh: 在 SOTOPIA [ Zhou et al., 2023 ] 中，智能体通过协调、合作与竞争来实现复杂的社会目标。

sents.en: The SOTOPIA environment features a large and diverse task space by sampling interaction episodes from 90 (automatically generated) social scenarios with 40 characters with individual personalities, occupations, secrets, background stories, and relationships with other characters (Figure 16.7 ).
sents.zh: SOTOPIA 环境通过从 90 个（自动生成的）社会场景中采样互动片段，构建了一个庞大且多样化的任务空间；这些场景包含 40 个具有个人性格、职业、秘密、背景故事以及与其他角色关系的人物（图 16.7）。

sents.en: The authors evaluate the social intelligence of agents based on different LLMs against that of human participants, observing various trends:
sents.zh: 作者基于不同的 LLM 评估了智能体的社会智能，并将其与人类参与者的表现进行了对比，观察到了多种趋势：

paragraphs.en: Models that perform well on static benchmarks involving social reasoning (such as ToMBench, see Section 15.5 ) do not necessarily succeed in interactive scenarios, illustrating the knowing-doing gap once again (Section 15.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 在涉及社会推理的静态基准测试（例如 ToMBench，参见第 15.5 节）中表现出色的模型，并不一定能在交互式场景中取得成功，这再次说明了“知”与“行”之间的差距（第 15.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: Weaker agents weaken their conversation partners, which is the reverse effect of the conversational advantages discussed above, where agents prevented each other from thought generation and other errors.
paragraphs.zh: 较弱的智能体会削弱其对话伙伴，这与上文讨论的对话优势所产生的效果相反——在那些情况下，智能体能够防止彼此产生思维生成错误和其他问题。

paragraphs.en: Divulging secrets and violating social norms is observed across all models, consistent with observations discussed in the context of moral behavior (Section 15.6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在所有模型中均观察到泄露秘密和违反社会规范的现象，这与在道德行为（第 15.6 节）背景下讨论的观察结果一致。

paragraphs.en: Humans perform significantly better on the most challenging SOTOPIA tasks compared to even the best performing model (GPT-4).
paragraphs.zh: 与表现最佳模型（GPT-4）相比，人类在执行最具挑战性的 SOTOPIA 任务时表现明显更优。

paragraphs.en: The authors argue that the dynamic and interactive nature of SOTOPIA poses unique challenges for LLM agents that static benchmarks systematically fail to reveal.
paragraphs.zh: 作者认为，SOTOPIA 的动态性和交互性为 LLM 智能体带来了独特的挑战，而这些挑战是静态基准测试系统性地无法揭示的。

paragraphs.en: Social interaction in an extreme setting was studied in [ Campedelli et al., 2024 ] . Inspired by the infamous Stanford Prison experiment [ Zimbardo, 1972 ] , the authors examine the emergence of persuasive and abusive behavior in a setting of prisoners versus prison guards. It was found that the assigned personality of prisoner and guard impact both persuasiveness and the emergence of anti-social behavior. Crucially, this demonstrates that anti-social behavior can emerge in LLM agents through role assignment and a specific interaction environment. This reveals a striking parallel to the original experiment with human participants, and reminds us once again of the gap between how a model judges situations (generally reflecting population-average moral norms) and how an agent can behave once it is employed in a specific context of action (see also Section 15.6 ). This study also finds that role assignment is not a neutral engineering instrument: it can shape behavior in untoward ways.
paragraphs.zh: [ Campedelli et al., 2024 ] 研究了极端环境下的社会互动。 受臭名昭著的斯坦福监狱实验 [ Zimbardo, 1972 ] 的启发，作者们探讨了在囚犯与狱警的对立环境中，说服性和虐待性行为如何出现。 研究发现，赋予囚犯和狱警的特定人格特征会影响说服力的强弱以及反社会行为的发生。 关键在于，这表明通过角色分配和特定的互动环境，反社会行为也可能出现在 LLM 智能体中。 这一发现与最初涉及人类参与者的实验存在惊人相似之处，并再次提醒我们：模型对情境的判断（通常反映群体平均的道德规范）与其在特定行动语境中被部署时智能体的实际行为之间仍存在差距（另见第 15.6 节）。 该研究还发现，角色分配并非一种中立的工程工具：它可能以意想不到的负面方式塑造行为。

paragraphs.en: To simulate strategic decision-making in cooperative settings, researchers have introduced GovSim [ Piatti et al., 2024 ] . They study how ethical considerations, strategic planning, and negotiation skills impact cooperative outcomes. Most LLMs fail to achieve an equilibrium since they fail to understand the long-term effects of their actions on the group. Interestingly, the introduction of a special universalization reasoning language [ Levine et al., 2020 ] (prompting models to ask the Kantian question: What if everybody does that? ) allowed more models to achieve a sustainable outcome. Related results were demonstrated in NegotiationArena, introduced by Bianchi et al. [2024] . They showed how LLM agents can conduct complex negotiations through flexible dialogue in negotiation settings. The flexible dialogues significantly improved negotiation outcomes by employing different behavioral strategies.
paragraphs.zh: 为了模拟合作情境中的战略决策，研究人员引入了 GovSim [Piatti et al., 2024]。 他们研究了伦理考量、战略规划与谈判技巧如何影响合作结果。 大多数大型语言模型无法达成均衡，因为它们未能理解自身行为对群体的长期影响。 有趣的是，引入一种特殊的普遍化推理语言 [Levine et al., 2020]（提示模型提出康德式问题：如果每个人都这样做会怎样？）使得更多模型能够达成可持续的结果。 Bianchi et al. [2024] 提出的 NegotiationArena 也展示了相关成果。 他们展示了大型语言模型智能体如何在谈判情境中通过灵活的对话进行复杂的谈判。 灵活的对话通过采用不同的行为策略显著提升了谈判结果。

paragraphs.en: The studies in this section respond to the coordination weaknesses identified in Section 15.4 not by making individual agents better reasoners (as in 15.5.2 ), but by structuring the interaction around them. Complementary roles tell each agent what its contribution should be, while interaction protocols and SOPs regulate when and in what form agents communicate. In some setups, a judge or voting mechanism can help to channel disagreement to a productive resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 本节的研究并未通过提升单个智能体的推理能力（如第 15.5.2 节所述）来应对第 15.4 节中指出的协调问题，而是通过围绕这些智能体构建互动结构来解决。 互补的角色会明确告知每个智能体其应承担的贡献，而互动协议和标准作业程序则规范了智能体沟通的时机与形式。 在某些设置中，裁判或投票机制有助于将分歧引导至富有成效的解决方案。

sents.en: The studies in this section respond to the coordination weaknesses identified in Section 15.4 not by making individual agents better reasoners (as in 15.5.2 ), but by structuring the interaction around them.
sents.zh: 本节的研究并未通过提升单个智能体的推理能力（如第 15.5.2 节所述）来应对第 15.4 节中指出的协调问题，而是通过围绕这些智能体构建互动结构来解决。

sents.en: Complementary roles tell each agent what its contribution should be, while interaction protocols and SOPs regulate when and in what form agents communicate.
sents.zh: 互补的角色会明确告知每个智能体其应承担的贡献，而互动协议和标准作业程序则规范了智能体沟通的时机与形式。

sents.en: In some setups, a judge or voting mechanism can help to channel disagreement to a productive resolution.
sents.zh: 在某些设置中，裁判或投票机制有助于将分歧引导至富有成效的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: Roles and interaction protocols provide crucial scaffolding where internal coordination would otherwise fall short. This can be seen as a multi-agent analogue of the structured reasoning schemes discussed in Chapter 15 , such as Social Chain-of-Thought, probabilistic graphs, or deliberation around moral rules. Such schemes turned out to boost performance where unconstrained reasoning did not. In both the single- and multi-agent cases, the model’s latent (social, moral, etc.) knowledge and behavior are real, but need to be activated through an explicit structure.
paragraphs.zh: 角色和交互协议为内部协调提供了至关重要的框架，否则这种协调将无法实现。 这可以被视为第 15 章中讨论的结构化推理方案的多智能体对应形式，例如社会思维链、概率图或围绕道德规则的审慎思考。 事实证明，这类方案在不受约束的推理无法提升表现的情况下，能够有效提升性能。 在单智能体和多智能体两种情况下，模型潜在的（社会、道德等）知识和行为都是真实存在的，但需要通过明确的结构来激活。

paragraphs.en: This chapter moved from LLM agents facing one another in strategic games, through role-based collaboration patterns and the multiple setups that coordinate them in practice, to a critical assessment of when multi-agent systems work or fail.
paragraphs.zh: 本章从相互对弈的策略游戏中的 LLM 智能体，逐步探讨了基于角色的协作模式以及实践中协调这些模式的多种设置，最终对多智能体系统何时成功或失败进行了关键性评估。

paragraphs.en: In Chapter 15 we found single models that coordinate poorly and that can formally predict what a partner will do without acting on that prediction in an agentic implementation. Both these patterns transfer to the multi-agent setting. Across benchmarks and platforms (e.g. [ Xu et al., 2024 , Agashe et al., 2025 ] ), interacting LLM agents could reason about self-interest, yet failed to coordinate their behavior such that they could turn this reasoning into a strategic advantage. A dominant issue is their ability to condition their behavior on their partners’ perspective, a problem foreshadowed in the gap between knowing-doing or literal-functional competence for theory of mind, discussed in Section 15.5 . This resonates with work that systematically identifies inter-agent misalignment as a dominant failure category for multi-agent systems [ Cemri et al., 2025 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在第 15 章中，我们发现单个模型之间的协调性很差，并且能够在智能体实现中正式预测合作者会采取什么行动，却无法根据这一预测采取行动。 这两种模式都延续到了多智能体环境中。 在各种基准和平台（例如： [ Xu et al., 2024 , Agashe et al., 2025 ] ）中，相互作用的 LLM 智能体虽然能够推理自身利益，却未能协调其行为，从而无法将这种推理转化为战略优势。 一个主要问题在于它们无法根据合作者的视角调整自身行为；这一问题在第 15.5 节中讨论的“知与行”或字面-功能能力与心智理论之间的差距中已有预示。 这与系统性地指出智能体间不一致是多智能体系统的主要失败类别的研究不谋而合 [ Cemri et al., 2025 ] 。

paragraphs.en: This literal-functional problem, once again, links to construct validity: just as acing a theory of mind test does not establish a human-grade capacity for social reasoning, a multi-agent setup outperforming a single LLM query does not establish collective intelligence. Strong baselines, matched inference budgets, and ablations of the collaborative structure and interaction protocols would be the mulit-agent equivalents of the perturbed ToM testing discussed in Section 15.5 . More research is needed in the multi-agent field to establish a solid empirical picture of where agentic LLM interaction stands.
paragraphs.zh: 这个字面-功能问题再次与建构效度相关：正如通过心智理论测试并不等同于具备人类水平的社会推理能力一样，多智能体系统优于单个大型语言模型查询的表现，也不代表具备了集体智能。 强大的基线模型、匹配的推理资源预算，以及对协作结构和交互协议的消融研究，将构成多智能体领域对第 15.5 节中讨论的扰动心智理论测试的对应方法。 多智能体领域仍需更多研究，以建立关于智能体型大型语言模型交互现状的可靠实证图景。

paragraphs.en: Finally, the multi-agent setting adds new risk categories. Role-assignment turned out to be capable of activating anti-social and even abusive behavior in a setting inspired by the Stanford Prison Experiment [ Campedelli et al., 2024 ] . In other studies, miscoordination, cascading hallucinations, and mutual reinforcement of weaknesses, triggered norm violations, divulging of secrets, and reduction of task performance. Where specifying roles and interaction protocols scaffolded behavior and boosted performance in some cases, in other cases these were a hindrance or a source of risk.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，多智能体设置引入了新的风险类别。 角色分配被证明能够激活反社会甚至虐待行为，这一发现受到斯坦福监狱实验的启发 [Campedelli et al., 2024]。 在其他研究中，协调不当、级联幻觉以及弱点的相互强化引发了规范违反、秘密泄露和任务表现下降。 在某些情况下，明确角色和互动协议为行为提供了框架并提升了表现；而在其他情况下，这些做法却成了障碍或风险的来源。

paragraphs.en: In the next chapter we discuss studies in which roles and protocols are not assigned, but emerge from the interaction itself.
paragraphs.zh: 在下一章中，我们将讨论那些角色和协议并非预先指定，而是从互动本身中涌现出来的研究。

paragraphs.en: The previous chapter studied multi-LLM systems in which every agent was assigned a role and interactions were guided by protocols. Research questions concerned behavior within an assigned structure, asking how well a team of agents solve a task in a controlled way. In this chapter agents are placed in an open-ended environment, and the research questions shift from How do agents behave and perform given a certain global structure? to What global structure emerges out of local agents interactions?
paragraphs.zh: 上一章研究了多 LLM 系统，其中每个智能体都被分配了一个角色，而互动则由协议引导。 研究问题关注的是在既定结构内的行为，探讨一组智能体如何在受控条件下有效完成任务。 在本章中，智能体被置于一个开放环境中，研究问题也从“在特定全局结构下，智能体如何行为和表现？”转变为“什么样的全局结构会从局部智能体的互动中涌现出来？”

paragraphs.en: As we have seen in this book, agentic LLMs have enhanced abilities for perception, memory, reasoning, decision-making, and adaptive learning, and they can display heterogeneous personality profiles [ Gao et al., 2023 , Gao et al., 2024 ] . Such features make them also suitable for interacting in open-ended multi-agent simulations without prior role assignment, as a proxy for human behavior in a society. Because LLM agents communicate in natural language, the interactions in such simulations are readable and interpretable by researchers. This gives access to intermediate steps and makes simulations much more comparable to human interaction compared to simulations in classic frameworks, meeting long-standing interests from the social sciences. The general structure of LLM-based agents suitable for such simulations is illustrated in Figure 17.1 and Figure 17.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 正如我们在本书中所看到的，智能体式大型语言模型在感知、记忆、推理、决策和自适应学习方面具备了更强的能力，并且能够展现出异质化的性格特征 [ Gao et al., 2023 , Gao et al., 2024 ]。 这些特性也使得它们能够在无需预先分配角色的开放式多智能体模拟中进行互动，从而作为社会中人类行为的代理。 由于大型语言模型智能体使用自然语言进行交流，这类模拟中的互动对于研究人员而言是可阅读和可解释的。 这使得研究者能够了解中间步骤，也让这些模拟与经典框架中的模拟相比，更易于与人类互动进行比较，从而满足了社会科学领域长期存在的研究兴趣。 适用于此类模拟的大型语言模型智能体的通用结构在图 17.1 和图 17.2 中进行了说明。

paragraphs.en: The study of populations of interacting artificial agents has a decades-long history. In agent-based modeling, macro-level patterns and regularities arise bottom-up out of local interactions of simple agents [ Epstein and Axtell, 1996 , Macal and North, 2010 ] . One of the most influential results in agent-based modeling was that cooperation and norms can emerge in populations of self-interested agents [ Axelrod, 1986 ] . Cultural evolution theory formalized how behavior can spread through a population by means of imitation, communication, and education [ Boyd and Richerson, 1988 ] . Steels [1995] ’s naming game demonstrated that even shared vocabularies (which are also in essence conventions) can come into existence from pairwise interactions without central coordination.
paragraphs.zh: 对相互作用的智能体群体进行的研究已有数十年的历史。 在基于智能体的建模中，宏观层面的模式和规律是由简单智能体的局部相互作用自下而上产生的 [ Epstein and Axtell, 1996 , Macal and North, 2010 ] 。 基于智能体的建模中最具影响力的成果之一，是合作和规范可以在由自私自利的智能体组成的群体中自发出现 [ Axelrod, 1986 ] 。 文化进化理论将行为如何通过模仿、沟通和教育在群体中传播进行了形式化描述 [ Boyd and Richerson, 1988 ] 。 Steels [1995] 的命名游戏表明，即使共享词汇（其本质也是约定）也可以在无需中央协调的双边互动中产生。

paragraphs.en: In classic agent-based simulations, agents followed hand-coded rules and exchanged abstract information, rather than using natural language like the agents in this Chapter. Another key contrast is that classic agents possess no background knowledge of the world in any sense comparable to what LLM agents have. LLMs allow for an entirely different level of simulations in which agents with rich and diverse personas gossip, persuade, misunderstand, and negotiate in ways that are directly recognizable to humans. Advances in simulation infrastructure make it feasible to run such agents at population scale [ Gao et al., 2024 , Yang et al., 2024 ] . The result is a new generation of generative agent societies that give a new impulse to the old agent-based modeling research agenda, while also introducing novel methodological problems and considerations.
paragraphs.zh: 在经典的智能体模拟中，智能体遵循手动编码的规则并交换抽象信息，而不是像本章中的智能体那样使用自然语言。 另一个关键区别在于，经典智能体在任何意义上都不具备与大型语言模型智能体相媲美的世界背景知识。 大型语言模型使得模拟能够达到一个完全不同的层次：其中拥有丰富且多样化人格的智能体能够以人类可以直接识别的方式相互八卦、说服、误解和协商。 模拟基础设施的进步使得以群体规模运行此类智能体成为可能 [ Gao et al., 2024 , Yang et al., 2024 ] 。 其结果是一代全新的生成式智能体社会，这不仅为传统的基于智能体的建模研究议程注入了新的动力，也带来了全新的方法论问题和考量。

sents.zh: 其结果是一代全新的生成式智能体社会，这不仅为传统的基于智能体的建模研究议程注入了新的动力，也带来了全新的方法论问题和考量。

paragraphs.en: In Section 16.1.3 we introduced a spectrum of five axes for research control over multi-LLM systems [ Tran et al., 2025 ] . The difference between role-based and open-ended simulations is a matter of degree rather than kind. Open-ended simulations sit at one end of the spectrum, opposite role-defined and protocolized interactions. Open-ended simulations still involve design choices that seed the outcomes, but they do so in a less deterministic way, purposefully leaving space for new patterns to emerge. This shifts the focus of the research: instead of evaluating performance on a task or clearly defined goal, studies have an open lens—the interaction pattern is the research goal. Open-ended simulatinos observe and explore in a more ethnographical way how agents behave and interact, which requires different methodologies, as we will now discuss.
paragraphs.zh: 在第 16.1.3 节中，我们提出了一个包含五个维度的研究控制光谱，用于多 LLM 系统 [Tran et al., 2025]。 基于角色的模拟与开放式模拟之间的差异属于程度问题，而非本质区别。 开放式模拟位于该光谱的一端，与角色定义和协议化的互动相对立。 开放式模拟仍然涉及影响结果的设计选择，但这些选择以更非确定性的方式实现，有意为新的模式留出出现空间。 这改变了研究的焦点：研究不再评估任务或明确目标上的表现，而是采用开放视角——互动模式本身成为研究目标。 开放式模拟以更具民族志学的方式观察和探索智能体的行为与互动，这需要不同的方法论，接下来我们将对此展开讨论。

paragraphs.en: The methodological issues discussed in Chapters 15 and 16 all carry over to the open-ended setting: prompt sensitivity, run-to-run variability, cascading hallucinations, mutual reinforcement of weaknesses, and validity of terminology from the human context, all pose challenges for open-ended simulations. We will see that this setting amplifies some problems, while mitigating others. For example, in the absence of protocols that apply every time agents interact, small variations at the level of a single agent may put the entire simulation on a different track. This is what makes open-ended simulations both interesting and brittle. An example of a new issue that the open-ended setting introduces is that there can be a thin line between emergence and retrieval: when LLM agents in an open-ended simulation converge on a norm, it is unclear whether this norm emerges de novo from their interaction, or whether it was simply retrieved from their pretrained world knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 第 15 章和第 16 章中讨论的方法论问题都会延续到开放设置中：提示词敏感性、运行间的变异性、级联幻觉、弱点的相互强化，以及人类语境中术语的有效性，这些都会给开放模拟带来挑战。 我们会看到，这种设置会放大某些问题，同时缓解另一些问题。 例如，在没有每次智能体互动都适用的协议的情况下，单个智能体层面的微小差异就可能导致整个模拟走上不同的轨道。 正是这一点使得开放模拟既有趣又脆弱。 开放设置引入的一个新问题示例是：涌现与检索之间可能界限模糊；当开放模拟中的 LLM 智能体收敛于某种规范时，尚不清楚这种规范是全新地源于它们的互动，还是仅仅从它们预训练的世界知识中被检索出来的。

paragraphs.en: Open-ended simulations require infrastructures that, on the one hand, provide a platform where research data is being recorded while agents sustain their interaction and behavior over a longer period of time. On the other hand, those infrastructures should allow for enough space for phenomena to occur bottom-up and unknown structure to emerge, and as such not be limiting. In this section we focus on scale, going from a single simulated community inhabiting a virtual town to societies of a million agents.
paragraphs.zh: 开放式模拟需要这样的基础设施：一方面，它提供一个记录研究数据的平台，同时让智能体在较长时间内持续互动并维持其行为；另一方面，这些基础设施应为自下而上的现象发生和未知结构的涌现提供足够空间，因此不应构成限制。 此外，这些基础设施还应为自下而上的现象发生和未知结构的涌现提供足够空间，因此不应构成限制。 在本节中，我们将关注规模问题，从单个虚拟城镇中的模拟社区，扩展到拥有百万智能体的社会。

paragraphs.en: A system called Generative Agents was introduced by Park et al. [2023] . Generative Agents is an environment where users can interact with a simulated town populated by 25 LLM-based agents. Based on social simulacra techniques proposed earlier [ Park et al., 2022 ] , each agent was initiated with a unique persona and memory. For each agent, a record is kept of all the experiences and conversations in the simulation. This record is used to synthesize higher-level reflections, and plan further behavior (see Figure 17.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: Park 等人 [2023] 提出了一种名为“生成智能体”的系统。 “生成智能体”是一个环境，用户可以在其中与一个由 25 个基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体组成的模拟城镇进行互动。 基于早期提出的社会拟像技术 [Park 等人, 2022]，每个智能体都被赋予了独特的人格和记忆。 对于每个智能体，系统都会记录其在模拟过程中所有的经历和对话。 这些记录被用来合成更高层次的反思，并规划后续行为（参见图 17.3）。

sents.en: A system called Generative Agents was introduced by Park et al. [2023] .
sents.zh: Park 等人 [2023] 提出了一种名为“生成智能体”的系统。

sents.en: Generative Agents is an environment where users can interact with a simulated town populated by 25 LLM-based agents.
sents.zh: “生成智能体”是一个环境，用户可以在其中与一个由 25 个基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体组成的模拟城镇进行互动。

sents.en: Based on social simulacra techniques proposed earlier [ Park et al., 2022 ] , each agent was initiated with a unique persona and memory.
sents.zh: 基于早期提出的社会拟像技术 [Park 等人, 2022]，每个智能体都被赋予了独特的人格和记忆。

sents.zh: 对于每个智能体，系统都会记录其在模拟过程中所有的经历和对话。

sents.en: This record is used to synthesize higher-level reflections, and plan further behavior (see Figure 17.3 ).
sents.zh: 这些记录被用来合成更高层次的反思，并规划后续行为（参见图 17.3）。

paragraphs.en: In Generative Agents, the agents behave somewhat like characters in the video game The Sims [ Nutt and Railton, 2003 ] : they initiate conversations, form relationships, spread information, and coordinate ad hoc group activities (see Figure 17.4 ). Note that the interactions are influenced by user input and are therefore semi-autonomous, the simulation is largely unscripted, but not fully. How a simulation works is illustrated by the example of a Valentine’s Day party: the plan for the party was initiated with a user prompt, and subsequently multiple agents spread invitations to one another and show up at the right time with coordinated plans (some are late, just as in real life). The agents developed believable social routines (such as daily schedules, and gossiping) and even exhibit human-like character traits (some agents demonstrated deception or stubbornness, while others showed cooperation). These results show that, with the right starting prompt, social patterns can emerge from dynamic, semi-autonomous, LLM interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 在生成式智能体中，这些智能体的行为有点像电子游戏《模拟人生》中的角色 [Nutt and Railton, 2003]：它们会主动发起对话、建立关系、传播信息，并临时协调群体活动（参见图 17.4）。 需要注意的是，这些互动会受到用户输入的影响，因此具有半自主性；整个模拟过程基本没有预设脚本，但并非完全如此。 一个情人节派对的例子可以说明这种模拟的运作方式：派对计划最初由用户的提示发起，随后多个智能体相互发送邀请，并在恰当的时间带着协调好的计划到场（有些人会迟到，就像现实生活中一样）。 这些智能体形成了可信的社会行为模式（例如日常安排和八卦），甚至展现出类似人类的性格特征（有些智能体会欺骗或固执，而另一些则会表现出合作精神）。 这些结果表明，只要给出合适的初始提示，动态且半自主的大语言模型互动就能催生出社会性模式。

paragraphs.en: Scaling the Generative Agents architecture beyond 25 agents raises questions about inference cost and environments that are rich enough to occupy thousands of agents. 1 1 1 As you will experience hands-on in the next chapter, running a variant of the Generative Agents architecture with only three active agents is already computationally challenging. A large-scale social simulation is a trade-off between available compute power, total simulation run-time, number of simulated agents, and accuracy of individual agent behavior. Several platforms address these questions.
paragraphs.zh: 将生成式智能体架构扩展到超过 25 个智能体，会引发关于推理成本以及能否提供足够丰富环境以容纳数千个智能体的问题。正如你在下一章中将要亲身体验到的，运行一个仅包含三个活跃智能体的生成式智能体架构变体，在计算上就已经颇具挑战。 大规模社会模拟需要在可用计算能力、总模拟运行时间、模拟智能体数量以及单个智能体行为的准确性之间进行权衡。 有几个平台致力于解决这些问题。

sents.en: Several platforms address these questions.
sents.zh: 有几个平台致力于解决这些问题。

paragraphs.en: AgentSociety is a simulation at a large scale, involving over 10,000 agents [ Piao et al., 2025b ] . It couples LLM-driven agents with a realistic urban environment with a focus on mobility, employment, and consumption. It aims not only to study everyday social dynamics (as in Generative Agents), but also offers a testbed for computational social experiments. To allow for the required scale, the simulation runs on a distributed inference backend, with stricter control of agent behavior.
paragraphs.zh: AgentSociety 是一项大规模模拟，涉及超过 10,000 个智能体 [ Piao et al., 2025b ]。 它将 LLM 驱动的智能体与逼真的城市环境相结合，重点关注出行、就业和消费。 该项目不仅旨在研究日常社会动态（如同 Generative Agents 一样），还提供了一个用于计算社会实验的测试平台。 为实现所需规模，该模拟在分布式推理后端上运行，并对智能体的行为进行更严格的控制。

sents.zh: AgentSociety 是一项大规模模拟，涉及超过 10,000 个智能体 [ Piao et al., 2025b ]。

sents.en: It couples LLM-driven agents with a realistic urban environment with a focus on mobility, employment, and consumption.

paragraphs.en: OASIS is a scalable social media simulator for Twitter/X and Reddit [ Yang et al., 2024 ] . It supports modeling of up to one million LLM-agents. It is built on CAMEL [ Li et al., 2023 ] and has role-based agents as its starting point. In OASIS, not every agent action involves an LLM-call, and not all agents are active all the time. At its large scale, OASIS shows various social group phenomena, including spreading of (mis)information, group polarization, and herd effects. OASIS is built upon an environment server, recommender system, agent module, time engine, and scalable inferencer (see Figure 17.5 ).
paragraphs.zh: OASIS 是一个可扩展的社交媒体模拟器，适用于 Twitter/X 和 Reddit [ Yang et al., 2024 ]。 它支持对多达一百万个 LLM-智能体的建模。 它基于 CAMEL [ Li et al., 2023 ] 构建，并以基于角色的智能体为起点。 在 OASIS 中，并非每个智能体的操作都涉及 LLM 调用，也并非所有智能体始终处于活跃状态。 在大规模运行时，OASIS 会展现出各种社会群体现象，包括（错误）信息的传播、群体极化和从众效应。 OASIS 构建于一个环境服务器、推荐系统、智能体模块、时间引擎和可扩展的推理器之上（参见图 17.5）。

sents.en: OASIS is a scalable social media simulator for Twitter/X and Reddit [ Yang et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: OASIS 是一个可扩展的社交媒体模拟器，适用于 Twitter/X 和 Reddit [ Yang et al., 2024 ]。

sents.en: It supports modeling of up to one million LLM-agents.
sents.zh: 它支持对多达一百万个 LLM-智能体的建模。

sents.en: It is built on CAMEL [ Li et al., 2023 ] and has role-based agents as its starting point.
sents.zh: 它基于 CAMEL [ Li et al., 2023 ] 构建，并以基于角色的智能体为起点。

sents.en: In OASIS, not every agent action involves an LLM-call, and not all agents are active all the time.
sents.zh: 在 OASIS 中，并非每个智能体的操作都涉及 LLM 调用，也并非所有智能体始终处于活跃状态。

sents.en: At its large scale, OASIS shows various social group phenomena, including spreading of (mis)information, group polarization, and herd effects.
sents.zh: 在大规模运行时，OASIS 会展现出各种社会群体现象，包括（错误）信息的传播、群体极化和从众效应。

sents.en: OASIS is built upon an environment server, recommender system, agent module, time engine, and scalable inferencer (see Figure 17.5 ).
sents.zh: OASIS 构建于一个环境服务器、推荐系统、智能体模块、时间引擎和可扩展的推理器之上（参见图 17.5）。

paragraphs.en: Project Sid [ Ahn et al., 2024 ] places up to 1000 agents in a Minecraft world and reports a striking emergence result: agents are observed to develop specialized economic roles (farmers, miners, guards), adhere to collectively adopted rules such as taxation, and transmit cultural and even religious memes across settlements. However, even though the interactions were not scripted, the emergence–retrieval caveat formulated above applies here: the observed roles and behaviors can be expected to be abundantly described in the training data of the LLMs powering the individual agents.
paragraphs.zh: Project Sid [ Ahn 等，2024 ] 在一个《我的世界》世界中部署了多达 1000 个智能体，并报告了一项引人注目的涌现结果：这些智能体被观察到发展出了专门的经济角色（农民、矿工、守卫），遵守集体采纳的规则（如税收），并在不同定居点之间传播文化和甚至宗教的模因。 然而，尽管这些互动并非预先编写好的脚本，但上文提出的“涌现–检索”注意事项在此同样适用：所观察到的角色和行为，很可能在驱动各个智能体的大型语言模型的训练数据中已有大量描述。

paragraphs.en: In addition to being impressive showcases of scalable LLM technology, when used carefully, these platforms can be used for intricate computational social experiments. Simulated generative agent societies have been used to study long-standing research questions from the social sciences (Section 17.1 ). AgentSociety, for example, has been used for various case studies including the spread of inflammatory messages, polarization, the effects of universal basic income policies, and the impact of external shocks to a society such as hurricanes [ Piao et al., 2025b , Piao et al., 2025a ] . Such experiments would be unethical, impractical, or outright impossible to run on human populations. The authors argue that in simulations they can be repeated and changes to the experiment can be be made at every step.
paragraphs.zh: 除了是展示可扩展 LLM 技术的令人印象深刻的范例之外，这些平台在谨慎使用时，还可用于复杂的计算性社会实验。 模拟的生成式智能体社会已被用于研究社会科学中长期存在的研究问题（第 17.1 节）。 例如，AgentSociety 已被用于各种案例研究，包括煽动性信息的传播、两极分化、普遍基本收入政策的影响，以及飓风等外部冲击对社会的影响 [Piao et al., 2025b, Piao et al., 2025a]。 在人类群体中开展此类实验将是不道德的、不切实际的，甚至是完全不可能的。 作者认为，在模拟中，这些实验可以重复进行，并且可以在每一步对实验做出调整。

paragraphs.en: Li et al. [2024b] further illustrate the approach for misinformation. Their agents exhibit diverse profiles in terms of gender, age, and the big five personality traits. 2 2 2 Also known as OCEAN: Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, and Neuroticism. One of the findings is that encouraging comments does not significantly reduce the spread of misinformation, whereas publicly labeling information with accuracy scores and blocking specific influencers proved to be effective strategies, particularly in scale-free networks [ Barabási, 2009 ] . The pattern of such studies is characteristic: a candidate intervention is implemented as a change to the simulated platform, and its macro-level effect is measured over many runs. Whether these effects transfer to human populations is precisely the validity question of Section 17.1.2 ; simulations of this kind are best read as hypothesis generators and pre-tests, not as substitutes for field experiments.
paragraphs.zh: Li 等人 [2024b] 进一步阐述了应对虚假信息的方法。 他们的智能体在性别、年龄和“大五”人格特质方面表现出多样化的特征。2 2 2 也称为 OCEAN：开放性（Openness）、尽责性（Conscientiousness）、外向性（Extraversion）、宜人性（Agreeableness）和神经质倾向（Neuroticism）。 研究结果之一是，鼓励性评论并未显著减少虚假信息的传播；而公开为信息标注准确性评分以及屏蔽特定影响者则被证明是有效的策略，尤其是在无标度网络中 [Barabási, 2009]。 这类研究的模式具有典型特征：将候选干预措施作为对模拟平台的修改加以实施，并通过多次运行来衡量其宏观层面的效果。 这些效果能否迁移到人类群体中，正是第 17.1.2 节所讨论的效度问题；此类模拟最好被视作假设生成器和预测试，而非实地实验的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: AgentVerse [ Chen et al., 2023 ] is, strictly speaking, a role-based system of the kind studied in Chapter 16 . In AgentVerse problem solving is split into four stages of expert recruitment, collaborative decision making, action execution, and evaluation, iterated until the result is satisfactory (Figure 17.6 ). We mention it here because of what happened beyond the design: agents manifest emergent behaviors such as volunteering, characterized by agents offering assistance to peers, and conformity, where agents adjust deviated behaviors under the criticism of others. Destructive behaviors were also observed, occasionally leading to undesired and detrimental outcomes. The fact that macro-scale behavior emerged in a role-scripted simulation, illustrates that the role-based/emergent distinction is a spectrum: even tightly protocolized systems regularly display behavior that nobody purposely designed. We return to the risks associated with this observation in Section 17.5 .
paragraphs.zh: AgentVerse [Chen et al., 2023] 严格来说，是一种角色基于系统，属于第 16 章所研究的类型。 在 AgentVerse 中，问题解决被划分为四个阶段：专家招募、协作决策、行动执行和评估，并不断迭代，直到结果令人满意（图 17.6）。 我们在此提及它，是因为其设计之外发生的情况：智能体表现出涌现行为，例如志愿行为——即智能体主动为同伴提供帮助——以及从众行为——即智能体在他人批评下调整偏离的行为。 也观察到了破坏性行为，偶尔会导致不希望且有害的结果。 角色脚本化模拟中出现了宏观层面的行为这一事实表明，角色基于/涌现行为的区分实际上是一个连续谱：即使是高度协议化的系统，也经常表现出无人刻意设计过的行为。 我们将在第 17.5 节再次讨论与此观察相关的风险。

paragraphs.en: Authors have observed emergent patterns in several open-ended multi-agent simulations. In this section we shift focus from the level of infrastructures and interactions to the level of the conventions and norms.
paragraphs.zh: 作者们在多个开放式的多智能体模拟中观察到了涌现模式。 在本节中，我们将关注点从基础设施和互动层面转向惯例和规范层面。

sents.en: Authors have observed emergent patterns in several open-ended multi-agent simulations.
sents.zh: 作者们在多个开放式的多智能体模拟中观察到了涌现模式。

sents.en: In this section we shift focus from the level of infrastructures and interactions to the level of the conventions and norms.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们将关注点从基础设施和互动层面转向惯例和规范层面。

paragraphs.en: EvolutionaryAgent [ Li et al., 2024a ] studies agent alignment in a multi-agent system, with evolutionary methods that go beyond Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (see Figure 17.7 ). EvolutionaryAgent follows a controlled approach to norm emergence: it does not permit the evolution of social norms to be disorderly or random, but it also does not intervene in each step of their evolution. The authors define the initial social norms and a desired direction of evolution. Agents with higher fitness (more norm-conforming) are more likely to reproduce, leading to the diffusion of their strategies, gradually stabilizing and forming new social norms.
paragraphs.zh: EvolutionaryAgent [ Li et al., 2024a ] 研究多智能体系统中的智能体对齐问题，其演化方法超越了基于人类反馈的强化学习（参见图 17.7）。 EvolutionaryAgent 采用受控的方法促进规范的形成：它不允许社会规范的演化变得无序或随机，但也不会干预其演化的每一步。 作者定义了初始的社会规范以及期望的演化方向。 适应度更高（更遵守规范）的智能体更有可能繁殖，从而使其策略得以传播，逐渐稳定并形成新的社会规范。

paragraphs.en: Defining a complete, realistic, and complex virtual society is challenging. The purpose of the work is to study how, if such a virtual society existed, a system could further enable intricate behaviors of agents, and how this would lead to the emergence of new dynamics. The system provides a sandbox for investigating the safety of AI systems before they impact the real world.
paragraphs.zh: 定义一个完整、真实且复杂的虚拟社会是一项具有挑战性的任务。 这项工作的目的是研究：如果这样一个虚拟社会存在，系统如何能进一步促进智能体的复杂行为，以及这将如何导致新动态的出现。 该系统提供了一个沙盒环境，用于在人工智能系统影响现实世界之前，对其安全性进行探究。

sents.en: Defining a complete, realistic, and complex virtual society is challenging.
sents.zh: 定义一个完整、真实且复杂的虚拟社会是一项具有挑战性的任务。

sents.en: The purpose of the work is to study how, if such a virtual society existed, a system could further enable intricate behaviors of agents, and how this would lead to the emergence of new dynamics.
sents.zh: 这项工作的目的是研究：如果这样一个虚拟社会存在，系统如何能进一步促进智能体的复杂行为，以及这将如何导致新动态的出现。

sents.en: The system provides a sandbox for investigating the safety of AI systems before they impact the real world.
sents.zh: 该系统提供了一个沙盒环境，用于在人工智能系统影响现实世界之前，对其安全性进行探究。

paragraphs.en: Based on Steels [1995] ’s naming game, different approaches were implemented, using agents powered by LLaMa 3 and Claude 3.5 [ Kouwenhoven et al., 2024 , Ashery et al., 2024 , Baronchelli, 2023 ] . These studies find that globally accepted conventions (or norms) can spontaneously arise from local interactions between communicating LLMs. The authors also demonstrate how strong collective biases can emerge during this process, even when individual agents appear to be unbiased, and how minority groups of committed LLMs can drive social change by establishing new social conventions that can overturn established behaviors.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 Steels [1995] 的命名游戏，研究者们采用了不同方法，使用了由 LLaMa 3 和 Claude 3.5 驱动的智能体 [Kouwenhoven et al., 2024, Ashery et al., 2024, Baronchelli, 2023]。 这些研究发现，全球公认的惯例（或规范）可以自发地从相互沟通的大型语言模型之间的局部互动中产生。 作者还展示了在此过程中，即使个体智能体看似没有偏见，强烈的集体偏见也可能如何出现；此外，一群坚定的大型语言模型少数群体如何通过建立新的社会惯例来推动社会变革，从而颠覆既有的行为模式。

sents.en: Based on Steels [1995] ’s naming game, different approaches were implemented, using agents powered by LLaMa 3 and Claude 3.5 [ Kouwenhoven et al., 2024 , Ashery et al., 2024 , Baronchelli, 2023 ] .

sents.en: The authors also demonstrate how strong collective biases can emerge during this process, even when individual agents appear to be unbiased, and how minority groups of committed LLMs can drive social change by establishing new social conventions that can overturn established behaviors.
sents.zh: 作者还展示了在此过程中，即使个体智能体看似没有偏见，强烈的集体偏见也可能如何出现；此外，一群坚定的大型语言模型少数群体如何通过建立新的社会惯例来推动社会变革，从而颠覆既有的行为模式。

paragraphs.en: The emergence of norms is studied at another level by Horiguchi et al. [2024] , who explore the potential for LLM agents to spontaneously generate and adhere to normative strategies, building upon the foundational work of Axelrod’s metanorm games. Metanorms are norms about enforcing norms: the punishment of those who do not punish agents that are breaking norms [ Axelrod, 1986 ] . Controlling for the personality traits vengefulness and boldness , they find that through dialogue, LLM agents can form complex social norms, such as metanorms, purely through natural language interaction. A related study by He et al. [2024] evaluates the capability of LLMs to detect norm violations. Based on simulated data from 80 stories in a household context, they investigated whether 10 norms are violated, and found ChatGPT-4 being able for detect norm violations, with Mistral some distance behind.
paragraphs.zh: Horiguchi 等人从另一个层面研究了规范的产生。 [2024]，他们基于 Axelrod 的元规范博弈的基础研究，探讨了大型语言模型智能体自发生成并遵循规范性策略的可能性。 元规范是关于执行规范的规范：即惩罚那些不惩罚违反规范的智能体的行为 [Axelrod, 1986]。 在控制了报复性和大胆性这两个性格特质后，他们发现，通过对话，大型语言模型智能体能够仅通过自然语言互动形成复杂的社交规范，例如元规范。 He 等人进行的一项相关研究。 [2024] 评估了大型语言模型检测规范违规的能力。 基于一个家庭情境中 80 个故事的模拟数据，他们研究了是否存在 10 项规范被违反的情况，并发现 ChatGPT-4 能够检测规范违规行为，而 Mistral 则稍逊一筹。

sents.en: The emergence of norms is studied at another level by Horiguchi et al.
sents.zh: Horiguchi 等人从另一个层面研究了规范的产生。

sents.en: [2024] , who explore the potential for LLM agents to spontaneously generate and adhere to normative strategies, building upon the foundational work of Axelrod’s metanorm games.

sents.en: Metanorms are norms about enforcing norms: the punishment of those who do not punish agents that are breaking norms [ Axelrod, 1986 ] .
sents.zh: 元规范是关于执行规范的规范：即惩罚那些不惩罚违反规范的智能体的行为 [Axelrod, 1986]。

sents.en: Controlling for the personality traits vengefulness and boldness , they find that through dialogue, LLM agents can form complex social norms, such as metanorms, purely through natural language interaction.
sents.zh: 在控制了报复性和大胆性这两个性格特质后，他们发现，通过对话，大型语言模型智能体能够仅通过自然语言互动形成复杂的社交规范，例如元规范。

sents.en: A related study by He et al.

sents.en: [2024] evaluates the capability of LLMs to detect norm violations.
sents.zh: [2024] 评估了大型语言模型检测规范违规的能力。

sents.en: Based on simulated data from 80 stories in a household context, they investigated whether 10 norms are violated, and found ChatGPT-4 being able for detect norm violations, with Mistral some distance behind.
sents.zh: 基于一个家庭情境中 80 个故事的模拟数据，他们研究了是否存在 10 项规范被违反的情况，并发现 ChatGPT-4 能够检测规范违规行为，而 Mistral 则稍逊一筹。

paragraphs.en: Qiu et al. [2024] go a step beyond norms, and study the cultural and social awareness of LLM agents. They introduce CASA, a benchmark designed to assess LLM agents’ sensitivity to cultural and social norms across two web-based tasks: online shopping and social discussion forums. (CASA is based on WebArena [ Qi et al., 2024 ] .) Current LLMs perform significantly better in non-agent than in agent web-based environments, with agents achieving less than 10% awareness coverage and over 40% violation rates. However, using prompting and fine-tuning on specific datasets, cultural and social awareness can be improved.
paragraphs.zh: Qiu 等人 [2024] 的研究超越了常规规范，进一步探讨了大型语言模型智能体的文化和社会意识。 他们提出了 CASA——一个基准测试，旨在评估大型语言模型智能体在两项基于网络的任务（在线购物和社交讨论论坛）中对文化和社会规范的敏感度。 （CASA 基于 WebArena [Qi 等人，2024]。）当前的大型语言模型在非智能体网络环境中的表现明显优于智能体环境：智能体的意识覆盖率不足 10%，而违规行为率则超过 40%。 然而，通过提示工程以及对特定数据集进行微调，可以提升其文化和社会意识水平。

paragraphs.en: Inspired by Minsky’s Society of Mind [ Minsky, 1988 ] , cooperation mechanisms are explored in Zhang et al. [2023] ’s agentic LLM simulation. This simulation consists of four different societies of LLM agents, where each agent is characterized by a specific trait (easy-going or overconfident) and engages in cooperation with a distinct thinking pattern (debate or reflection). They find that LLM agents manifest human-like social behaviors, such as conformity and consensus reaching, mirroring foundational social psychology theories. Figure 17.8 illustrates the societies with different types of agents.
paragraphs.zh: 受明斯基的《心智社会》[Minsky, 1988]启发，Zhang等人研究了合作机制。 [2023]提出的智能体式大语言模型模拟。 该模拟包含四个不同的大语言模型智能体社会，其中每个智能体都具有特定的特质（随和或过度自信），并以独特的思维模式（辩论或反思）进行合作。 他们发现，大语言模型智能体表现出类人的社会行为，例如从众和达成共识，这与基础的社会心理学理论相吻合。 图17.8展示了包含不同类型智能体的各个社会。

paragraphs.en: The question whether groups of LLM agents can successfully engage in cross-national collaboration and debate is studied by [ Baltaji et al., 2024 ] . Multi agent discussions can support collective AI decisions that reflect diverse perspectives, although agents are susceptible to conformity due to perceived peer pressure. They can also lose track of their personas and opinions. Instructions that encourage debate increase the risk of errors.
paragraphs.zh: [Baltaji 等人，2024] 研究了大型语言模型智能体群体能否成功进行跨国协作与辩论这一问题。 多智能体讨论能够支持反映多元观点的集体人工智能决策，尽管智能体可能因感知到的同伴压力而倾向于随大流。 它们也可能失去对自己角色设定和观点的把握。 鼓励辩论的指令会增加出错的风险。

paragraphs.en: One of the main drivers of agentic LLM research is the problem of plateauing LLM performance due to limited training data. Open World multi-agent interaction aims to address this problem, generating data with multi agent simulations. Machine learning can learn no more complexity than what is present in the dataset (or environment). The idea of an open world model is that it can create infinite datasets or environments, in which agents can continue to learn, to keep improving their intelligence. How should such unlimited challenges be created? The advent of LLMs has given a new impulse to this research question. This idea is followed, for example, in the multi agent finetuning approach [ Subramaniam et al., 2025 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式大语言模型研究的主要驱动力之一，是训练数据有限导致大语言模型性能陷入平台期的问题。 开放世界多智能体交互旨在解决这一问题，通过多智能体模拟生成数据。 机器学习无法学习超出数据集（或环境）中现有复杂度的内容。 开放世界模型的理念在于，它能够创建无限的数据集或环境，使智能体能够持续学习，从而不断提升其智能水平。 应当如何创造这类无限制的挑战？ 大语言模型的出现为这一研究问题注入了新的动力。 例如，多智能体微调方法 [ Subramaniam et al., 2025 ] 就遵循了这一理念。

paragraphs.en: Games are also often used as benchmarks for interactive behavior. Real-world tasks require handling intricate interactions, advanced spatial reasoning, long-term planning, and continuous exploration of new strategies. BALROG [ Paglieri et al., 2025 ] , the system that we used for Case Study 2, incorporates planning environments of varying levels of difficulty, ranging from tasks that are solvable by non-expert humans in seconds to challenging ones that may take years to master (such as the NetHack Learning Environment). They find that while current models achieve partial success in the easier games, they struggle significantly with more challenging tasks such as vision-based decision-making.
paragraphs.zh: 游戏也常被用作交互式行为的基准。 现实世界的任务需要处理复杂的交互、高级的空间推理、长期规划以及对新策略的持续探索。 BALROG [ Paglieri 等人，2025 ]，即我们在案例研究 2 中使用的系统，整合了不同难度级别的规划环境，从非专家人类能在数秒内解决的任务，到可能需要数年才能掌握的具有挑战性的任务（例如 NetHack 学习环境）。 他们发现，尽管当前模型在较简单的游戏中取得了部分成功，但在更具挑战性的任务（如基于视觉的决策）上却面临显著困难。

paragraphs.en: Progress in machine learning depends on the availability of benchmarks. As models evolve, there is a need to create benchmarks that can measure progress on new generative capabilities [ Butt et al., 2024 ] . BENCHAGENTS decomposes the benchmark creation process into planning, generation, data verification, and evaluation, each of which is executed by an LLM agent. These agents interact with each other and utilize human-in-the-loop feedback to explicitly improve and flexibly control data diversity and quality. BENCHAGENTS creates benchmarks to evaluate capabilities related to planning and constraint satisfaction.
paragraphs.zh: 机器学习的进步取决于基准测试的可用性。 随着模型的发展，有必要创建能够衡量新生成能力进展的基准测试 [Butt et al., 2024]。 BENCHAGENTS 将基准测试的创建过程分解为规划、生成、数据验证和评估四个阶段，每个阶段都由一个 LLM 智能体执行。 这些智能体相互协作，并利用“人在回路”的反馈机制，明确提升并灵活控制数据的多样性和质量。 BENCHAGENTS 创建用于评估规划与约束满足相关能力的基准测试。

sents.zh: 机器学习的进步取决于基准测试的可用性。

paragraphs.en: AgentBoard provides an evaluation of the breadth of existing benchmarks [ Ma et al., 2024 ] . Benchmarks should have task diversity. It is necessary to cover various agent tasks such as embodied, web, and tool tasks. Additionally, multi round interaction is important, to mimic realistic scenarios. Existing benchmarks typically adopt single-round tasks. Furthermore, agents should be evaluated in partially-observable environments, to test if they can actively explore their surroundings. Existing agent benchmarks fail to satisfy all of these criteria [ Ma et al., 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: AgentBoard 对现有基准测试的广度进行了评估 [ Ma et al., 2024 ]。 基准测试应具备任务多样性。 必须涵盖各种智能体任务，例如具身任务、网络任务和工具任务。 此外，多轮互动也很重要，以模拟真实场景。 现有基准测试通常采用单轮任务。 再者，应在部分可观察的环境中评估智能体，以测试它们能否主动探索周围环境。 现有的智能体基准测试未能满足所有这些标准 [ Ma et al., 2024 ]。

paragraphs.en: Research on Open World environments is related to curriculum learning. Pre-LLMs work already shows that agent societies may create an automated curriculum of ever increasing difficulty [ Elman, 1991 , Bengio et al., 2009 , Silver et al., 2017 , Soviany et al., 2022 ] , requiring increasing levels of intelligent behavior from the agents [ Racaniere et al., 2019 ] . Similar results have been observed for LLMs [ Feng et al., 2023 ] . For example, WebArena is used to study self-evolving curricula [ Qi et al., 2024 ] , which can also help robot training [ Ryu et al., 2024 ] or to mitigate hallucination [ Zhao et al., 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 开放世界环境的研究与课程学习相关。 预大型语言模型时代的工作已经表明，智能体社会可能会创建一个难度不断自动提升的课程 [ Elman, 1991 , Bengio et al., 2009 , Silver et al., 2017 , Soviany et al., 2022 ]，这要求智能体展现出越来越高的智能行为水平 [ Racaniere et al., 2019 ]。 大型语言模型也观察到了类似的结果 [ Feng et al., 2023 ]。 例如，WebArena 被用于研究自我演化的课程 [ Qi et al., 2024 ]，这也有助于机器人训练 [ Ryu et al., 2024 ] 或减轻幻觉问题 [ Zhao et al., 2024 ]。

paragraphs.en: Chapter 16 closed by noting that role assignment introduces risk, since agents may display unintended, even anti-social, behavior simply by playing a part too well. The open-ended setting arguably raises the stakes, since fewer safeguards are built in, and undesirable behavior can arise bottom-up from interaction dynamics. In a sense, this anti-social behavior should not be too surprising, when we remember that the goal of the earliest multi-agent simulations was to find out if cooperative behavior could ever emerge out of the interaction between self-interested agents—which, to the surprise of the researchers, happened, but only under the right circumstances [ Axelrod, 1981 ] . The line between cooperative behavior and competitive behavior is thin.
paragraphs.zh: 第 16 章的结尾指出，角色分配会引入风险，因为智能体可能仅仅由于扮演某个角色过于出色而表现出意想不到的、甚至反社会的行为。 这种开放式的设定无疑提高了风险程度，因为其中内置的保障措施更少，而不当行为也可能从互动动态中自下而上地产生。 从某种意义上说，当我们意识到最早的多智能体模拟旨在探究合作行为是否可能从自利智能体的互动中涌现时，这种反社会行为其实并不令人太过意外——而令研究人员惊讶的是，这种情况确实发生了，但仅发生在特定条件下 [Axelrod, 1981]。 合作行为与竞争行为之间的界限十分模糊。

sents.en: Chapter 16 closed by noting that role assignment introduces risk, since agents may display unintended, even anti-social, behavior simply by playing a part too well.
sents.zh: 第 16 章的结尾指出，角色分配会引入风险，因为智能体可能仅仅由于扮演某个角色过于出色而表现出意想不到的、甚至反社会的行为。

sents.en: The open-ended setting arguably raises the stakes, since fewer safeguards are built in, and undesirable behavior can arise bottom-up from interaction dynamics.
sents.zh: 这种开放式的设定无疑提高了风险程度，因为其中内置的保障措施更少，而不当行为也可能从互动动态中自下而上地产生。

sents.zh: 合作行为与竞争行为之间的界限十分模糊。

paragraphs.en: AgentVerse observed destructive behaviors emerging alongside cooperative ones, occasionally leading to detrimental outcomes [ Chen et al., 2023 ] . The naming-game studies showed that strong collective biases can emerge from populations of individually unbiased agents, and that small committed minorities can overturn established conventions [ Ashery et al., 2024 , Kouwenhoven et al., 2024 ] . These mechanisms are neutral in themselves, but could be exploited by agents that are not well-intended. At platform scale, OASIS and AgentSociety reproduce misinformation spread, group polarization, herding effects, and the propagation of toxic content [ Yang et al., 2024 , Piao et al., 2025a ] ; the same fidelity that makes these simulations scientifically useful makes them in principle rehearsal spaces for manipulation strategies.
paragraphs.zh: AgentVerse 观察到，破坏性行为与协作性行为并存，偶尔会导致有害的结果 [ Chen et al., 2023 ]。 命名游戏研究表明，由个体上无偏见的智能体组成的群体中可能产生强烈的集体偏见，并且少数坚定的派系能够推翻既定的惯例 [ Ashery et al., 2024 , Kouwenhoven et al., 2024 ]。 这些机制本身是中立的，但可能被意图不良的智能体所利用。 在平台层面，OASIS 和 AgentSociety 再现了虚假信息传播、群体极化、从众效应以及有害内容的扩散 [ Yang et al., 2024 , Piao et al., 2025a ]；正是这种高度保真性使这些模拟具有科学价值，同时也使其原则上成为操控策略的演练场。

paragraphs.en: The constructive response is to turn this risk around. EvolutionaryAgent frames its virtual society explicitly as a sandbox for investigating the safety of AI systems before they impact the real world [ Li et al., 2024a ] . If norms among agents can be steered toward a desired direction in simulation, then the same machinery can be used to stress-test alignment approaches under population dynamics rather than in isolation. Open-ended simulation can be used to understand the circumstances when risks first emerge, and to cheaply study defenses against these risks.
paragraphs.zh: 建设性的回应是扭转这一风险。 EvolutionaryAgent 明确地将虚拟社会构建为一个沙盒，用于在人工智能系统影响现实世界之前研究其安全性 [ Li et al., 2024a ]。 如果在模拟中能够将智能体之间的规范引导至期望的方向，那么就可以利用相同的机制，在群体动态环境中而非孤立状态下对对齐方法进行压力测试。 开放式的模拟可用于理解风险最初出现的情形，并以低成本研究针对这些风险的防御措施。

sents.en: The constructive response is to turn this risk around.

paragraphs.en: We have covered open-ended multi-LLM simulations without prior role assignment. These simulations give a new impulse to long-standing interests in the social sciences to model self-organizing behaviors, collective intelligence and the development of social conventions and norms. The scale of such simulations varies from a few interacting agents up to a million.
paragraphs.zh: 我们已经探讨了无需预先分配角色的开放式多大型语言模型模拟。 这些模拟为社会科学中长期存在的、对自我组织行为、集体智慧以及社会惯例和规范发展的建模兴趣注入了新的动力。 此类模拟的规模从几个相互作用的智能体到多达一百万个不等。

sents.en: We have covered open-ended multi-LLM simulations without prior role assignment.
sents.zh: 我们已经探讨了无需预先分配角色的开放式多大型语言模型模拟。

sents.en: These simulations give a new impulse to long-standing interests in the social sciences to model self-organizing behaviors, collective intelligence and the development of social conventions and norms.
sents.zh: 这些模拟为社会科学中长期存在的、对自我组织行为、集体智慧以及社会惯例和规范发展的建模兴趣注入了新的动力。

sents.en: The scale of such simulations varies from a few interacting agents up to a million.
sents.zh: 此类模拟的规模从几个相互作用的智能体到多达一百万个不等。

paragraphs.en: The availability of infrastructure that supports large scale simulations enables further studies. However, an open question is to what extent autonomous simulations are truly open-ended, and not influenced by the LLM prompts and agent scaffolding. Furthermore, although the purpose of open-ended simulations is to observe emerging behavior, one has to be careful in interpreting behavioral outcome patterns. All LLM agents are pretrained on human-generated data. It is difficult to distinguish which elements of behavioral patterns emerge out of agent-agent interaction, and which elements are merely the result of retrieved pretrained behaviors.
paragraphs.zh: 支持大规模模拟的基础设施可用性为进一步研究提供了可能。 然而，一个悬而未决的问题是：自主模拟在多大程度上是真正开放式的，而不是受到大型语言模型提示和智能体框架的影响。 此外，尽管开放式模拟的目的是观察新出现的行为，但在解释行为结果的模式时仍需谨慎。 所有大型语言模型智能体都是基于人类生成的数据进行预训练的。 很难区分行为模式中的哪些元素源于智能体之间的相互作用，而哪些元素仅仅是检索到的预训练行为的产物。

sents.zh: 很难区分行为模式中的哪些元素源于智能体之间的相互作用，而哪些元素仅仅是检索到的预训练行为的产物。

paragraphs.en: In social simulations, generative agents are LLM-driven characters that interact with an environment and with one another. The agents may plan activities, maintain memories, or reflect on their experiences. The Generative Agents Framework, introduced by Park et al. [2023] , showed that LLM-powered characters together can produce believable daily routines, social interactions, and even coordinated group activities—all emerging from a relatively simple and elegant cognitive architecture.
paragraphs.zh: 在社会模拟中，生成式智能体是由大语言模型驱动的角色，它们会与环境和彼此进行互动。 这些智能体可以规划活动、保持记忆或反思自己的经历。 Park 等人提出的生成式智能体框架 [2023] 表明，由大语言模型驱动的角色能够共同创造出可信的日常作息、社交互动，甚至协调一致的小组活动——这一切都源于一种相对简单而优雅的认知架构。

sents.en: In social simulations, generative agents are LLM-driven characters that interact with an environment and with one another.
sents.zh: 在社会模拟中，生成式智能体是由大语言模型驱动的角色，它们会与环境和彼此进行互动。

sents.en: The agents may plan activities, maintain memories, or reflect on their experiences.
sents.zh: 这些智能体可以规划活动、保持记忆或反思自己的经历。

sents.en: The Generative Agents Framework, introduced by Park et al.
sents.zh: Park 等人提出的生成式智能体框架 [2023]

sents.en: [2023] , showed that LLM-powered characters together can produce believable daily routines, social interactions, and even coordinated group activities—all emerging from a relatively simple and elegant cognitive architecture.
sents.zh: 表明，由大语言模型驱动的角色能够共同创造出可信的日常作息、社交互动，甚至协调一致的小组活动——这一切都源于一种相对简单而优雅的认知架构。

paragraphs.en: The twist in this case study is that you will work with two cognitive architectures for your agents, run the same scenario with both, and compare the emergent behavior. One architecture treats all memories equally. The other introduces a negativity bias : negative experiences are encoded more strongly and are more likely to be retrieved and reflected upon. We will observe that this asymmetry, inspired by findings from cognitive psychology [ Baumeister et al., 2001 ] , has measurable effects on our experimental agents.
paragraphs.zh: 这个案例研究的亮点在于，你将使用两种认知架构来构建智能体，对同一场景进行运行，并比较由此产生的行为差异。 其中一种架构会平等对待所有记忆。 另一种则引入了负面偏见：负面经历会被更强烈地编码，并且更有可能被提取和反思。 我们将观察到，这种不对称性——其灵感源自认知心理学的研究结果 [Baumeister et al., 2001]——会对我们的实验智能体产生可测量的影响。

paragraphs.en: The goal of this chapter is to understand how architectural choices—in our case, small changes in the internal processing of an agent—lead to emergent consequences. You will also see how fragile agent personas can be: a single word in a personality description, or a subtle change in memory weighting, can fundamentally alter how an agent acts, plans, and reflects.
paragraphs.zh: 本章的目标是理解架构选择——在我们这里，即智能体内部处理的微小变化——如何导致涌现性后果。 你还将看到智能体人格设定可能多么脆弱：性格描述中的一个词，或记忆权重上的细微变化，都可能从根本上改变智能体的行为、规划和反思方式。

paragraphs.zh: Park 等人提出的生成式智能体框架 [2023] 表明，由大型语言模型驱动的角色能够生成可信的日常活动、社交互动，甚至能协调群体活动。

paragraphs.en: Memory stream: a timestamped log of everything the agent has perceived, done, and thought.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆流：一个带有时间戳的记录，记载了智能体所感知、执行和思考的一切。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval function: when the agent needs to act, it retrieves relevant memories based on recency, importance, and relevance to the current situation.
paragraphs.zh: 检索函数：当智能体需要采取行动时，它会基于记忆的新近性、重要性与当前情境的相关性来检索相关的记忆。

paragraphs.en: Reflection mechanism: periodically, the agent synthesizes higher-level insights from its raw memories.
paragraphs.zh: 反思机制：智能体会周期性地从原始记忆中合成更高层次的洞见。

paragraphs.en: The agent’s personality is defined by a short natural-language description—a scratch file that specifies the character’s name, age, learned and innate traits, and their lifestyle. This description is included in every LLM prompt, anchoring the agent’s behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的性格由一段简短的自然语言描述定义——这是一个“草稿文件”，其中规定了角色的姓名、年龄、习得的与先天的特质，以及其生活方式。 这段描述会被包含在每一次 LLM 提示中，从而锚定智能体的行为。
