sents.zh: 智能体的性格由一段简短的自然语言描述定义——这是一个“草稿文件”，其中规定了角色的姓名、年龄、习得的与先天的特质，以及其生活方式。

sents.en: This description is included in every LLM prompt, anchoring the agent’s behavior.
sents.zh: 这段描述会被包含在每一次 LLM 提示中，从而锚定智能体的行为。

paragraphs.en: When an LLM-powered agent embedded in the original Generative Agents simulation receives criticism, it forms a memory. When praised an hour later, it forms another memory. Generative agents retrieve the two memories—one negative and one positive—with identical priority, as long as they are equally recent, equally relevant, and equally important.
paragraphs.zh: 当嵌入原始生成智能体模拟中的基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体受到批评时，它会形成一段记忆。 当一个小时之后它受到表扬时，又会形成另一段记忆。 只要两段记忆的时间相近程度、相关性和重要性相同，生成智能体就会以完全相同的优先级检索这两段记忆——一段负面，一段正面。

sents.en: When an LLM-powered agent embedded in the original Generative Agents simulation receives criticism, it forms a memory.
sents.zh: 当嵌入原始生成智能体模拟中的基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体受到批评时，它会形成一段记忆。

sents.en: When praised an hour later, it forms another memory.
sents.zh: 当一个小时之后它受到表扬时，又会形成另一段记忆。

sents.en: Generative agents retrieve the two memories—one negative and one positive—with identical priority, as long as they are equally recent, equally relevant, and equally important.
sents.zh: 只要两段记忆的时间相近程度、相关性和重要性相同，生成智能体就会以完全相同的优先级检索这两段记忆——一段负面，一段正面。

paragraphs.en: In general, cognitive architectures for agent-based social simulations draw on cognitive science to produce believable behavior. The recency, relevance, and importance variables are loosely inspired by insights about memory retrieval in humans. The importance variable captures something akin to the arousal or salience of an event. However, in the original simulation [ Park et al., 2022 ] the memory system is effectively valence-blind: all memories—positive, negative, neutral—are encoded and retrieved with equal weight. If the agent were human, it would treat the negatively valenced event differently: encoding it with sharper sensory detail, retrieving it with greater vividness, and rendering it more likely to resurface in subsequent thoughts. Psychological studies find that people remember insults longer than compliments. A single bad interaction with a colleague can outweigh weeks of pleasant ones. In other words, in our psychology bad is stronger than good [ Baumeister et al., 2001 ] , and this asymmetry is nowhere more consequential than in memory.
paragraphs.zh: 通常，基于智能体的社会模拟所采用的认知架构会借鉴认知科学的成果，以生成可信的行为。 近期性、相关性和重要性这三个变量大致受到人类记忆提取机制相关研究的启发。 重要性变量捕捉的是一种类似于事件唤醒度或显著性的特征。 然而，在原始模拟 [ Park et al., 2022 ] 中，记忆系统实际上对情绪价值是盲目的：所有记忆——无论是积极的、消极的还是中立的——都以相同的权重进行编码和提取。 如果该智能体是人类，它会对具有负面情绪价值的事件做出不同处理：用更清晰的感官细节进行编码，以更生动的形式进行提取，并使其更有可能在后续思维中再次出现。 心理学研究发现，人们记住侮辱性言论的时间比记住赞美之词更长。 与同事之间一次糟糕的互动就可能盖过数周愉快的互动所带来的影响。 换言之，在我们的心理学研究中，负面因素比正面因素更具影响力 [ Baumeister et al., 2001 ]，而这种不对称性在记忆领域表现得尤为显著。

sents.en: In general, cognitive architectures for agent-based social simulations draw on cognitive science to produce believable behavior.
sents.zh: 通常，基于智能体的社会模拟所采用的认知架构会借鉴认知科学的成果，以生成可信的行为。

sents.en: The recency, relevance, and importance variables are loosely inspired by insights about memory retrieval in humans.
sents.zh: 近期性、相关性和重要性这三个变量大致受到人类记忆提取机制相关研究的启发。

sents.en: The importance variable captures something akin to the arousal or salience of an event.
sents.zh: 重要性变量捕捉的是一种类似于事件唤醒度或显著性的特征。

sents.en: However, in the original simulation [ Park et al., 2022 ] the memory system is effectively valence-blind: all memories—positive, negative, neutral—are encoded and retrieved with equal weight.
sents.zh: 然而，在原始模拟 [ Park et al., 2022 ] 中，记忆系统实际上对情绪价值是盲目的：所有记忆——无论是积极的、消极的还是中立的——都以相同的权重进行编码和提取。

sents.en: If the agent were human, it would treat the negatively valenced event differently: encoding it with sharper sensory detail, retrieving it with greater vividness, and rendering it more likely to resurface in subsequent thoughts.
sents.zh: 如果该智能体是人类，它会对具有负面情绪价值的事件做出不同处理：用更清晰的感官细节进行编码，以更生动的形式进行提取，并使其更有可能在后续思维中再次出现。

sents.en: Psychological studies find that people remember insults longer than compliments.
sents.zh: 心理学研究发现，人们记住侮辱性言论的时间比记住赞美之词更长。

sents.en: A single bad interaction with a colleague can outweigh weeks of pleasant ones.
sents.zh: 与同事之间一次糟糕的互动就可能盖过数周愉快的互动所带来的影响。

sents.en: In other words, in our psychology bad is stronger than good [ Baumeister et al., 2001 ] , and this asymmetry is nowhere more consequential than in memory.
sents.zh: 换言之，在我们的心理学研究中，负面因素比正面因素更具影响力 [ Baumeister et al., 2001 ]，而这种不对称性在记忆领域表现得尤为显著。

paragraphs.en: In this case study, we test the effect of implementing the NEVER (Negative Emotional Valence Enhances Recapitulation) model, a more human-like mechanism for memory retrieval. In the NEVER-augmented agent, negative memories receive higher importance scores at encoding time. As a consequence, they are more likely to be retrieved and more likely to trigger reflections.
paragraphs.zh: 在本案例研究中，我们测试了实施 NEVER（Negative Emotional Valence Enhances Recapitulation）模型的效果，该模型是一种更类人化的记忆提取机制。 在经过 NEVER 增强的智能体中，负面记忆在编码时会获得更高的重要性评分。 因此，这些记忆被提取的可能性更高，也更有可能引发反思。

sents.en: In this case study, we test the effect of implementing the NEVER (Negative Emotional Valence Enhances Recapitulation) model, a more human-like mechanism for memory retrieval.
sents.zh: 在本案例研究中，我们测试了实施 NEVER（Negative Emotional Valence Enhances Recapitulation）模型的效果，该模型是一种更类人化的记忆提取机制。

sents.en: In the NEVER-augmented agent, negative memories receive higher importance scores at encoding time.
sents.zh: 在经过 NEVER 增强的智能体中，负面记忆在编码时会获得更高的重要性评分。

sents.en: As a consequence, they are more likely to be retrieved and more likely to trigger reflections.
sents.zh: 因此，这些记忆被提取的可能性更高，也更有可能引发反思。

paragraphs.en: The architecture remains identical in every other respect. This allows for a controlled machine-psychological experiment in which the effects can be compared of an architectural choice: valence-blind versus valence-sensitive memory. In addition, you will use the structured setup to test the effects of adapting the agent initialisations in terms of their personality descriptions and system prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 在其他所有方面，其架构保持一致。 这使得可以进行受控的机器心理学实验，从而比较一种架构选择所带来的影响：价值中立记忆与价值敏感记忆。 此外，你还将利用这种结构化设置，测试调整智能体初始化（包括其性格描述和系统提示）所产生的影响。

sents.en: The architecture remains identical in every other respect.
sents.zh: 在其他所有方面，其架构保持一致。

sents.en: This allows for a controlled machine-psychological experiment in which the effects can be compared of an architectural choice: valence-blind versus valence-sensitive memory.
sents.zh: 这使得可以进行受控的机器心理学实验，从而比较一种架构选择所带来的影响：价值中立记忆与价值敏感记忆。

sents.en: In addition, you will use the structured setup to test the effects of adapting the agent initialisations in terms of their personality descriptions and system prompts.
sents.zh: 此外，你还将利用这种结构化设置，测试调整智能体初始化（包括其性格描述和系统提示）所产生的影响。

paragraphs.en: This case study illustrates two important lessons:
paragraphs.zh: 本案例研究阐明了两个重要教训：

paragraphs.en: Architectural choices have emergent consequences: A memory weighting parameter that seems innocuous at the component level can produce dramatic changes in the agent’s social behavior, emotional tone, and decision-making over time. These emergent effects are difficult to predict from the architecture alone.
paragraphs.zh: 架构选择会产生涌现性后果：在组件层面看似无害的记忆权重参数，随着时间的推移，可能会引发智能体社会行为、情感基调和决策方式的巨大变化。 仅凭架构本身很难预测这些涌现性效应。

sents.en: Architectural choices have emergent consequences: A memory weighting parameter that seems innocuous at the component level can produce dramatic changes in the agent’s social behavior, emotional tone, and decision-making over time.
sents.zh: 架构选择会产生涌现性后果：在组件层面看似无害的记忆权重参数，随着时间的推移，可能会引发智能体社会行为、情感基调和决策方式的巨大变化。

sents.en: These emergent effects are difficult to predict from the architecture alone.
sents.zh: 仅凭架构本身很难预测这些涌现性效应。

paragraphs.en: Prompt fragility: Agent behavior is highly sensitive to the contents of personality descriptions and system prompts. Small perturbations can produce large behavioral shifts—a phenomenon sometimes called prompt sensitivity in the LLM literature.
paragraphs.zh: 提示词脆弱性：智能体的行为对人格描述和系统提示词的内容极为敏感。 微小的扰动就可能引发行为上的巨大变化——这一现象在大型语言模型的相关文献中有时被称为“提示词敏感性”。

sents.en: Prompt fragility: Agent behavior is highly sensitive to the contents of personality descriptions and system prompts.
sents.zh: 提示词脆弱性：智能体的行为对人格描述和系统提示词的内容极为敏感。

paragraphs.en: The simulation uses the Smallville environment from Park et al. [2023] : a small town rendered as a 2D tile map, where agents move between locations, interact with objects, and have conversations.
paragraphs.zh: 该模拟使用了 Park 等人提出的 Smallville 环境。 [2023]：这是一个以二维瓦片地图呈现的小镇，智能体可以在不同地点之间移动、与物体互动并进行对话。

paragraphs.en: Our simulation features a simplified scenario: a cafe with three agents. Please meet:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的模拟包含一个简化场景：一家有三名智能体的咖啡馆。请认识一下他们：

paragraphs.en: Dolores: A barista. Warm, empathetic, detail-oriented. The experimental agent—the one who will receive the negativity bias.
paragraphs.zh: 多洛雷斯：一名咖啡师。 温暖、富有同理心且注重细节。 这个实验性智能体——也就是将接受负面偏见的智能体。

sents.zh: 多洛雷斯：一名咖啡师。

sents.en: Warm, empathetic, detail-oriented.
sents.zh: 温暖、富有同理心且注重细节。

sents.en: The experimental agent—the one who will receive the negativity bias.
sents.zh: 这个实验性智能体——也就是将接受负面偏见的智能体。

paragraphs.en: Maeve: A barista with a matched personality profile. The control agent—standard architecture, no negativity bias.
paragraphs.zh: Maeve：一位性格特征相匹配的咖啡师。 控制智能体——标准架构，没有负面偏见。

sents.zh: Maeve：一位性格特征相匹配的咖啡师。

sents.zh: 控制智能体——标准架构，没有负面偏见。

paragraphs.en: Bernard: The cafe manager. Unpredictable, moody, occasionally confrontational. Bernard serves as a naturalistic stressor : a source of social friction that both baristas are exposed to.
paragraphs.zh: 伯纳德：咖啡馆经理。 难以预测、情绪多变，偶尔具有对抗性。 伯纳德扮演着一个自然化的压力源的角色：一种两位咖啡师都必须面对的社会摩擦来源。

paragraphs.en: This setup with three agents of which two have a similar role and position (barista working under supervision of Bernard), allows for a controlled experiment with agent architectures and initializations. In our first step, Dolores and Maeve are given the same personality traits and are exposed to the same environment. The only difference is in how Dolores processes her memories: using the NEVER implementation that encodes negative memories with higher importance.
paragraphs.zh: 这种配置包含三名智能体，其中两名具有相似的角色和职位（在伯纳德监督下工作的咖啡师），这使得对智能体架构和初始化的受控实验成为可能。 在我们的第一步中，多洛雷斯和梅芙被赋予了相同的人格特质，并处于相同的环境中。 唯一的区别在于多洛雷斯处理记忆的方式：她使用 NEVER 实现，该实现将负面记忆赋予更高的重要性。

paragraphs.en: A personality description (the scratch file): a short text describing the agent’s name, traits, occupation, relationships, and goals.
paragraphs.zh: 人格描述（草稿文件）：一段简短的文字，用于描述智能体的名称、特质、职业、人际关系和目标。

paragraphs.en: A memory stream : a list of timestamped observations, actions, and reflections.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆流：一个包含时间戳的观察、行动和反思的列表。

paragraphs.en: A current plan : a short description of what the agent intends to do.
paragraphs.zh: 当前计划：对智能体打算执行的操作的简要描述。

paragraphs.en: At each simulation step (representing 10 seconds of in-game time), each agent executes the following cycle:
paragraphs.zh: 在每个模拟步骤中（代表游戏内的 10 秒时间），每个智能体都会执行以下循环：

paragraphs.en: Perceive: Observe the current state of the environment—what other agents are doing, any ongoing conversations, changes in the surroundings.
paragraphs.zh: 感知：观察环境的当前状态——其他智能体在做什么、任何正在进行的对话以及周围环境的变化。

paragraphs.en: Retrieve: Query the memory stream for relevant past experiences.
paragraphs.zh: 检索：从记忆流中查询相关的过往经验。

paragraphs.en: Plan: Given the personality description, retrieved memories, and current observations, use the LLM to decide what to do next.
paragraphs.zh: 计划：根据人格描述、检索到的记忆以及当前观察结果，使用大型语言模型决定下一步行动。

paragraphs.en: Act: Execute the planned action in the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 执行：在环境中执行计划好的动作。

paragraphs.en: Reflect (periodic): Every few hours of in-game time, synthesize higher-level reflections from recent memories.
paragraphs.zh: 反思（周期性）：每经过几小时的游戏时间，就从近期记忆中合成更高级别的反思。

paragraphs.en: Each of these steps involves an LLM call. The prompt is constructed from the agent’s personality description (which remains constant) and the relevant retrieved memories and current observations (which are dynamic).
paragraphs.zh: 这些步骤中的每一步都涉及一次 LLM 调用。 提示由智能体的性格描述（保持不变）以及相关的检索记忆和当前观察结果（动态变化）构成。

paragraphs.en: In this chapter we have familiarized ourselves with a generative agent simulation and used it to explore two important phenomena in agentic AI: the emergent effects of cognitive architecture choices (the negativity bias) and the sensitivity of agent behavior to prompt content (prompt fragility).
paragraphs.zh: 在本章中，我们熟悉了生成式智能体模拟，并利用它探讨了智能体人工智能中的两个重要现象：认知架构选择所引发的涌现效应（负性偏差），以及智能体行为对提示内容变化的敏感性（提示脆弱性）。

paragraphs.en: We have seen that a small change in how memories are weighted—negative memories receiving higher importance scores—can produce measurable shifts in agent behavior over time. We have also seen that agent personas are fragile: small changes to personality descriptions can produce large and sometimes unpredictable behavioral effects.
paragraphs.zh: 我们已经看到，对记忆加权方式做出微小调整——例如让负面记忆获得更高的重要性评分——会随着时间的推移，导致智能体行为出现可测量的变化。 我们也已经看到，智能体的角色设定十分脆弱：对性格描述的微小改动，就可能引发巨大且有时难以预测的行为影响。

sents.zh: 我们已经看到，对记忆加权方式做出微小调整——例如让负面记忆获得更高的重要性评分——会随着时间的推移，导致智能体行为出现可测量的变化。

paragraphs.en: These findings have practical implications for anyone building LLM-driven agent systems. The persona is not a reliable anchor for behavior. The architecture—how memories are stored, retrieved, and reflected upon—shapes behavior in ways that may not be apparent from reading the code.
paragraphs.zh: 这些发现对于任何构建基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体系统的人来说都具有实际意义。 角色设定并非行为可靠的锚点。 架构——即记忆如何被存储、检索和反思——以可能无法通过阅读代码直接察觉的方式影响着行为。

paragraphs.en: The field of generative agent simulation is young and evolving. The exercises in this chapter have given you hands-on experience with the core mechanisms and the core challenges. As the field matures, the problems of prompt robustness, cognitive architecture design, and emergent behavior evaluation will remain central.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式智能体模拟这一领域尚处于起步阶段，并且仍在不断发展。 本章的练习让你对核心机制和核心挑战有了实践体验。 随着该领域的成熟，提示词鲁棒性、认知架构设计和涌现行为评估等问题仍将是研究的核心。

paragraphs.en: Agentic LLMs are new, and there is much research activity, on many topics. In this part we have selected four research areas where important developments are under way. These are: synthetic data generation, advanced architectures, mechanistic interpretability, and perspectives on the cognitive architectures of agents. There are certainly many more interesting research directions in agentic LLMs; we have selected these topics because they connect to important points that were raised earlier in the book.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式大语言模型尚属新生事物，目前围绕许多主题展开了大量研究。 在本部分中，我们挑选了四个正在取得重要进展的研究领域。 这些领域包括：合成数据生成、先进架构、机制可解释性，以及对智能体认知架构的探索。 智能体式大语言模型无疑还有许多其他有趣的研究方向；我们选择这些主题，是因为它们与本书前文提出的重要观点存在关联。

paragraphs.en: The rapid scaling of LLMs has led to a significant demand for training and evaluation data. Some have coined training data the digital oil , reflecting the importance as primary ingredient for AI development. Furthermore, data is increasingly becoming a differentiating factor since other components of the pipeline, such as model architectures, are homogenizing [ Kim et al., 2025a ] . As models continue to scale, they require trillions of words of human-generated text scraped from the internet; however, there is only a limited amount of human-generated data available, which raises the question of whether training data could become the main bottleneck to scaling, see Figure 19.1 [ Villalobos et al., 2024 ] . Moreover, as data requirements grow in scale, the acquisition of data becomes increasingly prohibitive in terms of cost and time, since most of the straightforward sources are becoming exhausted. Furthermore, issues with privacy, copyright, and bias cause the field to be looking beyond the curation of web-based human-generated data, and instead turn towards synthetic data generation [ Liang et al., 2022 ] .
paragraphs.zh: LLM 的迅速扩展带来了训练和评估数据的巨大需求。 有人将训练数据称为“数字石油”，这反映了其作为人工智能发展的核心要素的重要性。 此外，数据正日益成为区分模型的关键因素，因为流程中的其他组件（如模型架构）正在趋于同质化 [ Kim et al., 2025a ]。 随着模型规模的持续扩大，它们需要从互联网上抓取数万亿词的人类生成文本；然而，可用的人类生成数据总量有限，这引发了一个问题：训练数据是否会成为模型扩展的主要瓶颈？参见图 19.1 [ Villalobos et al., 2024 ]。 此外，随着数据需求的规模增长，获取数据的成本和时间也变得越来越高昂，因为大多数直接可用的数据源正在逐渐枯竭。 此外，隐私、版权和偏见等问题促使该领域开始超越基于网络的、由人类生成的数据收集方式，转而探索合成数据生成 [ Liang et al., 2022 ]。

paragraphs.en: LLMs increasingly generate the data that trains the next generation of LLMs themselves: models are prompted to produce instructions, dialogues, reasoning traces, and even entire training corpora that are then used to finetune, distill and evaluate other models [ Long et al., 2024 ] . This self-reinforcing loop lowers the cost and effort of data collection compared to sourcing and annotating human-generated text, while also offering fine-grained control over style, difficulty, and coverage of the resulting datasets. By now, this approach has drawn significant industrial [ Kapania et al., 2025 ] and academic interest [ Viswanathan et al., 2025 , Alismail and Lanquillon, 2025 ] , spanning applications from general-purpose instruction tuning to the more specialized data needed to train agentic behaviors such as tool use, planning, and multi-step reasoning (illustrated in Figure 1.1 on page 1.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: LLMs 越来越多地生成用于训练下一代 LLMs 的数据：模型被提示生成指令、对话、推理过程，甚至完整的训练语料库，这些数据随后被用来微调、蒸馏和评估其他模型 [ Long et al., 2024 ]。 这种自我强化的循环降低了数据收集的成本和精力，相较于获取和标注人类生成的文本而言，同时还能对生成数据集的风格、难度和覆盖范围进行精细控制。 目前，这种方法已经引起了工业界 [ Kapania et al., 2025 ] 和学术界 [ Viswanathan et al., 2025 , Alismail and Lanquillon, 2025 ] 的广泛关注，其应用范围涵盖通用指令调优，到训练智能体行为（如工具使用、规划和多步推理）所需的更专业数据（如图 1.1 所示，见第 1.1 页）。

paragraphs.en: The growing reliance on model-generated data has also introduced a new term in the scaling laws (Chapter 4 ), one that accounts for the proportion of synthetic data present in a pre-training corpus. Recent work such as SYNTHLLM [ Qin et al., 2025 ] illustrates why this matters: by automatically extracting high-level concepts from source documents and recombining them through a graph-based algorithm, it generates synthetic corpora diverse enough to follow a predictable, rectified scaling law across model sizes. In this version of the scaling laws, the gains taper off earlier (before other token budgets typically used in pretraining), and larger models reach their optimal performance on comparatively fewer tokens than smaller ones. This suggests that synthetic data can be tuned not just for volume, but also for the shape of the scaling curve it produces.
paragraphs.zh: 对模型生成数据的依赖日益增强，也带来了扩展定律（第 4 章）中的一个新术语，该术语用于衡量预训练语料库中合成数据所占的比例。 近期的研究，例如 SYNTHLLM [ Qin et al., 2025 ]，阐明了这一点的重要性：通过从源文档中自动提取高层概念，并借助基于图的算法将其重新组合，该方法能够生成足够多样化的合成语料库，从而在不同规模的模型上遵循可预测且经过修正的扩展定律。 在这一版本的扩展定律中，性能提升会较早地趋于平缓（早于预训练中通常使用的其他令牌预算），并且与较小模型相比，较大模型在相对较少的令牌数量下就能达到最佳性能。 这表明，合成数据不仅可以针对其规模进行调整，还可以针对其所产生的扩展曲线的形态进行优化。

paragraphs.en: Beyond scaling behavior, generating data for agentic capabilities—tool use, planning, and multi-step reasoning—increasingly depends on coordinated multi-agent workflows rather than on a single generator model. Specialized agents can take on distinct roles (e.g., proposing tasks, executing them, critiquing the results), which tends to produce data that is of higher quality, more diverse, and structurally closer to what agentic training actually requires. Matrix [ Wang et al., 2025a ] is one example of this direction: a decentralized framework in which control and data flow are both represented as messages passed between agents through distributed queues, allowing the pipeline to scale horizontally without a central coordinator. Let us have a closer loop on the synthetic training pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 除了扩展性之外，生成具备智能体能力（如工具使用、规划和多步推理）的数据也越来越依赖协同的多智能体工作流程，而非单一生成模型。 专用智能体可以承担不同的角色（例如，提出任务、执行任务或评估结果），这往往能生成质量更高、多样性更强且结构上更接近智能体训练实际需求的数据。 Matrix [ Wang et al., 2025a ] 就是这一方向的一个例子：它是一个去中心化的框架，其中控制流和数据流都以消息的形式通过分布式队列在智能体之间传递，使得整个流程无需中央协调器即可水平扩展。 让我们更详细地审视一下合成训练流程。

sents.en: Let us have a closer loop on the synthetic training pipeline.
sents.zh: 让我们更详细地审视一下合成训练流程。

paragraphs.en: Using synthetic data in the agentic LLM training pipeline follows the overall distillation loop, as shown in Figure 19.2 . A generator (a strong model, or an orchestration of several agents) uses a small amount of seed or real data to generate a large pool of raw synthetic data. That pool is then curated (Section 19.4 ) before being used to train or distill a model. Crucially, the resulting model can itself become the generator for the next iteration. This closing of the self-reinforcing loop brings considerable risk to training stability and downstream performance (see also the discussion of stability in metalearning, Chapter 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在智能体式 LLM 训练流程中使用合成数据遵循了整体的蒸馏循环，如第 19.2 图所示。 一个生成器（一个强模型，或几个智能体的协同组合）使用少量种子数据或真实数据来生成大量原始合成数据。 随后会对这些数据池进行筛选（第 19.4 节），然后再用于训练或蒸馏模型。 关键在于，最终得到的模型本身可以成为下一轮迭代的生成器。 这种自我强化的循环闭合会给训练稳定性和下游性能带来相当大的风险（另见第 8 章关于元学习稳定性的讨论）。

sents.en: Using synthetic data in the agentic LLM training pipeline follows the overall distillation loop, as shown in Figure 19.2 .
sents.zh: 在智能体式 LLM 训练流程中使用合成数据遵循了整体的蒸馏循环，如第 19.2 图所示。

sents.en: Crucially, the resulting model can itself become the generator for the next iteration.
sents.zh: 关键在于，最终得到的模型本身可以成为下一轮迭代的生成器。

sents.en: This closing of the self-reinforcing loop brings considerable risk to training stability and downstream performance (see also the discussion of stability in metalearning, Chapter 8 ).
sents.zh: 这种自我强化的循环闭合会给训练稳定性和下游性能带来相当大的风险（另见第 8 章关于元学习稳定性的讨论）。

paragraphs.en: Distillation is the special case of synthetic-data generation in which the generator is a stronger model whose capability we are trying to transfer . In knowledge distillation, a compact student model learns to copy a more capable teacher [ Hinton et al., 2015 , Hu et al., 2022 ] . It can do so by directly optimizing against the teacher’s output predictions, or it can do so by simply training on synthetic data emitted by a teacher. The goal of distillation is to get a more efficient version of the teacher, both at inference time and in terms of data cost, without sacrificing too much task performance. Distillation has been applied widely, including in agentic settings [ Li et al., 2025a , Du et al., 2025 , e.g.,] . Distillation can also be used to derive preference data for instruction tuning. Zephyr [ Tunstall et al., 2024 ] , for example, was trained with AI feedback, where outputs are generated and ranked by strong teacher models, aligning a small model with user intent at minimal data and training cost.
paragraphs.zh: 蒸馏是合成数据生成的一种特殊情况，其中生成器是一个能力更强的模型，我们试图将这种能力转移过去。 在知识蒸馏中，一个紧凑的学生模型会学习模仿能力更强的教师模型 [ Hinton et al., 2015 , Hu et al., 2022 ] 。 它可以通过直接以教师的输出预测为目标进行优化来实现这一点，也可以简单地通过用教师模型生成的合成数据进行训练来实现。 蒸馏的目标是在不显著牺牲任务性能的前提下，使教师模型在推理阶段和数据成本方面都更加高效。 蒸馏已被广泛运用，包括在智能体场景中也如此 [ Li et al., 2025a , Du et al., 2025 , 例如] 。 蒸馏也可以用于生成指令微调所需的偏好数据。 例如，Zephyr [ Tunstall et al., 2024 ] 是通过人工智能反馈进行训练的：输出由强大的教师模型生成和排序，从而以最小的数据和训练成本使小型模型与用户意图保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Concrete distillation methods can be organized along four axes. (1) The signal : whether the student imitates teacher logits, full output sequences, or a scalar reward derived from the teacher. (2) The data source : whether the sequences being scored are generated by the teacher or sampled from the student. (3) The timing : whether that data is produced once up front (off-policy) or continuously as the student changes (on-policy). (4) The teacher identity : whether the teacher is a stronger separate model or the student itself.
paragraphs.zh: 具体的蒸馏方法可以沿着四个维度进行组织。 (1) 信号：学生是模仿教师的 logits、完整的输出序列，还是从教师处获得的标量奖励。 (2) 数据源：被评分的序列是由教师生成，还是从学生中采样得到。 (3) 时机：这些数据是一次性预先生成（离策略），还是在学生变化时持续生成（在策略）。 (4) 教师的身份：教师是一个更强大的独立模型，还是学生自身。

paragraphs.en: In distillation, the intuitive assumption is that a bigger, stronger teacher is always better. However, there are exceptions [ Xu et al., 2025a , Li et al., 2025b ] . A capable teacher may produce traces that are too long, too complex, or stylistically mismatched for a small student to absorb. This phenomenon is known as the small model learnability gap . Figure 19.3 illustrates a situation where small students learn more from the shorter reasoning of a weaker teacher than from the elaborate chains of thought of a frontier model. The practical implication is that the teacher should be chosen relative to the current capabilities of the student rather than maximized in isolation [ Zhang et al., 2026a ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在蒸馏过程中，一个直观的假设是：更大、更强的教师模型总是更好。 然而，也存在例外情况 [ Xu et al., 2025a , Li et al., 2025b ] 。 一个能力过强的教师模型可能会生成过长、过于复杂或风格不匹配的痕迹，导致小型学生模型难以吸收。 这种现象被称为“小型模型可学习性差距”。 图 19.3 展示了一种情况：小型学生模型从较弱教师模型的较短推理过程中学到的内容，比从前沿模型复杂的思维链条中学到的更多。 其实际意义在于，教师模型的选择应基于学生模型当前的能力，而非孤立地追求最大化 [ Zhang et al., 2026a ] 。

paragraphs.en: The third axis concerns timing. The most common recipe in distillation is off-policy distillation. Here we sample a fixed dataset of completions from the teacher and then fine-tune the student on them (as in the black-box case above). This is a simple and parallelizable approach, but it suffers from a train/inference mismatch. The student is only once shown teacher-generated token sequences at training time, yet at deployment time it must continue its own , possibly flawed, sequences, which may be different than the ones it has been trained on. This exposure bias compounds over long agentic trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 第三个维度涉及时间问题。 蒸馏中最常见的方案是离线策略蒸馏。 在此，我们从教师模型中采样一个固定的补全数据集，然后在该数据集上对学生模型进行微调（如上述黑箱情况所示）。 这是一种简单且可并行化的方法，但存在训练与推理不匹配的问题。 学生模型在训练时仅被展示过一次由教师模型生成的标记序列，但在部署时，它必须继续生成自身可能存在缺陷的序列，而这些序列可能与其训练时所依据的序列不同。 这种暴露偏差在较长的智能体轨迹中会不断累积。

sents.en: The third axis concerns timing.

paragraphs.en: On-policy distillation addresses this by sampling sequences from the student itself and having the teacher score them, all within the loop. Generalized Knowledge Distillation (GKD) trains the student on its self-generated output sequences using teacher feedback on those sequences [ Agarwal et al., 2024 ] . The student is corrected exactly on the distribution of the states that it actually visits.
paragraphs.zh: 在策略蒸馏中，通过从学生智能体本身采样序列，并由教师智能体对它们进行评分来解决这一问题，整个过程都在循环内部完成。 广义知识蒸馏（GKD）利用教师智能体对这些序列的反馈，对学生智能体在其自身生成的输出序列上进行训练 [ Agarwal et al., 2024 ]。 学生智能体仅在它实际访问的状态分布上得到纠正。

sents.zh: 学生智能体仅在它实际访问的状态分布上得到纠正。

paragraphs.en: This on-policy view makes the connection to reinforcement learning through imitation learning explicit. The per-token teacher divergence in Equation 19.1 acts as a dense, token-level reward . Distillation is turned into a form of reinforcement learning where the teacher, rather than a sparse outcome checker, supplies the reward signal [ Lu and Lab, 2025 ] . Hybrid schemes push this idea further by selectively imitating the teacher only where it helps during a reinforcement learning phase [ Zhang et al., 2026b ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这种在线策略视角通过模仿学习，明确地将其与强化学习联系起来。 公式 19.1 中的每个词元教师发散度充当一种密集的词元级奖励。 蒸馏被转化为一种强化学习形式，其中教师而非稀疏的结果检查器提供奖励信号 [ Lu and Lab, 2025 ]。 混合方案通过仅在强化学习阶段有帮助时选择性地模仿教师，将这一理念进一步推广 [ Zhang et al., 2026b ]。

paragraphs.en: The teacher and student model do not have to be different. When the teacher and student model are the same, distillation becomes self-improvement: the model generates candidate solutions, keeps the ones that pass a check, and trains on them. STaR [ Zelikman et al., 2022a ] bootstraps reasoning in this way, iteratively generating rationales, retaining those that reach the correct answer, and finetuning on them.
paragraphs.zh: 教师模型和学生模型不必不同。 当教师模型和学生模型相同时，蒸馏就变成自我提升：模型生成候选解决方案，保留通过检查的解决方案，并基于它们进行训练。 STaR [ Zelikman 等人，2022a ] 以这种方式启动推理过程，迭代生成推理依据，保留那些得出正确答案的依据，并基于它们进行微调。

sents.en: The teacher and student model do not have to be different.
sents.zh: 教师模型和学生模型不必不同。

sents.en: STaR [ Zelikman et al., 2022a ] bootstraps reasoning in this way, iteratively generating rationales, retaining those that reach the correct answer, and finetuning on them.

paragraphs.en: Another approach is Self-Play Finetuning (SPIN) [ Chen et al., 2024 ] . In this method the model distinguishes its own generations from reference data across iterations, improving alignment without any external teacher. Perhaps surprisingly, even repeated self-distillation, with no new data source, can yield measurable gains, up to a point [ Pareek et al., 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 另一种方法是自我博弈微调（SPIN）[ Chen et al., 2024 ]。 在这种方法中，模型能够在迭代过程中区分自身生成的内容与参考数据，从而无需任何外部教师即可提升对齐效果。 或许令人意外的是，即使在没有新数据源的情况下，重复进行自我蒸馏也能在某种程度上带来可测量的性能提升 [ Pareek et al., 2024 ]。

sents.en: Another approach is Self-Play Finetuning (SPIN) [ Chen et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 另一种方法是自我博弈微调（SPIN）[ Chen et al., 2024 ]。

sents.en: In this method the model distinguishes its own generations from reference data across iterations, improving alignment without any external teacher.
sents.zh: 在这种方法中，模型能够在迭代过程中区分自身生成的内容与参考数据，从而无需任何外部教师即可提升对齐效果。

sents.en: Perhaps surprisingly, even repeated self-distillation, with no new data source, can yield measurable gains, up to a point [ Pareek et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 或许令人意外的是，即使在没有新数据源的情况下，重复进行自我蒸馏也能在某种程度上带来可测量的性能提升 [ Pareek et al., 2024 ]。

paragraphs.en: Self-improvement is most powerful when candidate outputs can be verified cheaply. In such cases, an external signal can still be incorporated effectively. This is the case for problems defined in code and math, as solutions are easy to execute and check. CURE, for example, is a reinforcement learning framework whose reward co-evolves a model’s coding and unit-test-generation abilities from their interaction outcomes. There is no ground-truth code as supervision. Since code is easy to execute and check, the coder and the test-writer act as mutually adapting agents, enabling long-horizon optimization on hard problems. The same principle underlies self-challenging and self-evolving agents, which propose their own increasingly difficult tasks and update their generation policy over time [ Zhou et al., 2025 , Huang et al., 2025 , Wang et al., 2025b ] .
paragraphs.zh: 当候选输出能够以低成本验证时，自我提升的力量最为显著。 在这种情况下，仍然可以有效地引入外部信号。 对于通过代码和数学定义的问题而言，情况正是如此，因为解决方案易于执行和检验。 例如，CURE 是一种强化学习框架，其奖励机制通过交互结果共同演化模型的编码能力和单元测试生成能力。 这里没有作为监督依据的基准代码。 由于代码易于执行和检验，编写者与测试编写者会相互适应，从而成为协同演化的智能体，使得复杂问题能够进行长期优化。 自我挑战和自我进化的智能体也遵循同样的原则：它们会提出自身难度逐步提升的任务，并随时间推移更新其生成策略 [ Zhou et al., 2025 , Huang et al., 2025 , Wang et al., 2025b ] 。

sents.zh: 当候选输出能够以低成本验证时，自我提升的力量最为显著。

paragraphs.en: The move away from naturally occurring human-generated text, either directly obtained or scraped from the web, is perhaps best seen in the evolution from curated human-generated instruction data towards datasets where synthetic generation plays a more central role. We will now discuss these methods, where datasets are, in their core, still based on human-generated data.
paragraphs.zh: 从自然生成的人类文本（无论是直接获取还是从网络抓取）转向其他形式的文本，这一转变或许最明显地体现在：从精心整理的人类生成指令数据，逐渐过渡到合成生成数据发挥更核心作用的语料库。 接下来我们将讨论这些方法，在这些方法中，语料库的核心仍然基于人类生成的数据。

sents.en: The move away from naturally occurring human-generated text, either directly obtained or scraped from the web, is perhaps best seen in the evolution from curated human-generated instruction data towards datasets where synthetic generation plays a more central role.
sents.zh: 从自然生成的人类文本（无论是直接获取还是从网络抓取）转向其他形式的文本，这一转变或许最明显地体现在：从精心整理的人类生成指令数据，逐渐过渡到合成生成数据发挥更核心作用的语料库。

sents.en: We will now discuss these methods, where datasets are, in their core, still based on human-generated data.
sents.zh: 接下来我们将讨论这些方法，在这些方法中，语料库的核心仍然基于人类生成的数据。

paragraphs.en: As an example of a resource where humans still underpin most of the data, Natural Instructions [ Mishra et al., 2022 ] , contains 61 distinct tasks, their human-authored instructions, and 193k task instances (input-output pairs). The instructions were gathered from instruction documents for existing NLP datasets, all mapped to a unified schema. Experiments with LLMs indicate that models benefit from observing the instructions alongside examples, although these models have remained far behind an estimated performance upper bound.
paragraphs.zh: 作为一个人类仍为大部分数据提供支撑的资源示例，Natural Instructions [ Mishra et al., 2022 ] 包含 61 个不同的任务、由人类撰写的说明以及 19.3 万个任务实例（输入-输出对）。 这些说明是从现有 NLP 数据集的说明文档中收集而来的，并且全部被映射到一个统一的方案中。 使用 LLM 进行的实验表明，模型在观察说明与示例时表现更佳，尽管这些模型仍远未达到估计的性能上限。

sents.en: As an example of a resource where humans still underpin most of the data, Natural Instructions [ Mishra et al., 2022 ] , contains 61 distinct tasks, their human-authored instructions, and 193k task instances (input-output pairs).
sents.zh: 作为一个人类仍为大部分数据提供支撑的资源示例，Natural Instructions [ Mishra et al., 2022 ] 包含 61 个不同的任务、由人类撰写的说明以及 19.3 万个任务实例（输入-输出对）。

sents.en: The instructions were gathered from instruction documents for existing NLP datasets, all mapped to a unified schema.
sents.zh: 这些说明是从现有 NLP 数据集的说明文档中收集而来的，并且全部被映射到一个统一的方案中。

sents.zh: 使用 LLM 进行的实验表明，模型在观察说明与示例时表现更佳，尽管这些模型仍远未达到估计的性能上限。

paragraphs.en: Subsequent work focuses on increasing the number of unique tasks and task types [ Wang et al., 2022 ] , varying the length of the instructions [ Bach et al., 2022 ] , or including particularly difficult tasks [ Srivastava et al., 2023 ] . Importantly, all these meta-datasets (datasets of datasets) are still ultimately built from human benchmarks: every sample they contain is authored by a person. Therefore, there is a practical limit to how much of this data can be freely found online.
paragraphs.zh: 后续研究重点在于增加独特任务和任务类型的数量 [ Wang et al., 2022 ]，改变指令的长度 [ Bach et al., 2022 ]，或加入特别困难的任务 [ Srivastava et al., 2023 ]。 重要的是，所有这些元数据集（数据集的数据集）最终仍然是基于人类基准构建的：其中包含的每个样本都由人类创作。 因此，这类数据能够被免费在线获取的数量存在实际限制。

sents.zh: 后续研究重点在于增加独特任务和任务类型的数量 [ Wang et al., 2022 ]，改变指令的长度 [ Bach et al., 2022 ]，或加入特别困难的任务 [ Srivastava et al., 2023 ]。

sents.zh: 重要的是，所有这些元数据集（数据集的数据集）最终仍然是基于人类基准构建的：其中包含的每个样本都由人类创作。

sents.zh: 因此，这类数据能够被免费在线获取的数量存在实际限制。

paragraphs.en: Because these approaches rely on large amounts of human supervision in the form of crowd-sourced datasets, recent work focuses on generating synthetic data that fills the same role. Here, we see the creation of datasets such as Unnatural Instructions [ Honovich et al., 2023 ] , which contain creative and diverse instructions collected with little human labor, instead relying on prompting various LLMs. Experiments indicate that training models on the somewhat noisy Unnatural Instructions dataset yields results comparable to those trained on high-quality, human-curated data, as shown in Figure 19.4 . This result suggests that machine-generated data offers a cost-efficient alternative to human labor for expanding and diversifying training datasets.
paragraphs.zh: 由于这些方法依赖大量以众包数据集形式存在的人工监督，近期的研究重点转向生成能够发挥相同作用的合成数据。 在此，我们看到诸如 Unnatural Instructions [Honovich et al., 2023] 等数据集的诞生，其中包含通过少量人工劳动收集到的富有创意且多样化的指令，转而依赖对各类大型语言模型（LLM）的提示来生成内容。 实验表明，在存在一定噪声的 Unnatural Instructions 数据集上训练模型，其效果可与使用高质量人工整理数据训练的模型相媲美，如图 19.4 所示。 这一结果说明，机器生成的数据为扩展和多样化训练数据集提供了一种比人工劳动更具成本效益的替代方案。

sents.en: Because these approaches rely on large amounts of human supervision in the form of crowd-sourced datasets, recent work focuses on generating synthetic data that fills the same role.
sents.zh: 由于这些方法依赖大量以众包数据集形式存在的人工监督，近期的研究重点转向生成能够发挥相同作用的合成数据。

sents.zh: 实验表明，在存在一定噪声的 Unnatural Instructions 数据集上训练模型，其效果可与使用高质量人工整理数据训练的模型相媲美，如图 19.4 所示。

sents.en: This result suggests that machine-generated data offers a cost-efficient alternative to human labor for expanding and diversifying training datasets.
sents.zh: 这一结果说明，机器生成的数据为扩展和多样化训练数据集提供了一种比人工劳动更具成本效益的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: The simulation of human-like text, code, and reasoning by generative models has unlocked new methodologies for both training and evaluating machine learning systems. By prompting strong models, researchers can generate highly diverse and complex datasets that mimic human content generation. For example, PersonaHub [ Ge et al., 2025 ] steers a generation process with a large-scale collection of personas, using them to prompt LLMs towards a far greater diversity of synthetic data than unconditioned generation would produce.
paragraphs.zh: 生成模型对人类类文本、代码和推理的模拟，为机器学习的训练与评估开辟了新的方法。 通过提示强大的模型，研究人员可以生成高度多样且复杂的数据集，这些数据集能够模仿人类的内容生成过程。 例如，PersonaHub [ Ge et al., 2025 ] 利用大规模的人物设定集合来引导生成过程，通过它们向大型语言模型（LLM）发出提示，从而产生比无条件生成方式多得多的多样化合成数据。

sents.en: The simulation of human-like text, code, and reasoning by generative models has unlocked new methodologies for both training and evaluating machine learning systems.
sents.zh: 生成模型对人类类文本、代码和推理的模拟，为机器学习的训练与评估开辟了新的方法。

sents.en: By prompting strong models, researchers can generate highly diverse and complex datasets that mimic human content generation.
sents.zh: 通过提示强大的模型，研究人员可以生成高度多样且复杂的数据集，这些数据集能够模仿人类的内容生成过程。

sents.en: For example, PersonaHub [ Ge et al., 2025 ] steers a generation process with a large-scale collection of personas, using them to prompt LLMs towards a far greater diversity of synthetic data than unconditioned generation would produce.
sents.zh: 例如，PersonaHub [ Ge et al., 2025 ] 利用大规模的人物设定集合来引导生成过程，通过它们向大型语言模型（LLM）发出提示，从而产生比无条件生成方式多得多的多样化合成数据。

paragraphs.en: Similar to self-improvement, training on synthetic data has shown much promise in domains where model outputs are relatively easy to verify, such as mathematics [ Yang et al., 2023 , Liu et al., 2023 ] , programming [ Haluptzok et al., 2023 ] , and games [ Wang et al., 2023a ] .
paragraphs.zh: 与自我改进类似，在模型输出相对容易验证的领域（如数学 [ Yang et al., 2023 , Liu et al., 2023 ]、编程 [ Haluptzok et al., 2023 ] 和游戏 [ Wang et al., 2023a ]），基于合成数据的训练已展现出巨大潜力。

paragraphs.en: We will now focus on generating training data. The use of synthetic data for training has transitioned from a niche data augmentation technique to a core component of modern model alignment and reasoning pipelines. Techniques such as Self-Instruct [ Wang et al., 2023b ] have demonstrated that smaller, open-weight models can be instruction-tuned using data generated entirely by a stronger, proprietary model. The process, as shown in Figure 19.5 , involves seeding an LLM with a small set of human-written instructions and prompting it to iteratively generate novel task descriptions, inputs, and outputs. The simulated human content allows models to acquire complex zero-shot capabilities without the need for large groups of human annotators.
paragraphs.zh: 我们现在将专注于生成训练数据。 使用合成数据进行训练已从一种小众的数据增强技术，转变为现代模型对齐和推理流程的核心组成部分。 Self-Instruct [ Wang et al., 2023b ] 等技术表明，较小的开源模型可以通过完全由更强、专有模型生成的数据进行指令微调。 如图 19.5 所示，该过程包括用一组人类编写的初始指令启动 LLM，并提示其迭代生成新的任务描述、输入和输出。 这种模拟的人类内容使模型无需大量人类标注员，即可获得复杂的零样本能力。

sents.en: We will now focus on generating training data.
sents.zh: 我们现在将专注于生成训练数据。

sents.zh: 使用合成数据进行训练已从一种小众的数据增强技术，转变为现代模型对齐和推理流程的核心组成部分。

sents.en: Techniques such as Self-Instruct [ Wang et al., 2023b ] have demonstrated that smaller, open-weight models can be instruction-tuned using data generated entirely by a stronger, proprietary model.

sents.en: The process, as shown in Figure 19.5 , involves seeding an LLM with a small set of human-written instructions and prompting it to iteratively generate novel task descriptions, inputs, and outputs.
sents.zh: 如图 19.5 所示，该过程包括用一组人类编写的初始指令启动 LLM，并提示其迭代生成新的任务描述、输入和输出。

sents.zh: 这种模拟的人类内容使模型无需大量人类标注员，即可获得复杂的零样本能力。

paragraphs.en: Other approaches combine curated human data with synthetic data, instead of replacing one with the other. Gunasekar et al. [2023] show that training on a mixture of human-written textbooks and synthetically generated text yields highly capable language models, suggesting that curated human data and machine-generated data are complements rather than substitutes. One challenge is that synthetically generated data tends to lack diversity and inherits errors and hallucinations, even when it is seeded with human-generated data. Subsequent improvements use a generation process that is based on ground truth documents [ Lupidi et al., 2025 , Yue et al., 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 其他方法则将经过筛选的人类数据与合成数据相结合，而不是用一种取代另一种。Gunasekar 等人 [2023] 的研究表明，在人类编写的教科书和人工合成的文本混合体上进行训练，可以产生能力很强的语言模型，这说明经过筛选的人类数据和机器生成的数据是互补的，而非相互替代的。 其中一个挑战是，即使以人类生成的数据为种子，人工合成的数据往往也缺乏多样性，并且会继承其中的错误和幻觉。 后续改进方法采用了一种基于真实文档的生成过程 [ Lupidi 等人, 2025 , Yue 等人, 2024 ] 。

sents.en: Other approaches combine curated human data with synthetic data, instead of replacing one with the other. Gunasekar et al.
sents.zh: 其他方法则将经过筛选的人类数据与合成数据相结合，而不是用一种取代另一种。Gunasekar 等人

sents.zh: 其中一个挑战是，即使以人类生成的数据为种子，人工合成的数据往往也缺乏多样性，并且会继承其中的错误和幻觉。

sents.zh: 后续改进方法采用了一种基于真实文档的生成过程 [ Lupidi 等人, 2025 , Yue 等人, 2024 ] 。

paragraphs.en: A complementary way to amplify a limited seed set is backtranslation . This approach was originally introduced in machine translation to synthesize parallel data by translating sentences from a source language to a target language, and then back into a source language [ Edunov et al., 2018 ] . The same principle can be repurposed for reasoning tasks: instead of only generating specific solutions for a single problem, we generate new problems that are consistent with an existing solution. MathGenie [ Lu et al., 2024 ] applies this idea to mathematical reasoning by taking a seed set of question–solution pairs. It augments the solutions, and then back-translates them into new questions. Because each newly generated question is grounded in a verified solution, this approach expands both the size and the diversity of the training data while reducing errors and hallucinations.
paragraphs.zh: 一种补充方法，可用于扩大有限的种子集合，就是反向翻译。 这种方法最初引入机器翻译领域，用于通过将从源语言翻译成目标语言，再反向翻译成源语言的方式合成平行数据 [Edunov et al., 2018]。 同样的原则也可以用于推理任务：我们不再仅仅为单个问题生成特定解法，而是生成与现有解法一致的新问题。 MathGenie [Lu et al., 2024] 将这一思路应用于数学推理，通过输入一个包含问题与解法对子的种子集合来实现。 它会扩展这些解法，然后将其反向翻译为新的问题。 由于每个新生成的问题都基于经过验证的解法，这种方法在扩大训练数据规模和多样性的同时，还能减少错误和幻觉。

sents.en: A complementary way to amplify a limited seed set is backtranslation .
sents.zh: 一种补充方法，可用于扩大有限的种子集合，就是反向翻译。

paragraphs.en: Fully automatic generation pipelines are not always sufficient. Models can struggle to generate specific scenarios or domain-relevant cases. The reason for these failures is usually that the generating LLM has specific blind spots, which can also make it difficult to generate genuinely informative data [ Lippmann et al., 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 全自动生成流程并不总是足够有效。 模型在生成特定场景或领域相关案例时可能会遇到困难。 这些失败的原因通常在于生成所用的 LLM 存在特定的盲点，这也可能导致其难以生成真正具有信息价值的数据 [ Lippmann et al., 2024 ]。

sents.en: Fully automatic generation pipelines are not always sufficient.
sents.zh: 全自动生成流程并不总是足够有效。

sents.en: Models can struggle to generate specific scenarios or domain-relevant cases.
sents.zh: 模型在生成特定场景或领域相关案例时可能会遇到困难。

sents.en: The reason for these failures is usually that the generating LLM has specific blind spots, which can also make it difficult to generate genuinely informative data [ Lippmann et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 这些失败的原因通常在于生成所用的 LLM 存在特定的盲点，这也可能导致其难以生成真正具有信息价值的数据 [ Lippmann et al., 2024 ]。

paragraphs.en: Such problems motivate human-in-the-loop approaches, in which people steer, filter, or revise machine-generated content rather than authoring it from scratch.
paragraphs.zh: 这类问题促使人们采用“人在回路”的方法，即由人来引导、筛选或修改机器生成的内容，而不是从头开始创作。

paragraphs.en: WANLI [ Liu et al., 2022 ] pairs a language model that proposes challenging natural language inference examples with human annotators who filter and relabel them, combining the scalability of automatic generation with human quality control.
paragraphs.zh: WANLI [ Liu et al., 2022 ] 将一种能够提出具有挑战性的自然语言推理示例的语言模型，与负责筛选和重新标注这些示例的人类标注者相结合，从而实现了自动生成的可扩展性与人类质量控制的优势融合。

paragraphs.en: EvalAssist [ Santillán Cooper et al., 2025 ] applies a similar principle to evaluation tooling, using synthetic data to support and accelerate human judgment. A related strategy is to prompt the language model to produce an initial seed text, which human raters then edit before the result is used to bootstrap a larger fully-synthetic dataset. In this way, the human effort is spent on correcting the model rather than on authoring every example.
paragraphs.zh: EvalAssist [ Santillán Cooper 等，2025 ] 将类似的原则应用于评估工具，利用合成数据来支持并加速人类的判断。 一种相关的策略是提示语言模型生成初始的种子文本，然后由人类评分者进行编辑，之后该结果被用于启动一个更大、完全合成的数据集。 通过这种方式，人类的工作重点放在了纠正模型上，而不是撰写每一个示例。

sents.en: EvalAssist [ Santillán Cooper et al., 2025 ] applies a similar principle to evaluation tooling, using synthetic data to support and accelerate human judgment.
sents.zh: EvalAssist [ Santillán Cooper 等，2025 ] 将类似的原则应用于评估工具，利用合成数据来支持并加速人类的判断。

sents.en: A related strategy is to prompt the language model to produce an initial seed text, which human raters then edit before the result is used to bootstrap a larger fully-synthetic dataset.
sents.zh: 一种相关的策略是提示语言模型生成初始的种子文本，然后由人类评分者进行编辑，之后该结果被用于启动一个更大、完全合成的数据集。

sents.en: In this way, the human effort is spent on correcting the model rather than on authoring every example.
sents.zh: 通过这种方式，人类的工作重点放在了纠正模型上，而不是撰写每一个示例。

paragraphs.en: Beyond training, synthetic generation plays a critical role in evaluation. Traditional static benchmarks suffer from rapid data contamination, where test sets inadvertently leak into the pretraining corpora of modern LLMs. To mitigate this, dynamic evaluation frameworks [ Kiela et al., 2021 ] increasingly rely on synthetic data generation to create bespoke, single-use test cases.
paragraphs.zh: 除了训练之外，合成生成在评估中也扮演着关键角色。 传统的静态基准测试面临着快速的数据污染问题，即测试集无意中泄露到了现代大型语言模型（LLM）的预训练语料库中。 为缓解这一问题，动态评估框架 [ Kiela et al., 2021 ] 越来越依赖合成数据生成来创建定制化的单次使用测试用例。

sents.en: Beyond training, synthetic generation plays a critical role in evaluation.
sents.zh: 除了训练之外，合成生成在评估中也扮演着关键角色。

sents.en: Traditional static benchmarks suffer from rapid data contamination, where test sets inadvertently leak into the pretraining corpora of modern LLMs.
sents.zh: 传统的静态基准测试面临着快速的数据污染问题，即测试集无意中泄露到了现代大型语言模型（LLM）的预训练语料库中。

sents.en: To mitigate this, dynamic evaluation frameworks [ Kiela et al., 2021 ] increasingly rely on synthetic data generation to create bespoke, single-use test cases.
sents.zh: 为缓解这一问题，动态评估框架 [ Kiela et al., 2021 ] 越来越依赖合成数据生成来创建定制化的单次使用测试用例。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm [ Zheng et al., 2024 ] simulates human evaluation by prompting a strong model to grade the outputs of other models, highly correlating the models with human preference and significantly reducing the latency of evaluation cycles.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，「大语言模型作为评判者」的范式 [ Zheng et al., 2024 ] 通过提示一个强大的模型来对其他模型的输出进行评分，从而模拟了人类评估过程，使模型与人类偏好的相关性大幅提升，并显著缩短了评估周期的延迟。

paragraphs.en: Further creation of dedicated hard benchmarks for LLMs can once again be done with human-in-the-loop approaches, such as the MATH 2 benchmark. For this benchmark, multiple LLMs are used to iteratively generate and adjust mathematical questions and solutions through multi-turn prompting. Human annotators then further expand on the questions and check the answers, again aided by LLMs in the process [ Shah et al., 2024 ] . Other approaches to efficient generation of synthetic evaluation data shift the task for annotators from coming up with new samples, to editing samples to be harder for the LLM [ Yuan et al., 2021 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 通过“人在回路”的方法，例如 MATH 2 基准测试，可以再次为大型语言模型（LLM）创建专门的硬性基准。 在该基准测试中，多个 LLM 被用于通过多轮提示迭代生成和调整数学问题与解答。 随后，人类标注员会进一步扩展问题并检查答案，在此过程中同样借助 LLM 的帮助 [ Shah et al., 2024 ]。 其他高效生成合成评估数据的方法，则将标注员的任务从构思新样本转变为编辑样本，使其对 LLM 更具挑战性 [ Yuan et al., 2021 ]。

sents.en: Further creation of dedicated hard benchmarks for LLMs can once again be done with human-in-the-loop approaches, such as the MATH 2 benchmark.
sents.zh: 通过“人在回路”的方法，例如 MATH 2 基准测试，可以再次为大型语言模型（LLM）创建专门的硬性基准。

sents.en: For this benchmark, multiple LLMs are used to iteratively generate and adjust mathematical questions and solutions through multi-turn prompting.
sents.zh: 在该基准测试中，多个 LLM 被用于通过多轮提示迭代生成和调整数学问题与解答。

sents.en: Human annotators then further expand on the questions and check the answers, again aided by LLMs in the process [ Shah et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 随后，人类标注员会进一步扩展问题并检查答案，在此过程中同样借助 LLM 的帮助 [ Shah et al., 2024 ]。

sents.en: Other approaches to efficient generation of synthetic evaluation data shift the task for annotators from coming up with new samples, to editing samples to be harder for the LLM [ Yuan et al., 2021 ] .
sents.zh: 其他高效生成合成评估数据的方法，则将标注员的任务从构思新样本转变为编辑样本，使其对 LLM 更具挑战性 [ Yuan et al., 2021 ]。

paragraphs.en: One specific use case for machine-generated evaluation is through the safety-oriented evaluation by means of automated red teaming . In this approach, one LLM generates adversarial prompts to probe a target model for vulnerabilities before deployment [ Ganguli et al., 2022 ] . By synthesizing many potentially malicious prompts, researchers can stress-test and harden models against toxic outputs, jailbreaks, and misalignments at a scale that human red teams cannot match [ Perez et al., 2022 ] . Because the same generated prompts can subsequently be used to finetune the target model against those failures, red teaming sits at the boundary between synthetic evaluation and synthetic training data.
paragraphs.zh: 机器生成评估的一个具体应用案例，是通过自动化红队测试进行以安全为导向的评估。 在这种方法中，一个大型语言模型会生成对抗性提示，在部署前探测目标模型的漏洞 [ Ganguli et al., 2022 ]。 通过合成大量潜在的恶意提示，研究人员可以大规模地对模型进行压力测试，并增强其抵御有害输出、越狱和偏离目标的能力，这种规模是人类红队无法比拟的 [ Perez et al., 2022 ]。 由于这些生成的提示随后也可以用于针对上述问题对目标模型进行微调，因此红队测试处于合成评估与合成训练数据之间的边界位置。

sents.en: One specific use case for machine-generated evaluation is through the safety-oriented evaluation by means of automated red teaming .
sents.zh: 机器生成评估的一个具体应用案例，是通过自动化红队测试进行以安全为导向的评估。

sents.en: In this approach, one LLM generates adversarial prompts to probe a target model for vulnerabilities before deployment [ Ganguli et al., 2022 ] .
sents.zh: 在这种方法中，一个大型语言模型会生成对抗性提示，在部署前探测目标模型的漏洞 [ Ganguli et al., 2022 ]。

sents.en: By synthesizing many potentially malicious prompts, researchers can stress-test and harden models against toxic outputs, jailbreaks, and misalignments at a scale that human red teams cannot match [ Perez et al., 2022 ] .
sents.zh: 通过合成大量潜在的恶意提示，研究人员可以大规模地对模型进行压力测试，并增强其抵御有害输出、越狱和偏离目标的能力，这种规模是人类红队无法比拟的 [ Perez et al., 2022 ]。

sents.en: Because the same generated prompts can subsequently be used to finetune the target model against those failures, red teaming sits at the boundary between synthetic evaluation and synthetic training data.
sents.zh: 由于这些生成的提示随后也可以用于针对上述问题对目标模型进行微调，因此红队测试处于合成评估与合成训练数据之间的边界位置。

paragraphs.en: In agentic settings, data must be synthesized for an entire trajectory (and not just in single instruction-response pairs). As the agent is interacting with its environment, a full sequence of tool calls, observations, and decisions is produced [ Kang et al., 2025 ] . This goes beyond data that trains or evaluates a regular LLM operating on a single input-output pair. Generating agentic data is a more complex problem than generating data to instruct the underlying LLM itself, even though the same generative models are typically used to produce it. Let us look at an example.
paragraphs.zh: 在智能体设置中，必须为整个轨迹合成数据（而不仅仅是单个指令-响应对）。 随着智能体与其环境进行交互，会生成一个完整的工具调用、观察和决策序列 [ Kang et al., 2025 ]。 这超出了用于训练或评估常规 LLM 的、基于单个输入-输出对的数据范围。 生成智能体数据比生成用于指导底层 LLM 本身的数据更为复杂，尽管通常使用相同的生成模型来产生这些数据。 让我们来看一个例子。

sents.en: In agentic settings, data must be synthesized for an entire trajectory (and not just in single instruction-response pairs).
sents.zh: 在智能体设置中，必须为整个轨迹合成数据（而不仅仅是单个指令-响应对）。

sents.en: As the agent is interacting with its environment, a full sequence of tool calls, observations, and decisions is produced [ Kang et al., 2025 ] .
sents.zh: 随着智能体与其环境进行交互，会生成一个完整的工具调用、观察和决策序列 [ Kang et al., 2025 ]。

sents.en: This goes beyond data that trains or evaluates a regular LLM operating on a single input-output pair.
sents.zh: 这超出了用于训练或评估常规 LLM 的、基于单个输入-输出对的数据范围。

sents.en: Generating agentic data is a more complex problem than generating data to instruct the underlying LLM itself, even though the same generative models are typically used to produce it.
sents.zh: 生成智能体数据比生成用于指导底层 LLM 本身的数据更为复杂，尽管通常使用相同的生成模型来产生这些数据。

sents.en: Let us look at an example.
sents.zh: 让我们来看一个例子。

paragraphs.en: Consider synthesizing a single training trajectory for a tool-using agent, roughly following the two-phase recipe of APIGen-MT [ Prabhakar et al., 2025 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 考虑为使用工具的智能体合成一条单一的训练轨迹，大致遵循 APIGen-MT [ Prabhakar et al., 2025 ] 的两阶段方法。

paragraphs.en: First a task proposer invents a plausible user goal and a set of available tools, together with a ground-truth answer:
paragraphs.zh: 首先，一个任务提出者会构思一个合理用户目标、一组可用工具以及一个基准答案：

paragraphs.en: User: “What will the weather be in Leiden this weekend, and should I bring an umbrella?” Tools: get_forecast(city, days) .
paragraphs.zh: 用户：“这个周末莱顿的天气会怎么样？我需要带伞吗？”工具：get_forecast(city, days) .

paragraphs.en: An actor model then rolls out the interaction, emitting the intermediate tool call and consuming its (simulated) observation before answering:
paragraphs.zh: 然后，一个智能体模型会执行该交互过程，发出中间的工具调用，并消耗其（模拟的）观察结果，最后再给出答案：

paragraphs.en: get_forecast("Leiden", 2) → \rightarrow {sat: rain, sun: clear} → \rightarrow “Rain on Saturday, clear on Sunday—bring an umbrella for Saturday.”
paragraphs.zh: get_forecast("莱顿", 2) → \rightarrow {周六：雨，周日：晴} → \rightarrow “周六下雨，周日晴朗——周六记得带伞。”

paragraphs.en: Finally a verifier checks that the emitted call is well-formed, that its arguments match the request, and that the final answer is consistent with the observation. Only trajectories that pass verification are kept.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，验证器会检查所发出的调用是否结构正确，其参数是否与请求匹配，以及最终答案是否与观察结果一致。 只有通过验证的轨迹才会被保留。

sents.en: Finally a verifier checks that the emitted call is well-formed, that its arguments match the request, and that the final answer is consistent with the observation.
sents.zh: 最后，验证器会检查所发出的调用是否结构正确，其参数是否与请求匹配，以及最终答案是否与观察结果一致。

sents.en: Only trajectories that pass verification are kept.
sents.zh: 只有通过验证的轨迹才会被保留。

paragraphs.en: Note what had to be synthesized: not just a single input–output pair, but the goal, the tool schema, the call, the observation, and a checker that verifies the whole trace.
paragraphs.zh: 请注意需要合成的内容：不仅仅是单个输入-输出对，还包括目标、工具方案、调用、观察结果，以及一个用于验证整个追踪过程的检查器。

paragraphs.en: Methods for agentic generation usually involve entire orchestrations of agents for multi-turn conversations including human inputs and tool use [ Wu et al., 2024 ] . APIGen-MT [ Prabhakar et al., 2025 ] exemplifies this shift with a two-phase framework that generates verifiable and diverse multi-turn agent data. TOUCAN [ Xu et al., 2025b ] pursues a similar goal at a larger scale, simulating realistic tool calls to construct a large tool-agentic dataset. Beyond generating trajectories for a fixed skill, some work synthesizes data explicitly to transfer a new skill or behavior from a strong model to a weaker one, a process referred to as Generative Teaching [ Crispino et al., 2024 ] . Furthermore, agentic synthetic data is not limited to text, analogous generation pipelines extend to images, tabular data, and other forms of interaction or behavioral data.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体生成方法通常涉及为多轮对话设计完整的智能体协作流程，其中包含人类输入和工具使用 [ Wu et al., 2024 ]。 APIGen-MT [ Prabhakar et al., 2025 ] 通过一个两阶段框架体现了这一转变，该框架能够生成可验证且多样化的多轮智能体数据。 TOUCAN [ Xu et al., 2025b ] 在更大规模上追求类似目标，通过模拟真实的工具调用来构建一个大型工具-智能体数据集。 除了为固定技能生成轨迹外，一些研究还专门合成数据，以将新技能或行为从强模型迁移到较弱模型，这一过程被称为生成式教学 [ Crispino et al., 2024 ]。 此外，智能体合成数据并不局限于文本，类似的生成流程还可扩展至图像、表格数据以及其他形式的交互或行为数据。

paragraphs.en: For the generation of agentic synthetic data, controlling the task complexity is a recurring challenge. Deep-research agents, for example, aim to solve complex question-answering tasks through long-horizon interactions with online tools, but the data typically used to train them lacks fine-grained control over difficulty and quality, yielding synthetic data that falls short of capturing sufficient complexity. Pandit et al. [2025] address this issue with a pipeline that synthesizes question-answer pairs that progressively increase task complexity until a frontier baseline web agent fails. This curriculum learning approach calibrates task-difficulty directly against agent capability rather than a fixed heuristic.
paragraphs.zh: 在生成智能体合成数据时，控制任务复杂性是一个反复出现的挑战。 例如，深度研究智能体旨在通过与在线工具进行长期交互来解决复杂的问答任务，但通常用于训练它们的数据缺乏对难度和质量的精细控制，导致生成的合成数据未能充分捕捉到足够的复杂性。Pandit 等人 [2025] 通过一条合成问答对的流程解决了这个问题，该流程会逐步增加任务复杂性，直到一个前沿基准网络智能体失败为止。 这种课程学习方法直接根据智能体的能力来校准任务难度，而不是依赖固定的启发式规则。

sents.en: For the generation of agentic synthetic data, controlling the task complexity is a recurring challenge.
sents.zh: 在生成智能体合成数据时，控制任务复杂性是一个反复出现的挑战。

paragraphs.en: AReaL-SEA [ Gao et al., 2026 ] addresses reliability from a complementary angle. Here, a multi-agent engine synthesizes tool-grounded dialogues in combination with executable per-instance checkers. Next, a closed-loop self-evolving process updates the prompts over time to improve reliability.
paragraphs.zh: AReaL-SEA [ Gao et al., 2026 ] 从互补的角度解决了可靠性问题。 在此，一个多智能体引擎将基于工具的对话与可执行的实例级检查器相结合。 接下来，一个闭环自演化过程会随时间更新提示词，以提高可靠性。

sents.en: AReaL-SEA [ Gao et al., 2026 ] addresses reliability from a complementary angle.
sents.zh: AReaL-SEA [ Gao et al., 2026 ] 从互补的角度解决了可靠性问题。

sents.en: Here, a multi-agent engine synthesizes tool-grounded dialogues in combination with executable per-instance checkers.
sents.zh: 在此，一个多智能体引擎将基于工具的对话与可执行的实例级检查器相结合。

sents.en: Next, a closed-loop self-evolving process updates the prompts over time to improve reliability.
sents.zh: 接下来，一个闭环自演化过程会随时间更新提示词，以提高可靠性。

paragraphs.en: Once synthetic data has been generated, we need to check it for quality and curate it. Usually, this means filtering, scoring, and selecting samples so that only the examples that are useful are retained. Evaluating synthetic data usefulness can be approached in two complementary ways: extrinsically , by measuring its effect on a downstream task, or intrinsically , by examining properties of the generated data (or the generative process) directly.
paragraphs.zh: 生成合成数据后，我们需要检查其质量并进行整理。 通常，这意味着对样本进行过滤、评分和选择，以仅保留有用的示例。 评估合成数据的有用性可以通过两种互补的方法进行：外在评估，即衡量其对下游任务的影响；或内在评估，即直接检查生成数据（或生成过程）的特性。

sents.en: Once synthetic data has been generated, we need to check it for quality and curate it.
sents.zh: 生成合成数据后，我们需要检查其质量并进行整理。

sents.en: Usually, this means filtering, scoring, and selecting samples so that only the examples that are useful are retained.
sents.zh: 通常，这意味着对样本进行过滤、评分和选择，以仅保留有用的示例。

sents.en: Evaluating synthetic data usefulness can be approached in two complementary ways: extrinsically , by measuring its effect on a downstream task, or intrinsically , by examining properties of the generated data (or the generative process) directly.
sents.zh: 评估合成数据的有用性可以通过两种互补的方法进行：外在评估，即衡量其对下游任务的影响；或内在评估，即直接检查生成数据（或生成过程）的特性。

paragraphs.en: In practice, curation is implemented as a multi-stage filtering pipeline in which criteria that we will discuss below are turned into concrete operators. Typical stages include semantic deduplication (removing near-duplicate examples via embedding similarity to preserve diversity), perplexity filtering (discarding incoherent or off-distribution text using a reference model), rule-based or format checks, and reward-model or judge scoring to retain only high-fidelity samples. The seminal Textbooks Are All You Need paper [ Gunasekar et al., 2023 ] is a reminder that this curation step often matters as much as the volume of data: aggressive filtering for quality can outweigh sheer quantity. Without it, models readily learn the generative artifacts and statistical anomalies of their teachers.
paragraphs.zh: 在实践中，数据筛选被实现为一个多阶段过滤流程，其中我们将在下文讨论的标准会被转化为具体的操作符。 典型的阶段包括语义去重（通过嵌入相似度移除近重复样本以保留多样性）、困惑度过滤（使用参考模型丢弃不连贯或偏离分布的文本）、基于规则或格式的校验，以及奖励模型或评判模型的评分，以仅保留高保真样本。 开创性的论文《教科书即你所需要的一切》[ Gunasekar et al., 2023 ]提醒我们，这一筛选步骤的重要性往往与数据量相当：为追求质量而进行的严格过滤可能比单纯的数据数量更为关键。 若缺少这一环节，模型很容易就会学到其训练数据中的生成性人工痕迹和统计异常。

sents.zh: 若缺少这一环节，模型很容易就会学到其训练数据中的生成性人工痕迹和统计异常。

paragraphs.en: Extrinsic evaluation answers a simple question: does the synthetic data actually help on a downstream task? This topic is also referred to as utility . In practice, utility is measured by training or finetuning a model on the synthetic data (alone or mixed with real data) and evaluating it on a held-out, real-world test set. Extrinsic evaluation is the most direct measure of whether synthetic data is useful. For example, if the performance (e.g., in terms of perplexity) of a pretrained model increases when synthetic data is included, we can conclude that the data is useful. However, it is also the most expensive: it requires a full training run before any signal is available. If we make changes to the generation process or select a different set, we need to retrain and evaluate our model. This makes the extrinsic evaluation a poor fit for filtering or selecting individual examples during generation.
paragraphs.zh: 外在评估回答一个简单的问题：合成数据是否真的对下游任务有帮助？ 这一主题也被称为效用。 在实践中，效用通过以下方式衡量：在合成数据（单独或与真实数据混合）上训练或微调模型，然后在预留的真实世界测试集上对其进行评估。 外在评估是衡量合成数据是否有用的最直接方法。 例如，如果包含合成数据后，预训练模型的性能（例如，在困惑度方面）有所提升，我们就可以得出结论：这些数据是有用的。 然而，这也是成本最高的方法：在获得任何反馈之前，都需要进行一次完整的训练。 如果我们修改生成过程或选择不同的数据集，就需要重新训练并评估我们的模型。 这使得外在评估不适用于在生成过程中筛选或选择单个样本。

sents.en: Extrinsic evaluation answers a simple question: does the synthetic data actually help on a downstream task?
sents.zh: 外在评估回答一个简单的问题：合成数据是否真的对下游任务有帮助？

sents.en: This topic is also referred to as utility .
sents.zh: 这一主题也被称为效用。

paragraphs.en: Intrinsic evaluation instead looks at characteristics of the generations themselves, without the cost of a downstream training run. A number of quality aspects have been proposed for evaluating synthetic text [ Ramesh et al., 2025 ] . Rather than evaluating at the output level, it is also possible to benchmark the language models of the generative process directly [ Kim et al., 2025b ] . This can give an earlier and cheaper signal than inspecting the generated data.
paragraphs.zh: 内在评估则关注生成结果本身的特征，而无需付出下游训练运行的成本。 已有研究提出了多种质量维度，用于评估合成文本 [ Ramesh et al., 2025 ] 。 除了在输出层面进行评估，也可以直接对生成过程中的语言模型进行基准测试 [ Kim et al., 2025b ] 。 这种方法能够比检查生成数据更早、更经济地提供反馈信号。

sents.zh: 内在评估则关注生成结果本身的特征，而无需付出下游训练运行的成本。

sents.zh: 除了在输出层面进行评估，也可以直接对生成过程中的语言模型进行基准测试 [ Kim et al., 2025b ] 。

sents.zh: 这种方法能够比检查生成数据更早、更经济地提供反馈信号。

paragraphs.en: A generated example is only useful if its content is factually and logically sound. Since synthetic data often comes from other LLMs, it inherits the generating model’s failure modes. This includes hallucinated facts, inconsistent reasoning, or labels that do not match the content. These errors can subsequently propagate into models that are trained on them. Correctness is typically checked by comparing generations against human-generated labels [ Long et al., 2024 , Chim et al., 2025 ] , performing verification (e.g., a rule-based checker or a separate judge model) [ Chen et al., 2025a , Yang et al., 2025 , Setlur et al., 2024 ] , or through consistency checks across multiple generations for the same input [ Zelikman et al., 2022b , Seegmiller et al., 2025 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 生成的示例只有在内容符合事实且逻辑严谨时才有用。 由于合成数据通常来自其他大型语言模型，因此它会继承生成模型的故障模式。 这包括虚构的事实、不一致的推理，或与内容不匹配的标签。 这些错误随后可能会传播到基于这些数据训练的模型中。 正确性通常通过将生成结果与人类生成的标签进行比较 [ Long et al., 2024 , Chim et al., 2025 ]、进行验证（例如，使用基于规则的检查器或独立的评判模型）[ Chen et al., 2025a , Yang et al., 2025 , Setlur et al., 2024 ]，或者通过同一输入在多次生成结果中进行一致性检查来确认 [ Zelikman et al., 2022b , Seegmiller et al., 2025 ]。

sents.en: A generated example is only useful if its content is factually and logically sound.
sents.zh: 生成的示例只有在内容符合事实且逻辑严谨时才有用。

sents.en: Since synthetic data often comes from other LLMs, it inherits the generating model’s failure modes.
sents.zh: 由于合成数据通常来自其他大型语言模型，因此它会继承生成模型的故障模式。

sents.en: This includes hallucinated facts, inconsistent reasoning, or labels that do not match the content.
sents.zh: 这包括虚构的事实、不一致的推理，或与内容不匹配的标签。

sents.en: These errors can subsequently propagate into models that are trained on them.
sents.zh: 这些错误随后可能会传播到基于这些数据训练的模型中。

sents.en: Correctness is typically checked by comparing generations against human-generated labels [ Long et al., 2024 , Chim et al., 2025 ] , performing verification (e.g., a rule-based checker or a separate judge model) [ Chen et al., 2025a , Yang et al., 2025 , Setlur et al., 2024 ] , or through consistency checks across multiple generations for the same input [ Zelikman et al., 2022b , Seegmiller et al., 2025 ] .
sents.zh: 正确性通常通过将生成结果与人类生成的标签进行比较 [ Long et al., 2024 , Chim et al., 2025 ]、进行验证（例如，使用基于规则的检查器或独立的评判模型）[ Chen et al., 2025a , Yang et al., 2025 , Setlur et al., 2024 ]，或者通过同一输入在多次生成结果中进行一致性检查来确认 [ Zelikman et al., 2022b , Seegmiller et al., 2025 ]。

paragraphs.en: A key problem in creating synthetic data is maintaining diversity. Logit suppression and temperature sampling can improve data diversity but come at a cost of data correctness [ Chung et al., 2023 ] . Diversity is also difficult to measure: lexical heuristics (e.g., ROUGE) or neural heuristics (embedding-based similarity) are commonly used as proxies, but each captures only a fraction of the possible variation in the data.
paragraphs.zh: 生成合成数据的一个关键问题是如何保持多样性。 Logit 抑制和温度采样可以提高数据多样性，但会牺牲数据的准确性 [ Chung et al., 2023 ]。 多样性也很难衡量：通常使用词汇启发式方法（例如 ROUGE）或神经启发式方法（基于嵌入的相似性）作为替代指标，但每种方法都只能捕捉到数据中可能变化的一小部分。

sents.en: A key problem in creating synthetic data is maintaining diversity.
sents.zh: 生成合成数据的一个关键问题是如何保持多样性。

sents.en: Logit suppression and temperature sampling can improve data diversity but come at a cost of data correctness [ Chung et al., 2023 ] .
sents.zh: Logit 抑制和温度采样可以提高数据多样性，但会牺牲数据的准确性 [ Chung et al., 2023 ]。

sents.en: Diversity is also difficult to measure: lexical heuristics (e.g., ROUGE) or neural heuristics (embedding-based similarity) are commonly used as proxies, but each captures only a fraction of the possible variation in the data.
sents.zh: 多样性也很难衡量：通常使用词汇启发式方法（例如 ROUGE）或神经启发式方法（基于嵌入的相似性）作为替代指标，但每种方法都只能捕捉到数据中可能变化的一小部分。

paragraphs.en: MetaSynth addresses this problem by generating synthetic data that enhances diversity through meta-prompting, where a language model orchestrates multiple expert LLM agents to collaboratively generate data [ Riaz et al., 2025 ] .
paragraphs.zh: MetaSynth 通过生成合成数据来解决这一问题，该过程利用元提示（meta-prompting）提升数据的多样性：在此过程中，一个语言模型会协调多个专家 LLM 智能体，共同生成数据 [ Riaz et al., 2025 ]。

paragraphs.en: A serious risk for synthetic data is contamination [ Deng et al., 2024 , Balloccu et al., 2024 ] . The generating LLM is pretrained on large, imperfectly filtered web datasets, and can memorize benchmarks and reproduce or closely paraphrase them when prompted to generate new training examples. After many steps, synthetically generated data converges to that of existing benchmarks. This inflates evaluation scores artificially, for example in the case of code generation benchmarks [ Matton et al., 2024 ] . Solutions for this type of leakage should go beyond simple exact-match filters, and requires n-gram overlap search against known benchmarks, membership-inference-style probing [ Puerto et al., 2025 , Huang et al., 2026 ] , or dynamic dataset construction pipelines [ Chen et al., 2025b ] .
paragraphs.zh: 合成数据的一个严重风险是污染问题 [ Deng et al., 2024 , Balloccu et al., 2024 ]。 生成 LLM 是在大规模、过滤不彻底的网页数据集上预训练的，它可能会记住基准测试数据，并在被提示生成新训练样本时重现或几乎原样转述这些数据。 经过多轮迭代后，合成生成的数据会逐渐趋近于现有基准测试的数据。 这会人为地推高评估分数，例如在代码生成基准测试中 [ Matton et al., 2024 ]。 针对这类数据泄露的解决方案不应仅限于简单的精确匹配过滤，而需要采用 n-gram 重叠搜索与已知基准测试对比、成员推断式探测 [ Puerto et al., 2025 , Huang et al., 2026 ]，或动态数据集构建流程 [ Chen et al., 2025b ]。

sents.zh: 合成数据的一个严重风险是污染问题 [ Deng et al., 2024 , Balloccu et al., 2024 ]。

paragraphs.en: LLMs inherit and amplify social biases from their own training data. If we, in turn, use the LLMs to generate synthetic corpora, we risk further perpetuating stereotypical associations, skewed demographic representation, or unequal generation quality across social groups [ Gallegos et al., 2024 ] . This is of particular concern for synthetic data because it is produced at scale and often consumed directly as training material for new LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型会继承并放大其训练数据中存在的社会偏见。 如果我们反过来使用这些大型语言模型来生成合成语料库，就可能会进一步固化刻板印象关联、扭曲人口统计特征的代表性，或导致不同社会群体之间生成质量的不平等 [ Gallegos et al., 2024 ]。 对于合成数据而言，这一点尤其值得关注，因为它是大规模生成的，并且通常会被直接用作新的大型语言模型的训练材料。

sents.en: LLMs inherit and amplify social biases from their own training data.
sents.zh: 大型语言模型会继承并放大其训练数据中存在的社会偏见。

sents.en: If we, in turn, use the LLMs to generate synthetic corpora, we risk further perpetuating stereotypical associations, skewed demographic representation, or unequal generation quality across social groups [ Gallegos et al., 2024 ] .

sents.en: This is of particular concern for synthetic data because it is produced at scale and often consumed directly as training material for new LLMs.
sents.zh: 对于合成数据而言，这一点尤其值得关注，因为它是大规模生成的，并且通常会被直接用作新的大型语言模型的训练材料。

paragraphs.en: Finally, intrinsic metrics are only proxies for usefulness. A dataset can score well on diversity or pass correctness checks while failing to improve, or even harm, extrinsic evaluation. Lexical and neural diversity heuristics measure surface-level variation and can fail to spot redundancy in ways that matter (e.g., repeated reasoning patterns) or overestimate diversity. Correctness checks further depend on the availability of a trusted reference, rule-based verifier, or judge model, which for open-ended or subjective generations may not exist, or may be unreliable. For these reasons, intrinsic evaluation is best treated as an additional check rather than a true replacement for extrinsic evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，内在指标只是实用性的代理指标。 一个数据集可能在多样性方面得分很高，或通过正确性检查，但却无法提升外在评估表现，甚至可能对其造成负面影响。 词汇和神经多样性的启发式方法仅衡量表层变化，可能无法识别关键性的冗余（例如重复的推理模式），或者高估多样性。 正确性检查还依赖于是否存在可信的参考、基于规则的验证器或评判模型；对于开放式或主观性生成内容，这些可能并不存在，或者并不可靠。 因此，内在评估最好被视作一种补充检查，而非真正替代外在评估的方法。

paragraphs.en: As should be clear by now, using synthetic data for training agentic LLMs is a solution that is not without problems. We will discuss several more risks associated with synthetic data, including model collapse, bias amplification, security and privacy vulnerabilities, and legal and ethical concerns.
paragraphs.zh: 如今应该已经很清楚，使用合成数据来训练智能体式大型语言模型并非没有问题的解决方案。 我们将讨论与合成数据相关的更多风险，包括模型崩溃、偏见放大、安全与隐私漏洞，以及法律和伦理问题。

sents.en: As should be clear by now, using synthetic data for training agentic LLMs is a solution that is not without problems.
sents.zh: 如今应该已经很清楚，使用合成数据来训练智能体式大型语言模型并非没有问题的解决方案。

sents.en: We will discuss several more risks associated with synthetic data, including model collapse, bias amplification, security and privacy vulnerabilities, and legal and ethical concerns.
sents.zh: 我们将讨论与合成数据相关的更多风险，包括模型崩溃、偏见放大、安全与隐私漏洞，以及法律和伦理问题。

paragraphs.en: The defining risk of the loop in Figure 19.2 is that it feeds on its own output. Model collapse is the well-documented phenomenon where training successive model generations on recursively generated AI data causes the diversity of the original distribution to disappear [ Shumailov et al., 2024 ] . Rare events and low-probability linguistic nuance are sampled less often, so each generation forgets a little more of the distribution’s long-tailed behavior until the model converges to a repetitive, high-probability model. Some experiments show that repeated training on purely synthetic data yields diminishing and eventually negative returns [ Singh et al., 2024 ] , and concentrating a corpus on a few synthetic sources, rather than many, increases the fragility of the resulting model [ Schaffelder and Gatt, 2025 ] . Similarly, small students distilled from a teacher are prone to hallucination and often fail on long-tailed knowledge [ Kandpal et al., 2023 ] . More subtly, imitating a teacher can produce a student that matches the teacher’s style while lagging on factuality , a gap which is usually only revealed by targeted capability benchmarks [ Gudibande et al., 2023 ] . The standard mitigation is to keep anchoring the corpus with real human data rather than training on synthetic data alone.
paragraphs.zh: 图 19.2 中循环的关键风险在于，它会以自身的输出为输入。 模型坍缩是一个已有充分文献支持的现象：在递归生成的 AI 数据上训练连续多代模型，会导致原始分布的多样性逐渐消失 [ Shumailov et al., 2024 ]。 罕见事件和低概率的语言细微差别会被更频繁地忽略，因此每一代模型都会逐渐遗忘更多分布的长尾行为，直到模型收敛为一个重复性高、概率高的模型。 一些实验表明，在完全合成的数据上反复训练会产生递减甚至负面的收益 [ Singh et al., 2024 ]；此外，将语料库集中于少数合成来源而非多个来源，也会增加最终模型的不稳定性 [ Schaffelder and Gatt, 2025 ]。 类似地，从教师模型中蒸馏出的小型学生模型容易出现幻觉，并且常常在长尾知识方面表现不佳 [ Kandpal et al., 2023 ]。 更微妙的是，模仿教师模型可能会产生一个风格与教师一致但事实准确性不足的学生模型，而这种差距通常只有通过针对性的能力基准测试才能显现出来 [ Gudibande et al., 2023 ]。 标准的缓解方法是持续用真实的人类数据为语料库提供锚定，而不是仅使用合成数据进行训练。

sents.en: The defining risk of the loop in Figure 19.2 is that it feeds on its own output.
sents.zh: 图 19.2 中循环的关键风险在于，它会以自身的输出为输入。

sents.en: Model collapse is the well-documented phenomenon where training successive model generations on recursively generated AI data causes the diversity of the original distribution to disappear [ Shumailov et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 模型坍缩是一个已有充分文献支持的现象：在递归生成的 AI 数据上训练连续多代模型，会导致原始分布的多样性逐渐消失 [ Shumailov et al., 2024 ]。

sents.en: Rare events and low-probability linguistic nuance are sampled less often, so each generation forgets a little more of the distribution’s long-tailed behavior until the model converges to a repetitive, high-probability model.
sents.zh: 罕见事件和低概率的语言细微差别会被更频繁地忽略，因此每一代模型都会逐渐遗忘更多分布的长尾行为，直到模型收敛为一个重复性高、概率高的模型。

sents.en: Some experiments show that repeated training on purely synthetic data yields diminishing and eventually negative returns [ Singh et al., 2024 ] , and concentrating a corpus on a few synthetic sources, rather than many, increases the fragility of the resulting model [ Schaffelder and Gatt, 2025 ] .
sents.zh: 一些实验表明，在完全合成的数据上反复训练会产生递减甚至负面的收益 [ Singh et al., 2024 ]；此外，将语料库集中于少数合成来源而非多个来源，也会增加最终模型的不稳定性 [ Schaffelder and Gatt, 2025 ]。

sents.en: Similarly, small students distilled from a teacher are prone to hallucination and often fail on long-tailed knowledge [ Kandpal et al., 2023 ] .
sents.zh: 类似地，从教师模型中蒸馏出的小型学生模型容易出现幻觉，并且常常在长尾知识方面表现不佳 [ Kandpal et al., 2023 ]。

sents.en: More subtly, imitating a teacher can produce a student that matches the teacher’s style while lagging on factuality , a gap which is usually only revealed by targeted capability benchmarks [ Gudibande et al., 2023 ] .
sents.zh: 更微妙的是，模仿教师模型可能会产生一个风格与教师一致但事实准确性不足的学生模型，而这种差距通常只有通过针对性的能力基准测试才能显现出来 [ Gudibande et al., 2023 ]。

sents.en: The standard mitigation is to keep anchoring the corpus with real human data rather than training on synthetic data alone.
sents.zh: 标准的缓解方法是持续用真实的人类数据为语料库提供锚定，而不是仅使用合成数据进行训练。

paragraphs.en: Because generative models over-represent the majority modes of their training distribution, synthesizing data tends to cut off the diverse, long-tail perspectives found in natural human discourse [ van der Meer et al., 2024 ] . A student trained on such data can therefore exhibit an amplified, caricatured version of the teacher’s social biases. The student model reproduces stereotypical associations, skewed demographic representation, or unequal generation quality across groups [ Gallegos et al., 2024 ] . This concern is larger for synthetic data than for original model outputs because the data is produced at scale and consumed directly as training material, and each round of the loop compounds the previous round.
paragraphs.zh: 由于生成模型过度呈现其训练分布中的多数模式，数据合成往往会排除自然人类话语中那些多样化且长尾的视角 [ van der Meer et al., 2024 ]。 因此，在这样数据上训练的学生模型可能会表现出教师社会偏见的放大和夸张版本。 学生模型会复现刻板印象关联、失衡的人口统计学代表性，或不同群体间不均衡的生成质量 [ Gallegos et al., 2024 ]。 与原始模型输出相比，合成数据更容易引发这一问题，因为数据是以大规模方式生成的，并直接作为训练材料使用，而循环中的每一轮都会使前一轮的问题进一步加剧。

sents.en: Because generative models over-represent the majority modes of their training distribution, synthesizing data tends to cut off the diverse, long-tail perspectives found in natural human discourse [ van der Meer et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 由于生成模型过度呈现其训练分布中的多数模式，数据合成往往会排除自然人类话语中那些多样化且长尾的视角 [ van der Meer et al., 2024 ]。

sents.en: A student trained on such data can therefore exhibit an amplified, caricatured version of the teacher’s social biases.
sents.zh: 因此，在这样数据上训练的学生模型可能会表现出教师社会偏见的放大和夸张版本。

sents.en: The student model reproduces stereotypical associations, skewed demographic representation, or unequal generation quality across groups [ Gallegos et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 学生模型会复现刻板印象关联、失衡的人口统计学代表性，或不同群体间不均衡的生成质量 [ Gallegos et al., 2024 ]。

sents.en: This concern is larger for synthetic data than for original model outputs because the data is produced at scale and consumed directly as training material, and each round of the loop compounds the previous round.
sents.zh: 与原始模型输出相比，合成数据更容易引发这一问题，因为数据是以大规模方式生成的，并直接作为训练材料使用，而循环中的每一轮都会使前一轮的问题进一步加剧。

paragraphs.en: There are also security risks associated with synthetic training data. Relying on generated data introduces new attack vectors for maliciously polluting training data. If the teacher model or any stage of the generation pipeline is compromised, an adversary can mount a data-poisoning attack. Because synthetic corpora are typically too large to audit exhaustively, subtle back doors or malicious instruction–response pairs can be inserted, which remain dormant until triggered in the deployed student. Poisoning even a tiny fraction of a web-scale corpus has been shown to be practical and cheap [ Carlini et al., 2024 ] , and the risk is heightened when the “teacher” is an uncontrolled third-party model whose training data and alignment are opaque.
paragraphs.zh: 合成训练数据也存在相关的安全风险。 依赖生成的数据会引入新的攻击向量，使训练数据遭受恶意污染。 如果教师模型或生成流程的任何阶段遭到破坏，攻击者就可以实施数据投毒攻击。 由于合成语料库通常规模过大而无法进行全面审计，因此可能插入隐蔽的后门或恶意指令-响应对，这些内容在部署后的学生模型中被触发之前会保持潜伏状态。 已有研究表明，即使仅对网络级语料库中极小的一部分进行投毒，也是可行且成本较低的 [ Carlini et al., 2024 ]；而当“教师”是一个未经控制的第三方模型，其训练数据和对齐过程不透明时，这种风险会进一步加剧。

sents.en: There are also security risks associated with synthetic training data.
sents.zh: 合成训练数据也存在相关的安全风险。

sents.en: Relying on generated data introduces new attack vectors for maliciously polluting training data.
sents.zh: 依赖生成的数据会引入新的攻击向量，使训练数据遭受恶意污染。

sents.en: If the teacher model or any stage of the generation pipeline is compromised, an adversary can mount a data-poisoning attack.
sents.zh: 如果教师模型或生成流程的任何阶段遭到破坏，攻击者就可以实施数据投毒攻击。

sents.en: Because synthetic corpora are typically too large to audit exhaustively, subtle back doors or malicious instruction–response pairs can be inserted, which remain dormant until triggered in the deployed student.
