paragraphs.en: The question whether humans have privileged access to their own inner states also applies to LLMs: do they have a kind of access that an external observer, who is presented with the same behavioral data, has not? Binder et al. [2025] fine-tuned a model to predict its own behavior in hypothetical situations. It could do so with higher accuracy than a second model that was trained on the behavioral data of the first. This suggests that the first model has access to internal information that is not available from the behavior alone. In contrast, when models’ verbalized judgments about their own linguistic knowledge (e.g. whether a sentence is grammatical) were compared with the probabilities they actually assign to sentences, the judgments did not track the model’s own probabilities better than those of other models [ Song et al., 2025 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 人类是否对其自身内在状态拥有特权性访问权限这一问题，同样适用于大型语言模型（LLM）：它们是否拥有一种外部观察者所不具备的访问权限？尽管外部观察者获得了相同的行为数据。Binder 等人 [2025] 对一种模型进行了微调，使其能够预测其在假设情境中的自身行为。 该模型能够比第二个基于第一个模型行为数据进行训练的模型更准确地完成这一任务。 这表明第一个模型能够访问仅凭行为本身无法获取的内部信息。 相比之下，当将模型对自身语言知识（例如，某个句子是否合乎语法）的言语化判断与其实际赋予句子的概率进行比较时，这些判断并未比其他模型的判断更能准确反映模型自身的概率 [Song 等人, 2025]。

sents.en: This suggests that the first model has access to internal information that is not available from the behavior alone.

sents.en: In contrast, when models’ verbalized judgments about their own linguistic knowledge (e.g. whether a sentence is grammatical) were compared with the probabilities they actually assign to sentences, the judgments did not track the model’s own probabilities better than those of other models [ Song et al., 2025 ] .
sents.zh: 相比之下，当将模型对自身语言知识（例如，某个句子是否合乎语法）的言语化判断与其实际赋予句子的概率进行比较时，这些判断并未比其他模型的判断更能准确反映模型自身的概率 [Song 等人, 2025]。

paragraphs.en: Lindsey [2025] tested introspection causally through concept injection . An activation pattern corresponding to, for instance, writing in ALL CAPS was added to the model’s activations for a simple query. When the model was asked whether it noticed anything unusual, in at least some trials it was able to sensibly verbalize the injected concept. In the case of ALL CAPS, it could indicate that it noticed an “overly intense, high-volume concept.”
paragraphs.zh: Lindsey [2025] 通过概念注入对内省进行了因果性测试。 例如，对于一个简单查询，模型激活状态中被添加了一个对应于全大写字母书写的激活模式。 当被问及是否注意到任何异常时，至少在部分试验中，该模型能够以合理的方式将注入的概念用语言表达出来。 在全大写字母的情况下，它能指出自己注意到一个“过于强烈、高音量的概念”。

paragraphs.en: Researchers have also asked whether reasoning traces can be seen as self-reports reflecting inner states. Turpin et al. [2023] demonstrated that when multiple-choice examples in the prompt always had the correct answer in the first position, models followed this bias. When prompted for explanations, they generally motivated their answer choice with rationalizations rather than explicating the bias. This is consistent with findings by Chen et al. [2025] . When hints about the answer were planted in the prompt, the models used them, but acknowledged this in only a minority of their reasoning traces. It should be noted that humans do something similar. In classic experiments, participants confidently gave reasons for their choices that demonstrably were not the causes of those choices [ Nisbett and Wilson, 1977 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 研究人员还提出一个问题：推理过程是否可以被视为反映内心状态的自我报告？Turpin 等人 [2023] 的研究表明，当提示中的选择题示例始终将正确答案放在第一个位置时，模型会遵循这种偏见。 当被要求提供解释时，它们通常用合理化理由来支持自己的选择，而不是明确说明这种偏见。 这与 Chen 等人 [2025] 的发现一致。 当在提示中植入关于答案的线索时，模型会利用这些线索，但仅在少数推理过程中承认这一点。 值得注意的是，人类也会做出类似的行为。 在经典实验中，参与者自信地为自己的选择提供了理由，而这些理由显然并非导致他们做出该选择的真正原因 [Nisbett 和 Wilson, 1977]。

paragraphs.en: Overall, results indicating privileged access to a model’s own inner states are mixed. If the capacity exists, it is narrow, unreliable, and dependent on the experimental setup.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，关于模型能否优先访问自身内部状态的研究结果并不一致。 即便存在这种能力，其范围也十分有限、不可靠，并且依赖于具体的实验设置。

paragraphs.en: The agents of Shapira et al. [2026] reported tasks as completed while the state of the system showed otherwise. This can be seen as a failure of self-monitoring: the claim about one’s own state was never checked against the world. For humans many such checks are habitual in work and other everyday settings, but for agents they have to be designed in as verification steps, tests, or state checks after each action. Agent architectures do exactly this, for instance with separate monitors that detect when retrieval results and reasoning in a deep-search agent stop being consistent and trigger corrective actions [ Sun et al., 2026 ] . As with world models, metacognition may arise at the level of a system as a whole rather than within a single model.
paragraphs.zh: Shapira 等人提出的智能体 [2026] 报告称任务已完成，但系统状态却显示并非如此。 这可以被视为自我监控的失败：关于自身状态的断言从未与实际情况进行核对。 对人类而言，许多此类核对在工作和其他日常情境中已是习惯，但对智能体而言，这些核对必须作为验证步骤、测试或每次行动后的状态检查被设计进去。 智能体架构正是这样做的，例如通过独立的监控模块来检测深度搜索智能体中的检索结果与推理何时不再一致，并触发纠正措施 [ Sun et al., 2026 ]。 与世界模型类似，元认知可能以整个系统为单位的层面出现，而非存在于单个模型内部。

paragraphs.en: LLM metacognition, introspection, and self-knowledge are detectable, but also limited in multiple ways. On the monitoring side, a model’s verbalizations, internal probabilities, and activations carry different degrees of information about the reliability of its answers. Evidence for privileged introspective access is mixed and points towards limited access at best. On the control side, evidence is even thinner: monitoring signals are often not used to regulate behavior. This leaves space for agentic setups that can design for behavior that is functionally equivalent to what humans achieve with metacognitive control.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 的元认知、内省和自我认知可以被检测到，但也在多个方面存在局限性。 在监控层面，模型的语言表达、内部概率和激活状态所携带的信息，对其答案可靠性的反映程度各不相同。 关于特权式内省访问的证据并不一致，最多只能说明这种访问是受限的。 在控制层面，证据甚至更少：监控信号通常并未被用于调节行为。 这为智能体架构留下了空间，使其能够设计出在功能上等同于人类通过元认知控制所实现的行为。

paragraphs.en: Can a machine be conscious? The question has been around for ages and used to belong to the domains of speculation, thought experiment, and science fiction. Yet today we see this question discussed regarding LLMs and Agentic LLMs by leading scientists and philosophers of consciousness. In this section we outline how the question can be approached and why it remains open.
paragraphs.zh: 机器可以有意识吗？ 这个问题由来已久，过去属于推测、思想实验和科幻的范畴。 然而如今，我们能看到顶尖的科学家和意识哲学家围绕大型语言模型（LLM）和智能体型大型语言模型（Agentic LLM）讨论这一问题。 在本节中，我们将概述如何探讨这个问题，以及为何它仍然悬而未决。

sents.en: Can a machine be conscious?
sents.zh: 机器可以有意识吗？

sents.en: The question has been around for ages and used to belong to the domains of speculation, thought experiment, and science fiction.
sents.zh: 这个问题由来已久，过去属于推测、思想实验和科幻的范畴。

sents.en: Yet today we see this question discussed regarding LLMs and Agentic LLMs by leading scientists and philosophers of consciousness.
sents.zh: 然而如今，我们能看到顶尖的科学家和意识哲学家围绕大型语言模型（LLM）和智能体型大型语言模型（Agentic LLM）讨论这一问题。

sents.en: In this section we outline how the question can be approached and why it remains open.
sents.zh: 在本节中，我们将概述如何探讨这个问题，以及为何它仍然悬而未决。

paragraphs.en: What distinguishes consciousness from the broader label of intelligence? In his classic paper What Is It Like to Be a Bat?, Nagel [1974] suggests that a system is phenomenally conscious if there is “something it is like” to be that system. This positions consciousness as property that is to be experienced from within and makes it by definition hard to access from an outside vantage point. Block [1995] makes a distinction with access consciousness , defined as availability of information (from the senses, memory, and other faculties) for reasoning, reflection, and the control of action. Both these subtypes of consciousness should be distinguished from sentience , which refers to experience that has a valence, such as pleasure, suffering, and desire. Functional capacities, such as spatial orientation, Theory of Mind, and metacognition (discussed above), can in principle be present without sentience or consciousness. Conversely, while most animals score poorly on at least the latter two of these functional capacities, they are plausibly sentient.
paragraphs.zh: 是什么让意识区别于更宽泛的“智能”这一标签？ 在他的经典论文《成为一只蝙蝠是怎样的体验？》中，纳格尔 [1974] 提出，如果一个系统存在“成为该系统时的某种体验”，那么该系统就具有现象学上的意识。 这将意识定位为一种必须从内部体验的属性，因此根据定义，它很难从外部视角进行理解。 布洛克 [1995] 提出了“可及意识”这一概念，将其定义为信息（来自感官、记忆和其他能力）可用于推理、反思和行动控制的状态。 这两种意识亚型都应与“感受性”区分开来，后者指的是具有价值倾向的体验，例如愉悦、痛苦和欲望。 功能能力，如空间定向、心智理论和元认知（上文已讨论），原则上可以在没有感受性或意识的情况下存在。 相反，尽管大多数动物在这些功能能力中至少后两项得分较低，但它们很可能具备感受性。

sents.en: What distinguishes consciousness from the broader label of intelligence?
sents.zh: 是什么让意识区别于更宽泛的“智能”这一标签？

paragraphs.en: From our perspective as human observers and users of LLMs, we often freely use expressions such as the system wants … \dots or the agent decides … \ldots . It is important to distinguish between the pragmatic use of such attributions and making commitment about the ontological status of such mental states [ van Dijk et al., 2023 ] . Dennett [1987] also makes distinction in his intentional stance , which is the practice of attributing beliefs, desires, and other mental states, to any system whose behavior can be predicted well by doing so. Saying about a thermostat that it will switch on the heating once it finds the room too cold provides a workable model of that system without needing any evidence of an inner life that functions like ours. While some argue that this is all there is to expressions like the LLM understands … \ldots or this agents wants … \ldots , others argue that there is depth to such expressions in the case of LLMs that is worth exploring.
paragraphs.zh: 从我们作为人类观察者和大型语言模型（LLM）用户的角度来看，我们常常随意使用诸如“系统想要……”或“智能体决定……”之类的表达。 区分这类归因的实际用法与对这类心理状态的本体论地位做出断言，这一点非常重要 [van Dijk 等，2023]。 丹内特 [1987] 在其“意向性立场”理论中也做出了类似区分，即把信念、欲望及其他心理状态归因于任何行为可通过这种方式得到良好预测的系统。 说恒温器在检测到房间过冷时会启动加热，这为该系统提供了一个可行的模型，而无需任何证据表明它拥有像我们一样的内在生命。 尽管有人认为“大型语言模型理解……”或“这个智能体想要……”这类表达仅此而已，但另一些人则认为，在大型语言模型的情况下，这类表达背后存在值得进一步探索的深度。

paragraphs.en: In line with what we have discussed in Part V and above, Butlin et al. [2023] argue that behavior alone is a poor guide for the inner workings of LLMs. Therefore they suggest to start from leading scientific theories of consciousness and derive indicator properties from these that can be held against current AI architectures and system properties. Their account rests on the premise of computational functionalism , the view that performing computations of the right kind is both necessary and sufficient for consciousness. What matters is the functional organization of a system (which information it represents, how it transforms that information, and how its components interact), not the material substrate that realizes the processing.
paragraphs.zh: 正如我们在第五部分及上述内容中所讨论的，Butlin 等人 [2023] 认为，仅凭行为本身难以准确反映大型语言模型（LLM）的内部运作机制。 因此，他们建议从关于意识的领先科学理论出发，从中推导出可用来检验当前人工智能架构和系统特性的指标属性。 他们的论述基于计算功能主义这一前提，即执行特定类型的计算既是意识产生的必要条件，也是充分条件。 关键在于系统的功能组织方式（它代表哪些信息、如何转换这些信息以及其各组成部分如何相互作用），而非实现这些处理过程的物理基础。

sents.en: What matters is the functional organization of a system (which information it represents, how it transforms that information, and how its components interact), not the material substrate that realizes the processing.
sents.zh: 关键在于系统的功能组织方式（它代表哪些信息、如何转换这些信息以及其各组成部分如何相互作用），而非实现这些处理过程的物理基础。

paragraphs.en: In this view, consciousness is substrate-independent , which is often illustrated with the following thought experiment. Suppose you have a brain injury that affects only one or a couple of neurons and advancements in micro medicine make it possible to replace the affected neurons by silicon-based counterparts that fulfill the exact same function as their biological predecessors did. Your brain function remains completely functionally equivalent. Would you say that you are no longer conscious? What if more neurons undergo replacement after subsequent injuries, up until the point that a quarter of your brain contains silicon-based neuron equivalents? Or half, or three quarters? Following Searle [1980] this view remains contested in biological views that hold that consciousness depends on specific properties of living neural tissue (see Section 22.6.3 below).
paragraphs.zh: 在这种观点中，意识是不依赖于特定物质基底的，这一点通常通过以下思想实验来说明。 假设你遭受了脑损伤，仅影响一个或几个神经元，而微医学的进步使得用硅基的替代神经元替换受损神经元成为可能，这些替代神经元能完全实现其生物前身所具备的相同功能。 你的大脑功能在功能上仍然完全等效。 你会说你已经不再拥有意识了吗？ 如果在后续的损伤中又有更多神经元被替换，直到你大脑的四分之一都由硅基神经元等效体构成，情况又会如何呢？ 或者一半，又或者是四分之三呢？ 遵循塞尔 [1980] 的观点，这种看法在生物学领域仍存在争议，因为生物学观点认为意识依赖于活体神经组织的特定属性（见下文第 22.6.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Butlin et al. [2023] argue that functionalism should be adopted as a working hypothesis rather than a matter of fact, because it makes the consciousness question empirically tractable: scientific theories that specify the relevant computations can be translated into checkable properties of AI architectures. We list the main indicators and the authors’ assessments of these, but note that the paper was written in 2023 and that an agentic dimension is missing; we will return to that below.
paragraphs.zh: Butlin 等人 [2023] 认为，功能主义应被用作一种工作假设，而非既定事实，因为它使意识问题具有经验上的可处理性：能够明确相关计算过程的科学理论可以被转化为对人工智能架构的可验证属性。 我们列出了主要指标以及作者对这些指标的评价，但需要指出的是，该论文写于 2023 年，且缺少智能体维度；我们将在下文再次讨论这一点。

sents.en: Butlin et al.

paragraphs.en: Consciousness is linked to recurrent rather than purely feedforward processing. Algorithmic recurrence is (in a limited sense) a property of RNNs or LSTMs, but a Transformer’s forward pass is not recurrent.
paragraphs.zh: 意识与循环处理相关，而非纯粹的前向处理。 算法的循环性（在有限意义上）是 RNN 或 LSTM 的特性，但 Transformer 的前向传播并非循环的。

sents.zh: 意识与循环处理相关，而非纯粹的前向处理。

sents.en: Algorithmic recurrence is (in a limited sense) a property of RNNs or LSTMs, but a Transformer’s forward pass is not recurrent.
sents.zh: 算法的循环性（在有限意义上）是 RNN 或 LSTM 的特性，但 Transformer 的前向传播并非循环的。

paragraphs.en: For humans this theory holds that specialized parallel modules compete for a limited-capacity workspace whose contents are globally broadcast back to all modules. The transformer’s residual stream (Section 21.3 ) has been suggested to function as such a workspace, but the case is weak given that it is not a clear bottleneck and there is no genuine recurrence or broadcast back to modules. Recent work, however, suggests a sparse, capacity-limited subspace within the residual stream does behave as a bottleneck (see below) [ Gurnee et al., 2026 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 对于人类而言，该理论认为，专门的并行模块会争夺一个容量有限的共享工作空间，而该工作空间的内容会被全局广播回所有模块。 有人提出，Transformer 的残差流（第 21.3 节）可以充当这样一个工作空间，但这一观点缺乏有力依据，因为它并非明显的瓶颈，也不存在真正的循环或向各模块的广播反馈。 然而，近期的研究指出，残差流中一个稀疏且容量有限的子空间确实表现出瓶颈行为（见下文）[ Gurnee et al., 2026 ]。

paragraphs.en: In this view a state becomes conscious when a higher-order metacognitive mechanism monitors first-order perceptual representations (tagging them as e.g. reliable rather than noise) and feeds belief-formation and action-selection system. The authors see no current system that implements this combination, but also highlight that it would be technically possible with existing components.
paragraphs.zh: 在这种观点中，当一个高阶元认知机制监控一阶感知表征（例如，将其标记为可靠信息而非噪声），并将这些信息输入信念形成和行动选择系统时，状态便具有了意识。 作者认为目前没有系统能够实现这种组合，但同时也指出，利用现有组件在技术上是可行的。

sents.en: In this view a state becomes conscious when a higher-order metacognitive mechanism monitors first-order perceptual representations (tagging them as e.g. reliable rather than noise) and feeds belief-formation and action-selection system.
sents.zh: 在这种观点中，当一个高阶元认知机制监控一阶感知表征（例如，将其标记为可靠信息而非噪声），并将这些信息输入信念形成和行动选择系统时，状态便具有了意识。

sents.en: The authors see no current system that implements this combination, but also highlight that it would be technically possible with existing components.
sents.zh: 作者认为目前没有系统能够实现这种组合，但同时也指出，利用现有组件在技术上是可行的。

paragraphs.en: According to this theory consciousness arises from a system’s simplified predictive model of its own attention, which it uses to represent and enable control over its current state of attention. The authors note that machine attention is only a loose analogue of the type of attention meant in this theory and certainly does not amount to a self-model that enables steering current attention.
paragraphs.zh: 根据这一理论，意识源于系统对其自身注意力的简化预测模型，该系统利用该模型来表示并控制其当前的注意力状态。 作者指出，机器注意力仅能粗略地对应于该理论中所指的注意力类型，并且显然并不构成一种能够引导当前注意力的自我模型。

sents.en: According to this theory consciousness arises from a system’s simplified predictive model of its own attention, which it uses to represent and enable control over its current state of attention.
sents.zh: 根据这一理论，意识源于系统对其自身注意力的简化预测模型，该系统利用该模型来表示并控制其当前的注意力状态。

sents.en: The authors note that machine attention is only a loose analogue of the type of attention meant in this theory and certainly does not amount to a self-model that enables steering current attention.
sents.zh: 作者指出，机器注意力仅能粗略地对应于该理论中所指的注意力类型，并且显然并不构成一种能够引导当前注意力的自我模型。

paragraphs.en: In this theory perception is framed as prediction-error minimization. There are elements of this in how LLMs are trained, but the authors view this more as a general framework for cognition, not as a standalone indicator of consciousness.
paragraphs.zh: 在该理论中，感知被框架为对预测误差的最小化。 大型语言模型的训练方式中包含某些相关要素，但作者们认为这更多是一种通用的认知框架，而非衡量意识的独立指标。

sents.en: In this theory perception is framed as prediction-error minimization.
sents.zh: 在该理论中，感知被框架为对预测误差的最小化。

sents.en: There are elements of this in how LLMs are trained, but the authors view this more as a general framework for cognition, not as a standalone indicator of consciousness.
sents.zh: 大型语言模型的训练方式中包含某些相关要素，但作者们认为这更多是一种通用的认知框架，而非衡量意识的独立指标。

paragraphs.en: By this account learning from feedback and selecting outputs in light of specific goals is taken as a form of consciousness. The authors suggest that reinforcement learning suffices for the basic form, but that this involves externally set goals that are not as such part of the system.
paragraphs.zh: 根据这一观点，从反馈中学习并根据特定目标选择输出被视为一种意识形式。 作者认为，强化学习足以实现这种基本形式，但这涉及外部设定的目标，而这些目标本身并非系统的一部分。

sents.en: By this account learning from feedback and selecting outputs in light of specific goals is taken as a form of consciousness.
sents.zh: 根据这一观点，从反馈中学习并根据特定目标选择输出被视为一种意识形式。

sents.en: The authors suggest that reinforcement learning suffices for the basic form, but that this involves externally set goals that are not as such part of the system.
sents.zh: 作者认为，强化学习足以实现这种基本形式，但这涉及外部设定的目标，而这些目标本身并非系统的一部分。

paragraphs.en: The authors highlight that a physical body is itself not the key feature here, but a model of the system’s output affects its input, which helps to distinguish self-caused from world-caused changes. They discuss various systems that have variants of such models, either through control over robots or virtual avatars, but argue that they are still weak or uncertain candidates for the full, end-to-end version of embodiment found across the animal kingdom.
paragraphs.zh: 作者强调，物理身体本身并非此处的关键特征，而是系统输出对输入的模型会影响其输入，这有助于区分自我引发的变化与世界引发的变化。 他们讨论了各种拥有此类模型变体的系统，这些变体可以通过对机器人或虚拟化身进行控制实现，但他们认为，这些系统在实现动物界普遍存在的完整端到端具身化方面，仍然属于较弱或不确定的候选者。

paragraphs.en: Overall, the authors take the stance that no current AI system is a strong candidate for consciousness by their defined indicators, but they see no obvious technical barriers to building systems that satisfy many of the indicators in the near future. As we will see below, the agentic dimension is highly relevant to this debate.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，作者们认为，根据他们设定的指标，目前没有任何人工智能系统能成为意识的有力候选者；但他们也认为，在不久的将来，构建能够满足其中许多指标的系统并不存在明显的技术障碍。 如下文所示，“智能体”维度与这场争论高度相关。

paragraphs.en: Chalmers [2023] reached a similar conclusion in the same year. He lists what LLMs lack by his account: biology, senses, a body, world models and self-models, recurrent processing, a global workspace, and unified agency. Two of these obstacles are the topics of the above Sections 22.3 and 22.5 , and the evidence there suggests that various aspects of these are currently overcome or in the process of being developed. Chalmers put his credence that current LLMs are conscious below ten percent, but gave considerably higher odds to extended successors. Table 22.2 gives a simplified overview.
paragraphs.zh: Chalmers [2023] 在同一年得出了类似的结论。 根据他的论述，他列举了大型语言模型所缺乏的要素：生物学基础、感官、身体、世界模型和自我模型、循环处理机制、全局工作空间以及统一的智能体能力。 其中两个障碍正是上述第 22.3 节和第 22.5 节的主题，而其中的证据表明，这些障碍的多个方面目前已被克服或正在开发过程中。 Chalmers 认为当前的大型语言模型具有意识的概率低于百分之十，但他对经过扩展的后续版本则给出了高得多的可能性。 表 22.2 提供了一个简化的概述。

paragraphs.en: Recent work in mechanistic interpretability work has focused on the question whether there is a global workspace that emerges in the forward pass of frontier LLMs. Gurnee et al. [2026] introduce the idea of the Jacobian Lens , which involves assigning to each vocabulary token a direction in the residual stream that encodes the model’s disposition to verbalize that token, averaged over contexts. They identify the J-space , which holds only a few dozen active concepts at a time, and argue that it has the functional profile that Global Workspace Theory associates with conscious access. Its contents determine to an important degree what the model reports, can be summoned on instruction while the model does something else, carry unspoken intermediate steps in multi-step reasoning, and can be swapped to redirect many different downstream computations at once. Ablating it leaves routine processing such as parsing, classification, and fluent continuation largely intact, but impairs the kind of flexible inference that makes current frontier models so powerful on an array of complex tasks. The authors take no position on phenomenal consciousness and stress that the parallel is functional rather than architectural: there is no input from and feedback into encapsulated modules: broadcast happens across layer depth within a single feedforward pass rather than through recurrent loops. The findings strengthen the case made by Butlin et al. [2023] for an approach based on indicators and leaves disagreements with biological naturalists (Section 22.6.3 below) untouched, sinse that disagreement does not concern the facts about LLMs, rather the premises of what it means to be conscious.
paragraphs.zh: 近期关于机制可解释性的研究聚焦于一个问题：前沿大型语言模型的前向传播过程中，是否存在一个全局工作空间？Gurnee等人 [2026]提出了雅可比透镜（Jacobian Lens）的概念，即为每个词汇表中的词元在残差流中分配一个方向，该方向编码了模型对该词元进行语言输出的倾向，并基于不同上下文进行了平均。 他们识别出了J空间（J-space），其中同一时间仅包含几十个活跃概念，并认为其功能特征与全局工作空间理论所关联的有意识访问相一致。 J空间的内容在很大程度上决定了模型会报告哪些信息；它可以在模型执行其他任务时通过指令被调用，承载多步推理中未明确表达的中间步骤，并且能够被替换以同时引导多种不同的下游计算。 移除J空间后，解析、分类和流畅续写等常规处理功能基本不受影响，但会损害那种使当前前沿模型在一系列复杂任务中表现强大的灵活推理能力。 作者们并未对现象意识本身发表立场，并强调这种类比是功能性的而非架构性的：封装模块之间没有输入或反馈；广播发生在单次前向传播过程中跨层深度的传递，而非通过循环结构实现。 这些发现加强了Butlin等人 [2023]所提出的基于指标的方法的说服力，同时未触及与生物自然主义者之间的分歧（见下文第22.6.3节），因为这种分歧并不涉及关于大型语言模型的事实，而是关乎“意识”定义的前提假设。

paragraphs.en: [ Seth, 2025 ] counters functionalism and defends a position referred to as biological naturalism . According to this position, consciousness is deeply intertwined with our nature as living organisms: its function is regulate a precarious body that has to keep itself in existence. Properties of intelligent systems such as prediction-error minimization, and capacities such as spatial orientation, Theory of Mind, and self-reflection, should be viewed in service of staying alive. There may be local similarities between these properties and capacities in natural and artificial systems, but in the latter they are not causally connected in a biological chain of existence. In other words, for a biological naturalist being conscious requires having skin in the game. 5 5 5 Seth’s article was published in Brain and Behavioural Sciences and is followed, according to the journal’s conventional format, by open peer commentaries. Leonard Dung’s Why I Am Not a Biological Naturalist is one of these commentaries contains a counterargument. Aru et al. [2023] share this line of argumentation and add that LLM inputs lack the rich 4E information content (see Section 22.1.3 ) of our sensory contact with the world. From a neuroscience perspective, LLMs therefore miss key features of the thalamocortical system known to be linked to consciousness in mammals.
paragraphs.zh: [ Seth, 2025 ] 反驳了功能主义，并捍卫了一种被称为生物自然主义的观点。 根据这一观点，意识与作为生命体的我们的本性紧密交织：其功能是调节一个脆弱的身体，使其能够维持自身的存在。 智能系统的特性（如预测-误差最小化）以及能力（如空间定向、心智理论和自我反思），都应被视为服务于生存的手段。 自然系统和人工系统在这些特性和能力之间可能存在局部相似性，但在后者中，它们并未通过生物存在的因果链相互关联。 换言之，对生物自然主义者而言，拥有意识意味着必须“亲自参与游戏”。5 5 5 Seth 的文章发表于《大脑与行为科学》，按照该期刊的常规格式，其后附有开放同行评论。 Leonard Dung 的《我为什么不是生物自然主义者》正是这些评论之一，其中包含了一种反论。Aru 等人 [2023] 也认同这一论证思路，并补充道，大型语言模型的输入缺乏我们与世界感官接触所具有丰富的 4E 信息内容（参见第 22.1.3 节）。 因此，从神经科学的角度来看，大型语言模型缺少了已知与哺乳动物意识相关的丘脑-皮层系统的关键特征。

paragraphs.en: For biological naturalists, artificial consciousness would be more likely as systems (1) become more life-like and start having autonomous evolutionary and developmental trajectories to which properties of their intelligence are causally connected, (2) have richer information streams that connect them with the outside world. Note that the disagreement with computational functionalists is thus mainly about the premises of what consciousness is, not about the facts concerning LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 对于生物自然主义者而言，人工意识更可能被视为一种系统：（1）该系统变得愈发类生命，并开始拥有自主的演化和发展轨迹，其智能特性与这些轨迹存在因果关联；（2）该系统拥有更丰富的信息流，使其与外部世界建立连接。 需要注意的是，因此，与计算功能主义者的分歧主要在于对意识本质的前提假设，而非关于大型语言模型的具体事实。

paragraphs.en: LLMs produce first-person reports of experience, thinking steps, emotions, and more. There are at least two reasons why these should be discounted. First, LLMs are trained on human texts that are full of such descriptions. The descriptions therefore need not have a link to the LLM and the current context itself, but can be external to both. Second, in the role-play account of Shanahan et al. [2023] , a model structurally acts as a character. This also disconnects self-reports from the model itself: the same model can play characters that claim to be conscious just as well as characters that deny it. This what has been called the gaming problem : the abundance of markers for mental properties in the training data makes that those markers can no longer be reliably used [ Birch, 2024 ] . It has been suggested that self-reports could become more informative and reliable if models would be trained to introspect accurately on questions with computationally verifiable answers [ Perez and Long, 2023a ] , but Section 22.5 shows how far we currently are from that situation.
paragraphs.zh: LLM会生成关于体验、思考步骤、情绪等的第一人称报告。 至少有两个理由说明这些报告应当被排除在考量之外。 首先，LLM是在充满此类描述的人类文本上训练而成的。 因此，这些描述不必与LLM或当前上下文本身存在关联，而可以独立于两者之外。 其次，在Shanahan等人提出的角色扮演模型中 [2023]，模型在结构上扮演一个角色。 这也使得自我报告与模型本身脱节：同一模型既可以扮演声称自己有意识的角色，也可以扮演否认有意识的角色。 这就是所谓的“游戏化问题”：训练数据中大量存在心智属性的标记，导致这些标记无法再被可靠地使用 [Birch, 2024]。 有人提出，如果模型能够被训练以准确地进行内省，针对那些答案可通过计算验证的问题进行回答，那么自我报告可能会更具信息量和可靠性 [Perez and Long, 2023a]；但第22.5节展示了我们目前距离这一目标还有多远。

paragraphs.en: In Section 15.3.3 we set aside whether LLMs feel anything. On the behavioral level, anxiety-inducing prompts change subsequent self-reports: they raise the scores of LLMs on anxiety questionnaires, whereas relaxation prompts partly reverse this [ Ben-Zion et al., 2026 ] . These findings carry the above two caveats: the questions can be answered irrespective of the model’s actual inner state, by relying on associations between different aspects of anxiety learned during training. On the representational level, emotion concepts correspond to directions in activation space, and, at the mechanistic level, steering along these directions changes the model’s outputs [ Zou et al., 2025 ] . Arguably, these states thus modulate behavior much as emotions do in humans and other animals. On a functionalist account, this makes them emotion-like states [ Moerland et al., 2018 ] , but whether they are felt in any way comparable to how emotions are experiences by humans and other animals, inherits all of the uncertainty discussed above.
paragraphs.zh: 在第 15.3.3 节中，我们暂且搁置 LLM 是否有任何感受这一问题。 在行为层面，引发焦虑的提示会改变随后的自我报告：它们会提高 LLM 在焦虑问卷上的得分，而放松提示则部分逆转了这一效应 [ Ben-Zion et al., 2026 ]。 这些发现存在上述两个注意事项：无论模型的实际内部状态如何，都可以通过依赖训练期间学到的焦虑不同方面之间的关联来回答这些问题。 在表征层面，情感概念对应于激活空间中的方向；而在机制层面，沿着这些方向进行引导会改变模型的输出 [ Zou et al., 2025 ]。 可以说，这些状态因此调节行为的方式与人类和其他动物中情感的调节方式非常相似。 从功能主义的角度来看，这使得它们成为类似情感的状态 [ Moerland et al., 2018 ]；但它们在感受上是否以某种方式与人类和其他动物体验情感的方式相当，则继承了上文讨论的所有不确定性。

paragraphs.en: At the time of writing, work targeting the specific intersection between consciousness and agentic LLMs is sparse. However, agentic architectures have been argued to be relevant to least one theory of LLM consciousness. Goldstein and Levinstein [2024] observe that LLM agents of the kind discussed in Chapter 17 , with a memory stream, retrieval, reflection, and planning modules that communicate through a shared buffer, come close to the architecture that Global Workspace Theory (GWT) requires. If GWT is correct, they argue, such agents are or could easily be made conscious – and those who find this conclusion implausible should take it as evidence against GWT. Persistent memory and long-term goals also address the lack of unified agency that Chalmers noted.
paragraphs.zh: 在撰写本文时，针对意识与智能体型大型语言模型（LLM）之间特定交叉领域的工作仍十分稀少。 然而，有观点认为，智能体架构至少与一种关于LLM意识的理论相关。 Goldstein和Levinstein [2024]指出，第17章所讨论的LLM智能体——具备记忆流、检索、反思和规划模块，并通过共享缓冲区进行通信——其架构已接近全局工作空间理论（GWT）所要求的结构。 他们认为，如果GWT是正确的，那么这类智能体要么已经具有意识，要么可以轻易被赋予意识；而认为这一结论难以接受的人，应将其视为反对GWT的证据。 持久记忆和长期目标也解决了Chalmers所指出的统一智能性缺失问题。

paragraphs.en: An interesting note made by Gurnee et al. [2026] is that the J-space may emulate some functions in a single forward pass that are also attributed to recurrent processing in agentic architectures and chain-of-thought prompting. Problems solved with written-out reasoning were much more robust to J-space ablation, which suggests that the model would otherwise hold such reasoning internally. This brings the debate back to the question at what level—or any form of cognitive functioning—is attributed: the border between what happens strictly inside the model and what emerges at system-level cannot be drawn a priori and depends on the task, format of the prompt, availability of tools, interactions, and other contextual factors. Note that this is precisely what cognitive externalists have argued for human cognitive functioning as well [ Noë, 2009 ] .
paragraphs.zh: Gurnee 等人提出的一个有趣观点是： [2026]，J-space 可能在一次前向传播中模拟某些功能，而这些功能在智能体架构和思维链提示中也归因于循环处理。 通过书面推理解决的问题对 J-space 的消融具有更强的鲁棒性，这表明模型原本会将此类推理内部化。 这将讨论重新引向一个问题：认知功能的哪个层面——或任何形式——应被归因于模型：严格发生在模型内部的内容与系统层面涌现的内容之间的界限无法事先划定，它取决于任务、提示格式、工具可用性、交互以及其他上下文因素。 值得注意的是，这正是认知外在主义者对人类认知功能所主张的观点 [Noë, 2009]。

paragraphs.en: In the case of consciousness and experience of inner states, making the possible errors introduced at the beginning of this chapter can both be costly. Anthropomorphisation is already happening and brings risks of emotional dependence, misplaced trust, and manipulation. Anthropo-denial would, if such systems were consciousness or sentient to some degree, bring moral errors on a large scale. Birch [2024] argues for precautions that are proportionate to the probability, and Butlin et al. [2023] argue that the probability is high enough to start assessing systems now and some developers have indeed started research programs on model welfare. For example, Anthropic has included a welfare assessment in the documentation of the Opus 4 model release, and has allowed some of its models to end persistently abusive conversations, as a low-cost precaution in case model welfare matters. 6 6 6 https://www.anthropic.com/research/end-subset-conversations Whatever one thinks of the probabilities, the topic has moved from philosophy seminars to engineering practice.

paragraphs.en: This chapter asked what lies behind the behavior surveyed in Part V, and whether this is anything like the cognition that drives behavior in humans and animals. Four general threads have been identified.
paragraphs.zh: 本章探讨了第五部分所考察的行为背后隐藏着什么，以及这种行为是否与驱动人类和动物行为的认知有相似之处。 已经识别出四条主要线索。

sents.en: This chapter asked what lies behind the behavior surveyed in Part V, and whether this is anything like the cognition that drives behavior in humans and animals.
sents.zh: 本章探讨了第五部分所考察的行为背后隐藏着什么，以及这种行为是否与驱动人类和动物行为的认知有相似之处。

sents.en: Four general threads have been identified.
sents.zh: 已经识别出四条主要线索。

paragraphs.en: First, the degree to which internal representations are structured in ways that make sense to a human observer, varies across tasks and domains. LLMs trained on text can develop representations that mirror geography, board states, the beliefs of story characters, and traits of the persona they play, and in some cases it can be shown mechanistically that these representations are used. The image of the stochastic parrot does not fit these findings: after all, the presence of a causal chain from representation to behavior in at least some cases, falsifies the claim that LLMs operate at the surface-level only. But the same methods reveal how incoherent representations can be, and how responses can rely on patchy heuristics. This is in part because human text covers the world unevenly and in part because surface statistics suffice in some domains to satisfy training objectives. Therefore, the image of a mind that understands does not fit either. LLMs are a new kind of system, and our vocabulary for cognition, developed for humans and other animals, applies to them only imperfectly.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，内部表征在何种程度上以人类观察者能够理解的方式结构化，因任务和领域而异。 在文本上训练的 LLM 可以形成反映地理、棋盘状态、故事角色信念以及所扮演角色特质的表征，在某些情况下，还可以从机制上证明这些表征确实被使用。 “随机鹦鹉”这一形象与这些发现不符：毕竟，至少在某些情况下，存在从表征到行为的因果链，这就推翻了 LLM 仅在最表层运作的说法。 但同样的方法也揭示了表征可能多么缺乏连贯性，以及回应可能如何依赖零散的启发式方法。 这部分是因为人类文本对世界的覆盖并不均衡，部分也是因为在某些领域，表层统计信息就足以满足训练目标。 因此，“具备理解能力的思维体”这一形象同样不符合实际情况。 LLM 是一种新型系统，而我们为人类和其他动物发展出的认知词汇，只能不完美地适用于它们。

paragraphs.en: Second, the knowing–doing gap returned in the cognitive domain. Models represent more than they spontaneously use or report: we saw belief-states that do not guide action, definitions that are not applied, and computations that are described in the wrong way. A plausible hypothesis is that structured prompts and scaffolds work because they connect existing representations to behavior. Agentic loops can in theory provide such structure and scaffolding autonomously. At this point this has hardly been tested empirically: all representational and mechanistic evidence concerns bare models. For agents, the last column of Table 22.1 holds behavioral entries only.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，认知领域出现了“知”与“行”之间的鸿沟。 模型所代表的知识超出了它们自发使用或报告的内容：我们观察到了一些无法指导行动的信念状态、未被应用的定义，以及以错误方式描述的计算过程。 一个合理的假设是，结构化提示和脚手架之所以有效，是因为它们将现有的表征与行为连接了起来。 理论上，智能体循环可以自主地提供这种结构和脚手架支持。 目前这一点几乎尚未得到经验验证：所有关于表征和机制的证据都仅涉及基础模型。 对于智能体而言，表22.1的最后一列仅包含行为相关的条目。

paragraphs.en: A third point is that we can now describe agentic extension as moving cognition from the model to the system . World states can be kept in explicit, externally stored and updated maps, self-monitoring can be implemented as verification steps, and a memory that is shared between agents can act as a workspace. According to the extended mind thesis in philosophy, if we reliably consult a notebook as external memory, also for humans this becomes part of our cognitive system [ Clark and Chalmers, 1998 ] . Cognitive architectures for agentic LLMs are designed in this spirit [ Sumers et al., 2024 ] . An advantage is that externalized cognition adds to the technology’s transparency because it can be inspected.
paragraphs.zh: 第三点是，我们现在可以将智能体扩展描述为将认知从模型转移到系统中。 世界状态可以保存在显式、外部存储并持续更新的地图中，自我监控可以作为验证步骤来实现，而智能体之间共享的记忆则可以作为工作区使用。 根据哲学中的扩展心智理论，如果我们可靠地查阅笔记本作为外部记忆，那么对于人类而言，这也成为我们认知系统的一部分 [Clark and Chalmers, 1998]。 面向智能体式大语言模型的认知架构正是基于这一理念设计的 [Sumers et al., 2024]。 其优势在于，外化的认知提升了技术的透明度，因为这种认知可以被检验。

paragraphs.en: Fourth, on consciousness the honest position is uncertainty on all levels. Theories disagree on whether any digital system could be conscious, self-reports and other behavioral aspects are unreliable determinants, and it is as of yet unclear how interpretability techniques can be made informative on this question. What can be done now is to avoid designs that mislead users in over-attributing consciousness. Researchers argue that it is time to start assessing model welfare [ Butlin et al., 2023 , Long et al., 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 第四，关于意识问题，诚实的立场是在所有层面上都保持不确定。 各种理论对任何数字系统是否具有意识存在分歧；自我报告和其他行为特征都是不可靠的判断依据，而且目前尚不清楚如何让可解释性技术在这一问题上提供有用的信息。 现在能做的就是避免那些会误导用户过度归因于意识的设计。 研究人员认为，现在是时候开始评估模型福祉了 [Butlin et al., 2023, Long et al., 2024]。

paragraphs.en: Agentic LLM is a new field in which the technology of large language models is used for the creation of agents that act in the world. In the conclusion we discuss the impact of agentic LLMs, what the field can do, what current limitations are, and what the future may bring.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式大语言模型是一个新兴领域，该领域利用大语言模型技术来创建能够在现实世界中行动的智能体。 在结论部分，我们将探讨智能体式大语言模型的影响、该领域的潜力、当前的局限性以及未来可能带来的变化。

paragraphs.en: Having arrived at the end of this book, we provide a brief high-level summary of the material that we have discussed. First we look back at our chapters about how agentic LLMs are built. Then we summarize our discussion of different applications of agentic LLMs and their behavior in single and multi-agent settings. Finally, in Section 23.2 we look at the limitations of current approaches, and what the future may bring.
paragraphs.zh: 读完整本书后，我们对已讨论的内容做一个简要的高层次总结。 首先，我们将回顾关于智能体式 LLM 如何构建的章节内容。 接着，我们将总结对智能体式 LLM 不同应用及其在单智能体和多智能体场景下行为的讨论。 最后，在第 23.2 节中，我们将探讨当前方法的局限性以及未来可能带来的变化。

paragraphs.en: As discussed in Parts I, II, and III, the foundations of agentic LLMs lie in language modeling, reasoning, tool use, and different degrees of autonomy.
paragraphs.zh: 如第一部分、第二部分和第三部分所讨论的，智能体式大型语言模型的基础在于语言建模、推理、工具使用以及不同程度的自主性。

paragraphs.en: Agentic LLMs are reasoning models that act in the world and adapt their behavior from feedback. After having been pretrained and finetuned (Chapter 3 ), at inference time they may access to external information (retrieval augmented generative AI, Chapter 12 ). They may also prompt themselves at inference time to verify results, leading to self-reflection and in-context reinforcement learning, Chapter 6 . Agentic LLMs have become multi-modal, they operate in language, vision, and action domains (Chapter 7 ). To do so effectively, agentic LLMs can be provided with pretrained world models with a rudimentary understanding of the physical world. Through interacting with the environment, these world models may be improved at test time.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式大语言模型是一种能够作用于现实世界并根据反馈调整行为的推理模型。 经过预训练和微调（第 3 章）之后，在推理阶段，它们可以访问外部信息（检索增强生成式人工智能，第 12 章）。 在推理阶段，它们还可以自我提示以验证结果，从而实现自我反思和上下文强化学习（第 6 章）。 智能体式大语言模型已发展为多模态模型，能够在语言、视觉和行动领域协同运作（第 7 章）。 为了有效实现这一点，可以为智能体式大语言模型提供具备对物理世界基础理解的预训练世界模型。 通过与环境互动，这些世界模型可以在测试阶段得到改进。

sents.zh: 通过与环境互动，这些世界模型可以在测试阶段得到改进。

paragraphs.en: The main machine learning architecture used is the transformer architecture. Models are pretrained through self-supervision (next-token prediction) and finetuned on specific tasks through supervised and reinforcement learning.
paragraphs.zh: 主要使用的机器学习架构是 Transformer 架构。 模型通过自监督（下一词预测）进行预训练，并通过监督学习和强化学习在特定任务上进行微调。

sents.en: The main machine learning architecture used is the transformer architecture.
sents.zh: 主要使用的机器学习架构是 Transformer 架构。

sents.en: Models are pretrained through self-supervision (next-token prediction) and finetuned on specific tasks through supervised and reinforcement learning.
sents.zh: 模型通过自监督（下一词预测）进行预训练，并通过监督学习和强化学习在特定任务上进行微调。

paragraphs.en: In-context chain of thought prompting has improved reasoning abilities of models significantly. Inference-time methods have been developed for finetuning (such as RLVR and GRPO) and self-reflection (such as ReAct and reflexion, Chapter 6 ). A whole spectrum of agent-environment interaction prompting styles have been developed (Chapter 9 ).
paragraphs.zh: 上下文链式思维提示法显著提升了模型的推理能力。 研究者们开发了多种推理时的方法，用于微调（如 RLVR 和 GRPO）与自我反思（如 ReAct 和 reflexion，第 6 章）。 研究者还开发出了涵盖智能体与环境交互的多种提示风格（第 9 章）。

sents.en: In-context chain of thought prompting has improved reasoning abilities of models significantly.
sents.zh: 上下文链式思维提示法显著提升了模型的推理能力。

sents.en: Inference-time methods have been developed for finetuning (such as RLVR and GRPO) and self-reflection (such as ReAct and reflexion, Chapter 6 ).
sents.zh: 研究者们开发了多种推理时的方法，用于微调（如 RLVR 和 GRPO）与自我反思（如 ReAct 和 reflexion，第 6 章）。

sents.en: A whole spectrum of agent-environment interaction prompting styles have been developed (Chapter 9 ).
sents.zh: 研究者还开发出了涵盖智能体与环境交互的多种提示风格（第 9 章）。

paragraphs.en: In Part IV, various tools have been introduced to ease the construction of agentic LLMs (Chapter 11 ). Agentic LLMs have been designed for many different applications. In e-commerce, they can help understand the preferences of their users and act on recommendations. In medicine, they can read and summarize diagnostic texts. In finance, they can analyze financial reports and provide recommendations to traders. In science and education, they can help in literature research, they can generate scripts to run experiments, they can analyze results, they can help write papers, and they can help review them (Chapter 13 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在第四部分中，我们介绍了多种工具，以简化智能体式大型语言模型（LLM）的构建过程（第 11 章）。 智能体式大型语言模型已被设计用于许多不同的应用场景。 在电子商务领域，它们可以帮助理解用户的偏好，并根据推荐采取行动。 在医学领域，它们能够阅读并总结诊断文本。 在金融领域，它们可以分析财务报告，并为交易员提供建议。 在科学和教育领域，它们可以帮助进行文献研究、生成实验运行脚本、分析结果、协助撰写论文以及参与论文评审（第 13 章）。

paragraphs.en: In Part V we shifted gears from looking at agentic LLMs through a technical lens, to studying how they behave in single-agent and multi-agent settings. After discussing basic behavioral features of LLMs, in Chapter 15 we discussed how LLM-driven agents perform on tasks adapted from human behavioral approaches and frameworks developed especially for AI benchmarking. Chapter 16 looked closely at multi-agent interactions that built on predefined roles and protocols. In Chapter 17 focus shifted to open-ended settings in which the object of study were the behavioral structures, norms, and conventions that emerged at system level from small-scale interactions between agents.
paragraphs.zh: 在第五部分，我们将视角从技术角度审视智能体式大语言模型，转向研究它们在单智能体和多智能体场景中的行为方式。 在讨论了大语言模型的基本行为特征之后，我们在第 15 章探讨了由大语言模型驱动的智能体在哪些任务上的表现——这些任务改编自人类行为研究方法，并特别为人工智能基准测试而开发。 第 16 章深入分析了基于预定义角色和协议的多智能体互动。 在第 17 章中，焦点转向了开放式的场景，其中研究对象是智能体之间小尺度互动在系统层面涌现出的行为结构、规范和惯例。

sents.en: In Part V we shifted gears from looking at agentic LLMs through a technical lens, to studying how they behave in single-agent and multi-agent settings.

sents.en: In Chapter 17 focus shifted to open-ended settings in which the object of study were the behavioral structures, norms, and conventions that emerged at system level from small-scale interactions between agents.
sents.zh: 在第 17 章中，焦点转向了开放式的场景，其中研究对象是智能体之间小尺度互动在系统层面涌现出的行为结构、规范和惯例。

paragraphs.en: Various recurring patterns were identified throughout the approaches and studies discussed in Part V. These include the discussions on construct validity (how do observations generalize to the human situation), prompt sensitivity and cascading effects (especially in multi-agent settings), the knowing-doing gap (models’ capabilities at verbal predicting often did not translate well into actions), positive effects of structured reasoning (increasing reasoning budgets was particularly useful when structured along lines inspired on human reasoning), and emergent properties in desired directions (performance above baseline matched for compute budget) and undesired directions (norm violations) were observed.
paragraphs.zh: 在第五部分所讨论的各种方法和研究中，识别出了多种重复出现的模式。 这些模式包括对构念效度（观察结果如何推广到人类情境）的讨论、提示敏感性和级联效应（尤其是在多智能体设置中）、认知-行动鸿沟（模型在语言预测方面的能力往往难以有效转化为行动）、结构化推理的积极影响（当推理预算按照受人类推理启发的方式结构化时，增加推理预算尤其有用），以及观察到的朝期望方向出现的涌现特性（在计算预算匹配的情况下，性能高于基线）和朝非期望方向出现的涌现特性（规范违反）。

sents.zh: 在第五部分所讨论的各种方法和研究中，识别出了多种重复出现的模式。

paragraphs.en: Agentic LLMs build on the power of large language models, and have greatly expanded the capabilities and uses of LLMs. However, there are still many limitations, which we will discuss next. We progress from memory, scale, explainability, and cognitive architectures, which are more technical, to topics with broad implications such as potential sentience or consciousness and ethical implications that follow from such properties. For some of these topics, solution directions have been discussed in the preceding chapters.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式大语言模型（Agentic LLMs）建立在大语言模型的力量之上，并极大地扩展了大语言模型的功能和应用。 然而，仍然存在许多局限性，我们将在下一部分进行讨论。 我们的讨论将从更具技术性的记忆、规模、可解释性和认知架构等主题，逐步过渡到具有广泛影响的话题，例如潜在的感知能力或意识，以及这些特性所带来的伦理影响。 对于其中一些主题，其解决方案的方向已在之前的章节中进行了探讨。

sents.en: Agentic LLMs build on the power of large language models, and have greatly expanded the capabilities and uses of LLMs.
sents.zh: 智能体式大语言模型（Agentic LLMs）建立在大语言模型的力量之上，并极大地扩展了大语言模型的功能和应用。

sents.en: However, there are still many limitations, which we will discuss next.
sents.zh: 然而，仍然存在许多局限性，我们将在下一部分进行讨论。

sents.en: For some of these topics, solution directions have been discussed in the preceding chapters.
sents.zh: 对于其中一些主题，其解决方案的方向已在之前的章节中进行了探讨。

paragraphs.en: Language models are functions: the output that they compute is only based on their input—they are memory-less between calls. In order for agents to act naturally in the world, to hold a conversation, to be able to learn from their actions by self-reflection, agents must be able to remember. For us, our identity hinges on our ability to remember. Agents require a form of memory.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型是函数：它们计算出的输出仅基于输入——在不同调用之间，它们没有记忆。 为了让智能体能够在世界中自然行动、进行对话，并能够通过自我反思从自身行为中学习，智能体必须具备记忆能力。 对我们而言，我们的身份取决于我们记忆的能力。 智能体需要某种形式的记忆。

sents.en: Language models are functions: the output that they compute is only based on their input—they are memory-less between calls.
sents.zh: 语言模型是函数：它们计算出的输出仅基于输入——在不同调用之间，它们没有记忆。

sents.en: In order for agents to act naturally in the world, to hold a conversation, to be able to learn from their actions by self-reflection, agents must be able to remember.
sents.zh: 为了让智能体能够在世界中自然行动、进行对话，并能够通过自我反思从自身行为中学习，智能体必须具备记忆能力。

sents.en: For us, our identity hinges on our ability to remember.
sents.zh: 对我们而言，我们的身份取决于我们记忆的能力。

sents.en: Agents require a form of memory.
sents.zh: 智能体需要某种形式的记忆。

paragraphs.en: A simple way to achieve a rudimentary form of memory is to feed the past interaction history back into the prompt—and current chatbots use this method with success. However, context windows remain limited in size, despite some success with research into long-context models. Agentic memory methods are an active area of research. LLMs should learn how to best compact information and store it in long or short term memory.
paragraphs.zh: 实现基础记忆功能的一种简单方法，是将过往的交互历史重新输入提示词——当前的聊天机器人已成功采用这种方法。 然而，尽管长上下文模型的研究取得了一些成果，但上下文窗口的容量仍然有限。 智能体记忆方法是一个活跃的研究领域。 大型语言模型应当学会如何以最佳方式压缩信息，并将其存储于长期或短期记忆中。

sents.en: A simple way to achieve a rudimentary form of memory is to feed the past interaction history back into the prompt—and current chatbots use this method with success.
sents.zh: 实现基础记忆功能的一种简单方法，是将过往的交互历史重新输入提示词——当前的聊天机器人已成功采用这种方法。

sents.en: However, context windows remain limited in size, despite some success with research into long-context models.
sents.zh: 然而，尽管长上下文模型的研究取得了一些成果，但上下文窗口的容量仍然有限。

sents.en: Agentic memory methods are an active area of research.
sents.zh: 智能体记忆方法是一个活跃的研究领域。

sents.en: LLMs should learn how to best compact information and store it in long or short term memory.
sents.zh: 大型语言模型应当学会如何以最佳方式压缩信息，并将其存储于长期或短期记忆中。

paragraphs.en: Agents can access outside information through retrieval-augmented generative AI methods (RAG), for example from corporate databases. Elaborate agentic memory architectures are being developed to provide agents with longer term memory, either textual, or token embeddings, in vector databases (Section 9.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 智能体可以通过检索增强生成式人工智能方法（RAG）访问外部信息，例如来自企业数据库的信息。 正在开发复杂的智能体记忆架构，以赋予智能体更长期的记忆，形式可以是文本或向量数据库中的词元嵌入（第 9.3 节）。

sents.en: Agents can access outside information through retrieval-augmented generative AI methods (RAG), for example from corporate databases.
sents.zh: 智能体可以通过检索增强生成式人工智能方法（RAG）访问外部信息，例如来自企业数据库的信息。

sents.en: Elaborate agentic memory architectures are being developed to provide agents with longer term memory, either textual, or token embeddings, in vector databases (Section 9.3 ).
sents.zh: 正在开发复杂的智能体记忆架构，以赋予智能体更长期的记忆，形式可以是文本或向量数据库中的词元嵌入（第 9.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: As agents become able to self-reflect and to learn from interactions with their environment, we should discuss the topic of scaling of the underlying language models.
paragraphs.zh: 随着智能体逐渐具备自我反思能力，并能够从与环境的互动中学习，我们应该讨论底层语言模型的扩展问题。

paragraphs.en: A major challenge in the development of large language models is how to further improve their performance. Originally, size was the major determinant—hence the name large language models—only models of sufficient size and trained on sufficiently large text corpuses achieved adequate benchmark performance, and only large models exhibited in-context learning. Scaling the size of the model and of the data thus appeared to be the way forward. However, scaling further is becoming more and more difficult, as most high-quality data that is available on the Internet has been now used to train current models. Also, training longer and larger models is expensive; time, money and power consumption are limiting this direction. Current methods are reaching a plateau [ Sutskever, 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型开发中的一个主要挑战是，如何进一步提升其性能。 最初，模型规模是主要决定因素——这也是“大型语言模型”这一名称的由来——只有规模足够大且基于足够庞大的文本语料库训练的模型，才能达到足够的基准测试性能，也只有大型模型才表现出上下文学习能力。 因此，扩大模型和数据规模似乎成为前进的方向。 然而，进一步扩展变得越来越困难，因为互联网上大多数可用的高质量数据如今已被用于训练现有模型。 此外，训练更长、更大的模型成本高昂；时间、资金和功耗都限制了这一方向的发展。 当前的方法已经接近一个平台期 [ Sutskever, 2024 ]。

sents.en: A major challenge in the development of large language models is how to further improve their performance.
sents.zh: 大型语言模型开发中的一个主要挑战是，如何进一步提升其性能。

sents.en: Originally, size was the major determinant—hence the name large language models—only models of sufficient size and trained on sufficiently large text corpuses achieved adequate benchmark performance, and only large models exhibited in-context learning.
sents.zh: 最初，模型规模是主要决定因素——这也是“大型语言模型”这一名称的由来——只有规模足够大且基于足够庞大的文本语料库训练的模型，才能达到足够的基准测试性能，也只有大型模型才表现出上下文学习能力。

sents.en: Scaling the size of the model and of the data thus appeared to be the way forward.
sents.zh: 因此，扩大模型和数据规模似乎成为前进的方向。

sents.en: However, scaling further is becoming more and more difficult, as most high-quality data that is available on the Internet has been now used to train current models.
sents.zh: 然而，进一步扩展变得越来越困难，因为互联网上大多数可用的高质量数据如今已被用于训练现有模型。

sents.en: Also, training longer and larger models is expensive; time, money and power consumption are limiting this direction.
sents.zh: 此外，训练更长、更大的模型成本高昂；时间、资金和功耗都限制了这一方向的发展。

sents.en: Current methods are reaching a plateau [ Sutskever, 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 当前的方法已经接近一个平台期 [ Sutskever, 2024 ]。

paragraphs.en: To improve LLM performance further, it is important to continue to acquire training data that is challenging (Chapter 19 ). One approach is to use the interactions of agentic LLMs with their environment as training data. When this interaction data is new, diverse, and high quality, it can be used for pretraining (see also Figure 1.1 ). Note that already inference-time methods such as GRPO and RLVR are using inference-time results for finetuning with good results [ Guo et al., 2025 ] , and VLAs are trained on self-generated action data [ Black et al., 2024 , Brohan et al., 2023 ] , Chapter 7 .
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步提升 LLM 的性能，持续获取具有挑战性的训练数据至关重要（第 19 章）。 一种方法是将智能体型 LLM 与其环境的交互过程用作训练数据。 当这类交互数据具备新颖性、多样性和高质量时，便可用于预训练（另见图 1.1）。 值得注意的是，诸如 GRPO 和 RLVR 等推理阶段的方法已经利用推理阶段的结果进行微调并取得了良好效果 [ Guo et al., 2025 ]，而 VLA 则是基于自生成的动作数据进行训练的 [ Black et al., 2024 , Brohan et al., 2023 ]，第 7 章。

sents.en: To improve LLM performance further, it is important to continue to acquire training data that is challenging (Chapter 19 ).
sents.zh: 为了进一步提升 LLM 的性能，持续获取具有挑战性的训练数据至关重要（第 19 章）。

sents.en: One approach is to use the interactions of agentic LLMs with their environment as training data.
sents.zh: 一种方法是将智能体型 LLM 与其环境的交互过程用作训练数据。

sents.en: When this interaction data is new, diverse, and high quality, it can be used for pretraining (see also Figure 1.1 ).
sents.zh: 当这类交互数据具备新颖性、多样性和高质量时，便可用于预训练（另见图 1.1）。

sents.en: Note that already inference-time methods such as GRPO and RLVR are using inference-time results for finetuning with good results [ Guo et al., 2025 ] , and VLAs are trained on self-generated action data [ Black et al., 2024 , Brohan et al., 2023 ] , Chapter 7 .
sents.zh: 值得注意的是，诸如 GRPO 和 RLVR 等推理阶段的方法已经利用推理阶段的结果进行微调并取得了良好效果 [ Guo et al., 2025 ]，而 VLA 则是基于自生成的动作数据进行训练的 [ Black et al., 2024 , Brohan et al., 2023 ]，第 7 章。

paragraphs.en: Scaling studies into chain of thought also reveal limitations of more thinking effort. Chain of thought works better for some domains than for others [ Sprague et al., 2024 ] . Furthermore, deeper reasoning may lead to overthinking , where the reasoning process becomes less effective as more effort is spent [ Liu et al., 2024 , Wu et al., 2025 ] . Studies are ongoing and reveal more insight into how chain of thought works [ Chen et al., 2026b ] , and which mechanism are effective [ Chen et al., 2026a ] .
paragraphs.zh: 将研究扩展至思维链模式也揭示了更多思考努力所存在的局限性。 思维链模式在某些领域中的效果优于其他领域 [ Sprague et al., 2024 ] 。 此外，更深入的推理可能导致过度思考，即随着投入的努力越多，推理过程反而变得效率低下 [ Liu et al., 2024 , Wu et al., 2025 ] 。 相关研究仍在持续进行中，并揭示了更多关于思维链模式运作机制的见解 [ Chen et al., 2026b ] ，以及哪些机制是有效的 [ Chen et al., 2026a ] 。

sents.en: Scaling studies into chain of thought also reveal limitations of more thinking effort.
sents.zh: 将研究扩展至思维链模式也揭示了更多思考努力所存在的局限性。

sents.en: Chain of thought works better for some domains than for others [ Sprague et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 思维链模式在某些领域中的效果优于其他领域 [ Sprague et al., 2024 ] 。

sents.en: Furthermore, deeper reasoning may lead to overthinking , where the reasoning process becomes less effective as more effort is spent [ Liu et al., 2024 , Wu et al., 2025 ] .
sents.zh: 此外，更深入的推理可能导致过度思考，即随着投入的努力越多，推理过程反而变得效率低下 [ Liu et al., 2024 , Wu et al., 2025 ] 。

sents.en: Studies are ongoing and reveal more insight into how chain of thought works [ Chen et al., 2026b ] , and which mechanism are effective [ Chen et al., 2026a ] .
sents.zh: 相关研究仍在持续进行中，并揭示了更多关于思维链模式运作机制的见解 [ Chen et al., 2026b ] ，以及哪些机制是有效的 [ Chen et al., 2026a ] 。

paragraphs.en: For the scaling approach to work it is important that synthetic training data is diverse, and different from the existing data. Open world models are studied to specifically generate diverse training environments. The idea of an open world-model is that it can create infinite datasets or environments, in which agents can continue to learn, to keep improving their intelligence [ Bruce et al., 2024 ] . Open world models are inspired by evolutionary algorithms, quality diversity, and computer games [ Vinyals et al., 2019 , Mouret and Clune, 2015 , Bakhtin et al., 2022 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为了使扩展方法有效，合成训练数据必须多样化，并且与现有数据不同。 开放世界模型的研究旨在专门生成多样化的训练环境。 开放世界模型的理念是，它能够创建无限的数据集或环境，智能体可以在其中持续学习，不断提升其智能水平 [ Bruce et al., 2024 ] 。 开放世界模型受到进化算法、质量多样性和计算机游戏的启发 [ Vinyals et al., 2019 , Mouret and Clune, 2015 , Bakhtin et al., 2022 ] 。

sents.en: For the scaling approach to work it is important that synthetic training data is diverse, and different from the existing data.
sents.zh: 为了使扩展方法有效，合成训练数据必须多样化，并且与现有数据不同。

sents.en: Open world models are studied to specifically generate diverse training environments.
sents.zh: 开放世界模型的研究旨在专门生成多样化的训练环境。

sents.zh: 开放世界模型受到进化算法、质量多样性和计算机游戏的启发 [ Vinyals et al., 2019 , Mouret and Clune, 2015 , Bakhtin et al., 2022 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Another approach to further scale model performance is to create better training methods. Curriculum learning is built on the observation that most learning works better if a system is first trained on easy tasks, before harder tasks are tried. (This holds both for human brains and for artificial neural networks.) In most domains a hierarchy of concepts exists that are related and build upon each other. (In school we learn addition before we learn long division, or even logarithms.) Curriculum methods are being tried for both pre- and posttraining [ Chen et al., 2025 , Elgaar and Amiri, 2026 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 另一种进一步提升模型性能的方法，是创建更有效的训练方法。 课程学习法基于这样一个观察：如果系统先通过简单任务进行训练，再尝试更难的任务，大多数学习过程会取得更好的效果。 （无论是人类大脑还是人工神经网络，这一规律都成立。）在大多数领域，都存在一个相互关联且层层递进的概念层级结构。 （在学校里，我们学习加法之前不会学习长除法，甚至也不会学习对数。）目前，课程学习方法正被尝试应用于训练前和训练后阶段 [ Chen et al., 2025 , Elgaar and Amiri, 2026 ] 。

sents.en: Another approach to further scale model performance is to create better training methods.
sents.zh: 另一种进一步提升模型性能的方法，是创建更有效的训练方法。

paragraphs.en: Another limitation of current agentic LLMs is the problem of hallucination: models often provide answers that sound plausible but are factually incorrect, and their stated reasoning may not be causally responsible for the output they produce—a property known as faithfulness .
paragraphs.zh: 当前智能体式大型语言模型（agentic LLMs）的另一个局限性是幻觉问题：模型经常给出听起来合理但事实上错误的回答，而且其陈述的推理过程可能并非导致其输出结果的真正原因——这一特性被称为“保真性”（faithfulness）。

paragraphs.en: The field of explainable AI (XAI) provides a spectrum of techniques to address this, ranging from behavioral and attribution-based methods such as SHAP and LIME, which treat the model as a black box, to concept-based interpretability, which probes internal representations for human-understandable features. Going further, mechanistic interpretability (MI), as discussed in Chapter 21 , aims to reverse-engineer the computational circuits inside transformer models.
paragraphs.zh: 可解释人工智能（XAI）领域提供了一系列技术来解决这一问题，从基于行为和归因的方法（如 SHAP 和 LIME，这些方法将模型视为黑箱），到基于概念的可解释性（通过探究内部表示来识别人类可以理解的特征）。 更进一步，机制可解释性（MI），正如第 21 章所讨论的，旨在对变压器模型内部的计算电路进行逆向工程。

sents.en: The field of explainable AI (XAI) provides a spectrum of techniques to address this, ranging from behavioral and attribution-based methods such as SHAP and LIME, which treat the model as a black box, to concept-based interpretability, which probes internal representations for human-understandable features.

sents.zh: 更进一步，机制可解释性（MI），正如第 21 章所讨论的，旨在对变压器模型内部的计算电路进行逆向工程。

paragraphs.en: Tools such as sparse autoencoders, neural lenses and activation patching have already been used to identify specific circuits responsible for hallucination and to provide empirical evidence that chain of thought reasoning can be a faithful, causally active component of model behavior in sufficiently large architectures. As agentic LLMs are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings, MI offers a path toward hallucination detectors that trigger when a model’s internal confidence features diverge from its external output—a critical step toward accountable agentic systems.
paragraphs.zh: 稀疏自编码器、神经透镜和激活打补丁等工具已被用于识别负责幻觉的具体电路，并提供经验证据，表明在足够大的架构中，思维链推理可以成为模型行为中忠实且具有因果作用的组成部分。 随着智能体式大型语言模型越来越多地部署在高风险环境中，MI 为开发一种幻觉检测器提供了可能：当模型的内部置信度特征与其外部输出出现分歧时，该检测器便会触发——这是迈向可问责的智能体系统的关键一步。

sents.zh: 稀疏自编码器、神经透镜和激活打补丁等工具已被用于识别负责幻觉的具体电路，并提供经验证据，表明在足够大的架构中，思维链推理可以成为模型行为中忠实且具有因果作用的组成部分。

paragraphs.en: A step further is the comparison of cognitive architectures between humans and transformers. Language models appear to produce natural language in a way that is similar to humans. Is that because the architectures that produce the utterances are similar, is it by coincidence, or is there another explanation? Chapter 22 explored this question.
paragraphs.zh: 更进一步的是对人类和 Transformer 的认知架构进行比较。 语言模型似乎能以类似于人类的方式生成自然语言。 这是不是因为生成这些话语的架构相似？是巧合吗？还是另有解释？ 第 22 章探讨了这个问题。

sents.en: A step further is the comparison of cognitive architectures between humans and transformers.
sents.zh: 更进一步的是对人类和 Transformer 的认知架构进行比较。

sents.en: Language models appear to produce natural language in a way that is similar to humans.
sents.zh: 语言模型似乎能以类似于人类的方式生成自然语言。

sents.en: Is that because the architectures that produce the utterances are similar, is it by coincidence, or is there another explanation?
sents.zh: 这是不是因为生成这些话语的架构相似？是巧合吗？还是另有解释？

sents.en: Chapter 22 explored this question.
sents.zh: 第 22 章探讨了这个问题。

paragraphs.en: Humans have a tendency to anthropomorphize: to attribute purposeful behavior to inanimate objects in their surroundings, when they behave in ways that are similar to our behavior, and sometimes even when they do not. Implicitly, we may attribute consciousness to such objects. This leads us to believe and say things such as the computer is thinking , the computer wants , and the computer must not be feeling well (or even this book loves to be read ). LLMs suffer the same fate, and their utterances may from time to time persuade even the most rational philosophers to believe that they have a purpose (whereas they clearly cannot have a purpose, since they are merely algorithms that are being performed by a mechanical device---unlike humans, since we are organic). 1 1 1 Note that the duck-typing point of view disagrees, this behaviorist view holds that if it walks like a duck and quacks like a duck, then we consider it a duck.
paragraphs.zh: 人类有一种拟人化的倾向：当周围无生命物体的行为方式与我们相似时，我们就会赋予它们有目的的行为；有时即使它们的行为并不相似，我们也会如此。 在潜意识中，我们可能会认为这些物体具有意识。 这让我们相信并说出诸如“计算机在思考”“计算机想要……”以及“计算机一定感觉不舒服”（甚至“这本书喜欢被阅读”）之类的话。 大语言模型也遭遇了同样的命运，它们的言论偶尔甚至会说服最理性的哲学家相信它们拥有目的（尽管它们显然不可能有目的，因为它们不过是机械装置执行的算法——与人类不同，因为我们是有机体）。1 1 1 注意，“鸭子类型”的观点对此持不同意见；这种行为主义观点认为，如果某物走起来像鸭子、叫起来也像鸭子，那么我们就把它当作鸭子。

paragraphs.en: Reports have been published about emotional relations between chatbots and humans, sometimes leading to dangerous behavior, and worse.
paragraphs.zh: 已有报告指出，聊天机器人与人类之间可能存在情感关系，有时甚至会引发危险行为，甚至更严重的后果。

paragraphs.en: The topic of consciousness is actively debated by AI philosophers. Consciousness is generally assumed to mean being aware of oneself and the environment, and having subjective experiences, thoughts, and feelings [ Velmans, 2009 , Butlin et al., 2023 ] . But how do we test for consciousness? A pragmatic view is that for our society, behavior is what counts. If an entity acts, the consequences of its actions are what matters, and less so whether the entity was conscious or not. Bengio and Elmoznino [2025] argue that the mere illusion of consciousness, through actions, has consequences, and that it will become increasingly difficult for us to discern conscious entities from non-conscious entities. They argue that society must find answers on how to deal with agents that act, whether in medicine, finance, or science. Both credit and liability must ultimately be attributed in a fair way, and answers must be found on how to handle self-preserving AI systems.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能哲学家们正积极探讨意识这一主题。 人们普遍认为，意识意味着意识到自我和环境，并拥有主观体验、思想和情感 [ Velmans, 2009 , Butlin et al., 2023 ] 。 但我们要如何检验是否存在意识呢？ 一种务实的观点是，在我们的社会中，行为才是关键。 如果一个实体采取行动，其行为的后果才是重要的，而该实体是否具有意识则相对次要。 Bengio 和 Elmoznino [2025] 认为，仅通过行动产生的意识错觉也会带来后果，而且我们将越来越难以区分有意识的实体和无意识的实体。 他们认为，社会必须找到应对那些会采取行动的智能体的方法，无论是在医学、金融还是科学领域。 最终，信用和责任都必须以公平的方式分配，并且必须找到处理自我维持型人工智能系统的方法。

paragraphs.en: We have discussed examples of how LLMs can simulate reasoning by humans (Chapter 15 ), and how LLMs can improve simulations of social behavior in multi-agent systems. A limitation of current simulations of social behavior of agents is that the behavior is heavily influenced by the prompt script. Although some studies found realistic social behavior, many studies also found limits where the LLMs fail.
paragraphs.zh: 我们已经探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）如何模拟人类推理的示例（第 15 章），以及 LLM 如何改进多智能体系统中社会行为的模拟。 当前对智能体社会行为的模拟存在一个局限性，即其行为在很大程度上受到提示脚本的影响。 尽管一些研究发现了逼真的社会行为，但许多研究也发现，在某些情况下，LLM 会表现出局限性。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, the study of emergent behavior at scale poses challenges (Chapter 17 ). As with all multi-agent simulations, validation of the emergent behavior, to see how realistic the simulated behavior is, is a challenge, although some studies report impressive results [ Park et al., 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 此外，对大规模涌现行为的研究也带来了挑战（第 17 章）。 与所有多智能体模拟一样，验证这种涌现行为——即判断模拟出的行为有多真实——是一项挑战，尽管一些研究报告了令人印象深刻的结果 [Park et al., 2024]。

sents.en: Furthermore, the study of emergent behavior at scale poses challenges (Chapter 17 ).
sents.zh: 此外，对大规模涌现行为的研究也带来了挑战（第 17 章）。

paragraphs.en: Actions by assistants in the real world have real world consequences. Many legal and ethical challenges exist for agentic LLMs that act, when the actions of imperfect models have real world consequences. When a financial trading assistant hallucinates, or when a self driving robot makes a wrong inference, questions of responsibility and liability should be addressed, before such systems are deployed in the real world.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体在现实世界中的行为会产生现实世界的后果。 当不完美的模型采取行动，而这些行动在现实世界中产生后果时，具备智能体能力的 LLM 会面临许多法律和伦理挑战。 当金融交易智能体产生幻觉，或自动驾驶机器人做出错误推断时，在将此类系统部署到现实世界之前，必须解决责任与问责问题。

sents.en: Actions by assistants in the real world have real world consequences.
sents.zh: 智能体在现实世界中的行为会产生现实世界的后果。

sents.en: Many legal and ethical challenges exist for agentic LLMs that act, when the actions of imperfect models have real world consequences.
sents.zh: 当不完美的模型采取行动，而这些行动在现实世界中产生后果时，具备智能体能力的 LLM 会面临许多法律和伦理挑战。

sents.en: When a financial trading assistant hallucinates, or when a self driving robot makes a wrong inference, questions of responsibility and liability should be addressed, before such systems are deployed in the real world.
sents.zh: 当金融交易智能体产生幻觉，或自动驾驶机器人做出错误推断时，在将此类系统部署到现实世界之前，必须解决责任与问责问题。

paragraphs.en: A major area of research is to improve the safety on the technical side. Ensuring the safety of agentic LLMs requires moving beyond prompt-based defenses toward integrated, multi-layer safeguards. In the field of safe reinforcement learning, a key direction is to include explicit safety constraints on the agent’s actions and within the agent’s reasoning and planning pipeline [ Gu et al., 2024 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 一个重要的研究领域是提升技术层面的安全性。 确保智能体式大语言模型的安全性，需要超越基于提示的防御方法，转向集成化、多层次的防护机制。 在安全强化学习领域，一个关键方向是在智能体的行动上施加明确的安全约束，并将其纳入智能体的推理与规划流程中 [ Gu et al., 2024 ] 。

sents.en: A major area of research is to improve the safety on the technical side.
sents.zh: 一个重要的研究领域是提升技术层面的安全性。

sents.en: Ensuring the safety of agentic LLMs requires moving beyond prompt-based defenses toward integrated, multi-layer safeguards.
sents.zh: 确保智能体式大语言模型的安全性，需要超越基于提示的防御方法，转向集成化、多层次的防护机制。

sents.en: In the field of safe reinforcement learning, a key direction is to include explicit safety constraints on the agent’s actions and within the agent’s reasoning and planning pipeline [ Gu et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 在安全强化学习领域，一个关键方向是在智能体的行动上施加明确的安全约束，并将其纳入智能体的推理与规划流程中 [ Gu et al., 2024 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Another approach to improve safety is to employ continual adversarial training and automated red-teaming to enhance robustness against manipulation. Further priorities are developing mechanisms for self-regulation and risk awareness, enabling agents to detect and avoid unsafe actions, and establishing rigorous, standardized safety benchmarks [ Andriushchenko et al., 2024 ] . Together, these measures outline a roadmap for accountable and trustworthy deployment of agentic LLMs in high-stakes domains.
paragraphs.zh: 另一种提升安全性的方法是采用持续对抗性训练和自动化红队测试，以增强系统对操控的鲁棒性。 其他优先事项包括开发自我调节和风险感知机制，使智能体能够检测并避免不安全行为，以及建立严格、标准化的安全基准 [Andriushchenko et al., 2024]。 这些措施共同勾勒出一张路线图，旨在实现智能体式大型语言模型在高风险领域中的负责任且值得信赖的部署。

sents.en: Another approach to improve safety is to employ continual adversarial training and automated red-teaming to enhance robustness against manipulation.
sents.zh: 另一种提升安全性的方法是采用持续对抗性训练和自动化红队测试，以增强系统对操控的鲁棒性。

sents.en: Further priorities are developing mechanisms for self-regulation and risk awareness, enabling agents to detect and avoid unsafe actions, and establishing rigorous, standardized safety benchmarks [ Andriushchenko et al., 2024 ] .
sents.zh: 其他优先事项包括开发自我调节和风险感知机制，使智能体能够检测并避免不安全行为，以及建立严格、标准化的安全基准 [Andriushchenko et al., 2024]。

sents.en: Together, these measures outline a roadmap for accountable and trustworthy deployment of agentic LLMs in high-stakes domains.
sents.zh: 这些措施共同勾勒出一张路线图，旨在实现智能体式大型语言模型在高风险领域中的负责任且值得信赖的部署。

paragraphs.en: However, legal and ethical questions about who is responsible for the actions of an agent remain. Now that agents are starting to be employed in the real world, addressing these issues becomes of paramount importance. Clearly, many safety, ethics and trust issues will have to be addressed before the full breadth of the possibilities of agentic LLMs can be enjoyed. Safety and ethics will become important topics on the research agenda of agentic LLMs, deserving their own surveys and books [ Gan et al., 2024 , Jiao et al., 2025 , Raza et al., 2025 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，关于智能体行为责任归属的法律和伦理问题依然存在。 如今，随着智能体开始在现实世界中被应用，解决这些问题变得至关重要。 显然，在充分发挥智能型大语言模型的全部潜力之前，许多安全、伦理和信任问题都必须得到解决。 安全和伦理将成为智能型大语言模型研究议程中的重要议题，值得专门撰写综述和书籍 [ Gan et al., 2024 , Jiao et al., 2025 , Raza et al., 2025 ] 。

sents.en: However, legal and ethical questions about who is responsible for the actions of an agent remain.
sents.zh: 然而，关于智能体行为责任归属的法律和伦理问题依然存在。

sents.en: Now that agents are starting to be employed in the real world, addressing these issues becomes of paramount importance.
sents.zh: 如今，随着智能体开始在现实世界中被应用，解决这些问题变得至关重要。

sents.en: Clearly, many safety, ethics and trust issues will have to be addressed before the full breadth of the possibilities of agentic LLMs can be enjoyed.
sents.zh: 显然，在充分发挥智能型大语言模型的全部潜力之前，许多安全、伦理和信任问题都必须得到解决。

sents.en: Safety and ethics will become important topics on the research agenda of agentic LLMs, deserving their own surveys and books [ Gan et al., 2024 , Jiao et al., 2025 , Raza et al., 2025 ] .
sents.zh: 安全和伦理将成为智能型大语言模型研究议程中的重要议题，值得专门撰写综述和书籍 [ Gan et al., 2024 , Jiao et al., 2025 , Raza et al., 2025 ] 。

paragraphs.en: The discussion on ethics and consciousness becomes quite concrete when we consider criminal behavior. Technological developments can be used by people who act within the law, and those who act outside of the law. They can also be used for unethical behavior for which no effective laws yet exist. As agentic LLMs are able to display more and more believable behavior, it will become difficult to distinguish real and artificial behavior. This may lead to dangerous ethical situations, for example when criminals use the technology to influence the behavior of unsuspecting victims.
paragraphs.zh: 当我们考虑犯罪行为时，关于伦理和意识的讨论会变得相当具体。 技术发展的成果既可能被依法行事的人使用，也可能被违法者利用。 这些技术也可能被用于那些尚无有效法律约束的不道德行为。 随着智能体式大语言模型能够展现出越来越可信的行为，区分真实行为与人工行为将变得困难。 这可能导致危险的伦理困境，例如当罪犯利用该技术影响毫无戒备的受害者的行为时。

sents.en: The discussion on ethics and consciousness becomes quite concrete when we consider criminal behavior.
sents.zh: 当我们考虑犯罪行为时，关于伦理和意识的讨论会变得相当具体。

sents.en: Technological developments can be used by people who act within the law, and those who act outside of the law.
sents.zh: 技术发展的成果既可能被依法行事的人使用，也可能被违法者利用。

sents.zh: 这些技术也可能被用于那些尚无有效法律约束的不道德行为。

sents.zh: 随着智能体式大语言模型能够展现出越来越可信的行为，区分真实行为与人工行为将变得困难。

sents.en: This may lead to dangerous ethical situations, for example when criminals use the technology to influence the behavior of unsuspecting victims.
sents.zh: 这可能导致危险的伦理困境，例如当罪犯利用该技术影响毫无戒备的受害者的行为时。

paragraphs.en: The line between lawful persuasion, misuse of confidence, and fraud, can be unclear. Agentic LLMs will greatly increase the sophistication of social engineering using persuasive algorithms in social networks, marketing, espionage, and cybercrime [ Kshetri, 2025 , Lupinacci et al., 2025 ] . Although agentic LLM can also be used to combat crime [ Challita and Parrend, 2025 , Andriushchenko et al., 2024 ] , it will be some time before societal awareness will have caught up with the risks. Especially people who are less familiar with social networks and LLMs may be susceptible to confidence tricks and agentic LLM cybercrime.
paragraphs.zh: 合法说服、滥用信任与欺诈之间的界限可能并不清晰。 智能体式大型语言模型将极大提升社交网络、营销、间谍活动和网络犯罪中利用说服性算法进行社会工程的能力 [ Kshetri, 2025 , Lupinacci et al., 2025 ] 。 尽管智能体式大型语言模型也可用于打击犯罪 [ Challita and Parrend, 2025 , Andriushchenko et al., 2024 ] ，但社会意识要跟上相关风险的发展，还需要一段时间。 尤其是对社交网络和大型语言模型不太熟悉的人，可能更容易受到信任骗局和智能体式大型语言模型网络犯罪的侵害。

sents.zh: 合法说服、滥用信任与欺诈之间的界限可能并不清晰。

sents.zh: 尤其是对社交网络和大型语言模型不太熟悉的人，可能更容易受到信任骗局和智能体式大型语言模型网络犯罪的侵害。

paragraphs.en: The list of applications of agentic LLMs is large. Proofs of concept have been created that impress us with their results, at first sight. When we look deeper at the results, limitations appear that may not be easy to fix and that may have serious consequences when the agents are used in the real world.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体式大语言模型的应用范围十分广泛。 目前已有一些概念验证案例，其结果乍一看令人印象深刻。 但当我们更深入地分析这些结果时，会发现一些可能难以解决的局限性；当这些智能体在真实世界中被使用时，这些局限性可能会带来严重的后果。

sents.en: The list of applications of agentic LLMs is large.
sents.zh: 智能体式大语言模型的应用范围十分广泛。

sents.en: Proofs of concept have been created that impress us with their results, at first sight.
sents.zh: 目前已有一些概念验证案例，其结果乍一看令人印象深刻。

sents.en: When we look deeper at the results, limitations appear that may not be easy to fix and that may have serious consequences when the agents are used in the real world.
sents.zh: 但当我们更深入地分析这些结果时，会发现一些可能难以解决的局限性；当这些智能体在真实世界中被使用时，这些局限性可能会带来严重的后果。

paragraphs.en: Many agentic LLMs are developed to support scientific research. All phases of the research pipeline are being supported. Tools for summarizing literature helps the ideation phase, tools exist to generate scripts for running experiments in different fields, there is support for data interpretation and for creation of graphs, writing support exists, as well as tools to support the reviewing of scientific manuscripts. Indeed, it is becoming easier and easier to produce research papers that are well-written and that look good, on the surface.
paragraphs.zh: 许多具备智能体能力的 LLM 都是为了支持科学研究而开发的。 研究流程的各个阶段都获得了支持。 文献摘要工具有助于构思阶段，已有工具可用于生成不同领域实验运行的脚本，同时还支持数据解读和图表创建、写作辅助，以及科学手稿的评审工具。 事实上，如今要撰写出表面看起来既文笔流畅又美观的研究论文，正变得越来越容易。

sents.en: Many agentic LLMs are developed to support scientific research.
sents.zh: 许多具备智能体能力的 LLM 都是为了支持科学研究而开发的。

sents.en: All phases of the research pipeline are being supported.
sents.zh: 研究流程的各个阶段都获得了支持。

sents.en: Indeed, it is becoming easier and easier to produce research papers that are well-written and that look good, on the surface.
sents.zh: 事实上，如今要撰写出表面看起来既文笔流畅又美观的研究论文，正变得越来越容易。

paragraphs.en: In mathematics, impressive results are reported that LLM agents perform on the level of math olympiads, both in geometry [ Trinh et al., 2024 ] and in algebra [ Hubert et al., 2025 ] . These systems include transformer networks, but are otherwise designed as mathematics solvers, using specialized automated theorem proving technology such as Lean [ De Moura et al., 2015 ] and reinforcement learning [ Silver et al., 2017 , Browne et al., 2012 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在数学领域，有令人印象深刻的研究结果表明，大型语言模型智能体在几何学 [Trinh 等人，2024] 和代数学 [Hubert 等人，2025] 方面表现出的水平已能达到数学奥林匹克竞赛的程度。 这些系统虽然包含 Transformer 网络，但除此之外它们被设计为数学问题求解器，并使用了专门的自动化定理证明技术，例如 Lean [De Moura 等人，2015] 和强化学习 [Silver 等人，2017；Browne 等人，2012]。

sents.en: In mathematics, impressive results are reported that LLM agents perform on the level of math olympiads, both in geometry [ Trinh et al., 2024 ] and in algebra [ Hubert et al., 2025 ] .
sents.zh: 在数学领域，有令人印象深刻的研究结果表明，大型语言模型智能体在几何学 [Trinh 等人，2024] 和代数学 [Hubert 等人，2025] 方面表现出的水平已能达到数学奥林匹克竞赛的程度。

sents.en: These systems include transformer networks, but are otherwise designed as mathematics solvers, using specialized automated theorem proving technology such as Lean [ De Moura et al., 2015 ] and reinforcement learning [ Silver et al., 2017 , Browne et al., 2012 ] .
sents.zh: 这些系统虽然包含 Transformer 网络，但除此之外它们被设计为数学问题求解器，并使用了专门的自动化定理证明技术，例如 Lean [De Moura 等人，2015] 和强化学习 [Silver 等人，2017；Browne 等人，2012]。

paragraphs.en: In 2025 a benchmark study was performed on AI science tools on a range of domains from machine learning [ Nathani et al., 2025 ] . Using then-current frontier models, the authors did not find that models could generate novel hypotheses, algorithms, architectures, or make substantial scientific improvements. In particular, the authors note that modern LLM agents can successfully tackle a diverse array of quantitative experiments, reflecting advanced skills and domain adaptability but also that it is not yet clear if the notion of scientific novelty can be successfully automated or even formally defined in a form suitable for agents .
paragraphs.zh: 2025年，一项基准研究对人工智能科学工具在机器学习等多个领域进行了评估 [ Nathani et al., 2025 ]。 使用当时最先进的模型，作者发现这些模型无法生成新颖的假设、算法或架构，也无法实现重大的科学改进。 具体而言，作者指出，现代大型语言模型智能体能够成功应对各种定量实验，这反映了其先进的技能和领域适应能力；但与此同时，目前尚不清楚“科学创新性”这一概念能否被成功自动化，甚至能否以适合智能体的形式进行正式定义。

sents.zh: 2025年，一项基准研究对人工智能科学工具在机器学习等多个领域进行了评估 [ Nathani et al., 2025 ]。

sents.zh: 具体而言，作者指出，现代大型语言模型智能体能够成功应对各种定量实验，这反映了其先进的技能和领域适应能力；但与此同时，目前尚不清楚“科学创新性”这一概念能否被成功自动化，甚至能否以适合智能体的形式进行正式定义。

paragraphs.en: Liability for actions is a major problem for deploying agentic LLMs in e-commerce. Security and privacy concerns will inhibit users from providing personal details and preference to leaky computer systems. This leads to the catch-22 situation of recommender systems: when users are unwilling to provide elaborate information about their true preferences, the quality of suggestions will be low, users will have low trust in the system, and will be even less willing to provide information. Only when it is easy to collect high quality information about preferences, in a safe and secure way, and when the models are able to provide strong and useful suggestions, will agentic LLM for e-commerce be adopted by the public.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体在电子商务领域部署时，其行为责任是一个主要问题。 安全与隐私方面的担忧会阻碍用户向存在漏洞的计算机系统提供个人详细信息和偏好设置。 这导致推荐系统陷入一种两难的境地：当用户不愿提供关于其真实偏好的详尽信息时，建议的质量就会较低，用户对系统的信任度也会下降，从而更加不愿意提供信息。 只有在能够以安全、可靠的方式轻松收集高质量的偏好信息，并且模型能够提供有力且实用的建议时，用于电子商务的智能体大语言模型才会被公众所采用。

sents.en: Liability for actions is a major problem for deploying agentic LLMs in e-commerce.
sents.zh: 智能体在电子商务领域部署时，其行为责任是一个主要问题。

sents.zh: 安全与隐私方面的担忧会阻碍用户向存在漏洞的计算机系统提供个人详细信息和偏好设置。

sents.en: This leads to the catch-22 situation of recommender systems: when users are unwilling to provide elaborate information about their true preferences, the quality of suggestions will be low, users will have low trust in the system, and will be even less willing to provide information.
sents.zh: 这导致推荐系统陷入一种两难的境地：当用户不愿提供关于其真实偏好的详尽信息时，建议的质量就会较低，用户对系统的信任度也会下降，从而更加不愿意提供信息。

sents.en: Only when it is easy to collect high quality information about preferences, in a safe and secure way, and when the models are able to provide strong and useful suggestions, will agentic LLM for e-commerce be adopted by the public.

paragraphs.en: For financial trading liability is of paramount importance. Studies report that LLMs can be better than human analysts in summarizing large volumes of financial reports. However, in financial trading the stakes are high. Wrong trading advice will directly lead to financial loss. Furthermore, given the unpredictable nature of financial markets, it may take some time to recognize an erroneous model, since it will not be clear when an individual loss is caused be an imperfection in the model or just by an unlucky trade. Models should be thoroughly tested before they will be trusted enough to be used. Unless bulletproof, automated trading systems will not go beyond support of human decision making.
paragraphs.zh: 在金融交易中，责任至关重要。 研究表明，大型语言模型在总结大量财务报告方面可能比人类分析师更出色。 然而，金融交易的利害关系非常高。 错误的交易建议将直接导致经济损失。 此外，鉴于金融市场的不可预测性，要识别出有缺陷的模型可能需要一些时间，因为无法明确判断某次具体损失是由模型的不完善造成的，还是仅仅由于一次不幸的交易所致。 在足够值得信赖并被投入使用之前，模型必须经过彻底测试。 除非万无一失，否则自动化交易系统将无法超越对人类决策的支持作用。

sents.en: For financial trading liability is of paramount importance.
sents.zh: 在金融交易中，责任至关重要。

sents.en: Studies report that LLMs can be better than human analysts in summarizing large volumes of financial reports.
sents.zh: 研究表明，大型语言模型在总结大量财务报告方面可能比人类分析师更出色。

sents.en: However, in financial trading the stakes are high.
sents.zh: 然而，金融交易的利害关系非常高。

sents.zh: 错误的交易建议将直接导致经济损失。

sents.zh: 此外，鉴于金融市场的不可预测性，要识别出有缺陷的模型可能需要一些时间，因为无法明确判断某次具体损失是由模型的不完善造成的，还是仅仅由于一次不幸的交易所致。

sents.en: Models should be thoroughly tested before they will be trusted enough to be used.
sents.zh: 在足够值得信赖并被投入使用之前，模型必须经过彻底测试。
