sents.zh: 除非万无一失，否则自动化交易系统将无法超越对人类决策的支持作用。

paragraphs.en: LLMs in finance are mostly successful in analyzing textual reports. For time series analysis of financial data some results are published, but it is hard to achieve reliable and verifiable benchmark results. Although some studies claim good results, others report that predictions by agentic LLM of financial market results remain in doubt [ Li et al., 2026 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 金融领域的 LLM 在分析文本报告方面大多取得了成功。 关于金融数据的时间序列分析，虽然已有部分研究成果发表，但要获得可靠且可验证的基准结果仍然困难。 尽管一些研究声称取得了良好结果，但另一些研究指出，智能体型 LLM 对金融市场结果的预测仍存在疑问 [ Li et al., 2026 ] 。

sents.en: LLMs in finance are mostly successful in analyzing textual reports.
sents.zh: 金融领域的 LLM 在分析文本报告方面大多取得了成功。

sents.en: For time series analysis of financial data some results are published, but it is hard to achieve reliable and verifiable benchmark results.
sents.zh: 关于金融数据的时间序列分析，虽然已有部分研究成果发表，但要获得可靠且可验证的基准结果仍然困难。

sents.en: Although some studies claim good results, others report that predictions by agentic LLM of financial market results remain in doubt [ Li et al., 2026 ] .
sents.zh: 尽管一些研究声称取得了良好结果，但另一些研究指出，智能体型 LLM 对金融市场结果的预测仍存在疑问 [ Li et al., 2026 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Accuracy and especially explainability of results are even more important for trustworthiness in medicine. In medicine, model predictions are directly related to liability and ethics of actions. For medical applications, explainability of results is essential, and agentic LLM systems will include a human in the decision making loop.
paragraphs.zh: 在医学领域，结果的准确性，尤其是可解释性，对于建立信任而言更为重要。 在医学中，模型预测与行为的法律责任和伦理问题直接相关。 对于医疗应用而言，结果的可解释性至关重要，而智能体式的大语言模型系统将在决策流程中引入人类参与。

paragraphs.en: As in trading, the most promising results of agentic LLM in medicine are in the analysis and summarization of textual documents, such as meeting reports or literature surveys. Results in other applications, such as decisions on treatment plans, or performing operations, are limited.
paragraphs.zh: 与交易领域类似，智能体式大型语言模型在医学中最有前景的成果体现在文本文件（如会议报告或文献综述）的分析与摘要生成方面。 在其他应用中的成果则较为有限，例如治疗方案的决策或手术操作的执行。

paragraphs.en: Medicine might well be one of the most valuable and at the same time one of the most conservative fields of application for agentic LLM. In matters of life and death, we should be extra careful, and at the same time the potential gains are large.
paragraphs.zh: 医疗领域或许正是智能体大语言模型最具价值，同时也是最保守的应用领域之一。 在生死攸关的问题上，我们应当格外谨慎，而与此同时，其潜在收益也十分巨大。

paragraphs.en: Agentic LLM technology is developing at a rapid pace. This book has traced that development across three interconnected pillars: reasoning , acting , and interacting . Reasoning LLMs provide the cognitive foundation, through chain of thought, self-reflection, and retrieval augmentation: models have become capable of multi-step problem solving, literature synthesis, and complex decision support. Acting agents extend this foundation into the real world, using tools, APIs, and world models to assist users in domains from robotics to finance to medicine. Interacting agents go further still, engaging with one another in multi-agent simulations that exhibit emergent social behaviors such as cooperation, trust, and norm formation, that were not explicitly scripted in the prompts.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体大语言模型技术正在飞速发展。 本书追溯了这一发展过程，其贯穿三个相互关联的支柱：推理、行动与互动。 推理型大语言模型提供了认知基础，通过思维链、自我反思和检索增强，模型已具备多步骤问题解决、文献综合和复杂决策支持的能力。 行动型智能体将这一基础延伸至现实世界，利用工具、API 和世界模型，在从机器人学到金融再到医学的各个领域协助用户。 互动型智能体更进一步，它们通过多智能体模拟相互协作，展现出合作、信任和规范形成等涌现性社会行为，而这些行为并未在提示中被明确设定。

sents.en: Agentic LLM technology is developing at a rapid pace.
sents.zh: 智能体大语言模型技术正在飞速发展。

paragraphs.en: These three pillars are connected. As Figure 1.1 illustrates, they form a cycle: reasoning enables better acting and interacting, while the data generated by (inter)acting agents can be used to pretrain and finetune better reasoning models. This virtuous cycle offers a promising path beyond plateaus in LLM scaling, as inference-time interaction data from agentic assistants, robotic systems, and multi-agent simulations, provides a continuously replenishing source of high-quality, diverse training signals.
paragraphs.zh: 这三个支柱是相互连接的。 如图 1.1 所示，它们构成了一个循环：推理能够促进更有效的行动与互动，而智能体在（相互）行动中生成的数据，可用于预训练和微调更强大的推理模型。 这一良性循环为突破大型语言模型扩展中的平台期提供了一条有前景的路径，因为来自智能体助手、机器人系统和多智能体模拟的推理阶段互动数据，能够持续提供高质量且多样化的训练信号。

paragraphs.en: Yet, significant challenges remain across all three pillars. Hallucination undermines trust in reasoning chains and threatens the stability of self-improving systems. Safety, liability, and ethical accountability are unresolved for acting agents in high-stakes domains. Emergent behavior in large-scale multi-agent systems remains difficult to validate and control. Further research in the fields of mechanistic interpretability, open world models, scalable simulation infrastructures, and robust safety benchmarks is required to overcome these challenges.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在所有三个支柱领域，仍然存在重大挑战。 幻觉会削弱对推理链的信任，并威胁到自我改进系统的稳定性。 对于在高风险领域执行行动的智能体而言，安全性、责任以及伦理问责制等问题尚未解决。 大规模多智能体系统中涌现出的行为仍然难以验证和控制。 为了克服这些挑战，需要在机制可解释性、开放世界模型、可扩展的模拟基础设施和稳健的安全基准等领域开展进一步的研究。

sents.zh: 幻觉会削弱对推理链的信任，并威胁到自我改进系统的稳定性。

sents.en: Emergent behavior in large-scale multi-agent systems remains difficult to validate and control.
sents.zh: 大规模多智能体系统中涌现出的行为仍然难以验证和控制。

sents.en: Further research in the fields of mechanistic interpretability, open world models, scalable simulation infrastructures, and robust safety benchmarks is required to overcome these challenges.
sents.zh: 为了克服这些挑战，需要在机制可解释性、开放世界模型、可扩展的模拟基础设施和稳健的安全基准等领域开展进一步的研究。

paragraphs.en: We are at an early and consequential moment. Proofs of concept are impressive; real-world deployments are beginning; and the theoretical foundations—of memory, metacognition, consciousness, and collective intelligence—remain open questions that connect artificial intelligence to philosophy, cognitive science and law. This book has aimed to give you the technical grounding and conceptual vocabulary to contribute to these questions. The field needs researchers who understand both the power and the limits of what agentic LLMs can do today, and who can help shape what they will become tomorrow.
paragraphs.zh: 我们正处在一个早期但意义深远的时刻。 概念验证令人印象深刻；实际应用已经开始；而关于记忆、元认知、意识和集体智能的理论基础，仍然是悬而未决的问题，这些问题将人工智能与哲学、认知科学和法律联系了起来。 本书旨在为你提供技术基础和概念词汇，以便你能够参与对这些问题的探讨。 这一领域需要既理解当前智能体式大型语言模型的能力与局限，又能帮助塑造其未来形态的研究人员。
